stays.name: Xuehua Ya Ju Homestay
stays.description: Wang Gong is a small fishing village in western Taiwan. Some of the villagers who were relying on raising oysters and shelling oysters for a living, and some were relying on raising laying hens. In recent years due to the thriving tourism industry, villagers providing gourmet food services with oyster cars are correspondingly increased. The folk custom is quite simple and honest. Coming to stay here, you can enjoy oysters cuisine, watch the sunset, oyster fields, egrets forest, and fiddler crabs; playing with sand bathing, blowing sea breeze, and enjoying the beauty of nature. In this piece of intertidal zone, there are numerous ecological activities, waiting for you to visit. Our B&B is a traditional Sanhe Yuan house of Minnan style. B&B lived a 90-year-old white-haired grandma, a friend from Indonesia, a handsome Labrador stray dog, and me. Here is where I grew up and is also my mother's family home. Welcome you to my hometown to experience the intertidal ecology, the mien of the fishing village, traditional Sanhe Yuan building, and making friend with enthusiastic villagers. I believe that if you stroll through the alleys of low wall, you are sure to find out more.... Thank you very much.

stays.description: Tongnian Wangshì B&B is the first legitimate B&B in Lukang, located behind the tour bus parking lot of Tin Hau Temple, and about 600 meters from Tin Hau Temple and Lukang Street. You can stroll through the Lukang Street and the nearest B&B to the Historic District. The B&B covers over an area of 2,640 square meters. It is an new nostalgic manor that Mr. Wu Zhizhong, the owner, has carefully built. It features volleyball courts, basketball courts, children's play area, lawn area, barbecue area, happy farm and other facilities ~ Tongnian Wangshì B&B is an artistc architecture that combines baroque architecture and Fujian-style Sanhe Yuan houses. Each room is well designed, and the host furnished the rooms with his collections accumulated for many years to make each room like a small museum. Through the host's collections, you can restore the lost part of childhood. Let your life back to your childhood memories and ponder over the past events ~ let you savor true life, humanity goodness, and the beauty of history, so that Taiwan's culture has become a part of the continuation of life.

stays.name: Yau Xian Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: Located outside Lukang Old Street, it is quite quiet at night, allowing you to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the city~The purpose of the B&B is to provide travelers with the comfort and quality of their own home. The hospitable owner of the B&B will occasionally make tea for the travelers and chat with them, recommending must-visit snacks and restaurants in Lukang, as well as introducing historical sites and attractions. What is the itinerary like? The arrangement is relatively smooth and stable, and I hope it can bring more joy and convenience to everyone.The layout of the B&B is very warm, and the room price is very affordable (breakfast is provided in every room). It also provides parking spaces for self-driving travelers, which is very convenient!Lukang has a strong human touch and good quality and cheap things. Everyone is welcome to come and explore together!

stays.name: A Day in Lukang
stays.description: One day Lukang B&B is located in the quiet alley next to the Lukang Town Land Office, which was originally planned by the owner as a retirement to return to his hometown for self-residence, and the gardening and landscaping design and room layout inside and outside the building are all created by DIY by his own family, minus the commercial atmosphere, so that visitors have a feeling of going home. Although the visitors did not grow up in Lukang Town, they came to the town for a day trip and stayed overnight to enjoy the quaint and leisurely fun of the town, and became Lukang people for a day. If there is an opportunity to land deep roots here, passers-by can also be returnees, and one day Lukang people can also be Lukang people forever.

stays.name: Yuan Lin Hotel
stays.description: Yuan Lin Hotel is situated on the Sanyi Rd., Yuanlin. The convenient shopping mall, commercial building, train station and expressway nearby is our competitive edge. The shopping area is only a 10 minutes' walk from our hotel. The Tien Wei Highway Garden is just 4km away. It only takes you 5 minutes to drive to the Provincial Highway 76 from which you can go to Lukang, Puxin or everywhere with ease. As you enter the hotel lobby, you can see the furnishings that are different from common business hotels. You can admire well-chosen art works and paintings at every corner of the hotel. These art collections can not only enhance the taste of the entire hotel, but give every guest a sense of art. In addition, all of our furniture has been tailored to match different rooms and interior design. This creates a sense of simple and implicit luxury to amaze the guests. Yuan Lin Hotel focuses on a service quality that's better than 5 star hotels. We extend our services from the smallest details to guests with all kinds of needs. We hope that every of our guests can experience an "consistent quality" of service from check in to check out, not just a passionate reception that only appears when you first come to the hotel. Yuan Lin Hotel offers our guests a definitely private and quiet space to live in. Every guest will receive a dedicated room card. Only with this card can you go in and out freely. This way, your safety is fully guaranteed. We wish every of our staff can be professional, thoughtful, sincere and attentive. Every guest who comes to Yuan Lin Hotel, no matter a business person or a traveler, is the most important person that we have to treat with care. Our staff are all well-trained and they attend staff meetings periodically. Our general manager will coach them all service etiquette in person. Perhaps it's our staff's profession and duty to serve every guest, but to the guests, it's meticulous, tailored and sincere service what they can perceive. Yuan Lin Hotel's professional image and reputation is your best choice. We invite you to our hotel with true heart. Let us provide you the greatest service.

stays.name: Hotel Taiwan Changhua
stays.description: Sincere Service - A Home Away From Home Hotel Taiwan has 50 years of history. It's located next to the train station in downtown Changhua, a convenient location for tourism and business. In order to provide better service and a better environment, a large sum of money was spent to redecorate the hotel. The updated hotel has improved facilities and presents a modern and spacious new look. The staff here are friendly, warm and sincere. Decorative Art - Hand-carved Stone Art by Artist, Yen Yun-lian Our motel houses eight large scale hand-carved stone art created by the master abstract artist, Yen Yun-lian. Mr. Yen became well-known for designing Taipei's Bolero Restaurant, thus becoming Taiwan's number one interior designer. He is also the original creator who incorporated geometric abstract compositions into interior design. He is referred as The First Taiwanese Abstract Artist, enjoying equal popularity as abstract artists Zhao Wo-ki and Chu Teh-chun. Warm, Bright and Modern Guestrooms Hotel Taiwan has 45 exquisite and modern guestrooms. Each room has brand new Toto bathroom fixtures, 32" LCD TV, furniture sets, silent refrigerator, airtight windows, fireproof door, fiber broadband internet and independent air conditioning system. Every room is decorated differntly, but are all warm and comfortable.

stays.name: Jincheng Hostel
stays.description: Jincheng Hostel has a nostalgic and modern industrial style, and a variety of room types; in addition to a variety of suites with different themes, there are women-only backpacking rooms on the second floor and men-only backpacking rooms on the third floor. In addition to a variety of suites with different themes, there is also a backpacking room for women on the second floor and a backpacking room for men on the third floor, which is divided into male and female sections for privacy and safety. The interior materials used include glass tile walls, lattice tiles, red bricks, bare bricks and metal sheets, giving a lively yet vintage flavor to the calm space. The interior of the house is made of glass tile walls, lattice tiles, red bricks, bare bricks and metal sheets, giving a lively and retro flavor to the stable space. In addition, the warm wood texture presents a strong industrial design style, allowing people to linger in a time corridor where the old and the new are intertwined with the retro and fashionable. The time corridor where old and new are intertwined. In addition to the comfortable lobby to receive travelers, the seating area is designed like a small bar, where travelers can relax by the glass seats. The seating area is designed like a small bar, where travelers can take a break and enjoy the sunshine that falls freely on them. The winding staircase on the patio, the bright light from the patio, like walking into the past time, stopping in your heart and mine! The balcony retains the boiler that used to boil hot water, the mottled rust, accompanied by a small light bulb, tells the story of the past. It also creates a brand new look for Jincheng hostel.

stays.description: Changhua Laurel Motel has a unique style. The only common element is the bed of presidential suite level, which is offered without considering cost, and provide passengers with comfortable, respectful, considerate and warm service. Changhua Laurel Motel is the first hotel passed the highest ISO9001: 2008 international quality certification, won Happy Stay 100 sponsored by the Tourism Bureau and Taiwan Top 100 by vote organized by the Taiwan Travel News. Affectionate Changhua, attentive Laurel Motel, and sincere treatment, unswerving from start to finish.

stays.name: GUN YAKUSHO(B&B)
stays.description: nonNo Old City Memories, Just a Night& #39;s Stroll – A Timeless Walk Near Chiayi City HallChiayi, having witnessed the vicissitudes of time, possesses a charm that time cannot erase. As the humble innkeeper of this guesthouse, I always love to sit on the old wooden chair in front of the door, watching the setting sun cast its rays onto the red-brick old houses at the alley entrance, as if I can hear the footsteps of the past, telling the stories of the city. This guesthouse is located near Chiayi City Hall; during the Japanese occupation, this area was practically the city& #39;s core, and it still retains a rich historical atmosphere.A Qing Dynasty Minnan-Style House Hidden Around the Corner of the CityWhat many travelers wouldn& #39;t expect is that behind our guesthouse, there quietly lies a Qing Dynasty Minnan-style house. With its bluestone brick walls and swallowtail roof, it exudes a serene, poetic atmosphere. This old house, over a hundred years old, was the former residence of a local prominent family, witnessing the early immigrant settlement and community formation in Chiayi. Afternoon sunlight spills onto the roof tiles, casting shadows through the carved window frames, like gentle strokes of time deliberately left for this space. Many visitors enjoy sitting on the small stone steps in front of the old house, sipping tea and chatting, as if they& #39;ve inadvertently shared a moment with people from a bygone era.A four-minute walk to vibrancy and local lifeJust a four-minute walk from the guesthouse will take you to the "Fountain Roundabout" and the Cultural Road Night Market, familiar to Chiayi locals. As evening falls, the lights come on, and the air is filled with enticing aromas; each stall holds the flavors of old Chiayi. Grandma& #39;s grilled corn, a long-established chicken rice shop, aiyu jelly, charcoal-grilled oden… that& #39;s Chiayi& #39;s night—lively and genuine.Breathe in the Forest: Step into the Hinoki VillageOnly about 500 meters from the guesthouse, a seven-minute walk will take you to the "Hinoki Village." This area, once a dormitory complex for forestry workers, has been transformed into a cultural and creative cluster. The Japanese-style wooden buildings are scattered throughout, and walking along the quiet paths gives one the illusion of stepping into the Showa era. Teahouses, handicraft shops, and exhibition spaces allow visitors to immerse themselves in the aroma of wood and the atmosphere of bygone eras.Step into the Chiayi City God Temple and East Market, where faith and daily life intertwine.A seven-minute walk will take you to the century-old Chiayi City God Temple. The temple is a vibrant center of life for the older generation of Chiayi residents. Next to the temple is the East Market, a treasure trove of culinary delights. Enjoy a bowl of rice cake, a taste of pig& #39;s blood soup, and takeout...The starting point for the journey to the mountains—Beimen Station and Chiayi Railway Station.A thirteen-minute walk north will bring you to Beimen Station, one of the starting points of the Alishan Forest Railway. The retro wooden station exudes a nostalgic charm, and you can also visit the Alishan Forestry Village along the way. If you& #39;re coming from out of town, Chiayi Railway Station is just an 18-minute walk away. Along the way, you& #39;ll find old streets and local charm, quietly telling the story of this city. Braised pork rice and a cup of herbal tea are the familiar flavors of every morning for locals.The starting point to the mountains—Beimen Station and Chiayi Railway StationA 13-minute walk north will take you to Beimen Station, one of the starting points of the Alishan Forest Railway. The retro wooden station exudes a nostalgic charm, and you can also visit the Alishan Forestry Village along the way. If you& #39;re coming from out of town, Chiayi Railway Station is just an 18-minute walk away. Along the way, you& #39;ll find old streets and local charm, quietly telling the story of this city.Our guesthouse may not have luxurious modern decor, but every window, every lamp, and every handcrafted old wooden table is a small scene of time that we& #39;ve carefully arranged. We sincerely invite you to stay here for a night, and together, let& #39;s quietly listen to the voice of Chiayi.e

stays.description: Greetings to all guests who care about living and accommodation quality! Li-Gin Spa Motel is a fine recreational motel with an elegant, fashionable atmosphere and style unique throughout Taiwan. Located diagonally opposite from Nanshan Life on Zhongxiao Road in Chiayi City, it features convenient transportation, only a 15 minutes drive from National Highway No. 1 Chiayi Interchange and near attractions such as the city cultural center, Alishan Railway Beimen Station, garden, and Chiayi Park. Whether you’re here for business or travel, enjoy our comfortable and affordable, excellent-value accommodation. Li-Gin was funded and built by a group of connoisseurs of art and aesthetics. Focusing on improving the motel’s atmosphere and maintaining standards of perfection, they created the nation’s top recreational motel, officially registered and completely legal. The stand-alone building is quiet and elegant, while the amazingly affordable prices allow us to share the product of our efforts with guests of good taste.

stays.name: Sun Dialogue Hotel
stays.description: Cosmos Creation is the newest branding venture from Cosmos Hotels and Resorts; and in the spring of 2016, it launched Sun Dialogue – a professionally managed hotel that is enriched with local cultural and artisanal craftsmanship. Located on Da-Ya Road in Chiayi City, its bright white geometric design of the exterior expresses fluidity in style with an art museum-like elegance, while the guest rooms are injected with pops of bright colors to inspire a lively energy. Through creative and imaginative design and artwork, A-Li Mountain’s iconic beauty is able to permeate every corner of the hotel’s public space and guest rooms – its breathtaking sunrise, mesmerizing mountain mist, and majestic Cypress Pines – which further invokes a sense of pleasant amenity from guests and travelers. Furthermore, the Sun Dialogue by Cosmos Creation aims to target the family market with is abundant display art and design that will draw out the inner child in everyone.

stays.name: Xiao Mu
stays.description: At Xiaomu Inn, our goal is to embody “the life of Chiayi people.” We hope to share with everyone the local rhythm of life and our deep love and appreciation for wooden houses. This home, built in 1964, is made of Taiwanese hinoki (cypress) and carries many stories and memories connected to Alishan. I still naively believe that this house will see another hundred years. If fate brings you here, gently touch the hinoki wood inside and try to slow your breathing. Feel the strength and calm that this thousand-year-old Alishan cypress is ready to offer you.

stays.name: Yuh-Tong Hotel
stays.description: Yuh Tong Hotel is one of the business groups of Yuh Tong Construction Group in Chiayi. For 25 years, Yuh Tong Construction Group has steadily gained client confidence through the spirit of prioritizing safety and quality, thereby establishing an extraordinary brand image – Yuh Tong. We expect to bring travelers into our “life”, experience our “culture” and appreciate our “hospitality”. Starting from the hotel’s culture and natural environment, traditional crafts in Chiayi such as Chinese cypress sculptures, stone monkey sculptures and Koji potteries are used to decorate the public space. Our thoughtful service staff will bring you refreshments when you arrive in the lobby; upon checking in, they will also offer you a towel. For guests who are staying in our hotel, the exclusive tea-serving service will be offered so that besides savoring the unique aroma of Yuh Tong’s Alishan high mountain tea, you can also experience Yuh Tong’s attentive service. At Yuh Tong, moving emotions are more important than satisfaction.

stays.name: A Li Shan chih feng Royal Chiayi Hotel
stays.description: Situated in Chiayi's city center, the newly opened business hotel A Li Shan Chih Feng Royal Chiayi Hotel combines modern aesthetics and a splendid European style to create a prestigious and comfortable space of accommodation. With European design as its theme, the 8.5 meters tall lobby is constructed mainly with marble. A generous amount of marble slabs are applied throughout all the facilities to create an atmosphere of generosity and luxury. Built with a level on a par with star-rated hotels, the hotel provides a wide range of services. Located only a 10 and 15 minute ride away the Chiayi Interchange and THSR Chiayi Station, we are the preferred choice of accommodation for business and leisure travelers. TRA Chiayi Station, Chiayi's Wenhua Rd. Night Market and Chia-Le-Fu Night Market are also nearby. Our rich portfolio of services: 190 rooms; Chinese & Western restaurants with suites for large banquets, wedding parties, year-end & new-yearbanquet and festivity events; multi-purpose conference room with a capacity of 60 people; wedding planner center; business center; recreation center; and gift shop. Our service not only satisfies the needs of living and recreation for the people in Yunlin, Chiayi and Tainan, also facilitates the development of local service industry. On the basis of our complete services, we strive to promote Taiwan's business travel for the creation of a high quality and comfortable business communication space in Taiwan.

stays.name: Chiayi Look Hotel
stays.description: Look Hotel will impress you with its ultra fashionable design and low-key simplicity yet extravagant style at your first sight. The 3 crystal chandeliers hanging from the ceiling correspond to the magnificence in black tone in the lobby. When you first step into the hotel, you will feel like walking on the catwalk in a fashion show and receive the admiration from everyone else. During your time staying in the city, we hope you may enjoy the gorgeous scenery, leisure life and a slow living pace in the most laid-back mood. You will be lost in our superb services and forget about time, even the heavy burden on your shoulder. Look Hotel will forever become the place to remember in your journey for relaxation. At Look Hotel, we provide hotel-wide WiFi and a small, quiet business space to quench modern people's desire for technology in addition to a conference hall, rich A/V equipment and a comprehensive laundry service for those who travel all year round. Moreover, a gym is available for you to get a good exercise at any time. You will be able to leave all the worldly disturbances behind with a cup of cold drink in your hands.

The splendid cherry blossoms bloom here during every March and April along with the beautiful local dance of “Alishan Girls” and the joy of aboriginal’s folk songs performed to be highly appreciated and complimented by tourists. By residing beside this well-known tourist attraction in Chiayi City, Ever Delightful Business Hotel features superior location with wonderful scenery while taking advantage of “Shinkong Mitsukoshi Department Store”, “Far Eastern Department Store”, “Carrefour” and the night market nearby to meet your demands of leisure, recreation, local delicacies, traditional street food, and shopping in one go.Ever Delightful Business Hotel was designed and constructed by the renowned interior designer in Taiwan for the safety and comfort of your stay. The materials and products of fireproof, soundproof and seismic resistant are carefully reviewed and selected to apply. In addition to the delicious food and restaurant, the Business Center, gym and standard conference room are also provided for a wonderful experience during your trip.Different room styles such as luxury, exquisite and elegant ones are designed with a range of type from single accommodation to family room for you to choose from.You are able to look out the mountain scenery from your room during day time while overlooking the sparkling city lights of Chaiyi at night in order to have clear thoughts and relaxed moments.It is our pleasure to meet you at Ever Delightful Business Hotel. You are very welcomed by our most considerate services, sincere passion and the warmest hospitality.

stays.name: JEN JU HOTEL
stays.description: Jen Ju Hotel — A Time Capsule in the Heart of ChiayiTucked inside Chiayi City’s historic Central Second Market, Jen Ju Hotel has been welcoming travelers since 1974. With its retro charm and authentic local character, this hotel offers more than just a place to stay—it offers a journey back in time.From the moment you walk in, you’ll notice the beautiful stained-glass panel at the entrance, a signature feature that’s been carefully preserved for over five decades. Inside, an elevator imported from Milan, Italy stands as a proud reminder of the hotel’s elegant beginnings. Even the original button panel remains, inviting guests to step into a slower, more nostalgic era.Located just a one-minute walk from Wenhua Road Night Market and Zhongshan Road shopping district, the hotel puts you right in the center of Chiayi’s most vibrant neighborhood. Whether you& #39;re craving local dishes like turkey rice, clay pot fish head, or a refreshing grapefruit green tea, everything is just steps away.Perfect for travelers who love vintage aesthetics, local history, and unbeatable convenience. Jen Ju Hotel is where old Chiayi lives on—quietly, beautifully, and right outside your door.

stays.name: MAISON DE CHINE HOTEL
stays.description: With the grand new opening in 2015, MAISON DE CHINE HOTEL began its journey to success on the edge of Chiayi's bustling commercial district near the well-known Fountain Roundabout. Though the busy two-lane Wenhua Rd. is always full of traffic during daytime, its noise will never reach this urban getaway. After the sun sets, you can pay a visit to the famous local night market. In the next morning, you may take the renowned Alishan Forest Railway to Alishan, enjoy a tour of the beautiful natural scenery, experience the local life to the fullest extent and end your trip with a colorful memory. MAISON DE CHINE HOTEL has 185 fine rooms and suites designed with warm tone and elegant yet heartening interior layout, bringing about the atmosphere of the natural forest. We also provide warm and comfortable Japanese-style suites furnished with tatami mats to make you feel at home. Our spacious and luxurious ballroom is equipped with top-of-the-lineaudio/video equipment, making it suitable for parties, wedding parties, cocktail parties, conferences and exhibitions. The venue is your choice for parties and events!

Apart from enjoying the bustle of Chiayi City, you can still get away from the city and relax.

stays.name: little-moonlight
stays.description: I am Little, from Taipei, I like Chiayi, and moved to Chiayi. I named and founded the brand little-moonlight, Fuguanlvzi No. 1113602670, Chiayi City B&B No. 012.Little likes the totem of rabbits. Xiaoxiao also represents delicacy and attentiveness, a sense of contentment, gratitude and non-greedy. Step by step, she firmly moves towards her own dreams. Her persistence and pursuit of dreams is like the rabbit in the moon. They kept their duties and accompanied each other in the palace, hence the origin of little-moonlight.Through the warmth and energy brought by travel, as well as the preference and observation of art and culture, brick by brick, the Japanese-style Taiwanese street houses that survived the Showa period of Japanese occupation were recreated in Guohua Street, Chiayi City. The whole house is built of red bricks and cypress wood. The house exudes a faint fragrance of cypress wood and is called little-moonlight. From then on, He was filled with abundant vitality and was no longer lonely. He also had the care and cherishment of travelers.People-oriented and willing to share, let every traveler see and hear what they see and hear when they come to Little-Moonlight, hoping to bring courage to more travelers and friends, and ignite a small inspiration and a short period of time in their hearts. Inspiration is enough to make people happy and comfortable.Calm and restrained, the city of Chiayi and the old house space of Little-Moonlight bring travelers quiet energy and warm healing.Let’s set off! Come to my old house and find your own inspiration. Welcome travelers and friends to come and take a walk in Chiayi, come and sit in my old house, walk into the little-moonlight in the alleys of Chiayi’s ancient roads, follow the small steps, and listen carefully through the small perspective. , savor it carefully, come to Chiayi, and practice being a Chiayi person.

stays.name: Alishan Hotel (Historical building)
stays.description: Hotel HistoryRespond to the twenty first century tourism development movement, Ministry of Transportation & Communications developed on Twenty First Century Taiwan Tourism Strategy, and created a high quality sightseeing environment concentrate in local community, ecological community, and variety as the main principal. To continue promote tourism, the Executive Yuan Tourism Development Team appointed Chiayi County government and Tourism Bureau to carry out the scenic resource investigation and management arena agenda for Ali Mountain region. In March 2001, Ministry of Transportation & Communication completes the grade review as national class scenic area and declared management region. In the same year, established National Scenic Area Administration Office in Mt. Ali on July 23rd. On September 4th, President Chen came in person for the grand opening.Story of DevelopmentEight years ago, government operated Alishan House entrusted Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company for business management. Afterwards, Alishan House has obvious improvements in hotel amenities, and became the five-star holiday hotel at highest altitude in Taiwan.Future PerspectiveChao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company officially contracted with Forestry Bureau in December 2004, and obtained the first non-governmental investment BOT case qualification from Forestry Bureau. Chao-Li Hotel Management Advisory Company anticipate to build a five-star holiday hotel at the current address in approximately two years, and expand it to 150 guestrooms with plenty facilities upon completion. Once again, push Mt. Ali to be the best sightseeing region in Taiwan.

stays.name: Mimiyo
stays.description: Room reservation number: 0952165761 /05-2511378 Website: www.mimiyo.com.tw Email: mimiyo7@gmail.com Mimiyo is located at an elevation of 1400 meters in the Tsou Tribe Dabang Community, Alishan (Chiayi County), surrounded by mountains and greenery as far as the eye can see, away from the noise and dirt of the city, letting guests put their worries and cares behind them. In the Tsou language, “Mimiyo” means “running off,” and it was chosen by Afayi Nuozhaqiyana, the owner, in hopes that guests can take a casual, spontaneous vacation without having to worrying about anything. Rooms include wood or bamboo clothing hooks, dressing tables, tables, benches, desk lamps, and tissue boxes, all handmade by the owner. Balconies and bathrooms come with huge French windows featuring mountain views that change throughout the day. Sit at the wooden handmade table on the partially outdoor balcony and have a cup of tea while looking at the mountains and clouds, reading, or anything else. For those who would like to learn more about the Tsou Dabang Community culture and ecology, the owner, who is licensed, can arrange 2-day 1-night in-depth tours.

Bofu’s House Bed and Breakfast offers a feeling of home, with local friendliness that makes guests feel at home, and peace and quiet not found in the city, a place to let go of worry and stress. Bring the whole family and enjoy countryside living and simple dishes made from locally-grown vegetables. Experience local agricultural life. In the evening, roast fresh local oysters and sweet potatoes and have a chat and cup of tea with the owner, enjoying the tranquility of countryside evenings and listening to the sounds of insects. Wake up to the sound of birds in the morning and take a walk by the riverside, breathing in the fresh air and experiencing a life away from the city.

"Sleep over in San Ho Yuan" has long been a popular activity for people from the cities. Chuan Zi Tou Tian Shang Ju Homestay is also a place for visitors to experience farming, fish farming and other package tours. Chuan Zi Tou Tian Shang Ju Homestay also hires local housewives as housekeepers and tour guides.

stays.name: Chuanzaitou Homestay
stays.description: Enjoy the relaxation and serenity of a harbor community and experience the limitless fun of a fishing village. Dongshih (Dongshi), the “township of three colors,” is a mixture of green, blue, and gray viewed from a distance and includes eight unique scenic sites and eight natural ecological sites, while the authentic seaside community provides a diverse travel experience. Try out the plump and crispy sweet Dongshih oysters, be a part of the Dongshih fish market, bustling with the sounds of vendors, and visit the Aogu wetland, Waisanding Sand Bar, the natural ecology display center…fully experience the unending charm of this little seaside community. Chuanzaitou Homestay located in Chuanzaitou, Dongshih Township, Chiayi County, was the first legally certified bed and breakfast in Chiayi. Located on the border between Dongshih Township, Puzih (Puzi) City, and Lioujiao (Liujiao) Township, Chuanzaitou was a place of beautiful childhood memories for Mr. Cai Zhencheng, the owner of the bed and breakfast. In order to introduce others to the beauty of this place, he and his wife returned to his hometown and established Chuanzaitou Homestay, promoting an outstanding in-depth cultural trip with package activities such as the Puzih Stream Levee Bike Trail and dragon boat rowing so that travelers may not only relax but thoroughly experience the carefree fun of the fields and fishing village. In addition to providing an outstanding, in-depth experience, Chuanzaitou offers a well-designed, warm, elegant, comfortable, bright, and secure resting place. During the day, take a in-depth tour of village experiences, such as the mangrove ecological area, Dongshih fishing wharf, and an ox-cart ride around the village, then spend the night at Chuanzaitou Homestay enjoying the peaceful countryside scenery and traditional three-section building compound and listening to the crickets. Bring the whole family!

stays.name: Hotel Indigo Alishan
stays.description: The Hotel Indigo Alishan is located 58 kilometers from the Alishan Highway, the first point of entry into Alishan Forest. It is near the Xiding Eryanping Trail, 20 minutes from the Fenqi Lake Station and 45 minutes from the Alishan Forest Recreation Area. The hotel is a gold-grade green building that pays the highest tribute to Alishan. The exterior of the hotel is made of stone walls. Its grille design was inspired by the cypress carriages of the Alishan Forest Railway, evoking the image of the trains. The walkway from the hotel’s drop-off point to the entrance of the lobby features a train platform and sleepers, symbolizing the start of the journey to discovery.When you enter the lobby, you feel like you are in a bamboo forest, interconnected with the greenery of the mountains. Walking through the tunnel of light and shadow, you will be greeted by millet fields, sparking the joy of abundance. The hotel is a combination of nature, forest, neighborhood culture and history. It is a key to Alishan that awaits travelers, so they can explore and create their own stories.

stays.name: Hwadh Resort
stays.description: Fresh, sweet-smelling air, pure and bright mountain springs, and rich, nourishing earth are things no one can put a price on. The “welcoming fountain” is a precious natural resource. Take a stroll through this beautiful, clean land – your body needs some rest to restore its energy. Let the gentle breeze comfortably kiss every inch of your skin, gaze out at the fantastic mingling of natural water and light, open a beautiful new page for the day, recording your travels…Hwadh Resort is located in an otherworldly paradise beneath Alishan, occupying three hectares, with a lush forest trail in the back and the upstream portion of Puzi Stream in front. It sits on the Central Mountain Range, with beautiful natural scenery, an ever-changing sea of clouds, sunrises, and a variety of striking scenes that often appear, from where you can embark on a deep, amazing vacation.

stays.name: MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL
stays.description: To watch watch the Alishan sunrise, you do not have to go up to Zhu mountain in the darkness anymore! You just need to open the French window in your room, and wait on the balcony to watch the sunrise as dawn breaks, a cool breeze blowing. Even more amazing is that the first ray of sunshine at Alishan is embracing you! That's called "Watching Sunrise at MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL." MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL sits beside the "Dragon Head" road at Highway No. 18 (57.5K) and at an elevation of 1,280 m. It takes 20 minutes to drive to Rose Lake from here; it takes 40 minutes from here to drive to Alishan. It is at the doorstep to Yushan National Park, Alishan National Scenic Area, Mt. Tatung Trail, Ruitai Trail, and Dulishan Trail. This is just like visiting the Lotus Flower Peak. It is called "the Verdant mountains surround Dragon Head, sunrays and cloud kiss MEI YUAN LOU." MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL is a multifunctional leisure and recreational park designed by Japanese design master Sasakibe with consideration for the local terrain, the microclimate and the seasons, the alpine forest, and the rich natural ecosystem. The design theme is : "Watch the sun rise from the east and clouds from the west, and kick the morning dew as you explore the surroundigns. Gaze out over the Jianan Plain as hearths and lights are lit. until they are joined by countless stars in the sky at night." Mountain horticultural crops are used for your organic and healthy meals; Ju-Lu Tea leaves a delectable aftertaste for joy and memories during your journey. MEI YUAN LOU LANDSCAPE HOTEL "Cares for every guest."

stays.name: Renyi Lake Hotel
stays.description: Our scenic vacation offers you a marvelous adventure.Renyi Lake Hotel lies next to the road surrounding Renyi lake at the junction between the lake and mountain in Chiayi Renyi Lake Scenic Area. The sky, lake, kites, and bikes make the spot a dreamlike paradise that promises you a relaxing vacation.From the hotel, taking Provincial Highway 18 eastward leads to Alishan and westward to Chiaya City. The hotel is 8 minutes from the Zhongpu ramp of Freeway 3, 30 minutes from the High Speed Rail Chiayi Station, and 15 minutes from downtown. The transportation here is convenient. Welcome to Reiyi Lake Hotel.Renyi Lake Scenic Area is located at the junction of Alishan and Chiayi inside of FAnlu Village, Chiayi County. Besides providing water to the residents of Chiayi County, the lake also owns an unforgettable scenery.The length of the road running around the lake is 8.9 kilometers. You may ride a bike along the causeway to enjoy the beautiful lakeside view, the kites flying in the sky, the waves shimmering on the lake, and the Renyi Lake Hotel sitting among the elegant scenery.

stays.name: Season Star
stays.description: My wife and I met in college and our family has been growing tea in Alishan for several generations. As the eldest son, I returned with my wife to my hometown after getting married, originally planning to make a living growing tea. However, after hearing about new trends in the leisure industry, I started considering changing the family business. My wife and I spent 6 years studying Chinese and Western cooking, baking, making drinks, bed and breakfast operation, restaurant management, and obtaining a license. My wife, who had never studied design before, managed to create a plan using paintbrush, and in 2006, our dream finally became a reality. Featuring a southern European style, the building’s design includes light yellow walls, red roof tiles, and wood strip patterns, displaying a rich European recreational style, with distinctly separate front and rear buildings. On a bright, clear day, it looks particularly lovely and inviting. Pension Seasonstar is located at Alishan Xiding, with views of the sunrise, sunset, and magnificent sea of clouds. As this is the famous Alishan tea area, surrounded by mountain mists in the distance all year round, the tea grown here is particularly sweet, smooth, and refreshing. We like to make friends with travelers by sharing our lives and feelings with them. An elderly Japanese man and his sister came to visit the Japanese colonial era elementary school, lovers have proposed to each other here, and wedding photographs have been taken here. Sometimes a entire family comes out to enjoy this place, and really, the happiest moment is being able to make our friends smile.

stays.name: Zhong Ming Ju Taoyi Fang Homestay
stays.description: Would you like to take a trip and deeply experience Alishan’s sunrise, sea of clouds, forest, railway, sunset clouds, and tea village? Visit us, have some tea, and go hiking! From the 50 kilometer point of Alishan Highway, turn right toward Tanayiku and go straight for about 2 minutes to reach us. We are located at an elevation of 1060 meters, with a mild climate year round, surrounded by lush greenery and fresh air. Beautiful mountain mists and magnificent seas of clouds are our regular visitors; come here and enjoy a rare moment of leisure and tranquility, listening to the sounds of the birds and insects in the forest and peacefully gazing off at the mountain range in the distance. There is nothing artificial about the beauty of this place, only the praise of nature. Our little wooden building stands tall and unflustered throughout time within the refreshing mountain forest, looking out at Tanayiku, surrounded by the verdant mountains, making people forget all about the noise of the city. Suite rooms feature warm, simple layout, bright and spacious, while retaining a homely atmosphere and making guests feel perfectly comfortable. We provide meals prepared from organic, seasonal vegetables, whether it’s the homestyle-cooking restaurant or Tsou Tribe Aboriginal Flavor Restaurant, guaranteeing use of only the best ingredients to provide guests with a happy, secure dining experience. We provide homegrown high mountain tea, bringing you a taste of Alishan’s local specialty, as well as expert local travel information and trip planning to make sure your trip is worth it! Call us at 05-2586608 or 0932-843889.

stays.name: Shuai Ge Nong Home
stays.description: Shuaige Farmhouse B&B is part of the Lu surname village in Liujiao Township. It's part of a hundred-year-old courtyard house belonging to the Lu family that was once occupied by five extended families. As the family grew, many of them moved away to make a living and only the third son's family was left to take care of the traditional Taiwanese ancestral property. This house went from being a traditional acestral property to a leisure B&B business, which became known as Shuaige Farmhouse. As our guests increased in number, the thought of turning the house into a legally operated business came to mind, simply because it was not a good idea to leave it vacant. Coincidentally, the government was promoting tourism in the area, so an application was submitted to legalize the operation. Though we faced many obstacles such as legal issues and land use rights, we were finally certified to operate our business. No. 57 Shuaige Farmhouse B&B gradually spread its name through word-of-mouth and internet marketing. A trip is often memorable when you remember the hospitality, safety and cleanliness of the place you stayed at. Shuaige Farmhouse B&B provides the following packages to visitors: Carefully planned 3 days 2 nights package, and 2 days 1 night custom-package. Our mission is always to serve our customers with honor. We hope to see you soon at Shuaige Farmhouse B&B.

stays.name: A Ben De Jia Homestay
stays.description: A-Bun’s Home Bed and Breakfast in Ruili is legally-certified Bed and Breakfast No. 78, surrounded by verdant mountains and greenery, with a two-story wooden building, quietly standing in front of the tea garden in a perfectly serene environment. With a superior location on the the Ruili Scenic line, it’s near sites such as the Ruitai Visitor Center, Yejianghua Creek Trail, Swallow Cliff, 1000 Year Bat Cave, Yuantan Creek Eco Park, and Fenqihu Old Street, with convenient transportation whether you’re coming here by bus or car. The owner of A-Bun’s Home originally worked in the tea business; in cooperation with the Alishan Management Office and public promotion of the Ruili tourism industry, A-Bun’s Home also promoted the local industry, leading visitors on tours to learn about the aesthetic beauty of Ruili’s natural mountain scenery and rich plant and animal ecology. Rooms are limited, but each is warm and bright with elegant layout and decoration. The wooden floor and walls give off a faint scent, and right outside the window is a tea garden that looks straight out of a TV commercial. These rooms are perfectly comfortable. After enjoying a delicious dinner, let the owner take you on a night tour – the night life of Ruili is sure to bring unprecedented experiences. The thoughtful owner has also created an outdoor rest area and game room where guests can play mahjong or cards if they are in the mood for it. Or chat with friends under a starry sky, sampling homegrown high mountain tea. Tea-picking or tea production process tours are available from April to November.

stays.name: Arce Wisteria
stays.description: Ruili Arce Wisteria Bed and Breakfast is located on Chiayi Mountain at an elevation of 1100 meters, featuring mild, comfortable weather, surrounding mountain mists, and fog in the afternoon. Sit in the beautiful, secluded environment, sip a cup of homegrown coffee, and savor the moment of enjoying the lush, colorful garden. The bed and breakfast is housed in a traditional three-section building compound different from those commonly imagined, as Arce has increased its artistic appeal. Originally his home, he opened it up to guests at the recommendation of friends. The remodeled building is integrated with a European outdoor garden, offering a bed and breakfast as well as coffee. Bring all your friends to the mountain, where you’ll feel like you’re living in a vacation cottage. We have two housekeepers and a lush garden, and have collected several coffee mugs. “Choose one you like, and experience your true self.” We’ve got Arce’s homegrown coffee beans, good music, many stories, and outdoor music performance in the evenings. With mountains in the background, you’ll feel as if you’re in another country. Arce and Yanhuang enjoy adjusting arrangement and layout, bringing out the building’s greatest potential and exceeding the imagination. We’re located away from the street and noisy traffic, instead featuring great scenic views and on clear nights a sky full of stars, or even shooting stars! It will be an unforgettable night; leave the city behind and experience this kind of life! Every person reserves a place for dreams in their heart, and should you wish to discover new surprises, take a music and flower tour and visit Arce Wisteria Bed and Breakfast.

stays.name: Dashan Zizai Homestay
stays.description: Da-Shan-Zi-Zai Homestay is located in the mountain and surrounded by beautiful natural scenery. The 50-year old traditional Fujian-style architecture retains its original simple façade, and emits a modern, natural elegance. The original wood used in the construction seems to release a faint fragrance. The green lawn in the courtyard leads the eyes to a broad view of sunrise, mountain mist, clouds, fog, sunset and stars - all coming and going depending on the time of day. Take a walk to the bamboo forest and the endless tea plantation, and enjoy the mountain fresh air. Feel the serenity and the cool breeze in the mountain. Slow down your steps and relax your mind and body. Take a deep breath, enjoy the fresh moutain air and savor a cup of warm mountain tea.

stays.name: House of Ahan
stays.description: House of Ahan is located in the mountains at an elevation of 1100 meters in Beidao Ruili Scenic Area, Alishan National Scenic Area, near attractions such as Taiping, Taising (Taixing), and Fenqihu. Ruili is home to 8 tourist sites as well as a variety of ecological sights, and this is the perfect bed and breakfast for travelers planning a smooth, convenient vacation. House of Ahan in surrounded by mountains, and was originally a small farmhouse before it was transformed into a European-style wooden building through Ahan’s care and effort. Our care and effort is evident from the decorations among the flowers and grass of the outdoor area. Flower Garden Scenic Bed and Breakfast – Firefly ecological tour available from March to July. Listen closely to the sounds of the birds and insects in the day, and enjoy the peaceful starry sky in the evening, appreciating a rare mood of leisure. The tranquil scenery before you is not a dream, it’s a life of pleasantness that can take away all your cares and worries. Ahan helps guests plan their trip; enjoy happiness, nostalgia, ecology, and the beauty of the countryside on your free journey.

stays.name: Kuangye Homestay
stays.description: Originally a fruit farmer, Mr. Guo wanted to provide his family with a place to rest and was tired of an environment full of pesticides. Using the existing stonework and garden techniques, he converted the fruit farm into a pine tree area and the family home into a bed and breakfast, providing his family with a place to rest as well as a surplus of produce to share. A 10 minute drive from Meishan City, it features a unique wild pine tree area with nearly one hundred unique Taiwan white pines, black pines, osmanthus trees, and cherry trees of various sizes. It was built by Mr. Guo and his family, who spent 13 years to create the finished product. Currently, we offers courses in handicraft, an all-natural, wild vegetable restaurant, and more inland areas for you to slow down, relax, and be close to nature, creating your own natural wilderness life. Ours is a simple, down-to-earth bed and breakfast, featuring a beautiful environment in harmony with nature. The name comes from the Bible, as we hope this can be a place for people to leave behind the distractions of the city and put their minds and hearts at ease, enjoying a break from their busy lives so they can take on the next challenge. The owner is more than willing to share about the process of creating the bed and breakfast; a miraculous story you don’t want to miss out on!

stays.name: Rui Li Chahu Homestay
stays.description: Address: No. 100-6, Ruili Village, Meishan Township, Jiayi County. Room reservation number: 05-2501806. Fax: 05-2501533 Website: www.ruili.com.tw Email：ruiliteapot@gmail.com The first snack shop (Ruili rest stop) was founded in Ruili in 1989. Since most of the original guests were hikers, they would return hungry and looking for a place to eat after climbing. They would inquire the locals, who would offer a friendly reply: “Keep going past Ruili Elementary School and you’ll see a teapot (the only one in Alishan to have an inlaid clock, which used to let hikers know when to come down from the mountain) where you can get a bite to eat! Over twenty years later, the teapot has become a landmark of Ruili, and just like it, the bed and breakfast and restaurant preserve the wonderful flavor of our memories! The teapot lady represents it and performs well in competitions! (Invited to compete in New York!) A trip to Ruili isn’t complete without enjoying this wonderful twenty year old flavor! Like the teapot, the bed and breakfast has a great capacity, with a large open space in the center of each floor where guests can completely relax! Make this your home away from home! I hope every guest who visits “empties his or her heart of everything undesirable, and replaces it with positive things!” Brew a cup of good tea for life at Ruili Teapot Bed and Breakfast! We’re located in Meishan Township (Chiayi County), being No. 61 Bed and Breakfast, a Culture and Tourism Bureau of Chiayi County) legally-certified establishment. Quietly listen to the soft symphony of the forest during the day, calmly observe the colorful sunset clouds in the evening, and as night falls, the exciting and diverse countryside night life begins… In order to provide each guest with a fun and satisfying experience, we provide packages such as detailed tours and transportation service, as well as antique lantern night trips based on the season. During firefly season, the air is filled with dancing glows; we welcome everyone to experience the beauty of Ruili! Our blog includes more details as well as an introduction to the beauty of Ruili, feel free to check it out! http://blog.xuite.net/laln/teapot?st=c&p=1&w=1302045

stays.name: Xin Cai Homestay
stays.description: Alishan Xin Cai B&B is located in the Meishan area, part of Alishan's scenic area, which is also where Taihe Zhangshu Lake in Chiayi County is located. The high altitude makes the air especially thin and fresh. The nearby attractions - Alishan National Park, Fengqihu Lake, Ruili Scenic Area - provide a variety of leisure activities and services, including dining and accommodation, specialty products and tour guides. Visitors can relax and enjoy the scenery of Chiayi's Meishan. The high mountain tea sold at the B&B had been carefully grown and irrigated with pure clean mountain spring water. The slowly roasted tea leaves render a cup of tea with clarity and excellent fragrance. It's absolutely a high quality tea. Alishan Xin Cai B&B is a modern small wooden architecture. The spacious and clean guestrooms have a large picture window with beautiful mountain views and green forest, and it brings a lot of bright light into the room. The room's simple elegance and leisure ambiance compliment the owner's warm and friendly reception. You will feel as if you've returned home for a relaxing vacation.

stays.name: lai Home Country Cottage B&B
stays.description: Familiy lai''s Country Cottage B&B Minshuku, which is located in Ruifeng Village, Mei Shan Township, Chiayi County. According to the surrounding terrain here, the owner built Taiwan-style stilts using neighboring material. Its height is about 1,000 meters above the sea level, which create its comfortable temperature. Ruifeng township is famous with cultivating tea and it splendid moutain view , waterfall, and the nature surrounding. There are more than ten trails with their own special view. Visit here, you cannot only hiking alone the trail, but also experience the local farm life such as climacteric seasonal fruit or making brown sugar. We also provide guidance of surrounding ecology. What’s more, we serve the meal with mountain-grew chicken and vegetable in the season which may be fed and grew here or wild.

stays.name: Hoya Resort Hotel Chiayi
stays.description: The Hoya Resort Hotel Group insists on the brand image and style of “natural, straightforward, and humanitarian love”. The Hoya Resort Hotel Chiayi honors the company spirit and provides exquisite services with passion, creating a relaxing and comfortable space, presenting to you a hotel full of happiness.The Hoya Resort Hotel Chiayi is located in Minhsiung Township, Chiayi County. The European beige architecture brings out the elegant quality of the hotel, making it a knight from the middle ages guarding the culture of Minhsiung.The hotel is close to National Chung Cheng University and is the 7th branch of the Hoya Resort Hotel Group. After carefully planning and reconstruction, the hotel had its grand opening in end of 2014. The 196 rooms are designed with modernistic simplicity and are all comfortable and cozy, making guests who arrive here feel just like home. Other than the beautiful sunsets and dazzling night views, the place is also full of warm hospitality and passionate service. The Hoya Resort Hotel Chiayi is bound to creat a new horizon for Chiayi’s tourism industry.

stays.name: Yue Lai Ju Homestay
stays.description: Located just 3 minutes off the Minxiong Interchange in Chiayi and only a 5-minute drive from Chiayi City, Yuelai Ju B&B is tucked away amidst rural fields, offering a hidden paradise with a stunning bald cypress estate and a garden full of birdsong and blooming flowers. With clear blue skies, misty mountain views, and a vast green meadow, it feels like a serene getaway in a foreign land! Children can run and play freely on the lush lawn, while adults relax with tea and conversations in front of the house. At night, everyone can enjoy stargazing together. A delicious and refined breakfast is included with your stay! The peaceful and cozy environment lets you unwind and enjoy a leisurely vacation — the perfect way to relax. The estate is equipped with swings, slides, bouncy horses, and various toys for kids to enjoy, along with a beautiful ornamental fish pond where you can feed the fish. It’s an ideal place for families, couples, or groups. The romantic bald cypress forest changes colors with the seasons, making it a must-visit spot for Instagrammers — a truly healing retreat for the body and soul. The estate also offers group reservations for European-style buffet catering. It’s perfect for romantic outdoor weddings, elegant ceremonies, themed parties, group gatherings, or business meetings. We warmly welcome your visit!

In addition to 263 rooms with simple and stylish views, the Evergreen Palace Hotel (CHIAYI) has an all-day dining restaurant that can accommodate up to 200 people. A variety of exquisite room services options (Food and Beverage) available upon request. Our international ballroom with high pillars can accommodate up to 400 people. It is an excellent venue for variety banquets. High-resolution LED wall, theater-level audio equipment, and lighting equipment are specially prepared for all kinds of large-scale conference, event exhibition, wedding banquet, and venue.

stays.name: The Brick Hotel
stays.description: Located in Taibao City, Chiayi County in southern Taiwan, The Brick Hotel is the first resort hotel that uses bricks with both cultural and ecological characteristics as the theme of the hotel. It is only two minutes& #39; walk away from the Southern Branch of the National Palace Museum. The hotel provides family accommodation and catering services. Its facilities include the Kids& #39; Luminous Bricks Playroom, the Kid& #39;s Exclusive Racing Track .The Brick Hotel comprises two main halls and 188 brick-themed rooms. On display in the corridor of the guest room are copies of 100 world-famous paintings. By integrating technology and the human-touch, the luminous brick corridor is interactive and voice-activated. Inside the hall, the luminous brick playroom nearly 330 m2 in size provides a great space for all guests to relax. The child-friendly hall has 36 large rooms with six themes, including the cherry blossom fairy, the tunnel train, the blue mountain and sea, wood elves, Mr. Giant Tree and a deer park. There are also special tracks for children to play with electric cars, including a garage, cars in every room, and private bathroom facilities.The hotel boasts a Hotsai banquet hall that provides both Chinese and western breakfast containing strictly selected, high-quality agricultural products and fresh ingredients. The banquet room is tall without columns, affording all guests a broad view of the room. Covering an area of 1,320 m2, the banquet venue can accommodate up to 100 round tables (10 guests per table) so is suitable for conferences, meetings, wedding banquets, dinners and other special events.

Ali Mountain Oriental Pearl International Hotel stands out from the contiguous area. It has a view of the beautiful Chianan Plain, and overlooks the expansive Taiwan Strait. Flourishing forests, friendly residents, lofty rolling clouds, golden sunsets, and arich ecological environment help to heal visitors' tired minds and souls. Ali Mountain Oriental Pearl International Hotel greatly welcomes your visit. Situated on hectares of land AMOPIH parking areais large enough to accommodate 20 tourist coaches. stays.name: Moon Villa
stays.description: Moon Villa is located in Zhongpu Township at the foot of Alishan, surrounded by natural mountain scenery and is far from the hubbub of the city. With pure mountain ranges, green forests, colorful clouds, and a mild, refreshing breeze blowing from the mountain and fields, this is a place where guests can observe the sunrise in the morning, a sea of clouds in the evening, and the moon and stars at night. Everywhere you look there are amazing sights, making this a great choice for recreation or accommodations for families or groups of friends. We offer 20 comfortable and elegant living structures with independent views, as well as three floors and a spacious living room where guests can enjoy a serene, tranquil environment free of distractions. Here, free of all time constraints, you can enjoy happiness with your beloved friends and family creating beautiful memories. The huge rooms, over 66 square meters in area, are spacious and elegant, while the uniquely tasteful furniture and beds present a perfect picture of warm and fashionable spatial art with a variety of beds for you to choose from. Each building comes with its own huge, independent scenic deck, offering expansive views of the blue sky, green mountains, and ever-changing scenery, which are our standard features. You can fully enjoy ease and leisure and enjoy a luxurious vacation experience. The scenic balcony includes a private outdoor spa surrounded by the verdant greenery of Alishan, completely washing away your fatigue and pampering every inch of your skin. Here, you can take a stress-relieving bath, enjoy a view of the moon and stars while taking a deep breath of phytoncides and anions, absorbing the full power of the mountain and forests, experiencing an all-new vacation aesthetic. Moon Villa provides bikes for rent, providing guests the opportunity to leisurely wander the fields and experience the countryside atmosphere. We also rent mahjong tables and chairs for a stimulating game with friends. Take a comfortable hot bath to relax your mind and body and let your stress slip away, or gather with your beloved family and friends to sip tea and enjoy a rare leisurely vacation. Internet service: WiFi service throughout the building, business district venue, and public computers for guest use. Rooms also include WiFi for guests with notebook computers and network cables. Free outdoor parking lot with 20-30 spaces.

stays.name: Mu Zheng Farm
stays.description: Mu Zheng FarmIn a quiet corner of Chiayi, a unique B&B combines the essence of local customs, accommodation and tea culture to create a story-filled stay experience for you. The owner of the house is a tea farmer in Chiayi. He personally participates in the management, picking and production of tea leaves, cultivating tea leaves of excellent quality. This history of tea's struggle has become the inspiration for the B&B. After five years of hard work, another piece of the puzzle of life has been completed, presenting you with a story-filled stay experience.The B&B integrates tea and nature elements and provides a variety of tea tastings. Entertainment facilities such as: KTV, electric mahjong, starry sky cinema, barbecue area, tea tasting area, allow you to taste the charm of Chiayi tea in a leisurely environment and enjoy the peace of mind.The unique architectural style combines local customs and tea culture. The large light courtyard brings natural light and is filled with the fragrance of logs and tea, allowing you to deeply feel the beauty of nature. The atmosphere is comfortable and relaxing, while showing respect for local culture and the natural environment. Come and taste the beauty of life like tea together.

stays.name: Chang Qing Ju Homestay
stays.description: Changqing Ju is located at an elevation of 1450 meters, 600 meters above the 63.6 kilomemeter mark of Alishan Highway, between Fenqihu and Dadongshan Forest Trail. The building is a traditional Taiwanese-style three-section building compound offering an outstanding accommodation environment and relaxing, scenic pine forest area where visitors can relax in the shade of the trees. Tea time isn’t complete without the owner’s homegrown Alishan Shizhuozhulu tea, featuring a sweet aftertaste and finely mild, fragrant flavor. Visitors long for the freedom and relaxation of nature, and the environment, pleasant throughout the seasons, relieves the worries and cares of city dwellers, making Changqing Ju the perfect place to enjoy the relaxation of nature.

stays.name: Guan Xingyuan Homestay
stays.description: Star Resort Put aside your stress and take a trip to Guanghua Village to search for your natural paradise up in the mountain. Alishan has rich, diverse natural resources, and the Guanghua area in Alishan is known as nature's ecological paradise. In the early summer, glittering fireflies dance in the woods, brightening the darkness of the night. Suddenly, you'll come face to face with the Formosan White-faced Squirrel, as it hops from branch to branch. This eco-trip will give you a chance to take a closer look at a variety of ecology that our ecosystem offers. Alishan B&B - Star Resort Ecological B&B is located along Chiayi's County Road 159, near Shizhuo, Fengqihu and Alishan Forest Recreation Area. The conveniently located B&B is in a quiet, beautiful and expansive garden. The cool mountain breeze and wonderful sounds of birds chirping and insects buzzing are like music to the ears. Enjoy a cup of fine tea with the hospitable B&B owner and rejoice in the delightful and simple mountain living. Alishan B&B - Star Resort Ecological B&B has rooms that accomodate 2 to 6 people. The carefully decorated rooms are spacious, bright, warm, elegant and comfortable. You must not miss the delicious homemade meals that the lady of the house prepares. When various dishes such as fresh bamboo shoots and fresh tender wild greens arrive to the table, the tantalizing smell will wake up your appetite. After the meal, go to the forest with the owner, who's also a professional eco-tour guide, and explore the unique ecological resources and habitat that wild animals forage in.

stays.name: He Yuan Guan Wu Homestay
stays.description: Ho Yuan Landscape Villa features expansive views and rising mists in the afternoon, as if you’re in a fantasy of clouds and fog. In the evening, one-of-a-kind waterfalls create unforgettable memories for photographers, giving this place the name “Ho Yuan Landscape Villa.” Rooms come with large windows and different views and scenic mountains in the distance. During the spring and summer, enjoy views of the Chianan Plain, Kaohsiung and Pingtung night scenery, and stars; fall and winter feature one-of-a-kind sunsets and seas of clouds and unrivalled scenic beauty. A scenic tea growing area is located in the back of the mountain, making guests feel as if they’re a part of the atmosphere during picking season. On clear nights, the twinkling stars and bright mountain high in the sky provide expansive views. This place is home to the most natural beauty, and the nights are so quiet you can hear the whispers of people, sounds of the birds and insects, softly falling rain, and faint call of your inner feelings. To preserve this environmenta, we ask guests to please keep the volume down so you and your friends may enjoy the most peaceful beauty of nature.

stays.name: Inn By Tree
stays.description: Inn By Tree is located near Zhuqi Train Station in Alishan. Like the Water Park, it's on the upstream of Puzi River. There are a number of bikeways and walking trails in this area, such as Dulishan National Trail and Tanghu Ancient Trail. Wengtan Waterfall along Tanghu Ancient Trail is non-stop running year round. This inn is a Taiwanese architecture with cypress wood-blocking design. The interior decor is modern and comfortable like your own home. The air conditioned bedroom is simple but comfortable. In addition, there is a simple and elegant Zhushe Restaurant and Dakeju, a multi-purpose space. Feiwu is the place that provides information about traveling. The garden is big with a green lawn perfect for camping and a variety of other activities. You will experience the fun of being in a private property when you stay at Inn By Tree.

The garden is big with a green lawn perfect for camping and a variety of other activities. You will experience the fun of being in a private property when you stay at Inn By Tree.

If you want to leave behind the city and crowds, yearning for a different kind of pure countryside, then Isabelle Garden is your ideal choice!

stays.description: Located on the Alishan Scenic Route, San Ho Yuan Recreational Homestay is a legally-certified establishment of Chiayi, with an outstanding geographic spot close to sites such as Alishan, Jhuci (Zhuqi), Fenqihu, Ruili Scenic Area, Greening Farm, DGC Leisure Farm, and Dulishan National Trail. We offer a private parking lot and bikes, meeting your needs whether you came here by bus or car. Both buildings feature a spacious living room and lobby, and cozy, elegant, spacious, and bright suite rooms. In order to provide guests with a place of relaxation outdoors, we’ve included public areas such as a pavilion rest area, tea brewing area, and BBQ area, each being filled with a comfortable, homely atmosphere. Do you have a hard time planning trips? Then don’t miss out on our complete tour plan, providing a peaceful, comfortable, and romantic vacation that includes nearby authentic local restaurants, giving you a trip of ultimate satisfaction.

stays.name: Sky B&B
stays.description: This neat, verdant tea orchard is nestled within the mountains, with whiffs of clouds embracing the mountain peaks that create a paradise-like atmosphere. The full beauty of the orchards can be witnessed during spring and summer, while autumn and winter seasons feature seas of clouds dyed crimson red by the setting sun. These picturesque sights help visitors relax and bask themselves within the beauty of nature. Homestay in Alishan - Sky B&B is a safe and legally registered Alishan B&B located at Shizhao. The location is only a 10-minute drive away from such famous destinations as Fenqi Lake Boulevard, providing great traffic accessibility. All rooms are constructed using natural wood and are comprehensively furnished to create a cozy and holiday atmosphere. The beauty of the tea gardens outside and fresh mountain air that contain the faint fragrances of the Camellia trees provide guests with a cool and refreshing environment and the perfect getaway from the blistering heat of summer.

stays.name: SunRise 23.5N House
stays.description: 「Alishan Guest House‧Sunrise 235 Manor」is located near the Alishan Highway, making it very easy and convenient to connect to nearby famous scenic sites, such as Alishan National Scenic Area, Long Tou Cliff, the Fenqihu, Shizhao Eco Reserve, etc…Besides its convenient location, Sunrise 235 Farmstead also amazes visitors by its beautiful tea garden landscape and brisk environment while is surrounded by green woods.「Alishan Guest House‧Sunrise 235 Manor」is a magnificent and spacious Taiwanese style rural architecture. With a great quantity of woods (Chinese cypress and incense wood) as the base element, the building is further decorated by red brick floor and beige walls. Meanwhile, the overall atmosphere is adopted by dark-colored wood in order to reflect outdoor natural environment. Guests can be fully embraced by fresh fragrance while staying here. The guest rooms are also designed with a great quantity of woods as the main element and are painted into the purest white color. The delicate and exquisite countryside atmosphere releases busy from the city and gives more substantial life experiences.

stays.name: Yuan Ming Ju Homestay
stays.description: Located at the highest point of Dingshizhuo Bed and Breakfast Area, Yuanming Ju has always been home to scenic and natural beauty, with expansive views, surrounded by verdant mountains, the sunrise, seas of clouds, the sunset, colorful clouds, and fog, just like a Chinese scenic ink painting, or the Land of Peach Blossoms, the blissful place yearned for by the scholar and poet Tao Yuanming. When the sun sets and the decorated lanterns go up, one can look up and see a sky full of stars, and realize the charm of this place. After retiring from finance, Liu Ningyuan (the owner) and his wife devoted themselves to the establishment of Yuanming Ju, an otherworldly paradise of delicious food, fine teas and fruit, rest, accommodation, and relaxation for those lucky enough to find it. Here, you can completely release your body’s stored-up free radicals and recharge your energy with phytoncides and anions from the green mountains and valley. Improve your health and find a new place to call “home.” The friendly owner loves to brew and share a cup of Alishan Oolong Tea with old friends, while Mrs. Liu’s tea leaf fried with eggs and perilla fried with eggs are famous for miles. After dinner, have a cup of fig jelly or try out the Hongbao sweet persimmons grown by the owner himself. Retreat into the mountains and experience the peaceful quiet of nature, fully enjoying the pleasantness of life!

stays.name: Yunlong Xiao Zhu Homestay
stays.description: Yunlong Leisure Farm is located at the 63.5 kilometer mark of the Alishan Highway at an elevation of 1,500. Due to the owner’s conservation efforts, it has become one of the most ecologically rich areas of Taiwan’s high mountain region, covering 20 hectares of original forest. The farm grows a variety of plants with medicinal properties, and if you come to visit, you’ll discover herbs and treasure everywhere you look. Additionally, delicious cuisine and beautiful scenery vary with the seasons, creating unforgettable memories. The bed and breakfast was renovated from a farmhouse and built of Taiwan red cypress wood, filling the rooms with a faint fragrance. Blankets are stuffed with down, warm in the winter and cool in the summer, bringing sweet dreams.

stays.name: lǜ yě xiān zōng Homestay
stays.description: Alishan Fenqi Lake Green Field B&B is located in Guanghua Village, Zhuqi Township, Chiayi County. It is located in the Alishan National Scenic Area and is adjacent to Alishan Fenqi Lake. This is the source of Bazhang Creek. It is surrounded by mountains and rivers, has beautiful scenery, a cool climate, is quiet and pleasant, and is full of natural resources. It allows you to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the city and enjoy the endless fun of a mountain village. You can experience catching shrimps along the river, mountain climbing and picnicking, and watching fireflies at night. In the park, you can watch countless wild birds flying, butterflies flying, dragonflies soaring...listen to the chirping of cicadas and enjoy the harmonious sounds of nature. If you are lucky, you can even catch a striga to keep you company!

stays.name: Hotel Royal Hsinchu
stays.description: Hotel Royal Hsinchu, a premier business hotel in Hsinchu, belonged to the Hotel Royal Group, and was officially opened on January 15, 1999. With its convenience to transportation and centralized location in the heart of the Hsinchu County and Hsinchu City that is near the Hsinchu Science Park, Hotel Royal Hsinchu is a favorite choice for accommodation in Hsinchu among business travelers. These 208 deluxe rooms, each room comes with an all new LCD TV and separate shower facilities, making it the most modern and well equipped hotel guest room in Hsinchu. This Hsinchu hotel provides free wireless broadband internet access and various other business amenities, ensuring smooth communications even when you are away from home. For your dining in Hsinchu, Royal Hotel Hsinchu has many dining options to choose from – Ming Court Restaurant’s Hong Kong style Cantonese cuisine, Le Café Western and Chinese fusion of delicious buffet spread, Nakayama Japanese Restaurant’s exquisite Japanese cuisine and last but not least the sizzling Royal Teppanyaki, to satisfy the different tastes of every guest. Hotel Royal Hsinchu has the most outstanding management team and service staff. We look forward to making your stay at the hotel a memorable experience!

With the Hsinchu Railway Station and Bus Station, J.Piin Shopping Mall and the Hsinchu Science Park just within our vicinity, you are guaranteed to experience a rich fusion of the Arts and the Science.Take a stroll down the Riverside right next to our hotel. This pedestrian-friendly area boasts lush greenery, fresh air, water and a green living space. Enter a fairytale world when you walk down the stretch of beautifully painted wall murals near the station! Rental point for YouBike provides an alternative way of experiencing the romantic atmosphere of the city at your own pace.In the day, soak in the warm sunlight and let the gentle winds caress your cheeks while relaxing under the shade of a tree. Hope along the stepping stones in the river or just take in the calming nature around you on the stone bridge. When night falls, the viewing platform on the 12th story of the J.Piin building will give you a bird’s eye view of the city lights. Experience the magical city of Hsinchu and let the street artistes and performers enchant you with their sweet melodies.

stays.name: Solhotel
stays.description: The symbol of the Sol Hotel is a sunflower. The sunflower in full blossom represents Sol Hotel’s enthusiasm as well as its dedication in seeking stability and perfection. The English name of the hotel is “Sol”, which means warmness reaching everywhere. This reflects a continuous guarantee of Sol Hotel in service quality. Sol Hotel, founded in 1993, is located in the heart of Hsin-Chu city’s flourishing business area, where the hotel is an island of tranquility in of a prosperous area with a well-connected transport system. The hotel is next to the historic East Gate (also known as Yingxi Gate) and its moat, Hsin-Chu’s train station, SOGO department store, Big city shopping mall, Elite bookstore, coffee shops, museums, Cheng Huang Temple, and various restaurants and bars are all within walking distance. Hsin-Chu Science Park, and Chu-Pei, Hu-Kuo, and Chu-Nan Industrial Parks are all a few minutes drive from Sol Hotel. The Sol Hotel, a delicate hotel with a historic atmosphere and ideal geographic location, is the first choice for business travelers and tourists in Hsin-Chu.

stays.name: The Ambassador Hotel Hsinchu
stays.description: A total of $6.4 Billion NT Dollars established, the aristocratic exterior architecture of the Ambassador Hotel Hsinchu, which has become the new landmark of the Hsinchu area; its top of the line out-fitting and services have become the new indicator of the local first-class leisure! The hotel is located right next to the upcoming shopping district, and is within a few minutes from the Hsinchu Train Station, and only a 15 minute drive to the interchange and Hsinchu Science Park, and is close to popular scenic spots like Neiwan, Guanxi and Beipu, its convenient central traffic location has become the first choice for those on holidays, tours or on business in the Hsinchu area! The Ambassador Hotel Hsinchu has 257 guest rooms on the executive floor with stunning city-views, the guest rooms provide a fiber-optic network and free Wi-Fi internet services, and their simplistic décor design presents an ultimate dignitary taste, which suits even the most traveled businessmen with extraordinary tastes. The epicurean delights of the Ambassador are famous for their fine quality, and there are multiple restaurants and bars such as the 9th Floor Chinese Restaurant, A CUT STEAKHOUSE, Promenade Buffet, Mezzanine Café, Le Bar Cigar Bar and Corner Bakery, and seven multi-function convention rooms that are fully equipped! Enjoy a first class leisure tour, our guests are here treated as family, the Ambassador will give you the most heavenly memories of your trip; with our friendly smiles and warm hugs, we will make the Ambassador Hotel Hsinchu feel like it’s your second home. The Ambassador Hotel Hsinchu sincerely welcomes your visit! E-mail: prdep.hc@ambassador-hotels.com
