stays.name: Zhilan Hotel
stays.description: Hsinchu 101 Hotel is located in the busy Hsinchu downtown. It was newly renovated and had a grand opening on April 1, 2012. Besides carrying on its missions - "Home Away from Home" and "Customers First" - the reasonable price and excellent service are also reasons that many customers are drawn to us. The newly decorated Hsinchu 101 Hotel is a visual breakthrough. The simple Japanese-style guestrooms are clean, elegant and comfortable.Brand New, Time-nurtured Non-traditional Decor Following the renovation, Hsinchu 101 Hotel was reopened on April 1, 2012 to symbolize a new direction in the 101st anniversary of the founding of the Republic of China. It continues to uphold the missions of "Provide a Home Away from Home" and "Customers First". The Front View of Hsinchu 101 Hotel Excellent Location - Highly Recommended for Business Travelers Hsinchu 101 Hotel is located in the busy Hsinchu downtown, about 20 meters left of the Hsinchu Station. It only takes about a 1 minute walk to some of the major public transportation stations, such as Kuo Kuang Motor Transport Terminal and the Hsinchu Bus Terminal. The nearby department stores and famous attractions, such as SOGO, Shinkung Mitsukoshi and Dayuan Department Stores, and Douchenghuang Temple are just 5-8 minutes away. The convenient location makes our hotel an excellent choice for business people or tourists alike.

It was designed with a modern style and constructed with exposed concrete mold to better blending itself with the natural scenery. The exposed concrete renders the building with the characteristics belonging to Erquan Lakeside, which is an introverted attitude to not stick out. We use a lot of glasses and a modern way on related designs also.

stays.name: Tuscany Garden B＆B
stays.description: Tuscany Country B&B - An Organic Paradise Mr. and Mrs. Luo returned home to build this B&B when they were a young couple. Mr. Luo was the descendent of the Luo Family Limestone Mining Company and Mrs. Luo was the daughter of a miner. They both embraced the tough Hakka work spirit, and raised their farm from sowing seeds to growing grains and vegetables. They created an organic, slow pace lifestyle here that feels like a paradise. The Mediterranean-style Tuscany building has an elegant dining space. Camping ground and a rock climbing course are also available for camping enthusiasts. The second floor has several guest rooms where visitors can experience and enjoy the lay-back lifestyle and the beautiful surroundings.

stays.name: Uni-Resort
stays.description: Uni-Resort - Mautu is a domed red-tile Spanish-style architecture, shaded by lush green plants and surrounded by mountain and water. The flowers and trees throughout the outdoor space emit a relaxing atmosphere. The resort was designed with fitness and health in mind and has several sports facilities. The guestrooms are decorated in various styles to meet each individual's preference. The sports facility and beautifully designed rooms make our resort your ideal lodging choice. We also have the most advanced meeting facilities, a variety of meeting rooms and team building courses, all designed especially to meet the needs for corporate trainings. We are the first hotel that combines corporate training and leisure into a resort for clients who wish to meet both purposes. In addition, the authentic Hakka-style cuisine and unique health meals served in our restaurant are must-haves when you stay with us! Haokezhuang Restauarnt handles banquets and small parties, and can accommodate up to 500 people. The cuisines served are mainly Taiwanese, Cantonese, Zhejiang and Hakka style. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are served in this restaurant. Nearby tourism attractions are Leofoo Village Theme Park, Window on China Theme Park, Taoyuan Xiangu, Mautu Discovery Forest, Guanxi Bat Cave, Shuitian Scenic Area and Yuanyanggu Waterfalls. Transportation: Take No. 2 Highway North and exit on Guanxi Interchange, turn left towards Guanxi Township, continue until you reach Youju Road and turn left. Stay on County Road 118 in the direction of Jinshan for about 15 minutes, or take No. 3 Highway to Zhongfeng New Road, in the direction of Jinshan (Jinniao Park) and drive for 8 minutes.

stays.name: Jihead Villa1507@gmail.com
stays.description: Introduction of Ji-Yue VillaJiu-Zhou Lake is a quiet and secluded mountain settlement, and later the Agriculture Committee has promoted the "Rich Countryside" project, and developed the mountain settlement into a combination of agriculture and tourism leisure area. The original environment is a beautiful mountain and river condition, and has been improved with recreational facilities of trails, pavilions and landscape table. The local farmers have set up sightseeing orchards and Hakka restaurants. With these preparation, Jiu-Zhou Lake is expected to become a popular leisure area. There are three hiking trails in the Jiu-Zhou Lake area, namely, "Jiu-fu", "Guan- Nan" and "Ji-Yue". Hiking trails can be found in the mountain and the lake area. Three trails have been planned with stone steps, red brick, or sleepers. The trails are also wide and safe to walk freely. People can absorb the natural phytoncide for about two hours while walking these three trails among the old acacia trees, suitable leisure trails for young and old people as well as children. "Ji-Yue Villa" becomes famous because it is close to Ji-Yue trail. People can come to Ji-Yue Villa from Ji-shan Bridge of Jiu-fu road along the river with bald pines planted by the Soil and Water Conservation Bureau. The bald pines have different color in four different seasons. The scenery is especially beautiful in the winter like the northland style bleak landscape. The residence also retains the traditional Hakka red brick house, part of the villa is currently open for the accommodation and resting place of tourists. Allegedly, the children of the original house owner are very smart with good school grades. Currently, they are very successful in the education sector and hold high work positions in the academia circle. This house is built facing the mountain with river and backing mountain geographical location, the so called good Feng-Shui pattern " Jade Belt Waist ", and this house is also called "Champion Home" by the local people. This house retains the ancient hakka kitchen stove that worships the traditional Chinese gods called "Stove God". When visitors arrive at the "Ancient House", they are greeted with a row of red brick and tile-roofed house. Walking red brick on the floor, the visitors will experience the sense of the past. Under the hundred-year lychee tree in the courtyard, tourists can rest and chat. In the manor, there are several old camphor trees that are extremely large and precious old trees.The green grass is planted in the garden and there is a "Big Fish" in the form of a fish pond, where the carps swim in fish pond and the wood flooring platform is the best view of the beautiful scenery and the bald pines. It is also possible to gaze at “South Park”from the manor, a good recreational activity venue for the group tourists to dance and sing songs. It is like a paradise and it is also a wonderful choice for vacation and relaxation.Service Items:1. Accommodation2. Mountaineering Trip Planning (Itinerary Tour)3. Order the Restaurant Services (Liu Stew Chicken, Chen Farm Restaurant, and Catering Service) for the Tourists4. Group Activities Arrangements (Package for Karaoke Singing)5. Meeting Arrangements

stays.name: Huanman Shitiping Homestay
stays.description: Hualian｜ Adagio ShihtipingA Slow Travel Journey Between Mountains and SeaTime seems to slow down beneath clear blue skies as you follow the Hualian-Taitung Coastal Highway (Provincial Highway 11) from Changbin township northward to Fengbin. Pulling off into the Shitiping ocean-lookout rest area, you arrive at today’s destination: Adagio Shihtiping. At a slow, relaxed pace, you set off on your exclusive journey.The enchanting elegance of mountain and seaCrossing grassy fields and ascending stone steps with the Pacific Ocean spread out right before your eyes, you push open the front doors and are greeted by the faint smell of solid wood and the smiles of your cordial hosts. Gentle piano music plays in the background as you take in the ocean vista beyond the windows and any tension you’ve brought with you slowly fades away. Laying your luggage to one side, you enter the main hall and enjoy the afternoon array of self-serve refreshments consisting of fresh seasonal fruit, handmade indigenous desserts, and fresh coffee. Sitting beside floor-to-ceiling windows and gazing at the captivating coastal vistas, your spirits feel soothed by the waves gently lapping the shore and the clouds drifting carefree through the sky.You peruse the local indigenous artwork in the main hall. With their roots in the natural world, these works of art create yet another fascinating landscape for the delight of travelers. With their insistence upon a win-win community philosophy, all Adagio Inn branches are making connections between local art and the natural environment.Enjoy pampered intimacy in any of seven private ocean-view roomsService personnel considerately help you choose the room key and the aromas best suited to your tastes, adding to the pleasure of the travel experience. Each keychain is unique, with indigenous markings that represent different romantic stories and cultural elements. Once you choose your favorite relaxing aroma from several unique herbal bath creams, the housekeeper will swap the shower products in your room for your preferred fragrance so that bath time may become a journey back to your most comfortable self.As you take off your shoes and walk up the wooden stairs, the coziness of this house reveals itself. Lounging in the spacious common room, with its assortment of magazines, two hardwood tables and roomy sofa, you can enjoy a slow-paced, cheerful mountain holiday by the seaside even without leaving the comforts of the B&B.The 330-square meter space allows each of the seven rooms to have its own special ocean view and independent open balcony. Whether you find your own comfy corner to laze around in or head out of Shitiping for a stroll, there is no need to add the stress and haste of a travel plan to your vacation. Just find your favorite spot and stay put and let the clouds and mist of the mountains drift slowly through your state of mind.Diverse breakfast dishes, slow travel with beautiful sceneryIn the brilliant morning sunlight, you stroll into the main hall to enjoy a delicious breakfast of warm congee accompanied by an array of tidy side dishes made from healthy local ingredients and served on a three-by-three square of nine small porcelain plates a la Chinese calligraphy paper and a bowl of refreshing fish soup, leaving both body and soul feeling nourished and satisfied. Before leaving, you bid farewell to the gorgeous scenery outside the floor-to-ceiling windows. Your heart suddenly softens as your body unconsciously unloads some of its usual burden. As the stress of the usual struggle for survival is cast aside, you become aware that the thing you needed to warm your heart, after all, was a date with the mountains and sea at Adagio Shihtiping.

stays.name: Oceanskyline Homestay
stays.description: "Two travel lovers and musicians found and acquired a piece of uncared land in the middle of Eastern Taiwan seven years ago to make their dream of peaceful life. Besides music, they also have a passion for architecture. With fundamentals from related publications and shows, three years of discussion with engineer Mr. Chao, and two years of planning with gifted designer Mr. Li, they built up their dream with the idea taken from Pacific. The house is playful with the long wall resembling seven paino keys from do-re-mi to fa-so-la-si. The guests have their independent space, while they can make friends in the lobby. Each room provides sea view, secures privacy, and is equipped with sound-proof, air-right laminated glass window to provide unobscured view of sea and the Coastal Mountain Range. With its earthquake-resistant structure and stylish yet durable doors, you can feel at ease when enjoying the sea view, starry sky and wind."

stays.name: Shitiyuan Homestay
stays.description: Located in Shitiping Recreation Area in the East Coast Scenic Area, Sea Fan Bed and Breakfast is a 3-story grey washed-pebble building backed against the Coastal Mountain Range and facing the Pacific Ocean, providing a variety of experiences including mornings and evenings throughout the seasons, whale-watching, and quiet contemplation during walks along the beach. On clear days, the bright and dazzling sunlight of the beach makes the blue decoration of the sea even more charming, while cloudy days bring the sea and mountains a more majestic atmosphere, resembling a masteful Chinese scenic painting. The courtyard is filled with special coastal plants and borders the Shitiping Recreation Area. Visitors can take a morning or afternoon stroll along Shiti Coast, observing the coastal erosion and coral reef, watching fishermen from the one-sided mountain, or watching them sell their goods at Shiti Harbor. The first floor offers Hualien Sugar Factory ice cream and treats, as well as food and drinks. The second floor has a coffee shop, providing coffee, juice, and flower tea, as well as classic Mandarin and Taiwanese albums. Rooms are on the third floor, providing accommodation. Welcome to Shiti Yuan - release your worries and follow your destiny.

stays.name: Jing Yuan Chi Pan Homestay
stays.description: In addition to expansive grounds, Jingyuan Chipan Bed and Breakfast’s most remarkable feature is its visual pollution-free environment. The building covers 330 square meters and was designed with green features as well as a color and style that perfectly matches the grounds, while the interior decoration is exquisite and elegant, with the owner’s careful planning evident in every area. This is a 100% “home” design and therefore only includes 3 rooms of modest size, featuring classic design, to offer guests who share our countryside dream or wish to experience such a life. Features of our business – Operated based on the spirit of a bed and breakfast, with the owner living in the same building with guests and serving as their best local guides. Since this is the owner’s side business, it’s a low pressure environment that hosts no more than one party of “good friends” per day. In order to provide guests with a safe and secure eating and accommodation experience, we maintain cleanliness and offer food and drink, which the wife of the owner insists on carefully preparing and handling herself. The surrounding landscape and ecology is natural and diverse, offering new sights and surprises based on the season or climate. A favorite among old customers, this is a place that can’t be fully appreciated without seeing it in person.

stays.name: Stay.qingchuan
stays.description: Listen, the noise of the city is gone! It’s the sound of birds, frogs, insects, ducks, and geese. Are you moved? Then do something about it! As the smell of fresh fruit wafts over you, enjoy running in the orchard, taste organic fruit, and recall the happiness of playing barefoot in the mud as a child. Featuring richly nostalgic countryside living, a beautiful living environment, and outstanding service, this is your perfect choice for accommodations. Here you’re surrounded by beautiful scenic green mountains and plains, experiencing the ultimate leisure of biking the little paths of the countryside fields and breathing in the phytoncides, lifting and refreshing your spirits. Combining a recreational farm, this bed and breakfast allows guests to experience the fun of picking fruit, roasting duck, and relaxing with family to enjoy an unrestrained countryside life. After night falls, twinkling stars appear before your eyes! No, they’re fireflies! Watch them perform a welcoming dance, feast on freshly picked organic, pesticide-free fruit, and sip fragrant tea…this must be paradise. When you’re fully rested and ready, welcome the bright new day and get ready to explore the nearby culture and scenery!

stays.name: Fengnan small Tianzhuang B & B
stays.description: Nestled in the lush greenery of Fengnan Village, this traditional residence—over 80 years old—stands as a rare, well-preserved example of historic architecture. Built with handwoven bamboo structures, it showcases the ingenious craftsmanship and wisdom of a bygone era. Now transformed into a cozy guesthouse, it retains its original charm, offering natural comfort: warm in winter and cool in summer.Staying here is like stepping into a time tunnel. The nostalgic ambiance brings to life the simplicity and resilience of the past, allowing guests to truly connect with the spirit of old Taiwan. It is not just a stay, but a journey through time—a tranquil feast of history and tradition. You are warmly invited to experience it for yourself.

stays.name: Fuli Stay
stays.description: Fuli Stay B&B is about a 5-minute walk from the Fuli Station. It's located in the southernmost town of Hualian, and at the junction of Fuli Township and Chishang Township in Taitung. The B&B's modern black pebble exterior wall is quite a contrast to the interior, which mainly uses local Taiwan wood. The warm feel of the cypress wood handrail matches the rustic and warm ambiance created by the B&B owner. The handmade cypress wooden bed frame and pure white bedding, still emitting the smell of fresh clean laundered sheets, are inviting and comfortable. The decor in the bedroom exudes the image of a beautiful scenery in the east coast, like the breathtaking view of the East Rift Valley outside the window. The colors of the farm fields outside change from lush green to golden yellow season to season. Watching the waves of grains in the rice paddy moving gracefully in the wind makes you forget all your troubles. Besides the beautiful natural scenery, we also pay special attention to your comfort. While the decor is modest and simple, a full set of HCG bathroom fixtures, SPA shower and Washlet toilet allow our guests to be comfortable and feel at home. Fuli Stay B&B welcomes your visit.

stays.name: Fulib Homestay
stays.description: The beautiful scenery of Taiwan is in the east, and the secret place of the eastern Taiwan is in Fuli; the secret place of Fuli is more beautiful than the pictures, and the best homestay in the eastern Taiwan for private tours is Fulib Homestay.Fulib Homestay is around 800 meters away from Fuli Railway Station, about a 10-minute walk. The terrace overlooks the Fuli lifestyle, beautiful scenery, and the starry sky.Fulib Homestay is located at the commanding heights of Fuli village. You can overlook the streets of Fuli from a high altitude, and at the same time, you can enjoy the Central Mountains, Coastal Mountains, and East Longitudinal Valley's changing shapes and colors of clouds. The fresh air makes your field of vision more penetrating. It feels like you own the whole world from a high position. At night, you can go up to the Star Wishing Platform and look up at the starry sky 360 degrees. If you are lucky, a shooting star will pass by and you can make a wish!Fulib Homestay's Features:Brand new self-built single-family house next to Fuli Township LibraryMake an appointment and book a room. Free taxi pick-up from Fuli Station.Each room has its own bathroom, heating and cooling, and a 55-inch 4K LCD TV.Free breakfast provided (with reservation)Free WifiFree and convenient parking

stays.name: Kilm B&B
stays.description: A leisure home stay bigger than an elementary school, it is situated on the border of Hualien and Taitung counties, a 5 minute drive from Chihshang (Chishang) Train Station, and an 8 minute drive from Fu Li Train Station. The outer wall is made of red bricks. The indoor space is distinctively decorated with Taiwanese wood. The guest rooms especially emphasize light and ventilation. The bedrooms and bathrooms are dry and comfortable, with a warm and comfortable environment. Outside, rosemary and chrysanthemum are grown on MOA organic certified land. With the many kinds of flowers and broad leisure space, the nearby mountains and ocean, Brick Home is most suitable for slow, relaxed leisure pace. Staying at Brick Home Stay, you have easy access to the nearby sights: Embrace nature- Fu Li, ChihShiang, and Guan Shan Flower Sea, Liushidan Mountain (Liushishi Mountain), Chi Ke Mountain, Dapo Pond, Nan Heng Scenic Area, Nan An Waterfall Walami Trail, Rui Yuan and Ruishui (Ruisui) water rafting, Luyeh plateau (Luye Gaotai ) hot air balloon, Chihshiang Brown Bicycle Trail, Anton (Antong) Hot Spring. Aboriginal culture- Pisilian Paw Paw drums, Bunun ear hitting festival (Mala-ta-ngia), Amis Harvest Festival.

A rich western-style breakfast is served to give you all the energy you need. We hope all of our guests can stay in a relaxing and comfortable environment.(Overtue) How long has it been since I strolled around casually in the farmland and forest, and allowed myself to get lost? How long has it been since I looked at the stars in the sky and be amazed by the shooting star? How long has it been since I paid attention to the changes around me and noticed the beauty of each changing season? How long has it been since I encountered a Taiwan blue magpie and Mikado pheasant in the mountain forest? Here, Young green life symbolizes spring, Pink lotus symbolizes summer, Chinese sivergrass symbolizes autumn, Golden yellow rapeseed flowers symbolize winter.

stays.name: Sweethome 101 Homestay
stays.description: Instead of a luxurious, magnificent exterior, Sweet Home 101 Bed and Breakfast has a friendly, genuine heart, aiming to provide you with a clean, secure, warm, comfortable, experience different from ordinary motels, making guests feel at home. Sweet Home 101’s decoration is displayed according to concept, with handmade furniture and countryside drawings, creating an appropriate atmosphere and style. Leisurely gaze up at the blue sky and white clouds from the countryside-style courtyard, as the mild scent of green grass brings in a deep breath of fresh air. Put the distractions of the city behind you and enjoy a quiet, romantic atmosphere, finding rest for the soul. Dear friends: Are you ready to give yourself a wonderful, relaxing vacation? The beautiful scenery of the East Rift Valley brings a warm happiness to your journey. Attractions near Sweet Home 101 include: Lintian Mountain (nostalgic trip), Fuyuan Butterfly Valley (distinct seasonal scenery and a hot springs area on the grounds), Mataian Wetland (rich natural ecology and special Amis tribe restaurant), Hualien Sugar Factory (delicious ice cream and treats), Taibalang Settlement (special Amis tribe culture), all well worth a trip.

stays.description: TSC Hualien Hotel is located in Guangfu Township, Hualien County, was a sugar refinery of a private 【Ensuiko Sugar Refining Co., Ltd.】 in the Japanese colonial period. The buildings were constructed according to the "Building Standards of Official Residences" of Governor-General of Taiwan, and the current Japanese-style wooden dormitories were constructed in 1936 for staff quarters purpose. It remains 27 buildings, consisting of 73 rooms, and other quarters for single employees (now renovated as a Creative Studio), dorms for officials on business trip, clinic, offices, etc., a total of five wooden structure buildings. After renovation, the Japanese-style dormitories have been transformed into a hotel with historic characteristic style. The housing is divided into Japanese log cabins (room for two) and parent-child log cabins (room for four) and family log cabins(room for four)etc. Each room is a wooden structure building with the most primitive style. It features comfortable environment, soft colors and lighting, introverted calm design style, makes you still feel the beauty of Japanese culture, while escaping from the urban jungle to cast off tensions. We at TSC Hualien Hotel cordially invite you to stay and experience the elegance of Japanese-style log cabins.

stays.name: 36lighthouse
stays.description: Number 36 Lighthouse Home Stay is situated in Hualien City, and is the home stay closest to the ocean. Along the coast, there are many recreational facilities, which allow you to easily step closer to this beautiful ocean. The homes stay owner is very friendly, and makes every guest feel right at home. The old lighthouse in memory: Originally it was pure white. In 1980, Hualien Harbor was extended, and the lighthouse was demolished; a new red lighthouse was later built. The lighthouse during our childhood was a landmark where we gathered and played, and also a place we went to when we are bored. No matter how we played, we and the lighthouse are inseparable. The lighthouse became the most loyal playmate. Now, I have also established my own white lighthouse, and I also hope to provide travelers the best recreational choice in Hualien. You can enjoy the beautiful views of the Pacific Ocean from your room. Lying in bed, you can see the sunset and hear the sound of wave crashing. Outside the building, there is an ocean view platform where you can drink coffee leisurely, and enjoy the ocean scenery. Our scenery is worth appreciating and will relax you. Number 36 Lighthouse is the only place with the magnificent sunrise in the east, sea breeze and bright moon at night, sea viewing, wave listening, and the sight of fishing boats entering and exiting the harbor. Local delicacies, from seafood and bomb scallion pancakes, temple pole black tea, Gong Cheng steamed buns to Yi Hsian won ton can all be eaten nearby. You can also rent motorcycles to travel to each scenic spot. We arrange trips to the famous Nan Bing (Nanbin) and Tzu Chiang (Ziqiang) Night Markets, Bei Bing Park, the beach, Farglory Ocean Park nearby, and also whale watching and river tracing trips.

stays.name: Aili Si Homestay
stays.description: Walking in the European white stone gate in small steps, Alice’s ponytail on the azure collar, two white cats by the foot, following the vines twining on the wall side elegantly to form a beautiful curve. Alice begins to anticipate “Aili Si’s Homestay”, bypassing the metallic black square table, the carpet with totems gradually floats to contrast the snow white leather sofa, the standing rose lamp and two aristocratic coffee cups are having a conversation; Alice slows down the pace to listen to their whispers, “I hear Mr. Rabbit is here, and this little girl is looking for him”, at this moment, the sound of the clock rings in the ears, Alice continues to search forward. The green vines, white stone statue, colored candle, and royal chandelier endowed this place with exotic colors, more splendor and romance. At this moment, the footsteps stop by the entrance to this pink space, the sun gently shines through red flower laces, and Mr. Rabbit who lying on the soft bed is startled, when Alice screams in excitement: Found you, Mr. Rabbit!

The newly-opened "Be Sunny B & B" sits in an alley of the Golden Triangle in Hualien. With an environment suitable for both static and dynamic activities, the entire building has the most primitive and natural architectural concrete walls with simple texture looking like splash-ink paintings. There is no too much chemical paint. The B&B owner has a unique sense of design, integrating the loft, industrial, retro, simplicity, and fashionable style with the interior design. The building appearance of the "Be Sunny B & B" is so striking that the entire building is filled with young and vibrant vitality. The B&B owner retired from his previous job upholds the traditional concept and believes that "home" is the source of happiness. Thus he guards Be Sunny B & B and you.

He turned his 350 sqm villa and land into a hostel and named it Bellaria ("pleasing air" in Italian). This quiet, elegant European rural villa is designed with garden and parking spaces. It sits at Meilun Cultural and Educational Area, with easy access to park, 7-11 convenience store, culture center, port scenic bridge, golf course, and two churches. It takes about 5 minutes of driving to shop in downtown, go for whale-watching from Hualien Port, or take a walk at Qixingtan Bay. European bed and breakfast "Bellalia" is your best accommodation partner in Hualien!

stays.name: Dumbo Hostel Hualien
stays.description: Dumbo Hostel is a cozy, affordable spot just 3 mins from Hualien Station! Enjoy free Wi-Fi, lockers, and breakfast. We provide kitchen access, laundry services, and privacy with functional beds. Please bring your own toothpaste, toothbrush, and towel, or rent from us. No food/drinks on guest floors, and keep quiet after 10 PM. Come enjoy green living, a comfy stay, and no curfew!❤️ Reception business hour: 15:00 ~ 22:00 ❤️ Check in time : 15:00 ~ 22:00 ❤️ Check out time : ~ 11:00front gate, backyard, and lobbyDumbo HostelWhat's a 'DUMBO' ? Let us explain the value Dumbo Guesthouse cherish. Every person visiting DUMBO is considered as a Guest and a Family. “Come as a guest. Leave as a friend” is our catch phrase. We guarantee a trip that you will never forget through our satisfying friendly service to all the guests visiting DUMBO. It’s easy to make new friends here, also you can exchange cultures and tips for trip! We do hold parties and give you great chances to be connected each other, including us! All we are so friendly and always happy to help you to make your trip greater! Dumbo Hostel is a homely, clean, affordable accommodation located just a three minutes’ walk from Hualien Railway Station. We are the perfect hostel to accommodate you during your stay in Hualien.To remind you of some accommodation notices, you need to prepare your own toothpaste, toothbrush and bath towel; you can eat and drink ONLY in the lobby on the first floor, and the kitchen and the refrigerator can be used. Food and beverages are NOT allowed on the guest floor; after 10 PM in the evening, please keep your voice down, do not disturb the rest of other guests. No smoking inside the building. We wish we can maintain the quality of accommodation together.Additionally, we provide complimentary amenities such as free Wi-Fi, secure lockers, reading lights, a guest kitchen, laundry facilities, and much more! Start your day with a delicious breakfast offered every morning 8:00 to 10:00AM. Dumbo promotes green and conscious living by encouraging sharing and mindful choices in daily life, aiming for a more sustainable world. Please read our T&Cs below before booking, so there are no surprises! What we provide is FREE: *Internet access. *AC. shower gel, shampoo, hair dryer *Kitchen (drinking water, microwave, and induction stove) Free coffee/tea bags /Free Breakfast What we provide is CHARGE: * Towel rental (NT$30) *big towel(NT $50) *toothbrush set(NT$10) and coin laundry machine.See you in beautiful Hualien.===Best Choice For Your Stay In Hualien===*3 mins walk from Hualien Railway Station Exit “West”. *No Curfew!! *Free Wi-Fi *Shower rooms and Living room are available. *Fully equipped kitchen. *Laundry service with free detergent. *Functional beds with reading light, outlet for power, sub cushion and curtain/slide door keeps your privacy. ==== BUSINESS HOURS ==== * Reception business hour: 08:00 ~ 10:00 15:00 ~ 22:00 * Check in time : 15:00 ~ 22:00 * Check out time : ~ 11:00 + If you need an arrangements for late check-in, please inform us in advance via e-mail. ==== LOCATION ==== *3 mins walk from Hualien Railway Station Exit West. We are located in the heart of Hualien. (for sightseeing, eating, shopping, and everything!)

stays.name: Easttown 26 Hotel
stays.description: Easttown 26 opened in December 2008, is located in a secluded and quiet corner of downtown Hualien, just blocks away from the bustling city center, major gourmet snack shops, and specialty boutiques. When entering the lobby, you are greeted with one big red welcome glazed wall, simple and elegant chandeliers, unique rose landscape stone of Hualien specialty, presenting an oriental style of antique beauty spontaneously. We uphold our commitment to offer services with a friendly attitude to make travelers feel at home. Tired of the fast paced busy city, are you ready to have a relaxing holiday? Bring your family or friends, or a good book to savor the leisurely pace of Easttown 26, and write a new note in your personal travel journal.

stays.name: Fairy Tale Motel Co., Ltd. Metropolitan Branch
stays.description: The Fairy Tale Hotel is hidden in the quiet alleys of Hualien City, just a ten-minute walk to the vibrant shopping area in the city center. The Dongdamen Night Market (Rainbow Night Market) offers delicious treats like temple entrance red tea, steamed buns from Gongzheng Street, and oyster omelets from Haipu, all within easy reach. You can also ride the bicycles provided by the Fairy Tale Hotel, enjoying the warm sunshine and gentle sea breeze as you leisurely explore the beauty of Hualien along the Beibin Park, Shuguang Bridge, and Qixingtan bike paths. The themed rooms at the Fairy Tale Hotel are meticulously designed to provide you with the highest quality and most comfortable accommodation experience. Each room is equipped with a luxurious massage bathtub to help weary travelers wash away their fatigue. Travel is not a race against the schedule; it is about escaping the hustle and bustle of the city, completely relaxing your body and mind, and enjoying the leisurely pace of life in the back mountains. The Fairy Tale Hotel will accompany you on a wonderful and unforgettable journey.

Hualien Harbor is a tourist destination for whale watching in the summer. Other places to visit in Hualien include Taroko, Huadong Valley, Hualien East Coast, and Mugumuki,. At Small Whale House, you’ll enjoy a level of friendliness and laid-back atmosphere not found in hotels. We offer soft beds and a good night of sleep, clean bathrooms to wash away your fatigue, and a warm, comfortable living room that’s a great place to chat and drink tea with a group of friends. If you like warm, laid-back bed and breakfasts, come to Small Whale House, where you’re sure to create great memories!

stays.description: The "Kadda Hotel" is located next to the Hualien Harbour facing the Pacific Ocean. It is a sports-themed hotel. It is not only the first bicycle-themed sports hotel in eastern Taiwan. The whole building is more active in promoting cycling and low-carbon travel. All rooms are equipped with organic non-toxic premium Italian imported toiletries. As soon as you enter the welcome hall of Kadda, the first thing that comes to your attention is a full-faced Hualien bicycle map and logo. On the wall, there are many antique handmade steel bicycles from the 60s and 80s. The bicycle-style hall is full of flavors and is a lot of passengers. stays.name: Kaixin Homestay
stays.description: My names is Xunyi, and I was raised here in Hualien. In order to realize a simple dream and have more time to spend with my beloved mother, I decided, before the age of 32, to switch professions and enter the bed and breakfast business. The grand opening of Happy Hostel was held in 2012; now it is a legally-certified establishment in downtown Hualien, featuring a spacious area, comfortable atmosphere, and simple, tasteful style. Rooms come with windows and stand-alone HCG separate wet/dry area bathrooms. Welcome to Happy Hostel! Happy Hostel is located in the city center with convenient transportation, close to the train station and a variety of local delicacy attractions, including exploding onion pancake with egg, Time Book House, Ziqiang Night Market, Far Eastern Department Store, Tzu Chi Campus, Kagawa Sushi House, Gongzheng Street Buns, Miaokou Black Tea, Nanbin Night Market, Pine Garden, and Qixingtan, all a 3-10 minute drive away. Our building is very easy to find (next door to Settour and across the street from Hualien Vocational High School of Agriculture, a rare place in the city with views of the school campus, trees, and ocean.

stays.name: Lishiuan International Hotel
stays.description: Lishiuan Hotel is the perfect choice. The excitement of the city center is only 2.3 Km away. A haven of rest and relaxation, the hotel will offer total renewal just steps away from the city's numerous attractions such as Hualien County Stone Sculpture Museum, Meiluen Shan Nature Park, Meilunxi Riverside Park.Take advantage of a wealth of unrivaled services and amenities at this Hualien hotel. A selection of top-class facilities such as free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour front desk, 24-hour room service, facilities for disabled guests, luggage storage can be enjoyed at the hotel. Hotel accommodations have been carefully appointed to the highest degree of comfort and convenience. In some of the rooms, guests can find locker, wooden/parqueted flooring, slippers, complimentary instant coffee, separate living room. Throughout the day you can enjoy the relaxing atmosphere of the fitness center, golf course (within 3 km), spa, garden, karaoke. Whatever your reason for visiting Hualien, the Lishiuan Hotel is the perfect venue for an exhilarating and exciting break away.

stays.description: Mix hostel is located in front of Hualien train station. Only takes 5 minitues by walking. Each suite is decorated with western and aboriginal details. The fusion of varied cultural themes makes each room a surprising expression of aesthetics, simple and classical. The location of the hostel is very convenient for leisure or business with super market (7-11), dining, coffee shop, cinema, bars, and bowling store around the hostel. About 10 minutes, you can visit the Hualien downtown and the night fair. Spacious room, wooden floor, and comfort bed cheer up the visitors and release their fatigue. Every visitor uses the key with senor to entry the hostel. High security increases the quality of rest and sleep for visitors.Mix B&B plans a trip for 2 or 3 days to visit the Taroko National Park (northern Hualien) or rift valley or seascape (southern Hualien). With our utmost sincerity, we welcome you to be our honorable guests and serve you a pleasant time at Mix hostel.

stays.name: Moon House B& B
stays.description: Moon House B&B - Where you sleep with the moon... Everyone wants to get away from the hustle and bustle of daily life. In Hualien, we have prepared this holiday house for you. Every bit of it is designed by the owner. It is quiet, clean, and comfortable. And it is refined with imported wooden furniture, the chandeliers and the artworks. What& #39;s more - the warm and welcoming hosts that wish to make friends with everyone is the main feature of the place. Moon House B&B is on Meilun Mountain, Hualien. It is secluded and has plenty of space to park by the road. It is a 10-minute drive to downtown Hualien. A Freshly cooked breakfast is provided for every room. Rooms are equipped with a 32-inch LCD TV, household speakers, a refrigerator, a coffee machine, and free Internet. Moon House B&B makes sure every room is professionally cleaned before every check-in. Room amenities are replaced regularly. We provide a supreme environment with imported wooden furniture. This is where you can rest your mind and soul and enjoy every bit of your stay.

stays.name: OCEAN HOTEL HUALIEN
stays.description: Ocean Hotel Hualien is located on the seashore of the Pacific Ocean. The hotel is built with local raw stones and furnished with handmade log furniture, and with a modern minimalist style. The suites facing the sea view employ ceiling-to-floor scenery glass curtain, and you can watch the sunrise in the morning and the sunset in the evening, providing you a vantage point to see the sweep of beautiful Pacific sea view. Ocean Hotel Hualien is just 5 minutes' drive from downtown, Train Station, and Nanbin Night Market, and 10 minutes from the Hualien Airport by car. In front of the Hotel, you can find a sea water swimming zone of the Beibin Park, sea landscape trails, and bike lanes. To the right, the Hotel neighbors on Meilun River, Beibin and Nanbin Parks, to the left, connects to Qixingtan, the whale-watching recreation pier of Hualien Harbor, and Mt. Meilun and the Pine Garden of National Monuments are behind the Hotel. The hotel offers staying guests Western buffet breakfast, welcome drinks, free shuttles to and from the Train Station, airport, urban area, etc., and attentive services and travel advice. A great location and functions for leisure, business, tourism, and sport life. It is your best choice for accommodation when you visit Hualien.

stays.name: Olah Poshtel Hualien
stays.description: OLAH POSHTEL Hualien is located near the city center of Hualien, just a 10-minute walk from the Zhongzheng Commercial Area. Popular attractions such as Dongdamen Night Market, Far Eastern Department Store, and South Bay Scenic Park are within easy reach, allowing guests to leisurely explore the city and experience a laid-back lifestyle.The hotel offers 39 rooms and 12 bunk beds, combining the core concept of "sharing" with sleek design elements to create a new type of light luxury hostel. It not only provides a warm, friend-like hospitality experience but also offers a relaxed and carefree atmosphere. Additionally, the hotel features automated check-in, free Wi-Fi throughout the building, Bluetooth speakers, a shared kitchen, a reading room, an interactive lounge, a self-service laundry, a rooftop garden, and free bicycle rentals, among other unique services. Guests can enjoy the familiar feeling of being at home during their stay.

stays.name: Pink Corner Hotel
stays.description: Hotel located in Hualien County(Meet Hualien Pinyue) A touch of pink in Gouzaiwei, a busy area in Hualien, pays tribute to that glorious era!Hualien Pinyue Hotel is an eye-catching pink building located at the corner of the alley in Gouzaiwei. Half a century ago, it was a traveler's hotel with more than ten rooms, where people of all kinds came and went. It was rebuilt from the original Datong Business Hotel and became a special hotel under the planning of interior designers. On the one hand, it retains the soul of the years, and integrates the new era design to give the old building a new life. The pink color echoes the prosperous era of Hualien's downtown area with bright fireworks. In the past, the predecessors came to Hualien and exchanged their lives for a second life. Now Pinyue wants tourists to have a second life of relaxation after staying in Hualien; continuing the years, it welcomes travelers from afar with warm human feelings!(Meet Pinyue Room) The alleys of the old city block the hustle and bustle of the downtown area, giving you a sense of quiet timeEach room in the Hotel Pin Yue has a well-designed window. The changing light and shadow make you feel like you are in history. The modern bathroom is refreshing and neat. The wireless charging bedside table allows you to feel the intimate touch of the hotel! Located in the busiest alley in Hualien City, counting the stories of the old city is like stepping into a living history. The narrow alley slightly blocks the hustle and bustle of the traffic, allowing the hotel to cleverly have a quiet and secluded feeling in the bustling city. Come to the Hotel Pin Yue for a night and experience the most story-filled night in Hualien!!Check-in time: After 15:00Check-out time: before 11:00Hotel phone number: 03-834-2166Hotel address: No. 155, Nanjing Street, Hualien City

stays.name: SEVEN INn
stays.description: We are in Hualien. This is a beginning, one may enter the internationally famous Taroko Gorge when visiting here, and embrace the wind through jogging 42Km or riding a bicycle; you may row a kayak to admire the beauty of the crystal clear water from the surface of the Pacific Ocean; have conversation with whales and dolphins by crossing over the black tide that cultivates life; visit the stream by going upwards to search for the legendary Golden Valley. When the evening lights are lit, get away from the bustling city and follow the dots of lights to reminisce the childhood fun. In the silence of the night, we can go passionately across the Central Cross-Island Highway to arrive at Wuling, open arms wide to look up at the endless starry sky; when the first ray of morning sun shines, grab your surfboard and switch on the weather radio, where Jack Johnson accompanies you to dive in the sea to catch the waves. You can even do nothing but be a rebellious urban kid and have a small love encounter with Seven Inn.

stays.name: Shiny Ocean Hotel
stays.description: Sunny Hotel Management Co., Ltd was established in Taipei in 1987 by Mr. Chen Chen Hsing (chairman of the board). The hotel and catering management company which provides a variety of services had established the five star hotel Alishan House at Ali mountain in 2002. Upholding the spirit of providing excellent services for every guest, the hotel had earned its reputation during all these years. After establishing Alishan House, the company had decided to build the Shiny Ocean Hotel, in Huanlien. With the unique and natural Taroko National Park on one side, the beautiful coastline on the other. Shiny Ocean Hotel is home for 86 tasteful decoration bedrooms. Well positioned at the coast of Pacific Ocean, the high floor rooms of Shinny Ocean are featured with magnificent ocean views. When the window is opened, you can feel the sea breeze in your face, smell the sea air, and see the beautiful landscapes. It takes about 15 minutes walking distance to reach city center. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see tourism attractions such as local snacks, and special souvenir stores. No matter you drive to here or take bus, we can always offer you the best hotel experience and the happiest journey. Welcome to our hotel!

When the window is opened, you can feel the sea breeze in your face, smell the sea air, and see the beautiful landscapes. It takes about 15 minutes walking distance to reach city center. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see tourism attractions such as local snacks, and special souvenir stores. No matter you drive to here or take bus, we can always offer you the best hotel experience and the happiest journey. Welcome to our hotel!

stays.description: The fast pace of life in the city has accumulated a lot of stress and fatigue physically and mentally. At this time, you should get away from the hustle and bustle and come to Hualien to enjoy the slow life and the beauty of nature here! Near Hualien Railway Station! The homestay is designed with the concept of coffee shop decoration, a lot of wooden furniture exudes a calm atmosphere, the space is spacious and unstressed, the atmosphere is quite leisurely without losing the warm feeling of home! Here not only the service is attentive, the equipment is novel, but also an elevator is thoughtfully provided to make your travel more convenient! Such a high-quality homestay recommendation, let’s go now and have a pure vacation!The rooms at Hualien Little Squirrel B&B are clean and bright, all have external windows, and are cleaned by professional cleaning staff every day. Each room has its own bathroom, heating and cooling air-conditioning, TV, hair dryer, etc. There is also an elevator, no matter how tall the room is.In addition, it provides travel consultation, travel booking or car rental services.

stays.name: TABOHOUSE
stays.description: Dear friends, we don't have a big piece of land, garden, let alone a swimming pool...just a reminder so I'm sure you won't ask again at your visit, and it's the duty of Central Weather Bureau to predict the weather of...let's say...the day you're visiting in the next month. It's absolutely beyond my knowledge. And don't ask me something like ""are the whales awake now?"" I can tell you everything about having fun in Hualien: river trekking, rafting, quiet activities in Taroko National Park, scenic spots along the Coastal Range, and the popular restaurants and local delicacies. Don't hesitate to ask, even you're not going to stay here! Our homestay is registered and the host is living here. If you're going to rent the whole building (although legally we can’t call it that), we'll leave maximum freedom to you. The following answers some frequently asked questions, and notices: The guest rooms are equipped with brand new split-system air conditioner, 42-in LCD TV, and the rooms for 4 have separate bathrooms and washrooms as well as new hair dryer. Please note that the environment is out-dated in The Google street! Attention (updated August 16 2015):1. We provide toiletries, towels and face cloths (please don’t take them home, or you’ll make me cry) 2. We have a free parking lot for guests. 3. We can order breakfast from outside for you, we don’t make it ourselves such as egg pancakes, burgers or sandwiches When there is a discount on room fare, we're sorry that you have to find breakfast somewhere else! 4. We provide transportation from and to the train station and airport at NTD 100~150 per trip (with 7 seats, and free for frequent visitors). Please note that it's too difficult for me to drive at small hours, but it's all right if you're frequent visitor or you're on the run (I'm not kidding! I met this situation before!) 5. I consider my guests friends. I will take care of you and talk your worries away, but never burn charcoal or barbeque in the rooms! You may have fun but it can be my property's doom! 6. Smoking is banned in the rooms, you must ask me for ashtray and smoke at balcony! Note that ""no smoking"" sign is applied here for regulatory compliance! 7. We provide grillied food ordering and self-made grill wire meshes, the latter should be cleaned after use for the convenience of the next visitor! We appreciate your kindness and consideration.

stays.name: Travelers’ Home
stays.description: Travelers’ Home B&BWelcome to “Travelers’ Home”, a friendly B&B offers comfortable accommodation and healthy fine food. The B&B is located in a high quality neighborhood next to Tzu-Chi Cultural Park in Hua-lien City. It is easy to access shopping areas and night markets.These are many tourist attractions nearby. A 30-minute drive from Travelers’ Home B&B, you could reach the famous Taroko Gorge National Park, Chishingtan Beach and Liyu (Carp) Lake. Several ecological trails, bike paths, religious places and indigenous tribes are within walking or short biking distance.If you are interested in organic agriculture, ecology, culture and healthy find food, the Travelers’ Home B&B is your best choice! The owner Dora Mama has excellent knowledge and plentiful experiences “from farm to table”. As a licensed inspector of organic food products, Dora Mama is specialized in organic agriculture and cooking from traditional dishes to various desserts. She enjoys meeting new friends and sharing her passion for food and life with her guests.

stays.description: View Ocean Bed and Breakfast links the Pacific Ocean and Central Mountain Range, with a prominent city location that features Nanbin Park on the left and Beibin Ecological Park on the right. The city’s only garden scenic bed and breakfast covering over 660 square meters, it affords incredibly beautiful views of the sunrise, sunset, moon, stars, and ships at night, as well as the design of the Yu Yu Yang Art Museum, Taroko Line and snake pattern stone ladder, native trees of Hualien, flocks of swallows in the spring, changing clouds in the summer, rainbows following an afternoon rain, and migratory birds gathering around the ocean in fall and winter. There’s an abundance of natural beauty that varies by season and climate.

We’re a 10 minute walk from Hualien Train Station, with a parking lot next door that provides more than enough space. Several restaurants and shops are located nearby, meeting all your shopping and culinary needs, with tourist sites also in the vicinity. For environmental reasons and to provide customers peace of mind, we use only environmentally-friendly, non-toxic Melaleuca cleaning products. Next time you’re in Hualien, don’t forget to choose Art Nouveau Homestay, the best place to rest and relax.

stays.name: Zhi Liao Ju Homestay
stays.description: Discovering Zileju(Cicada-Home). Zile is another name for Cicada. Zileju is situated on Mei Lun Mountain in Hualien City. There is a Pine Garden next to it. In this beautiful environment, you can often hear the chirping sound of cicada that seems to be urging us to quickly step into this beautiful environment; therefore, we called our home stay “cicada.” Here, you can enjoy a great view of Hualien City. To the right, there is the Central Mountain Range, and, to the left, is the Coastal Mountain Range. In this natural scenery, you are far from the disturbance of the noisy city, and enjoy the most grand and simple baptism of Mother Nature. When you step into Zileju, Taiwan red pines and an array of stars greet you. The purple-dancing Cape Primrose, pink and romantic morning glory, and lavender also welcome you. We provide the most friendly service, the most comfortable facilities and enjoyment, allowing you to unwind and forget the stress of work by bathing in the mountains, sea, sunlight, and air of Hualien. Zileju welcomes guests who have taste and a love for nature. The day and night of Hualien: Morning- Sunlight shines on the newly awakened Hualien City. The sunlight shines through, and lights up the grand Central Mountain Range, and also shines on the beautiful Pacific Ocean. Sunset- Afterglow sweeps across the sky, a breeze gently blows, starlight and street lights are faintly discernible. Night- Looking over Hualien night scene, you see glittering lights, as moon light gently shines on the ground and stars twinkle on the sky. The croaking of frogs and chirping sounds of cicadas is like a natural symphony. We serve a delicious breakfast, personally made by the inn keeper, consisting of a tasty hamburger, together with fresh and tasty lettuce salad and seasonal fruits; as for drinks, guests can choose juice, hot cocoa, or hot coffee. After eating breakfast, you will have all the nourishment and energy you need for the day !

stays.name: happy fishing B&B
stays.description: Fish Fun is situated next to Hualien City Office. Everything needed for convenient living is easily available . Nearby there are a bomb scallion pancake street and second hand bookstore, and Mei Lun Mountain where you can go trekking. Mei Lun Mountain is only 5 minutes away by car. You can see the entire Hualien City and the beach from the mountain. At night, you can go to the famous Nan Bing (Nanbin) and Tzu Chiang (Ziqiang) Night markets. We can arrange nighttime shrimp catching, fishing, night fishing, and a 2 day, 1 night package trip. April to May is the best time to go bird, firefly, and butterfly watching, and observe plants in Liyutan (Liyu Lake). August to September is the Lioushidan (Liushishi) Mountain daylily flower season. July to August is the Hualien Aboriginal Harvest Festival. October has the Hualien International Stone Sculpture Art Festival. November has the Taroko Gorge Marathon and Valley Music Concert. As for good food in Hualien: There are the Sankokuighi Drink & Foods Restaurant, Yue Lu (Moon House), Ying Tien Yeh, Health and Wellness House, Hua Ben House (Kagawa), Lichuan Fish Pond, Shuen Fu Yu Snack Stand, Gong Cheng Steamed Buns, Mr. Goose Meat, Lai Cheng Pork Chop, China Noodle Shop, First Barbecue Shop, Chiang Family Hualien Style Coffin Boards, all serving up delicious delicacies at a reasonable price. I like fishing. In Hualien, I have been in the fishing equipment business for over 20 years. I inherited the 40 year old store from my father. I love fishing, and often go rock fishing, beach fishing, and boat fishing on the river or the sea, enjoying the fresh air of Mother Nature and cool sea breeze. Hualien is a beautiful place.

At night, you can go to the famous Nan Bing (Nanbin) and Tzu Chiang (Ziqiang) Night markets. We can arrange nighttime shrimp catching, fishing, night fishing, and a 2 day, 1 night package trip. April to May is the best time to go bird, firefly, and butterfly watching, and observe plants in Liyutan (Liyu Lake). August to September is the Lioushidan (Liushishi) Mountain daylily flower season. July to August is the Hualien Aboriginal Harvest Festival. October has the Hualien International Stone Sculpture Art Festival. November has the Taroko Gorge Marathon and Valley Music Concert. As for good food in Hualien: There are the Sankokuighi Drink & Foods Restaurant, Yue Lu (Moon House), Ying Tien Yeh, Health and Wellness House, Hua Ben House (Kagawa), Lichuan Fish Pond, Shuen Fu Yu Snack Stand, Gong Cheng Steamed Buns, Mr. Goose Meat, Lai Cheng Pork Chop, China Noodle Shop, First Barbecue Shop, Chiang Family Hualien Style Coffin Boards, all serving up delicious delicacies at a reasonable price. I like fishing. In Hualien, I have been in the fishing equipment business for over 20 years. I inherited the 40 year old store from my father. I love fishing, and often go rock fishing, beach fishing, and boat fishing on the river or the sea, enjoying the fresh air of Mother Nature and cool sea breeze. Hualien is a beautiful place.

stays.name: Butterfly lovers' B&B
stays.description: Butterfly Lovers& #39; Bed & Breakfast is located in the peace of Hualien county, only five minutes from the city centre and also Hualien& #39;s biggest night market. Run by Paul and his wife Sandy with help from their two children Sophie and Ben, they aim to provide a warm and comfortable environment suitable for families and explorers alike. Named Butterfly Lovers& #39; in English, the Chinese name Ju-Ying-Tai is a play on words, meaning come stay with a British Taiwanese family. Paul and Sandy met while studying their masters degrees in the UK, and after graduating Paul came to visit Taiwan and fell in love with this land. The couple spent some time in Kaohsiung before choosing the more easy going feel of Hualien in order to be closer to nature and give Sophie and Ben a chance to have a happy childhood. We welcome you and your family to visit us and stay with us in our cozy home.

stays.name: Cloud Top Landscape
stays.description: Cloud Top Landscape Hotel is located in Jinlan Shan (Taichang Village, Ji’an Township, (Hualien) County) at an elevation of 180 meters, surrounded as far as the eye can see by the beautiful natural scenery of 5 townships –Hualien, Shoufeng, Ji’an, Sioulin, and Sinchen. Occupying nearly 5,000 square meters, the building is a unique, exquisite structure built from several thousand artificial lava culture stones, while imported furniture and artwork display careful planning and effort. The evening is an even better time to experience the natural tranquility of this place. Twinkling stars in the night sky compete with thousands of lights below, giving the feeling of being within a vast universe and putting you completely at rest and ease. Take a break! You don’t need any excuse to bring your family and enjoy the most comfortable and well-serviced vacation of natural beauty!

stays.name: Follow Me
stays.description: Follow Me! Hualien is known as "Taiwan& #39;s Pearl of the Orient" due to its magnificent mountains, and happy and friendly people. The clean environment and beautiful scenery make it a worthwhile visit. Follow Me B&B is a stand-alone farmhouse with an area of 1,652 meters, located on an expansive taro field. There are also two big parking lots in the front courtyard and backyard. Directly in front of the B&B is 18 hectares of large pasture field, where Taiwan& #39;s purebred baffalos graze and a variety of birds perch. Next to the pasture field is Ji& #39;an Township& #39;s most beautiful Green Tunnel and bikeway. The B&B& #39;s European red brick wall and slate architecture make a sharp contrast, and exude a warm and calm ambiance from afar. The simple, clean and bright interior create a light and airy feel. This B&B provides a great space to enjoy the wonderful nature and relaxing countryside.

Seasons changing, farmers are farming and pasturing, making Yinsherb a steady development as an index industry in the east of island.After three years of preparation and construction, Gaeavilla Resort officially opened on May 16, 2019. stays.description: The owners of the "Hospitable and Beautiful House", Mr. and Mrs. Huang, were born in an authentic and simple Hakka village. They recall the agricultural society when material was scarce and everyone went barefoot, fed livestock, and cooked on stoves. The real and simple life was impressive. The "Hospitable House" is an innovative work that recalls the innocent and beautiful memories of childhood. It is also a mini museum that preserves precious Hakka cultural relics. Every corner hides little stories about the owner& #39;s life. We welcome you to explore and experience it together!

stays.name: Hualien Meilan Merica B&B
stays.description: Meilan Merica is located in the Hualien suburb, but close to the Hualien city center. This great location has the advantage of living in the countryside surrounded by nature, but doesn& #39;t have to sacrifice the conveniences. It& #39;s also in a beautiful setting and close to a number of tourist attractions, such as Tzu Chi Jingsitang, Qingxiuyuan (a third class historical site), indigenous tribe village and Liyu Lake. Situated in the vast rural countryside, the European-style architecture and picturesque landscape take your mind away from the busy city life. It allows you to soak in nature& #39;s goodness, and relax your mind completely. Come to enjoy a trip of culture and nature, and visit Hualien& #39;s famous scenic area in a quiet afternoon with family and friends. Then return to the warm and comfortable Meilan Merica after tasting a delicious authentic Hualien dinner. After a completely relaxing deep sleep, let the ray of dawn creep into your room and gently wake you up. Fully rested, you& #39;re ready to continue the second day of your perfect vacation. Meilan Merica is your top choice.

stays.name: Hualien-shangrila
stays.description: Hualien Shangrila Garden Home Stay is situated on Nan Hai 3rd Street in Ji An Township. Due to its proximity to mountains and ocean, it has attracted a lot of foreign visitors. Here, the environment is beautiful, the air is fresh, offering visitors a place to stay that is full of warmth and happiness where they can get together with friends and family. There is blue sky and lush green land, everywhere you can hear the birds sing and smell the fragrance of flowers. In the little pond, the fish play in the water. If you don’t want to go on an excursion, there are chairs inside and outside placed by the enthusiastic female owner, allowing you to sit and drink coffee and chat with friends or just chill out alone. The stars in the summer night sky add to the beauty of Shangrila Home Stay. At night, sitting in the garden of Shangrila Home Stay, you can enjoy a leisurely time under the stars and moon. In the morning, be awoken by the sunlight of dawn, and start a brand new day with an abundant breakfast. Elegant and delicate room decorations give you a comfortable recreational space. In the quiet countryside, only the sounds of insects and birds can be heard. A happy country life experience awaits you. If you are looking for a place for a tranquil and relaxing vacation, Hualien Shangrila Home Stay is the place Here, visitors can be reminded of happy childhood times, walk on the grass barefoot, enjoy peace and quiet, and embrace nature.

stays.name: Hualienbay B&B
stays.description: Leave the noise of the city behind and come to Hualien Bay Bed and Breakfast, featuring a spacious guest hall, restaurant, fashionable furniture and layout, and gentle color tones/elegant atmosphere carefully planned by the owner. Rooms come with natural, comfortable lights, filling them with warmth, comfort, and ease. At night, accompanied by the twinkling stars and sounds of frogs and insects, take a hot bath and then lay back and relax on our big, clean, comfortable beds, washing away fatigue of the mind and body. Enjoy this moment of leisure and tranquility and you’ll discover how simple life really can be! When the sun rises the next morning, it’s time for a happy, relaxing trip.

stays.name: Ji Ye Jing Zhan Club B&B
stays.description: Ji Ye Jing Zhan is a loft that gives an impression of staying in a different era of time. The owner of the loft is also a lover of traveling. When he visits other countries, he loves to stay in family lofts with different styles. By chance, he missed his flight but get to know the owner of LOFT. Because of this, I started to like the style of an old storage. Because I started to fall in love with all the old things, after serious consideration, I decided to give up my high paying job of management and get into business of running a loft and its idea to pursue my dream. In order to involve personally in the whole renovation of LOFT, I take part in brainstorming, blueprint creation, choosing material and even construction myself. The whole project took me a total of three years to finish. Ji Ye Jing Zhan would like the travelers to enjoy their stay on this beautiful island of treasure - the precious back garden Hualien. Here travelers can experience a completely different style.

stays.name: Ji Ye Jing Zhan Homestay
stays.description: This is a very special B&B. Its open-structured and permeable decoration is full of art spirit, showing the style of fashion and indicating the freedom and lifestyle. Surprisingly, the B&B host, Mr. Dai, is a young and cheerful man, and his friends call him Dai. He is fond of independent travel, and occasionally saw loft-style B&B's when traveling abroad. The open-structured space with no partitions and freestyle design had attracted his attention. He started to have a dream. It is hard to imagine that this humorous and friendly young man was a perfect salesman with outstanding performance in the banking industry. However, his life was filled with work. He worked long hours and attending social functions, and often came back home at late night. He suddenly realized that what he was missing when he saw his children sound asleep. At last, when he was 40, he made an important decision - to retire. He found his own way after tendering his resignation letter. He desired to make his dream come true. What he saw abroad affected him and made him eager for action, and he started to make plans. He wanted to bond with his children when it was not too late, let them grow up in a great environment, and realize his dream - running a special B&B. After thinking carefully, he settled down in Hualien - the most beautiful area in Taiwan. He spent two years completing his own buildings- from design and plan to selecting materials and constructing, and he gradually completed the perfect B&B in his mind. He owns two buildings for the B&B. Building A, with dark red brick walls, vintage electric fans, visible pipelines and log doors, makes you go back to the 1950s. Building B, with black iron partition cabinet, leather sofa and glossy floor, shows an ornate style to make you feel like displaced in time and place. There is no other B&B like Ji Ye Jing Zhan Villa Homestay in Taiwan. Dai hopes that travelers can experience the happiness he had experienced before as long as they visit Hualien- no flight ticket, not going abroad, and no tiring flight.

stays.name: Justlike Villa Homestay
stays.description: The building adopts Andou Tadao& #39;s architectural concrete for its external structure and flat slab floor system indoors to present a minimalist design. This is complemented with eco-friendly elements such as eco pond, green roof and increased wall thickness for better sound and heat proofing. On this 2750 sqm of land, the building looks fairly small and the land around is scattered with sunflower, lavender and many other plants visited by butterflies, honeybees and dragonflies. This is a heaven to them. The rooms are named after the 24 solar terms: "Grain in Ear" and "Summer Solstice" is presented in cool azure, "Autumnal Equinox" and "White Dew" is coated in golden yellow, the color of harvest and abundance, "Lesser Cold" of winter and "Grain Rain" of spring is presented in the alternation of violet and pink, while "Winter Solstice" and "Spring Equinox" is presented in red, the symbol of reunion and prosperity. Each room is designed with French windows that do not block away the nature wonders and clear sky. Breakfast is definitely one of the features of "Justlike Villa": If you feel like staying on the bed longer, you can order a customized, freshly made breakfast at the designated time! "Eat fresh" is more than an advertisement term here: The hostess Ms. Han buys her vegetables from organic farms nearby, and it& #39;s no less special than local specialty dishes!

stays.name: Mandheling Homestay
stays.description: Detached Mandheling Home Stay is situated at the foot of the Central Mountain Range. Surrounded by forests, fields and gardens, guests can not only enjoy a phytoncide shower, they can also view the lovely countryside scenery.Entering the 250 square meter Mandheling Home Stay, in the broad outdoor garden you can see all kinds of flowers grown by the owner, and all kinds of artistic rocks. The poetic scenery is almost too beautiful for the eyes to take in. Happy you should be embraced by Mother Nature in this quiet environment! The interior design is mixed in style. From the arrangement of ornaments and special lights, you can see the ingenuity and diligence of the owner. The furniture design integrates creativity and aesthetic appeal, creating a leisurely and yet comfortable environment. The elegant, warm and comfortable rooms all have independent balconies, allowing each guest to be spoiled by their own exclusive space. During the day, you can view the grand and changing scenery of the Central Mountain Range. At night, you can see the stars and shooting stars while lying on your back on the rock bed of the observatory. Bathing under the beautiful moonlight, a breeze gently blowing, you can enjoy a quiet evening! Here, a wonderful vacation still has the comfort and friendliness of home. Welcome to another paradise: Mandheling Home Stay.

stays.name: Nistay
stays.description: Hi, we are “Nistay” B&B, built in 1980, 2016 decoration complete, Now only can observe Nistay's age from the windows and outer wall of the building. Each room has independent air-condition and electric water heaters. Furniture, appliances and bedding are all new.Here we don't have amazing landscape (mountain, ocean, or field), nor have unique interior design. Close to school wall and vegetable garden, without the noise of dense traffic, only can hear frogs croak and birds twitter at night, and school bell in the morning.Near traditional market, supermarket, convenience store and open 24-hour McDonald's. There are many kinds of shops, breakfast, drinks, bento box, noodle, ginger duck, steak..., easy to eat, easy to buy.All we want is to give everyone a comfortable space, just like the name, This word in Chinese means people always can feel well be here.About Nistay's future, we can't predict what will be the change, hope toward a better direction, with each guest of Nistay.

stays.name: Pretty Sun Homestay
stays.description: To get away from the crowded city and noise, you can choose Hualien. To enjoy space and comfort, and embrace quiet and elegance, you can choose Pretty Sun. This is a place full of warmth: Natural, simple, low-key, and luxurious. Delicate hand-made quilts, beautiful embroidery work, made by the female owner over 20 years decorate each corner of the home stay. A quiet and leisurely big garden allows you to contently enjoy the breeze while drinking tea. In the tasteful main hall with its classic wooden furniture, you can enjoy a delicious breakfast we personally prepare for you. Lodging here, we believe you will feel at home. Getting here is convenient; it only 7 minutes by car from the train station, the city, and Tzuchiang (Ziqiang) Night Market. Chihsingtang (Qixingtan), Mu Gu Mu Yu, and Nanbing (Nabin) Night Market are only 10 minutes away by car. A 7-11, supermarket, restaurants, and snack stands are only 300 meters on foot.

stays.name: Shan tyi Home Stay
stays.description: Featuring all-new decoration, rich European-style architecture, and a courtyard with luxuriant greenery, Shan Ti aims to be a great place of rest for travelers. With a serene environment that transports guests to an otherworldly paradise, exquisitely prepared rooms, a warm living room, and outdoor coffee tables and chairs, Shan Ti brings guests leisurely enjoyment and a peaceful environment. If you’re tired of the noise of the city, you’re welcome to pay us a visit at Shan Ti. We’re surrounded by green mountains and white clouds, with expansive views as far as the eye can see, transporting you away from the noise and crowds of the city. Have a seat on the chairs in the outdoor area carefully prepared by the owner, and enjoy a long chat with friends and family. Look out at the beauty of the mountain forest, feel the blowing breeze, and enjoy a phytoncide bath. As night falls, listen quietly to the sound of insects, as the beautiful symphony of nature seems to play for you. The leisurely life of Shan Ti – an experience it’d be a pity to miss out on.

stays.name: Suto Home
stays.description: Ms. Liu, the owner, purchased this site and built Stone House Bed and Breakfast, the ideal place of her childhood dreams. The front includes a large parking area and scenic pond, instantly making guests comfortable and relaxed, while the back is a big lawn where children can run and play. Nearby are water buffalo, white egrets, and several types of birds, forming a small ecological landscape. The friendly, straightforward owner provides guests with outstanding service, and says with a laugh, “I hope you have such a good time you’re exhausted by the end of it, and laugh until your stomach hurts.” Are you looking for a place of smiles and happiness? Come to Stone House, you won’t regret it!

stays.description: ☘️ Hefeng Lanting Homestay｜Enjoy the Relaxing Charm of HualienSituated at the junction of Ji& #39;an and Hualien City, close to Ji& #39;an Railway Station, Hefeng Lanting Homestay is the ideal starting point for exploring Hualien. We are committed to providing a comfortable and relaxing accommodation environment, featuring spacious, bright, and well-ventilated rooms, each equipped with private bathrooms and convenient elevator access. Our sunlit public lounge area offers a perfect space for relaxation, and a shared washing machine is available, adding extra convenience to your stay. Experience the comfort and ease of home away from home.Our location is exceptionally convenient, with 7-11 and Family Mart located just downstairs. A short five-minute walk brings you to Hualien’s largest evening market, ensuring you have everything you need close at hand. Additionally, the famous Dongdamen Night Market and central dining district are only about a 10-minute drive away.Hefeng Lanting is a self-service homestay, offering thoughtful yet unobtrusive service. We are always available to assist when needed, ensuring every traveler feels warmly welcomed. Whether you& #39;re here for a brief stay or to deeply experience Hualien’s leisurely pace, Hefeng Lanting Homestay is your best choice for accommodations in Hualien. We sincerely look forward to welcoming you to share in the enchanting charm of eastern Taiwan!

stays.description: Mdm Ko is an independent and courageous lady par excellence. She got married during the tumultous Post WWII era. Due to her adamant personality, she sternly refused to seek assistance from her maternal family even during her hardest times. Despite such adversities, she was blessed and ultimately pulled it through - she is now living a life of happiness. Thus, Mdm Ko is constantly grateful and thus the whence of the motto of the Ko family - to pass on happiness through acts of generosity and kindness.Holding on to that same principle, the Ko children established Chang Yu Social Welfare Charity Foundation in 2008 based in Hualian to fund the children from the lower income families so that they can receive extra-curricular education assistance. In 2015, Mdm Ko had offered her house in Ji'An Township, Hualian to set up Cozy Home hostel, hoping that the profits from the hostel will provide job opportunities for lower income families and also a steady source of income for the foundation.

stays.name: whitesun
stays.description: The hostess of White Sun B&B, Qiao Mom, brought her guide dog POLO with her and returned from the U.S. to Taiwan ten years ago. Since then, she realized that seeking temporary lodging with a pet in Taiwan had been unfairly treated. Based on doggy empathy, Qiao Mom decided to build an exclusive vacation paradise for pets and the owners, and White Sun thus became the first pet-friendly B&B in Taiwan. And through decades of steady operation, White Sun becomes the best place to go for canine friends and fellowship gatherings. Situated on the hillside corner, White Sun has an area of ​​6,600 square meters, as a paradise hidden in a field road of Ji-An Township, Hualien. Upon entering the park, you can see a large lawn covering more than 2,130 square meters for dogs to run and chase happily without restraint, which not only lets the doggy owner be able to completely relax in the green field, but also leaves the dog obtain physical and mental balance in a woodland. There are five biking trails surrounding the White Sun, and you can ride a bicycle strolling along and enjoying the beautiful views of the hillside and the leisurely fun. A restaurant designed by David Michael, a renowned designer, is really a comfortable dining environment, where the effect of visual sense has been extended and the warmth of European countryside style was added in. Each room has a different creative idea, including the rustic, classic minimalist style, the European aristocratic style, etc., the only thing in common is that a vast expanse of green grassland presents outside the windows. Mattresses used here are all steel wire bi-layer with independent cylinders, matched with a soft silk quilt, 100ï¼ cotton bedding, to allow visitors to have the most comfortable sleep quality. The delicate equipment is rarely found in the other B&Bs. You can enjoy together with your dog White Sun specially selected itineraries, whether whale watching, one-day or half-day river trekking, a true family travels. Welcome you with your dog or dog-loving friends together to White Sun to relax and experience the leisurely pleasure of life.
