stays.name: Cosmos Oasis
stays.description: Located in the Fuyuan National Forest Recreation Area in Hualien County, Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley is the first collaboration between Tiancheng Hotel Group and the Forestry and Conservation Administration of the Ministry of Agriculture. With "sustainability, ecology, and vacation" as its core concepts and the vision of "becoming a leading destination for forest ecotourism and hot spring vacations nationwide," Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley integrates natural resources with the accommodation experience, creating an ecological retreat featuring hot spring guest rooms, single-family villas, open-air hot springs, and forest trails.This area boasts rare low-altitude broadleaf forests in eastern Taiwan and is a key habitat for purple butterfly species. The scenery changes with each season, offering a unique experience of immersion in nature, whether enjoying butterfly watching in spring, escaping the summer heat, or enjoying hot springs in autumn and winter.Adhering to the core values ​​of Tiancheng Hotel Group, "diversity, integration, sharing, and continuity," Tiancheng Hotel - Butterfly Valley extends its brand spirit to the natural setting, creating a unique slow-paced accommodation experience nestled in the forest. Guest rooms are designed with natural imagery in mind, and large windows extend the outdoor greenery indoors, allowing guests to wake up in the morning to soak in the phytoncides and feel the vibrant vitality of the mountain forest.The park draws on precious, 10,000-year-old hot spring waters from the foothills of the Central Mountain Range, offering a premium hot spring experience ideal for relaxation. The park also features a comprehensive nature trail system, exploring butterfly habitats, native forests, and clear streams, allowing guests to experience the tranquility and purity of the Fuyuan National Forest Recreation Area.Tiancheng Yilv - Butterfly Valley invites guests to enter a verdant kingdom of fluttering butterflies, allowing them to breathe in sync with nature and embark on a journey of healing and reconnecting with nature, immersed in the rhythms of the earth.

stays.description: Guei Yuan Tien Ju is situated in Rui Shui (Ruisui), next to the bypass road of Provincial Highway 9,a 3 minute drive from Rui Shui Train Station. It is surrounded by mountains and offers beautiful countryside scenery. It is often shrouded in mountain mist, leaving visibility of only 30 meters, making it seem like you are in a cloud sea. You can ride a bicycle at will through the green fields. We hope friend who come to Hualien and Taitung can get away from the hubbub of the city, unload the pressure of work, and enjoy a leisurely stay with us.

stays.name: HOYA SPA HOTEL
stays.description: From the bottom of Hu Tou Mountain came Hoya Spa, located in a remarkable place of Rui Shui, Hualien County that produces outstanding people. This spring is reputed as Kingly Golden Amber Spring. For the Chinese people, “Hoya” is a legendary god that protects their children, fills their house with tranquility and wealth. Hoya Spa, possessing the fusion of the riches of the land and the attributes of its name, will bring its guests the blessing of peace, fortune, a sound mind and a healthy body.Hoya Spa was established by Lin Chang Kui in November of 2001 and completed in April of 2003. Mr. Lin, a local born of Rui Shui, found the place being abundant in natural hot spring yet with is traditional make up cannot satisfy the present demands of spa goers. Because of his desire to return its favor to the local residents, he set up modern spa equipments, constructed a high quality resort. He also hoped that by coming to Hoya, the guests could enjoy the local products, magnificent landscape, combined with various activities such as: rafting at Siou Gu Luan River, biking with the scenic view of the country’s rich produce of canola flowers and day lilies. Hoya offers not only relaxation and enjoyment of the finest spa experience but also causes its guests to embrace the majestic view of Rui Shui that they may have a full taste of the country and experience a rich, comfortable and unforgettable stay. An enjoyment of a matchless satisfaction is what Mr. Lin desires for every guest of Hoya Spa.

Jiang Jia Home Stay allows you to wash away the tiredness of body and soul, and the star light will accompany you until you fall asleep

stays.name: Ruisui Bin Cheng Xiuxian Du Jia Nongzhuang Homestay
stays.description: Bin City Bed and Breakfast is located in the suburban of Ruisui, about 1 km from Ruisui downtown. Bin City is a villa that the host prepared for the people who doesn't want to live in the downtown area and want to be away from the hubbub to enjoy the pastoral quiet, and the pastoral fun of sipping tea, drinking wine, listening to the sounds of insects, frogs, and birds. To preserve the scene of early farm, the host has renovated the Sanheyuàn, and displays early farming equipment. In addition, lotus in the pond next to the house, as well as tadpoles, dragonflies, fireflies, for ecological observation, and in marshes, wild ginger flower fragrance, are all just waiting for you to experience. In the farm, you can enjoy barbecue, parties, camping, and other activities.

stays.name: Sunshine Hot Spring B&B
stays.description: A Hakka old house located in Ruisui Golden Hot Springs, and at the foot of Hutou Mountain. It has window frames in bagua shape and fine windows of cast iron, rustic wooden doors, outlining the house& #39;s history. Mr. Huang loves to enjoy nature and collect antiques, after retirement, fate acquired this beautiful Hakka old house under the hillside by chance, with the mood of entertaining friends, named the house "Sun•shine Hot Spring" and hangs a wooden sign to start a new life of operating a B&B business. Now the Sun•shine Hot Spring is under the operations of the second generation, Terry and Alma born in the 80s, who love travel. Although they are seemingly younger, they have rich and pragmatic ideas, continuing the spirit of antique-loving of the previous generation, but added a creative idea of accommodating the new generation backpackers to turn the Hakka old house a new page. Mr. Huang Tairan wanted to let the Sun•shine Hot Spring can provide more comfortable services and gradually step into the market for foreign backpackers. Together with his wife, they study the aesthetics of interior design, with unique ideas and a limited budget, they blended Huang& #39;s collection of antique furniture with the building to revitalize the old house and created a minimalist style that brighten the eyes of admirers.

stays.name: The Silence Manor
stays.description: Silence is the best language to talk to the mountain, the water, and Mother Nature""The Silence Manor"" sits at the valley of the Coastal Mountain Range, where you can find the scent of burnt silvergrass and resting sheep. In a wordless talk during a toast with trees, you no longer have to think, instead, instinct will take the lead and all you have to do is opening your mind. Wind, clouds, spring water and even the butterflies leaves a trace in your memory, which you will only share with the loved ones.

stays.name: Classic Villa B & B
stays.description: This home stay is a Japanese style mansion, a steel structure green building. It fulfills the criteria of environmental protection, energy conservation, and carbon reduction. It also has the advantages of earthquake resistance, and damp, sound, and heat-proofing. The rooms are warm, comfortable, bright, and clean, with complete equipment and Japanese style log furniture or old-fashioned rattan furniture, making happy living and slow life the biggest enjoyments of travel. You are welcome to make a room reservation or book the whole building. This home stay is situated at the 221.5 km point on East Rift Valley Provincial Highway 9. It is in close to Shoufeng Elementary School, library, township office, police station, post office, 7-11, Supermarket, Fengchun ice shop, and CPC gas station. The social order situation is good, and transport and shopping are convenient. Scenic spots that are 5~10 minutes drive from the home stay include: Lichuan Fisheries (Experience the fun of catching clams and wash your pants simultaneously), Promise Land Resort and Lagoon (Feng Valley Wetland Park, Liyutan (Liyu Lake) Scenic Area (Bicycle trail, forest trail, firefly, bird watching, and butterfly watching, Chinan National Forest Recreation Area (Forest Relic Museum, forest trail, phytoncide, bird watching, and butterfly watching, Hualien Aquaculture Breeding Institute, Bai Bao River Ecological Park (Bicycle trail), National Dong Hwa University, Fengtian Immigrant Village and Cultural History Museum, Grade 3 historical monument, Bi Lien Temple, and Chao Feng Ranch & Resort. Scenic spots that are 10~20 minutes drive from the home stay include: Mu Gu Mu Yu Ecological Forest Trail (Also known as the Little Tien Hsian (Xiaotianxiang)) Mi Chien (Mizhan) Community (Mi Chien Trail), Yun Shan Shui Ecological Park, Farglory Ocean park, Yen Liao (Yanliao) (Eat lobsters and Taiwanese abalone), He Nan Temple (The five foot Guanyin sculpture made by sculptor Yang Ying Feng (Yuyu Yang)) .

stays.name: Cloudrange B&B
stays.description: Room reservation line: 0911-277-178 Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast is located in the north end of Shoufeng Township (Hualien County), a place with a simple, down-to-earth atmosphere, surrounded by magnificent mountains. Every corner of the building has a great view of the towering Qilai Mountain and surrounding ridges. In the depth of winter, the Qilai Mountains, covered with a layer of pure white snow, are a magnificent sight, appearing incredibly fantastic and romantic in combination with the pure white color of our building. Here at Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast, our mission was to create a living space based on “nature, health, simplicity, spaciousness, security, and art.” The owner turned his home into a comfortable environment and built a rich little green forest outside. During the various seasons, different flowers blossom and the area is rich in ecological resources, while guests can enjoy the natural music of chirping birds and croaking frogs as well as going bird-watching. Here you enjoy not only a comfortable environment but ecological experience of the myriad of plants and animals interacting together. Cloud Range 128 Bed and Breakfast is a legally-certified bed and breakfast, a simple white building located in a green area, with comfortable, spacious areas for activity both inside and out. The large building only houses 5 rooms, the rest of the space being common area, offering guests who come for relaxation the chance to browse the book room, chat with friends in the warm living room, or head to the kitchen, a room with excellent views and bathed in sunlight. Enjoy a delicious breakfast and come to Cloud Range 128, where you’ll experience the incomparable delight of being bathed by nature, truly experiencing a joyful vacation!

stays.name: Farglory Hotel, Hualien
stays.description: Farglory Hotel Hualien towers north coastal mountains at an altitude of 220 meters, with back to the mountains and facing the sea, and vast horizons. Standing in Farglory, to the east, overlooking the deep blue Pacific Ocean, to the north, the bustling city of Hualien, to the west, the magnificent Central Mountain Range and East Rift Valley, and to the south, scenic Eastern Coastline and Marine Theme Park. The mountains and the sea are intertwined, a beautiful heaven. The Hotel used Victoria Palace building as the imagery theme of design. Welcome hall is designed to have a ceiling of 28 meters high, making everyone feels the comfortable and spacious space when stepping into the Hotel. Guest rooms use auto climate control for seasons. Interior decorations are all upscale materials. Each guest room has a viewing balcony to allow each guest to enjoy contemporary Victorian prosperity and senses to the fullest to achieve the perfect leisurely vacation mood. The Hotel features five top-level restaurants and bars, including the Oriental Garden Restaurant, a Chinese restaurant that fully use local ingredients of Hualien, exotic British Garden Restaurant, Aki Kusa Japanese Restaurant has deep Zen inspiration, the Piazza KTV Bar is the beauty in the nights, and the Cliff Lobby Lounge where you can enjoy carefree. The Hotel is surrounded by the tree-lined trails and viewing platforms, connecting all outdoor attractions and indoor facilities, such as the statue of the poet garden landscaping, Garden Walkway, Fire Dance Plaza, each is an ingenuity crafting. The hotel won international awards in 2010 World Luxury Hotel Award, which is Taiwan's only one The Coastal Hotel, and in 2011 obtained a 5-Star Mark from Tourism Bureau, MOTC, the first International Tourist Hotel honored in Hualien.

stays.name: Forever Hotel
stays.description: Yanliao Village, located east of the Pacific Ocean, boasts a long, narrow coastline and pleasantly cool summers, making it a prime tourist destination. The village boasts numerous cultural attractions, including the Eastern Coast National Scenic Area, Farglory Ocean Park, and Henan Temple. Early farming and fishing were the primary occupations of the village, with agricultural products including peanuts, citronella oil, and sweet potatoes; fish primarily consisted of mullet fry and lobster. Today, Yanliao primarily serves as a tourist destination for guesthouses. Yanliao& #39;s most famous coastal landscape is Taiwan& #39;s longest gravel beach, making it the best place to explore rock formations along the island& #39;s coast. The gravel on the beach boasts a wide variety of rock types. Metamorphic rocks from the Central Mountain Range have traveled thousands of miles to this location, where they blend with sedimentary and igneous rocks from the Coastal Range, creating a spectacular geological landscape.

stays.name: GOLDEN-YIHE STRONGHOLD
stays.description: Golden Yihe Stronghold is located to the west of East Rift Valley, encircled by Mizhan Old Trail , with a view embracing the Rift Valley Plain, and enjoys mountain breeze all year-round, creating an atmosphere unique to this mountain villa. Its predecessor, Mizhan Ranch, has endowed the Yihe with many moving and surprising elements, which hardly contain commercial vibe. All of things in the Yihe are the staples of owners& #39; operations, which their lives depend upon, make the villa like a border fortress with unique style and personality, in addition to its peaceful and gorgeous natures. At first, these might be too many to be credible; however, every dream has been realized in this aesthetic and magnificent place between the sky and the land, and that is Golden Yihe Stronghold. Is it a secluded paradise or an imagination closest to the reality? A simple dream, original ideas, and passionate thoughts, every constituent element has encountered in a most clever way, which is a surprise but is not strange thing. In here you can feel the details without being constrained, everything from the tranquility in a mountain or woods, to the magnificent style of South Islands, or a place embraced by hills and woods, or the amorous feelings of constantly changing atmospheres, and then an innovative concept was born here. The owner applied the principles of Chinese five elements and culture, incorporated with a variety of exotic elements in the designing, and created infinite feelings of accommodation, from European imageries to Oriental visuals, to situational space. An independent terrace integrated with the natural environment makes you breathe. A surprising turn in the attic space generates a pleasant feeling. These alien encounters of fantastic imagination have been realized in here. If this kind of boundless imagination can make you feel happy to detach from reality, than when this condition has been achieved, how exciting is it. We welcome you to experience the feelings of embracing the mountains and woods, at Golden Yihe Stronghold.

stays.name: Green Villa
stays.description: Located in the scenically beautiful East Rift Valley (next to National Donghwa University), Green Villa commands a view of the beautiful scenery of the valley. The owner hopes his daughter has a good landlord while she’s living away from home, and thus turned his home into a bed and breakfast after his children grew up and left home. It offers comfortable rooms and service that makes guests feel at home, welcoming all travelers to Hualien. Surrounded by scenic beauty and far away from the noise of the city, Green Villa is a place where, even if you want to stay at home, you can sit in the walkway and read, accompanied by the mountains and white clouds. Enjoy the night sky full of stars, fully experiencing the fun of a leisurely trip through Hualien. If you’d like to get out and explore nearby attractions, it’s only a 10-20 minute drive to the famous scenic areas of the valley or the beautiful, majestic east coast. We can arrange custom tours for you, ensuring a worthwhile, high-quality vacation. The owner’s two sons love photography and can share their most beautiful images of Hualien with you as well as divulging the location of secret spots in the area, making your Hualien trip truly unique.

stays.name: Lan Bai She Haibian Du Jia Homestay
stays.description: Owner's former private villa. In early spring of 2010, the owner reserved the house's original structure, redesigned the space, and changed the residence into a Mediterranean vacation cottage. It is a property of a white house with blue windows, a large yard, and little cozy rooms, designed for experiencing a gentler way of life. Under the eaves, sip tea or coffee, overlook the ocean, enjoy the beauty of sea and sky, or up on the roof, wait for the sunrise, or watch the moon and stars, are activities. The cool host accommodates only a small group per day. Your noise won't affect other tenants but you. Having a yard of more than 330 m2, it is convenient for parking. In here, you enjoy a space for relaxing not just a room. With quiet peaceful atmosphere, relaxed pace of life, here you have undoubtedly an ideal place for a vacation to enjoy resort life undisturbed, or just lazily nesting in a B&B. Blue & White Beach House is located in a place 7 km from Highway 11, Shoufeng Township, Hualien County. Follow Highway 11 South about 2 km to Hualien Ocean Park. Take Highway 11 North about 7 km (10 minutes by car) to downtown Hualien. Welcome to Blue & White Beach House! Even you don't want go anywhere, just staying in the B&B is an experience of happiness!

stays.name: Meetcanaan
stays.description: Located at a pasture in Xi-Kou Village, Meetcanaan is natural and quiet. Ring-necked pheasant, bamboo partridge, turtle dove, nightjar and starling, etc. are flying and singing in groups; bees and butterflies are humming and dancing from flower to flower. It’s a quiet place without light pollution. Looking up, you’ll find stars shinning sparklingly; looking down, you’ll find fireflies lighting lively. All year round, nights are peaceful and beautiful here. Meetcanaan is a place for you to relax your body and soul. You may enjoy the pleasant time with your family, ease your tension, free your soul and recharge yourself here. If you’ve been looking for a safe and secluded place that you can totally free your heart, a quiet place that you can relax your mind or a nice place that you can energize your soul, you’ve found it. Meetcanaan is always here looking forward to your visit.

Don't miss the refreshing air here!

stays.name: Monetgarden Coffee Grange(B&B)
stays.description: ★Monet Garden—Don Gus Coffee Farm is the main agency for the renowned Balanjoyo Coffee. With top quality coffee beans imported directly from the volcano district in Guademala, Mr. Chang as the farm owner brews limited amount daily. Therefore, the entire farm manifests mysterious atmosphere integrating Latino romance and Mayan magic. The setting of Central American Tropical Forest is decorated with numerous artifacts from Mayan ruins. Even furniture is handmade by Mayan workers, while bed cover is made from the most famous Mayan textile. ★Such a unique style combining Latino romance and Mayan magic can only be represented via techniques of the impressionist school. Mr. Chang and his son who majored in architecture present natural simplicity with joint efforts so that aesthetic elegance is distributed via impressionist approach. Of course, a water lily pond is established here to elicit reminiscence of the famous painting by Claude Monet. Our farm is named as Monet Garden for this reason. ★The farm has rich natural ecosystems. Visitors inadvertently encounter a variety of lizards, stag beetles, and rhinoceros beetles here. Dragonflies, butterflies, Gunder brown frogs come back every spring and summer. In front of the Mayan Suite, there is a waterway, derived from the mountain creek, zigzagging into the water lily pond. Five generations of kois and Chinese sturgeons live in the water lily pond along with many other fishes from mountain creeks riding currents down here as passers-by. The geese couple, Pipi and Yaya, are the most welcome ambassadors of goodwill. They greet people with passion. Another pair of Japanese rooster and hen stroll leisurely to seek feed. With the advent of night, you can sit on the stairway of the Monet Chicken Farm to appreciate the scene with bird species flying on top of the trees to rest in sleep. ★Located to the north end of East Rift Valley, Carp Like has abundant picturesque natural ecosystems. From March to May every year, tourists flock here to view fireflies. ★A five-kilometer trip around the lake by bike or on foot is full of joy. So is sitting in the pagoda next to the lake with your heart and mind totally relaxed. Swinging on the lake by peddling a boat or shaking a canoe is fun as well. Scenic Spots Nearby:★White Abalone River and Gems Canyon----You can explore in stream-tracing, wade into the clear water, pick up gems, or follow the forest trail all the way to the Woods of Green Light in quest of natural ecosystems. ★Mukumugi Ecological Garden----It is Toroko Gorge in miniature. As you wade into the creeks, schools of shoveljaw carps will play with you by licking your soles. ★South Lake Forest Park----Formerly Harlem Forest with papaya trees all over, the Park now has an exhibition hall as well as an ecological classroom. The mini-rail which used to distribute logs has long discontinued. Strolling among the remaining rail tracks, you will be surrounded by chirping birds and fragrant flowers as Carp Lake mirrors your reflection. ★Carp Hill Hiking Trail----Stepping on the observatory six-hundred kilometers in height, you can view Mount Chilai in the north from afar. Winter will decorate the hilltop with snow. And the blue Pacific is visible at the east side. ★From Monet Garden to downtown Hualien is an easy ride of approximately twenty minutes. All the main scenic areas are within half-hour ride by car.

stays.name: PROMISED LAND RESORT & LAGOON
stays.description: Promisedland Resort in Hualien is positioned to promote the concept that "Instead of rushing about, to stay is the ideal vacation; instead of following a schedule, it is to stroll ..." Accordingly we built a canal-style resort, which the respectable "100 Hotels + Resorts" magazine recognized the Promiseland as the only resort from Taiwan to be among the world's top 29 hotels in Asia, such as Grand Hyatt Bali, Hilton Sanya Resort, as a destination to lift one's spirit. The world's longest original artificial hotel canal of 2.2 km long, designed by the world's top-ranked international architectural design team W. A. T. & G., runs through the resort and passes through seven docks, 16 charming bridges, and 22 villa style landscape architectures. One after another, Spanish style low rise castles were built along the river, based on the legendary Spanish architect Gaudi's architectural concepts and combined with Byzantine and Moorish styles, added the architectures with soft curves and fairytale flavor, and successfully blended them into the local natural landscape, creating a global exclusive original architectural style. Guests can take a boat cruise along the canals and enjoy the scenery on sides, insect buzzes and bird chirps, as well as the characteristic scenery of the 16 bridges. "Feng Valley Ecological Park" is the only ecological park in Taiwan attached to a hotel. The park uses the underground springs from Taiwan's Central Mountains to ecologically restore an area of 5.7 hectares green space for three years. Pure water has nurtured rich aquatic plants and the park become a habitat and feeding place for nearby birds, insects, and frogs. Professional narrators lead visitors through the programs of urban farmer experience, cycling migratory bird, equestrian riding, grass skiing, and many other enriching activities for parent and child to experience together, with a deep sense of ecological and conservation enlightenment. Four room types with different Spanish story themes, "Flamenco," "Isabella," "Antonio," and "San Diego," each room is equipped with elegant exotic handmade rosewood furniture and has balconies facing the canal and the East Rift Valley Mountains. Your visit Promisedland Resort will always leave you with unexpected wonders, joy, and touching memories, The only Spanish Gaudi-style resort hotel surrounded by a spring canal, and a land promised to let you relax your body and ease your mind.

stays.name: Revika B&B
stays.description: Hualien Revika B&B Map Living in a busy city with heavy traffic, many days pass by in a hurry.There are many nights when I want to look up and search for the peaceful starry sky in my memory, but in the urban jungle full of high-rise buildings, There are only flashing neon lights, and I can& #39;t find the twinkling little star in the nursery rhyme.In order to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and find myself, I often travel to Hualien to enjoy the tranquility in nature that cannot be found in the city.Once, I sat quietly in the courtyard of the homestay, listening to the symphony of nature played by the croaking of frogs and the chirping of birds, watching all the subtle changes in the sky from sunrise to sunset, and under the starry sky at night, I saw countless stars. In such an environment, I seemed to have found a sense of belonging. At that moment, I realized that it was time to return to Hualien.In this way, I traveled back and forth between Hualien and Taipei just to find the place of my dreams.By chance, I came to the small village of Yuemei. At first, I didn’t have any special thoughts about it, but later, I visited it many times at different times and in different weather conditions. I couldn’t help but marvel at how much of this place there is that I have not yet seen. No matter whether it is sunny, cloudy or rainy, the changes in the mountain shapes and valleys are never the same. They really attract the eyes and make people reluctant to look away. Being in a natural environment, facing the mountains and the sea, always makes people feel small and calm. This is definitely not something that an urbanite living in a concrete jungle can easily feel.At that moment, I knew this was it, this was the place of my dreams.@revika wechat revikabb Booking hotline: 0937 738 452 Vivian Hualien County Government approved legal B&B No. 2130 Copyright 2017 Hualien B&B-REVIKA

stays.name: Sea-Hi
stays.description: It is a ocean paradise for the dialogue between mountains and the sea. Sea-hi B&B used to be the exotic scenes for filming television drama "Tokyo Juliet." Because here is only about 200 meters from the sea and the pebble beach. A dark house with a pitched roof sits on a green land, matched with a small house of European style and with elegant Japanese brick walls. A white cafe on the terrace, the house, surrounded by green grasses, banana, coconut, and flowers, exudes a lazy, relaxed, and free atmosphere. It is like being in romantic southern Aegean Sea or the Maldives in the Indian Ocean. "Sea-hi B&B" is located in the East Coast National Scenic Area of Taiwan, with back to the hillside (to the east of Coast Mountains) and facing the sea (on the left bank of the Pacific Ocean), and is a garden architecture covering an area of ​​about 9,900 square meters, enclosed in a whole, a seaside landscape paradise. Staying here makes your secular anxieties suddenly vanished and feel the incomparable happiness, by listening to the sounds of waves, chasing waves, stargazing, moon gazing, watching the rising sun, the changing clouds, coming and going vessels, flying gulls and herons, or enjoy coffee and meals with distinctive flavors, or just watching the sea venting. Such a happy garden is waiting for people of same karma to share.

stays.description: Villa Home in Hualien, nestled in Shoufeng Township of East Rift Valley National Park, covering an area of 24 hectares, and Blue Dream Lake of 4 hectares. Villa Home has an accommodation area of about 2,640 m2, European style architecture, offers three double rooms, two four-person rooms, thousands of trees in various sizes, a variety of birds, fish, frogs, ring-necked pheasants, common moorhens, etc. In the night, watch stars, track fireflies, nighthawk, and other ecological creatures. Villa Home began life on January 1, 2011, welcomes guests to treat yourself and your family in their spare time at this landscape villa. We are ready to welcome you home.

stays.name: Villa of Permaculture
stays.description: We all dream of a place without the stress of modern life, , "Villa of Permaculture" is a land of wonder hidden in the Coastal Mountain Range. Simplicity is the rule after everything settles. The host loves "Robinson Crusoe", that explains why he left his achievements behind and looked for a fresh start as an organic farm, and Shoufeng, Hualien is the perfect place to realize this dream. In "Villa of Permaculture", everything is the materialization of the host's imagination, and he believes everyone may recollect his or her longing to live in a natural way and find the final resting place there.

stays.name: Yi Xin Yuan Homestay
stays.description: Hualien Yixinyuan B&B covers an area of ​​more than 500 square meters and is located next to the beautiful front gate wall of National Dong Hwa University . Take Provincial Highway 11C and turn right (left) next to 7-11 at 5.5 kilometers and you can see our park. It is only a 10 to 15 minute drive from Farglory Ocean Park, Liyu Lake, Zhaofeng Farm, and Dongdamen Night Market. Here you can enjoy the garden scenery with a comfortable accommodation environment and the best quality and friendly service. There is a beautiful garden and brocade pond, so you can enjoy the garden scenery to your heart's content. The entrance of the park overlooks the green coastal mountains and faces the rising sun in the east. In addition to the beautiful environment, we also provide exquisite and nutritious breakfast. Let every guest be refreshed and ready for a new day. Our service tenet is to make guests feel at home and remember their stay after they leave.

stays.description: ""Yuan Qi Wu Homestay"" is a registered homestay in Hualien and was passed on, the motto of ""service as the top priority"", to the next generation. New room interior design has been applied and glass dome dining area has been deployed, this ensures guest safety and satisfaction. To our delight, we got the certifications of ""Taiwan Host"" and ""Hualien County Accommodation Business Hygiene Certification"". ""Yuan Qi Wu"" is on Provincial Highway 11c, providing easy access to Farglory Ocean Park, Harvest Ranch Resort, Mugu Muyu, Fenglin 3D Children& #39;s Water Park, Carp Lake, Tungtamen Night Market within 10~20 minutes of driving, and Happy Farm, Dong Hwa University, Promisedland Resort & Lagoon and Lichuan Fish Market takes approximately 10 minutes of driving. Cities are dazzling but blinding. If you& #39;re looking for a few days off from the never-ending stimuli, retreat to the cradle between the Central Mountain Range and the Coastal Mountain Range as a pilgrim of nature! ""Yuan Qi Wu"" is graceful with the artwork of nature, and we invite you to experience what it& #39;s like in a land of dreams.

stays.description: Lakeside House Bed and Breakfast faces the Liyu Lake Water Dance Performance Stage, where a variety of activities and international concerts are held. The scenery is relaxing and peaceful, the water and sky seem to blend together, and amidst light rains and mist in the afternoon, geese, birds, and fishing boats reflect on the clear green waves, bringing you up close to the mountains and lake. Capture the ever-changing moment as the lake’s appearance shifts with the passage of time. Take a stroll or bike around the lake, appreciating the ecology, or climb the mountain trail, breathing in the fresh forest air. If you’re not interested in that, relax and daydream on the deck facing the lake. Your best vacation experience starts here at Lakeside House Bed and Breakfast.

stays.name: Crossing The Rainbow Bridge B&B
stays.description: Back to the land of Truku people, we are here again. The land presents a visual feast with mountain forests and composes the life movement with streams; we hope to lead the people of this land to know the toughness of life and the kindness of Creator. Crossing The Rainbow Bridge B&B will guide you to discover the nature, which may be the greatest experience for you to get the closest to the true history and nature or the best travel for you with a touching memories. We look forward to meeting you. Crossing The Rainbow Bridge B&B aims to present and introduce Truku culture. We use the mountain spring water to form a small waterfall with the special design of illumination to form a rainbow above the waterfall. Combining landscaping with the culture, we introduce our culture in a profound but simple way for cultural transmission and education.

stays.name: MQMGI HOSTEL
stays.description: Mu Gu Mu Yu which has the style of a Japanese style vacation villas, built next to a creek and mountains. On the left hand side is a large area of grass for children to play ball. On the trail in front, you can go play with the water along the riverside rock, and also walk for about 15 minutes along a 200 meter long old tunnel to Jade Valley (Feicui Valley) in front of the home stay to take a SPA, swim, river trek, and explore old trails. On the left side, there is the most popular scenic spot in Hualien, Mu Gu Mu Yu. There are also Qingshui River and Long Chien (Longjian) Valley, known as Taiwan's Jiuzaigou (About 32 km round trip). On the right hand side of the home stay, within 6 km, there is the Bai Bao River, Liuyutan (Liyu Lake), Ji-an Canal, Feng Lin trail with bicycle trails. Every building has a window and the view is good. In the rooms, balcony, outer hallway, green grassland in the grounds, you can enjoy the beautiful natural scenery of mountains, Papaya River (Mugua River) and Jade Valley. The buildings have a Taroko aboriginal architectural style. We provide 2 person to 6 person rooms which are comfortable, spacious, bright, and simple. All the rooms have good views. The viewing platform in front of the home stay enjoys expansive views of the Papaya River. Standing here opens the mind. In addition, the observatory next to the fish pond is the best place for relaxing the mind and soul, where you can be caressed by the breeze as you soak up the country charm. The Tong Men Community is only 15 km away from the city (Hualien Train Station), however Mu Gu Mu Yu Home Stay’s favorable geographical location, with the mountains and mountain mist, and the winding river bed of the Papaya River and Taroko tribe buildings with aborigine totems, giving you a different lodging and vacation space. We welcome you to enjoy the life and culture of the Taroko tribe and embrace the beautiful environment of Mother Nature, relax, and get away from the city hubbub.

stays.name: So-Ga B & B (Taroko)
stays.description: Situated in the land given by the creator/ In the home of the Taroko tribe, the Hualien (Taroko) So-Ga Home Stay is 3 years old. From 2012, by way of showing gratitude, we have been offering free accommodation to people with physical and mental disabilities, allowing them to have the opportunity to go out and have fun; and the price for each accompanying person is just NT 600/day, no matter what the room type is. Everyone please forward this message to friends and institutions in need. Our front garden is the Pacific Ocean Beach (You can watch sunrise, moonrise, pick beautiful rocks, and view the beautiful scenery of Cingshui (Qingshui) Cliff from afar. The backyard is the Taroko Gorge (The entrance to the Taroko National Park is on the other side of Provincial Highway 9). The left wing-room is Chungde (Chongde) Bay (There are 3 fixed net fisheries where you can purchase fresh fish). The right wing-room is the mouth of the Li Wu River (Early origin of golden sand) We have a 300 square meter Bachiru Park (literally A bread tree park in Chinese, ‘Artocarpus altilis’) garden. Each year, the harvest season is in July), quiet double rooms, elegant 4 person rooms, cheap dormitories, multi-functional group classroom (Japanese style floor), with a camping ground full of wilderness fun. Our foods and beverages include hand-made pancakes, fresh and pesticide-free juice, pure and natural tea. You can relax, chill out, daydream, drink tea, have a group get together, picnic, barbecue, rest, stay, and go camping.

stays.name: Taroko Hotel(B＆B)
stays.description: Taroko Home Stay is situated near Taroko Gorge, only a 3 minute drive from Taroko National Park. You can view the green mountains from afar and white clouds spread across the sky. Deeply inhale the fresh air of Taroko Gorge to allow the good mountain and good water to put you in a positive frame of mind. Taroko Home Stay, situated in Taroko National Park, not only has a comfortable and elegant lodging environment, the park offers superb mountain and gorge scenery. The front yard of the home stay is an open grass area where you can run and play all you want. Holding group activities here is also a good option. This home stay with mountain and ocean charm has comfortable and warm rooms; even inside you can smell the fragrance of the grass outside the windows. Through the window next to the bedside, mountain scenery stretches as far as the eye can see. Slow down and take a relaxing Taroko trip, enjoying the quiet countryside life. At night, you can lay on the grass and watch the stars, and hear the happy singing of insects. On the misty mountain, the attracted gaze, moved soul, and the already merged body, all seem to belong to nature. What kind of feeling is that? I look into the distance. The mountains rise like giant towers, partially hidden by a misty shroud. The green skin of mountain goes through white fog, and makes the sky hazy. It seems like I am surrounded by clouds. At this time, not only am I relaxed, I sit on the green grass, and look at the sky. I rest for awhile at the juncture of blue sea and sky. Here, I am only resting for a while; and then, with the returning steps, the reddish afterglow on the other side of the mountain perhaps brings another state of mind.

stays.description: Taroko sialin features two themes: Theme 1: sialin coffee farm-stay B&B featuring coffee experiences. On the 5,643 m2 farm land, hundreds Arabica coffee trees has been planted without applying any pesticides, an absolute health concept endowed with the coffee farm, visitors definitely enjoy our fragrant sialin coffee with the peace of mind. Guests of Taroko sialin can sample our handmade sialin coffee free of charge, in addition to experiencing picking, peeling, pulping, baking coffee beans, and other coffee production all by themselves. stays.name: TheArneykylongstayagriculture
stays.description: Arneyky Farmhouse Bed and Breakfast Features: The theme of this place is mountains and lakes, being a 1 minute drive or 5 minute walk from Liyu Lake, the sapphire of the East Coast, as well as 3-5 minute drive from Baibao Stream Bike Trail, Liangtan Bike Trail, Mugumuki Ecological Corridor, and Chinan Forest Recreation Area. Additionally, we provide a BBQ area, 2 meter high pizza oven, and raise nearly 10 types of cute animals right next to the bed and breakfast. The grounds are home to Luciola cerata E. Olivier (black wing fireflies) from March to May, Rhinoceros beetle from May to July, a garden full of Shanchuang fireflies from October to December, and 15 types of frogs and 12 types of butterflies. The plant and animal life is rich enough to regard this place as a secluded ecological area, and it’s a paradise of bike lovers, the top choice for taking a family vacation, and a prime spot for ecology, nature, and leisure. If you’re not in a hurry, this is the place to enjoy a comfortable, leisurely vacation.

stays.name: Wisdom Garden Homestay
stays.description: Wisdom Garden Homestay is located in the north of Yuli, Hualien, at the start of Yuli-Changbin Highwayoad, and it is a B&B surrounded by beautiful mountains and waters. However, to become a B&B was not our original intention. The innkeepers Mr. Xu Kunliang and Mrs Li Pingmei couple are devout Buddhists, and following an unrestrained attitude and karma, they would like to share with friends the peace and elegance of the land. She was graduated from the National College of Arts, was a talented artist swaying her capabilities in Taipei workplace, before experiencing a series of frustrations. Because of studying the Dharma, she changed her interpretation of and attitude toward life. Her master named the B&B Wisdom Garden Homestay. The environment of Wisdom Garden Homestay is quiet and elegant, each room has a totally different style, does not have luxurious décor and building materials, but the furnishings are from the hostess's ingenuity, an accentuated rendition of the talents and intentions of the hostess. Wisdom Garden Homestay, a building with strong Chinese style, is many foreign travelers' favorite. Zen Joy Floor, a layout of the natural materials, has a distinctive flavor, while the Star Hunt Floor at the top of the building surrounded by french sashes is suitable for group meetings or spiritual exploration. Not much deliberate publicity making, the owner said, an arrival is a success. In the first month of spring, frogs cry, fireflies carry lanterns, in the second month of summer, shining stars fill the sky, in early autumn lilies are all over the hillsides, and late winter Canola flowers wave in the wind. Wisdom Garden Homestay may be your mind bosom pal.

stays.name: Yuli Rainbow Bridge Bed &Breakfast
stays.description: The construction of Yulihongqiao B&B was completed on May 6, 2011. The construction was contracted to Guangsheng Construction Company Ltd, a famous construction company in Hualien. The proprietor was Tingmei Construction Co., Ltd. The land originally belonged to Mr. Chen Zheng-xiong, the owner of the B&B and Chairman of the Board of Guangsheng Construction Company. In order to develop Yuli, Tingmei Construction Company entered into proprietorship with the B&B owner and built this beautiful 12-condo luxury villa. Chairman Chen named the B&B "Yuli", a homophone that means "royal gift", to imply a royal gift (grand mansion) was bestowed and passed down to him as his private mansion. The B&B uses electronic smart devices and top notch construction materials. The owner has a deep connection to his property and created this luxury villa with beautiful surroundings, such as the Rainbow Bridge across from the B&B, which is also Yuli's landmark. His wish is to provide visitors a comfortable living space in Hualien's beautiful Yuli Township, so they can have an enjoyable and happy vacation.

stays.name: Yong Jie Hotel
stays.description: Yongjie Hotel was founded in 1999 and is located in Kaohsiung City’s Daliao District, a 10-minute drive from Chengcing Lake (Chengqing Lake), Fo Guang Shan Monastery, Dashu Old Railway Bridge, Wei Wu Ying Metropolitan Park, Fongshan (Fengshan) Stadium, the Republic of China Military Academy, and Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School; a five-minute drive from the train station and subway station; 20 minutes from Kaohsiung International Airport; and 15 minutes from urban Kaohsiung. By car, Qingnian and Fongshan (Fengshan) Night Markets are only 10 minutes away. It is situated in a thriving area with convenient transportation, and is a great choice for business travelers and independent travelers alike. The hotel offers wireless Internet access to help you stay on top of business or keep in touch with family, and is a comfortable way to escape the madding crowds and relax. In its 12 years of operation, it has earned two awards from the Taiwan Chamber of Commerce and Kaohsiung City Chamber of Commerce, as well as receiving the mark of quality from the Kaohsiung County Department of Health in 2008 and the “Excellent Hotel” Kaohsiung County Accommodation Health Management authorities in 2009. A trustworthy choice, this hotel prizes service above all and strives to provide its guests with a home away from home.

stays.name: E-DA Royal Hotel
stays.description: E-DA ROYAL HOTEL is located in southern Taiwan, 20 minutes by car from downtown Kaohsiung and Kaohsiung High Speed Rail station. It is the only luxurious resort hotel in Taiwan that combines diverse enjoyments of theme park, world class outlet mall, digital cinema and theme stadium. E-DA ROYAL HOTEL consists of 655(Included Sleeping Center) luxurious rooms, 5 restaurants, 20 function rooms for meetings and events, kids’ club, and trendy SPA facility. The hotel also presents video and audio lighting show in the Dream World, which is one and only in Asia 656 luxurious room types with modern facilities; LCD TV, free high-speed broadband access, bathroom with separate toilet. Our suites are equipped with coffee makers and head massage machines. Spacious comfortable rooms provide a total relaxing experience Royal Club floor: personalised services for extra comfort; quick check-in/ check-out counter, exclusive access to the Royal Club Lounge, offering refreshments, night cocktails and 2 hours usage of meeting facilities. 5 superb dining facilities. Heat’N Chill: international buffet restaurant. Royal Palace: classic Cantonese cuisine with private dining rooms, for business or private gatherings. Casa Fontana: chic Italian style cuisine. The Cut: high quality steaks or teppanyaki. Yanagi: delicious Japanese food and sake of the highest standard. Deli2go: freshly baked breads, cake, sweets and hand-made chocolate. E-DA ROYAL HOTEL provides extensive, well equipped recreational amenities for in-house guests. Our Recreation Centre offers aerobic studios, sauna and “Royal e-Spa”, Aqua World, indoor and outdoor pools, water playground, tennis courts, billiard and table tennis rooms, video game arcade, and a specially designed Kid’s Club. The two Grand Ballrooms accommodate up to 60 tables making them perfect for grand weddings. The Wedding Centre: comprehensive services including grooming, gown selection and photo shoots that ensure a stress-free fabulous wedding. The Royal Wedding Director provides friendly and professional services to prepare you for the best day of your life.

stays.name: SOHO Military Dependent's Villages Exploration Hall
stays.description: Three old trees with lush greenery set off the Japanese-style single-family two-story brick and wood elevated house covered with cement roof tiles. The four-inch anti-theft nails above the brick fence and the red and white red gate of the military community. The whole house uses mortise and tenon structure to repair large wooden beams and columns, reinforce the elevated wooden floor, and open the damaged pole edge ceiling, so that the roof waterproofing and roof tile repair work can be seen at a glance, showing the restoration method and the integration of old and new local materials. This house is It is the residence of Principal Wang Jingyou, the first principal of Chengzheng Elementary School, and teacher Sun Juren (cousin of Sun Liren).We hope that everyone can experience the immersive daily life of the military dependents' village like us. In addition to walking through the village alleys and visiting the houses, you can also learn about the restoration process of the military dependents' houses and feel the gentle breeze blowing on your face under the three big trees that are unique for more than a month. You can linger comfortably, make a pot of fragrant tea, and enjoy the afternoon snacks of the Military Village. Children, both adults and children, can also experience making early handcrafted Children's Village toys. When night falls, you can ride your bicycle to Fengshan Street to buy local delicacies and return to the family home to enjoy. You can also simply experience making home-cooked food from the military family in the cooking area that retains the white square tiles from the 1950s. After a meal and a break, fill the bathhouse with hot water and put a bath tablet in it to relieve stress. At the end of the night, people quietly put on their pajamas and nestled in the master bedroom full of military village atmosphere or on the Japanese-style floor. Listening to the long good night song of the Army Academy, they fell asleep soundly. The next day, the melodies of various birds singing on the trees in the yard composed the beautiful movement of nature. Mix in the military academy’s reveille and experience the unique morning march of the military military village. After washing, make a cup of hot milk or hand-brewed coffee, pick up the steaming steamed buns in the steamer, and pair them with porridge and side dishes, which is the delicious taste of home in the military community. Open the edge grille sliding door and extend the interior to the courtyard. The inside and outside complement each other. Open a book in the corner, sit on a rocking chair, sometimes relax and sometimes reflect, and enjoy the unique SOHO studio that has evolved in this military village.​

stays.name: SPRING ART HOTEL
stays.description: Spring Art Hotel is located in Kaohsiung's Fengshan District, close to Weiwuying Park, Fengshan Stadium, Chung Cheng Armed Forces Preparatory School and Republic of China Military Academy. It's about a 5 minute drive from the highway interchange. Other transportation stations, such as train station, bus terminal, Kaohsiung International Airport and downtown Kaohsiung are all about a 10 minute drive away. In addition, it only takes a 10 minute ride to get to the famous Kaohsiung International Tourism Liuhe Night Market and the Fengshan Youth Tourist Night Market. With a lively surrounding and convenient transportation, Spring Art Hotel is definitely an ideal hotel for business and pleasure. Spring Art Hotel has a very nice restaurant that serves complimentary Chinese and western buffet breakfast to the hotel guests. The wireless connection available in all the guestrooms provides easy access to business clients to stay connected to their work. The hotel also has a business center, sports and leisure area and meeting rooms. You will be able to take care of all your businesses and relax when you stay at Spring Art Hotel, and we promise you will return home feeling happy and satisfied.

stays.name: Sunrise Bike Inn
stays.description: .Sunrise Bike Inn is located in Fengshan, Kaohsiung, at the intersection of the city and suburb. Transformed from a Japanese-style space, it’s filled with the daily lives of its hosts—cycling, Surfing, and the vibrant energy of an old house that never fades with age. Instead, it continues to thrive with the arrival of different lives at different times. This is the essence of a military dependents’ village: a blend of various eras and diverse people.This is our home, and we share this space to offer rest and respite. The 80-year-old Japanese-style building isn’t about luxury or grandeur—it’s been simply restored to preserve the soul of the house and traces of past lives. If you’re on a journey or a cycling trip, Sunrise offers a laid-back place to stay. You might hear some noise, perhaps the sound of bicycles—that’s just the rhythm of our life here.

stays.name: Hotel R14
stays.description: Hotel R14, named after its location near Kaohsiung MRT Red Line Stop 14, and next to Kaohsiung Arena, was designed by Mr. Lin Po-Yu, an architecture student of the renowned Japanese architect, Kengo Kuma. Hotel R14 is a green building, upholding “natural”, “authentic”, “green”, and “simple” concepts. Its style can be considered modern Japanese, combining a sense of modernity, simplicity and low-key luxury.Outwardly, the hotel’s appearance is an impressive symmetrical black and white bar code design conveying a strong sense of the future. The interior design is constructed using exquisite woodwork, noble titanium plated metal, elegant exposed concrete, and bamboo materials from Bamboola, Taiwan. The color theme is black, white, wood, and gray- all earth tones which exude tranquility to make guests feel relaxed.

stays.name: PARKLEES HOTEL
stays.description: Sitting across from a park amid the bustling city, PARK LEES does not simply borrow from the serenity of the park but rather uses this asset to explore our natural disposition and the soul’s longing for repose. Our hotel offers travelers an abode to be themselves and rejuvenate, close to yet separate from the urban hubbub. We hope that business travelers and tourists alike enjoy our minimalist design and attentive service and derive a sense of quiet peace and renewed energy from the park across the street.Architectural appearanceThe hotel is decorated with a simple color palette of black and white paired with gray hues, and fluid lines that dress the hotel in an elegant architectural cloak, while a crown of irregular black iron sculptural forms around the roof create a playful transition between the building and the sky above. The lanterns in the park make the hotel’s logo light up, like a beacon beckoning the travelers home to their haven in the harbor city of Kaohsiung. In the pavement outside the lobby doors, etched copper plates mark the latitude and longitude of the location. A green building The building’s exterior surface is coated with a thermal insulation layer, while gray-scale reinforced glass is applied throughout to block part of the heat. The rooftop is laid with insulation tiles, green plants, and solar panels that power the hotel’s exterior lighting at night. The building’s air conditioning and hot water use a heat pump and ice water heat recovery system, which reduces energy consumption. Inside and outside, high-performance LED lighting is used under a KNX (smart building) system and software which manages the light sources for different zones and times.Taking the "traveler's autonomous space" as the main axis, connecting each environment with coherent color temperature and line light and shadow, large-area floor-to-ceiling windows echo the outdoor sunshine and green, transparent gray glass and mirrors in the bathroom, simple and comfortable white desktop, casual details Ingenuity creates a stylish, comfortable and complete sophisticated space, with wood, iron, rock, light and shadow, and fine-quality elements integrated into the sensory design.

stays.name: Watermark Hotel-Sizihwan
stays.description: The “Watermark Hotel”, located in Sizihwan, is surrounded by the prosperous Kaohsiung Harbor and Chai Shan which is peaks and ridges and a whole slice of green. Feel the phytoncidere in the mountain and wash tiredness of body and soul early in the morning. The fading light of sunset spilled here, glistening yellow, sparkling like a jewel when sunset. And it can overlook the city view with bright lights of Kaohsiung Harbor and the landmark of Kaohsiung of 85 building and Ferris Wheel of Dream Mall can be a panoramic view. The sea and the sky merge into one, the ship goes into the territory and the verdant mountain and sea views can be got easily at anywhere and anytime. In addition to the stunning scenery, the convenient transportation is a big advantage here. It is near Sizihwan MRT station and Gushan Ferry Station; it is very convenient to go to the urban area of Kaohsiung and Cijin. The nearby attractions are too numerous to enumerate, there are Sizihwan Beach, Shaochuantou Park, British Consulate, Martyrs’ Shrine, Pier-2 Art Center, Banana Pier, Love Pier, Cijin Seaside Park, Cihou Lighthouse and so on. It combines the convenience and prosperity of city and the quiet and beauty of suburb; it can be said to be the most beautiful back garden in Kaohsiung. Would you like to get away temporarily from the hubbub and make a relax tour for you that tired of crowded urban life? Here is absolutely your best choice.

Hotel Sunshine gathers classic grace of oriental culture and gives out the vitality of Harbor City, Kaohsiung. Because we provide exquisite tastes and close services, our hotel is your best choice when you visit Kaohsiung. The hotel is worthy of the name and welcome to Hotel Sunshine.

stays.name: The Lees Hotel
stays.description: About TLHThe Lees Hotel The company’s core culture is based on the artistic persistence and the corporate governance of the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu; with a background in arts, architecture and business, Dr. Lee uses his natural acuity for business management and arts and culture and established a five star hotel complete with humanities, services, aesthetics, and facilities. The aim of the hotel is to treat the guests with honor. Also, by creating a living space full of aesthetic and cultural ambience, guests can easily encounter antiques, paintings and other art works in the lobby, hallways, or other unexpected places. The aesthetic of the building The design of the building is based on the Chinese character “zun”, which in ancient times refers to the utensil the emperor uses to drink wine. By using the shape of the word as an exterior design expresses the company’s respect towards guests and staffs. The building material uses granite panels to express a sense of honor, glory and generosity. The main wall is Italian styled with four different colors of imported pearl mosaic panels and shifts color under different angles of sunlight. The aesthetic of the spacesThe lobby is presented with the simple and modest modern new classical and decoration art styles. The overall design uses marble floors and maple wood integrated with indirect lightings along with a collection of many art works. The ten meter high ceiling atrium uses metal and glass to design a large modernistic overhead art piece, echoing with the restaurants on the second floor. The abstract paintings painted by the founder Dr. Lee Deng Mu are hanged on the lobby walls, adding a spacious and imposing ambience to the lobby.

stays.name: Feng Yuan Homestay
stays.description: For the independent traveler, transportation can be a vital concern; without a car, it can be hard to get to many of the most scenic areas. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast is just five minutes from the train station and offers its own guided tours, making it a great choice for backpackers and independent travelers. Owner Chen Qizhong is also secretary general of the Kaohsiung Minsu (Bed & Breakfast) Development Association and a licensed tour guide, so he spares no effort in promoting the beauty of Meinong through tourism and accommodation. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast offers half-day and full-day tours tailored to guests’ preferences and backgrounds, as well as providing transportation, all helping guests get a full experience of the local Hakka culture. Fengyuan Bed & Breakfast cordially invites you to experience the fantastical rural scenery and local culture!

stays.name: Jhong Jheng Hu B&B
stays.description: Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a Belvedere B&B, close to Zhongzheng Lake. Looking out the window of the house, you can see a lush green herringbone mountain, with lakes and mountains, a natural beauty. The male and female owners Li Wenqin and Su Yingju personally built a park garden with rich flowers and plants, and healthy trails. , small bridges and flowing water, and at night, under the beautiful lights, the Zhongzheng Lake B&B looks even more romantic and alluring.The small town of Meinong is located in Kaohsiung City, nestled at the foot of the rolling [Herringbone Mountain] mountains. In this Hakka settlement, there are historical sites, old houses and water towns, as well as simple and kind-hearted humanistic customs. It is worth slowing down and savoring it. In winter, you can see the small, white and tender white jade radishes; in summer, you can come here and see green in different shades, admire the lingering mountains after the rain, or ride a bicycle and let the warm south wind blow on your face.The host, Ms. Su, is not only a professional tour guide, but also an enthusiastic and cheerful volunteer. She knows the customs and customs of Meinong Hakkas like the back of her hand, and can help tourists get to know Meinong in the shortest possible time. He is committed to promoting the traditional Hakka music, which is based on gongs and drums and mainly suona-like drum instruments. Sometimes he will improvise a "welcome song" to welcome guests from afar.Zhongzheng Lake B&B is located in Zhongzhen Community, which won the National Model Community Competition. The residents here attach more importance to the greening and beautification of the environment than residents of other communities. Zhongzheng Lake B&B is a cozy little building carefully built by the owner. In addition to using it to promote the quality of Meinong's tourism and promote the Hakka culture in Meinong, we also hope to give you an unforgettable holiday life. We sincerely invite you. 's visit.1. It is located in a model community that has been awarded, close to Zhongzheng Lake and the Hakka Cultural Relics Museum. The TV travel support group, once known as the Bel Canto B&B, is for music lovers to learn about Hakka ancient music, music and folk songs.4. Diversified room types, clean and tidy, and a home-like feel are the most important demands of this B&B.

stays.name: Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay
stays.description: A place with flourishing flowers and floral fragrances, as well as lush prosperous woods, and the owner named it Yun Shanju. With a pond drilled on its west side to guide the stream for cultivating trees to become a recreational venue, which has already become quite a large scale under the owner’s intended management for over the past more than 30 years, such that it is surrounded by trees, and is further the ideal playground for children. The owner who is also a musician has an aloof quality of Taosim. Anyone who has wealthy spirit will naturally feedback to oneself, and only those with a wealthy heart will be capable pf hosting others sincerely. The owner’s exertion towards gardening art explains this point. “Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay” faces the Central Mountain Range “Dawushan” on the east, with crystal clear running stream, morning sunlight and evening shade, as well as ever-changing sceneries. Take a half day off to admire the golden sunset, just as refreshing as watching the odd mountains in Guilin sheltering the sunlight. It used to be the gathering venue for writers and poets in the past, where time often gets past midnight with being noticed; with the rain through sunlight, the breeze through trees, the magnificent sceneries, the bright moon in the clear sky, the ripples in the pool, the splashes between water and stones, as well as the birds chirpings amongst the woods… the owner with background as a musician is thus naturally related to art. Whether straight stem or hanging down, literati or graceful are all artistic bonsais created meticulously by the owner. Trees and stones are naturally inseparable, offering an alternative sentiment with garden stones or scene stones placed in the yard. The image of white geese swimming in the pool and green ducks chasing after the waves form an interesting scenery as well! Wait for you to uncover the secrets of Meinong Yun Shanju Homestay!

stays.name: Ran-Ge B & B
stays.description: The owner of Ren Zji Village is a children’s art teacher with over 20 years’ experience, and has set up a plaza here to help teach children art and creativity. It’s also a perfect space for grown-ups to exercise their creative muscles as well! In 2003, as the government began promoting bed-and-breakfasts, as well as being motivated by a desire to make new friends, they got a license from the government and began operating their own bed-and-breakfast. Sitting on just over 1,650 square meters of land, Ren Zji Village is located near the spectacular Lake Zhongzheng and Mt. Renzi. The lush mountain greenery, Rubik’s-cube-like pagoda, and fragrant lotus lake create an atmosphere of serene beauty, particularly in the evenings, and the grounds are decorated with the artworks of the owners, one of whom specializes in watercolors, the other in a variety of art forms, including gourd carving, paper art, and dyework. Special features include: 1) Free personalized itineraries for guests, offering tours that are in-depth, artistic, and informative. 2) Maps of bicycle paths around the local scenic spots, a particularly recommended way to enjoy the beauty of the Meinong area. 3) DIY art sessions, which offer a chance to experience something a little different.

Whether it’s under clear blue skies or twinkling, starry nights, you’re sure to find Tobacco City a relaxing stay.

stays.name: The Grand Hotel Kaohsiung
stays.description: Kaohsiung is an important city in southern Taiwan, both economy and tourism-wise. The Grand Hotel, situated by the Cheng Ching Lake in Kaohsiung, is a renowned palatial recluse from the bustles and hustles of the Kaohsiung City. It is approximately 30 minutes by car from the Kaohsiung International Airport, and 20 minutes from the Kaohsiung Train Station and the Zhuoying Station of Taiwan High Speed Rail. The convenient location makes the hotel a great place to spend vacation time, stay for business trips, or hold banquets.The Grand Hotel is a combination of the grandeur of Western architecture and classic Easter architecture. Exquisite craftsmanship is evident in the colorful painted rafters and red columns in traditional Chinese styles. The Ming-dynasty style decor and redwood furniture in the rooms all bring back thoughts of ages past. The hotel used to be a high society entertainment and diplomatic reception venue for the nation in the past, and it has stood witness to countless historical events.

stays.name: GRAND HI-LAI HOTEL
stays.description: Grand Hi-Lai Hotel is located in the bustling commercial center of Kaohsiung, with 186 meters height, overlooks the panoramic view of Kaohsiung, houses the décor with more than three thousand pieces of antique art treasures everywhere, 540 comfortable rooms, 13 Chinese and Western restaurants, and a parking lot with 1,000 cars' capacity. Just 20 minutes' drive from high-speed rail station; 15 minutes' walk from MRT station. The hotel, in addition to functions of accommodation, catering, conference, and banquet, combines with boutique-studded Hanshin Department Store to comply with the convenience of one-stop shopping. The hall filled with neo-classical style, antique works of art distributed throughout the hotel, showing the style of magnificent and elegant design. In the rooms, generous and staid logs are decorated with simple lines with modern sense and European classical ornamentation to present a noble and elegant temperament. Opening the curtains, the beautiful panoramic view of Kaohsiung not only is stunning, but also creates a priceless Grand Hi-Lai Hotel. It offers 540 rooms with a variety of designs, which fully meet the demands of various consumer groups. Healthful rooms are equipped with fitness devices on the balcony, and you take an exercise while enjoy beautiful seascape, relaxing completely your body and mind. In the business rooms, multifunction device and wireless internet are set up to provide convenient services, so that visitors will not miss any business opportunities. The furniture and furnishings in Hi-Lai suites are all works of art or antiques, like living in a small art gallery, where heads of state, international superstar Michel Jackson, tenor Jose Carreras, and global CEO of LV have checked in and stayed at Hi-Lai. Grand Hi-Lai Hotel has awarded the Best Business Hotel by domestic and international business magazines, has also been designated international banquet venue by the government for several times. Moreover, in 2008, Hi-Lai was designated foreign guests accommodations in the occasion of presidential inaugural banquet. With professional aesthetic architecture, experienced international hotel management, and the most elegant landmark of classic in southern Taiwan, Hi-Lai offers the best quality of professional services in international renown accommodation and in famous international cuisine dishes.

The hall filled with neo-classical style, antique works of art distributed throughout the hotel, showing the style of magnificent and elegant design. In the rooms, generous and staid logs are decorated with simple lines with modern sense and European classical ornamentation to present a noble and elegant temperament. Opening the curtains, the beautiful panoramic view of Kaohsiung not only is stunning, but also creates a priceless Grand Hi-Lai Hotel. It offers 540 rooms with a variety of designs, which fully meet the demands of various consumer groups. Healthful rooms are equipped with fitness devices on the balcony, and you take an exercise while enjoy beautiful seascape, relaxing completely your body and mind. In the business rooms, multifunction device and wireless internet are set up to provide convenient services, so that visitors will not miss any business opportunities. The furniture and furnishings in Hi-Lai suites are all works of art or antiques, like living in a small art gallery, where heads of state, international superstar Michel Jackson, tenor Jose Carreras, and global CEO of LV have checked in and stayed at Hi-Lai. Grand Hi-Lai Hotel has awarded the Best Business Hotel by domestic and international business magazines, has also been designated international banquet venue by the government for several times. Moreover, in 2008, Hi-Lai was designated foreign guests accommodations in the occasion of presidential inaugural banquet. With professional aesthetic architecture, experienced international hotel management, and the most elegant landmark of classic in southern Taiwan, Hi-Lai offers the best quality of professional services in international renown accommodation and in famous international cuisine dishes.

stays.name: Voyage Kaohsiung By Cosmos Oasis
stays.description: Welcome to Voyage Kaohsiung by Cosmos Oasis, where “Explore the Harbor City, Experience Exquisite Living” is our philosophy. ‘Voyage’ embodies the essence of travel and journeys, perfectly suited for our location in the vibrant harbor city of Kaohsiung. Inspired by the harbor and shipping containers, our hotel showcases timeless, understated, new oriental aesthetics. The main structure, composed of stacked containers, boasts an elegant, pure white exterior that seamlessly blends elements of the ocean, harbor life, ships, and trading goods. Illuminated at night, it mirrors the lively buzz of the bustling harbor, resonating with travelers from all over the world who dock here to experience the unique passion, culture, and history of Southern Taiwan. Experience a memorable stay at our enchanting harbor retreat and embark on an unforgettable journey. Bon Voyage!Voyage Kaohsiung by Cosmos Oasis features 28 well-appointed guest rooms, a grand lobby with soaring ceilings, and elegant floral and botanical arrangements that exude sophisticated charm. Natural light intertwines with Kaohsiung’s cultural highlights, creating an ambiance filled with profound visual imagery that reflects the vibrant essence of the local harbor city. This atmosphere offers a rich blend of visual allure and comfort, catering to both the mind and body of travelers.

stays.name: DreamWell Hostel
stays.description: D’well Hostel is the home for backpackers in Kaohsiung.The hostel enjoys the perfect location: just next to Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Mall in Sanduo Shopping area. It just takes 2-minute walking from the MRT station (R8, Sanduo Shopping Area Stop) to the hostel. Opposite to the hostel, Xing Zhong Night Market is your convenient choice to taste Taiwan food. Guests can also go to the largest Night Market in Taiwan- Kaixuan Night Market which is not far from the hostel as well. D’well is specialized for backpackers: a fashionable, safe, clean, comfortable and convenient accommodation. It provides you the chance to meet and share the experiences with international travelers. There is a spacious common area in the hostel where guests can read books, chat and share travel experiences with friends and travelers all over the world. All rooms are designed with anti-fire facilities. The bunk bed structure takes one year to design to provide guests with a wide bed for a comfortable sleep. The shared shower rooms are divided for male and female separately. All shower rooms have been nice decorated and equipped with good quality facilities which are used in the hotels. D’well will accompany with you to listen to your dreams. Leave the familiar hometown and explore new destinations, new experience, new life and new friendship. D’well Hostel is aiming to become the best accommodation in Kaohsiung for those backpackers who are looking after their dreams.

stays.description: Hubhotel Kaohsiung is located in downtown Kaohsiung's Sanduo Shopping District. It only takes a 10 minutes drive to the Kaohsiung Station and Xiaogang International Airport. The 89 spacious guestrooms in the hotel are elegant, exquisite, quiet and comfortable. The hotel has a partnership with Reve Cafe to provide lunch, afternoon tea and dinner to hotel guests. We have always placed our customers first and aimed to provide the best service. Thank you for giving us the chance to serve you.

stays.name: Hotel Nikko Kaohsiung
stays.description: Hotel Nikko Kaohsiung is a 22-story hotel offering 260 luxurious rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows that provide stunning views of the Kaohsiung skyline. Each room is equipped with a flat-screen TV, spacious workstation, spa-inspired bathroom with a walk-in shower and tub, UCC coffeemaker, minibar, and Panasonic hairdryer. The heart of the hotel & #39; s design is inspired by the brand & #39; s refined elegance, extending to the gym, swimming pool, and Sauna, and five exquisite dining options: Japanese, Chinese, All-Day Dining Buffet, Lobby Lounge, and Rooftop Bar. stays.name: Cishan san-ho-yuan B&B
stays.description: Qishan Sanheyuan B&B is a very distinctive ancient rural Sanheyuan building. It is located at No. 6, Zhongxing Street, Guangfuli, Qishan District, Kaohsiung City. Qishan is located in the center of Kaohsiung County and has always been the external transportation hub of Jiuxiang Town, Qishan District. You can drive there by yourself. It is very convenient to get to Qishan from the expressway. When passing the Zhongshan Expressway, you can get off at the Nanzi Interchange and take Qinan Highway directly to Qishan; or take the Zhongshan Expressway and connect to National Highway No. 10 and drive eastward, and turn right at the end of the national highway toward Ligang. There are signs for B&Bs on the road in the direction. This hotel provides vacation and leisure breaks, allowing people to temporarily stay away from the hustle and bustle of the city, embrace nature and enjoy a quiet, leisure and comfortable life. There are many flowers and plants planted around the B&B for you to enjoy, and there is also a Happy Farm (real version) to experience rural life, where the landlady will teach you how to grow vegetables. , fruits..., it is a good place for the whole family to relax. Pets can be accommodated. You can take a walk on the river embankment to watch the sunset in the evening, and there is a barbecue area. "Please inform us by phone in advance when bringing pets or using the barbecue area." Our hotel provides free breakfast to hotel guests, Chinese style (rice porridge) and coffee. Please inform in advance if you want to eat vegetarian food. In addition, instant noodles, drinks, and beer are sold... #Making tea (each set of tea sets is 500 yuan, including tea sets, tea leaves, and tea water), simple tea making is 150 yuan, and a bag of tea leaves is sold separately for 500 yuan. #Barbecue space and barbecue grills are provided free of charge. In addition, ingredients and charcoal are provided (please bring your own). (Please call us if you want to use the barbecue area)

The resort offers natural scenery, suburban peacefulness and quietness, clean and comfortable living quarters, broad space, the culture of old-time streets and Meinong, the famous home of Hakka culture. We provide visitors with the best comfort to help them have a perfect holiday.Hau-Xiang Resort is divided into five different themes: the Recreational Theme, the Metropolitan theme, the Fantasy Children theme, the Fashion Luxurious Theme, and the Simplicity Theme. The resort has a total of 81 rooms including 21 motel villa guest rooms and 60 commercial rooms to meet your traveling needs. We also provide duo and quad rooms that are spacious and fully equipped. Around the resort there are a lot of famous tourism spots such as Neimen Zizhu Temple, Fo Guang Shan Budda Memorial Center, Meinong Hakka Museum, Cishan old-street and many more, all of within ten minutes of car ride. The International Citizen Hotel Kaohsiung sits in the largest district in Kaohsiung and is one of the old brands. It has a geographical advantage; nearbyis the Kaohsiung Main Station through which you can go to Urban Spotlight Arcade, Shinkuchan, Liuohe Tourist Night Market, Hanshin Department Store, Talee Department Store, The Pier-2 Art Center, Tourist Wharf, British Consulate at Takao, Kaohsiung Film Archive, Kaohsiung Museum of History, Kaohsiung City Music Hall, Kaohsiung Museum of Fine Arts, Hanshin Arena Shopping Plaza, Ruifeng Night Market, Heart of Love River (Ruyi Lake), and the National Science and Technology Museum. Sizihwan and Cijin Island are also not far from here. You're welcome to pay a visit to these places anytime. A variety of spacious and comfortable guest rooms are equipped with a new 42" LCD TV, thermostatic refrigerator, free Wi-Fi, and broadband network, which form a quiet resting space for businessmen and visitors from any place. On a sunny morning, the elegant restaurant prepares rich and healthy Chinese and Western buffet breakfast for you using the food ingredients in season to make you become energized! International Citizen Hotel Kaohsiung has affordable prices and thoughtful waiters, and will respect and honor our guests with cordial greetings to give a warm feeling like home. It is the best choice for your business trip or vacation.

The International Citizen Hotel Kaohsiung sits in the largest district in Kaohsiung and is one of the old brands.
