On a sunny morning, the elegant restaurant prepares rich and healthy Chinese and Western buffet breakfast for you using the food ingredients in season to make you become energized! International Citizen Hotel Kaohsiung has affordable prices and thoughtful waiters, and will respect and honor our guests with cordial greetings to give a warm feeling like home. It is the best choice for your business trip or vacation.

stays.name: THE RIVERSIDE HOTEL
stays.description: Location. Located in Kaohsiung (Sanmin), The Riverside Hotel Esthetics is close to Sanfong Temple, Heart of Love River, and Kaohsiung Museum of Fine Arts. Also nearby are Kaohsiung Hakka Cultural Museum and Liouho Night Market.Hotel Features. A complimentary breakfast is served each morning. In addition to tour/ticket assistance and laundry facilities, The Riverside Hotel Esthetics features an elevator (lift). Complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access is available in public areas and a computer station is located on site. This is a smoke-free property.Guestrooms. The 61 air-conditioned guestrooms at The Riverside Hotel Esthetics include slippers and complimentary bottled water. Beds have down comforters and down blankets. Guests can use the in-room complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access. 32-inch LCD TVs are equipped with cable channels. All accommodations provide desks and phones. Bathrooms offer handheld showerheads, makeup/shaving mirrors, hair dryers, and complimentary toiletries. In addition, housekeeping is offered daily and amenities available on request include wake-up calls.The Riverside Hotel Esthetics must surely be one of your top choices.

The KMRT (Kaohsiung Main Station & Formosa Boulevard Station) is just around the corner. Our hotel is located in a convenient location which allows an easy transit by public transport to explore Kaohsiung. The most potential area for development in Kaohsiung! Ting B&B Hotel is near the romantic Love River, Kaohsiung Main Station and famous shopping paradise like Kaohsiung Main Station commercial district, Shinkuchan commercial district, Sanfong Central Street commercial district and Lio Ho Night Market. Ting B&B Hotel is situated at the intersection of Hebei 2nd Rd. and Zili Rd. The Front Station, KMRT Kaohsiung Main Station exit and bus station are not far away. You can go everywhere with various means of transport. "Love River", the famous spot for boat tour and Lio Ho Night Market, Sanfong Central Street, Shinkuchan commercial district, Nanhua commercial district and Rueifong Night Market are all our neighboring spots. Our hotel is very comfortable and convenient for either casual tour or business trip. Ting B&B Hotel offers consumers a truly affordable price and a modern accommodating environment. We also offer various package tours with corresponding tourism resources. You can appreciate the beauty of the harbor city with an economical approach! Ting B&B Hotel has a total of 50 exquisite rooms, including double rooms, business rooms and family rooms.

stays.name: YaLi B&B
stays.description: There is a Bunun style B&B near Baolai Hot Spring Area, YaLi B&B. The weather is cool all the year here, and, surrounded by mountains, it is a Xanadu for you to relax. Entering YaLi B&B, you will feel that you have arrived home. The big garden in the front courtyard, a spacious parlor and Japanese style rooms compose a warm place to live. For God's sake... The hostess always shares what she has with others. Besides the passionate people and the warm house, you can also learn to do leather carving and beadwork, visit Bunun tribal villages, visit the ecological area at night, take part in mountain training, go to hot springs, etc. YaLi enriches your trip during your stay.

stays.name: SPRING HILL HOTEL
stays.description: Located in the northern foothills of Mt. Dagang and with natural cold springs, Spring Hill Resort is an oasis from the rat race for the body, mind, and soul. Sitting on over 23,000 square meters of land, it is focused three themes: health, art, and culture. We pride ourselves on our promotion of cold-springs tourism, along with flower-filled walking trails, karaoke, a study, a children’s room, nude bathing pools,and springs cabins, . The hotel is focused on promoting a slower pace of life, and the pools, whether private ones in the rooms or large public ones, offer natural, nourishing springs bathing. In terms of dining, our Chinese-style meals use seasonal ingredients sourced from the surrounding Tainan, Alian, and Tianliao areas, prepared by our creative chefs. We also offer elegant Chinese-style set meals and Western food including handmade Italian food, along with high-quality teas, coffees, and fruit juices to help you while away a relaxing afternoon. The main dining hall can accommodate 110 people and our conference room is of the highest quality, providing all the necessities, along with snacks that can be tailored to your conference’s needs. Our 30 high-class guest rooms average around 50 square meters, and include private baths and dry/wet segregated bathroom areas, offering a perfect mix of springs bathing and spectacular scenery. Additionally, we are near well-known tourist destinations like “Moon World,” the three-century-old Chaofeng Temple, Erliao (a great place to catch the sunrise), Chaoyuan Temple, and Qishan Old Street, providing a wonderful travel experience for guests of all ages.

stays.name: International The Riverside Hotel
stays.description: Location. Conveniently near the airport, The Riverside Hotel International is in Kaohsiung (Xiaogang), close to Jing Yuan Farm.Hotel Features. Guests are served a complimentary breakfast each morning. In addition to tour/ticket assistance and laundry facilities, The Riverside Hotel International features complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access is available in public areas and a computer station is located on site. Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, an elevator (lift), and express check-in. Guests have complimentary access to a roundtrip airport shuttle (available on request). Onsite parking is complimentary. This is a smoke-free property.Guestrooms. The 98 air-conditioned guestrooms at The Riverside Hotel International include coffee/tea makers and slippers. Guests can use the in-room complimentary wireless and wired high-speed Internet access. 32-inch flat-screen TVs are equipped with cable channels. All accommodations provide desks and phones. Bathrooms offer showers, hair dryers, and complimentary toiletries. All units feature refrigerators and complimentary bottled water. Housekeeping is offered daily. Renovation of all guestrooms was completed in May 2014.

stays.name: Fish Hotel-Kaohsiung
stays.description: Fish Hotel Kaohsiung is located on Bade Road in front of the Kaohsiung Train Station, in which diversified transportations gather, and coach numbers are high concentrated. Moreover, it takes only 15 minutes to the airport and 10 minutes to the Zuoying High Speed Rail Station by car, and the MRT is also within feet, so you can easily reach any famous scenic spots in Kaohsiung, such as the World Games Plaza, the Hanshin Arena Shopping Plaza,the Juifeng Night Market, the Lotus Pond, the Chiaotou Sugar Refinery, eating lamb in Kangshan, the Yencheng District, the Cijin Ferry Pier, and the Love River. The well-known Liuhe Night Market is even within 5 minutes by walk, and so are the computer street and the mobile phone street in Kaohsiung. There are 98 guest rooms in our hotel. Various room types are available. The decoration is classic and in good taste, and all the guest rooms are quiet and clean. In addition, the emergency facilities have passed safety inspections, and our guards patrol at night for security.

stays.name: Hoyang Business Hotel
stays.description: A drifting work style is the destiny for those who graduated from the department of civil engineering and the graduate school of architecture. From Kaohsiung to Taipei, and from Taiwan to the Mainland to every corner around the world, either for work or business, with bitterness and happiness, I am a wanderer between cities, staying at different hotels at night. The silver moonlight, however, is the one thing that never changes no matter whether the streets are booming or quiet. Shone by the streetlight, those extravagantly adorned 5-star hotels provide the comfort of brand-name beds, whereas in the ordinarily equipped, confined room of business hotels, only beds of slightly insufficient length and roughness to be had. These only make me feel the lack of warmth being away from home. The pillows without my own smell arouse the homesickness deep inside of me in the depth of night. I miss home. We all have what it takes to plan, design, build and decorate a beautiful, comfortable, warm and safe house of our own. Those who travel anywhere owing to the highly developed global village without their own permanent residence want a hotel to be "like home" for their time staying there. It is with such idea that "Hoyang Business Hotel - Chu" was born in our home town, the gorgeous harbor city in southern Taiwan where the sun always shines - Kaohsiung. An inconspicuous old building on the Qixian 2nd Rd. was thus given a new life by our expertise, dedication and persistence. It is hoped, whether it is because of business, work or travel, those who are far away from home and destined to spend a night at out place will find it like home with all its comfort and relief. Come visit us! Be a part of this big family. You will find it just like moving into a new house upon your stay first time. From then on, end every time you happen to be in Kaohsiung, you will have an impulse to go back to your home at "Hoyang Business Hotel." Now that our "Hoyang Business Hotel" is open for business, we hope our dedication, business philosophy and passion touch deep down inside all of you who ever spent a night here. And you will miss your home of Kaohsiung - "Hoyang Business Hotel."

stays.name: JÒHŌ HOTEL
stays.description: JÒHŌ Hotel is located in the transportation hub of Kaohsiung City, adjacent to Kaohsiung Train Station and MRT Formosa Boulevard Station. It is a 15-story building with two basement levels for mechanical parking. The hotel features 60 guest rooms, equipped with high-definition audiovisual entertainment systems, TOTO smart toilets, and patented world-class sleeping mattresses. The room types for double occupancy and above also include separate bathtubs and wet and dry bathrooms.The hotel's dining space offers breakfast, brunch, and afternoon tea at the Lounge, with a special cocktail service during Happy Hour. The bright spaces of the rooftop garden and the panoramic fitness center allow guests to enjoy the beautiful sunset views of Kaohsiung and experience the romance of the starry night. Even if guests prefer to stay in, they can still create a wonderful accommodation experience.The hotel upholds the concept of warm hospitality from local people and emphasizes "Artisan Butler Service." Unlike the traditional one-on-one professional butler service model, the hotel provides customized services for travel itineraries, accommodations, and dining. The professional managers undergo intensive training for at least three months, aiming to convey the core spirit of the hotel: "JÒHŌ U JÒHŌ! Wishing you all the best" (JÒHŌ, a homonym in Taiwanese Hokkien, means blessings and goodness).

stays.name: Paris Hotel
stays.description: We are situated on Zihli and Datong road intersection in Xinxing District of Kaohsuing city center. Our guests, within a convenient distance, can visit Liuhe International Tourist Night Market, South Hua Xinxing Night Market, Central Park (the R9 MRT station), and Formula Boulevard R10 MRT Station in just about 5 minutes by foot. You may even stop by Wufu and Zhongshan road conjunction where there is a modern shopping district (Shinkuchan mall) and Urban Spotlight, or travel a little further to shop at luxurious Talee department store. Along the way you may also pay additional stops at Hanshin Department Store and the Glory Pier, and Love Pier to appreciate the coastal scenery. During the day, many tourists may plan a trip to ride Gushan Ferry boat and to admire tourist night harbor district. Then, you can visit Chichin Island to enjoy the delicious seafood or Sizihwan Shoushan Park visiting the British Consulate and the Martyrs’ Shrine overlooking the Kaohsiung evening streetscape and night scenes.

stays.name: Chateau de Chine Hotel Kaohsiung
stays.description: Chateau de Chine (Kaohsiung) is an international-class business hotel built by L’Hotel de Chine Hotel Group, Taiwan’s first franchise hotel brand. Located in Yancheng District near the Love River, Pier 2 Art center, Kaohsiung Museum of History, and Kaohsiung Film Archive, and a 2-3 minute walk from from Yanchengpu MRT Station Exit 2 , it is situated downtown with convenient transportation, including the Taiwan high speed rail Zuoying Station, Kaohsiung International Airport, train station, and highway entrance. The new opening of the hotel gathered together several top-class designers who contributed their own creativity, styles, and skills toward construction of the building, common areas, and guest rooms. 152 brand-new fashionable and exquisite rooms and suites feature two distinct styles, modern urban fashion and aristocratic class. We provide a variety of fine foods, with the highly popular Cantonese Tea House on the third floor being famous for its dim sum. The Pin Japanese cuisine restaurant on the first floor offers sushi, sukiyaki, and shabu-shabu, the 2nd floor VIP wing a variety of exquisite Chinese cuisine, and the 7th floor VIP Lounge a variety of deserts and beverages, providing you with a comfortable resting place during your journey. Additional facilities include a fully functional business center, variety of fine foods, and impressive conference room for all your business, tourism, and accommodation needs.

stays.name: City Suites - Kaohsiung Chenai
stays.description: Following the successful launches of its Taipei Nansi, Taipei Nandong, and Taoyuan Airport branches, the HPW Group proudly presents another landmark property in Yancheng District, Kaohsiung — City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai.Designed with ocean-inspired elements as its core theme, the hotel embraces a modern, minimalist, and elegantly stylish aesthetic. It offers travelers a chance to rediscover the simple beauty of everyday life while experiencing the refined comfort of minimalist living.At City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai, guests can admire the striking modern city skyline or gaze across the harbor to witness the awe-inspiring sight of massive ships arriving at port. With exceptional views that transform from day to night, the hotel delivers a truly distinctive accommodation experience in the heart of the harbor city.The hotel features a total of 8 floors and 298 premium guest rooms, each offering approximately 33 square meters of comfortable space. With a design that is understated yet luxurious, guests are treated to panoramic views of sea and mountains — from ocean liners cruising across the water, to sunrise and sunset over the hills, to serene cityscapes. Every view unfolds at a glance.City Suites Kaohsiung Chenai adds a touch of art and style to every stay, offering both leisure travelers and business guests a fashionable yet warm and personable hospitality experience.The hotel’s wave-inspired exterior façade highlights the mystery and depth of the sea, while vibrant colors express the joy of living. From the bright and unpretentious lobby, to the relaxed and spacious lounge areas, and the softly lit, tranquil guestroom corridors, every detail reflects a balance of understated elegance and comfort.

stays.description: Fullon Hotel (Kaohsiung) is located in Yancheng District, at Wǔfú 4th Rd and Dacheng Street, and has an excellent geographical environment and convenient transportation. Near famous attractions Love River, the hotel, positioned as an international tourist hotel, offers 250 rooms, and its facilities include a swimming pool, a sauna, a gym. Provides also wireless Internet access available for whole hotel, a very considerate plan; specifically designed premier floors for high-end consumers with luxurious style of comfort, allowing for an elevated view of the cityscape, which is the exclusive personal attraction. Sipping a glass of red wine, the hustle and bustle world instantly falls away, ends a busy day in satisfaction. Nearby Attraction Diversities: Gurgling clean flows of Love River is worth spending leisure time; Peace Park with elegant atmosphere attracts wedding couples to take pictures; Ruyi Bridge romantically glowing in the night; Love Pier& #39;s twin sails stand opposite to Kaohsiung District and Cijin (Qijin) ferry terminal, respectively. Arriving Fullon, you can enjoy Kaohsiung& #39;s urban style of modern skyscrapers, or overlook and experience the shock of huge ships entering Port of Kaohsiung, during the day or the night, each with a different style.

stays.name: Go Home
stays.description: GO HOME is a townhouse located just a 3-minute walk from Yanchengpu MRT Station Exit 1. It& #39;s also a 3-minute walk to the light rail and the Pier-2 Art Center, making it an ideal spot for a leisurely 2-day or 3-day trip.We are situated in the convenient location of Yancheng District, where there are many delicious snacks, desserts, and exotic creative cuisines worth exploring. The manager will provide a local food guide list for your reference.The interior of the guesthouse features an ocean theme, with 3D mural paintings by artists on the walls, giving each angle a different feel. Combined with European-style Greek white architecture, each floor has its unique style and murals.Additionally, we have installed a whole-house soft water filtration system, allowing guests to bathe without the irritation of chlorine, which can cause skin issues. This ensures a relaxing and comfortable stay, offering a unique travel experience.Breakfast is personally prepared by the housekeeper MELODY with love, and if you stay for more than two days, the breakfast will be different each day, giving you a homey feeling. Welcome home! ^0^

stays.name: Holiday Inn Express Kaohsiung Love River
stays.description: Kaohsiung, a harbor city. It is full of sunshine all year round and the weather is delightful. Along the love river, rich historic culture and the enthusiasm of people make the city genuine and vigorous. Hotel is located in Yancheng district adjacent to the famous tourist attractions with easily accessible location. Able to reach metro in 3 minutes on foot and to arrive railway station in 10 minutes by car. Only 10 kilometres to Kaohsiung International airport or Zuoying highspeed railway station. Easy to travel over the city and to experience the local. In walking distance, the love river side and Peir 2 Art Centre are must go of visiting Kaohsiung. In 10 minutes by car, hot destination as Liuhe Night Market, Siziwan and Cijin scenic area could be easily approached. In 15 minutes by car, there are central business district and major industry park, Kaohsiung Software Park, export processing zone and port zone. European style exterior and high ceiling lobby provides a relaxing and comfortable space for all traveller. Simple, trendy and spacious guest room comprises smart design concept and the awesome view. On the high floor, the evening harbor view. In the morning, complimentary Express Buffet Breakfast includes various Western and Eastern choices. Chic style and fully equipped smart space provides multifunction travel solution. Highspeed Wi-Fi covers everywhere in hotel. To make a simple, smart and comfortable accommodation experience.

stays.name: Love River Riyang
stays.description: Welcome to Love River Inn!We are located in the prime area of Yancheng District, Kaohsiung, right by the Love River. It takes only one minute on foot to reach the riverbank, and within a 10-minute walk you can reach the MRT Orange Line Yanchengpu Station, the Kaohsiung Museum of History, and the romantic Love Boat cruise on the Love River.Love River Inn is your best starting point to explore Kaohsiung’s most popular attractions: the bustling Pier-2 Art Center, True Love Pier, the historic Yancheng Old Street, the lively Liuhe Night Market, the breathtaking sunset at Sizihwan, the perfect day-trip destination Cijin, Shoushan National Nature Park, and the largest zoo in southern Taiwan, Shoushan Zoo—the list goes on.We are also right next to Kaohsiung& #39;s popular walking and cycling routes. You can stroll or bike along the Love River, heading north to the Heart of Love River or south to Glory Pier, all while enjoying the waterfront city& #39;s pleasant scenery and sunsets.Love River Inn offers convenient self check-in. Each guest room is uniquely decorated, with a private bathroom and free high-speed unlimited Wi-Fi. Many of our bathtub rooms feature spacious Japanese-style stone baths—perfect for a soothing soak to relax both body and mind. Selected rooms are equipped with smart TVs with YouTube and Netflix for free viewing, allowing you to stay connected with the world at any time. Whether for leisure or business, we& #39;ve got you covered. Guests may also enjoy our complimentary self-service bar with coffee, tea, hot cocoa, snacks, and cereals, available 24 hours a day.We also provide family rooms and group accommodations. Groups of 12 to 18 people can book an entire floor with private access—ideal for family trips, reunions, or friends traveling together.Love River Inn is a fully non-smoking, legally registered hotel (Kaohsiung City Hotel License No. 532), ensuring safety and comfort for all our guests.Whether you& #39;re here for a delightful holiday or a well-deserved break from work, let us create a unique and comfortable stay for you. Book now and begin your journey of relaxation!

stays.name: A Touch of Zen Guest House
stays.description: A Touch of Zen offers travelers a rare opportunity to spend a night in the former home of a navy admiral built during the Japanese colonial era and restored to reflect design and decor of that period. We are located near the Zuoying HSR station and the Lotus Pond, and walking distance from the Kaohsiung National Stadium (aka World Games Stadium). The decor has a Taiwanese movie theme. We have 3 guest rooms - an old fashioned tatami room for 2-3 people, The writer's room - a creative single room, and a 4-person mixed backpackers' cabin bunk dorm, which can be rented as a whole room or by the individual bunk. Larger families or groups may rent out our entire guest wing with all 3 rooms, sleeping up to 9 people. There is a shared kitchen available. We sometimes host concerts and other special events in our large lounge bar. Bicycles are available for guests to rent at low daily rates. More info at https://www.facebook.com/atouchofzenguesthouse/

stays.name: HUA-XIANG
stays.description: Hua-xiang Business Hotel is located in the most bustling shopping area in Zuo-ying District, Kaohsiung. Within one minute’s walkfrom the hotel to the shopping area. It is conveniently situated only 15 minutes by car from the Zuo-ying High Speed Rail Station. Many old brand restaurants cluster there selling scrumptious delicacies such as Nan-chang buns,Zheng-kou-wei(true taste) roast duck, Rong-yuan pie & porridge, Jin-hua pastries , Shanghai Zui-ji(chicken cooked in wine) , Liu’s preserved vegetables with pork pot, San-Niu (three- cattle)beef noodles. The renowned “Rui-feng Night Market” is only 15 minutes’ driving distance from the hotel. The market is the largest, most well-managed quality night market in Kaohsiung with more than 1000 booths, selling countless types of thing. Delicious and inexpensive snacks give each visitor unforgettable mouth-watering experience that attracts frequent reporters for interviews. A ten minutes’ walk from the hotel can bring you to the shopping area of Lian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）where Kaohsiung Zuo-ying Wan-nian Folklore Festivalis held annually . The festival, originally a local temple celebration in Zuo-ying, under vigorous promotion by local people, cultural workers, religious and Kaohsiung City Government in recent years, has evolved into the equally most representative activity in Kaohsiung City with the Kaohsiung Lantern Festival. Nearby attractions such as the Confucius temple, Chi Ming palace, Spring and Autumn Pavilions, Wu-li Pavilion, Dragon and Tiger Pagodas, and a host of specialty snacks eateries there have all fueled the city with excitement and created a famous temple tourist spot.The hazy dawns and evenings atLian-chih-tan（Lotus Pond）unveils a mysteriously charm beyond description that one must not miss out !

stays.name: Keep A Little Light Art Hostel
stays.description: Keep a Little Light Art Hostel is a hostel located in a former military dependents’ village in Kaohsiung City.Leaving a small light on represents the warmth of home—so that when family members return after a long day, they know this home has always been waiting for them.It also symbolizes the anticipation and hope that the families of naval servicemen once held for their loved ones’ safe return.Here, everything can move a little slower. You can relax as if you were at home, enjoying the nostalgic charm and tranquil life of the old villages, away from the hustle and bustle of the city.This is a military dependents’ village—a place where the families of servicemen once lived. After demolition and reconstruction, the remaining villages have become part of Taiwan’s valuable cultural heritage.It is an ideal place for friends to gather, for family retreats, wedding celebrations, or simply as a quiet stop during your travels. At the same time, it serves as an art studio and a peaceful space for rest and reflection—an oasis in the heart of the city.Its unpretentious, vintage atmosphere is built upon the wisdom of the past and the humility of carrying on tradition for the future. With gratitude, care, and dedication, we have restored No. 23 to bring its historical beauty back to life.

stays.description: KEELUNG BNB Located on a 50-meter-high plateau at Huzishan in Zhongshan District, Keelung B&B sits on the west bank of Keelung Harbor, facing east towards the sea. The floor-to-ceiling windows and balcony on the fourth floor offer breathtaking views of Keelung Harbor at sunrise, nighttime illuminations, and the magnificent panoramic mountain, sea, and harbor views during the day.On clear mornings, guests enjoy about half an hour of sunrise sunlight, witnessing the changing colors of the mountains, sea, harbor, and cityscape. During the day, the sky is ever-changing with the clouds, and on rainy days, one may even witness colorful clouds after the rain. The scenery of the mountains, sea, and harbor is ever-changing on clear days, while the night view brings tranquility.Notes: Guests are requested to maintain a quiet environment in the B&B.1. stays.name: Spangle Inn
stays.description: "We have always aimed to create accommodations that foster creativity and provide a canvas for travelers to capture their memories. Thus, Lin Island Hostel was born out of this vision. Our goal goes beyond offering a great lodging experience; we aspire to be a catalyst for transformation in this community. To achieve this, we have forged a deep collaboration with the local art group, 'Starry Haman Port Town Art Co-Creation.'The ground floor of our hostel serves as their studio and exhibition space, fostering a continuous flow of creativity. Additionally, we provide our guests with a cozy shared kitchen and a rooftop observation deck for their utmost comfort. We don't just want visitors to admire the scenery and take photos; we want them to fully immerse themselves in the ambiance of art and the fishing port.This is Spangle Inn, a place where you can truly embrace and enjoy life."

stays.name: Chen Jiayuanli
stays.description: Chenjiayuanli is located in the Shuitou settlement of Kinmen. It is a B&B renovated from a traditional Fujian-style double-roofed ancient house. On the basis of retaining the charm of the old house, it not only meets the modern living functions, but also injects a reinterpretation of the feelings of the old era.Abandon excessive decoration and materials, follow its shape and speak its own language, revealing the simplicity and authenticity that an old house should have.From the painted murals, Cochin pottery to the aged old bricks, the beauty of southern Fujian architecture is conveyed; by sorting out past letters, land deeds, utensils and other old objects and placing them in the space, they tell the story of the past.We believe that travel is more than just a night's rest, but more about interaction with people, time, and space. Although accommodation is only a small part of the journey, it is a place to replenish energy and carry beautiful dreams.Let us brew a pot of old tea and share the story of Chenjiayuan with you

stays.name: Dafudi Homestay
stays.description: The building compound is located outside Dashe, Zhushan, and is a traditional-style structure with an impressive layout. The outside is covered with six-sided bricks, an example of rare Kinmen craftsmanship. As our B&B is one of the few to be housed in an officially designated historical building, a trip to come appreciate its beauty is well worth it.Follow the little road by the Zhushan shooting range and it leads to the traditional-style Taiwanese building compound in what seems like another-worldly paradise. Inside is an ornate gate created by expert craftsman, a spacious central courtyard, rosewood, and old-fashioned wood chairs. The bedrooms contain valuable antique carved beds, dressing tables and modern ceramic bathroom facilities, plasma TVs thoughtfully incorporated into wall decoration, classic romantic bed curtains, bedding, and wireless Internet. The experience is a beautiful, uplifting blend of the antique and modern.Flowers grow in a large traditional water jar, increasing the natural beauty and representing the spirit of Kinmen. Inside the building are antiques used in early times, such as stone beads, stone mills, and chicken bowls. There is a moving tale behind each of these items, and we welcome you to witness for yourself the evidence of our ancestors’ wisdom and efforts, hoping this becomes a place to relax your body and soul. Welcome to Zhushan No. 41 Bed & Breakfast, where you can take a break to appreciate the beauty of this old building. We hope each visitor is a precious contribution to the development of Kinmen.

stays.name: GRACE HOMESTAY 35
stays.description: New Shui Diao Ge Tou B&B Traditional-Style Taiwanese Building is a large traditional residence featuring a traditional layout, “11 Support” style structure with 11 pillars, and front and rear sections connected on the left and right sides. It was built by Huang Sunzhang around the turn of the 20th century. The Kinmen National Parks of Taiwan had the land rights for 30 years and renovated the building before turning it over to be privately operated as a B&B. New Shui Diao Ge Tou Bed & Breakfast took its name from a famous poem by Su Dongpo as well as its location by the water. It has 7 rooms; 4 of the rooms have upper attics and can accommodate 2-4 people, while the 3 rooms on the right side are doubles which can accommodate 14-22 people. The overall design combines traditional building features with bright, clean modern suite rooms, making this a warm, comfortable B&B. Here you can experience the wisdom and charming layout of Kinmen’s old buildings, as well as a sense of spiritual fulfillment. These old buildings have a long and colorful history; the weathered stone slabs have stood firm against the test of time and the mottled red bricks and tiles still shine after a long rain. Life is to be celebrated and cherished! Share a moment of peace and quiet with family and friends, and hold it as a beautiful, lasting memory – this is the sublime power of our traditional-style B&B. Welcome to Shuitou No. 35 Bed & Breakfast! Location: Shang Yi Airport – Zhong Yang Road – left at Jin Cheng Roundabout – right at Bei Ti Road – left at Wu Jiang Bridge – go straight till Shuitou Community – go straight at the Kaoliang Liquor Mark (behind the Deyue Tower), and we are on the left, after about 12 minutes. No. 6 or No. 7 bus from Jin Cheng Station, get off at Shuitou Roundabout.

A 7.5 meter courtyard is located outside the entrance, and nearby are a group of Deyue Tower old Western-style buildings, Jinshui Elementary School, Shuitou 18 Beams, and Huang Family Youtang Garden, a second-grade historical site, making this a hub of tourist attractions. Here you can experience the wisdom and charming layout of Kinmen’s old buildings, and feel a sense of spiritual fulfillment. stays.name: Live Guesthouse
stays.description: Kinmen｜Live GuesthouseEasy listening every day at Kinmen Live GuesthouseAfter a flight across a stretch of ocean, you follow your map into the alleys and laneways of Kinmen. In contrast to the other large settlements in Kinmen, Oucuo Village is a simple, tranquil place, allowing you the time and space for romantic wandering. Turning down that unassuming little road, the sea breeze carries the sound of a guitar to your ear. Lively and spontaneous, the melody carries you into the daily life at Live Guesthouse.Blank space for your imagination to unfoldLow walls constructed of irregularly sized bricks with old, darkly colored wooden doors open inwards to a courtyard decorated with a few large potted trees. The faded paint of the old wooden chairs create a pleasant vacation atmosphere. The main hall connected to the courtyard serves as a common living room for travelling guests. The simple furnishings add luster to the old building. An artistic painting and two acoustic guitars hung high on the walls speak about the daily lives of the hosts. The afternoon sun slants into the enclosed courtyard of this traditional Minnan house, while clothing hung high in the breeze to dry sways as if to the rhythm of the Live Guesthouse beat. “Why not come this way, your room is over here.” The male half of your couple of hosts, Xu-Ran, is from Beijing. With his special accent and style of speaking, he leads you inside with a smile. Live Guesthouse has one double room, and two loft-style four-person rooms. The small room is perfect for visiting with a friend or to enjoy the the freedom of travelling alone. The interior paint appears new and original - a large swath of white wall intersected by a stripe of aquamarine creates just the right contrast with the other red brick floor, creating an atmosphere of harmony and vitality. In your room, there is a poem in simplified Chinese, and a different poem, expressing the emotions of Chinese poets, has been left in each room, corresponding with the customs and style of Kinmen. The charm implicit in the poem’s simplicity corresponds precisely to the impression that hosts Xu-Ran and Wang-Ling leave you with.A guitar’s melody like a slow, dreamy eveningLive Guesthouse invites you to arrive without a plan. Wang-Ling and her older sister established “Local Methodology”, providing an ideal opportunity for exploration. Even a short conversation with Wang-Ling opens the cultural landscape of Kinmen up before you. Even though she has married, she chooses to remain in Kinmen to follow her dreams. Fortunately, her husband Xu-Ran also prefers the pace of Kinmen to the big city of Beijing. As such, he was willing to pack a bag, grab his guitar and follow his wife back to Kinmen to put down roots. Some afternoon, you may also get the chance to explore Xu-Ran’s secret music collection with him. He is himself a guitarist who performs in the band Momo Sky, and has insisted that each room be equipped with a CD player so that he can share his collection with travelers. Perusing the lyrics in the CD booklet, you feel a warmth lacking in today’s online music world. It matches beautifully with the slow rhythm of life in Kinmen.Other than compact disk music, if you are lucky, you may get to see a live performance, acoustic guitar music lingering in the courtyard. Xu-Ran’s focused and easy music merges into the old courtyard home. You might take a book and sit quietly on the sofa, or grab another guitar and play in harmony. In this sunset composition, you smile as you strum one final chord and the sound echoes leisurely into the night and into your dreams. Stroll along the beach and explore Kinmen daily cultureEarly in the morning, before the town has really woken up, the music from the night before still echoes in your ears. Your step is particularly light after a sound night’s sleep, you carry the light snacks prepared by Live Guesthouse down towards the beach. Less than ten minutes from the guesthouse, you can see Oucuo Beach, where people, searching the island for traces of war, come to marvel at the scenery a tank stranded in the sand. You slip out of your shoes and step onto the fine, white sand, the slow sound of the Kinmen wind resembling the resonance of plucked guitar strings. The calm surface of the ocean is just like a poem - perhaps, if you slow down and simplify your life, you can truly appreciate the moment in which you live!

stays.description: The B&B is located in Jincheng Township, the most prosperous area of Kinmen. Jincheng Bus Station is just behind the B&B. The tourists can buy a One-Day Pass at the Station to take the bus tour and borrow the bicycles without payment from the Station. The tourist spots Mofan Street and Kinmen Military Headquarters are just next to the B&B, and that is the reason why the B&B is called "Mofanno Jia Homestay" ("mofan" means "Model" in Chinese). The B&B is an historical house and contains three rooms. We welcome the group or a family to rent the whole B&B for your convenience.

stays.name: Piano Piano B&B
stays.description: The ancient houses in Kinmen are like pieces of art work, fused with western architectural esthetics and eastern classical flavor, which have been left behind by time. The buildings themselves seem to breathe a life of their own, telling their own tales to the people that walk into their doors. With a leisurely stroll, a traveler can be transported back to another time in history. If one is lucky enough to stay at one of these houses for a longer period of time; then they can really enjoy the LOHAS and romantic lifestyle. All of these reasons led me to name my B&B, Piano Piano.Piano Piano B&B is a renovated ancient house in Kinmen National Park. It is located just at the entrance of the village with its distinctive outer walls. Within the walls lies a renovated southern Fujian styled house. The house has history that dates back to the Ming dynasty. Under the clear, blue sky, we gave the old house a new face: with sunflower yellow as the color for the public areas and Tuscany orange in the bedrooms. The atmosphere is a mixture of the old house''s antiquity, south Pacific casualness, and the passion of southern Europe. It is a reflection of the house''s history with cultural clashes, which is also my preferred style of mixing and matching.

stays.name: Piano Piano B&B
stays.description: Manman Classic Hall is a traditional Fujian-style double-fall house. The front stone masonry is in a special hexagonal shape. The roof trusses are made of fir. Red bricks are not used much. The dragon-protecting kitchen has windows made of red bricks. You can see the outside from the inside. You can't see the inside from the outside; the layout includes two front and back halls, an atrium, a dragon-protecting courtyard and four guest rooms, two of which are large attic rooms, suitable for family accommodation. Under the elegant appearance of an ancient house in southern Fujian, each room is equipped with an LCD TV. The bathroom space is equipped with modern equipment and a flush toilet. The quality of bath towels and towels is comparable to that of a five-star hotel, allowing tourists to experience the nostalgic style of an ancient house. In addition, you can also enjoy the convenience and quality of modern life. At night, sit in the atrium, enjoy the cool air, chat, and look up at the stars and moon. The aesthetics and wisdom of these ancient architectural designs are best lived in so that you can slowly appreciate the classical and elegant beauty of life.

stays.name: Shun ten Homestay
stays.description: Shuntian Inn, located at No. 60, Ou Cuo, Kinmen, is a traditional-style Taiwanese building constructed around the turn of the 20th century, although it was not completed until 1923. A century of time and weather did little to detract from its former glory, and it was renovated in 2011 by Kinmen National Park as a specialty Bed & Breakfast. Ouyang Ziyong, the current owner, is a retired Navy officer. His parents formerly operated Shuntian Company, a fond memory for soldiers stationed by the seaside, and each year old veterans return to revisit the area. The name “Shuntian Inn” was chosen not only in memory of its origins, but also to express Ouyang’s desire to follow in his parents’ footsteps, pleasing and satisfying customers.

stays.searchText: Shun ten Homestay 順天旅店 金門縣民宿120號 Kinmen County Jincheng Township No.60, Oucuo, Jincheng Township, Kinmen County 893, Taiwan (R.O.C.) Shuntian Inn, located at No. 60, Ou Cuo, Kinmen, is a traditional-style Taiwanese building constructed around the turn of the 20th century, although it was not completed until 1923. A century of time and weather did little to detract from its former glory, and it was renovated in 2011 by Kinmen National Park as a specialty Bed & Breakfast. Ouyang Ziyong, the current owner, is a retired Navy officer. His parents formerly operated Shuntian Company, a fond memory for soldiers stationed by the seaside, and each year old veterans return to revisit the area. The name “Shuntian Inn” was chosen not only in memory of its origins, but also to express Ouyang’s desire to follow in his parents’ footsteps, pleasing and satisfying customers.

stays.name: Slowly Bungalows - Hearing Hall
stays.description: Piano Piano B&B III to the Wind Pavilion belongs to the refreshing sketches in the slow man B&B series. It is located at the foothills of the Zhushan settlement, in front of the left front of the Zhushan Xue's Ancestral Hall, and walks up the small steps beside the lush green trees. It is the Shuangluo big house and the southern Fujian style building with Zuohulong that has been renovated by the national park. There are two front and rear halls, an atrium, a dragon-protecting courtyard and five rooms in the Slow Man Tingfeng Pavilion. Each room is equipped with an LCD TV. The bathroom space is equipped with modern equipment and toilets. Bath towels are comparable to five-star hotels. The texture allows passengers to enjoy the convenience and quality of modern life in addition to experiencing the nostalgic style of the ancient house. When the night is cool, three or five friends and family members are most suitable for gathering in the atrium of this very exclusive Fujian-style building, enjoying tea and chatting with the starry sky, listening to the breeze singing slowly; Wake up from the sound and start a journey of listening to the wind that belongs to you.

stays.name: Talking about the ancient times and talking about the ancient house
stays.description: Shuitou was formerly known as Jinshui. As the name implies, Shuitou is located near the water. An old saying claims that this is a prosperous area and speaks to the value of its buildings. One of them, Huang Qi, was constructed around the year 1700, being a traditional-style building featuring an elegant exterior and construction materials including stone, brick, wood frame and beams, Taiwanese tile roof, wood doors and windows, and stone mullion windows. The bright and fully functional building includes rooms with bathrooms so visitors can enjoy their own private space, in addition to a uniquely-styled kitchen, front and rear courtyard, and passageway. Spacious living room helps visitors feel comfortable and satisfied, and in the evening they may put their spirits at ease viewing Kinmen’s starry night from the courtyard. This is a special B&B, and we welcome you to be a part of it.

stays.name: Bojue Homestay
stays.description: Formerly known as Wuzhou, Xianzhou, Wujiang, or Wu Island, Kinmen received its current name during the Ming dynasty, when one of the nobles built a city here. The name Kinmen, which means “Golden Door,” was derived from the island’s strategic location between Taiwan and mainland China. Surrounded by the sea, and it features rich cultural assets including old Taiwanese and Western buildings. The battle of Gu Ning Tou and 823 Artillery Bombardment left behind a wealth of war and military relics, the area has long been closed off and shrouded in mystery, and the well-preserved natural ecology is home to unique birds, making Kinmen a unique tourist destination. It gives off an impression of being a very foreign place with interesting military features, with a deeply friendly atmosphere even though separated from Taiwan only by a narrow strip of water. Don’t rely on your imagination, take a break and go on a backpack trip to Kinmen, where you can experience the culture and atmosphere firsthand. Feel its unrestrained passion. Let’s unveil this mystery together. We welcome you to Nobility Bed & Breakfast, a Baroque-style building backing the mountains and facing the sea, in a beautiful environment, equipped with a garden recreation deck and BBQ area.

stays.name: Dream of sharing homestay
stays.description: "Dream of Sharing Homestay" is based on a standalone European building in Jinhu and shows magnificence and quality. It sits at the side of Taihu Scenic Area and provides easy access to Jinhu Junior High School, Jinhu Elementary School, National Kinmen Agricultural and Industrial Vocational Senior High School, Kinmen Hospital, Bureau of Health, Shanwai Bus Station, Downtown, Liaoluo Bay, Banyan Park, August 23 Artillery Battle Museum, Kinmen Forest Recreation Area, and other well-known destinations. "Dream of Sharing" is a place to approach nature: hear the chirping in the morning and watching the moon in the night breeze. The pristine beach is a good place for an afternoon walk, stress relief and recollection, undisturbed by the busy life. "Dream of Sharing" has several kinds of rooms available, and unlike the magnificent exterior design, the rooms have an atmosphere like your own house with well-lit rooms, Chinese-style furniture and European-style balcony. What's more, the modest nature of Kinmen impregnates the whole building and you'll definitely appreciate it.

stays.name: Golden Gate Royal Villa
stays.description: Looking at the map of Kinmen, Kinmen looks like a bone, and the B&B is located just above the middle of the bone in the "Hengcuo" Village. This is the fastest way for people who don't know Kinmen to find this B&B, and it is also the most impressive. Hengshan Laoye Villa is located in the natural village of Hengcuo, just in the middle of Qionglin and Housha. It is particularly located in a moderate location and has convenient transportation. It is about seven kilometers away from the city centers of Jincheng, Shanwai and Shamei, about four kilometers from Shangyi Airport, and about 12 kilometers from Shuitou Pier. It takes more than ten minutes to walk to the adjacent Qionglin Underground Tunnel Scenic Area. "Qionglin Settlement" is one of the representatives of Kinmen's traditional settlements. It retains a large number of traditional Minnan buildings with swallow-tailed horses on back. In addition, the ancestral temples are the largest and most distinctive. In addition to the "Cai Family Temple" of the main ancestral family, each house also has its own ancestral hall. Two of them are in the same three-story building, so they are known as the "Seven Eight Ancestral Halls". Someone once used Tao Yuanming's "Peach Blossom Spring" to describe the village of "Hengcuo". Therefore, the village is located in a basin surrounded by trees. So when you enter from the path, you will be very confused. But after walking a few dozen steps, you will see a stream and a large lawn. There are small fish playing in the stream and turtles bathing in the sun. The teal ducks and water birds are swimming leisurely in the river and looking for food. You can also watch birds walking or foraging on the lawn, as if they are not afraid of people approaching. Then you will see several houses located in this basin, and the Hengshan Laoye Villa is one of them. Especially due to its superior geographical location, natural environment and lack of excessive man-made development, it upholds the concept of symbiosis between man and the environment, creating this village like a paradise. Therefore, you can see many birds coming to live in this building, and you can also see otters, Kinmen's protected animals, here. The creek in front of the B&B is connected to the sea. You can walk 400 meters along the village path. The first thing you see is a small intertidal zone. In the intertidal zone, you can see cute mudskippers bouncing in the water. Fiddler crabs are constantly shuttling in the caves. Groups of small crabs will dig in the sand in a spiral shape when people get close. Of course, there are many unknown creatures living in this intertidal zone. Walk dozens of steps along this intertidal zone to see the beautiful, deep and boundless sea. If you encounter a recession, When the tide is high, you can dig clams in this large intertidal zone and enjoy the fun. When the tide is high, you can sit on the shore and listen to the sound of the waves, which can calm your mind, or you can take off your shoes and socks to play with the waves.

stays.name: Lou Zai Xia Homestay
stays.description: The Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast was planned and renovated by Kinmen National Park and operated by the Cai sisters from Qiong Lin Community. Three sisters manage No. 79, 92, and 105. The B&B includes 12suites accomodating up to 34 people. Groups and individuals welcome. Facilities include a BBQ grill and ingredients. After spending a day around the island, travelers can come back and barbecue, sip tea, or chat with friends under a starry night. Enjoy the serenity and a break from the stress and bustle of the city. As an environmentally-friendly B&B, Lou Zi Xia Traditional-Style Taiwanese Bed & Breakfast complies with the Kinmen Low-Carbon Program by not automatically providing disposable toiletries or changing bedding and towels for guests staying more than one night. Qiong Lin Community is located in the center of the island, and is one of its representative communities. The original name for this area, “Pinglin,” came from the forests that used to grow nearby. It has been frequented by famous people since the Ming dynasty, when one of the emperors bestowed an honorary inscribed board from which the current name, “Qiong Lin,” is derived. A number of traditional-style Taiwanese buildings, simple and elegant, with natural charm, have been preserved here. The largest of these is the ancestral temple. During times of war, tunnels were dug around the island and it had a heavy military atmosphere; now it is open to the public. Qiong Lin was home to a number of successful scholars during the Ming and Qing dynasties, and therefore a number of ornate official residences can still be viewed here. The ancestral temples are full of inscribed boards celebrating the scholars’ achievements, and in addition to the main Cai Family Temple, several more representing the branches of the family can be found in Qiong Lin. One building houses two of these temples. Each of the temples provides interesting sights, and along with Yi Gu Tang and two of Feng Shi Ye (Wind Lion Gods) have been designated second-grade historical sites.

stays.name: Shang Her Yuan B&B
stays.description: Shangheyuan B&B in Kinmen was opened in July 2012. It's located in a quiet and clean village surrounded by trees, and has many European style architectures. The nearby attractions include Taihu Scenic Area, Ficus Park, Weilu Historic House, Chung Cheng Park (Zhong Zheng Park), 823 War Museum, Father Luo (Bernard M. Druetto) Memorial Park, Chen Ching-lan House, Yu Da-wei Memorial Hall, State Guest House and Haiyin Temple. Shuangheyuan overlooks Mt. Taiwu and the vast Taihu Lake, which covers 36 hectare. There are three islands - Tongxin, Guangfu, Huaxia - in the middle of the lake, and each has a pavilion. The name "Shangheyuan" implies "A great piece of land". The warm and friendly owner selects all the equipment and supplies used in the B&B as if he was the guest using the items. He chose the name "Shangheyuan" because he wished to provide a warm and comfortable space where visitors traveling to Kinmen can enjoy with their friends and family. The area surrounding the B&B is quiet and clean while the space inside is comfortable and spacious. The natural wooden furnitures made of yellow rosewood, camphor and cinnamomum cassia emit a faint fragrance of pure wood. We welcome you to stay at Shangheyuan to experience high quality living.

stays.name: golden lake hotel
stays.description: The Golden Lake Hotel is the first international five-star hotel in Kinmen, with 276 guest suites (including the lake view Presidential Suite).Situated in Jinhu Township, our rooms were designed to be spacious and comfortable while incorporating local cultural characteristics.Rooms range in size from 13-60 ping (43-198 square meters) to suit the desires and preferences of each of our guests. On-site facilities and dining options include a Chinese restaurant, Western-style buffet, lobby bar, banquet hall, conference rooms, business center, boutique, VIP room, gym, sauna, and swimming pool.Our hotel is also located next to the largest duty-free shop in Asia, the 9,000 ping (29,752 square meters) Golden Lake Plaza, where visitors may satisfy all their shopping desires in a single stop.hopes to offer a completely different choice to those travelling to Kinmen and to stimulate sightseeing amongst Kinmen, Xiamen, and Taiwan.We hope to attract more overseas visitors to these areas, and invite you to experience Kinmen’s diverse cultural customs, take in the remnants of a tumultuous past, and learn more about the locals and their way of life.

stays.name: Nanshan No. 85 Guest House
stays.description: Kinmen｜Kinba GuesthouseLittle Pug leads the way through the creative revitalization of an old houseAs you descended from the airplane, the bright sunshine of Kinmen embraces you. Follow the winding alleys around old water wells and past ancient homesteads as you discover the daily happenings of this island. All of a sudden, an adorable and mischievous pug bumps into you, leading you to your final destination. As if breaking free from the heavy wartime history of the area, Kinba guesthouse is radiant with liveliness.Each brick, each tile endowed with skillful designKinba is an amalgamation of historical buildings number 85 and 80. Inside the compact structure of number 85, the cute household pooch, Little Pug, passionately rushes forward in greeting and guides you down the hallway laid with red tiles. At the patio, the old-style water well, ingeniously surrounded with cylindrical bamboo tubes, creates a quaint scene. Green bonsai plants line stone shelves in mimicry of a Japanese courtyard, granting a pleasant vitality to the heavy dignity of this historical home. You spend a leisurely afternoon sitting on the threshold with Little Pug, soaking up the sunshine, chatting, leafing through a book. This is the simple life.Drawing open the doors of the main hall, you find the place where the travelers who come to Kinba rest. The hostess, Maruko, has decorated the space in her favorite Japanese style, with simple wooden furnishings that bring warmth to the reserved atmosphere of the house. The spacious double room is ideal for a couple to spend some sweet time together. If you come with friends, the Japanese-style rooms in the wings adjacent the main structure are your best choice. Whether sitting and chatting freely on the living room tatami mats or lying down for a heart-to-heart chat on the soft-cushion couches, Kinba brings you an idyllic lifestyle.When light industry meets historical homeFollowing Little Pug’s playful down the path, you turn progress a corner to find historical home number 80. Emitting the fragrance of Chinese fir, this structure is still magnificent despite the long years it has endured. With his own skillful hands, Little Kang has harmoniously infused number 80 with the style of light industry. When you enter the main hall, the rich colors of the decor mingle with the terracotta of the brick, and the bright-yellow sofa and handsome chandelier display youthful vitality. The old leather case and sewing table personally refurbished by Little Kang revive the past in in this place, where old and new perfectly intersect.With the sun setting in the west, a cool and gentle breeze blows through the open courtyard, and a characteristic Kinmen night prepares to unfold. You gather with your friends as the crystal-clear Koaliang, signature of Kinmen, is poured generously into small glass cups. You mix a special Kinmen cocktail of Koaliang and beer, and it’s bottoms up! Allow the cool, carefree flavor to wash away your worries. Deep in the night, you reluctantly climb the ladder into the loft where what was once a storage space has been transformed into cozy sleeping quarters. Sunset Sea B&B is quite convenient in terms of life functions. It is a 1-minute walk from the Quanlian Welfare Center to meet your daily travel needs; it is also only a 1-minute drive from the center of Jincheng City, allowing you to enjoy a convenient geographical location while enjoying the quiet environment Location. stays.name: Yozaiyo Historical B&B
stays.description: -Yozaiyo Historical B&B is located on the west side of Nanshan settlement in Guningtou, Jinning Township, Kinmen County (No. 39, Nanshan). It was built about 150 years ago and has a complete traditional spatial pattern. It has a southern Fujian courtyard, large wooden works, stone walls, and smoke bricks. Traditional materials and architectural features such as walls and plaster. After searching and meeting the team of Guning Xiexinyuan Historical Inn , it was rented and operated in 2023. It re-integrated traditional and modern elements and carefully built a new Chinese aesthetic ancient house hotel, including four beautiful and unique suites, comfortable and complete We hope that travelers from all over the world can put aside their worldly affairs and worries ~ Living in Nanshan will be carefree and leisurely ~

stays.description: Lanshe Gate, located in Jinsha Township, Kinmen County, is an elegant Minnan-style traditional house bed and breakfast that carries the unique charm of Kinmen's architecture. The property not only preserves the old-world beauty of red brick gables and carved wooden windows but also integrates modern comfort, allowing travelers to escape the hustle and bustle and experience the pure Minnan culture.Step outside the guesthouse, and you can stroll through the tranquil village alleys to explore the history and culture of Kinmen. Nearby, there are beautiful coastlines and famous landmarks, making your journey filled with surprises and emotional moments.Whether you're looking for an in-depth travel experience, a family outing, or a place for spiritual refuge, Lanshe Gate warmly invites you to embark on a peaceful journey where you can connect with the passage of time.

stays.name: Pearl Homestay (Tese Homestay)
stays.description: Slow down the pace. Listen to the sound of your heart. Enjoy the nature and the country life. Pearl Homestay is in Shanhou Folk Culture Village, Kinmen. Shanhou Folk Culture Village consists of 18 Minnan style old houses built during the Qing Dynasty. The construction lasted for 25 years to build the finest houses. To this day, the old houses remain the same as they were first built. The traditionally living space is well presented. Shanhou Folk Culture Village sits on the back of Shishan, facing Dongge Bay. Every morning when the sun rises up from the horizon, the sun shines into the halls. What's more Shanhou village used to be a restricted military base. Thus the environment of Wuhu Mountain is well preserved. There is a trail up just outside the village. There are also wetlands nearby where you can see native plants and insects. The abandoned military base, the intertidal zone are within walking distance. Traveling by bike is also a good way to go around. There are mountains and the sea around the homestay. You don't have to travel far to see and feel the nature. Slow down the pace and feel the tranquility. Enjoy the view of the moon and the stars. All the hustle and bustle of the city are miles away. Enjoy the nature, the fresh air and the lovely plants. When you stay at Pearl Homestay, look up to the sky and you will see clouds, birds, and butterflies. And there are organic vegetables that I grown myself for breakfast. Kinmen souvenirs available for free.

stays.name: Pearl coffee B&B
stays.description: Homestays in Kinmen CountyShanhou Haizhu Coffee Homestay is located in Shanhou Folk Village, Jinsha Town, Kinmen County. We have homestays, cafes, postcard monopoly, cultural and creative souvenir complex.It is located in the Shanhou Folk Culture Village on the East Peninsula of Kinmen. The ancient house was built in the 26th year of Guangxu in Qing Dynasty (1900). It is one of the sixteen two-storey large homes in the village. Originally the "Martial Arts Hall" in the Cultural Village, the house is tall and bright, with simple and elegant decoration, and the space is open and comfortable. The main hall still enshrines a wooden statue of Wusheng Guan Gong, majestic and majestic.The homestay is also an ancient house cafe. The design and layout of the space is dedicated to preserving the style of the traditional ancient house in southern Fujian. In public spaces such as halls, courtyards and corridors, flowers and trees, potted plants, decorations, and resting tables and chairs are everywhere for guests to use: Grand master chair, wooden stool, stone table and stool, log armchair, atrium leisure table and chair, leather sofa, Luohan bed, teak long-leg table and chair, bar chair... Find a place you like, enjoy coffee, tea, and small Drinking, dining, resting, daze, reading, chatting, listening to music, planning your itinerary... I look forward to everyone gathering at the coffee house to forget their worries and enjoy every day.

stays.description: Chinbe No. 25 Guesthouse is a unique traditional granite building with unmatched views of the ocean, a simple and down-to-earth place that nonetheless manages to astonish visitors. Within the unadorned structure one can find a warm comfortable place to stay. Sit in front of the building at sunset, gaze off at the twinkling lights of the village in the distance, listen to the crashing waves, enjoy a cup of coffee or cold beer, and create a perfect memory of relaxation in your travels.

stays.description: A Backpacker & B&B in MatsuStronghold 55, also known as Loyalty Fort, was originally a military camp for defending Nangan Island, Jinshaaokou, and was rebuilt as a historical site.The management team refurbished this stronghold, activated the military stronghold, and gave it a new name "55 Heart Gathering ".55 Xinjudian is located in the southwest of Matsu Nangan Island, about 20 minutes' drive from the airport, and provides a comfortable accommodation environment.There is also a living room and shared refrigerators, microwave ovens, ovens and other equipment, and a buffet breakfast is also provided.Room options include a double suite, as well as single-bed backpackers, double and quadruple rooms with shared bathrooms.The rooms are all air-conditioned, provide free Wi-Fi, and have lockers for each guest to use independently, as well as luggage storage services.The homestay is about a 3-minute drive from Iron Fort, and about a 5-minute drive from Beihai Tunnel and Dahan Stronghold.Warm space for everyone to relaxWhether traveling alone or with friendsYou are all welcome to share the magic time of 55 with us and enjoy the beauty of 55 together

stays.name: Dameishi Creation Sharing Home officer Hall
stays.description: What kind of imagination do you have about art, space, and travelers? We move art out of art galleries, museums, and performance halls, and let art happen in your daily life. When you live in the same space with resident artists from all over the world, you can see wonderful creations performed in front of you at any time. We imagine the point-to-point travel mode as living and experiencing in a different place. You can experience the birth of artistic creation and the life of local residents at the same time, and feel the embrace of Matsu& #39;s mountains and seas as a traveler. All of this happens in the Dameishi Creation Sharing Home. Here we allow travel, art and local culture to have a dialogue. Whether you are a traveler, artist or dreamer, you can live and coexist here, allowing us to generate different sparks and creations. This will be a special and exciting life experience.

stays.name: Furen Homestay
stays.description: Fu Ren Bed & Breakfast is a stone building nearly 80 years old. On October 15, 2003, the owner bought a NT$20 sickle and cut a basket-size bundle of grass by the stairs in front of the building. Thick wild grass and many large trees obstructed views of the building and prevented such this great construction project from being completed. So he called home and told his parents about the situation, asking them to come to Matsu and help renovate the old structure. It was very hard work, but his parents showed their love by helping and supporting him through the entire process. Their persistence and dedication transformed the old building, which now shines with a warm atmosphere, featuring stairs, curves, waving grass, and flowers. We would like to thank many people for making this possible. The building’s beauty is really unbelievable, and there is not a single nail to be found in the internal wood structure. The building is also well-situated, facing Fu-Ao Wharf, from where one can see little white boats traveling between the islands during the day and the most beautiful sights in the evening, including the moon in the middle of the month. The best part is relaxing either in the outdoor area or inside and listening to the sound of crashing waves! Flowers of all colors make their appearances by season, butterflies dance in the wind, and carefree birds fly overhead. Spring brings romance, summer passion, autumn beauty, and winter serenity, and the beauty of it all touches the heart! We’ve prepared a lucky key to open the door to your emotions. Stay in a traditional stone house, embrace the ocean, and enjoy the sunrise in the morning and waves during the day. The sea is right at your doorstep! Fu Ren Bed & Breakfast is the most convenient place to eat, stay, and travel! Natural scenery and a beautiful environment provide your very own place of peace and quiet!

stays.name: The Sidesea of Nujiao
stays.description: Matsu Niujiao Seaside Homestay is a traditional Fujian-style old house with five ridges and four slopes.The Fuzhou fir wood is completely preserved in the house, and the main structure is wooden mortise and tenon (that is, no nails are used).The indoor wood floor and Wooden partitions, so there is no sound insulation.Lying on the bed at night, you can gossip in the other adjoining rooms.With the fragrance of Fuzhou fir and the regular sound of the waves, you will fall asleep at whole night.We sincerely welcome three or five friends and the whole family to experience the different life in the fishing village of Mazu.Niujiao Seaside Homesyat is close to the village of indentation.At night, you can enjoy blue tears or sea sparkle by the sea, step on the star sand or lie on the soft golden sandy beach and count the stars in the night sky.Niujiao Seaside B&B offers travelers a natural and relaxing journey, returning to a slow and empty life in the embrace of the sea.Our homestay offer three private rooms and one bedroom, capacityfor six people.On the 1st floor,we attached coffee and local specialties meal.We welcome old and new customers home and abroad wholeheartedly~

stays.name: Maple map
stays.description: A holiday wonderland in which you can cast aside worldly cares and live independently. Spending a holiday alone is for leisure. Sharing the world with another person is romantic. Traveling with more than two people is brimming with happiness and belly-laughs. Follow the path forward, and at Maple Map Café, you may achieve your dream lifestyle. Maple Map Café B&B is located in the "Mt. Manapan of 1,406 meters in elevation" in Miaoli, and at the waist of the mountain of 754 meters in elevation, lies the idyllic romantic B&B at the start of mountaineering. The B&B is surrounded by green rolling hills with views alternating with the change of seasons, sometimes mist and fog, sometimes sea of clouds, and when the maples turn red, the tranquil ambience of the mountains quietly grabs your soul. Maple Map Café covers an extensive area, is one of highest rated resort B&Bs in Mt. Manapan. The host makes extensive use of floor to ceiling glasses, allowing you to be greeted by the stunning views of landscapes outside the windows, while savoring the delicacies in the room. Sip a cup of coffee, your beautiful holiday just starts. In the Maple Map Café, if you pay more attention to detail, you will find the host's ingenuities in everywhere from selecting building materials to the interior layouts. The B&B offers a fine dining service, and on 2nd floor accommodations, though just a few rooms, each bright and elegant room is furnished with selected furniture and sophisticated decorations. Every room is prepared particularly comfortable to make sure you have a good night's sleep after receding from the tired body and mind. Maple Map Café is quite suitable for vacation trips of a whole family or lovers. In the front part of the B&B, there is a large garden of alpine strawberries for you to enjoy the fun of picking fruit, in addition to hiking and sightseeing. If you have any questions about your trip, please contact the B&B, Maple Map Café welcomes your visit.

Sip a cup of coffee, your beautiful holiday just starts. In the Maple Map Café, if you pay more attention to detail, you will find the host's ingenuities in everywhere from selecting building materials to the interior layouts. The B&B offers a fine dining service, and on 2nd floor accommodations, though just a few rooms, each bright and elegant room is furnished with selected furniture and sophisticated decorations. Every room is prepared particularly comfortable to make sure you have a good night's sleep after receding from the tired body and mind. Maple Map Café is quite suitable for vacation trips of a whole family or lovers. In the front part of the B&B, there is a large garden of alpine strawberries for you to enjoy the fun of picking fruit, in addition to hiking and sightseeing. If you have any questions about your trip, please contact the B&B, Maple Map Café welcomes your visit.

stays.name: SCHOKOLAKE
stays.description: Schokolake was established in the end of 2002. It's located by the hot spring at the entrance of Dahu, Tai'an Township, which is known for their strawberries. Schokolake was built on a piece of undeveloped land covering an area of 4 hectares, completely surrounded by mountains. Originally named Dahu Yunzhuang, Schokolake was born out of a dream. The dream was to create a store exclusively for chocolate. The owner displays the chocolate confections in display cases that are more exquisite than any display cases you see at department stores. The store's exterior is a European style architecture with slanted roof tops and arched windows. The interior is a warm retro European country decor with red brick walls and white trims. Flanked by wooden cabinets, a large painting depicting cute little bears in a pastel pink background takes center stage in the Chocolate Dream Room. The lush green lawn and trees in front of the store evoke the feel of an European manor. Since the store was formally renamed Schokolake in 2009, it has been a dream come true for the owner. Everything she has created - plants, flowers and exquisite product - was a result of her vision, which was to turn fine ingredients into exquisite and delicious pieces of chocolate. We welcome you to Schokolake to share our dream.

stays.name: Spend Time
stays.description: Miaoli｜Spend TimeSpend time soaking in hot springs and enjoying nature by the lakesideThe afternoon scenery unfolds before your eyes as you drive up into the mountains in Dahu Township, Miaoli County. There, you find Spend Time guesthouse which melds into the landscape between mountains and lakes, resembling a picturesque painting.Enjoy Mother Nature’s genuine welcomeAs you walk down the stone path from your car to the guesthouse, you are surprised to discover that the main building sits right beside the lake. Water and mountains wrap around on all sides. Vivid flowers and trees abound. You are met by a delicious breeze and dancing butterflies. As you stroll around the wooden guesthouse, you can sense that nature has already prepared a full itinerary for you.Wandering by the flowing brooks on a bright sunny day, you can observe wisteria and sakura flowers in early spring and tung oil tree blossoms toward the end of the season. In the golden autumn, the sycamores turn red and you can behold the starry sky while steeping in hot-spring pools at night. During summer evenings, you open the balcony doors and the fireflies make their debut as the lake shimmers before your eyes. Spend Time guesthouse is always ready to serve you something spectacular whenever you swing by.Beauty in the scenery, the cuisine, the people, and the hot springsAt Spend Time, not only can you enjoy all the beauty that nature unselfishly provides; various kinds of local delicacies and homemade wines are also on offer. The roasted strawberry beer chicken and German-style pig’s trotters are must-try dishes. A Chinese-style breakfast with mouthwatering steamed breads is served lake-side every morning. The housekeeper and all the staff are exceedingly hospitable. You might even have the opportunity to taste unique, homemade grape and kumquat wines.Commonly referred to as “beauty springs”, the sodium bicarbonate hot-springs are one of the distinguishing features here. Spend Time guesthouse insists on providing an authentic hot-spring experience with no extra water or chemical additives whatsoever. Even the bath in your room runs with delicate spring water. The public pools at Spend Time are made from various materials in a number of shapes and sizes, some of them with controllable water temperature, and provide travelers with a uniquely refreshing hot spring experience.Building a dreamlike garden paradiseSpend Time guesthouse is the realization of a common ideal held by two mutually supportive friends. Mr. Lin loves creative work and is captivated by art. Ms. Cai adores working in the kitchen and is also fond of gardening. After a bout of serious illness several years ago, Mr. Lin accelerated his plans to retire and open a guesthouse, inviting Ms. Cai to help him realize his dream. One of the partners took charge of designing the space, and the other took responsibility for the gardens and the creative cuisine. In this way, the seemingly parallel lives of an artist and a housewife came to intersect in the planning and implementation of a beautiful dream.Why not find a day to come “Spend Time” here? Come enjoy this dreamlike garden paradise, relax in the pure, fresh hot spring, savor the gentle surroundings, and delight in the simple pleasures of nature.

stays.description: Chi Cha Ju is located in the Golden Town of Gongguan, Miaoli. The first floor is designed in an ancient and elegant style. It is the [Old Tea Room] where the owner’s collection of antiques, curios, and old objects are shared. stays.name: Miaoli Song He Taoran Ju Homestay
stays.description: Songhe B&B is located along the scenic and wide Taose Highway in Gongguan Township, Miaoli County. It& #39;s next to Ren& #39;an Community Center along Mountain Road with Tianquan Temple nearby. Behind the B&B are lush green mountains, hiking trail and Exercise Park. A hike up the mountain offers a birds-eye-view of Gongguan Township and the beautiful night scene of the entire Gongguan Town. This area is surrounded by greenery and flowers, sounds of birds chirping, insects buzzing, butterflies fluttering about and fireflies flickering at night. The soothing sounds of water running in the farm field ditches and fish swimming in the pond remind visitors from the busy city of the carefree country lifestyle and childhood games, such as catching grasshoppers and fishing for loachThe town& #39;s most beautiful bikeway and hiking trail is along the mountain. The B&B has bikes available for guests to use. It& #39;s very convenient to get to nearby neighborhoods, such as downtown Gongguan, Hakka Mansion and Oil Mine. Take a walk to the Hakka Village and see a variety of seasonal fresh vegetables growing in the farm fields - taros, strawberries and red dates. When flowers bloom, the colorful blossoms attract many butterflies to the area.The beautifully landscaped B&B courtyard evokes the local Hakka flavor and is equipped with barbeque facilities and kitchen utensils. The B&B can order BBQ food items for guests, and guests can also go to the supermarket or vegetable market to select the freshest vegetables and fruits. Our price is average, but our service is thoughtful and extensive, and our equipment and accessories in the guestrooms are very high quality. You will be guaranteed to have a fulfilled country style vacation. The living room has complimentary coffee and tea for guests to enjoy. This is a great place for a few friends to gather and catch up on each other& #39;s lives and forget all their troubles.
