stays.name: Tong Zhuang Homestay
stays.description: Miaoli｜House of Tung FlowersWhite snow in a mountain forest; the delight of Tung flower landFollowing Provincial Highway Six up into the mountains, you breathe the sweet, clear air of Miaoli County. Turning down a winding mountain road, you see a flurry of snow-like Tung flowers - the so-called May Snows. Trees encompass the road from both sides as you approach your beautiful mountain destination - House of Tung Flowers. Between the elegance of nature and the deliciousness of exquisitely prepared meals, you savor the taste of happiness.Afternoon tea in the mountains beneath the Tung treesThe layered green landscape of House of Tung Flowers unfolds before your eyes, with a lofty tung tree standing directly in the middle of the gardens, quietly extending its branches to bathe in the warm sunlight. You set out across a wooden pathway strewn with Tung flowers and resembling snow-covered ground, and stroll between the Tung, Phoebe zhennan, umbrella, and camellia assamica trees. The mountain breeze rustles the tree leaves as the sounds of insects and birds enters your ears, uniting into a lively forest concerto.In the afternoon, you enter the glass-walled tea room, with light spilling in from all sides. To one side sits a dessert cabinet full of sweets from the famous RT Bakery House. Have as much as you like, along with hot tea and coffee. Seated indoors or out, the scenery is beautiful any season of the year, not just during the Tung flower season. In spring, fresh emerald-green leaves sprout all around. In summer, the tung trees produce a snow of white flowers. In autumn, the maples shine red in the forest. And in winter, the mountain forests are shrouded in clouds and mist.Resting between fragrant trees, taste a creative, menu-free Hakka-style mealStepping into the three-story building, the scent of Chinese fir filling the entire space relieves your exhausted mind. At House of Tung Flowers, the furnishings in each room are made of solid wood, accentuated with exquisite antique lamps, and include a capsule coffee machine and complementary RT Bakery House cookies. The interior design includes Japanese tatami mats as well as wooden rocking chairs, with large windows that afford beautiful views of the mountain forests. You can sit on the balcony and breathe phytoncides from the comfort of hanging chairs, or soak in the bathtub to completely relax. With a maximum capacity of 20 people, House of Tung Flowers is well-suited for a family or a group of friends to reserve the entire wooden structure. With karaoke in the first floor common room and a small living room on the third floor where family and friends can play chess or chat with each other.A one night stay includes three meals, yet the thing most anticipated by visitors to House of Tung Flowers is the menu-free fusion dinner incorporating local ingredients and traditional Hakka flavors. Red date vinegar is used to start the meal off, followed by lotus root wrapped in the sweetness of Hakka-style grass jelly made of Chinese mesona. A bamboo steamer full of fresh seasonal vegetables with homemade kumquat sauce satisfies all the senses. A uniquely flavored bean curd chicken soup, served with crisp bread stuffed with Italian rice-flour noodles emits distinct Italian aroma. The sweet fish imparts the fresh sweetness of the sea, while the broiled Japanese beef (wagyu) simply cannot be missed. Finally, enjoy a bite of delicate almond tofu and a glass from host James’s private wine collection to bring your beautiful evening to a close. In contrast with one’s impression of the usual fixed villa menu, the food at House of Tung Flowers employs meticulous western-style techniques and the ingenious fusion of Hakka cuisine and Taiwanese ingredients to bring to each traveler an elegant and refined dining experience. James - promoting Taiwan’s tung flower season for the appreciation of the entire worldIn the morning, the mountain breeze urges you toward the breakfast table, where yet another sumptuous meal is laid out. Many summers ago, James decided to open his family home up to the public, to share the beautiful scenery with travelers by opening a guesthouse. The Hakka Affairs Council seized the opportunity to promote the Hakka tung flower season to attract large quantities of tourists, during which time House of Tung Flowers operates at full capacity every single day. Today, James has a full head of gray hair, yet in those first days, he truly was a pioneer, leading the way in the tung flower tourist market. With his endless Hakka passion and hospitality, he has been a great advocate of tung flower tourism during the month of May. Who would guess that he grew up in the Ximending neighborhood in Taipei! Yet he had always hoped to one day live in the tranquility of nature. Upon entering society, he continued his father’s construction business. At the turn of the millennium, in a time when many people could not even recognize a tung tree, he had come to admire the largest tung tree in Taiwan, right here beside House of Tung Flowers. He built his guesthouse and launched his one night, three meals slow living holiday package so that travelers can live in the mountains, and enjoy the tung flowers and delicious food. “Taiwan has many qualifications which surpass those of other countries, so we need to look at things from a new perspective, drawing in a tide of tourists from abroad, in order for Taiwan to build confidence!” With his warmth and sincerity, James invites travelers from around the world to come to this tranquil forest, to enjoy the tung flowers fluttering on the May breeze, like beautiful snow swirling in the air, and savor the taste of a truly happy vacation.

stays.name: Lily Village
stays.description: Reservation Tel: 037-825822 Email:lilyvillage50@yahoo.com Lily Village is located in Nanzhuang, Miaoli. We break through the B&B traditions and offer garden-style B&B and gourmet feasts and sophisticated hotel Management. Lily Village originated from a dream of a successful interior designer. He set standards to build an ideal residential house for himself after completing his military service and carried out the standards to every tiny detail and the internal control management processes that are more restricted than that of the B&Bs in neighboring areas. After nearly a thousand days and nights for planning and constructions, each hardware and software facilities and services in the Lily Village has been elevated dramatically to the level of star-rated hotels, laid a new milestone for the quality of B&Bs in Nanzhuang. Lily village is located in Nanzhuang Township, Miaoli County. As a national tourist resort, Nanzhuang is known that "beautiful waters and beautiful mountains are all in Nanzhuang" and, as another Hakka song puts it, "Nanzhuang girls are more beautiful than Dan (female character in an opera)" (Hakka pronunciation). Experiencing in person is believing. Lily Village is a top class fine B&B built with European windmill shape and features a golf putting green available for guests& #39; practice free of charge, a large viewing deck on the top floor for embracing the unique spectacular view of Nanzhuang, in addition to the exquisite landscaping and elegantly and tastefully furnished rooms. Also features a refreshment area for offering coffee, scented teas, and repasts, available for you to enjoy them indoors or outdoors, while enjoying the light dancing fountain. After dark, bright colorful lighting light up the Lily Village, creating both beautiful ambience and lighting, and in the morning before sunrise, you can walk barefoot on the health trail for exercising or just for strolling, meanwhile enjoy the sight of lotuses, fancy carps, along with the dawn to appreciate this rare leisurely time.

Along with the verdant hills and crystal streams, we create a homey guesthouse serve with mom& #39;& #39;s daily dishes and guests enjoy a feeling of refreshment with a cup of coffee or tea in our library café either outdoor garden seat. Colorful wild birds often reside and everything is welcoming your visit.

stays.name: Nan Chian Jade Garden
stays.description: Nan Chian Jade Garden is located in Nanzhuang, amid beautiful verdant countryside beside the road leading to Donghe, about 1 km from the Nanzhuang Old Street. It is a high quality Bed and Breakfast with convenient transportation and vast field of view. The appearance of Nan Chian Jade Garden is a European style of North America with a design reflecting the innkeeper& #39;s taste and intention, the overall feeling is elegant, sophisticated, and the presentation of the flow of light and shadow in the space varying with time, as well as the poetic beauties of the scenery changing window by window, makes you feel refreshing like being in a home of your earnest wish. Here, you can enjoy the owner& #39;s art collection, and also the music of creeks, while leisurely strolling in the mountains and valleys, or sip a cup of coffee while chatting with friends, accompanying by the natural sounds of surrounding brook. For people like you who love nature, you can bathe yourself in the forest Phytoncide to feel the green fairy dancing in your body. Or, take a hike on old trails to flex your motor nerve. If, an exciting journey to Nanzhuang natural and cultural eco-tour is what you have expected, in addition to experiencing the simplicity of Hakka mien and cuisine, you can study the historical relics and tribal cultures of Saisiyat and Atayal tribes, or visit the Penglai River (Creek) fish conservation trails that you can not miss. Overnight Nen Chian Jade Garden, you can enjoy the night view of the landscape surrounding streets and the sparkling starry sky. Nan Chian Jade Garden is a B&B certified by SGS, a certified Taiwan Host by the Tourism Bureau, MOTC, and a four-star B&B assessed by the Miaoli County Government. In short, the well-crafted Nan Chian Jade Garden is a name you can trust and a place to visit. Please make an appointment for your arrival to share the mountain quiet life together.

stays.name: Provence Villa
stays.description: Paying attention to every detail, we insist on making dreams come true regardless of time. It was never easy, but the joy of starting something from scratch and seeing it finished is beyond words. I realized that it does not matter how slow you go as long as you don't stop. Here you will feel the harmony of the land and the sky. The place to rest in the mountains is priceless. Every detail is the result of hard work. Here you will find the many faces of the mountains just like what you find in people. Different people see different things when they have different emotions as you see a different self when you reach a harmonious state. Come here and live in nature. The mountain is like a massive balcony. And during the night you feast on it. The beauty of the mountain brings joy to your body. Let the power of the silent mountains calm you and bring out your energy. Provence Villa in Nanchaung, Moali, is close to Nanchaung Old Street, Xiangtien Lake, Penglai river, and Fairy Valley. In summer there are fireflies. In spring there are cherry blossoms and tung flowers. You can enjoy the cold spring trail and Pas-ta'ai, the Ritual to the Short People. We have the finest environment and the best view in Nanchaung that we hope to share with you.

stays.name: Red Brick Villas
stays.description: Red Brick Villa has been recognized as an outstanding B&B with the characteristics of an ecological or landscape architecture, coordinating with the local government to develop the tourism industry (activities), approved by the Characteristic B&B Review Committee of the Miaoli County Government, and thus is the first Miaoli County Government certified Characteristic Bed and Breakfast. Red Brick Villa, located in Lijin Hall, Nanjiang Village, Nanzhuang Township, is a distinctive characteristic villa style Bed and Breakfast. Built with red Shimizu brick masonry, Red Brick Villa's red walls and silver tiles were blended with nature, and the villa features a wide field of vision, luxuriant and well-spaced flowers and trees, lush grass courtyard, crystal clear family paddling pool, fully equipped kitchen and dining facilities for self cooking or barbecue, which is the most suitable for family gatherings. Embraced by simple, unadorned, honest people and folk custom, your stay at Red Brick Villa offers you the chance to enjoy the rustic charm of Taiwan.

stays.description: Bed and Breakfast in Miaoli CountyWen Qiao Villa is situated at a mountainside in Nan Zhuang, a Hakka village in Miao Li County. At the upper end of a valley, Wen Qiao is an acre-sized paddy embraced by a forest and alongside a mountain stream.We found this gorgeous place in 2004, and decided to keep its original look by minimizing the changes to the landscapes and vegetation. We have also planted a number of indigenous trees and aquatic plants with a view to maintain an environment where human and all other creatures live in harmony.We built this cottage in 2011, and have since spent most of our holidays in Wen Qiao enjoying the unparalleled country experiences. Now, we are ready to share it with people who would appreciate such a life style.Service in English is available here. Come and see Wen Qiao a home during your stay in Taiwan.

This is a small town surrounded by green mountains and green waters.In addition, it is also a famous hometown of woodcarving in Taiwan. Hundreds of wood carving artists are here, and the artist studios full of wood fragrance are hidden in courtyard lanes. The fragrance of wood not only impacts your sense of smell, but also impacts your heart with exquisite craftsmanship.If you are interested in learning more about the deep culture and unique lifestyle of the town, please leave your free time here and let us arrange your journey, which will be an unforgettable journey.

The Ageless Farmhouse was established on March 7, 2023 and has been certified and licensed by the Miaoli County Government.This is a brand new farmhouse that only offers freshness and cleanliness, the indoor environment is very clean, the outdoors is breathable and the air is very fresh.The detached farmhouse offers comfort without the smell of petrol and the sound of horns.Sanyi Township is located in the south of Miaoli County, and is also a mountain town north of Taichung City, with an average altitude of more than 300 meters. This is a small town surrounded by green mountains and green waters.In addition, it is also a famous hometown of woodcarving in Taiwan. Hundreds of wood carving artists are here, and the artist studios full of wood fragrance are hidden in courtyard lanes. The fragrance of wood not only impacts your sense of smell, but also impacts your heart with exquisite craftsmanship.If you are interested in learning more about the deep culture and unique lifestyle of the town, please leave your free time here and let us arrange your journey, which will be an unforgettable journey.

stays.name: ChooArt Villa
stays.description: Miaoli｜ChooArt VillaBreathe with Nature and Return to the Tranquility Embraced by the ForestThe ripples of the green pool water reflect the beautiful shadows of trees in your mind. Close your eyes and let the mountain breeze brush against your body. Passing by the Longteng Broken Bridge, you are driving on the mountain road to Sanyi, Miaoli County. When the car enters ChooArt Villa, the fragrance of flowers and plants floats in the air and a large striped-dove flies in the sky. Behind the hidden wooden door, your exclusive holiday is expecting your arrival. Here, you breathe with nature, while the mountain and woods embrace you with their beauty.Share with Nature the Leisurely Vacation in Mountain Woods Under the rooftop garden of irises, the vine-covered buildings of ChooArt Villa in the valley are beautifully arranged in a haphazard way like stylish tree houses, while staying close to nature. You enter the lobby with the floor-to-ceiling windows and doors, have a cup of coffee and rest for a bit. Sit in the sofa chair by the glass window, browse through some magazines or books, take in the scenery and just enjoy the leisurely time.Step down the outdoor stairs, and you find yourself at the pool, where the verdant camphor woods above provide you with shade. When the wind blows, the tree branches and leaves flutter, and the shadows on the spring water sway to a natural rhythm. You sit on the deck chair as your lover floats relaxingly in the water. Your cheerful mood is accompanied by the chirping of the birds. Everything is just so delightful and at ease.Sun, Tree, River, and Moon; Planting Four Relaxing Sleep SpacesBeing built along the contour of the hill, four double rooms of ChooArt share a simple character, and they breathe and live with the woods. Walking into the “Tree Spring” double room, time seems to slow down here. In the bedroom space, three camphor trees stretching up toward the light are surrounded by the glass windows. Get closer to the window, and you’d enjoy the relaxing melody composed by the bamboo forest and the creek outside. Take off your clothes and get through the U-shaped corridor by the greenery balcony, you’ll arrive at the spacious bathroom with the forest view. The “Sunny River” room offers the view of the ruins of the Broken Bridge. You may listen to the sound of running water and enjoy the quiet peace here. The sunlight penetrates the transparent floor-to-ceiling gauze curtains of the “First Sun” room, while the bed with the gauze canopy brings you a sense of the romantic holiday. You can also walk through the glass passage with the reflection of the blue sky to the bathroom. In the “Tipsy Moon” room, you can admire the enchanting starry sky and the lush scenery.Taste the Authentic Taiwanese Flavor in the Creative CuisineAs your stay at ChooArt includes two meals, you can enjoy the culinary delights that incorporate creative ideas with local ingredients. In the evening, you step into the dining room on the second floor, where the chef will demonstrate how the food is carefully prepared in the open kitchen. There are refreshing appetizers, hearty salads, and creative dishes with a variety of artistic senses. Of course, the highlight would be the surf and turf meal combined with the seared short beef rib and coral hind from Penghu, bringing the perfect ending to the evening. In the morning, the breakfast contains a bowl of warm vegetable porridge and small dishes made with the ingredients purchased from the local farmers, all with simple seasoning for you to savor the most natural flavors.The name of the villa, ChooArt, is the Taiwanese word for trees, representing a tribute to the land and local hospitality. The team is dedicated to the coexistence of the ecologically sustainable architecture and nature. This dedication also leads ChooArt Villa to be the Gold Winner of the 2017 FIABCI World Prix d’Excellence Environmental Award (as “Oscars Award” of the real estate industry). The team believes that a good balance can be achieved by planting trees while building houses. Just like Brian, the amicable CEO, said: “A lot of things should not be taken for granted, we must learn how to adapt to nature.” His respect for the earth also deeply affects the employees of ChooArt. Working as a staff here, not only one’s capability is a must, but the attitude one bears would be the key. The staff here learn from nature while serving each traveler wholeheartedly.Before you leave, come to the lobby and enjoy some Chinese tea and a good chat with the tea master. With a cup of fine tea, reserve some quiet time for yourself. The aroma drifting in the air just reminds you of the thoughtfulness of ChooArt and the wonderfulness of being embraced by the forest.

stays.name: Feng Zhou Xiao Homestay
stays.description: The natural environment of Fong Chou Cabins is well maintained. When spring comes, lives are quietly enlivened, as palpable starry flickering. In Tung blossom season, pure and white flowers dance on the treetops above the earth; the scene is like patches of snow falling from the sky, and therefore the April Snow becomes famous. In late fall, some people in the park want to demonstrate the fiery passion side of them because of the cool weather, and it seems to announce the winter has arrived. With the arrival of the winter, it feels particularly cold and the moisture seems to become building up, and the condition at the moment is one of the most unique meteorological conditions in Sanyi. In the early morning, fogs cover the earth and the mountain view is followed by the coming of layers of clouds covering over the mountains, and the fresh air accompanies the beauty before your eyes. It is really great. Welcome to visit us.

stays.name: Futen house villa
stays.description: Futen-house Villa B&B is located in the Leisure Agriculture Area of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi Township, at Miaoli Highway 49-1 where connects Longteng Broken Bridge and Shengxing Station. Amid luxuriant woods next to Shengxing old railroad, you can find an independent red brick building, "Futen-house Villa," hides in the woods and appears particularly eye-catching. Toiling over to reclaim the land of Futen-house Villa and cultivating every tree and flower personally, the host couple hope to provide a natural environment for future generations and to present completely the organic and ecological perspectives of the Fulton- house Villa to the public. In particular, in every season of Tung Blossom, the natural forest barrier of Futen-house Villa presents a hazy sea of snow white flowers of the April. It is breathtakingly beautiful. Futen-house Villa covers an area of ​​two hectares, which focuses on environmental constructions of returning to the original forests. In the vast hinterland of the eco-park, the green land of forest includes organic orchards, ecological purification ponds, and has planted Lagerstroemia subcostata, maples, Taiwan Gordonia, etc., throughout. The natural environment often attracts the nesting of Taiwan Blue Magpies, Taiwan Barbets, Gray-cheeked Fulvetta, among others, in the park of Futen-house Villa. Every visiting visitor is able to experience the fun of living in the mountains and the leisure of recreational mode, to enjoy the idyllic countryside, and artistic creations of Hakka village, and to stroll in an open paradise of blue sky and green land. Come to Futen-house Villa, allow the hosts to elaborate the Sanyi culture / Monuments / Art / Nature, and to make carefully a custom journey package for you, featuring a natural hinterland of 16,500 square-meters for the parent-child ramble, tea party for a few friends, lovers' stroll, health programs for the seniors, and enjoying the calm space of the mind. Feature forest landscape log cabins, elegant coffee house, outdoor pavilion lounges, ecological lotus ponds, orchards, goose pond, and coffee tree trails, in addition to exclusive spacious suites. In Autumn, coffee beans turn ripe; visitors may also enjoy the pleasure of picking coffee beans. Visitors can experience all park facilities and activities, and because of this attitude of careful management, the Villa won consistently high praises from travelers. The innkeepers adhere to make Futen-house Villa a happy accommodation that the tourists to Sanyi cannot miss.

stays.name: Love face house
stays.description: The museum started off with a humble beginning as a woodcarving workshop. Later in 1988, it functioned as a woodcarving school that mainly conducted classes for young children between ages 10 and 12. The overwhelming responses for classes inspired the establishment of the current Face Painting Cultural Museum, which combines the art of wood carving and the art of Chinese Opera face painting together. More than a thousand traditional Chinese Opera face paintings are displayed in the museum, each exquisitely designed by the owner's family of 4 during the SARS period from 1992 to 1995. The SARS crisis was a blessing in disguise that provided the family with an opportunity to transform the site into the current Face Painting Cultural Museum. The gallery of face painting art pieces not only enhances the beauty of the place, but also represents the fruits of their hard work.

stays.name: Maison Philo
stays.description: Maison Philo is an owl shaped modern architecture, but it has a hall similar to a hall of the old European church, an exotic philosopher suites, which we want to share with you a different aesthetic perception of life. This is a B&B full of literature and philosophy. How long did you not have a dialogue with yourself? How long did you not talk with an old friend? Hectic pace even makes a leisure tour a full busy itinerary. Is a leisure activity meant to eat one meal after another? Is a travel meant to be rushed? Must a holiday be banded together? Envy a Frenchman can while away a long afternoon with just a book and a cup of coffee. If you have only one person - I hope you come to Maison Philo to have a dialogue with yourself. A bottle of red wine, a few slices of cheese, it seems suitable enough for having night chats with old friends with candles in hand. If you have some long lost friends, we hope you come to Maison Philo to have a chat about ideas, or philosophy with them. A blanket and a lawn, we can also lay a leisurely afternoon. If you are lovers--you are welcome to spend a leisurely life of two at Maison Philo. This is Maison Philo's vacation philosophy--"during a vacation, doing nothing is the greatest virtue of all.

stays.name: Sunhouse Homestay
stays.description: Coming into the zone of the historic Mountain Route of Railroad, Sanyi, Miaoli, at Shengxing Station look towards the direction of Longteng Broken Bridge, you will find Sun Green Holiday, a place filled with relaxed atmosphere and covered with greenery and flowers. Yes, this is exactly the forest feast we have prepared for you. We always have a dream that we can develop a park belonging to us to reserve the forests and ecological lands, and to share with the traveling people. Therefore, in 2000, we started to work on Sun Green Holiday& #39;s soil preparation, planning of lines of motion, housing construction, and planting trees, bit by bit, to create an ecological Bed & Breakfast. In the 2002 Spring Festival, the operation of the B&B was officially started. Rows of sweet-scented Osmanthus forest, camellias, huge Buddha cutters with maple trees, and other trees surround around the Sun Green Holiday, adding a bit more pastoral green to it. The retained trees to build the ecological environment in those days now seem to create a paradise for Sun Green Holiday. stays.description: Lita& #39;s Paradise is about 20 minutes by car from Sanyi Interchange, and has convenient transportation. Along the way to here, you pass through a small village full of simple rural style. Therefore, it is just a kind of fun that you can along the way to appreciate the traditional style of beauty by driving, cycling, or taking a bus. Here has verdurous mountains, and here you have freedom from care. Walking from the parking lot into the door of Lita& #39;s Paradise, you find the two green plantings located on both sides welcoming your visit. March your pleasant pace and move forward, make a turn, there lies a green garden with a bridge. The pivallion offers you a good place viewing landscape in the sunshine. Further advance, you see the gourmet restaurant of the Lita& #39;s Paradise. The gourmet restaurant is surrounded by green landscaping plants and carefully arranged flowers, and with pieces of French windows inside the restaurant, your dining and afternoon tea are set in such an environment you will feel comfortable to enjoy your cuisine, and there are lounges outdoor for you to choose. Lita& #39;s Paradise is a gourmet B&B located in Miaoli, close to Shengxing Station and Longteng Broken Bridge, featuring sophisticated accommodation quality, bedding of five-star hotel level, and in-room furnishings also uses elegant and textured furniture. In addition, the Lita& #39;s Paradise restaurant displays beautiful rows of plates with gold medal winning delicacies, which absolutely makes you enjoy unexpected flavors.

stays.name: Gui Ju Yuan Homestay
stays.description: Gui Ju Yuan B&B, located in Shihtan (Shitan) , Miaoli, stands in beside Highway No. 3, is a new building with gray and white and a significant landmark. From here you can overlook the pleasant country scene of Shihtan mountains, and having a spacious space; it is an excellent choice of place for enjoying the Mid-Autumn Festival. Mr. Huang Rongzong, the innkeeper, brought his family together back to hometown Shihtan after retirement, and decided to build a high-quality living space for home, During building the house, he had an idea to ​​operate a B&B. The B&B is located close to Taiwan Highway No. 3 surrounded by mountains. To close the distance between you and the sky is only to raise your head, and when facing the myriad of mountains, you catch the view of the greeting emerald green of the whole valley. Take a deep breath, you then inhale the freshness of the mountains immediately. The dawn of sunrise at here is comparable to that of Cingjing (Qingjing) Farm. If lucky enough, you are able to watch the domineering posture of an eagle soaring in the sky. When the sun goes down, night falls, and the vast starry sky is hanging over. While frogs croak, birds chirp, sweet Osmanthuses give off a fragrance, you brew a pot of tea and enjoy the life unavailable in the city but available in the most natural environment. A place you feel the warmth of home with rich real human interest, where you can have fun of playing the toys of old days, and breakfast of Hakka flavor. A real B&B the travelers have frequented repeatedly. Gui Ju Yuan offers spacious lawns, moon watching balcony, private indoor parking spaces, featuring a quiet and comfortable environment and relaxing countryside ambience. Whether it is family or group outings, you can enjoy the pleasure of a pleasance. Welcome to Gui Ju Yuan.

stays.name: Tumuyi Farm Health Resort
stays.description: The three brothers (Huang Jiande, the eldest, Huang Jianchu, the second, and Huang Jianlong, the youngest), born in a family in farming for generations of Aboriginal small tribe, cherish the memory of the living environment of their innocent, passionate childhood of without lights, playing in the rice fields, going to school barefooted, feeding pigs, watering vegetables, setting up traps, pulling bamboo, shooting fish in streams, cooking and helping with housework. Suddenly, 50 years later, our journeys of life have mostly gone, and now what we are looking for is feedback and serenity, and wish to pursue a healthy, peaceful, and simple life in their remaining years. Ever since, we have been thinking of "a falling leaf returns to the roots" and hoped that ancestral glory can come to us to help us creating a healthy living environment with the tribesmen together. To be closer to nature, closer to the waters and mountains, and closer to creating a healthy cause, we have a dream to own a health farm, render it in a simple, natural, earthy way to allow us to have a lazy laid-back life accompanied by nature and share it with all good friends who like here. Three brothers then actively brought the land 20 years ago. Beginning in April 2008, they have returned to tribe planning, followed by designing, in the same year on November 22 they started the construction, and officially completed the building and opened for business on October 3, 2009. We, three brothers, spent more than 2 years to complete the construction of this healthy farm. Here has very beautiful landscapes, pleasant climate, and is an unexplored paradise on earth, where you can find a lot of amazing things in every corner. We hope the staying tourists can have the beautiful feelings comparable to traveling to the Swiss. "Tumuyi" is my father's indigenous name. In the past, he was a farmer battling through hardship to live, inadvertently, at 38 years old, he died of hypertension and suddenly left us. To recall fondly and cherish the memory of father's kindness of bringing up us, hardworking, and helpful spirit of great love, and to awaken our descendants to attach importance to their health, the farm villa is therefore named "Tumuyi Healthy Resort."

Suddenly, 50 years later, our journeys of life have mostly gone, and now what we are looking for is feedback and serenity, and wish to pursue a healthy, peaceful, and simple life in their remaining years. Ever since, we have been thinking of "a falling leaf returns to the roots" and hoped that ancestral glory can come to us to help us creating a healthy living environment with the tribesmen together. To be closer to nature, closer to the waters and mountains, and closer to creating a healthy cause, we have a dream to own a health farm, render it in a simple, natural, earthy way to allow us to have a lazy laid-back life accompanied by nature and share it with all good friends who like here. Three brothers then actively brought the land 20 years ago. Beginning in April 2008, they have returned to tribe planning, followed by designing, in the same year on November 22 they started the construction, and officially completed the building and opened for business on October 3, 2009. We, three brothers, spent more than 2 years to complete the construction of this healthy farm. Here has very beautiful landscapes, pleasant climate, and is an unexplored paradise on earth, where you can find a lot of amazing things in every corner. We hope the staying tourists can have the beautiful feelings comparable to traveling to the Swiss. "Tumuyi" is my father's indigenous name. In the past, he was a farmer battling through hardship to live, inadvertently, at 38 years old, he died of hypertension and suddenly left us. To recall fondly and cherish the memory of father's kindness of bringing up us, hardworking, and helpful spirit of great love, and to awaken our descendants to attach importance to their health, the farm villa is therefore named "Tumuyi Healthy Resort."

stays.name: Cui Song Yuan Homestay
stays.description: A Horticultural B&B next to the Flying Cow Ranch. "Cui Song Yuan Bonsai Bed and Breakfast" is located in Tongsiao (Tongxiao), Miaoli, close to the Flying Cow Ranch. Beautiful scenery along the way to the B&B varies with changing seasons (grapefruit flowers, cotton trees, Tung flowers, cosmos, sunflowers, canola flowers)." Over hundreds of Taiwan White Pines has been planted in the garden of "Cui Song Yuan," providing natural, fresh air. Have your breakfast under century-old Autumn maple tree, while enjoy the nature& #39;s feast of surrounding flowers and trees. Rustic Leisure Experience Activities featured in the park of Cui Song Yuan include barbecue, tea parties, stargazing and firefly tours, creek shrimp catching, kiln smothered cooking, rice diet DIY, seasonal fruit picking, and healthy meals of local agricultural flavors. In addition, a 1-day or 2-day Depth Tongsiao (Tongxiao) Journey can be arranged to experience profoundly the rustic art and leisure.

stays.name: Fei Ying Homestay
stays.description: Firefly Farm is located on the hillside at the junction of the protected forest and the upstream of Nanshi River in Fuxing Village, Tongsiao Township, surrounded by the green hills in three directions. A babbling brook flows across the valley and slowly passes through the front of the house. A courtyard covered with floral. It is a typical quiet Sanhe Yuan farmhouse. Firefly Farm offers visitors the activities including watching fireflies, listening to birds, tea and chat, swimming and playing with water. It is the best place to enjoy the countryside snacks in an arranged vacation. Covered with wetlands around the park, the place is rich in fireflies during the annual spring season. At night, mountains and waters, in front of the house and behind the house, are dotted with charming flickering fireflies; therefore the name "Firefly Farm." Located halfway up the mountain, it is a clean environment with minimal pollution, so every year from March to November you can enjoy Luciola ficta Olivier, Pyrocoelia analis, and Luciola anceyi flying in the mountains dotting the lights. It is one of nature's most beautiful pictures. Firefly Farm is a comprehensive B&B that integrates the concepts of nature, health and sustainability. It is located in the Firefly Ecological Restoration Area and provides a variety of services. It aims to allow every visitor to experience the process of relaxation, learning and self-healing while getting close to nature. The farm's services include accommodation, catering, DIY experiences, ecological tours, environmental education, and professional forest healing activities. Whether you are a traveler pursuing leisure or a friend who desires to relax physically and mentally, you can find your own way to relax here.

It is the best place to enjoy the countryside snacks in an arranged vacation. Covered with wetlands around the park, the place is rich in fireflies during the annual spring season. At night, mountains and waters, in front of the house and behind the house, are dotted with charming flickering fireflies; therefore the name "Firefly Farm." Located halfway up the mountain, it is a clean environment with minimal pollution, so every year from March to November you can enjoy Luciola ficta Olivier, Pyrocoelia analis, and Luciola anceyi flying in the mountains dotting the lights. It is one of nature's most beautiful pictures. Firefly Farm is a comprehensive B&B that integrates the concepts of nature, health and sustainability. It is located in the Firefly Ecological Restoration Area and provides a variety of services. It aims to allow every visitor to experience the process of relaxation, learning and self-healing while getting close to nature. The farm's services include accommodation, catering, DIY experiences, ecological tours, environmental education, and professional forest healing activities. Whether you are a traveler pursuing leisure or a friend who desires to relax physically and mentally, you can find your own way to relax here.

stays.name: Shine Mood Spa&Resort
stays.description: Miaoli Yuanli is a small town with traditional breeding culture and historical traces everywhere. It is known as "Miaoli Barn" and "Lin Grassland Township".These artistic and cultural history are revitalized and carried forward under the efforts of a group of returning youths. Passed on from generation to generation.A vacation manor hotel that satisfies travellers' leisure kicked off in this classic town. It is rooted here. It is located at the foot of the Huoyan Mountain. It overlooks the endless alluvial fan plain. It is called "Enjoy the Time".On the way to "enjoy the time", drive through the spacious country roads, surrounded by field scenery, spring seedlings are green and vibrant; summer green rice fields swing with the wind, green waves ups and downs; autumn full of golden rice ears, floating bursts of rice Fragrant; fallow in winter to prepare for the coming year, planting flowers to form a unique scenery of the sea of ​​flowers, looking up at the sky will give you a panoramic view of the vast blue sky. This is a landscape that the city does not have. This is the unique leisure and tranquility of the countryside. There are 90 rooms, 11 types of rooms, each spacious and comfortable room has its own hot spring bath, so that travelers can enjoy the fun of bathing in the room.. There are 10 hot spring baths, naked hot spring baths, open-air baths and outdoor swimming pools. Travelers can freely choose the bathing method they want.. The planning of various areas such as "Xianyan" banquet hall, "Music" restaurant, "Time Man" coffee shop, "Guangyuan" outdoor terrace, game and reading area, KTV, indoor observation deck, etc. will bring guests the ultimate enjoyment .

Golden Tulip becomes No. 2 hotel group in Europe by scale, operates 1,554 hotels in 54 countries, and number of rooms has exceeds 120,000 rooms. Golden Tulip Aesthetics is the only international brand chain hotel in Miaoli County. Hotel is built in Baroque architecture and possesses 191 exquisite guest rooms. It is situated opposite a 33,000 square meters of scenery park and walking distance to Northern Miaoli Art Center. Plus outdoor European courtyard garden, hotel distributes an atmosphere of European nobles’ residence. The low tone luxury style is the best choice for visitors when stay in Miaoli.1962, Golden Tulip created in the Netherlands. 1975, Golden Tulip was a jointed venture with KLM Royal Dutch Airlines. 1993, Golden Tulip introduces Tulip Inn, its economy brand. 2006, Golden Tulip introduces Royal Tulip, its 5-star brand. 2009, Golden Tulip is acquired by Starwood Capital Group, and a strategic alliance is signed with Louvre Hotels. Golden Tulip becomes No. 2 hotel group in Europe by scale, operates 1,554 hotels in 54 countries, and number of rooms has exceeds 120,000 rooms. It is estimated that total number of hotels will exceed 2,000 hotels in year 2022.Integrated with the soothing hotel environments, forming an atmosphere of warmth, sense of ease, of being at home.At the same time, allowing business travelers to work in a leisurable setting.Miaoli Maison de Chine Hotel will present itself to be the first choice to stay for all purposes in the Miaoli area. Located at the intersection of Jhunan and Toufen urban, in a hottest commercial sections of re-zoned land, beside Gongyuan Road, facing Wan Ping Sports Park, right beside the Auditorium organ land, a notable landmark, access to 30 m Yongjhen Road and 50 m Zhongyang Road, and others, close to National Highway 1, National Highway 3, Taiwan Highway No 1, and No. 13 and other roads and rail systems, has a perfect convenient transportation network. Business travelers, domestic or international, can simply use public transportation to solve transportation problems. Shuttle between Chunan Science Park and the Hotel takes only 5-10 minutes drive. Whether for business trip or stay for leisure activities in attractions of Hsinchu and Miaoli areas, the Hotel has the convenience of transportation.

stays.name: Zhi Baishan Motel
stays.description: Zhi Baishan Motel is right in front of the Zhunan Station, Miaoli. If you turn right on the Guangfu Rd. and keep going for approx. 1km, you can see our motel. The location of Zhi Baishan Motel is in the vicinity of the Zhunan Industrial Park, Guangyuan Science Park and Zhunan Science Park and conveniently connects to the Sun Yat-sen Freeway, Formosa Freeway and West Coast Expressway. The graceful and peaceful environment is your best choice for traveling and going on business trip to Zhunan, Miaoli. Zhi Baishan Motel is built with reinforced concrete construction and meets every possible fire safety standard. The rooms are well-equipped, including whirlpool tubs for two, heating/cooling air conditioning and free WiFi. Welcome you to experience our kind services and clean environment by yourself. There are numerous scenic spots around Zhi Baishan Motel , such as Dahu strawberry garden, Mingte Dam, Tai'an Hot Spring, Lavender CottAge, Shangrila Paradise, Nanjhuang Scenic Area, Shitou Mountain, Taiwan Beer Factory, Cihyu Temple, Longfeng Temple, Wugu Temple, Tung-Hsiao West-Educational Sea World, Flying Cow Ranch, Sihfang Ranch, Qiding Haishui Yuchang, West Coast Wind Farm, Nanliao Harbor, etc. You can taste fresh sea food and admire sunset at Longfeng Harbor at the end of the day.

stays.name: HOTEL FORMOSA
stays.description: Hotel Formosa is an investment of parent company Hongdart Automation. As Hongdart’s painting equipment business has stabilized in Taiwan and Mainland China in recent years, Hongdart decided to cross over into the operation of a business and tourism hotel. Hongdart returned to its hometown and do its part in investing and creating employment opportunities. The name Hotel Formosa symbolizes happiness and joy. The hotel is 8 stories tall, with 149 exquisitely designed rooms and open air courtyard. The hotel aims to provide highest taste and most sincere service to touch the hearts of each traveler, which was why a formerly prosperous location on Bishan Rd was selected for renovation. Happiness, joy, exquisite taste, and traditional innovation are our business philosophies in hopes to bring the best accommodation, hospitality, and moving service to visitors.

stays.name: E-HUO GARDEN
stays.description: E-huo Garden Lemon Lodge — A Refreshing Retreat in the Heart of NatureNestled in the scenic countryside of Guoxing Township, Nantou County, E-huo Garden Lemon Lodge is a unique rural getaway that blends eco-friendly living, wellness experiences, and the refreshing charm of organic lemons. Operated by Yuan Chu Agricultural Biotechnology Co., Ltd., the lodge is part of a broader vision to promote sustainable agriculture and farm-based tourism.Surrounded by lemon orchards and lush greenery, E-huo Garden offers visitors more than just a place to stay — it invites them to experience the life and vitality of an organic lemon farm. Guests can enjoy seasonal farm-to-table tastings, therapeutic lemon-based workshops, and guided tours showcasing circular agriculture practices that reuse agricultural byproducts.Whether you are seeking a peaceful retreat, a hands-on farm experience, or inspiration for a healthier, more sustainable lifestyle, E-huo Garden Lemon Lodge provides a welcoming space where nature, health, and hospitality come together.

stays.name: Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: Every traveler hopes to stay in a clean and comfortable space, to allow body and spirit to relax completely. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay provides different styles of accommodation experience, including Red Promise in floral images, Golden Kingdom, exotic Season Rain, Bali Sentiment, Blue Rhapsody, Green Forest and Green Bodhi which love the forest phytoncides. Dream allows travelers to enjoy quality and romantic accommodation in the peaceful and simple town. Besides providing quality accommodation and cozy public spaces, the hospitable owner treats every guest as his own family and friend, offering delicious and healthy breakfast prepared using local agricultural products, allowing every guest to feel like being at home and have a memorable journey to Nantou before heading towards the next journey. Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay is at about 500 meters and a 7-minute walk from the train station, it only takes about 40-minute drive to famous international tourist attractions such as Sun Moon Lake, Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village and Xitou; popular sites such as Houtanching Recreational Area (Sky of Star Month), Fongguiedou in Sinyi Township, Paper Dome in Puli, and Checheng are all within the vicinity as well with convenient traffic connections. It is suitable for friends or family outings to experience the different seasonal natural sentiments, including plum blossom in winter, cherry blossom in spring, fireflies in summer and maple leaves in fall, to enjoy the fun time of the Slow Life. The meaning of traveling is to make the most heart-moving documentation of places you have been to, it may be magnificent sceneries, or may be folk customs you came in contact with; regardless of your intention for traveling, Da Ziran Xiuxian Homestay hopes that every traveler visiting here may return fully packed with happy memories!

stays.name: Hotel Jiji+
stays.description: Located in Nan Baoyi Village, the new brand of leisure tourism "Jiji Railway Travel" is based on the core concept of integrating local cultural characteristics and customizing the creation of professional hotels. "Jiji Railway Travel" is 300 meters away from the famous scenic spot "Jiji Railway Station". It is a hotel brand that combines exquisite design with parent-child travel. It has a classic gray appearance and a slightly European-style building, which seems to be full of history and stories. , complementing each other with the century-old "Jiji Railway Station". In the simple design style, we do not forget to show a comfortable and elegant atmosphere through complementary, contrasting and low-color tones, and combine it with local imagery: railways, mountains, countryside... and other natural materials, through the designer's skillful hand , creating ingenious public spaces and guest rooms. "Jiji Railway Travel" not only provides us with a hotel, but also provides every traveler with a place full of memories. You can immerse yourself comfortably in the hotel space and experience roaming in Jiji town with ease, forgetting the daily hard work and worries. Exploring Jiji Town allows travelers to have resonance and cultural exchanges in the process. It also combines the railway culture with a space of childlike memories, hoping that parents, children and travelers can have an unforgettable and beautiful memory.

stays.description: Jiji Bazhang B&B is located at the intersection of Minsheng Road and Bazhang Street, Jiji Township. Bazhang B&B is just 800 meters from Jiji Station, has convenient transportation to go to every attraction in Jiji. Because it is close to the city center, at night, you can stroll Jiji image circle, or shopping, or sample the local cuisine. During the Spring Festival, you can enjoy a cup of coffee on Mayor. If you travel to Jiji, please choose to stay in Jiji Bazhang B&B to experience the simplicity of this small Town, and it will give you a feeling of "a small country but not too small," because everything is so convenient.

stays.name: Ji Ji Shui Yuan Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: Jiji Shuiyuan B&B is located behind the Jiji Station. Being in the back of the train station has a lot of advantages. It avoids the noise coming from the busy Jiji Road, and the rooms are quiet. Transportation is very convenient as Jiji Road is within walking distance from the B&B. Jiji Shuiyuan B&B is situated among farmlands with an unobstructed broad open view. Mt. Jiji and the Lugu Mountain Range can be seen in the distance. The towering mountains contrasting against the blue sky and lush green farmland is delightful and picturesque. The B&B has rooms for couples and for a family of four. The bright and comfortable guestrooms are furnished with simple and modern furnitures and decorations. The furnishings are nicely coordinated, making the rooms warm and inviting. There is also a large open space equipped with a barbeque area available for guests to enjoy the country lifestyle. The spacious and beautiful outdoor space is perfect for families, friends and couples to hang out. Fresh organic fruits grown in the garden are also served for breakfast. You can explore the ecology in the area with your kids or take your loved ones for a stroll in the farmland. It& #39;s quite romantic.

stays.name: Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel
stays.description: "Jiji& #39;s Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (registered hotel number 095 under the Nantou County) is the only legally registered hotel in town. We accept the Taiwan Traveler Card. Boasting the latest facilities and an environment comparable to star-rated hotels, we provide free Wifi networks at all of our rooms. (You& #39;ll need your own phone, tablet or laptop to access the Internet) "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (formerly Jiji Resorts) is located on the Chenggong Rd., Jiji Township and right across Jiji Junior High School. The hotel is only 600 m from Jiji Railway Station and a 2-minute ride or 8-minute walk away from Jiji Old Street, highly convenient whether by public or private transport. In the front of the hotel stands Jiji Junior High School kindly built by Buddhist Compassion Relief Tzu Chi Foundation after the 921 earthquake of 1999. The campus is peaceful and beautiful. Our mountain view covers Big Jiji Mountain and Lion& #39;s Head Mountain surrounding by the vast greenness and bathed in fresh air. The nearby fields of the Ho Ping community are planted with a wide area of sunflower and cosmos. The loft suite offers a direct view of Ji-Lu Bridge, a cable-stayed bridge spanning 240 m wide. The bridge spanning connecting the two townships of Jiji and Lugu is the complementary work of the Jiji Dam, costing TWD 850 million . It& #39;s also the first cable-stayed bridge in Nantou County that connects the vital transportation network between Shuili, Jiji and Lugu! "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel" is far better than its competitors by offering more than 20 rooms. With the advantages of room interior design and conference venue capable of accommodating up to 100 people, we are the only option in Jiji when it comes to company or group tours and meetings! "Mountain Fish Water Boutigue Hotel (formerly Jiji Resorts) is located closely to the Jiji Township Swimming Pool. The pool is an eye-catching attraction with itsnatural spring water coming straight from Big Jiji Mountain and its area of 3,300 sqm. In addition, brand-new recreational facilities including glass SPA house, massage pool, children pool with a water slide and fashionable dining area have been set up for your convenience and enjoyment. P.S. the pool is closed in winter and during maintenance days in summer. Remember to consult the front desk before booking! The simple atmosphere of a humble country town coexist with the luxury and hospitality of an urban environment... If you have any queries for your trip, please contact us at 049-2761000.

stays.name: Pingguo De Jia Du Jia Homestay
stays.description: Apple Home Bed and Breakfast is located in Jiji Township, a short walk from the Jiji train station. Conveniently situated, it is close to Mingxin Academy, Green Tunnel, the Endemic Species Research Institute, and Wuchang Temple. The building is an imposing 4-story building made of steel-reinforced concrete, the only bed and breakfast in Jiji with elevator service. The villa is surrounded by greenery, and the spacious suite rooms feature balconies and French windows. At night, the stars and gentle breeze add to the atmosphere, but guests should take care to stay warm. The breeze, bringing fresh air, stops the next morning when the sun rises, as it is a phenomenon caused by the convergence of hot and cold air from the mountains and plains. One of the best features of this independent structure is phytoncides, which blow in during the evening if the windows are left slightly open.

stays.name: GINKGO HOTEL
stays.description: At 243 km of Taichung Highway No. 2 (National Freeway No. 3), exit at Jhushan (Zhushan) interchange and turn right towards the direction of Xitou, Lugu (Nantou Highway 151), pass "Chuxiang Bridge," along the mountain road, pass Lugu Towansjip--the home of tea. Along the way you will find there are over one hundred tea houses, and you may pick a tea house to enjoy tea or chat with people there about tea. (At 13 km) there lies a Neihu Elementary School, it has wooden school buildings, which are very rare and worth a visit. Arriving here, it is easy to feel the natural coolness, which is the result of the vast forests. Proceed to (18 km), pass "Moso Bamboo Highway," then you have arrived Xitou. The beauty of Xitou is in the mist, which is cool and pleasant. At the entrance of Xitou Nature Education Park, there is an "Moso Avenue", beside the avenue a "poetry corridor." A "Gigantic Bamboo" of 6 floors high is the world's tallest Dendrocalamus giganteus Munro. Next, go to "Ginkgo Tea Garden,", in the garden you find "Ginkgo Hotel." Xitou is also a special zone for Moso bamboos, Ginkgo Hotel in Chinese is named "Meng Zong", the name after one of 24 filial sons in Chinese history. The Hotel used to be a three-story building, each story is designed for having 24 rooms; therefore a total of 72 rooms. The number of 72 rooms sounds matching the stories of"24 sons of Filial Piety and 72 Virtuous," to shine on the historic events. The business philosophy of Ginkgo Hotel focuses on implementing of "elegant, cordial, and attentive" qualities for creating the most friendly ambience. Ginkgo Hotel is endeavored to keeping 3-star rating quality honor. Xitou is about 1000-1650 meters in elevation and enjoys spectacular views of multitudinous morning sunshine and multifarious evening overcasts. From the sky roof of Ginkgo Hotel, you can overlook Xitou's panoramic view. Guest rooms are decorated with specially produced Moso bamboos providing charcoal air purification, and other charcoal supplies, which obtain a high satisfaction rating. For 40 years, Ginkgo Hotel has served over one million visitors, scholars Yafang specially selected Mr. Zhang Daxiu's poems of Xitou, hired calligraphers Mr. Chen Lianzhong to write the poems on ancient cypress boards for exhibitions, sharing the masterpieces of cultural and creative productions with staying tourists. After the 921 earthquake reconstruction, each floor is designed to have 18 rooms, and the building has 4 stories; therefore, it has a total of 72 rooms. We prepare foods with local flavors and support the concepts of maintaining good health, diligently keeping our star-rated quality, and launching new services. Ginkgo coffee, fun of making tea, listening Xitou story. "Bamboo grilled rice" and "rice with dried bamboo shoots fast food" are innovative. Xitou is a suitable place for enjoying your vacation, fitness activities, nourishing the mind and body, temporary stay, and relaxing life. Colleagues of Ginkgo Hotel would be happy to provide you depth interpretation services, accompany you strolling in the mysterious forests of Xitou, elegantly experiencing the beauty of Xitou and the quality of Ginkgo Hotel services.

stays.name: Jijivellage villa B & B
stays.description: Natou｜Jiji Village B&BA traditional courtyard farmhouse where time temporarily stands stillAs you pass over the Jilu Bridge, cross farmers’ fields, and survey the rolling hills, the distracting thoughts in your mind all dissipate. In a moment, you seem to transcend space and time, returning to olden days where you encounter a traditional courtyard farmhouse, majestic in its old age and exuding the genuine ambiance of 1950s Taiwan. You feel as though you’ve walked into the type of picturesque pastoral landscape described in ancient Chinese poetry. Jiji Village B&B possesses a sunny verdancy, the courtyard of a mountain getaway, and host Mr. Liu’s love of the land.Deeply felt memories of childhoodYou and your friends disembark and put both feet on the soft, grassy ground as sunlight shines through lattice covered with loofah gourd vines. You pass through the wooden front doors surrounded by spring couplets, and admire the red brick walls which bear the traces of passing time. “Come right in and have a seat!” You hear Mr. Liu’s friendly welcome as a small, yellow dog named Cachito greets you. The name Cachito originates from a Spanish folktale, and Mr. Liu regards Cachito as a gift from heaven.This spacious, modern three-building courtyard is full of layers. The sunlight and air from the front vestibule and rear courtyard are able to penetrate inside through large, wooden-framed windows, imprinting the window screens with numerous beautiful silhouettes. The huge space is divided by wooden panels and doors, and to both sides, the refreshing greenery of potted plants is seen along the hinoki promenades of the left and right buildings. The entire space encourages you to slow your pace and wander leisurely around, taking in the scenery.A true reflection of the 1950sFrom the roof beams inside to the steps in the courtyard, from the low stone walls to the courtyard well, entering this house of wood and stone is like stepping into the childhood memories of Mr. and Mrs. Liu. According to Mr. Liu, “Wood and stone are two key elements here at Jiji Village B&B, because the veins in the stone and the grain of the wood are respectively identical inside and outside. So, too, should be the mind of man and woman.” Mr. Liu hopes that all travelers who visit here can perceive the sincerity which this building emits. Pushing open the rosewood screen doors and heading to the second-floor rooms, the floorboards creaking underfoot are reminiscent of childhood days chasing siblings up and down the halls and stairs. Jiji Village offers three guest rooms in old fashioned styles. The walls of the Taiwan Fir Tree Country-Style Room are constructed from Chinese fir, and the woody aroma permeates the room. The Japanese Tatami Room is exceedingly comfortable. Yet the most romantic of all is the Classic Chinese Canopy Bed Room. Mr. Liu searched far and wide to find this traditional bed. The room is also furnished with an ornately carved dresser, embroidered red pillows, and an antique gramophone phonograph player, creating a romantic dreamland for you and your lover.A traditional farmhouse infused with modernityBeneath a single yellow light bulb, Mr. and Mrs. Liu prepare dinner beside the traditional wood burning kitchen hearth. Mr. Liu cheerfully carries out plate after plate of authentic vegetable and meat dishes; juicy bamboo shoot with meat, organic loofah gourd fresh from the garden, braised bean and pork, and healthy burdock consommé, all made with love. After the meal, you chat over the tea table off to one side of the dining room, admiring the traditional Taiwanese tea spread and delicate ceramic teaware. Mr. Liu also has a traditional Japanese tea spread with tatami seating. Hollows in the floor allow you to extend your legs comfortably as the moon shines through the windows and reflects off the tea in your cup. You walk out into the courtyard to appreciate the tranquil evening and the cool, countryside air. The summer sun, just like a farmer, rises early, illuminating the bright green lawn in the courtyard. Waking to the shadows dancing in the passion fruit orchard outside your window, you walk spritely downstairs to find that Mrs. Liu has prepared a sumptuous breakfast of refreshing salad and rice milk, reminding you of the happiness to be found in simple things.After retiring from the air force, Mr. Liu felt homesick and so decided to return to his childhood home in Nantou and start a guesthouse business. He could not have anticipated that he would encounter the devastating Jiji earthquake which rocked Taiwan on the 21st of September, 1999. That traumatic event did not dishearten Mr. Liu, instead inspiring him to begin the activity of “Orally Recounting History” where he did relief work to aid those affected by the disaster. He and Mrs. Liu set up a vendor’s stall selling Job’s tear milk on the street, using their love of their homeland to get back on their feet. First, they opened a restaurant based on all of the old, traditional recipes they could find by interviewing the local elders, inviting travelers to taste the local flavors of Jiji. Yet they never forgot their original intention to open a guesthouse. Thus, after opening their restaurant and winery, they devoted themselves wholeheartedly to the operation of their guesthouse, a road that they have walked together, supporting one another all the way, using past frustrations to nurture their aspirations. They based their blueprints upon childhood memories, inviting travelers into their traditional courtyard farmhouse, to enjoy tranquility, happiness, and contentment.

Waking to the shadows dancing in the passion fruit orchard outside your window, you walk spritely downstairs to find that Mrs. Liu has prepared a sumptuous breakfast of refreshing salad and rice milk, reminding you of the happiness to be found in simple things.After retiring from the air force, Mr. Liu felt homesick and so decided to return to his childhood home in Nantou and start a guesthouse business. He could not have anticipated that he would encounter the devastating Jiji earthquake which rocked Taiwan on the 21st of September, 1999. That traumatic event did not dishearten Mr. Liu, instead inspiring him to begin the activity of “Orally Recounting History” where he did relief work to aid those affected by the disaster. He and Mrs. Liu set up a vendor’s stall selling Job’s tear milk on the street, using their love of their homeland to get back on their feet. First, they opened a restaurant based on all of the old, traditional recipes they could find by interviewing the local elders, inviting travelers to taste the local flavors of Jiji. Yet they never forgot their original intention to open a guesthouse. Thus, after opening their restaurant and winery, they devoted themselves wholeheartedly to the operation of their guesthouse, a road that they have walked together, supporting one another all the way, using past frustrations to nurture their aspirations. They based their blueprints upon childhood memories, inviting travelers into their traditional courtyard farmhouse, to enjoy tranquility, happiness, and contentment.

stays.name: Lailai Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: Xiaobantian Lailai Xiuxian Homestay is located in the Xiaobantian area of Lugu Township in Nantou County. The B&B and its gardens occupy an area of about 6600 square meters, offering a secluded and relaxing sanctuary that is furnished with multi-functional recreational (activity) centers, floricultural nurseries, oolong tea nurseries, relaxing tea appreciation areas, BBQ areas, DIY cooking areas, sandbox and playgrounds, and stargazing lawns. The Park is close to Xitou, Monster Village, National Fenghuanggu Bird Park, and Sunlin River. Other destinations such as Sky Ladder, Zinangong (Zinan Temple), Downtown Jiji, and Sun Moon Lake are only a 40 to 50-minute drive away. This is the perfect destination for a weekend getaway for those who dream of basking in forests and wholesome phytoncides of Xitou Sunlin River. Guest rooms are divided into: Cozy Room (for 2), Warm Family Room (for 4), Luxurious Room (for 2), and Joyful Group Cabin (for 6). Furnishings are brand-new and designed for comfort and provide a clean and elegant atmosphere. Couples, parents and children, and entire families will experience great fun with us!

stays.description: About Mingshan Forest Resort - The M VillageMingshan Forest Resort is located next to the Xitou Nature Education Area in Nantou.(Original name: Mingshan Hotel, Mingshan Villa)It is surrounded by the towering fir forest and unique flora and fauna of the National Taiwan University Experimental Forest.Provide tourist accommodation, sightseeing experience, business district market and other services.The guest rooms in the building area are divided into Building 1, Building 2, Building 3 and Broadway Building.Provide comfortable accommodation space and guest activities.There are also a limited number of escape rooms and secret treasure rooms where you can experience being a little detective and crack clues to solve mysteries.In addition to the building area, there are also twenty forest cabins of different styles.The independent wooden houses are surrounded by fir forests, full of phytoncides.Blending with the forest and being one with the earth, it is so beautiful.About the Matsubayashi shopping districtThe Songlin-cho shopping district is a shopping street affiliated with the Mingshan Forest Hall.There are more than 20 different businesses settled in the square, and there are also resident artists performing in the square.It was established in 2009 with the theme of Japanese architecture and was named "Matsubayashi Town".To commemorate the founder, Songlin Shengyi (Songlin Shengyi was a name during the Japanese occupation period, his real name was Lin Shan)Thanks to the widespread introduction of bloggers and influencers on the Internet, Songlin Town has become a popular tourist attraction in Xitou.The streets and landscapes of the town are decorated with big red torii gates, Japanese-style buildings, and big red lanterns.Travelers who come to Xitou to stay overnight can experience the special mysterious atmosphere under the big red lanterns.The chef of [Laosonglin Cake Shop] in the shopping street has created many special souvenirs, such as Xitou Cake and Ginkgo Cake.The famous Kubota Bakery commemorates the precious foreign friendship between Katsuichi Matsubayashi and his Japanese friend Kubota.Among them, the signature product "Bite the Cat Bread" has repeatedly caused queues and is a hot seller.After Songlin Town was officially established in Xitou, it has been holding a series of holiday and festival activities on a regular basis.In July, commonly known as the Ghost Month, the Demon Festival and Demon Festival are held.During Halloween, we will hold a Halloween Carnival and invite everyone to join us in making fun of others and spreading candy.During the Chinese New Year, a mountain god festival was held to celebrate the harvest and express respect for nature.Pray for peace and happiness to those who come to this land!A variety of rich activities and experiences have successfully attracted the general public to visit Matsubayashi.Dreams and construction are ongoing. We welcome you to come here and spend time with us.

stays.name: Pu Su Garden Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: Reasonably priced accommodation in B&B is hard to find, but Pusu Garden Bed and Breakfast provides surprisingly good value with a clean, simple and comfortable accommodation for guests to enjoy and experience the countryside living. Pusu is a perfect getaway for a short break from bustling city. Conscientious selection of domestic cooking ingredients for breakfast is our preference. Pusu serves traditional Taiwanese-style breakfast with seasonal vegetables and fruits. To provide a healthy, local and seasonal food is our goal and fulfillment. Such as rice porridge with sweet potato, its simple, yet distinctly homey flavor fascinates every customer. Moreover, Pusu provides homemade CIABATTA sandwiches, fresh blended sugar-free drinks and seasonal fruits for breakfast during vegetables low season.We plant small amount of large-leafed black tea and coffee by nature farming. They are growing in rough open field without any chemical fertilizer and herbicide. Farming is a painstaking job, yet we enjoy it and will persist. By farming we touch the soil, perceive the blessing and the harvest from the Mother Nature that reminds us to be modest and always cherish all we have. During your stay we will share our nature farming black tea and coffee with you and they are also available for our guests to purchase as featured local farm gifts.

stays.name: Sakura Villa
stays.description: Sakura Villa welcomes you with the warmest smile and most relaxing environment. Located in the quiet, leisurely Xiaobantian Community, the building was carefully and holistically designed and constructed by professional woodwork and landscape designers based on the surrounding environment, creating a comfortable, secure, warm, and relaxing wooden building accommodation. Convenient for tourism, it is located near tourist spots such as Xitou, Monster Village, and Sun Link Sea, being your best choice for quality and service. In this place of countryside friendliness, visitors can experience a relaxing, leisurely pace of life. Appreciate the azure sky, verdant forest, rich ecology, carefully designed courtyard, and rare moment of leisure. Relax, let go of stress, and enjoy a cup of sweet, refreshing Oolong tea with the friendly owner. Or gather with a few friends for drinking, chatting, and laughter. Daydream as you watch the carefree fish swimming by, or gaze up at a sky full of stars…all you need to do is relax and enjoy.

stays.name: Sitou Flora& #39;s House B&B
stays.description: Accompanied by the golden sunset and charming night scenes, the hostel “StarMoonValley” is well- known for its impressive wide-open view of Tung-ting Mountain, especially the view goes with bright shining among the valley whenever lamps are lighting at night. What’s more, you can watch the fantastic magic show of cloud-sea just in front of the hostel, especially in the summer raining days, the constantly changing cloud sea covers up the hill where bamboos and green teas living in, making the landscapes even more attractive to people.When you’re away from the city and stop by “StarMonnValley” hostel at night , you can enjoy this very moment with peaceful tranquility that the noises of city becomes a far-off murmur while the only sound echoes in the hill is the whisper of gentle wind responding to the fascinating Moonrise. Whenever you walk down to the hillside, you can easily catch up with the charming night-scene and overlooking the entire panorama view of Lugu Township. “Memory is the treasure of mind”, that’s what the host of hostel believing in and looking forward to sharing good things in life with whoever comes here. In this case, to offer great life experience in tasting every subtle of happiness that we made for every privileged you here in “StarMoonValley”, is always, and will be our primary pursuit and persistence for good in the future.Come to us and take a closer look, you’ll find another way home here!

stays.name: Tingtau Villa
stays.description: Our villa is located 3 kilometers from the front of the Xitou Forest Recreation Park, a 5 minute drive by car. Featuring an excellent natural environment of mountains and forest, it borders Beishi Stream, the main one in Xitou, with the name “Tingtau” being derived from the babbling sound of the water. During your holidays and weekends, come to this otherworldly paradise and enjoy the forest bath and phytoncides of Xitou and Sun Link Sea. In addition to providing accomodation, Tingtau Villa includes a restaurant (capable of holding 200 people), featuring experienced chefs who carefully prepare delicious cuisine using mountain produce and wild vegetables – an original flavor of home that never fails to win the praise of customers! Come sample famous dishes such as our rice with bamboo shoots, rice with bamboo shoots and braised pork, freshly-caught trout, fresh local vegetables, and rich coconut milk, providing energy for the next day’s journey!

stays.name: VICTORIA MANOR
stays.description: "VICTORIA MANOR" has a white wall with rose marks. With the golden gate and spacious courtyard, you may feel as if you were in an European manor. The white wall and gray tiles with the blue sky and green land are fresh and elegant. When you walk into the lobby, every corner will surprise you! The Manor is surrounded by mountains and forests with a sea of clouds. When it is shrouded with mists, it looks like a lady with white silks standing in forests. You may quietly watch natural beautiful sceneries and sit in the courtyard. You may enjoy yourself so much as to forget to go home in the mountains and forests. Hear the ambient sound of birds and insects and travel in the mountains and forests. With clouds and mists in the mountains and sunrise, you may forget all worries. You are far away from cities and live in mountains. This is a luxurious experience. When you in the Manor, the gorgeous European palace style makes you feel as if you were at Musée du Louvre in Paris. You can see the Ingenuity and taste.

stays.name: Xin Lailai Homestay
stays.description: Xiaobantian Lailai Xiuxian Homestay is located in the Xiaobantian area of Lugu Township in Nantou County. The Residence and its gardens occupy an area of about 6500 square meters, offering a secluded and relaxing sanctuary that is furnished with multi-functional recreational (activity) centers, floricultural nurseries, oolong tea nurseries, leisurely tea appreciation area, BBQ area, DIY cooking areas, sandbox and play areas, and stargazing lawns. The Park is close to Xitou, Monster Village, National Fenghuanggu Bird Park, and Sunlin River. Other destinations such as Sky Ladder, Zinangong (Zinan Temple), Downtown Jiji, and Sun Moon Lake are only a 40 to 50-minute drive away. This is the perfect destination for a weekend getaway for those who dream of basking in forests and phytoncides of Xitou Sunlin River. Guest rooms are divided into: Cozy Room (for 2), Warm Family Room (for 4), Luxurious Room (for 2), and Joyful Group Cabin (for 6). Furnishings are brand new and designed for comfort and provide a clean and elegant atmosphere. Couples, parents and children, and entire families will experience great fun with us! English

stays.name: Yecai Yuan Homestay
stays.description: Xitou B&B: Wild Vegetable Garden B&B is located on the Xiaobantian Scenic Route, and is the 214th legal B&B in Nantou. Surrounded by rolling green hills, the B&B& #39;s grounds are lush with flowers and verdant greenery. Strolling along the paved paths, you& #39;ll find butterflies fluttering to the sounds of birds and insects—a truly immersive rural holiday awaits…Xitou B&B: Wild Vegetable Garden B&B is a unique and popular local B&B. The owners, a husband and wife family, are farmers who have professionally created a refined, pollution-free organic greenhouse farm. The farm boasts nearly a hundred varieties of organic fruits and vegetables, all grown without pesticides or chemical fertilizers. stays.name: ShuangLiou B&B
stays.description: Shuangliu Leisure B&B in Nantou is a government approved operation known for its high standards and close proximity to many tourist attractions. This perfect establishment was created by a retired judge and his wife. Though far away from the hustle and bustle, transportation is very convenient. The nearby Mingjian Interchange is only a 6-minute car ride away, while a trip to the Nantou city center and Jiji Town takes 15 minutes. You can easily get to various attractions in Nantou when you stay at Shuangliu Leisure B&B. Facing three rivers with two streams running pass it, the 7,601 meters of terraced terrain is the ideal location that the owners had been searching for. There is a mountain spring water pond designated for a variety of fresh water fish. The 297 meters of net-enclosed organic vegetable garden provides most of the vegetables needed to prepare meals in the B&B, and is the perfect place for visitors to experience the joy of farming. In addition, the big green lawn provides a great space for families and friends to relax or play in the outdoors.
