stays.name: One City One Vacation Farm
stays.description: Located on the outskirts of Nantou City, A Peak, A Stay sits at the geographical center of Taiwan. It is just a 15-minute drive from the nearest freeway exit, making it an ideal venue for gatherings from all over the island. Nestled within the Bagua Mountain Scenic Area, it boasts beautiful landscapes and expansive views. Popular tourist attractions such as Sunny Hills Pineapple Cake Museum, Zhongxing New Village, and the Sky Bridge are only a 10 to 15-minute drive away. It also serves as a rest stop along the Tongyuan Irrigation Canal Cycling Trail, allowing travelers to explore nearby attractions at their leisure or enjoy a relaxing bike ride along the scenic paths."A Peak, A Stay" features a spacious estate surrounded by exceptional natural beauty. Guests can admire panoramic views of the Central Mountain Range, Jiji Dashan, the Jioujiou Peaks, and Hehuanshan. At dawn, the 180-degree vista offers a breathtaking sunrise, as the golden sun rises above the mountains, casting brilliant light across the misty white sea of clouds — a sight so stunning it leaves visitors in awe.The homestay is located within a leisure farm in Nantou and is equipped with a multifunctional activity plaza, outdoor café seating, al fresco dining areas, large outdoor event spaces, an organic farming experience area, restaurant, observation deck, pavilion, DIY agricultural workshop facilities, ecological pond, barbecue and kiln-cooking zone, and an herb garden. With its wide range of recreational spaces and facilities, it’s perfect not only for couples and families seeking a countryside getaway, but also for organizations and large groups looking to host events and gatherings.

stays.name: Alley Houses
stays.description: "Alley House" B&B is located in the city center of Puli Township, Nantou County, offering a comfortable and convenient accommodation experience. Each room is equipped with windows, a private bathroom, air conditioning, a TV, and a refrigerator, ensuring a private and cozy stay for guests.In terms of transportation, the B&B is about a 10-minute drive from the Ailan Interchange. For bus travelers, you can get off at the Puli Winery Station and walk about 3 minutes to reach the B&B, making it very convenient. There are also plenty of amenities nearby, with Starbucks and 85°C just around the corner. Within a 2-minute walk, you’ll find popular local breakfast spots like Qing Bao Salty Fried Dough and City Burger. stays.name: Bear Meets Moose B&B
stays.description: Nantou｜Bear Meets MooseThe unparalleled cuteness of a Japanese zakka-style guesthouseWe’re really lost this time! Various guesthouse signs stand along either side of the road in Taomi Village, yet our fabled super-cute destination is nowhere to be found. Turning this way and that on the country lanes, we finally arrive at the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. No wonder we got lost. They purposely have no sign!Dreamlike hosts straight out of Japanese mangaYou enter the pink building of the Bear Meets Moose guesthouse. Spacious, warm and bright, the style is rustic Japanese and there is a smell of cinnamon in the air. Light-colored wooden bookshelves hold all kinds of cute miscellaneous goods. Of course, the leading characters of this guesthouse - bear and moose - are hiding in every corner! No matter if it’s armwrestling moose and black bear, or white bears with moose antlers designed by the guesthouse owner, each wears a welcoming smile just for you!The most unexpected thing is that this cute, dreamlike, fairytale guesthouse is actually the creation of two grown boys, Jerry and Ethan. Jerry’s nickname is Tu-Tu-Ge (or Rabbit Brother), a reference to Tukisiro Yukito from the Japanese manga Cardcaptor Sakura. Both Jerry and Ethan appear as if they have just emerged from the kind of manga adored by young girls, with their fair, clear skin, eyes like crescent moons, and mouths always turned up at the corners in a smile.Afternoon tea prepared by the hosts is ready and waiting for you, but the best thing is that you get to choose your preferred mug from their rich and varied collections. Tea and handmade cookies are available around the clock here. You can even sign up for Jerry and Ethan’s own DIY dessert workshop, donning a cute apron in this cute house to make cute aromatic cookies together!A mansion fit for young ladiesBear Meets Moose is absolutely a mansion fit for young ladies; not a gold-and-jade kind of luxuriousness, but rather the kind of sweet and gorgeous environment that young girls dream of. A lavender-colored calico sofa furnishes the first floor common space, and a life-sized stuffed bear sits there awaiting your embrace. Even the wooden tree adorning the wall and ceiling spreads out overhead in layered shapes resembling a cloud, a butterfly and a heart!Each room is painted in tender colors, the favorite being the Tiffany blue room on the third floor where the ceiling is cut into diamond-shaped lines and adorned with a crystal light fixture. There is also the Rilakkuma room on the first floor where the doors are decorated with a big bear’s head and paws asking you to “give me five” before you enter. Furthermore, room and bathroom are furnished with a heater and a bed of the same quality as the Hilton hotel chain. Each and every guest is guaranteed a sweet night’s sleep.Joy fills the space inside and outYou wake up in the morning and push open the balcony doors. The sight of blue sky and green grass raises your spirits. Next, you go down stairs and find Jerry and Ethan working together to make the breakfast of your choice: a savory American-style meal, sweet banana and chocolate waffles, or toast and homemade jam. Breakfast is served with hot tea or coffee, giving the day a sumptuous and delightful start. After breakfast, walk out into the vast outdoor park area and discover even more pleasant surprises. Apart from the ecological pond and the four-seasons pathway, there is even a pool shaped like a cupid’s heart. Near the pool is a spacious barbecue area with the option to order barbecued suckling pig. Time flies in such a place, but each moment leaves a cheerful memory.

stays.name: Beimei
stays.description: The owner is a person who loves to travel, but the cost of accommodation is generally high nowadays, so he built an affordable and quality B&B. Beimei B&B is very suitable for backpackers to travel independently, and is a good place for couples and families to travel together. The B&B is located in Beimei Community, where the pace of life is comfortable and the environment is quiet. It is the best vacation choice for travelers and their families to get rid of the worries of work on weekdays. There have been farmlands in this area since ancient times, and the typical rural natural scenery. When you open the window, you can see the reflection of the mountains and paddy fields. The broad field of vision makes you feel relaxed and happy, making you feel deeply warm and comfortable."Beimei BEIMEI" is located near the second exit of National Highway 6, about an 8-minute drive away from Puli& #39;s famous attractions: Puli Distillery, 18 Degree C Chocolate Factory or National Jinan International University, Heads of State Pavilion, Taomi Ecological Village, Paper The church, Yue Lao Church, Nina Chocolate Castle and other attractions are all easily accessible. It is also close to Taiwan’s geographical center monument to experience flying with a paraglider, Hutou Mountain, Eagle Cave, Carp Pond, Liquidambar Forest, Zhongtai Zen Style and other famous attractions , a rest stop on the way from the popular Sun Moon Lake, Formosan Aboriginal Cultural Village, Hehuan Mountain, Aowanda, Qingjing and other spring-filled mountains and lakes, Beimei is definitely the best accommodation choice for you to visit the beautiful mountain city of Puli~ ~

stays.name: CHILL Homestay
stays.description: The journey toward realizing our dream started with preparing the land, one plant, tree, brick, and tile at a time, to create the bed and breakfast we have today. The outdoor area of 3,300 square meters has been carefully designed into an elegant and comfortable environment, and we invite you to experience a warm, romantic, leisurely and beautiful vacation, where your body, mind, and spirit can leave behind the hubub of the city and wander through the delights of nature. Room designs feature 8mm thick strengthened glass, thoughtfully utilized as theater-like viewing windows, giving guests the opportunity to casually enjoy the sunrise of Qilin Mountain and the evening sunset of Puli from the comfort of their rooms. Beautiful as a painting, the landscape is laid out before your eyes as your mood changes with the seasons, savoring that sweet feeling of quietude. The thoughtful owner has equipped rooms with real wood floors, closets, and dressing tables for a simple and refreshing layout, and of course he has taken into consideration the necessity for technology in modern life, including high quality plasma TVs and wireless Internet service so that guests can experience the simplicity and honesty of the countryside as well as surfing the Internet and staying connected with the times! Bathrooms come equipped with the most comfortable separate shower facilities and top-quality HCG lotus-shaped sinks. We’ve spared no expense to bring you name-brand toiletries, such as soap, toothpaste, shampoo, and body wash, in addition to providing blow dryers, razor blades, combs, shower caps, and slippers. Experience outstanding hotel quality at affordable prices!

stays.searchText: CHILL Homestay 闕麒景觀民宿 南投縣民宿481號 Nantou County Puli Township No.31, Dongrun Rd., Puli Township, Nantou County 545, Taiwan (R.O.C.) The journey toward realizing our dream started with preparing the land, one plant, tree, brick, and tile at a time, to create the bed and breakfast we have today. The outdoor area of 3,300 square meters has been carefully designed into an elegant and comfortable environment, and we invite you to experience a warm, romantic, leisurely and beautiful vacation, where your body, mind, and spirit can leave behind the hubub of the city and wander through the delights of nature. Room designs feature 8mm thick strengthened glass, thoughtfully utilized as theater-like viewing windows, giving guests the opportunity to casually enjoy the sunrise of Qilin Mountain and the evening sunset of Puli from the comfort of their rooms. Beautiful as a painting, the landscape is laid out before your eyes as your mood changes with the seasons, savoring that sweet feeling of quietude. The thoughtful owner has equipped rooms with real wood floors, closets, and dressing tables for a simple and refreshing layout, and of course he has taken into consideration the necessity for technology in modern life, including high quality plasma TVs and wireless Internet service so that guests can experience the simplicity and honesty of the countryside as well as surfing the Internet and staying connected with the times! Bathrooms come equipped with the most comfortable separate shower facilities and top-quality HCG lotus-shaped sinks. We’ve spared no expense to bring you name-brand toiletries, such as soap, toothpaste, shampoo, and body wash, in addition to providing blow dryers, razor blades, combs, shower caps, and slippers. Experience outstanding hotel quality at affordable prices!

stays.name: Chen Long
stays.description: A good place that has a safe, clean, warm home and garden landscaping, located near the Chung Tai Chan Monastery, and is a part of the tourism center. The father of the host constructed the house single-handedly, from design to construction, and with 20 years of construction experience, he carefully built this unique holiday wonderland. Cheng Long House is located in Puli Township, Nantou County, is the best place to stay in tourist centers. Cheng Long House is blessed with weather of four seasons and of sweet spring water. It is an open space villa with a European-style. The first and second floors have a seven-meter high-ceiling hall each, allowing you to instantly release the pressure in the urban jungle. The villa sits in the suburbs of Puli surrounded by mountains, air, sunlight, beautiful scenery. In Cheng Long House, you can enjoy the pleasure of taking a natural spring bath or enjoy the coziness of sipping a pot of tea, or a cup of coffee. At night, in the villa, you can listen to the birds singing and frogs wooing and the voice of the mountains played, as well as a few friends' hearty laughters, and you have long forgotten the existence of time and space. And, the rest is full of the feeling of warmth, accompanying your sleep. In addition, we have an own rural winery - Zhenglong Wineries. We use red cane of Puli and peace of Chingjing region in making wines, named Ganyuan and Taoxi, for a free wine-tasting of staying guests, as well as a greenhouse tomato garden, planting cherry tomatoes, offering guests fruit picking. (Minors do not drink) Remember to taste the roasted red cane offered by the host and experience the hospitality Puli. And with the local people's point of view, let you enjoy the beautiful mountain town of Puli.

stays.name: Ease Hotel
stays.description: The first boutique hotel of Ease Hotel Group was jointly designed by 5 interior designers renowned across the Strait. There are 18 VIP Villa rooms and 75 boutique business suites with stylish and exquisite spaces that are extremely beautiful than ever. Based on the concept of customer-centered design, the classic art and crafts of rooms that is innovative and overturns people’s imagination brings comfort, fashion and aesthetics together with a reinterpretation for building an iconic premium hotel in Puli.The understated and sophisticated façade was outlined by architects with the clever design of clean lines and a geometric touch that looks majestic and extraordinary.A total of 8598 materials were carefully selected and used on creating our hotel rooms. They were mixed and matched by designers to deliver wonderful views with creative sparkles.The handcrafted tailor-made furniture is fabulous in its shapes with a feeling of warmth. The carefully selected fabrics as well as the rare glossy design display a low-keyed luxury by themselves. Each piece of furniture has some place exclusively for it to shine. Our room is just like the king that needs furniture as his queen. Both of them are the important existence.The lighting with the refraction of crystal is stunning. It brings a sound of joy with a look of charm to the space by its eccentric shape. It allows travelers to recall all the wonderful details during the trip, have a beautiful dream and carry on their journeys.The story of travelers enjoying Puli in 2015 starts from here…

stays.name: FULL BLOSSOMS
stays.description: How can I let you meet me at my most beautiful moment? For this, I have prayed before Buddha for five hundred years, asking Buddha to grant us a predestined relationship. So Buddha transformed me into a tree, growing by the roadside you must pass. Under the sunlight, I carefully bloom, each flower a hope from my past life. When you approach, please listen closely; the trembling leaves are my passionate waiting. —Xi Murong, "A Flowering Tree"This is a love poem written by a poet to nature, and we use it as a metaphor for the welcoming sentiment. You are the traveler, I am the tree. Because meeting is not easy, I am cautious; to seek a predestined relationship, I bloom. For you, I carefully bloom.

How can I let you meet me at my most beautiful moment? For this, I have prayed before Buddha for five hundred years, asking Buddha to grant us a predestined relationship. So Buddha transformed me into a tree, growing by the roadside you must pass. Under the sunlight, I carefully bloom, each flower a hope from my past life. When you approach, please listen closely; the trembling leaves are my passionate waiting. —Xi Murong, "A Flowering Tree"This is a love poem written by a poet to nature, and we use it as a metaphor for the welcoming sentiment. You are the traveler, I am the tree. Because meeting is not easy, I am cautious; to seek a predestined relationship, I bloom. For you, I carefully bloom.

stays.name: Frog Grandma’’s Inn
stays.description: Creek is in front of my house, behind the house the hills, mountains on one side and water on the other. Insects buzz and birds chirp and they are everywhere. Floral aromas emit. No hubbub of the city, only mountains and waters, and filled with the fragrance of nature, and ears filled with the sounds of nature& #39;s call. Here, take a deep breath to relieve your physical and mental fatigue, here is the travelers& #39; warm home on their journey. Taumi Community in Puli is seemingly a barren marsh, a large depression of streams, but it has the largest frog species in Taiwan, damselflies and the largest number of fireflies, Grandma Frog--Wang Hui Mei was so plunge into the frog world. The host couple of "Grandma Frog Farm House" after working for a lifetime career and fatigued, they settled the fancy Taumi environment and choose to retire here. Wang Hui Mei originally engaged in teaching flower arrangement and site layout in Taichung, she has a unique sense of beauty and self-confidence, single-handedly led the B&B Planning and design of the room, but also unexpectedly surrender to frogs, birds and other small animals under innocence. Wiped off the makeup and took off costumes, dig in the pond bare-handed, and become Grandma Frog, Wang Hui Mei has no regret. Although called her Grandma Frog, she really is not old. It is the children call comes. But for understanding frogs and committed to it, that is her most vivid impression and joy of life .Both she and her daughter made a certificate for the narrator. She understands fully the voice of frogs, features, and characteristics. When talking about the fogs, she can speak on a subject with great familiarity, and a grin. Following their lead to observe frogs will be the most unforgettable memories of the stay. Grandma Frog Farm House, every lovely bits and pieces are all touching little stories. Perhaps you later will forget Grandma Frog of Puli Taumi, but I& #39;m sure you will not forget. The eco here ... and our story ... will give you a feeling of lifetime of memories ~

"Happyniuhome in Puli" provides you a cozy and clean accommodation and vast space for activities. The elegant, colorful and fresh decoration indoors combinedwith the green nature outdoor will warm your mind and bring you an unforgettable experience. It is filled with our passion and love here, and we sincerely welcome you to visit us!

stays.description: Puli Huì Lai Farm House is located in Taomi Eco-Village. It can be said that it occupies geographical advantages of the best environment. Rich in ecological resources and animals hiding in everywhere all will be the most common scene here. The scenery located within the farm is built with the original tree species and plants. You can find the animal protagonist, "frogs," of Taomi come and go from time to time in the village. If you are just interested in the frogs, then "Puli Huì Lai Farm House" will be a good place for you to dig the treasure Oh."Puli Huì Lai Farm House offers room types including two-person, four-person, and eight-person. Simply and tidy furnished rooms and the tranquility of a quiet peaceful environment, have greatly improved living comfort. Whether a guest room or shared living room, each room exudes all the comforts and leisure of a home; innkeepers use the gallery space of the second floor for scenic viewing and resting, in addition to chatting about, you can overlook the Jinan University and appreciate the beauty of the sunset."Puli Huì Lai Farm House has dozens of fruit trees planted in the space, if you staying coincides with production season, you can also enjoy complimentary fruit picking and tasting. It is recommended to enjoy the cold spring SPA pool, which was personally designed by the owner. However, please pay special attention. This is a wading pool suitable for adults and children alike, but only available during July to September each year. The hostess of Puli Huì Lai Farm House has a professional narrator& #39;s certification. Staying guests can enjoy free guided night tours, and she is also available for making a reservation of guided tours for groups.

stays.name: Jia Yuan Du Jia Homestay
stays.description: Jia Yuan B&B is located amid the green field and woods of Tao-Mi Eco-Village, and there are a lot of frogs, dragonflies, butterflies, birds here. In the night of April and May each year, there are fireflies lighting accompanying you. Jia Yuan B&B, in 1993, formally applied for a legal B&B. Because its quality has been recognized by many guests, they become good friends. Because Mr. Liao and Ms. Chen would like to make every staying friends enjoy even better holiday resort environment, they have invested more effort and thought in realizing the blueprint in their mind. The B&B offers three different accommodation styles, namely, "European Countryside," "Wooden Natural Style," and "Wood Art Style," as well as a restaurant full of antique flavor. The second floor is served as the industry's cultural relic exhibit area, which is open to staying guests to visit. In addition, after walking pass the cherry trail, you will find a prairie, which is served as a "Parent-child Interaction Park." The park has a "Eco-Classroom" and "Butterfly Landscape Observatory," where you can also lookout whole "Jinan University" and Taomi Mountain views....

stays.name: Lake Side Resort
stays.description: The construction of the Lake Side Resort was commenced by the Fu Li Development Co, Ltd. in 1995 and the hotel opened in March 1999. In 1999, the Fu Chuan Development International Co, Ltd. was awarded the "Promotion of Private Participation in the Tourism and Recreation Infrastructure in Puli Liyu Lake Scenic Area Project" by the Nantou County government. Facilities were added, such as 116 rooms from the previous 68, a floating restaurant and Lotus Cafe. The hotel is the only recreation and holiday hotel built at Liyu Lake in Puli, Nantou. From here, guests can reach Puli downtown by a 10 minute ride. To ensure guests& #39; safety during their stay and indulgence in the wonderful lake view, the hotel is constructed with a highly safe steel structure that endured the 921 earthquake of 1999, taking a perfect score for its structural safety. The hotel consists of 4 main buildings. When you enter the lobby, you will see the stairs on both sides connecting to the carefully designed conference hall on the 2nd floor. The conference hall is suitable for holding meeting and training activities by organizations. In buildings A, B and C, rooms of different types, styles and sizes are available to meet guests& #39; needs. Lake Side Resort is located right on the carp site of the Seven Carp Lake auspicious sites. A long time ago, before the willow causeway was built, the Carp Lake resembles a lively and shiny carp. When the sun sets, the crimson light shines on the lake surface as if the scales of a swaying fish . The reason why the willow causeway came into existence can be traced back to legends of various sources. I have always favored the legend that the Japanese built the causeway to penetrate the part of the lake resembling the fish maw when Taiwan was under Japanese rule for fear of any talent incubated from the power of Feng Shui. As in Feng Shui, there is a saying that destiny comes first, fate second and Feng Shui third and this is upheld by the Chinese. And the Japanese did it to sabotage the power of Feng Shui here. Whatever the case may be, this brought us a view comparable to the willow causeway in the West Lake. And you can enjoy it with your own eyes. Never miss the spot when you are around.

stays.name: Lu Hu Bie Zhuang Homestay
stays.description: "Lu Hu Bie Zhuang Homestay" was built ten years ago by the host who returned to his old homeland to build his vacation dreams, It is now open to offer a carefree atmosphere to all visitors and make everyone enjoy with contentment and satisfaction! The soft tuft is always welcoming, you will see no more busy traffic, excessive concrete buildings; instead, everything is relaxing and soothing, and the talks are filled with happiness and laughter! Don& #39;t get stunned by the host& #39;s collection of handmade cypress furniture, antiques, calligraphy and painting, it& #39;s typical for amateurs of art to pursue a simplistic yet delicate life of elegance! Artworks of ink, gouache, oil and acrylic paints fill the space with diversity and are always there, ready to catch your eyes. Make sure you visit "Lu Hu Bie Zhuang" for a feast of artistic concepts in a restful atmosphere!

stays.name: Man Man Geng Tian Homestay
stays.description: Beyond Hill Cottage is located at the 8.5 kilometer mark on Provincial Highway 64, about 2 kilometers from the Provincial Highway 21 51 kilometer mark, between Puli and Sun Moon Lake, about 6 kilometers from National Highway No. 6 Ailan Interchange, making it convenient for transportation. *GPS coordinates: East Longitude 120 degrees, 54 minutes, 31 seconds and North Latitude 23 degrees, 56 minutes, 1 second. Elevation: 750 meters. It faces the mountains, features views of Sun Moon Lake, and is an MOA-certified Fa Ma Si Te organic farm with a natural garden growing a variety of organic fruit trees and vegetables. Visitors may make reservations for the agricultural life or ecological tour. The structure features green architecture and wooden interior decorations, providing a simple, warm, healthy, and environmentally-friendly atmosphere. Breakfast is handmade using organic ingredients and includes oven-baked bread. Gently cultivate your spirit and sow the seeds of happiness. This place records the details of our pioneering spirit and construction process. Come share our life story and experience the rich mountain ecology.

stays.description: Locating at the beautiful campus of National Chi Nan University, NCNU Campus Inn provides a great environment for our interns to gain the first-hand experience of running a hotel and a really comfortable place for our guests to relax and rest. Being the third-largest University in Taiwan, NCNU covers an area up to 150 hectares, including more than 20 hectares of grassland.On the grassland, we have thousands and thousands of Cherry blossoms and other beautiful flowers surrounded by magnificent mountains and the boundless blue sky.Every Spring, NCNU holds several popular events featuring these Cherry blossoms such as The Sakura Run and Teatime With Sakura.NCNU Campus Inn welcomes every guest with our broad grassland to give out a greenness first impression.We provide three different kinds of room types,21 rooms in total, for our guest to choose from, which all included comfortable bed(s) and separate bathing/grooming facility .We also give out discounted tickets for entering the swimming pool in the campus ,which also featured SPA, steam room, and Sauna chamber, giving an ultra relaxing experience for our guests.

stays.name: Publicity Homestay
stays.description: Puli Anilique European Classical Bed and Breakfast, a romantic European kingdom within Puli, was orignally an elegant, white and gray building. In 2010, the owner built a new specialty bed and breakfast with exotic, European classical features, and the magnificent, appealing building naturally became one of Puli’s beautiful landmarks. Its light yellow exterior conveys the feeling of sunlit warmth, while the brown sloping roof and vertical, intersecting lines exhibit an exotic style, bringing visitors to a romantic European country. Legally-certified and convenient for transportation. Puli Anilique European Classical Bed and Breakfast is a legally-certified bed and breakfast of Puli providing guaranteed secure accommodation. Located in the heart of the city, transportation to the city, Sun Moon Lake, Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, or other tourist sites is convenient. Along with reasonable prices and its spot as a place a quiet in the middle of the city, these are the bed and breakfast’s three best features. World-class hotel luxury at affordable prices! The European style building’s appealing light yellow exterior provides world-class luxury, and the exotic main hall is full of fine, tasteful decorations. The wooden suite rooms are fragrant, luxurious, and comfortable, where travelers can take a stress-relieving bath. Rooms also come with an observation balcony with views of the beautiful layers of mountain mist in the distance.

stays.name: Puli Hideaway B&B
stays.description: Dao Xiang Cun is located in the Taomi Ecological Village of Puli Township. Taomi features an excellent natural environment, a complex and varied forest, rivers, wetlands, an agricultural ecological area, surrounding mountains, fresh air, beautiful scenery, and rich countryside atmosphre. Large in area, Dao Xiang Cun is surrounded by a well-preserved natural environment with an ecological pond full of diverse biological life and forest trail for visitors to explore the local ecology and get a close-up view of the diversity of life in the ecological pond. Pavilions by the pond offer a place to rest, enjoy the beautiful scenery of the surrounding green mountains, breathe in the fresh countryside air, and enjoy the relaxed, leisurely village pace of life. Rooms are well-lit and ventilated, with the double and 4-person rooms featuring simple colors and clean layout. The 6-person room, suitable for accommodating families, features a living room and thoughtful layout that makes visitors feel at home. Carefully listen to the sounds of nature outside in the evenings, putting your cares and worries aside! We maintain the natural appearance of the environment, a warm countryside friendliness, the babbling sound of the stream, beauty of the scenery, sounds of birds, and fragrance of flowers. Bring the children to experience green life in Dao Xiang Cun, where a stroll through the forest will bring back wonderful childhood memories of catching fish and shrimp by the pond – this is a relaxing, otherworldly paradise. Taomi Ecological Village – Dao Xiang Cun Vacation Bed and Breakfast.

stays.name: Qiao Kela Ti Homestay
stays.description: “Choc-Latte” – Italian for “chocolate.” Located in the geographic center of Taiwan, Choc-Latte Bed and Breakfast is a white and brown European-style structure with expansive views, surrounding mountains, and a green flower garden, a place of quiet in the midst of the city. The interior layout and decoration is simple, bright, and well-ventilated without feeling cramped. The bathrooms are made from natural materials and feature a half-open style. We’re located near the city area of Puli, within walking distance of McDonalds, convenience stores, the Puli Brewery, and the tourism industry. Tourist sites conveniently nearby include Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, Sun Moon Lake, Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, and Hehuanshan. Transportation is also convenient, with Puli accessible by bus or car and the High Speed Rail running to the Taichung Station, where passengers may transfer to the Puli bus.

stays.name: Red Maple Boutique Hotel
stays.description: The Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm is a four-star hotel with a combination of Nantou County's first farm, B&B, restaurants, and green energy ecological resources, located next to Taiwan Highway No. 14 (at the end of National Highway No. 6) at the Tai-Yi Red Maple Resort, which is a flower forest castle with access to Chigjing (Qing Jing) Road in Wushe, offering services for business, conferences, banquets, leisure, catering, accommodations, entertainment, and other functions all in one, creating a wonderful vacation paradise. For Staying: Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm is designed using environmentally qualified green building materials. Floors with seasonal names, “Spring Dew,” “Summer Lotus,” “Autumn Maple,” and “Winter Love” are carefully constructed, offering 73 rooms, all equipped with environmental-grade products, including essential oils, spare and separate marble baths, inviting guests to enjoy the exquisite hotel. For Dining: In the holiday park, we offer three dining environments for guests' choice. The South Garden Banquet Hall, with French windows 13 meters high, is built with native plant landscaping introducing king coconut trees, ferns, flowers, etc., to absorb the natural lighting, which includes a unique greenhouse restaurant and an elegant Water Garden Restaurant offering dishes of Taiwanese, Sichuan, Japanese, and Western styles, serving special “flower cuisine” and offering a creative menu. In addition, the simple quiet Flower Coffee House offers local, seasonal specialties and health concept foods, introducing individual packages, afternoon tea, coffee, herbal tea, and other delicacies. Welcome and enjoy! For Banqueting and Meeting: Unlike ordinary conference rooms, the Hotel features accompanying greenery and beautiful floral arrangements with natural fragrance all around for banquets or meetings of all sizes, and offers services for a variety of meetings, conferences, parties, year-end banquets, and weddings, among other activities. Leisure Facilities: Flower Spa is a separate private space, and provides aromatherapy services with meticulous, soft massage techniques to relax your frayed nerves and relieve the pressure accumulated over many years, a complete “baptism” from the inside out, from soul to body. Strolling out of the Tai Yi Ecological Leisure Farm, there is a colorful garden with an area of 132,000 square meters with ecological themes such as; flower temple, rainforest hall, honey garden, dancing butterfly museum, fairy tale forest, DIY activities, outdoor cinema, guided tours, etc., which will soothe and relax you!

stays.name: Red Villa
stays.description: Looking for green living environment that modern civilization lacks? Come Red Tile House Bed and Breakfast in Taumi ecological village. "Puli B&B ~ Red Tile House" took advantage of environmental advantages and combined with local scenery, within the scope planned their rooms, restaurant, conference rooms, and viewing terrace. Each environmental area emits an ancient nostalgic atmosphere through the natural elements of the building materials such as timber, red brick, and others, to create the most pure and simple leisure fields for travelers. Besides the nostalgic scenery, "Red Tile House" is also planning a new house featuring the senses of both retro and modern to allow you to experience different accommodation fun through different atmosphere environment.

stays.name: SUN MAU WU
stays.description: When walking into Tao-Mi Eco-Village, follow the signs, go east along the winding valley, you will find a lovely Rana latouchii greets you. A building with white walls and green columns hides in the forest. It is the San Maowu B&B that everyone talking about. Gurgling water with quality of clear and sweet, splashes, making you cool and carefree. This house is designed for frogs and dragonflies, called Qingwa Miao (frog wonderful), located next to the waterfall. A stone footpath passes through the forest, and you find a lush green, shady tree, sleepers trails, winding arrangement and extending away. The second floor has winding corridors inlaid in sweetgum tree. A flight of green stairs separated into Host use and Priviate use for focusing on privacy climbs up and down on the sidelines quietly, which is the owner's masterpiece of ingenuity for the courtyard landscaping, amazing! Balcony is for visitors to chat, for artists and writers to create, you can also look into the distance across the street over the limitless JNU campus. When night falls with layers of white clouds floating up, like sitting in a paradise between heaven and earth. A lovely petite "San Mao Coffee Stand" on the left of the courtyard has a deep and strong hostess flavor, with bursts of coffee aroma, coupled with languishing real human interest of grass root people, chat warmly with you and you feel it heartily. It was getting dark, the hostess prepared for you with the whole lust fragrance garden restaurant, in soft, supple candlelight, frogs insects call, flower perfume, water sound, accompanied by the moonlight and breeze, completely relaxed self, and enjoy a happy dinner. Meals are completed, you follow the host, armed with flashlights, wearing rubber boots, watch cute brown tree frog heroic, listen spotted frogs singing, one after another, like the sound of nature through an unprecedented feast.

stays.name: Sakura B&B
stays.description: Sakura Village Motel, located in Puli Township, Nantou County, is a motel combining leisure, tourism, and accommodation. Conveniently situated amidst mountains and a tranquil environment, it& #39;s an ideal place to rest and stay when visiting Nantou& #39;s various attractions. Nearby attractions include Puli Winery, Carp Lake, Chung Tai Chan Monastery, Taomi Eco-Village, and it serves as a transportation hub for popular tourist areas such as Sun Moon Lake and Cingjing Farm.The motel offers a variety of room types, including business suites, stylish suites, and romantic honeymoon suites, catering to different travelers& #39; needs. The well-equipped rooms provide spacious and comfortable accommodations, featuring amenities such as LCD TVs, king-size beds, jacuzzi bathtubs, steam rooms, and free Wi-Fi, allowing guests to relax and enjoy convenience during their trip.Furthermore, the motel offers a number of thoughtful services, such as 24-hour front desk service, free parking, tourist information, and housekeeping, ensuring a comfortable and convenient stay for business travelers, couples, or families. Overall, Sakura Village Motel has become a popular accommodation choice for many travelers visiting Puli due to its comfortable environment, complete facilities, and convenient location.

"Yingshiguang B&B" provides double and quadruple suites, and groups of people can choose to book a room for themselves; the room is spacious and bright, and the high-end equipment and tasteful home furnishings make people feel pampered. The warm light makes the space continue the warmth of the hall, making people reluctant to leave. Some rooms in the B&B are equipped with large bathtubs for travelers to relax, so that travelers can put aside all worries and fatigue and enjoy a happy vacation.

It features an independent, secure, clean, warm, and comfortable outdoor area, as well as a BBQ area, pool, spa, perfect pottery DIY facilities, DIY kitchens, and a tea-brewing area, making this a perfect place for vacations, recreation, learning pottery, accommodations, and seeing pine trees. Nearby locations include Chung Tai Chan Monastery, the Puli Brewery, Puli Carp Lake, Sun Moon Lake, Formosa Aboriginal Village, Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, and the Aowanda Forest Recreation Area. Come to Puli to eat, play, and live; our bed and breakfast is conveniently located close to all the tourist sites. We also have bed and breakfasts in Nantou, Puli, Cing Jing, Sun Moon Lake, and Lushan. Come to our beautiful facility, where you can experience the peaceful, leisurely countryside and phytoncides given off by Taiwan pine trees. Our refreshing, elegant bed and breakfast features expansive views of the entire basin; the beauty of sunrise and sunset is not to be missed. Come experience a special trip of the mind, one that you’ll never forget! Song Jing Farm is Puli Bed and Breakfast No. 395, legally certified. We accommodate up to 50 guests, are accessible by tour bus and are suitable for student groups.

stays.name: Shi Shang Qingquan Homestay
stays.description: Rock Springs B&B After the rain, the mountains are empty / After the evening, the weather turns cold. / Moonlight penetrates the pine trees, / water flow over rocks. / When bamboos make noise, it is the sign of washerwomen returning home. / Lotus waves, we know someone is going down the boat. / Spring is leaving, leisurely, I am contented, and here I stay. / ~ Mountain Autumn Evening by Wang Wei. Because we like the artistic mood of the poem, so the B&B named Rock Springs B&B (Shí Shàng Qīng Quán). It is located in Taumi, Puli, a Japanese-style building with silver roof and clear white walls, surrounded by green mountains. Here has pure spring, fresh air, blue sky, and beautiful wide views of idyllic. Quietly enjoying the beautiful scenery in the garden in the afternoon, as if everything& #39;s time is slowing down. At night, go to the bathing house to take a good bath washing slumbering mind. After that have a drink at the pub or izakaya with a few friends to relax. Woke up in the morning, bathed in the warm sunshine, sit in the garden and enjoy a delicious breakfast. Watch the sun changes in light and shadow, listen to the sound of the wind blowing leaves, look around all vegetation are all in warm color, and we enjoy the tranquility, being away from the city hubbub but close to nature.... The B&B has been in business for nearly 10 years, we hope that every guest comes here can enjoy a cozy, quiet moment away from the hubbub and get really relaxed, complete vacation experience.

stays.name: Songfeng Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: Located in Puli City, Songfeng Recreation Farm features outdoor scenery and countryside peace and quiet, and is close to the Puli Night Market, open on Fridays and Saturdays (enjoy the serenity of the countryside living as well as the liveliness of the night market). During the day, enjoy Puli’s friendly atmosphere and try out the great brewery products. Locations within a 3-15 minute drive include Shaoxing Banquet, local flavor restaurants, the Geographic Center of Taiwan Tablet, Taiyi Ecological Leisure Farm, and Guanyin Waterfall. Delicious foods and snacks are available to try at the Puli Night Market on Fridays and Saturdays. Songfeng is located next to the Puli Multi-Function Flower Center and a 3 minute drive from National Highway No. 6, near Mcdonald’s and Ya Zhuo Restaurant (Hakka cuisine), making finding a place to eat convenient. It’s a 5-10 minute walk from Puli Brewery, 10 minute drive to the Geographic Center of Taiwan Tablet, Taiwanpaper, and New Era Art Resort and Spa, 25 minutes to the Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, 20 minutes to Sun Moon Lake, and 40 minutes to Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, making travel to any of these places convenient.

stays.name: Tai-Yi Flower Lodge
stays.description: Located in Puli, Nantou, the center of Taiwan, "Taiyi Flower Inn B&B" is attached to Taiyi Ecological Leisure Farm. It has been established for more than 20 years and has been described by many netizens as a "fairy tale forest". The 40,000-square-meter garden green space is full of bald cypress, flowers and forests, and there are greenhouses that cultivate various vegetable or fruit seedlings. "Taiyi Flower Inn B&B" is a unique European-style building. There are various flowers planted in the small garden around it. The colors are bright and colorful. It feels like the prince and princess live in it, creating a warm and romantic atmosphere. The Milky Way Waterway next to it is also beautifully designed. There are many kinds of flowers and many bald cypresses around. Feel the four seasons of the earth and the ever-changing natural landscape, embrace the romantic and leisurely life in the mountains, and enjoy the tranquil beauty of the morning and evening. In order to allow guests to experience the same sleep quality as the Burj Al Arab in Dubai, the inn uses the same "thermal beds" made of the same material certified by NASA, Brazilian natural tourmaline, and carefully selected Binchotan technology gel, which has far infrared rays and releases negative ions, which can ease emotions and promote metabolism.

stays.name: TaoMiSong B&B
stays.description: "TaoMiSong B&B in Puli" sits in Shan Cheng, Puli, Nantou where there are soothing and relaxing mountains and forests with rural sceneries. The green mountains opposite to the B&B is clearly visible with the Central Mountain Range in the distance. It has a beautiful view of sunrise and clouds and mists in the halfway up a hills. You may easily watch mountains, clouds, sunset, stars, and trees as well as bamboos with different shapes. Welcome you to feel the temperature of the earth with your hands and hear the ambinet sound of birds and insects in the nature. You may also watch frogs, dragonflies, butterflies, summer fireflies, and tung blossoms in May. You may also choose to stroll forest trails slowly for a forest ecoloical trip to deeply relax your mind and body. "TaoMiSong B&B in Puli" has a vast space for activities and outdoor tables and chairs with the viewing platform where you may organize events, brew tea, or Barbecue. We can also help you book the activities, such as frog and firefly watching, or farm fun camp. If you want to travel in the countryside and enjoy the coolness in the mountains and forests, or feel the pure hospitality, come here!

stays.name: The Rippling Vale,Mansion Of Hot Spring
stays.description: Known as “Little Loyang,” The Rippling Vale, Mansion Of Hot Spring is located in Xiaoshan Valley (Puli Township). Its hot springs are clear and odorless, leave the skin feeling soft, smooth, and refreshed, and are mildly alkaline. Minerals in the water make it healthy for soaking, bathing, or drinking (after treatment). In your busy city life, how long has it been since you had a good rest? Instead of luxurious hotel decorations, we offer simplicity, natural elements, honesty, and enjoying the cool breeze, providing wooden furniture and good sleeping beds. The scenery of the mountains serves as the most natural decoration. Would you like to experience the relaxation and seclusion of mountain life, or are you tired of going on vacation and rushing from one place to the next, leaving you even more tired when you return? Then you must pay us a visit, soaking in the comfortable, relaxing springs, taking a deep rest, enjoying phytoncides in the morning, trying out our specially-prepared breakfast, and deliberately experiencing the scenic of beauty of Puli.

stays.name: Tian Lai Xiuxian Homestay
stays.description: Puli Tenlai Bed and Breakfast is located at the highest point of Maopukeng in the Taomi Ecological Village, and is a high-quality, legally-certified establishment. It features beautiful overlooking scenic views of the range of mountain peaks in the distance and is surrounded by a sea of clouds in the afternoon, a charming sight. The structure is an elegant red and gray building with clean, comfortable, spacious, well-lit rooms, making this a great place for visitors to relax. The interior features an elegant socializing area, balcony with a refreshing breeze, and double and 4 person rooms with simple, warm layout style and good lighting and ventilation. Outside is a lawn full of vibrant life and wooden rest pavilion where you and your friends can leave behind the dirt and noise of the city and relax under the umbrella’s shade, appreciating a place of secluded beauty. Our bed and breakfast features a lush green area and wooden pavilion where travelers can rest, put their minds at rest, and enjoy a rare moment of quiet. In the evening, they can appreciate the twinkling stars and listen to the beautiful, sublime sounds of nature. The overall area covers over 6600 square meters and includes a farm, variety of seasonal fruit trees, and elegant building, making this place an otherwordly paradise. Wake up in the embrace of nature, where Puli Tenlai Bed and Breakfast provides breakfast and unlimited freshly-ground coffee, courtesy of the owner.

stays.name: View on View B&B
stays.description: Jingshangjing is vacation bed and breakfast where you can slowly stir the sunlight and stop to watch the stars. It is located in the Taomi Ecological Village of Sun Moon Lake on the mountain behind National Chi Nan University, next to Caonan Wetlands, a place of wonderful scenery and ecology. At an elevation of 650 meters, it features expansive views of the snow on Qilai Southern Peak in Hehuanshan in the north, and Shuishe Dashan by Sun Moon Lake in the south. The scenery is what creates the most unforgettable memories, and the ecology is a harmonious way to experience nature at any time of the day. The owner uses natural agricultural methods to grow different seasonal fruits and vegetables, which visitors are allowed to pick, tasting sweet fruit free of pesticides. Rooms come with balconies and amazing scenic views, the air is filled with phytoncides, and guests are lulled to sleep by the low cries of owls. In the morning, the sunrise is embraced by a 3,000 meter mountain while visitors enjoy a Western or Chinese breakfast, providing energy for the day to come.

stays.description: Homestay located in NantouChunyang Homestay • ChunyangYipinju Homestay"Nantou Chunyang Yipinju Homestay" is located in the secret land of Chunyang near Lushan Mountain. The beautiful environment is intoxicating. It is surrounded by mountains. You can see the sea of clouds rolling between the mountains. At night, the sky is full of stars, outlining a romantic Milky Way. In addition, it also has an excellent geographical location. The Chunyang Waterfall is nearby, and major famous attractions such as Cingjing Farm, Aowanda Forest Recreation Area, Puli, etc. are also a short drive away, allowing you to easily travel in Nantou Ren'ai and have the purest date with the mountains and forests.Located among the mountains, "Nantou Chunyang Yipinju B&B" is like a small castle, shining brightly at night. The garden is spacious and can accommodate multiple groups of travelers to park at the same time, and children can also play here.

Nearby attractions include: Wujie, the hometown of clouds (15-minute drive), Qubing Ruins (5-minute drive), Qubing Iron Pipe Bridge (3-minute drive), and Aowanda National Forest Recreation Area (40-minute drive). Our B&B is located in the Wanfeng Village itself, where 80ï¼ of the population are farmers. Early to bed and early to rise is the norm here. As a result, our environment is tranquil and free of developed tourist attractions, yet it is closely connected to the surrounding area. Travelers who like this kind of environment are welcome to come home.

stays.name: Ming Qin Qing Jing Homestay
stays.description: Ming Ging Farm is located in the center of Taiwan – Nantou, which is the county surrounded by spectacular mountains. The air is fresh and the scenery is overwhelming. You can experience the rich culture and taste the most delicious and juicy fruits. Ming Ging Farm is famous for its fruits, such as Physalis and Cyphomandra. Cyphomandra is a breed of juicy tomatoes which grow on the tree. You will enjoy picking and tasting juicy fruits here. Sit back and relax in our simply, bright and cosy rooms, all designed with guest’s comfort in mind. They are fitted with a flat screen television, free Wi-Fi access, mini-bar, boiler, heater, air conditioning and private bathroom. Come and be inspired by the sunset in our courtyard, strolling along our garden footpaths, or sit out at night under the stars, enjoying the fresh air and twinkling lights from the cottage far below.Location : Central of Taiwan, Nantou CountyDirections :Taichung HSR Station (45 mins) →Pay-to-ride shuttle to Ming Ging Farm (90 mins)Taichung Aiport→ Pay-to-ride shuttle to Ming Ging Farm (120 mins)Local Attractions :Green Green Glasslands, Swiss Garden, Hehuan Mountain, Lushan Hotsprings, Aowanda National Forest Recreation Area, Wushe Memorial Park…etc.

stays.name: Qing Jing Xiao Taiyang Jingguan Homestay
stays.description: Go straight on Provincial Highway No. 14 toward Cing Jing (Qing Jing) Farm, turn onto Line A, and there will be a road distance indicator on the right just after passing Cing Jing Tourist Center. At the 9 km mark, you will see the sign for Sun Cabane. Sun Cabane was built next to the mountains, with a great view of peaks in the distance, blue skies, and the Hehuanshan Mountain Range. The owner’s care is evident in every part of the clean, elegant rooms, and to help guests feel at home, they’re thoughtfully designed and brightly-lit by natural sunlight. Here visitors can enjoy the beautiful scenery of layered mountains as well as the romantic drifting mist, making it definitely worthy experience. The recreation area includes 5 parts – camping, BBQ, wood house accommodation, organic garden, and natural fruit garden. The high mountain fruit is all-natural! Our garden produces a variety of seasonal fruits, including peaches, California plums, canteloupe plums (specialty of Cing Jing!), red fruit of the Physalis plant, kiwis, and Japanese sweet persimmons.

stays.name: Sheepvillage B&B
stays.description: We often go up the mountain. Not to reach the summit, nor to escape anything.It& #39;s just that when the car enters Qingjing, the clouds drift low, and the wind brushes against the car window, the pace of life slows down.Once, we temporarily parked our car by the No. 6 Livestock Trail at kilometer 10 of Provincial Highway 14A.We just wanted to get out and walk around, to feel the breeze.After walking for a few minutes, we came across this corner.The grass stretched out quietly, and the sunlight fell on the distant mountainline. No one spoke,but at that moment, it seemed everyone understood—this place was different from other places.A year later, we passed by there again. The grass was still there, and the wind was still there.So we stayed, built a house, and slowly, this name came to be.Qingjing B&B - "Giethoorn"—not because it resembles any other place,but because its tranquility reminded us of a small Dutch village we had once visited.There were no clamors to rush us there, no one urging us to leave,only the scenery, and just the right amount of time.If you& #39;re also a traveler, perhaps next time you pass through this area, you don& #39;t need to rush.Sit down, have a cup of hot tea, look at the distant mountains, feel the breeze for a while; maybe that will remind you that some scenery is meant to be appreciated by pausing and pausing.

stays.name: THE COTSWOLDS VILLA
stays.description: Located at the altitude of 2,000 meters, The Cotswolds Villa is just 500 meters away from Cingjing Farm (aka Qingjing Farm), and 20 meters from the bus stop (Operated by Nantou Bus). It only takes about 40 minutes drive (25KM) from the B&B to the famous Hehuan Mountains.The hosts—Daisy & Asungo, who were just ordinary white colars based in Taichung, founded the property that resembles the Cotswolds of the UK.The Cotswolds Villa is the first building in Cinjing built to be earthquake resistant (SRC). From the chimney caps handcrafted by the local pottery master, the vintage furniture carved from mahogany, to imported French paintings, Daisy & Asungo carefully decorate the property in and out, and surround the villa with various cypresses, maples, and cherry trees—with a hint of European rusticity.To ensure travelers the homey comfort, Daisy enrolled and has passed the professional training program to be a certified baker. Her daughter, Karina, who was working in semiconductor industry at TSMC, advances further and has got the highest certification as both bread & pastry chefs.Karina, who had a master degree from UC San Diego (California, USA), is an outdoor enthusiast. She loves backpacking & hiking, and would love to show their guests what Taiwan& #39;s mountains have got to offer. "Email us your plan and which nearby mountain you want to go. My friend and I can give you an in-depth and unforgettable backpacking experience in Taiwan," She adds with eyes sparklingly. The mother & daughter together knead local produce and natural ingredients (eg. persimmons, cherry blossoms, roses, beet roots…) into their breads, and served daily in the breakfast buffet. "At 16°C and with mountains in the eyes, we make our breads wholeheartedly, and welcome our guest with utmost sincerity," Daisy & Karina say proudly.

"At 16°C and with mountains in the eyes, we make our breads wholeheartedly, and welcome our guest with utmost sincerity," Daisy & Karina say proudly.

stays.name: Wujie Sea of Clouds B&B
stays.description: Wujie Tribe is the most northern tribe of the Bunun, one of the fourteen officially recognized Taiwanese Aboriginal Tribes. It is located 700 to 1600 meters above sea level in Fajhih Village, Ren''ai Township, Nantou County. Since it is high in altitude, clouds sometimes cover the village in early morning. Hence, it is also called "the home of clouds."Located in Wujie Tribe, Wujie Sea of Clouds B&B is a newly opened guesthouse, offering travelers a cozy and homely atmosphere. Each guestroom is well-furnished with high-quality pocket spring mattress. Aside from the interior design, Wujie Sea of Clouds B&B provides guided tours; travelers can appreciate magnificent sea of clouds in the early morning and enjoy a twinkling night sky. Historical spots, including Chubean Relics, Siyuan Diaoqiao, Wujie Dam and Momonaer Waterfall are recommended. To explore the historical trail and experience eco-tourism, enjoying the view of A Thread of Sky and collecting Dragon Bone Stone are included in schedule. Furthermore, witness thousand-year-old stalactites, peculiar geology and the catchment channel of Sun Moon Lake (cost US$300 million).In the meantime, Wujie Sea of Clouds B&B provides breakfast, aboriginal cuisine and BBQ area. Travelers can totally loosen up while staying here.

stays.name: Yi Lu Homestay
stays.description: Yilu Bed and Breakfast is located about 2 kilometers from Hui Sun Forest in the Meiyuan Tribal Area, (Xinsheng Village, Renai Township, Nantou County), close to tourist sites such as Qingliu Tribal Area (with a memorial to the survivors of a battle between the Japanese and Taiwanese aborigines), Atayal Resort, Old Glutinous Rice Bridge, Chung Tai Chan Monastery, Puli Brewery, Paper Dome, Puli Paper, Muh Sheng Museum of Enomology, New Era Art Resort and Spa, Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, and Sun Moon Lake. After retiring from the police force, the owner carried on his spirit and concept of serving the people, renovating his home (legally-certified bed and breakfast #521), located in an area of great natural beauty, thus continuing to serve the public. The name of the establishment comes from the Atayal word “Yi Lu Mi Su,” which means “I like you, I welcome you!” Yi Lu Bed and Breakfast is located in the Atayal Tribal Area, providing guests with an authentic traditional aborigine living experience. The building provides great views and comfortable accommodation, and the sound of birds and cicadas can often be heard in the mornings and evenings, leaving a lasting impression. In the summer, guests can walk on our private, narrow, winding pathway to Huangrou Stream, where they can play in the water. In the evening, they can brew tea, have a drink and snacks, or chat on the outdoor deck. Guests can bring their own BBQ, and the kitchen is available if you’d like to cook your own dinner, making this place just like home!

"Shuili Er Ping B&B--B&B in Shuili" is located in Erping Mountain, Shuili Township, with a vast and beautiful horizon overlooking the entire Shuili urban. The B&B is next to the local well-known Erping popsicle, and close to Shuili Snake Kiln, Checheng Street, Mingtan Reservoirs and other attractions. It has easy access to Chichi and Sun Moon Lake if you want to pay a visit. Staying in "Er Ping B&B," the scenery and the environment you have seen are comfortable views of 100ï¼ natural degrees, and it is a quite suitable for the whole family outings." Er Ping B&B" offers two-person, four-person and six-person types of rooms, and if the size of the party is relatively large, then a whole building package is available. Rooms are all furnished to emphasize the principle of comfort. Neat and generous room layout, coupled with a spacious sense of space to make every traveler be able to enjoy the most comfortable, relaxed, leisurely holiday. In addition, Er Ping B&B" also provides a set menu and dining table scheduling services and offers you delicious dishes with unique flavors skillfully prepared by the hostess. stays.name: Lao Wu Homestay
stays.description: With back to Yushan Mountain, across Chenyoulan River, opposite Xitou, located in Shang& #39;an Village, Shuili, Nantou, silently guarding the green mountains. Having been living in the city for a few years makes us realize the value of early experiencing the natural environment. Emotionally being deeply rooted in the land, we returned to favorite Shang& #39;an Village. On the river plains we built a folk house in Tang style. We introduced stream water into the pond and planted water willows and pine trees, and arranged it into a natural garden to regain natural tranquility of a mountain life. If life is a learning process, then the lush plantings in the courtyard is our learning outcomes, to set aside a space for nature, and nature will return full hearty responses. The Bigcatkin willow trunk becomes wider and wider, Japanese strobus pine& #39;s stretch without restrain, the fireflies come uninvited, river fish are full of ponds, and common Moorhens settle down here. Take care a plot of organic vegetable fields, leftovers make compost, lotus blossom in the ecological wastewater treatment pond, natural cycle of life here has been practiced freely, and we enjoy it. Rest in a soothing garden, taste the leisure of venting, listen to the birds chirping, branches and buds are flickering, when mountain mist floating by, or whether it is slow living or LOHAS, here words have been forgotten. Sharing this natural life process makes us feel more affluent. Welcome your visit, and together with our breath of life to share the mountain leisurely time.

stays.name: Song Zhi Yuan
stays.description: The "Dhyana and Pine Recreational Homestay" is located in Shuili Township, Nantou County, and right on the way to Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area, the destinations nearby include Sun Moon Lake, Jiji, Checheng, Shuili Snakekiln, Dongpu Hot Spring and more. This hostel occupies 25000 sqm of land and the location was Shuili's second largest log stockpile and lumbermill in 1950s to 1960s. The land was later purchased by Dr. Yang who is well-known locally after the "921" earthquake of 1999. With his massive planting of "Taiwan pines", this place booms years later. This pine garden is built with two hostels: "Dhyana Homestay" and "Song Zhi Yuan Homestay", both are registered with No. 260 and 279 licenses, respectively. These two homestays are managed by one single management group. The "Dhayana Homestay", a Japanese-style building with red roof tiles and white wall serves as the lobby of both homestays, while "Song Zhi Yuan" presents the cabins built with Taiwan red cypress timber and red honeycomb cell-shaped floor tiles, which resembles the old-school Japanese style. Relax in the Taiwan pine forest and pasture to talk to the breeze, pine forest and chirping birds and insects. There are several famous destinations, including Jiji (15 minutes driving), Sun Moon Lake (30 minutes driving), and Shuili Snakekiln (10 minutes of walking). Also, Taichung International Airport and HSR Taichung Station takes only about an hour of driving, and it's convenient to reach Checheng Recreational Agriculture Area, Sun Moon Lake National Scenic Area and Dream Works of the Mei in Xinyi Township. Featured with tranquility, healthy cuisine, various accommodation options and guest-oriented service, "Dhyana and Pine" welcomes your visit!

stays.name: Dong Guang Hot Spring Hotel
stays.description: 【Traveling in Dongguang, slow down your heart and let the scenery come in】 Dongguang Travel is located in the Dongpu Hot Spring Scenic Area in Xinyi Township, Nantou County, with an altitude of about 1,200 meters. It is famous for its natural hot springs and magnificent mountain scenery. The hotel is close to Chenyoulan River, with the Xinzhongheng Highway in front and the Batongguan Ancient Road in the back. It has a superior geographical location and is an important relay station between Xinzhongheng and the ancient road. It is also the critical point of Yushan National Park. It is surrounded by mountains, including mountains, Wangxiangshan and Yushan. The scenery is vast and is an excellent starting point for climbing Yushan and visiting Batongguan. Dongpu natural hot spring introduced by our travels is sourced from the foothills of Wangxiang. It has abundant water and is inexhaustible all seasons. The spring water is clear and transparent, colorless and odorless. It is a weak alkaline carbonated spring with a temperature of about 47°C. It can not only be soaked in soup, but also drink directly. It is the best among mineral water. The rooms have an exclusive soup house, allowing you to enjoy private hot spring time in the room. Outdoors are also planned to have an open-air bath pool and a hot spring swimming pool, which are suitable for all seasons. Whether it is morning or dusk, you can fully immerse yourself in the spring healing among the mountains and forests. When traveling in Dongguang, the dining table carries not only the flavor, but also the stories from the mountains, forests and land. We select local ingredients, blend the pure taste of natural terroir, and slowly simmer it into warm and delicious dishes, awakening the sleeping taste buds during the journey, making every meal not only full, but also a time worth savoring during the journey. In addition, Dongguang Travel also has a well-equipped conference space, equipped with projection equipment, audio systems and a comfortable discussion environment. Whether it is corporate meetings, education and training, lectures, or communication time during group tourism, it can be flexibly used to break the limitations of the field, allow inspiration to flow freely, and stimulate more possibilities of cooperation and dialogue in nature. Whether you are relaxing quietly in the private soup in the room, or feeling the embrace of the mountains and forests between the open-air soup pool and the hot spring swimming pool, every moment is the beginning of healing, accompanied by local and carefully cooked dishes, so that the taste buds are also treated gently. This place is not only a place to rest, but also an ideal place to reconnect with nature. I sincerely invite you to visit yourself and experience the beauty of the mountains, forests, hot springs.? stays.name: BLACK TEA WORKSHOP
stays.description: One day, a child raised beneath the black tea tree decided to leave the workplace behind and return to a place of serene mountains and the scenic countryside, his pure spiritual and life hometown, in order to live with the black tea plants and help the garden that raised him continue to grow sustainably. When the two children put aside their work and decide to help their parents, Black Tea Workshop was born! United in heart and mind, the family entered the world of black tea one step at a time. In order to realize their dream, they started with the designs, and following much debate, decided on a Tudor architectural style – simple, natural, refined, and down-to-earth. They drew up several designs matching the scale of their ideas for lattice windows which let in sunlight and greenery while providing great views. After cutting, pasting, and comparing, they decided on an ideal rectangular 4:3 ratio, changing the deep, narrow Tudor windows into a larger, wider design. For the color coordination of the building’s exterior, they not only diligently searched the Internet to select roof tiles, colors, magnets, tiles, and wood floors, but also visited manufacturers around Taichung to compare and contrast until they found the right texture and patterns. The bed and breakfast’s rooms are named based on the theme of black tea, such as Black Tea Seed, Black Tea Ren, Workshop Aged Tea, and Taiwanese Tea No. 18. The rooms also feature different-themed decoration, with the characters or pictures created by the workshop family or photographs subjected to a special pressure proces, giving them a unique, original style. In order to help guests feel at home, black tea pillows are provided, filling the room with a faint fragrance. The pillows are made by the three generations of family members who run the business and have been personally involved in everything from producing tea to sewing pillows. In addition to the fragrance of the pillows, the room walkways feature pictures detailing the process of hard work that goes into making pillows. In keeping with the black tea theme, room lights are designed with black tea leaves, and under the contrast of the soft light, the leaves spread out, contributing to Black Tea Workshop’s unique style. Rooms are spacious and well-lit inside and out, simple and refined in layout, and faintly fragrant of black tea – features provided by the Black Tea Workshop family in order to provide honored guests with the best and most comfortable atmosphere. The main goal of the workshop is sustainable management of the old tea garden, which naturally makes the old trees the point of focus. So before the 2010 Chinese New Year, in the dead of winter which is the best time for transplanting, the old trees are moved from the garden inside the house to be taken care of. We currently grow them in the Black Tea Workshop courtyard, where they accompany us each day. The days pass just as they once did amidst the tea trees; even when we don’t go to the garden anymore, we feel their presence. When you come to Black Tea Workshop, please take a close look at them. These are the trees that raised our family, standing strong and tall, braving winds and rain for over sixty years! Black Tea Workshop also features cuisine made from old tea garden black tea and seasonal fruits and vegetables. Our specialty milk tea blends the fragrance of milk and tea, refreshing without being overly sweet, and goes well with our handmade cookies and black tea cheesecake. Black Tea Workshop is a place that will leave wonderful memories! This is Black Tea Workshop! A small, warm, beautiful, carefree place!

stays.name: CHIN-PIN LO B&B
stays.description: Sun Moon Lake Homestay – CHIN-PIN LO B&B is located at Seshui Community in Yuchi Township. The B&B is a conspicuous yellow building intimately hugged by the surrounding mountains and rivers, helping to create a unique sanctuary and paradise. CHIN PIN-LO B&B is graced with a natural ecology pond that adapts to the seasons. Fish, dragonflies, frogs, and tadpoles as well as plants such as waterlilies and lotuses call this place their home. Tea plantations, farms, orchards, and other simple, rustic elements surround CHIN PIN-LO B&B. Guests could take a walk along the footpath that circles the village or visit Seshui Community in the morning while enjoying the refreshing air provided by the gentle wind while enjoying the hums and chirps of birds and other natural wildlife in the mountains. Visitors are also welcome to the pottery classroom to make their own porcelain and pottery, or go even further to the waterfall to enjoy its refreshing, misty splashes. Of course, you can also drive to nearby attractions such as Sun Moon Lake and Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village. It does not take long to drive to these places. Night time at CHIN-PIN LO features starry skies, a perfect time to enjoy tea with your friends while sharing a delightful conversation. The quiet countryside will help relax your soul, with the natural chirping of critters and birds keeping you company as you settle down for a most relaxing sleep.

stays.name: Das Nunu Haus
stays.description: Coexisting with nature is the way to gain an experience of limitless wonder. Come to Yuchic (Yuchi), a place surrounded by mountains, and Sun Moon Lake, a place of quiet, unrivalled beauty that will sweep away all your cares and worries. Nunu Haus Guest House, located in this area, features an all-white building adorned with a wooden roof and window frame, resembling a European villa that sprung out of nature itself. Built with environmentally-friendly materials and solar powered, it is a green building that was created from and gives back to nature, providing a comfortable, all-natural atmosphere where people can lose themselves in the quiet ease of the scenery. Covering a large area, Nunu Haus Guest House features recreational facilities such as an outdoor area, BBQ area, and scenic observation deck. Brew a pot of tea and have a casual chat with friends in the outdoor area, or have a good time at the BBQ area. Enter the unique, elegantly designed building, where the owner’s care and thoughtfulness is apparent in every corner. The European decoration displays extraordinary class without losing its warm touch, and the suite rooms are brightly-lit, spacious, and possess an elegant, sincere atmosphere, making guests feel comfortable and at home. Emphasizing ecological preservation and environmental maintenance, Nunu Haus Guest House features not only a lush green outdoor area but glimpses of rare insects and animals, bringing new surprises to your travels. Don’t wait –plan a vacation to come enjoy the comfort and seclusion of a place surrounded by mountains, where you can relax and enjoy a comfortable break! Please call our toll-free line at 049-2897597, 049-2897597, 0936-316048, or 0936-316048 for any questions regarding your trip or itinerary.

stays.name: Fleur De Chine Hotel
stays.description: Fleur de Chine Hotel is a five-star spa resort hotel on the shores of Sun Moon Lake. The hotel offers 207 rooms in total, all with elaborately designed French windows, balconies and in-room hot spring marble bathtubs, directly introducing the beauty of nature and offering travelers a broad visual horizon where you can pleasantly embrace nature all day and enjoy rich and varied views of the landscape. A variety of food and beverage services are on offer, including the Lobby Lounge, Sky Lounge, Crimson, KEN CAN by Ken Chan and Rainbow Cloud Teppanyaki restaurants with Chinese and Western and other catering services. The International Ballroom, including the elegant Cosmos Cloud and Soaring Cloud, can accommodate conferences of more than 500 people or a banquet of 40 tables, both suitable for corporate meetings, wedding celebrations, year-end party, theme parties, product launches and so on. Fleur de Chine Hotel has leisure facilities of more than one thousand square meters, including an outdoor Noble Hill, Circular Concourse, garden trails, indoor lake view gym, hydrophilic pavilion spa area, swimming pool, Mountain Mist Spring, children's playground, as well as the VALMONT SPA service in the hotel offering travelers a variety of recreational and leisure options. Fleur de Chine Hotel's spring is an alkaline HCO₃, ph 8.6, and is colorless and odorless hydrogen carbonate spring. The alternating of hot and cold spring relaxes you both mentally and physically. Suitable for a family outing.

stays.name: Flora Villa-Rexort
stays.description: Entering Sun Moon Lake, I find it hard not to be attracted by the lake water and the mountain scenery; I am here with an empty mood to accept all freshness, nature, beauty and romance here, where I will record into my travel log for memory in the future. Driving towards Flora Villa-Rexort at Sun Moon Lake, the standalone elegant villa is surrounded by carefree natural space; the two rows of hedges in the courtyard resemble guest-welcoming soldiers in a parade, the parasols randomly placed on the lawn sway with the wind. I am enjoying everything that is refreshing on this vast land, which is not very far away, I am at… Flora Villa-Rexort. Flora Villa-Rexort at Sun Moon Lake has an elevated design for the lounge to create an aristocratic manner, the super large field of vision straight to the second floor and the enlarged stylish French window allows you to embrace all scenery indoor and outdoor with a broad sight; the perfect combination between the majestic ambience created by the elegant decorative lighting, the beautiful temperament introduced by the white gauze curtains, the meticulously selected furniture and spacious space not only demonstrates the owner’s unique ideas, but further easily brings the travelers coming from afar to a better quality hotel taste. Your comfort and ease is the degree of satisfaction that we pursue, in order to create a resting space that suits you, gentle colored beddings are selected to go with simple and well-executed interior displays, such appropriate decorations stimulate the enhancement of the overall degree of comfort.

stays.name: Fuli Hot Spring Resort
stays.description: The brand image of the Fuli Hot Spring Resort is based on the two Chinese characters that make up its name, “Fu” and “Li”. With room type : CEO Suit, Royal Suite, Assam Suite with Japanese Living Room, Family Suite, Superior Double Twin, Superior Room, all the room carries a minimalist design that accentuates the natural scenery outside its balcony. For a resident with taste and an inclination toward lifestyles of health and sustainability, this room of humanistic culture is for you. Moreover, as you indulge yourself in a nourishing beauty soak, you also receive a beauty treatment that frees your body, mind and soul.Open to Fuli guests year round, our outdoor water facilities include a water amusement area for children, a wading pool, and a hot spring Jacuzzi. Surrounded by the verdancy of Moalan Mountain and fragrance of the green, this is a great spot to enjoy a sun bath and soak up refreshing phytoncides. Our indoor facilities include handcraft activities, chldren’s play room, x-box play room, snooker pool tables, table tennis, table soccer, chess room, KTV, gym, reading room, aroma therapy spa, stone spa, that all make your vacation more exiting.Cheers Banquet Hall: This spacious multi-functional banquet hall is a rarity around Sun Moon Lake area. There are eight private rooms inside the hall with footage between 30 to 50 square meters, and the hall can be partially compartmented or fully open. Imperial Kitchen: Using chef-selected Nantou specials that have come into season, we serve an array of delicacies and creative cross-national cuisines that accord with the 24 solar terms for maximum health benefits. Supreme Room: Simply elegant and well-lit, this conference room can accommodate up to 300 participants. Its height allows a vista of Sun Moon Lake and the surrounding sceneries make this conference hall a luxury. Lunchtea delicatessen: There is provided light meal and all kind of spirituous beverages and soft drinks. stays.name: GRAND HILAI SUN MOON LAKE
stays.description: Grand Hilai Sun Moon Lake is located at a high point on the serene banks of Sun Moon Lake, offering a stunning 270-degree view of the lush surroundings. Designed by the globally renowned designer LWMA Li Wei-Min, the hotel features a complete transformation of its 12 above-ground floors and 3 basement levels, with a reimagined entrance that creates a tranquil and elegant pathway for guests. The resort boasts 93 lakeview guest rooms and suites, with sizes ranging from 50 to 357 square meters. The design incorporates elements of sunlight, lake waters, mountain views, and forest surroundings unique to Sun Moon Lake, ensuring that every moment spent at Grand Hilai Sun Moon Lake feels like a dream in a fairy-tale landscape, redefining the ultimate luxury vacation experience.
