stays.description: Read Nice · Gather is the latest addition to the Read Nice B&B brand, designed as a whole-house rental for class reunions, family trips, and gatherings with friends.We believe that finding time to truly connect with friends and family has become rare and precious. stays.name: HU YUE LAKE VIEW HOME STAY
stays.description: At Hu Yue, you will feel an unprecedented tranquility and satisfaction.The morning light penetrates the curtains and gently falls on your face, bringing freshness and hope for the day. When you open the window, the fragrance of the lake comes towards you, like a warm embrace from nature, warming your heart.In the evening, the setting sun quietly sets, casting its afterglow on the lake, making the waves sparkle. You and your loved one stroll along the lakeside, and every step is picturesque and filled with sweet and warm memories. At this moment, time seems to have stopped, just for you to enjoy this tranquility and pleasure.As night falls, the moonlight shimmers on the lake like water, reflecting the stars in the sky. This lakeside is quiet and peaceful, allowing your mind to relax and feel as if you are one with nature.When you come to Hu Yue, you will have a sincere encounter with nature, let go of the hustle and bustle of life, and rediscover the peace and harmony deep in your heart.Let us create your eternal memory together, and feel the most sincere and profound touch and satisfaction among the beautiful mountains and waters by the lake.

stays.name: Jingxin Yuan Xiang Ju Homestay
stays.description: Sun Moon Lake’s Jing Xin Yuan Rural Bed and Breakfast is located in Seshui Community near Sun Moon Lake (Yuchih (Yuchi) Township, Nantou County). On Provincial Highway 21, on Zhongtan Road after passing Dayan Tunnel, take a right and enter. Conveniently located, with nearby tourist sites including Sun Moon Lake, Formosa Aboriginal Culture Village, Taiwan Adventist College, Lienhuachih, Shueili (Shuili) Checheng, and Puli, this is the ideal place to stay on weekends or vacations when planning your trip to Nantou. Seshui Community resembles a lotus blossom in a valley, featuring a beautiful environment, great scenery, and rich produce and ecological resources. Community resides worked together to build a very special ecological village which was selected as one of the Top 10 Classic Villages in 2007. It produces two specialty products, the first of which is Seshui Pottery, made from top-quality Baixian clay, which does not require the use of glaze. The oxidized ashes given off by the wood-fired baking process gives the finished pottery a varied appearance, making each piece a special, unique product. The other speicalty product is Seshui Royal Tea, which derives its name from being one of Taiwan’s top quality black teas. It was once the tea of choice for Japanese emperors; the name also refers to serving tea. All tea leaves are organic, handpicked with one bud and two leaves, and free of fertilizers or pesticides. Excellent quality guaranteed their place in the Assam cultural revival. We welcome you to try out this special “Japanese imperial tea.”

stays.name: Lealea Garden Hotels Sun Moon lake-Sun
stays.description: WELCOME TO LEALEA GARDEN HOTEL-SUNIn the trend of boutique hotels, the Sun Moon Lake- Sun, newly opened on August 2014, is small and neat in style. It is not only trendy but also exquisite in its architecture. Marvelously designed, out of 40 rooms, 25 of them offer the guests a magnificent view of the lake. In addition, the newly planned semi-outdoor lobby, in which there is a nice café, welcomes the guests with a leisurely atmosphere shortly before they check in.Following the semi-outdoor check in space, we arrive in the premises, feeling the neat design of the architect. Saturated with almost natural elements, it creates a primitive atmosphere. Of course, Sun Moon Lake -Sun was launched into operation earlier in the same area with the concept of “resort city.” Naturally, the lodgers in the Sun Moon Lake-Sun are welcome to use the facilities and restaurants of the flag ship hotel and the Sun Moon Lake. Living in the Lealea Garden Hotel, visitors can enjoy the simplicity and tranquility of a small hotel but with the facilities of a grand hotel. Visitors can enjoy all the merits of Lealea.

stays.name: Secret garden design villa B&B
stays.description: Looking for a relaxed, all-natural bed and breakfast? Next to the Taiwan Adventist College is a small, inconspicuous flower path that leads to a secret place – Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast. “Look for Mr. Wu when you come to Sun Moon Lake.” Unless you heard about this place by word of mouth or the Internet, it might be difficult to find such a beautiful, secret place. Mr. Wu and his family lived in Brazil for 8 years before deciding to return to Taiwan due to several considerations. A middle-aged man, he enjoys a reputation for being friendly and steadfastly pursuing his dreams. Without an architectural background, he nonetheless created his home through careful planning and skillful, self-taught methods. “Unique architectural creativity, unconcealable secrets.” Mr. Wu was singularly responsible for the blueprints, construction, and overall planning, completing this impossible mission that became his life’s most meaningful project. Thoughtfully integrating natural scenery and architectural art, it used a large amount of glass, whose transparency enhanced the visual appeal. The independent, creative design also fills every corner, inside and out, with surprises. We welcome you to Sun Moon Lake Secret Garden Bed and Breakfast, a place of friendliness and ideals that fate will hopefully lead you to!

stays.name: Shanshuitian Homestay
stays.description: After a busy day of shopping and enjoying the beautiful Sun Moon Lake, it's time to look for a place to spend the night. The rustic Sun Moon Lake Shanshuitian B&B is warm and homey, like the perfect home that appeared in our childhood dreams. The only difference is this home is now more carefully decorated and more perfect looking. You can't help but go inside to take a closer look.The living space is simply decorated but very warm and welcoming. The perfectly sized living space has a comfortable wooden floor, unlike other confined places with low ceilings. You will be so relaxed here that you wouldn't want to leave. The owner loves natural materials and uses furnitures and accessories made with natural materials to decorate Sun Moon Lake Shanshuitian B&B. The decor in each room happens to match the rooms in the house I dreamed of when I was little. Would you like to come here to see if this is the house from your childhood dream?

stays.name: Sishi
stays.description: It is called spring and summer, and it is called autumn and winter. These four seasons bring endless luck. The seasons change and time passes. This sentence expresses the endless cycles and changes in nature, and also reflects the ups and downs and changes in everyone's life journey. Just like the change of the four seasons of spring, summer, autumn and winter, each of us experiences different challenges and growth at different times. Whether it's a sunny spring or a cold winter, every season has its own unique scenery and meaning. The purpose of Sishi Hotel is to be a haven during your journey. No matter how far you go, Sishi is willing to be your place to rest.

stays.name: Skylight B&B
stays.description: Skylight B&B is located at one of the main piers of Sun Moon Lake, Ita Thao, an aboriginal village. The B&B is located in the middle of a shopping street with many food stalls and restaurants, just a 3-minute walk from Ita Thao Pier.Skylight B&B has easy access to all attractions: a 15-minute walk to the ropeway station, a 15-minute drive to Shuishe bus stop, and an 80-minute drive to Taichung HSR station. Sun Moon Lake has many unique and interesting attractions such as Ci'en Pagoda, Xuanzang Temple, Shiwatou Trail, Dazhu Lake Trail, Wenwu Temple, Longfeng Temple and so on. Skylight Bed & Breakfast is 1 hour and 20 minutes from Taichung Airport.Designed for modern comfort, the room is equipped with a large comfortable bed, free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, heating facilities, a flat-screen TV, a refrigerator, an electric kettle and free toiletries. Each bathroom has an overhead shower and a huge stone bathtub for you to wave goodbye to after a long day.The homestay provides guests with fresh and delicious breakfast. They can relax and enjoy the sun terrace of our outdoor restaurant. There are many restaurants within a 5-minute walk of Skylight B&B. Staff will be happy to help arrange tours.

stays.name: Slowmotion B&B
stays.description: Located in the Toushe Basin and not too far from Sun Moon Lake, Slow Motion B&B is tucked in the charming countryside and far away from the busy city. The rich diverse landscape includes the simple rural lifestyle and the must-not-miss Peat Live Basin, the only such unique geological terrain in Taiwan. The relaxing atmosphere and cool comfortable weather make this an enjoyable vacation spot. The simple and elegant exterior of Slow Motion B&B evoke a sense of laid-back atmosphere. All the rooms here are carefully decorated to create an inviting and comfortable ambiance. The clean and simple decoration further add to the warmth in each room. Visitors with a big group can reserve the entire house. We welcome you to bring a few of your best friends and spend a happy weekend with us.

stays.name: Sun Moon Lake Fishing Village B&B
stays.description: "Fisherman Homestay" is located in the gathering place of the Thao people in Dehua Village, Sun Moon Lake. It not only boasts a rare geographical landscape of mountains and water but also embodies the vibrant and rich Thao culture. From the windows of Fisherman Homestay, which faces the mountains and backs onto the water, one can see the lush greenery of surrounding hills and winding waters, harmonizing with the retro style of the annex, creating a sense of being detached from worldly concerns.Upon entering Fisherman Homestay, one is immediately captivated by its unpretentious environment. A large painting of the beautiful Sun Moon Lake scenery hanging in the lobby ignites a desire to explore Sun Moon Lake more deeply. All the furniture and fixtures in the homestay are made of dark wood evoke a sense of stepping into a time tunnel, returning to the innocent days of the past.

stays.name: The Lalu Sun Moon Lake
stays.description: If there is a name that can stir your emotions, it is The Lalu(Han Bi Lo in Chinese), even if each word in the name costs a hundred million dollars. In 1901, Mr. Ito built a small wooden cabin on the Lalu Peninsula for vacation use and called it “TheFor hundreds of years, with strict entrance control, only senior governmental official, generals, prime ministers, and emperors are allowed into The Lalu. Therefore, a myth is created to this building. However, how did The Lalu come about?In 1923, the Japanese Crown Prince Hirohito visited Taiwan and appointed The Lalu to be his official residence. He rebuilt the small wooden cabin into a two-story building and added eight guest rooms, including the east and the west wings, dining room, conference room and more. From this time on, The Lalu turned itself from a luxury vacation home into an official government guest house.In 1949, when the Chinese Nationalist Government retreated to Taiwan, The Lalu became President Chiang Kai-Shek’s hostel, used primarily for vacation use and to entertain foreign head of states.In 1998, Mr. Cheng-Yi Lai, chairman of the Shining Group, received a phone call that filled his heart with tremendous excitement and doubt. For the past 30 years, his dream was to build a world class hotel along the shores of Sun Moon Lake. The man that made the phone call indicated to him that The Lalu was for sale.However, buying this historical building was not going to be a simple task. The seller was asking for a sum of NT$ 270 million and made it clear that it was not negotiable. It took over a year of hard work and negotiation, with the end result closing at the firm asking price of NT$ 270 million. stays.name: You Shui Xiang Du Jia Homestay
stays.description: Do you feel rushed and out of breath from your rushed pace of life? Why not come to Sun Moon Lake – Youshuixiang Vacation Bed and Breakfast, where you can experience a more relaxing way of living? Sun Moon Lake is like a scenic painting of great depth and variety; whether you’re here to stroll the pathways and feel the breeze on your face, absorb the fragrance of a tea garden, or wander through the changing scenery by day or night, you can’t escape the beauty of this place. Located in the Sun Moon Lake Scenic Area, Youshuixiang Vacation Home is near tourist sties such as Yuchic (Yuchi) and Puli. It’s a legally-certified establishment, and the all-new white wood building looks straight out of a fairy tale forest, featuring a large outdoor area and surrounded by dense woods. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere of recreation amidst nature. Sun Moon Lake Youshuixiang Vacation Bed and Breakfast offers double and 4 person rooms featuring simple, clean layout, as well as being bright, spacious, clean, and refreshing, with large windows. Wake up to the morning sunlight and fall asleep to the sounds of birds and insects in the evening, experiencing the comfortable and carefree feeling of nature. Situated in a quiet secluded environment within the forest, you can enjoy a breakfast of delicious produce grown by the owner himself, providing health and energy for the day to come. Breakfast is free of charge. Other services include: 1. Meal ordering or BBQ ingredients. 2. Ticket purchase for the Formosa Aborigine Cultural Village or Sun Moon Lake boat tour. 3. Free samples of our homegrown Ruby Black Tea. 4. Activities – Sun Moon Lake Tour (along the bike trail). 5. Agricultural products: black tea, mushrooms, orchids. 6. Pickup service – provided by the owner. 7. Ecological features: Fireflies, flowers, beetles, butterflies.

stays.name: Spring-Feng Cinnamomum Bed&Bre
stays.description: Spring Feng Bed and Breakfast is located in Jhongliao (Zhongliao) Township (Nantou County), facing Jiji Mountain in the east and Jiji Township in the south, and located a 35 minute drive from Sun Moon Lake. In order to experience the simple life, the owner decided to build a farm and pond on his own land after retiring. Here, he has arranged every plant and tree and included a vegetable garden. For environmental reasons, he weeds by hand, makes his own organic fertilizer, and reuses wastewater and rainwater so as not to waste natural resources. This makes the garden rich in ecology, with tree frogs, Muller’s barbets, Chinese bamboo partridges, and scops owls. During the spring, summer, and fall, the frogs begin singing in the evenings, causing quite the commotion and staring at us, wondering why people never give them a round of applause. The pleasing sound of chirping birds in the morning seems to be calling us to wake up, get out of bed, and enjoy the fresh air outside! Looking off at the mountains in the distance and watching birds flying in pairs, one cannot help but feel their heart open up and mind be at peace. The total area is approximately 9000 square meters, including 700 Taiwanese indigenous cinnamon trees. The bed and breakfast itself occupies about 2500 square meters, including a parking lot, cinnamon oil refining DIY activity, special cinnamon spiced cuisine (cinnamon chicken, golden eggs, fried rice, and tea), cinnamon products (cinnamon shampoo, body wash, mosquito repellent, hand lotion, and lip gloss). Guests can enjoy cinnamon baths with fragrant oils, helping them relax and relieve pressure.

stays.name: BAMBOO HOUSE
stays.description: Bamboo House is a traditional southern Chinese courtyard house hidden in bamboo forests at Zhushan, Nantou. With more than half of a century long history, the building was out of shape until recent years. Winston Lin, after years of working around the world, returned to his home village and renovated the house he grew up in. stays.name: OWL Forest
stays.description: Nestled in the Sheliao area of ​​Zhushan Township, Nantou County, "Zinan Temple" is a wonderful neighbor.The proprietress survived the devastating 921 earthquake and rose from the ashes to build this haven. The environment is tranquil and the ecosystem is rich; everyone is welcome to come and visit, enjoy tea, and make friends.High cost-performance ratio, very clean rooms, beautiful and spacious environment, enjoy the entire mountain, beautiful night view, good breakfast, feel at home, the owner treats all guests like family, and the beauty of the Zhuoshui River, the longest river in Taiwan, flowing from the source of Aowanda into the sea, can be seen from this mountain, forget all your troubles and find the best place to relax. The lights of thousands of homes are under your feet, you can be very absorbed and relaxed, sit and watch the beautiful sunset, go down to the sea from Ershui, the lights of Linnei Town in Yunlin and Ershui Town in Changhua, and the lights of Zhaojingshan, Ergaoshan Chong Community, Zinan Temple, the largest fire station and the largest training center in Taiwan in Nantou form an animation. There are also many historical and cultural landscapes, natural landscapes and ecological environment that cannot be described at once, waiting for you to experience it for yourself.

Whether you’re on a family trip, a romantic getaway, or a gathering with friends, we look forward to providing you with an unforgettable accommodation experience that fills every moment with beautiful memories. Our comfortable rooms and exquisite dining options will make your journey even more enjoyable. We warmly welcome you to visit Shanlin Bieyuan Inn, where you can experience the beauty of nature and enjoy peaceful moments, creating wonderful memories just for you!

stays.description: The interior of the hotel has a casual and relaxing style. From the lobby, guest rooms and even the bathroom area, you can see the comfort and layout that makes you feel at home. Especially the bed set of the room is the solid wood furniture that we personally went to hand-built by the carpenter. Featuring a minimalist view, Heliwen Homestay is a 40-minute drive from Xitou Forest Recreation Area. Free Wi-Fi is available in public areas. He Liwen Homestay is a 7-minute drive from Zhunan Zinan Palace. The B&B is planned to have a room size of 2 to 6 people. With a simple style design, each room has a simple space and a comfortable and design environment. In addition to the number of people staying in the room, the room is licensed. Extra beds are also available in the range. Rooms are air conditioned and feature large windows, an LCD TV with free channels and a bathroom with shower and hairdryer. Guests can ask for assistance with travel arrangements and free private parking.

stays.name: Caesar Park Hotel Banqiao
stays.description: The international Caesar Park Hotel Banqiao is perfectly located in New Taipei City: Banqiao Train Station (train, high speed rail, metro) is only within 3 minutes’ walk, making Taipei City and tourist attractions in other parts of Taiwan easily accessible. Mega City, FE21’ Far Eastern Department Store Banqiao, Lin Family Mansion and Garden, Nanya Night Market and Fuzhong Shopping Area are all in the same neighborhood, offering a wide range of leisure, entertainment, shopping and gourmet food options.Our 400 guestrooms are available in 9 room types. Each room has a 50-inch high-definition LCD TV, bluetooth speaker, kettle, capsule coffee machine, tea bags and bottled water. Every private bathroom is equipped with an electronic bidet, a walk-in shower, a bathtub and a double wash basin. Towels, eco-friendly organic toiletries, slippers, anion hair dryer and baby care products are also provided. Hotel facilities include Bar 98, Lotus Thai Restaurant, and JIA YAN Chinese Restaurant, where guests can enjoy a variety of great food and beverages. The hotel also features a fitness center and a 32nd-floor rooftop outdoor swimming pool, offering a stunning city view and an exceptional visual experience.

stays.name: MRT Hotel
stays.description: The MRT Hotel offers a new business lodging experience with designer set up and elegant atmosphere geared for an intrinsically understated, easy and comfortable stay without pretentious decorations and overbearing colonnades. Guests are recognized immediately, for the friendly concierge will greet them by name at the lobby, and courteous hotel staff waiting to show them to the reception for registration. The MRT has readied most thoughtful “services from the heart” and “treatments better than home” to welcome guests arriving from all parts of the world. Here, we regard our guests as family, and we want our family to feel relaxed and cuddled after a day of work or play, this way when guests leave they’d take back the fondest, sweetest memory from the MRT home.Located at Banqiao, the commercial heart of New Taipei City, and bordered on key business towns such as Xinzhuang, Zhonghe, Yonghe, Tucheng, Shulin, Sanxia and Yingge, the MRT Hotel is merely a bridge crossing away from Taipei City, with easy access to the National Highway No.3 Interchange, MRT Fuzhong Station, and the Banqiao Train Station. The 3-in-1 joint-use public transportation station (train, high speed rail and metro services converge into one station) is also conveniently available, so as shopping at the Far Eastern Shopping District, as well as the likes of fashion and beauty items, and 3 C products (computer, communication, and consumer electronics). Hypermarkets and the Nanya Night Market are also nearby, meeting daily necessity needs of our guests from every perspective.The MRT is built to to bring premium business services to travelers of the greater Taipei Area without the need of being inside Taipei City, we sincerely invite you to experience what we have to offer, for we are convinced regardless of your travel purpose, be it business, vacation or family outing, you will find the MRT Hotel more than satisfying in every way.

stays.name: Norway Forest Banqiao Motel
stays.description: Norwegian Wood Villa Motel, located on Heping Road in Banqiao, was built at a cost of nearly $500 million NT, and its architectural beauty resembles a modern paradise. Room design is based on themes from around the world, combining traditional and modern elements and improving them into a post-modern, fashionable boutique motel. Themes include Japanese modernism, Lounge, Mediterranean, Modern European, Southeast Asian, Simplism, Bali, Zen, Modern Chinese, and Arabian, with the decoration, design, views, furniture, arrangement, and space contributing to the overall atmosphere. The owners imported a large quantity of high-class furniture and decorations from Southeast Asia to complement the overall elegance. From space design to landscape layout, selection of furniture, and decoration arrangement, we strike the perfect balance. Each room is planned based on its design style and facilities. Modern life is stressful, and work routines and business demands mean that couples and people often spend less time with each other. With this in mind, we provide high-quality massage chairs, multi-purpose love chairs, love beds, heated spas, forest scenes, steam showers, cold pools, nano-life milk baths, bathroom TVs, huge 42-inch TVs, surround sound KTV, DVD players, VOD systems, Wii systems, and atmospheric lighting. Our design and facilities are unbelievable, providing guests with a luxurious, comfortable, secluded, secure, and sanitary environment. The motel also includes a high class restaurant that provides rich, gourmet Chinese and Western breakfasts. After taking advantage of our facilities, customers will feel like honored guests in our dining environment. Villa Motel’s attentive care, top-quality service and affordable prices make it one of the best deals in Taipei. We await your arrival!

The surrounding area is full of trendy products, food, drink, and entertainment. "Ya Dou Hotel" provides you with a warmer environment than at home, comfortable rooms, high-quality accommodation environment, simple and low-key taste of life, in the noisy and busy city, it breeds an extraordinary spiritual feast and creates an exclusive hotel for you personal space. Each room is decorated with famous cabinet bed sets, high-quality bed quilts and latex pillows, and the bathroom is decorated with American patented ceramic partitions. Welcome to stay at Yadu Hotel to experience our considerate service. Each exquisite room has modern room equipment and almost perfect living space. From the projection of the light to the touch of the bed sheets, it means that we attach great importance to your sleep quality. Our customer service specialist will handle every detail of service and arrangement during your stay, so that you can enjoy the beauty of leisure while doing business. . Warm and elegant, soft and comfortable tones and warm and earnest greetings soothe the tiredness of travelers. The whole hotel starts from the heart with customer-oriented hardware and software facilities and customized considerate services. Ya Dou Hotel is an excellent choice for your business or sightseeing.

stays.name: Fullon Hotel Tamsui Fisherman’s Wharf
stays.description: Fullon Hotel (Tamsui Fishermen's Wharf) is located in Tamsui Fishermen's Wharf, adjacent to the estuary of Tamsui River, where you can see Guanyin Mountain from afar and overlook Bali ferry, embracing beautiful scenery. Whether staring at the sunset in Tamsui or seeing the sights of mountain or sea, it is a stunning experience. The hotel is built to look like a floating luxurious ocean liner; therefore has the name of Love Boat of Fullon. The hotel features 198 rooms, with relaxing atmosphere of ocean everywhere, and provides you with an ultimate considerate and royal service. Other recreational facilities include SPAs, swimming pools, gymnasiums, etc. The theater-style column-free conference room can accommodate up to 100 Chinese style tables, or a thousand of Western style tables. Around the hotel, there are shopping arcade and arts avenue, where offer travelers one-stop leisure and shopping experiences. The hotel is next to the famous super revolving scenic tower-- Valentine's Tower, which built by Lih Pao and costed over three hundred million NT. The tower is constructed with carefully selected hardware from Switzerland, so it should be safe. It is 100 meter high with capacity up to 80 people. You can enjoy a panoramic view from the tower overlooking the landscapes of Tamsui, Guanyin Mountain, and surrounding sea, Taiwan Strait, as the tower rotates 360 degrees. Whether it is misty rain, or early in the golden yarn-like morning, or poetic, picturesque twilight after sunset, you can have a breathtaking view of natural beauty. The amazing beautiful memories stay with you your whole life.

stays.name: HOTEL DAY+TAMSUI
stays.description: Since Hotelday Chiayi opened, Cheng-Yi-Wen-Lu opened another location in Northern Taiwan - Cheng-Yi-Wen-Lu Hotelday Tamsui. This is the first time we ventured outside of our hometown, Chiayi, and came to this highly desirable city. Taking the first initiative on a new business idea is always exciting and hopeful. With a sweet smile on our face and adventurous ideas in our mind, we grabbed our map and business plan and hit the road. Cheng-Yi-Wen-Lu Hotelday Tamsui made a dramatic debut. We understand that travelers want to avoid busy big roads and prefer a quiet relaxing environment, so our hotel is located in a quiet alley. The large floor-to-ceiling windows bring a lot of natural lights to the lobby. Visitors coming through the lobby door evoke the scene of passengers arriving to the ferry. The sparkling oval panels attached to the ceiling create a stacked 3-dimensional visual effect in the lobby. The boat-shape counter resembles a boat swaying between the edge of a river and the wetland. You can almost picture a school of fish nearby and the mangrove stretching before you. It& #39;s definitely an imaginative and romantic design concept.

Located on Xuefu Road in Tamsui District, our hotel is equipped with indoor parking spaces and near MRT Tamsui Station therefore enjoys a great transport convenience. 198 luxury suite rooms, family rooms, business suite plus facilities such as business center, meeting center, VIP hall, banqueting hall and sauna room are well prepared. Free internet access is provided to facilitate our guests with laptops.Surrounded by Mt. Datun, Guanyin Mountain and the sunset at Tamsui River estuary, our hotel overlooks stunning views and standsright next topopular attractions such as Tamkang University, Yinshan Temple and Tamsui old streets. stays.name: Taipei Travelers International Hostel
stays.description: The brand new building of Taipei Travelers International Hostel is located in the heart of famous Tamsui Dist., New Taipei City. The 90 bunk beds of Taipei Travelers are equipped with facilities that free travellers would love it. With Female Dormitory and Mix Dormitory, there are five floors. Rooms are facilitated with spring beds, reading light, universal sockets, lockers (with key); free Wi-Fi, hangers, bed sheet, duvet, pillow, air-conditioning, heating, hairdryer in sink counter, separate shower rooms and toilets in the public area. There are common area with TV, refrigerator, microwave, induction cooker, steam cooker, toaster, free coffee and tea with all building non-smoking. Free breakfast is also in common area. The Taipei Travelers is renovate in 2017 started to operate from April. Famous Tamsui Old Street is just right outside to the left of the street. Within walking distance to the famous Tamsui sunset and to the footage of missionary Dr. Mackay. Many history and stories that you can discover in Tamsui. There are also ferry by the Tamsui riverbank to the Bali Mountain (the other side of river) and Fisherman’s Warf. Beautiful scenery with river and ocean catch your eyes. Taipei Travelers invite you to come to stay and explore the unique Tamsui.

stays.name: Fulong Beach Resort Hotel
stays.description: Enjoy the boundless beach, crystal blue water, scenic landscape and quiet and graceful mountains here. The one and only golden beach and Suangxi River with an abundance of water make here an important water base on the Northeast Coast, and nourishes a colorful atmosphere of ocean vacation. Create colorful and wonderful memories of having fun with friends, a date, beach wedding, honeymoon, or family vacations. The Fulong International Sand Sculpture Festival attracts hundreds of thousands of visitors every year. In the pleasant fall you can pass through the Old Caoling Tunnel or take a trip on the Caoling Historic Trial on bike to relish the silver grass in blossom along the way and the delight in the caress of the west wind. In winter, you can enjoy the Fulong sea-water hot spring, the deep see water that can moisturize your skin. You can also stay in the hot spring guestroom and have a great time in the in-room hot spring. Stay in Fullon all year round. Play in Fulong all year round

stays.name: The Easy Space
stays.description: New Taipei｜The Easy SpaceParty time on the coast in an old fishing villageHow long has it been since you went on a trip to see the ocean with a big group of friends, to have a few drinks and sing songs until the sun comes up? Make the arrangements, claim a weekend for your own, board a vehicle heading for the seaside, and make a beeline for a youthful party -- The Easy Space is the perfect villa for a carefree, seaside vacation.Vacation space in a villaTravelling along the seaside, only an hour by car from Taipei city, you come to an old forgotten fishing village in Gongliao bay. A faded red brick European style villa overlooks the ocean and reminds you of the former magnificence of the area. You pull the heavy glass doors open and step instantly into a different world. A lazy bossanova jazz tune resounds in your ears as you take in the extraordinary style of the living room with its high ceiling and crystal chandeliers. Seven-meter tall floor-to-ceiling windows allow you to take in the blue sky, the ocean, and the mountain ranges outside. The Easy Space was in fact originally a gift from the father of the hostess, Amber, to her grandfather on his 60th birthday 12 years earlier. Amber’s grandfather had left his hometown in the struggle to make a living and, despite achieving professional success, had always longed to return. With grandpa’s dream of returning to the countryside in his mind, Amber’s father went home and built the most fashionable European-style villa of the time.For the current hostess, Amber, The Easy Space brings back memories of beautiful vacations with friends. After leaving a pleasant life in the USA and returning to Taiwan for her family, Amber helped to revamp their old family villa, with the goal of allowing those fond childhood memories to live on. Upon her return, Amber also met her love, Michael. Now, through the everyday happiness of The Easy Space, the two of them share their mutual love and appreciation with every traveler who stays with them.Five secret oceanside bays for five different roomsYet the biggest surprise in this space measuring 250 ping isn’t the 100-inch Blu-ray home theater; there’s also KTV equipment, a sauna and steam room, a cocktail bar, and a fully equipped gym! There’s even a small reading room filled with Amber’s beloved collection of Japanese manga. Furthermore, plans are in the works to build an outdoor cafe with an ocean view for the enjoyment of The Easy Space guests.All five rooms here at The Easy Space were renovated by Amber and Michael’s own skillful hands to create a fresh aesthetic environment. If you love a big room, with a grand view of the ocean and sky, then your first choice will certainly be the “oceanside and sky” suite on the second floor, which puts you closest to the vast ocean and sky. The “fisherman’s bay” suite on the first floor is equally large and gives you the same generous front row seat to beautiful scenery. Around to the side, you find the “garden scenery” suite in the color of violets, a space situated just right to give you a view of both mountains and sea from the balcony.Though it doesn’t directly face the ocean, the “mountain and sea landscape” suite on the second floor is painted an enchanting Tiffany blue, and presents an irresistible choice for travelers. If you love the simplicity of the mountains and long to hide away in comfort and security, then the “hilltop cloud” suite was designed precisely for you. With large windows facing majestic mountains and one entire wall painted with a tunnel motif, you’re left wondering where that road into the distance may lead. Tonight, you may take a train ride in your dreams, setting off for a paradise where friendships are eternal.The forgotten, yet most beautiful, fishing village in the northeastAfter finishing Amber’s delicious homemade breakfast, take a walk into the village under a clear, azure sky. Maoao Fishing Village, the most beautiful fishing village in the whole northeast, lies between Taipei and Yilan and is extremely close to the villa. Once bustling and lively, it now lies tranquil and serene. Old houses are preserved and exude a generous and friendly ambiance. You greet an elderly neighbor resting in the shade of a doorway, and play with the kittens rolling around in the sunshine. You snap a few photographs as you reluctantly prepare to leave, taking beautiful memories back with you.The ocean breeze gently blows as you look back up the hillside to The Easy Space, and images of the flourishing and decline of the fishing village play in your mind. The faded red brick building before you holds aloft the resplendent colors of youth, inviting you and your friends to make plans to return soon to this quaint fishing village in the northeast.

stays.name: Twilight B&B
stays.description: about usThe vast landscape changing in four seasons, overlooking the Pacific Ocean at 180 degrees, facing the east, is the sea where the sun and moon rise, and is a dream place full of positive hope. Taiwan blackbird family soars in front of the window and occasionally stops at the treetop in front of you to look at you. The fishing boat set off from the sulphur port on the right, carrying tasks and expectations, and set off for a boundless future. At night, distant rows of leucorrhea fishing boats glow with lights, looming like a non-existent sea highway. The light reflected by the deep sea becomes a very unreal scene in the silent night. In April and May each year, there are only four trampoline boats in the world, and the fishing range is on the sea directly in front of the guesthouse. The sea that jumped out of the fire was like lightning, a bang, and all fish jumped out of the sea. The sound of sea waves, the wind of mountains and forests, the call of cicadas, entering the cochlea, please close your eyes, you are floating in the updraft of Taiwan Island, overlooking the mountains and trees and the sea of ​​this beautiful island, and the people living here Cute people and animals on the island. After eight years of transformation, all design elements were removed, leaving only those belonging to this land and those belonging to the sea. Large floor-to-ceiling sea-view windows, private living room. The first floor room type has a firewood fireplace (additional purchase required). It is a 10-minute drive from downtown Jinshan, a 4-minute drive from Zhongjiaowan International Surfing Base, a 5-minute drive from Beihai Golf Course, and a 15-minute drive from Zhu Ming Art Museum and Teresa Teng Memorial Park. Jinshan Old Street has a lot of delicious food, such as King Roubao and Goose, all must-try classics.

stays.description: .We once gathered travelers to hear Daji introduce "Together Design& #39;s" installation art, "Kaohsiung Shui Shui." From that landscape, I saw an image of my own journey through the harbor city. At the time, I joked, "If the opportunity ever arises, could we collaborate on a similar installation somewhere?" Years later, that dream materialized in this old mountain house, allowing Daji to express his perception of this land through architecture and lines.One afternoon, I stepped into "WADO Light+Living" in Dadaocheng. I watched and listened as Jiyang used light to narrate memories with his grandfather, surrounded by a house full of vibrant lighting fixtures, until the golden hour of sunset. I thought, "Someday, given the chance, the lighting in a space should be arranged just like this." And now, within "Layers of Light," every moment sees not only the shifting natural light but also "WADO& #39;s" ingenious artistry with light harmonizing with it."Layers of Light" is the first movement in the "Glittering Gold" project by the Storing Light team. In life, we gather and disperse, then disperse and gather again, but we ultimately decided to do something fun together. This house is currently the largest guesthouse in the project, and the team has invited many collaborators we& #39;ve long wanted to work with, starting the story from the very genesis of the earth. We hope people will gather here, reflect on the treasures they& #39;ve found on their own journeys, and enjoy the layered convergence of each other& #39;s paths.

This artist, with his background in architecture, guided us in creating a space for spiritual contemplation, inviting craftsmen who give wood a third life, transforming decay into wonder to illuminate the house.

stays.name: Formosa Arcadian Villa
stays.description: With spectacular scenery, delicious dining, and relaxing rooms, all to the soundtrack of nature’s symphony, a stay at Formosa Arcadian Villa is sure to leave your body satisfied and your mind full of memories. Relax and unwind in this spiritual oasis and experience the local culture and environment at this top-notch holiday destination. A visit to Formosa Arcadian Villa is a lesson in the true beauty of nature and of Taiwan. Classy and elegant, this villa is a veritable paradise on Earth, boasting great food, great relaxation, great views, great cooking, and great accommodation. Long-term stays are welcome too! This resort has earned a number of awards and certifications, and guarantees a quality, comfortable stay in a safe, hygienic, comfortable, and homey setting. Our scenic restaurant offers both Chinese and Western food, drinks (including coffee and tea), and even local specialties that we can deliver to your door! A great place for group buffets, afternoon teas, DIY barbeques, or events like special gatherings, banquets, conferences, business meetings, wedding photo sessions, or even just good old-fashioned holidays, we can even help you organize a travel itinerary to help you get the most from your visit!

stays.name: Jiufen Toy House
stays.description: Jiufen Toy HouseNestled in the quiet alleys of the Jiufen mountain town, Jiufen Toy House is more than just a guesthouse—it is the result of years of passion and dedication. We have preserved the charm of a century-old stone house and blended it with elements of industrial design, creating a space that feels both nostalgic and modern. Every corner of the house is filled with toys I’ve collected during my travels—each one tells a story from a different era and reflects my enduring love for the childlike spirit.I believe that the passion for travel and the joy of collecting shouldn’t be just fleeting moments—they should be part of everyday life. I love exploring Northeast Asia, capturing scenery through my lens and experiencing culture through taste. Every journey becomes an extension of my life’s story, adding depth and color to who I am. For me, the greatest joy of running Toy House B&B is meeting and connecting with travelers from all over the world. I’m a passionate, sincere person who truly enjoys making new friends! stays.name: Levite Villa
stays.description: Levite Villa is a four-story building set on a mountainside with a distinctive façade of layers of white painted wall and stonework wall that make it look much like a church from a distance. The name “Levite” comes from Hebrew, meaning “exhorted to return to a natural life.” Every room at Levite Villa offers a spectacular view, and the interiors feature bedding hand-made by a well-known fashion designer out of pure white cotton. After guests check out, they use ozone to make sure any bacteria and other nasties are killed off, ensuring new guests get rooms as fresh as the mountain forest. Managers Pauling and Tony are also nationally licensed tour guides in both English and Chinese, and offer informative, friendly, and professional service to their valued guests, including in-depth tours of neighboring Jinguashi. And after expending all your energy exploring, you can come back and get a great night’s sleep in the custom-made bedding! Levite Villa is a home away from home, with food, fun, and comfort. If you’d like to experience it for yourself, get in touch with them at http://levitevillage.net

stays.name: Meiao Shiguang Homestay
stays.description: Jiufen "Good Time B&B" is 3-5 minutes walking from the old street, its Southern European-style, the building stands out with its balck-and-white elegance. Follow the rock staircase to the entrance and you will immediately find the tranquility unique to "Good Time". It provides spacious suites in a simple style but different interior styles for variety while keeping the welcoming aura. From the window you can clearly see the mountains, the sea and the streets. Rebuilt from the land for nine homes, this brings a trace of gentleness to the mountainside town once dominated by miners. Besides quality accommodation service, "Good Time B&B" also features a dining area. The Chinese-style carved seats renovated by the host are combined with a brilliant orange interior, European round table, and a mountain view from the window gives you a brand new dining experience.

stays.name: Something Easy
stays.description: New Taipei｜Something Easy GuesthouseA Window to Tranquility in a Mountain TownAs you ride up the mountain into the town of Jiufen, you catch sight of the misty mountains in the distance and see the sun pierce the clouds, warming the emerald-green mountainside. Disembarking from your ride, you recall the words of your host, Min, who warned that you would have to pass through the bustling old-street district on your way to the guesthouse. As you walk to the end of the street, you begin to foresee what is in store, as images of the elegant, tranquil face of Jiufen begin to fill your mind.A life of peace and quiet on the side of the mountainWalking along stone steps, you wind your way this way and that down the narrow alleys until you reach the appointed destination of Jiufen Elementary School, where you are met by the sweet smile of your host, Min. You follow her for less than three minutes until you reach the inconspicuous entrance of Something Easy Guesthouse to one side of the steep stone laneway. You close the door behind you and, slipping out of your shoes and into the slippers your host has prepared, you step onto the warm solid-wood floorboards. You bask in the warm lighting of the place, leaving the cold air of the mountains behind, as the mellow wooden environs instantly set your mind at ease.This space was originally designed to meet the vacation needs of Min’s family. From the verawood floorboards to the array of solid teakwood furniture, every corner of the space reveals her family’s insistence on quality and texture. The house, which is situated on the edge of this hillside town, affords you secluded, peaceful lodgings for your getaway from busy city life.Waking up free from worry in a scenic landscapeYou gently open the door to each of the rooms and walk in towards an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows. You gaze upon the mountain range beyond, the peaks extending layer upon layer all the way to the ocean where ocean and sky meet on the horizon. If you choose to stay in an upstairs room, you may enjoy the luxury of your own small living room, allowing you the freedom to laze about on the sofa in the company of the majestic landscape.As the evening sky gradually darkens, the lights of the town illuminate the mountainside one by one. Min has thoughtfully equipped your bathroom with a heater / dehumidifier so that you may stay warm and dry at all times. After you’ve enjoyed a lavish bath, connect to the room’s bluetooth sound system to play your favorite tunes. Finally, lie down on the large double bed and slowly drift into slumberland.A calm corner on the Old StreetAs morning breaks and the gentle sunlight peeks through the cracks of the curtains, you unhurriedly awake to meet the day. The single-serving coffee maker brews a silky smooth latte for you to enjoy on the rooftop patio with a few slices of toast and jam. In contrast to yesterday evening’s misty mountain scenery, the daytime skies in Jiufen appear especially clear and bright - the turquoise blue of the ocean blending into the azure blue of the sky. Glancing downwards, you realize the bustle of Jiufen Old Street is right below your feet. Anticipation of perusing the old street at a leisurely pace begins to build, as you imagine the undiscovered pleasures awaiting you within.Something Easy Guesthouse is situated in a corner of Jiufen’s bustling Old Street, inviting you to settle into your own tranquil corner from which to peacefully observe the everyday life of this hillside town. Regardless of the countless tumultuous days of your life, all that is left now is a wall of windows and the serene landscape beyond. From here, discover the peaceful getaway of your dreams.

The lush and vibrant garden will bring a smile to your face and a spark to your imagination, and this sharing of the beauty of life has created many an emotional connection in the guests. Each room is an emotional experience of its own, like a little play, except you get to choose how it goes! It is our goal to truly make your experience a homely one, like you are a member of our family. Each room contains all the necessities, and each stay includes a lovingly crafted breakfast. We look forward to having the pleasure of hosting you!

stays.name: Wang Yu Ku Homestay
stays.description: Wang Yougu Bed & Breakfast sits next to the Jiufen River in verdant mountainous foothills. With just a 10-minute stroll, you can reach the popular trail, a walk back into the days of Jiufen’s gold rush. From the homestay you can look out over Jiufen, and Mt. Keelung, and whether by day or by night, it’s a spectacular sight. A renovated building built in the traditional stone style of the area, Wang Yougu’s renovations are our own handiwork, with every tile and stone personally laid. We’re born and bred Jiufen residents, and as such have a strong connection to the area and are invested heart and soul in providing a homestay experience you’ll love. Every room has its own table and chairs to relax at, with the interior design our own work; we hope you’ll enjoy your stay with us! If you arrive in the afternoon, you can head down from Songde Park to Jiufen Old Street and while away the hours in the old-fashioned surroundings at one of the excellent tea houses or cafés, and in the evening you can watch the stars in our yard, relaxing before a good night’s sleep, then wake up to a home-cooked breakfast. Then, full of vim and vigor, you can travel out to Jinguashi, visit the Gold Park, or go for a hike up Mt. Keelung or along the northeast coast. We have three rooms in different styles—a Japanese tatami room, a “blue ocean” room, and a “pastel romance” room. Each comes equipped with its own bathroom and free snacks, including candy, cookies, instant noodles, water, and drinks — perfect for that midnight snack! The usual fee is NT$1500 (Sunday-Thursday), with weekends and holidays NT$2000. Extra beds can be provided for NT$300 a person, up to a maximum of two additional people.

stays.name: Yun Shan Shui Xiao Zhu Homestay
stays.description: Cloud Village sits in the middle of the “golden triangle” of Jinguashi, Jiufen, and Shuinandong, and is a fantastic place for those who love hiking. Up the trail about one kilometer, or about a 30-minute hike, is the hustle and bustle of Jiufen; down the trail about 15 minutes—also one kilometer—is Jinguashi’s well-known Huangjin (Golden) Falls; and a 20-minute walk will get you to Jinguashi’s Gold Museum Park. Or, rather than hiking, you could just kick back and enjoy the fresh air and birdsong as you unwind. There’s no need to go overseas for a great alpine experience — there’s one right here waiting for you!

stays.name: HOUSE OF SAN SIA AH KUEI
stays.description: Here, the mountains are close; here, the clouds are right in front of you; here, the butterflies dance carefree through the air; here, nature is right by your side. A-Kuei’s House Bed & Breakfast is only a half-hour drive from Sanxia Old Street, and the ability to so easily enjoy the embrace of nature and the mountains comes as quite the surprise to many! Over 10 years ago, A-Kuei was looking for a place to retire, finally settling on this slice of land. Now, we hope that you’ll find “A-Kuei’s House” a place to unwind and return to the embrace of Mother Nature as the natural scenery nourishes your soul and spirit. With the rolling hills and mountains curled up in front of you, the views from up here are spectacular; and as dusk comes, it offers a fantastic place to watch the sun go down as the skies turn a burning orange. Then, as night falls, the lack of light pollution means the starry night is on full display. A-Kuei’s House is only 10 minutes from The Great Roots Forestry Spa Resort, 15 minutes from Wuliaojian, 30 minutes from Manyueyuan National Forest Recreation Area, 30 minutes from Sanxia and Yingge Old Streets, and 40 minutes from the Culture Resort of the Chiangs.

stays.name: Xiuchuanju
stays.description: Xiuchuan Street was a bustling commercial street during the Qing Dynasty, more than a hundred years ago. The old dock of the Sanxia River was located here, attracting numerous merchant ships and presenting a picturesque scene. Adjacent to the riverbank stood the Zaisu Temple, the earliest center of worship in Sanxia. The street gradually became surrounded by traditional buildings as it catered to the residents& #39; daily needs for food, clothing, shelter, and transportation. However, during the Japanese colonial period, commercial activities in this area declined, and most shops moved to the current Sanxia Old Street. Nevertheless, Xiuchuan Street and its surroundings still retain a strong sense of ordinary life and are considered one of Taiwan& #39;s most historically valuable old streets.To revive the beauty of the old houses, Gandle Creative Studio has reinterpreted a historic building as an independent homestay called "Xiuchuan Residence," through a minimalist and gentle approach. The interior decoration preserves the charm of the old house, with nostalgic floor tiles and warm yellow pendant lights that naturally exude an indescribable sense of familial intimacy. We hope that during your short stay here, you can experience the nostalgic atmosphere of the past in this contemporary setting, and create wonderful memories with your family, friends, colleagues, and classmates.

stays.name: Rainbow brige B&B
stays.description: Its brilliant to stay at our house!The Rainbow Bridge Home-stayThe flourishing scenes have enriched the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay via various colors of blooming. You would see the vivid red brought by the Japanese maples and gradient purple of Irises and wisterias. The mediating green of the Water lilies and Pines. Our nice coffee has added a color of brown with unforgettable coffee scent. Furthermore, our Silk flowers, Rhododendrons and Hydrangeas play the stimulating roles to enrich the unique view of the Rainbow Bridge Home-stay.Locating at the center of the Award-Winning village for it& #39;s thriving and Eco-friendly, San Zhi Village. Through the years of conservation, we proudly introduce you a rich and healthy ecology which is only in San Zhi. A river that sometimes has the ducks comfortably swimming in it while an eagle has been seen few times on the sky. With love and effort, we have successfully developed all kinds of nature plants. At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, you could be really surprised by the flourishing scene of the Maples, Wisterias, Water lilies, Irises, Silk flowers, Pines and Calamus. Our unique garden always attracts heaps photographers over to take photos and artists to sketch during the Spring season. At Rainbow Bridge Home-stay, please enjoy the privilege of being our precious guest. Our hospitable staff always welcome the guests with the home-baked coffee and herbal tea and they are out of charge. Have a walk in the Village for a good meditation, moreover, soak your feet into the nice chill river to feel really fresh. We would like to also invite you to our wall-painting gallery which has been contributed by the Award-Winning artists. Fulfilling your tummy next morning with our buffet-style breakfast. Providing with the choices of Chinese and Western breakfasts. All dishes are organic and some are from our own farm. You would be guaranteed of a healthy and organic eating style. In addition to the breakfast, we accept the dinner reservation and providing you with the choices of seafood, steak, seasonal vegetables and other oriental cuisines such as Japanese and Vietnam cuisines. Exciting with the great convenience to reach other famous scenery, e.g. Whit Sand Bay, Yehliu Geopark, Tamsui Old Street, and Cianshuei Bay. stays.name: Walker Hotel-Sanchong Zhengyi Branch
stays.description: Walker Hotel - Zhengyi is located on Zhengyi South Road, only 5 minutes away from the Sanchong Interchange of Zhongshan Highway. It has convenient transportation and is located in the downtown area of ​​Sanchong! The Sanhe Night Market near Sanchungpu is the liveliest place in Sanchung at night. It is packed with people after dusk, especially the stalls selling clothing. The bustling scene of people and vehicles and the shouting of vendors make it a large place full of the most authentic night market atmosphere. As for food, the pig's trotters, fish ball soup, egg pancakes, crispy intestines, stinky tofu, papaya milk, shrimp soup, meatballs, oyster omelette, squid soup, etc. are all very popular, and the prices are more affordable than those in Taipei City, which is just across the bridge. It is very suitable for gourmets to come here for a "challenge" and try the fun of eating from the beginning to the end of the street.However, the room design is comfortable and clean, providing a comfortable and relaxing hotel space, and very complete room planning, simple and warm affordable accommodation, and the interior of the room is equipped with clean and elegant furnishings.

stays.name: Fullon Hotel Taipei,East
stays.description: The Fullon Hotel Taipei East – a Subtle Luxurious hotel. Completed in 2010, this magnificent hotel exudes fashionable luxury. It sits close to the Taipei Zoo metro station on the Wenhu Line, and is a 15 minutes car drive away from the Xinyi shopping district around Taipei 101. This bright and beautiful sightseeing hotel features 317 delicate and luxurious guest rooms that meet the needs of business and holiday travelers.Conveniently accessible, the hotel is located close to the Muzha Interchange of Freeway No. 3. Xinhai Road connects straight to downtown, while Xinyi Road connects to Xinyi District. Nearby sights abound: nostalgic Shenkeng Old Street and the food stalls at Shenkeng temple are in walking distance. The Taipei Zoo, a favorite with the young and old, also Maokong Gondola are not far either. Leisurely Pingxi, Shiding Scenic Area, and the secluded Qiandao Lake are also easily accessible by public and private transport.

stays.name: Shan Ming Shui She Homestay
stays.description: A new generation of bed & breakfast, Shanming Shuishe is a veritable paradise nestled amongst verdant mountains. The owners, Mama and Papa Wang, are nature lovers, and strove to create their own beautiful home amongst nature. Now they invite you to come and enjoy the beauty of birdsong and the fragrance of flowers in their quite country homestead, far from the madding crowd. Shanming Shuishe is located in Shuangxi District, New Taipei City, only a short six minutes’ drive from Pingxi/Shifen Train Station and close to Jiufen, Fulong, and Gongliao. As the city nearby continues to grow and change, Shuangxi retains a sense of simplicity and nature, giving visitors a sense of traveling back through time to the 1950s and to a more sedate, relaxing way of life. A licensed bed & breakfast, Shanming Shuishe boasts a combination of natural beauty and attentive hosts, making it an elegant, comfortable home away from home for any guest. Equipped with cable television, karaoke, and other entertainment facilities, it’s a perfect place for couples, families, small groups of friends, or company retreats. If you have any questions about your visit or your travel itinerary, please contact Shanming Shuishe at (02)2493-3969, (0915)731-371, (0955)064-131, or through their website at http://www.smss.tw

stays.name: twobest.hostel
stays.description: Shuangxi is a township at the confluence of two rivers, and the area is a protected water source. While it lacks the glitz and glamor of neighboring Jinguashi, Jiufen, Pingxi, or Fulong, it retains as its core value the concept of creating a dialogue between the rivers and the mountains, making hit a valued tourist destination. Shuangzhenyuan Bed & Breakfast aims to provide its guests with a tranquil, healthy, simple experience. Its managerial team has a total of five hospitality licenses, and the breakfasts provided, both Chinese and Western, are created using organic fruit and vegetables along with other locally produced ingredients. Built using green design ideas that provide excellent ventilation and lighting, the building offers a sense of being embraced by nature as you dine, while around you the calls of little egrets and Formosan blue magpies provide accompaniment. Enjoy the best that life has to offer in an atmosphere of green mountains, blue waters, and bright sunshine. This Bed & Breakfast has five rooms over two floors, with wooden floors that create a comfortable Japanese style. It also offers a safe, comfortable space for parents to bring their children to. The natural-stone-paved riverbank creates a perfect balance with the lush grasslands and greenery, which sop up the rain like a sponge. This natural environment also attracts a diverse range of fauna, and to help guests get the most out of their stay, guided tours from the owners and their families are available. Website: http://twobest.okgo.tw/

stays.name: INHOUSE HOTEL YEHLIU
stays.description: INHOUSE HOTEL YEHLIU is located at Taiwan’s Northern shore scenic area, adjacent to Geological Park and Ocean World. Designed by the highly respected Rockwell Group of New York, overall decoration incorporates original wood colors to create a comfortable, relaxing ambience, modern sophistication could be seen in every corner and has been regarded as the first choice for resort hotel in Northern shore area. Staying at the hotel, there is no need to leave the room to enjoy the stunning view of ocean and sky merging together and the display of rocks in spectacular forms as if they were carved by the extraordinary power of nature. At dusk, you can see the soothing view of fishing boat light flickering in the middle of ocean, awaiting the returns of fishing boat filled with harvest of fresh catches. INHOUSE HOTEL YEHLIU is your best choice in Northern shore area, presenting you the best of what Yehliu has to offer while creating a relaxing stay, it’s time to take vacation with a INHOUSE attitude.

stays.description: “The Loft Hotel” was named to invoke the image of a breezy, open and welcoming area for guests. Its environment was designed to incorporate luxury, architectural beauty and detailed composite designs to create a comfortable environment and allow both international and domestic travellers to feel at home as soon as they walk in the door.“The Loft Seaside Suites” (originally Seagala Spring Hotel) is located on the beautifully scenic North Coast in an area rich in tourism resources. The view from the North Coast Highway is stunning and the road is dotted with attractions and rest areas rich in artistic spaces.The Loft brand hotels received formal trading rights in June 2012 and works hard to uphold the group’s trading ethos: ‘Right Attitude, Right Service, Right Time’ to ensure your holiday is as close to perfection as it can be.The hotel is proud to offer pure, all-natural and hygienic seabed hot springs, making it a sacred spot for hot spring aficionados. Naturally, this isn’t the only thing the hotel boasts! Guests are able to enjoy superior service (in beachside style!), airy rooms with luxurious beds, natural and simplistic surroundings with swaying palm trees and tropical flowers, stone baths, and fine Japanese Kaiseki-style cuisine. Our hotel provides you with all the best to ensure you can enjoy the romantic flavors of Bali right here in Taiwan.

stays.name: Di Pan Hot Spring Homestay
stays.description: Spring Spa Bed & Breakfast is situated in Wulai, New Taipei City, amidst the spectacular mountains and waters of this hot-spring destination, as well as being in close proximity to Neidong Forest Recreation Area, Wulai Old Street, and other must-see spots. Inside, the owner’s hard work is on display, from the landscaped garden to the carefully crafted furniture, all waiting for you to experience it yourself. Hot springs, food, and accommodation are all available. There is also a nearly 650 square meter open-air café offering outstanding views of the neighboring Honghuang Valley and dam as well as being a great place to relax. The elegant springs rooms and Japanese style baths each cover about 50 square meters, providing open, comfortable spaces. Looking out the windows, Wulai’s beauty unfurls itself in front of you, making these perfect for the whole family. The luxury bathing rooms are 1:1 with their baths, with the baths available in both hot and cold, allowing you to freely switch between them as you enjoy the scenery of Wulai. These elegant, simple accommodations are designed with an aboriginal theme, and are perfect for honeymooning couples. For bookings, go to http://www.myhotel.com.tw/springspa

stays.name: Yun Hsien Hotel
stays.description: Wulai is located about 27 kilometers southeast of Taipei City and is the only mountainous district in New Taipei City. The entire area is lush with greenery, clear flowing waters, and surrounded by mountains. The renowned Wulai Waterfall originates from a stunning mountaintop landscape featuring tranquil lakes, ancient towering trees, misty forests, colorful butterflies, cicadas singing, and birds chirping — like a paradise hidden from the world. However, due to the steep cliffs of the Nanshi River, visitors were unable to fully appreciate this scenery up close. Thus, the idea to construct an aerial cable car was conceived. The cable car allows the pristine natural landscape to be fully presented to visitors from above. Because the natural beauty of the area changes uniquely with each season — spring, summer, autumn, and winter — like a fairyland, the place was named "Yun Hsien Resort" (literally meaning "Cloud Fairy Paradise").

stays.name: All-ur Boutique Motel
stays.description: Unlike the extravagant style in ordinary motels and hotels, or the standardized room design, the new site in Sinjhuang features "Art" and "Design." Not a single room has repeated size or design, even though there are up to 80 rooms. The rooms are individually different in terms of their styles by utilizing different artists, schools, paintings and the highlights commonplace in our everyday life. stays.name: Hotel 20 Alley
stays.description: This is a story about our hotel…Twenty years ago, in the road named Ershizhang, grandpa established a plain hotel. The core value was simple－ to be here is to be at home. At that time, grandpa displayed a statue of peacock inside the lobby, which was a spiritual symbol of the hotel. The symbol protected here soundly and developed steady.Three generations pass, this simple hotel located quietly in Ershizhang road grows up, and is more than simple. With the changing in the world, what never changes is our sincere heart and faith. The core value of ours is still the same, to provide you a soft and warm bed, and to cook you a hot and tasty food, but just add a little more creative and modern atmosphere to all feelings. The hotel is full of new thoughts in the concept of a beautiful life.We cherish a warm space, and we like to travel as you are; we love arts and creations as you do, and delicate bakery is our mutual choice. Therefore, they all move in this warm home.

stays.name: LAKE HOTEL
stays.description: 【Xindian Bitan Lake Hotel】 is located next to Bitan in Xindian District, New Taipei City. “Renaissance” is a philosophical and cultural movement that occurred in Europe between the 14th and 17th century. It inherited ancient Greek and Roman culture and brought about a revolutionary era in science and art. It has innovative meanings due to “inheriting the past and opening up for the future”. The Renaissance unveiled a new era for modern European history by setting foundations for modern science and culture development. It also symbolized the input of an unprecedented current regarding tourism and cultural creative industry. With 【Classic Replica－European Renaissance】 as the center of design, by assembling core art, drama, literature, science, and philosophy works, “humanism thoughts” promoted in the Renaissance are utilized in the overall design of the hotel, thus creating an European artistic and cultural atmosphere blended with modernity and classic. Upon entering the lobby, visitors can immediately feel the magnificence of European Renaissance scenarios. Staying in our themed rooms, tourists can enjoy the beautiful scenery of the green mountains and blue water of Bitan, along with classic Renaissance masterpieces from various fields, thus reproducing the grand recreational palaces of the time. This extravagant classical and European hotel is located in an area with convenient transportation. You can enjoy the beautiful landscapes of Bitan with your eyes! It is your first choice among all hotels in the Bitan region of Xindian! It is the most iconic hotel of this region!

You can enjoy various leisure equipment and free cable and wireless network. Travelers, business people and backpackers& #39; needs will be fulfilled. The guests can use and enjoy with peace of mind and relieve the stress from the daily work. Because our prices are very reasonable, many of our guests would like to pay a little more to upgrade to a more delicate room. In addition to the business rooms, we have boutique rooms with classic decorations, luxurious rooms with tidy environment, hot spring rooms with marble bathtubs and quad rooms for families. Deluxe and boutique rooms are the best-selling rooms in Xiangnai Er Motel. We also have a roomy space for you to watch numerous VOD videos and enjoy the most relaxing moment. Travelling wherever you will with your pack on your back, you arrive at the Yingge train station where, across the way, your eyes are drawn to a building with aquamarine blue window frames. That is the blue, the color of freedom, from which the home of a traveler is constructed - Fish Hostel.A traveler’s home, a rest station while journeying the worldAccording to legend, a gigantic parrot roaming the blue skies once decided to settle on a mountain ridge in the western part of New Taipei City. The moment it perched itself, the story of “Parrot Brother Rock” (literal translation of Ying Ge Shi) was born and slowly passed on by word of mouth to one day become the “Oriole Song” (literal translation of Ying Ge) we know today. Over the years, the traveler’s melody was added to the Oriole Song. Fish Hostel sits directly across from the Yingge Train Station, perfectly situated to welcome those drifting souls to take a rest along their journey.As you enter the main hall, a large tree limb is used as a merchandise display to the left side of the entrance. A variety of small products from far-off locations hangs from the branches. Available for purchase are ethnic clothing items with tribal designs, handmade jewelry, and much more. Your host Emma also loves travel, and has brought back a rich and diverse world with which to decorate Fish Hostel. “Since this is a traveler’s home, I wanted to give everyone a peaceful and comfortable feeling!” One entire wall on the first floor is covered in graffiti principally composed of blue and white colors, creating an ambiance of peace and harmony. The design was entirely created by Emma who gave life to her ideal through each brush stroke. Emma’s conviction is that, through her skillful creation, fish that once wandered to the ends of the world without a home now have a place to return to. She hopes to energize the travelers that come her way.A little backpacker’s abode built from bountiful graffitiKicking off your shoes, you head upstairs where you find tidy rows of simple wooden bunk beds that have supported the travel dreams of travelers from around the world. Besides backpacker accommodations, Fish Hostel also offers two- and four-person rooms. The keyring for the room shows a fish swimming through a little heart, like a nimble fish which can, in the blink of an eye, bring you back to the Little Sun Room. The Little Sun Room has its own private balcony and ample comforting daylight. The light bathes the warm tones of the room in which the compelling breeze lightly sways your beautiful dreams. A hand-painted wall with ocean-blue as its base color leads you along to the Big Sun Room. The color designs lead you to the splendid yellow flowers blooming in the Big Sun Room, as if keeping watch over anyone who sleeps soundly in the two double beds. A soft, bright green floor mat covers the floor beneath the beds, to allow guests the utmost level of relaxation and enjoyment.ΙΧΘΥΣ is the Greek word for fish, as well as an important spiritual symbol for Fish Hostel. In the early days of Christianity, when believers were under persecution from the Roman Empire, they would use the Greek word for fish with graceful arcs drawn above and below as a secret sign to identify each other’s status as believers. “It is my hope that every traveler who comes to Fish Hostel can find companions that they are compatible with, as well as to be in the peaceful presence of Jesus.” Emma says that fish are just like our souls; we are all in the middle of a journey, step-by-step to complete our own lives.A traveler’s chance encounter leads to the completion of lifeSurprisingly, the multi-talented host of Fish Hostel, Emma, redid her university test in order to choose her beloved industrial arts design program. During her student years, she worked as a pottery teacher, using her income to accumulate an impressive store of travel memories from all over. Just like the rich and diverse decor of the living room, Emma used movement to fulfill her heart and spirit. During the summer break of her second year of university, she was an artist in residence in Jiufen. She met many friends thanks to that opportunity. “They were all doing what they wanted to do, and it showed me that life can be very simple.” After two months in residence, Emma had imagined her ideal blueprint for her life, and the dream of opening a guesthouse slowly started to sprout in her mind. She recalls, “I didn’t want to wait until some time in the distant future. I could do what I wanted to do even while I was a student.” After she had made up her mind, she rode all over on her scooter to find a location. She found it on day three. By day seven she had created her business plan! Her past travel experience along with her meticulous craftsmanship all helped to nurture the development of Fish Hostel! “Our lives are always full of speed and light, and Fish Hostel opens a little chink in that speed.” The walls are covered in passionate messages, as well as Emma’s own hand-drawn map of local travel spots, awaiting travelers to continue to add to the map. At Fish Hostel, travel is like an ongoing dialogue. At Fish Hostel, no matter what language is used, whether vocal or silent, whether the dialogue is outwards or inwards; souls that are in love with travel will continue to rush forth as if pushed by a warm current, hurrying onwards for the next ocean journey.

Attached gourmet takeout area and serves offers handmade breads, pastries, and classic delicacies made by dessert kitchen of RSL Hotel Taipei Zhonghe. Walking up along the hall stairs to the second floor, you see the extension of Guanyin stone floor, then modern grilles screens and calm wooden grilles greet you. Warm RED restaurant features á la carte style all you can eat to provide customers easy consumption of gourmet food. RED restaurant, as its name implied, has bright, stylish, modern exterior, and provided restrained, traditional, rich and varied Chinese cuisine. Apart from the restaurant, the hotel features a ballroom with four meters high ceiling on the third floor available for all kinds of meetings, banquets to be held here.

stays.name: ChenHai Bay
stays.description: "Penghu – Baisha - Chenhai" Chenhai Village, Baisha Township is located in the suburb of Magong. It is a small village with an abundant marine ecosystem and is far away from the city. Its tranquility and simplicity comfort many urban residents. Currently many Fukienese traditional houses still remain in the village, inhabited by simple villagers. The streets in the community are designed in a concise and neat manner and the ambient areas are also conserving fresh and nature touch pertaining to this smaller village. When you open the door and set the foot in “ChenHai Bay”, you will be instantly impressed by the unique design. Intimate conversation with the visitors and clean-cut comfort rooms, it gives a home-like secureness and coziness. You can easily get near to the sea on the Tsen Hai Beach not far away from the B&B. During high tide, the beach here is also an absolutely safe water activity ground. You can also participate in the SUP paddling races held by the B&B, competing with foreign friends hailing from every corner of the world. When the tide recedes, you may gather prawns, crab and shells in the vast exposed inter-tidal zone while looking over the Penghu Maritime Museum and northern islands around Yuan Bei Island. During the night, the beach is also teeming with life as prawns and crab emerge from the sand. You may take part in the “Bao Tung” fishing activity and experience the marine life in close distance under the twinkling stars. It is really a perfect location for the family to spend some leisurely days.
