stays.name: Houniao Chaojian Dai Homestay
stays.description: Penghu｜Migrant Intertidal GuesthouseMigratory Birds Return to Roost in their Primitive Ocean HometownYou turn into a small village before Baisha township and the road leads seamlessly straight up to the inner Penghu ocean. As for the migratory bird intertidal zone, it is unique to this ocean area and is less than 20 meters from the hostel. Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse welcomes you city birds to return to your primitive, natural seaside home.White migratory birds perched in the intertidal zoneThe irregular design of the building, like a white migratory bird preparing to take flight, is caressed by the southern summer winds. The bright, yellow beach and expansive ocean scenery in front of the guesthouse, the independent docks and the beautiful vistas of the intertidal zone; all of these ecological landscapes before your eyes fluctuate with the ebb and flow of the tide and the come and go of daylight. These elements combine into a veritable painting of priceless abundant vitality wherein, each moment, a new and moving vista appears.Besides embracing the intertidal zone along the shore in front of the guesthouse, the name of Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse originates from hosts Amy and Ken’s love of birds. They are both members of the Penghu Wild Birds Association and are passionate about everything relating to birds on the island. They also look forward to helping all their city-dwelling guests to feel as if they are returning to roost, to invite them to come back regularly to enjoy the intact natural ecosystem as well as their own oceanside home.Earnest perception of the simplest blessings and happiness “There is really nothing special about our home, as there’s nothing of note in this area. All we have is our earnest perception and appreciation.” In the words of Amy, Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse doesn’t have any ornate decorations or elaborate designs, but is rather a return to primitive natural happiness, all of which is made possible by one’s willingness to “perceive”.Open your mind and strive to perceive, then! Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse will help you open your senses and your mind, and to cultivate an even more attentive attitude toward experiencing nature. Perhaps it will happen in the morning, when welcoming the sunrise over the ocean, or perhaps when observing the A-New, the guesthouse dog, running down to the ocean to frolic excitedly in the water. Or perhaps it will come to you in the morning over breakfast when you experience the taste of Zhongji baked sesame seed-coated cakes for the first time. In any case, you’ll experience so many moving moments in this place. Nighttime exploration of intertidal pools!Yet the most unforgettable experience on offer at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse is surely exploring the intertidal pools in the pitch-black darkness of night. Follow Ken on a magnificent intertidal nighttime adventure! Holding your flashlight, you put on shorts and sandals and, stepping over the vines on the beach, you enter the knee-high tidal pool. You catch sight of bright, silver clove fish as their slender bodies dart to and fro beneath the surface. They bump into your legs as you pass through and, before you have time to get used to this clove fish encounter, to your delighted surprise, Ken picks up a plump, round blowfish, spines protruding at all angles. If you make the trip to Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, you simply cannot pass up the opportunity to go out with Ken to explore the abundant ecological wonders of the intertidal pools. It will be a meeting with nature that you won’t soon forget!It’s hard to imagine that, after leaving the intertidal pools and returning to the guesthouse, yet another surprise awaits: a bowl full of a summer-season delicacy - fresh oysters! You use tongs to hold the shells of the oysters while you remove the rich milky flesh. No matter how much you eat, you never get tired of these oysters, especially when washed down with a cup of draft beer. How delightful!Life is simple at Migrant Intertidal Guesthouse, yet the experience is rich and plentiful. For city-dwelling travelers who are weary of the bustle of everyday life, it is a true blessing to return to such a place, like migratory birds returning to roost each year. After visiting such a place, with spirits revitalized, you can set off to achieve your next big goal.

stays.name: Xiang Xie Homestay
stays.description: Jibei Island--This is a beautiful sandy islet because it embraces a hooked spit with a beach of yellow sand stretching thousands of meters long, one of the world's rare spit terrain. The best way to enjoy your trip here is not to take a superficial, cursory observation, but to slow down the steps and collect your mood here to better feel the islet's thousand amorous feelings. Came to Gibay Sunshine, you'll have a more refined and comfortable accommodation!The newly completed Gibay Sunshine is located in a prime location of Jibei Island, near the most lively bazaar and neighboring Jibei Spit, and convenient life functions are all just within a walking distance. We have Penghu's only license of operating stone tidal weirs, which is one of our privately owned attractions to offer visitors staying Gibay Sunshine a surprise. Top-rated B&B facilities and gracious innkeepers will give you a romantic, profound memory of island vacation you'd leave. The nights falling on Gibei Island inherit different kind of tranquility. Staring at the sky, staying far away from the madding crowd, and listening to the sound of the sea waves to fall asleep, are the greatest enjoyments here on Jibei Island.

stays.name: ai li shih homestay
stays.description: Iris could be the famous painting of Vincent Van Gogh. In Greek mythology, Iris could be the goddess of rainbow. She travels between the sky and the land as well as the universe, and can close the door of storm to bring peace for human beings. She is the messenger of gods and mortals. This messenger of love is beautiful and glamorous, and all creatures are fond of her. She represents “love” and “rainbow.” In Bible, Iris could be the flower of rainbow, bringing light and safety, hope and love to the mortals. Iris could be a brand of clothes, and the flavor of essential oil. Iris represents nobility and beauty. Iris is my name. I did not know the meaning of “Iris” in my life; it is only a name when I introduce myself to foreign tourists. However, the name suddenly becomes sacred (for me), since I have searched for dreamland for a long time, and it is just by my side. It is God’s will that I am appreciative of creating such a beautiful and perfect place. I love Iris deeply, but I don’t know how to describe how perfect she is. All I can say is, being with her, I feel happy and thankful. I would love to share this grace of God with you. If you’ve seen Iris, you will fall in love with her; if you’ve visit Iris, you will love her deeply as I do. My friends, welcome to Iris Homestay!

stays.name: cheng cian yi jhan homestay
stays.description: In the announcement, I've told everyone that the B&B is simple and unadorned. There is no high class furniture and decoration, no luxurious facilities and no professional services. You may have questions. What does the selling point of my B&B? I will tell you the answer. I sell the scenery of Penghu to you. I had not been to Shili in a long while. Every time when I thought of it, I would burst into tears. When I was a kid, the road of Shili was next to the beach, and the sea and the sky were of one hue. The fishing sampans were hauled on the beach, and I stood on the beach, feeling that it was a merging space, like what it said in the Disney cartoon Atlantis: The Lost Empire, "It is part of it, while it is also a part of it." But now, the huge sea walls and overweight tetrapods have occupied the coast, crushed the memory of childhood and broken off the dialogue with nature. The coast is disappearing. Now, I look at the tide water rising and ebbing and the shadow changing on the sea surface from the glass window in the house, and I haven't done this for a long time. The people who visit here always praise that I am clear-eyed. What chance would it be for me to find such a nice place? When it comes to this question, I feel distressed about it. Sadly, I have to tell you that there were other places and coasts more beautiful than here in Penghu. But what have we done to the beautiful islands? People keep constructing buildings and ignore the destruction of ecological environment. If you feel touched when staying here, please love the land you live on. So I often sell my B&B with the sad irony of, "the more destruction in Penghu, the higher the value of my place." Chengqian, a small village. Thanks to being small and without large budgets, few destructing construction appears in Chengqian, which forms part of the natural coastline and the rich ecology of an intertidal zone. You can see prosperous Magong City on the other side, the tortuous islands of Xiyu Township and the precious location of the inner sea, Dacang village. The blue sea and sky of the day and the glittering stars of the night present the original sea viewing of Penghu. We hope you will like it.

stays.name: Blue lagoon
stays.description: Blue Lagoon Penghu B&B sits near the tidal belt and Chenggong Reservoir, and the wetlands are home to all kinds of migratory birds all year round. With its excellent location, Blue Lagoon’s windows are like observatories for the local bird life, making it a popular choice with nature lovers. The carefully landscaped environs include historical water vats, ox-carts (a sight gradually disappearing from modern Penghu), windmills spinning in the wind, and even a barbeque area. The authentic antique Penghu flavor of Blue Lagoon makes it stand out from the competition.The walls of the B&B are adorned with murals painted with the help of the neighborhood elementary school, and inside the lobby are tables and chairs lined up for the dining pleasure of the guests. Upstairs are chairs available for a cool night’s stargazing, and the solar water heater helps save energy and do our part for the environment. Two-person and four-person rooms are available, as well as the option to rent the entire building, and the bedding is themed around pure white, giving an air of class and cleanliness, while the bathrooms are divided into wet and dry sections. Blue Lagoon is also convenient to the city, as well as for getting to Beihuan and Huxi, and the planes taking off and landing nearby make for an amazing sight.

stays.name: Longmen House B&B
stays.description: Longmen House Bed & Breakfast was built for the Chen family in 1924 in the traditional Hokkien sanheyuan style, which incorporates three structures around a courtyard, and has been converted into a bed & breakfast in the hopes of sharing the beauty of Penghu’s traditional fishing-village style. When you first turn the oxcart-wheel door and enter Longmen House Bed & Breakfast, you’ll be met with a carefully crafted tiled map of Penghu. Then, after knocking on the stained wooden door, you’ll set foot on a red-tile floor and enter the central courtyard, flanked by traditional tiled windows and equipped with bamboo chairs and redwood bed, like a trip backward in time. The outdoor pavilion was hand-built by Mr. Chen from driftwood over the course of four months, and sits near another recently completed “Penghu boat” pavilion which is perfect for lying down in and enjoy the starry nights. One of life’s great pleasures is dining in these cool pavilions, enjoying a fresh Penghu seafood barbeque under the beautiful nighttime skies. Or you could sit in one of the second-floor balconies, looking out across the starry night sky and enjoying the sea breeze as you sip on a cup of coffee or tea. During these tranquil nights, troubles and stress just seem to melt away. Come visit us at Longmen House! Website: http://www.longmenhouse.com.tw

stays.description: 《B&B Introduction》 Loving Hut Paradise Island Vegan Bed & Breakfast occupies an area of 500 square meters with a single building with European style decorations. There is a courtyard in front (with a pavilion, pool, garden...) and a huge public space: elegant lobby and comfortable restaurant. The B&B sits in Huxi near the suburb of Magong with a nice environment. It is between Magong and Xiyu so it is convenient to go to each tourist attraction. It takes 10~15 minutes to drive to the downtown area of Magong. Quiet, comfortable, beautiful, convenient. It is the best choice for your vacation. You can tell us if you need anything, and we will do our best to assist the tourists~ Each suite has an independent bathroom. Except for the Ocean Group Room on the 2nd floor and the Countryside Room on the 1st floor, there is no balcony. The other 3rd floor Garden Double Room and the 2nd floor Star Moon Quadruple Room all have balconies~ In addition, this hotel is completely non-smoking. If you are addicted to smoking, please go outside to smoke. Thank you!

It takes about 10 minutes from Qing Jing Homestay to walk to Aimen Beach or about 3 minutes to drive to this beach. You can see the blue sky and sea which sets off the beauty of this golden beach.

stays.name: Summer Ya
stays.description: Penghu｜Summerya HouseA Place Overflowing With Sparkling Summer WatersCrossing the vast blue ocean, your boat anchors at Penghu island’s Magong Harbor. You set off along County Highway 203 for the distant city district in the north, eventually turning onto Township Road 11. Roll down the car window and let the blue sky and white clouds welcome you to the start of your journey. You arrive at Summerya House; a sunny-yellow vacation ground situated along the intertidal zone, where worries dissolve and summer cheer prevails.Inn dog and the tide: therapeutic and heartwarmingEntering the brilliant yellow building, the smile of your host Summer is as amiable as the summertime sun. Boss, the inn’s dog, circles your legs with a frisbee in his mouth, guiding you across the red-tile floor and by the solid wood table, after which you step into the sun-soaked backyard encircled by the tide. Boss runs excitedly across the lawn chasing the frisbee, you and he soaking in the ocean breeze as you chase each other around. In the sweltering afternoon, as the tide gradually rises, seawater covering the rocky seashore, Boss lazes around, too. As you sit in wooden chairs facing the ocean and listen to the burbling tide, you feel your own insignificance in the face of nature’s majesty. You also sense how fortunate you are; though you own nothing at all, at the same time, you have it all.Each room at Summerya has its own name, and each name reveals a little secret about this place. The Pure Sea Breeze room is located on the second floor and has ceilings just as lofty as the ocean winds. From the attached outdoor balcony, you have a clear view of the seaweed draped over the seaside rocks revealed by the receding tide, and the azure ocean waters at high tide. The Serene Starry Skies room also has a spacious balcony from which you might as well greet the evening stars, inviting you outside to take a stroll and enjoy the sparkling night sky. The Azure Seas room has an entire wall of floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the ocean. The beautiful ocean vista will keep you captivated all night until the first rays of the new day sun appear over the horizon. The following morning, follow your nose to the breakfast table where two slices of perfectly toasted bread with ham and eggs, a crispy salad with rich dressing, and a fragrant cup of coffee are waiting to wake up your belly. The simple yet rich flavors provide the perfect start to the day.Heartfelt regard for this piece of land, this stretch of seaRecalling the first time she saw the original piece of land where Summerya House now stands, extroverted and lively hostess Summer makes a silly face and exclaims, “It was practically in ruins!” Summer’s hometown is in the Lugu township of Nantou county. Having grown up in the mountain forests, Summer had a kind of inexpressible yearning for island life. At 17, she had saved up enough money from her part-time jobs to take a trip to Penghu, and it was that visit which left an indelible impression on her. From then on, she would seize any chance she got to go relax on Penghu island. After starting to date host Michael, Summer dragged him over to visit her beloved island. Little did she know that for Michael, Penghu would also be love at first sight! The moment he was able to wrap up the business at hand, he unhesitatingly decided to move to Penghu, the place that both he and Summer were longing for, to start a new life together and construct the beautiful Summerya House.After operating Summerya House for exactly ten years, another place that they both really liked came up for sale, the place where Oasis Hotel now sits. When asked why they wanted to create Oasis Hotel, Michael gave a mysterious answer, “Operating guesthouses is a path of no return; once you’ve begun, you end up investing all of your resources.” Perhaps it is precisely their sincere love of this land, their high self-demands, and the pull of destiny that conspired to establish them in the life that they now find themselves.Their backs to the azure ocean as they share with us their ideas about operating guesthouses, Summer and Michael laugh in unison when they get to the happy moments and listen attentively to each other when discussing the times things didn’t go as intended. Their seemingly very different personalities tacitly complement one another on account of their mutual love. In the same way, coming to Penghu from the distant main island of Taiwan, their love of the place has crystalized into the two guesthouses known as Summerya House and Oasis Hotel.Remembering the embrace of the ocean vista and the bustling journeySummerya House is like a benevolent friend who is always there to listen to your troubles and to share in your happiness. Sometimes there are layers of shape-shifting clouds, at others a vast, serene body of water. No matter if it’s early morning or late evening, no matter which season it may be, they always have a new and beautiful surprise for you. Coming to Summerya House, it’s best to bring your most sincere state of mind, and you are sure to forge a wonderful friendship!

stays.name: dream home stay
stays.description: Situated near Penghu’s Magong Airport, Mengqi Bed & Breakfast is close to Aimen Beach, the only forested recreational beach on the island. You’re sure to fall in love with Mengqi’s tranquility and peace from the moment you begin your exploration. A visit to Mengqi is like coming home, with a sense of comfort and consideration everywhere around.Mengqi Bed & Breakfast is itself a work of art, preserving the local architectural style without unnecessary embellishment. Instead, you can experience an atmosphere of comfort and calm; a visit here is the best way to shed the stresses of modern life and enjoy a little rural relaxation.A private itinerary: At night, visit the tidal belt with the owners of Mengqi to enjoy the environment there and learn about the diverse sea life that calls it home, a weird and wonderful assortment of crabs, shrimps, fish, shellfish, sea cucumbers, and sea urchins. It’s a fun activity for all ages that will expand your mind as well as entertain!

stays.name: ou chuan jhang homestay
stays.description: Homestay located in Penghu!Captain Ou B&B is located in a small fishing village in Huxi Township, Penghu Island. Follow Penghu County Road 202 or Penghu County Road 203, then Penghu Township Road 11, and enter the Tudigongqian Community in Shagang Village to find our location! Right in front of the B&B is Penghu's traditional small fishing port. In the early morning or at dusk, take a walk in the fishing port to watch the sunrise or sunset, as well as the moment when the boats enter and leave the fishing port. It feels like a relaxation away from the hustle and bustle of the city! Here, the fresh air and quiet fishing village life are definitely the best choice to relieve stress! Our location is about 15-20 minutes drive from Magong City and about 10 minutes drive from the airport! If you like to relax on vacation, you may wish to come and experience it!

stays.description: The owner of this guesthouse shares a belief in using authentic materials with his forebears, along with a passion for and fascination with handicrafts, and to help promote this, on 12 July 2007 he opened Chaoxilu Guesthouse. The distinctive interiors and exteriors of this guesthouse are due to the use of authentic items from historic temples and homesteads, giving new life to these treasured, thoughtfully crafted items. Penghu is also particularly known for its cuisine culture, and the meals provided are an authentic taste of Penghu. Near the tidal belt, this comfortable, spacious guesthouse also has a tremendous verandah that offers a 180-degree view of the ocean, a sight beyond compare.

stays.name: Daydream B&B
stays.description: Penghu｜ DaydreamCotton candy spaceship sailing the white clouds of a dreamOutside the car window, carefree white clouds drift in the blue sky, stirring up the wanderlust of the travelers within. The radio provides melodious accompaniment invoking further flights of fancy. Beside the road sits Daydream, Penghu Islands’ enchanting guesthouse, like a cotton candy spaceship just waiting to fly you away!Summer fantasyOpen the gates to this dreamland and behold a fantasy paradise out of a young girl’s daydream. A princess bed sits in the middle of a vast green field. Teak lounge chairs surround an inviting, clear swimming pool. Glance westward and behold an endless ocean view. There’s a variety of charming inflatable swim rings floating upon the clear water of the pool. The whole summer scene seems to have burst from a dream.Only when Heshi, the owner of this dreamland, walks out the front doors in her flowery skirt to greet you do you realize that this place is truly real. You follow Heshi into Daydream guesthouse, contemplating the relaxing atmosphere and princess-style decor which seems just like a little girl’s fantasy land.A daydream canvasThe high ceilings and huge windows make for a spacious and bright lobby. Macaron-colored sofa cushions catch the eye like bright paint splattered across a canvas. Tasty brown sugar cakes and tisane tea, a local specialty, sit welcomingly on the table before you. Travelers move unconstrained throughout the space.As you stroll up the stairs and along the outdoor balcony, you observe the attentive efforts Heshi has put into the creation of this white dreamland. Moon and star inlays decorate pure white walls. Cute little sailor dolls adorn window sills. stays.name: Greek Frontier Homestay
stays.description: With a Mediterranean style and situated on an island with a climate much like that of Greece, Greek Frontier is like a distant outpost for the blue and white of Greece. This is not just a home repurposed as a Bed & Breakfast, but rather a place that strives to provide guests is pure relaxation and an escape from the rat race. Here, free of the stresses of work, you can simply appreciate the broad expanse of the ocean and the warmth of the sun, relaxing in a unique space with quality facilities; so relaxed is it here that each minute feels more like 120 seconds. We hope everyone who’s dreamed of going to Greece will make a trip to the Greek Frontier and get a taste of the sun, sea, and sand of the Mediterranean.

stays.name: Han Xiang Ju
stays.description: Bed and Breakfast in Penghu CountyHanxiangju is located in the outer ring of Magong City. It takes about five minutes by car to reach the city center, allowing you to stay away from the hustle and bustle and troubles. It has an excellent geographical location with a quiet and beautiful scenery. You can overlook the star of Chrysanthemum Island and the painted oil drums of the First Fishing Port. The beautiful scenery in the port is quiet and you can spend your leisurely vacation. It is also close to the Zushi Temple Night Market, so you can eat endless food. There is also a Life Museum (a museum that allows you to understand the customs and culture of Penghu), Confucius Temple, and Martyrs' Shrine. Whether it is transportation, food, historical site tours, or entertainment, it is very convenient!

stays.name: Lai Wan Zhu Wo Jia Homestay
stays.description: While this Bed & Breakfast may be a little far from the city, that makes it the perfect place to escape the rat race. Breathe deep of the fresh Penghu air and take a stroll along neighboring Shanshui Beach, a great place to take in the dusk and the nighttime skies. Or maybe get in the water and have some fun without the hassles of having to get home on time, since the B&B is right nearby. Across from Live in My House is a 7-Eleven where you can grab late-night snacks, while the neighboring police station will ensure you always feel safe and secure. There’s even a post office nearby, giving easy access to an ATM!

stays.name: Magong Amcient street no.10 homestay
stays.description: No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B is located on Central Street in Magong City, a historical scenic spot where the ancestors of Penghu first developed and gathered. Although we are located in an ancient street, our B&B exudes a brand new vitality. In 2005, the building fell into disrepair and was no longer habitable. With the approval of the government, we rebuilt the house and carefully preserved the historical features of every brick and tile. When you come here, you feel as if you are in the early years of the Republic of China.Our bed and breakfast is very conveniently located in a corner of the city center, away from the hustle and bustle. There are many first-class historical sites around, such as Tianhou Temple, Taixiajiao Guild Hall (Narcissus Temple), Wanjun Well, Siyan Well, Shigong Temple, etc., which can be easily reached on foot. You can stroll through this quaint old street and experience the lifestyle of the early ancestors. In addition, our homestay is well connected, whether you are going to Guanyinting Beach to enjoy the fireworks, or to the downtown area of ​​Zhongzheng Road, Fisherman's Wharf and other urban attractions, it is a very convenient choice. We sincerely invite every traveler to slow down, experience the feeling of traveling through time, and immerse yourself in the unique charm of No. 10 Magong Ancient Street B&B.☆Our Honor:◆Won the first place in the "Sustainable Low-Carbon Island, Saving Electricity for a Better Life" electricity saving competition in 2023◆Rated as "Hospitable B&B" in January 2024◆Provide travel introduction and customized services​☆Tips:◆In order to preserve the historical features, this B&B is a three-story building without elevator facilities, but we have strong helpers who can assist in carrying luggage.◆Because it is located in the old street in the city center, parking may be a little inconvenient, but our little helper can provide detailed parking information.​☆★☆After booking, please be sure to join our official LINE: @mk864 to get more information!

stays.name: Makung Traditional Home Stay
stays.description: Makung Traditional Home Stay is situated in the heart of Magong City, in the historical area of Zhongyang Street, surrounded by places of historical note like the Matsu Temple, Shigongci (Shrine to Shi Lang), Wanjun Well (Well of Ten Thousand Troops), Siyan Well (Four-eyes Well), and the Taiwan-Xiamen Merchants Association Hall. Comprised of three buildings in a faux-ancient Hokkien style with red tiles and white walls, Makung Traditional Homestay provides a great place from which to wander the old streets and soak up the old-fashioned ambience. Nearby are the Guanyin Pavilion, Shuncheng Gate, Magong Harbor, Fisherman’s Wharf, and Zhongzheng Commercial District, making it an excellent starting point for sampling the seafood, doing some window shopping, exploring the city, or walking to the Rainbow Bridge at Guanyin Pavilion to enjoy the nighttime view. Bookings grant you 10 services: 1) airport pick-up and drop-off, 2) free breakfast buffet, 3) free mineral water in your room, 4) a tourism map, 5) a guided tour of the area, introducing the fun places to eat and visit, 6) car or scooter rental and travel or ferry vouchers, 7) cool aloe vera to help with sunburn, 8) access to the first-floor lobby, where you can enjoy breakfast, tea, or coffee, 9) wireless Internet access (bring your own computer), and 10) access to a shop that accepts the Citizen Travel Card.

stays.name: Mirage
stays.description: Many people are asking if Mirage is not the translation of Mei Haiqi...Ah, how did this come about?It was really a headache to design the name of this B&B...You can search any name you want on Google, otherwise they are all very common names, such as: Aegean Sea... My mom chose it... HahaBecause my brother loves drinking coffee, one time when he met the owner of a store in the city, my brother asked the owner about the origin of his name. The owner talked a lot and made me realize that a name must have a story!By chance, a friend told my brother that it could be called a mirage…My brother thought it seemed pretty good, but it was too common and the name was hard to pronounce. I didn’t expect Wikipedia to have an explanation.[The English word comes from the Latin word mirare, which then comes from the French word mirage, meaning "a strange sight seen," that is, a mirage. 】Our homestay, Meihaiqi, is a transliteration of French into Chinese.Everyone has a dream in their heart. My brother and I dream of having our own house.I built the entire house from scratch by myself.Of course, it is difficult for me and my brother to design a house with our talents.So as a second choice, I personally handled the interior design and furniture decoration;Now that we have our own dreams, why not let more people know about our dreams?So my brother and I's dream will be known to the world from now on!!【Notes】All accommodations include free round-trip pick-up (ferry) service from Penghu Airport (Magong Pier). Please inform the flight or ferry schedule 30 days before check-in.Free breakfast is provided according to the room type (there is a catalogue). Double rooms provide 2 breakfasts, quad rooms provide 4 breakfasts, and so on. The quota per person is 50 yuan, and you can purchase additional breakfasts at your own expense.Breakfast is served from 7am. To protect the rights of tenants, pets are not allowed.To maintain community peace, please refrain from making loud noises inside or outside the homestay after 10pm and before 7am.Smoking, drinking and other illegal activities are strictly prohibited in this property.Please take good care of all facilities inside and outside this homestay.Valuables should be kept properly by yourself. Please be sure to carry them with you when you go out. This homestay is not responsible for their safekeeping.To save energy and reduce carbon emissions, please be sure to turn off the power and electrical appliances in the room when you go out. Thank you for your cooperation.This B&B has surveillance cameras installed in the lobby and at the door. If you have any concerns, please do not book a room.Guests who book a room in this B&B must live with the B&B manager. The B&B manager stays in the B&B to prevent guests from having urgent needs and needing to hire someone to handle the problem. If guests need to book a room in the whole building or book individual rooms, we cannot accept this. Please do not book a room. Thank you.【Delay and Refund Instructions】If you wish to change the date for any reason after remittance, please notify us 7 days in advance and the room can be reserved for three months. Otherwise, the deposit will be forfeited without further notice.Instructions for cancelling a reservation (the following refunds are subject to a handling fee of 100 yuan):If you notify us of your cancellation 14 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), your deposit will be fully refunded or retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 10 to 13 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 70% of the deposit will be refunded (with a handling fee of NT$100) or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you notify us of cancellation 7 to 9 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 50% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you cancel your reservation 4 to 6 days before the check-in date (including the check-in date), 30% of the deposit will be refunded or the deposit will be retained for 6 months.If you do not notify us of cancellation 3 days before your stay (including the day of your stay), we will not accept any changes or cancellations.If there is force majeure (such as typhoon, earthquake, etc.) on the day of check-in, resulting in the cancellation of flight or boat flights (subject to the announcement of the local county or city government), you can choose to: refund the deposit in full or keep the deposit for 6 months.If the county is in a red tourism alert area on the day of check-in, the B&B will refund the deposit in full.If you need to book a room or want to inquire about any further questions, please contact Mirage B&B at [0910-884-720 (Xiao Yuanzhe)].Transportation Information:【Satellite positioning】Satellite coordinates of the B&B: Longitude (E) 23.577413 Latitude (N) 119.583507

stays.name: PHB-RESORT
stays.description: Known previously as Juguang New Village, a military dependent’s village, Penghu Bay Resort has its history rooted across two different historical eras: Japanese colonization, and the exodus of the Republic of China Government from China. Juguang New Village is one of the oldest military dependent’s village in Taiwan.Penghu Bay Resort offers 60 individual rooms. Each room is its own bungalow.Before the advent of red brick, concrete, and materials like steel rebars for construction, much of Penghu’s residences were made from coral stone or Penghu’s specialty: basalt.Every room in the resort is separated by a wall of coral stone, and when viewed from the outside, one can see the individual basalt pieces that form the outer wall of the bungalows.Walking in the quiet resort, you can feel the tranquility and beauty of this historic village.Every corner of this resort is filled with history and nostalgia, transporting you through time back to the simpler 50s and 60s Taiwan.

stays.name: PHSEA INN
stays.description: The hotel is located in Penghu County. In 2019, Yanju Island Travel pushed the connotation of Penghu culture and in-depth travel to the tentacles of accommodation, and officially established Yanju Cultural Hotel with 14 rooms. It also cooperated with local non-profit organizations to design each room with Penghu cultural and nature conservation education significance, and gave cash back to public welfare groups from the accommodation fees to promote the Penghu transformation project. In addition to accommodation services, Yanju Cultural Hotel is integrated with Yanju Travel Agency and Yanju Humanistic Slow Space in the same building, providing tourists with a complete range of services from accommodation to in-depth travel, as well as integrated services of cultural and creative shops and cultural and creative experience activities. This is the establishment of an integration and service system of the creative era, which will allow customers& #39; travel experience to combine culturally meaningful accommodation experience, in-depth travel planning, and beautiful cultural and creative products, purchase and participation in cultural and creative activities, and the birth of a complex cultural and creative base belonging to tourism.

stays.name: Residents love places
stays.description: Penghu B&B - Residents love places is close to the Nan Hai Visitor Center located in downtown Makung City, and it only takes 5 minutes of driving to the convenient stores and eateries. You may also hire a boat out to sea to experience the joy of nighttime fishing, such as small squid. Penghu main island is provided with popular scenic spots like Matsu Temple, Four-Eyed Well, Penghu Cross-Sea Bridge and Zhongtun Spin Wheel, etc. By renting a motorcycle, you may easily visit these scenic spot in the gentle sea breeze. Penghu B&B - Residents love places is located at a convenient location and a quiet spot among the hubbub of the city. Obsessed by a deep emotion for the sea and a strong bond with his hometown, Mr. Jung Wei, the young owner, came back home and developed his life by opening the “Penghu B&B - Residents love places” together with his parents. The B&B facility formally opened in 2015. It is designed in warm and elegant touch where whitish tone of room is adorned with modernized high-class sanitary facilities. It is most suitable for the passengers who want to savor the real life in Penghu. It gives a home-like coziness. If you have any question about your trip or route, call【0927-795202】Penghu B&B - Residents love places

stays.name: SEA OF THE MONTH
stays.description: Sometimes we are so used to the city life that we forget about the color of the sky and the scent of the ocean. Come to Penghu and feel the mother earth. Feel the tranquility beyond words. SEA OF THE MOON is a registered homestay. The famous Guanyinting Recreation Area is only a 5-minute walk away. You can enjoy the stunning fireworks without even leaving the homestay. Penghu Reclamation Hall, Shuncheng Gate, Magong Harbor, Tianhou Temple, Zhongyang Old Street, Four-eyed Well, Star of Gaillardia Island, Fishermen's Wharf, and South Sea Visitor Center are all just a 5 to 15 minute drive away. SEA OF THE MOON is meticulous about the comfort and the sleeping quality of our guests. We have spacious rooms that are simple but elegant and warm. We hope to make every traveler feel at home. Some of our rooms have views of the ocean just outside the window. If you don't feel like going out, stay in our room is also very relaxing.

stays.name: Serene Sails Inn
stays.description: Serene Sails Inn — A tranquil stay tucked away in the quiet alleys of Shuangtougua, Magong.Just a 5-minute drive from the airport and close to the city center, yet far enough to offer peace and quiet.Our four guest rooms are located on the second and third floors, each with its own private entrance and a sense of space and distance.No forced interactions, no overly enthusiastic greetings — just a calm place where every traveler can come and go freely, and truly rest.Each room is a compact suite suitable for couples or small families, equipped with private bathrooms, air conditioning, and separate wet-dry zones — clean, simple, and comfortable.We believe that good accommodation doesn’t require overbearing service.We won’t disturb you or interfere with your travel plans.When you need something, I’m here.When you don’t, feel free to stay quietly and peacefully.Silence is a form of respect.Distance, a kind of gentle care.As the host, I live on the first floor. You won’t see me often,but I’m always close by if you need anything.This is not a luxury hotel — it’s a space built slowly, bit by bit, with heart.We hope to offer an honest, clean, and quiet place to stay, at a fair price.Come see Penghu.And while you’re here, take a real rest.

Become the lead actor or actress of your own story on the beach, and if you’ve got a snorkel, why not dive down and explore the coral reef and hunt for some clownfish?Summertime Penghu welcomes you to this comfortable, homely homestay. Enjoy the provided breakfasts, made fresh with local produce, including seafood congee, pumpkin noodles, and other Penghu treats.

It's a stand alone white building with stone embellishments, which makes the exterior quite unique. The surrounding is serene and quiet. Summer is the perfect time to visit the Penghu Islands. You can see the sun shining on the mountain and water, and starlight reflecting on the beach.

stays.name: Yun Xiang Homestay
stays.description: "Yun Xiang Homestay" in Penghu is located at Magong Downtown, with Magong Harbor not far away. It is convenient to ride to the downtown for a few local specialty dishes and a visit to historical sites, or to drive to Nanhuan to take a walkthrough of Shanshui Beach, Shihli Beach, Serpent Head Mountain, Fongguei Cave and other scenic sites. You may also take a ferry to Qimei, Wangan or other smaller islands! "Yun Xiang" applies simple, modernist design with French windows in the lobby to show unmatched excellence. It sits at an ideal location at the edge of the downtown area where the you can reach your destinations "Yun Xiang Homestay" provides rooms for two or four as well as group rooms for five to six guests. The modern design provides good lighting and leaves abundant space for relaxing. "Yun Xiang" does not shine with luxurious decorations and themed interiors, but keeps the budget for clean bedrooms, fair utensils and most importantly, the clear sky reminds you the simple happiness of suburban life! For any questions, feel free to consult by dialing 0918-348211 or 0912-968211, or by LINE "wls348211".

Don't forget to have a stay in "Siao Cyue Sing B&B" for absolute warmth and comfort: The building is designed with simplicity and coziness in mind and provides rooms for 2, 4 or 6-8. We also welcome groups that wish to book the entire building! Contentment is a virtue that makes you feel at home, and that's exactly what the owner looks for.

stays.name: littleskylark
stays.description: The result of being busy and hardworking certainly allows you with income, but at the expense of health and spiritual life. Think to oneself, life is bitter and short, how can one waste it? Often thought about the busy and tense urban life when back in the various urban jungles in the northern, central and southern regions, with the work stress and the suffocating lifestyle, hence decided to return to hometown and pursue the dream of homestay. The Slow Life, leisure and non-competitive nature of Penghu people is further the motivation for my pursuance towards the dream; I hope to make friends from all places through the homestay, to share the beauty of Penghu, the carefree, Slow Life and leisurable new life.

stays.name: seaway
stays.description: The sunflower-yellow of Seaway is a perfect reflection of the personality of the owner — vibrant, outgoing, passionate, and professional. Situated in Xiwei Community on the outskirts of Magong City, this eye-catching Bed & Breakfast is designed with fashionable simplicity. A trip here is like stepping into an exotic small town, and sitting in the courtyard or under a sun umbrella in dusk or nighttime as the sea breeze blows across your face and you sip on a drink is pure relaxation. The rooms all include LCD televisions, small fridges, down duvets, and wet-dry bathrooms. Rooms on the second floor offer a tremendous view of the ocean, and each has full-height windows to make the most of the vistas. The common space also provides computers and a drink vending machine for guests. Why not put up your feet and enjoy the carefully crafted beauty of Seaway on your next visit to Penghu!

stays.name: sea‧to stay
stays.description: After realizing his dream of joining the military and spending years with them around Taiwan and Matsu, the owner of Sea, To Stay always had his heart back in Penghu, missing not only his family, but also the beautiful natural scenery of home. And so, after leaving the military, he seized the opportunity to get into the tourism industry in Penghu, working as a tour guide and introducing the sand and seas to guests while also making like-minded friends. After several years, he and some of these friends decided to make the most of their skills and set up a place for people to say and enjoy everything Penghu has to offer. Thus was Sea, To Stay born in May 2009 as part of Siwei Ocean Village!

stays.name: yue jyu homestay
stays.description: Penghu｜Murraya Paniculata VillaA classical Fujian-style vacation home beside the waterDriving along County Road 201, you see none of the hustle and bustle of Penghu City, as the spacious scenery along the sides of the road comes alive. You begin to hum a little country ditty, as you drive towards the classically appealing style of Murraya Paniculata Villa which sits at the end of the lane as if awaiting your arrival.Go to bed in secluded relaxation, surrounded by exquisite brick and tileThe gorgeous courtyard entrance to Murraya Paniculata Villa employs orange brick as its basic style while brightly colored ceramic tiles frame the two characters of the Chinese name to extend a magnificent welcome to all visiting travelers. A refreshing breeze blows by as you enter the premises and see several lotus blossoms are just waiting to burst into bloom in the pool out in front of the house. You raise your head and look upwards beneath the saddle-shaped Fujian-style roof ridge to see elaborate, vivid paintings of birds and flowers frolicking as if about to leap out at you. Upon closer inspection you realize that the scene is made by the nearly-lost traditional art of Taiwanese ceramic applique! Guesthouse owner, Well, especially sought out a team of old-house restoration specialists who carried out their renovation of the entire structure using ancient construction methods. Using the coral stone material unique to Penghu, the old building was made new so that visiting travelers might also enjoy the beauty of an ancient homestead.As the clear yellow sun creeps over the rooftop of Murraya Paniculata Villa, each square inch appears, under the brilliant sunlight, as if sprinkled with gold leaf. In the afterglow of sunset, and in the lamplight after darkness falls, numerous yellow lights appear like ornaments under the violet night sky. Light and shadow move with the passing of time, and the homestead’s winsome reflection is inverted in the waters of the pool. The picturesque reflection appears as if anew at progressive moments throughout the day, at once imposing and beautiful, yet refined and tranquil. Ancient but not old-fashioned, elegant yet adaptiveBehind the simple entrance, however, you’ll be surprised to find your own personal swimming pool! Inside the ancient homestead, you can enjoy all the modern comforts, and allow the light-reflecting water to mirror all the happiness of your vacation. As you push open the gold-leaf painted wooden shutter doors, you behold the elegant furniture in classical Chinese-style. stays.name: Little yard No. 66 Homestay
stays.description: "Little Yard No. 66 Homestay" is a single villa located in Pingtung's Chaozhou countryside, with an excellent view of the mountains, sunset, and the stars, making it ideal for both vacationing and relaxing.The interior is decorated in a small and fresh style, and there are two floors, the first floor has a guest room for two people, "Bian Bian Xing Xing Room", and the second floor has two bedrooms for two people, "Revolving Retro Room" and "Corner Sunshine Room", which share a bathroom, and the whole house can accommodate a total of six people. The common areas include a dining room and a roof garden, which can be enjoyed by all guests, as well as WIFI, freshly made breakfast and a dedicated garage.Each floor of the B&B only receives one group of guests per day, which is comfortable, cozy and comfortable, and is the best choice of accommodation for traveling to GaoPing, and the quiet atmosphere can provide guests with a good night's sleep.It takes only 10 minutes to drive from "Little Yard No. 66 Homestay" to Chaozhou Township, and only 5 minutes to Wan Ruan Pig's Foot Street and Lin Hou Si Lin Ping Di Forest Park, so it's a great way to get away from the dusty city, take a stroll to see the mountains, eat a lot of food, and ride a bicycle leisurely, so it's a great way to get away from the city and steal a half day of leisure time to roam around in the mountains and waters, so it's a great way to get away from the city!

stays.description: Located in Pingtung County, Wang Dad is not a follower of fashion aesthetics, nor does he understand the philosophy of life that is independent of the world. His cottage is simple and warm, reflecting his diligent life. He lives in the cottage himself, and wants to share the empty room with others. Wang Dad& #39;s cottage is still changing, and the scenery of the small garden is becoming more and more rich. You can enjoy the beauty of the hot springs and the quietness of the mountains and forests. Wang Dad& #39;s biggest wish in retirement life is to meet people from all over the world who have dreams to realize. Wang Dad can share his experience in realizing his dreams. Here is a story of concentration to tell you, striving to coexist with nature and return to the harmonious relationship with the land. Wang Dad& #39;s retirement concept is to understand the rules of daily life in the quiet mountains and forests. It is happy to realize dreams, and he always firmly passes this on to his family.

stays.description: The B&B is located in Donggang Town, Pingtung County, where there is warm sunshine, vast sea and charming natural scenery. Each room has a different theme, hoping that every traveler who comes here can enjoy a happy and relaxing vacation.The hotel is located in a convenient location, accessible by public transportation (Bus: 9127) and National Highway 3 (Linbian/Donggang Interchange). It is very convenient to enter Donggang City or go south to Kenting. stays.name: Jade Bay Bed And Breakfast
stays.description: From the balcony of the room, you can have an unobstructed view of the beautiful scenery of Dapeng Bay, so that travelers who are relaxing during travel can fully rest their minds under the beautiful scenery of the vast sea and sky. There is an elevator indoors, so travelers who want to climb high and see far away can enjoy the journey easily without having to carry large and small luggage up the stairs. Different from ordinary B&Bs that only have beautiful decorations, Yuwan Pengwan B&B not only has an impeccable interior decoration, but also specially lays sound insulation cotton, shock-absorbing floors, air-tight windows, laminated glass, and sound-absorbing curtains in each room to minimize noise. It is to provide the highest quality accommodation to the guests staying there. We care more about the details of accommodation quality than tourists, so that tourists can enjoy sufficient rest and relaxation during the journey. It takes 1 minute to walk to the Dapeng Bay Lake Road, 2 minutes to drive to the administrative center of the Dapeng Bay Management Office, the International Circuit, and Qingzhou Coastal Recreation Area, 3 minutes to drive to the center of Donggang, and 5 minutes to drive. You can reach the famous historical site Donglong Palace in Donggang, and it takes 7 minutes to drive to Xiaoliuqiu Ferry Terminal. There are incomparable sea views, high-quality rooms, professional coffee, homemade breakfast, kind hosts, and convenient location. Yuwan Pengwan B&B is really the first choice for high-quality B&Bs in Donggang and Dapeng Bay. Friends who come to Dapeng Bay are welcome to experience it for themselves~~

stays.name: Lu-Fang B&B
stays.description: "Pingtung Donggang Bed and Breakfast．Lu-Fang B&B" sits in the Donggang Township and is near popular attractions, such as the Donggang Fishery Port Marine Product Direct Sale Center (formerly known as Hua Qiao Market), Liuqiu Shuttle Boat Port, Jinde Bridge, Dapeng Bay, and Donglong Temple. No matter whether visitors want to eat fresh and big Blackfin tuna or explore local culture, customs and practices, or plan to go to Liuqiu with beautiful sceneries for a relaxing trip, this is the best rest place for them. "Pingtung Donggang Bed and Breakfast．Lu-Fang B&B" The sceneries in the surrounding is pleasant to the eyes with a quiet and peaceful environment. You can overlook the blue and Liuqiu Island on the rooftop of the B&B in the daytime. At night, the Linyuan Industrial Park has a bustling night view and a dazzling light show will be performed on the Jinde Bridge. The B&B provides clean, spacious, and elegant Twin, Quad, and Six-People suites. The neat style and design are complemented with comprehensive household appliances which make visitors have good accommodation experience.

stays.description: YUE JU 31 B&B is located around Donggang Night Market, Surrounded in the neighborhood of Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, Donggang Ferry Terminal, Hua Qiao Market, Seafood Street, Donglong Temple, lots of famous spots and soon. Also we have an outdoor creation, Sky Garden, a place for you to relax and enjoy the casual moment staying outdoor. If you have any further questions or you would like to make a reservation, please contact with 31 Hotel.Tel: 0900-111-883

stays.name: funnybnb
stays.description: Introduce of the B&B: (Funny B&B) Just like its name, Funny B&B is a friendly B&B with fun. Different from other B&B which only offers a bed and simple breakfast, we give you a different feast. After you go into the room, you may feel free, just like being at home, while the housekeepers have prepared the following services for you: I. Delicacy: 1st dish: The housekeeper has prepared a cup of warm soybean milk. The specially-made soybean milk tastes smooth and rich. It is different from the one sold on the market! 2nd dish: Eggs (soft-boiled eggs) The housekeeper and his family have eaten about 100 eggs to find out the perfect way to boil eggs with the ideal degree of doneness and the proper joy sauce. 3rd dish: Salad (shrimp salad) The housekeeper uses the freshest vegetables with the proper dressing, a refreshing taste! 4th dish: (Donggang Seafood) It could be fried cuttlefish balls, a tasty squid or grilled escargot with aroma. It is a delicacy you should try. 5th dish: Local snack Such as grilled bun, sesame flat bread with vegetables, pork rice pudding, rice soup, Ba Wan. 6th dish: (Coffee or black tea) It could be freshly ground coffee, or the housekeeper would make you a pot of black tea. II. A great location. It won't take too much time to walk to the tourist spots from here.Dapeng Bay: 2-minute walkDonggang downtown: 10-minute walkMcDonald's: 10-minute walkDonggang Night Market: 15-minute walkDapeng Bay Bridge: 15-minute walkDonglong Temple: 15-minute walkIII. Accommodation: We have prepared the standard king size beds for you to rest and relax. In the room, you can look far at [Dawu Mountain], view [Dapeng Bay] and enjoy the [projection mapping show] over Dapeng Bay Bridge.IV. Transportation:We will arrange rentedbicycles for you.V. Entertainment: We offer various fun package tours, and we can be the tour guide for you if necessary. If you have any questions, please call the direct line: 0988-610-213***In order to being environmental friendly, we will not provide single-use toiletries. We will not change towels, bed sheets and duvet covers for customers for short extension. Website: funnybnb.com

stays.name: water reflections at ease
stays.description: Chen, the host of Water Reflections at Ease B&B near Dapeng Bay, is fond of the thick, solid and solid touch of logs; thus, he has been gathering logs. He got to know a woodcarving expert of Sanyi by chance, and they became close friends due to their passion towards logs. Chen starts to design on the logs, and the expert will perform the woodcarving works. Each piece of log is unique, and the expert keeps the natural character of the logs when carving. Chen wants to build a house for these woodcarving works - Water Reflections at Ease B&B. There is a piece of distinctive woodcarving work in each corner of the house, and every bed, table and chair is special and unique. Water Reflections at Ease B&B is Chen's dream come true.

stays.name: FangLiao Hotel
stays.description: Every stay is a pleasure—begin your enjoyment with Fangliahotel.Nestled in the heart of the Pingtung Plain—Fangliao, Fangke Inn is embraced by the majestic Dawu Mountain to the rear, stretching across the Pingtung Plain and Hengchun Peninsula, while facing the deep blue Taiwan Strait with sweeping ocean views.Fangliao serves as a vital hub in southern Taiwan, located along Provincial Highways 1 and 17, and the South-Link Railway. It welcomes travelers journeying between Kaohsiung, Kenting, and Taitung, and is home to the Fangliao Fishing Port, which has nurtured the local community for decades.Since 2018, Fangke Inn has been reserving moments of leisure for travelers passing through. Whether it’s restful accommodation or inspiring meeting spaces, guests can unwind in ocean-view rooms with expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, float in the infinity pool, and embrace the golden horizon where sea meets sky.Step outside your room, and Fangliahotel will guide you to uncover Fangliao’s hidden gems—plan a stroll through local neighborhoods, experience the vibrant F3 Art Zone, and indulge in fresh, locally-sourced seafood prepared with fishermen’s craftsmanship.Fangliao’s fleeting beauty awaits your discovery—come and feel it for yourself.

stays.name: Lansin Villa
stays.description: Lansin Villa Bed and Breakfast is located next to Shueidiliao(Shuidiliao) Gas Station at the 438.6K mark on Provincial Highway No. 1 going from Donggang to Kenting. On the east side is Dawu Shan and the Dahan Shan Mountain Range, and on the west is Liouciou (Liuqiu), Fangliao Fishing Harbor, and the Grouper Fish and Shrimp Breeding Area, and the surroundings are home to expansive agricultural fields producing black pearl wax apples, Aiwen mangoes, pineapples, and other fruits and vegetables. Nearby is the Lansin Villa Farm, producing ghost chili peppers (the world’s hottest) and DIY processing experiences. Rooms come with the latest facilities and equipment, including 42-inch liquid crystal TVs, double-person massage tubs (huge bathrooms), separate wet/dry sections and spa body showers, 6-foot Simmons ventilated spring beds, sofa beds, dust-free fire-proof wooden floors, 3-ton separate-style air conditioning, massage chairs, private parking, and free Western-style breakfast. From 2012-2013, we were selected as an Ecological Tour Partner Accommodation Business by the Pingtung Forest District Office, in 2011, as an Artistic and Cultural Accommodation Partner Business by the Pingtung County Government, and in 2012, as a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast Business by the Tourism Bureau. Located between Kenting National Park and Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area, this is the most affordable place in the area. The best value trips may include day or night tours of Kenting, spending the night at Lansin, and the next day visiting Dapeng Bay and Liouciou (Liuqiu) and experiencing the Fangliao agricultural and fishing industry.

stays.name: Visit the property
stays.description: Located next to Fangliao Railway Station, this cozy base is within easy reach of the train. Fangliao Railway Station B&B is the best stopover for you to Hengchun, Kenting, Donggang and other places. The simple and comfortable space design combines local art with the leisurely sea breeze, making it suitable for backpackers, couples, and family stays. The bed and breakfast is only a 3-minute walk from the beach, night market and local snacks. Whether you want to stare at the sea, explore the railway, or ride a bike to explore the warm local customs of southern Taiwan, this is a great starting point. Staying in our B&B, you will feel the warmth of home and the anticipation of travel from the first step you take from the station.

stays.name: A-Yue Homestay
stays.description: A-Yue's B&B is located near Beimen, a historic city gate of Hengchun Township. It has been newly remodeled, and is a licensed B&B. The interior is simple but clean. It's conveniently located near restaurants, convenience stores, bank and post office - all within a 5-10 minute walk away. Nearby attractions include Kenting Road, Hengchun Old Street, Historic City Gate and Fire from the Earth (Natural gas coming through the cracks on the rocks and creates flames when ignited. This can only be seen at night). Also, the annual Qiang Gu Competition, held by the Hengchun Township Office, draws a big crowd. It's worthwhile to come to this southernmost part of Hengchun Township to enjoy all these attractions!

stays.name: Baisha House 35
stays.description: The white-lined building of Baisha 35 B&B is located opposite the Baisha Shell Beach. You can walk to Baisha Beach in three minutes to enjoy the quiet and comfortable beach. You can explore Taiwan& #39;s most beautiful ecological protection area, the Coral Sea, Houbi Lake, about 5 kilometers away, and the Aquarium, which is most suitable for family travel to explore the underwater ecology, is 15 kilometers away.Baisha 35 B&B follows the concept of natural farming and ecological symbiosis, making the park full of bird songs and diverse creatures. The space has a log space handmade by the owner, a cypress bed that exudes phytoncides, log chairs and large floor-to-ceiling windows. Visitors can taste the Manchurian black beans and coffee that are slowly roasted at low temperatures, read quietly, and enjoy the journey in the space.Travelers can book a dinner of Manfeng cuisine at Baisha 35. The cuisine features the sweet vitality that the owner has brought from the land to the table, as well as small creations that have fermented over time. For breakfast, you can enjoy freshly picked lettuce from the park and fruits from local small farmers, starting the day with vitality and energy.

stays.name: Beautiful South Bay
stays.description: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyBeautiful Nanwan‧Love Kenting "Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Beautiful Nanwan" is adjacent to Kenting Nanwan. It is only a minute's drive from Nanwan Beach to enjoy the cool water. You can wander in Kenting's exclusive happy mood at any time. The B&B is close to Kenting's main highway - Provincial Route 26. It is also very convenient to go to Guanshan Sunset, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Chuanfan Rock, Kenting Main Street and Baisha Bay. "Kenting Private B&B‧Beautiful Nanwan" mainly rents private rooms. It has a romantic and elegant French-style architectural appearance, a small and exquisite front courtyard, a spacious common hall, where family and friends can chat with each other. It is also equipped with an electric mahjong table for friends and family to show off their skills in a square city battle. A simple island-shaped kitchen provides simple cooking utensils, allowing travelers to feel as convenient and comfortable as if they were back at home. There is a simple barbecue area on the rooftop terrace of the B&B for families and friends to enjoy the barbecue. Travelers can simply sit indoors and enjoy the romance of looking up at the stars. The bedroom space welcomes travelers with a fresh, elegant and warm atmosphere, hoping that every visitor can find the deepest comfort and relaxation here. If you have any questions about your trip or itinerary, please call [0912-992809] Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Beautiful South Bay directly.

stays.name: Beras Manor Kenting
stays.description: The name Beras Manor Kenting is a transliteration inspired by the Indonesian phrase meaning “a manor by the rice fields.” Nestled in an organic environment, the property is surrounded by rich natural ecosystems—frogs croak, insects buzz, and birds sing throughout the day. With a bit of luck, guests may even encounter fireflies at night. The view through the large floor-to-ceiling windows resembles a painting, constantly changing with the seasons and offering a unique experience every visit.Beras Manor Kenting provides a comfortable and nature-connected vacation setting. Its unique geographical location, surrounded by lush tropical greenery, creates a peaceful and refreshing atmosphere for visitors. The B&B’s design incorporates natural elements, blending harmoniously with the landscape to offer guests a relaxing and rejuvenating stay.Conveniently located just a short distance from Kenting Main Street and the major attractions of Kenting National Park, the manor is only a 2-kilometer drive from the historic Hengchun Old Town. Guests can easily explore famous beaches, night markets, and scenic spots. Whether day or night, the surrounding tropical ambiance offers a complete escape from the everyday.The rooms at Beras Manor Kenting cater to a variety of needs, whether you're traveling as a couple or with family. Each room is thoughtfully designed with modern and minimalist décor, creating a warm and cozy experience. The beds are soft and comfortable, ensuring a restful night’s sleep, and the bathrooms are clean and well-equipped—making guests feel right at home. Some rooms, such as the Scenic Double Rooms, even feature private balconies where guests can enjoy the view, soak in the sunset, or gaze at the stars.With its excellent environment and high-quality facilities, Beras Manor Kenting is an ideal destination for vacationers. Whether you're here to admire the beauty of nature or to find a quiet place to unwind, this charming retreat offers the perfect stay.

stays.name: Bonjour be’be
stays.description: (Bonjour be’’be)is a place suitable for you to relax and rest. By walking along the sunset footprint of Kuangshan area at night , you can reach the seaside to stroll along the beach, go diving or simply enjoy the sunshine. Unlike the glamorous night views of Keng Ting Avenue, you can clearly watch the twinkling stars high above during the night hours. When awakened in the early morning, you can see the very different scenery of the Heng Chung Peninsula where birds sing out their songs among the fields. Such a simple and sensational touch is worthy of spending another night. Each room is equipped with a private balcony and a natural sulfuric spring pool. Custom-made solid wood furniture presents our efforts to live in a simple and natural way. In addition to these thoughtful services, we also offer Bonjour be’’be ready-made breakfast. It is the freshest meal prepared from organic vegetables grown by local farmers. As a reminder. The snack offered when you check in is also our most favorite treat. After finishing a busy day, be sure to put aside your work and spend some time with us to savor some tranquil and wonderful moments here at “Ma Cha Homestay”.

stays.name: Caesar Park Hotel Kenting
stays.description: Caesar Park Hotel Kenting is situated on the Hengchun Peninsula, adjacent to Kenting National Park. With its prime location and rich natural ecosystem, the hotel is dedicated to providing a world-class luxury resort experience. Guests can enjoy a variety of outdoor activities, from exhilarating water adventures and family-friendly ecological explorations to romantic moments for couples, creating passionate, joyful, and unforgettable memories.Since 2007, Caesar Park Hotel Kenting has been honored as a member of the Exclusive Island Hotels & Resorts (EIHR), solidifying its reputation as one of Taiwan’s most iconic resort destinations. Founded in France, EIHR is committed to the principles of "Beautiful Islands," "Luxury Experience," and "Thoughtful Hospitality." The alliance brings together the world’s finest island resorts, including the Burj Al Arab in Dubai and the Bulgari Resort Bali. Being continuously recognized by EIHR among many prestigious hotels highlights Caesar Park Kenting’s exceptional service and top-tier quality, making it a true honor for the hotel.

stays.name: Chateau Beach Resort Kenting
stays.description: Chateau Beach Resort is located in the tropical resort of Kenting at the southern boarder of the country and has a clean shell beach stretching 2.8 km. It is the first leisure resort hotel in Taiwan certified by SGS International Certification Services, the first leisure resort hotel to be listed, and was awarded a five-star certification by the Tourism Bureau. We offer a top-class recreational environment for vacation travelers for happy and beautiful memories. Chateau Beach Resort consists of beautiful beaches, warm sunshine, and blue ocean combined with the hotel’s bright and lively architectural features. Currently Chateau has Provence Hall, Marbella Hall, and Positano Hall designed in different styles, with a total of 293 rooms of different types, among them a Royal Suite. Chateau Beach Resort lies on the beach set against a green ocean blue sky, whitecaps, and the shade of terminalia and coconut. It is imbued with a laid-back style and passionate romance to offer holiday travelers a variety of choices to enjoy the sun, sand, and sea air. Kenting Chateau features the Aegean and Atami Restaurant, Mediterranean Banquet Hall, and Matisse Bar, Ocean View Cafe & Internet Zone, as well as the Azure Spa, Skyline Pool, and Hobie catamaran and canoe facilities, to allow visitors to enjoy the ultimate of physical and spiritual relaxation and sea activities unavailable at other hotels, which is the benchmark purpose of Chateau Beach Resort as an international leisure resort hotel. We welcome you to the Chateau Beach Resort.

The room area is over 42 square-metres in each room. For Shan room, you can see the mountain-view and the part of seaview even if Shan-rooms are ground floor. The balcony connects garden.For Hu room, it's high-ceiling and private balcony, the best one is you can see the mountain-view and the bay because Hu-rooms are first floor. The wide grassland is one of the landscapes on Coral B&B. We have over three hundred sweet viburnum trees which are native tree of Hengchun. In addition, we also have other kinds of tree, let Coral B&B be more colourful.

stays.name: Cupid Homestay
stays.description: Cupid B&B is located in Hengchun Town. It is directly opposite the "Hengchun Post Office", the filming location of Cape No. 7. It is 50 meters away from the "Hengchun Night Market" and 100 meters away is the popular tourist attraction Cape No. 7. "Ajia's Home", go to "Hengchun Old Street", "Hengchun Transfer Station", "Hengchun West Gate", "Hengchun South Gate", "Houdong Mountain Park", "Hengchun Integration Game" Scenic spots such as "Shanghai Stadium" are also within 200 meters to 500 meters, and the transportation is very convenient.Cupid B&B has a shared lounge space, WiFi (free) and a luxurious pet cat house. All room types have air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, refrigerators, hairdryers, and some room types provide private bathroom facilities, while some room types provide shared bathroom facilities, and all provide free toiletries. Supplies (disposable personal hygiene products will not be provided from January 1, 2020, please note 1). The accommodation provides German BWT four-channel magnesium ion drinking grade purified drinking water and an electric kettle.Other surrounding attractions and facilities are 10 kilometers from Kenting Main Street, 11 kilometers from Maobitou Park, 13 kilometers from Sichongxi Hot Spring, and 13 kilometers from Chuanfan Rock. The accommodation is 90 kilometers from Kaohsiung International Airport and 105 kilometers from Zuoying High-speed Railway Station. Paid shuttle service between Zuoying High-speed Railway Station and Kaohsiung International Airport is provided.

Q, Four Seasons Restaurant, Arcadia Café, Fuyuan Restaurant, offering masterworks of delicacies sketched out by your feast desires. stays.name: GREEN YARD B&B
stays.description: Head to southern Taiwan to unleash your passionate and blazing energies in the hallowed land of beaches, oceans, and youthful vigor. Kenting Homestay - GREEN YARD B&B is right next to downtown Hengchun and has plenty of amenities in the neighborhood, offering a definitive advantage of quick and easy access to popular destinations such as Kenting Boulevard, National Museum of Marine Biology & Aquarium, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Guanshan Sunset, Nanwan (South Bay), and Baishawan (White Sand Bay), making this B&B the best option for visitors. The accommodations are newly constructed, with all-new furnishings for both the indoors and outdoors. Minimalist design themes were adopted to create a bright, spacious, clean, and comfortable atmosphere. Rooms are provided with Daikin air conditioning, hotel-grade bed sets and carefully prepared items. Bathrooms are furnished with TOTO toilets and separate wet and dry areas to improve guest safety. The aim is to provide travelers with a cozy, comfortable, and clean environment for leisure and comfort while making them feel right at home. Kenting Homestay - GREEN YARD B&B is a legally registered B&B. Every facility is meticulously planned, providing travelers with safe and comfortable accommodations to fulfill our single greatest pledge to our guests. Those who have stayed at Kenting B&B - GREEN YARD B&B will definitely return home with plenty of unforgettable memories of a most relaxing and enjoyable holiday.

Devised for relaxation, business, and leisure trips. 4 Sisters Villa offers interiors that masterfully combine luxury and comfort.Each elegant room features air conditioning, wardrobe, flat-screen TV with cable channels, refrigerator and electric kettle. The private bathroom comes with bath or shower facilities, free toiletries and a hairdryer. Certain room types have a private balcony with sea views.Outdoor furniture and a library are provided for all staying guests. The property staff are glad to assist guests with luggage storage and provide touring information. 4 Sisters Villa has an in-house restaurant serving tasty gourmets, local foods and fresh fruits.

Fenxiangzhijia features a spacious outdoor environment as well as comfortably roomy interior. The open style of a divided living and dining room makes both areas feel more spacious and helps guests feel at home, without any restraints or pressure. We offer 4 and 6 person rooms, 2 – 4 person accommodation, beds for extra guests, or renting out the entire building. Rooms are spacious, well-lit, and decorated with a simple, efficient style, providing a clean, warm feeling of home. They also come with scenic windows so guests can gaze out at the limitless beauty outside while resting or chatting with friends.

stays.name: Harmony Ocean Hotel Kenting
stays.description: Harmony Ocean Hotel is located on the first row of the sea view on Dawan Road in Kenting, only about 100 meters away from Kenting Main Street and the beautiful Big Bay Beach. The hotel provides free WiFi and free private parking spaces (when the parking spaces are full, parking will be arranged in a nearby public parking lot and parking fees will be subsidized). Some rooms have balconies with sea views. The hotel is about 1 km from Little Bay Beach, 3.6 km from Chuanfan Rock, 4 km from Kenting Forest Recreation Area, 9 km from Eluanbi Lighthouse, 13 km from Maobitou Park and about 10 km from Hengchun City.The hotel has elevators to each floor. All rooms are equipped with wardrobes, flat-screen TVs, air-conditioning, dry and wet bathroom facilities and free toiletries (including towels, bath towels, and two-in-one bottles of shampoo and shower gel). According to government regulations, starting from January 1, 2025, disposable supplies such as toothbrushes, toothpaste, combs, shower caps, razors, and shaving foam must be carried by yourself or purchased at the counter.Our breakfast is in cooperation with a nearby breakfast shop. If your room rate includes breakfast, we will provide you with a breakfast coupon. You can take the breakfast coupon to the breakfast shop to enjoy your breakfast for free. The breakfast shop offers a la carte, American and Taiwanese cuisine.The hotel cooperates with local businesses to provide bicycle, motorcycle, and car rental services.The nearest airport is Kaohsiung International Airport, which is about 100 kilometers away from the hotel. The nearest high-speed rail station is Zuoying High-speed Railway Station, which is about 115 kilometers away from the hotel. There is a paid chartered shuttle service from the airport or high-speed rail station.

stays.name: Hope Homestay
stays.description: The bed and breakfast is located in Pingtung County, only 5 minutes away from Hengchun Town. It is hidden away from the city and you can see the night view of Hengchun Town. Away from the hustle and bustle, you can enjoy the tranquility of the fields and occasionally see fireflies? It is also very convenient to go to Nanwan, Baisha, Hongchaikeng, Wanlitong, Houbihu for water play and Kenting for shopping. Hope B&B is near Hengchun Old Street, Cape No. 7 Scenic Spot, the historic city gate, Hengchun delicacies (green bean dishes, salty rice cakes, duck vermicelli, Xiaodu buns, southern dumplings)... etc. It is within walking distance to Jun Hotpot Seafood Restaurant. Sitting on the balcony, you can enjoy the panoramic view of Longluantan, Taipower power plant windmills, Hengchun Town, Hengchun sunrise, Guanshan sunset, Chiniu Ridge, and you can also watch birds and rice ears in the fields. All are in full view. Whether you want to eat delicious food, play in the water or enjoy a leisurely time to relax your body and mind, ***Hope B&B*** is the only choice.

stays.name: Kenting Good News Homestay
stays.description: Kenting Good News B&B is a stylish *legal B&B* located in Hengchun Town. The entire building has a high-ceiling design, and the B&B provides guests with a very comfortable resting space. You can take a sightseeing bus at the intersection of the homestay, which takes about 5 minutes to get to Nanwan, 3 kilometers away, and 10-15 minutes to get to Kenting Street, 7.8 kilometers away. It also takes about 10-15 minutes to get to the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium. The Hengchun Peninsula is very large. Kenting Street is a street in Hengchun Town. It is very lively at night with a lot of commercial activities, but during the day most people go to places other than Kenting Street to play, such as Baisha Bay, Guanshan, Maobitou, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Longpan Park, Fengchuisha, Jialesui, Oceanarium... and so on. Kenting Good News B&B is located right in the middle of these attractions. There are many attractions and special foods near the B&B, such as Dong Niang's Store, Alley Kitchen, Hengchun Mi Valley, Garage Kitchen, Six-Inch Plate Brunch, Taiwan's First Fried Chicken, Food Stalls, Eight Treasure Ice, Braised Food, Vegetarian Noodles, Xiao Du Baozi, Ten Bowls of Noodles, Thai cuisine, seafood cuisine, Vietnamese cuisine, 7-11 convenience store, and PX Welfare Center, all of which are near the B&B and can be reached in about 2 to 10 minutes on foot. The B&B provides wireless internet access. Each room has a private bathroom and split-type air-conditioning, LCD TV, refrigerator, and toiletries. The accommodation environment is very comfortable and the transportation is convenient. The B&B will provide a complete guide map and introduce local delicious and fun information to tourists in need. It is also a high-quality B&B that spreads good news. This homestay will be left to my good friends, a place to stop and rest. We will provide the most comfortable accommodation environment and sincere and attentive service attitude to give you the most wonderful journey. I also wish you all a happy holiday!
