stays.name: Kenting light now Featured B & B
stays.description: Bed and Breakfast in Pingtung CountyHomestays in Pingtung CountyKenting is a pearl located at the southernmost tip of Taiwan, shining brightly in the hearts of travelers. "Light Show" stands on the hill of Houbihu in Kenting. Designed by master architect Xu Chunyi, the gray building with a texture similar to exposed concrete shows a style that is integrated with the art of nature. The entire floor faces Houbihu Harbor, and when you open your eyes in the morning, you will be greeted by the clear blue of Kenting. The boundless sky, the ever-changing white clouds, and the charming sea. Just a quick glance can unload the burden of the city."Light Shows" Each room faces the sea and has different design features, from "Spring Light" to "Sunset Light", through "Time" to "Great Light". Travelers linger in the cozy home design of red bricks and slates, lie on the soft and comfortable big bed, listen to the whispers of the sea, embrace the starry sky, and spend a happy and wonderful holiday with family and friends.At "The-light", you can relax and do nothing, just lean lazily on a lounge chair and watch the changing seascape, which is sometimes like emerald and sometimes a mysterious blue. The sea talks silently to the travelers, slowly settling the random thoughts in their hearts. The shadows of the trees are swaying outside the window, and I am half-squinting my eyes to listen to the whisper of the sea breeze. Kenting blue gently illuminates your heart.The secret area of ​​Houbihu Lake, which is within a short stroll from "The-light", has a mysterious beach that stretches for several kilometers. Walking on the beach beside the sea, playing in the sand and watching the sunset recreate the beautiful memories with family and friends."The-light" wishes to make Kenting's sunshine and sea better for your life!

stays.name: Lee Home
stays.description: LeeHome is located in Hengchun Township and is designed in a cozy, home-style setting. There are no luxurious furnishings or extravagant facilities here, but you’ll be welcomed by a friendly and hospitable owner who loves coffee and enjoys meaningful conversations with guests. Having been in operation for some time, the homestay has received many positive reviews online and offers well-equipped spaces for a comfortable stay.The outdoor courtyard features a barbecue area and a small splash pool, providing a safe and private environment where families with children can relax and enjoy their vacation with peace of mind. The homestay mainly operates as a private rental. On the ground floor, there is a shared living room and a kitchen available for guests to use. The property offers four guest rooms in total, simply decorated to create a warm, homelike atmosphere.With convenient access to dining, shopping, and local attractions nearby, Li Yu • Hengchun Home is an ideal choice for travelers who enjoy spontaneous trips and wish to share a private, relaxed getaway with family or friends.

stays.description: The B&B is located in Hengchun Township, Pingtung County, about a three-minute drive from Houbihu Port. The double suite with sea view (with balcony) has a sea view from the room; the room is all hand-made, unique wooden furniture, the whole building is made of green building materials, without too much gorgeous decoration, presenting a simple beauty, allowing tourists to feel the relaxation of body, mind and soul as soon as they arrive here......The courtyard covers an area of ​​about 1,000 square meters and is designed without light pollution, so you can watch the stars at night. stays.name: Love South Bay Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: Love Nanwan‧Love Kenting "Kenting Private Bed and Breakfast‧Love Nanwan" is close to Kenting Nanwan. It is only a minute's drive from Nanwan Beach to enjoy the cool water. You can wander in Kenting's exclusive happy mood at any time. The B&B is close to Kenting's main highway - Provincial Route 26. It is also very convenient to go to Guanshan Sunset, Eluanbi Lighthouse, Chuanfan Rock, Kenting Main Street and Baisha Bay. "Kenting Private B&B‧Liannanwan" mainly rents private rooms. The gray building has a simple and plain appearance. The first floor is equipped with a small and exquisite vestibule, a spacious common hall and a simple island-shaped kitchen. All household equipment is available, allowing travelers to feel as convenient and comfortable as returning to their own home. There is a glass house on the top floor of the B&B for stargazing. Travelers can simply sit indoors and enjoy the romance of looking up at the stars. The bedroom space welcomes travelers with bright space lighting, various warm room types that can accommodate multiple people, and a fresh, elegant and warm atmosphere. We hope that every visiting traveler can find the deepest comfort and relaxation here. If you have any questions about your trip or itinerary, please call [0912-992809] Kenting Private B&B‧Liannanwan directly.

stays.description: Wine is the dew of Heaven, sweet and pure with a slight tinge of fantastic mystery, and a sip of lovely sweetness. The warm sunlight paints the green leaves with a golden orange, set off by the seven gorgeous colors of the tulip-shaped wine cup. The sweetness in the cup reflects and shines, dark red with a bit of purple or a clear light yellow. A sip of the fragrance is enough to make you forget your worries. Enjoy the comfort of solitude, absorb the romance of the couple’s world, chat with a group of friends, or enjoy the company of family. Drink alone, or raise a toast to friends…at My Chateau, in Kenting.

Whether renting the entire house or sharing rooms, Milk Candy is an ideal choice for enjoying a wonderful life and private space.

stays.name: Ocean Paradise Resort
stays.description: Pingtung｜Ocean Paradise ResortEndless azure views from a resort beside the seaUp in the mountains of Kenting, beside the endless azure ocean, you discover a beautiful, pure white guesthouse. Two buildings sit like the two wings of an angel overlooking the sea and the human world. After circumventing the small town of Hengchun and driving past endless rolling hills and grasslands, the Ocean Paradise Resort appears before you, your companion for a beautiful vacation.Blessings of sea and sun in a white dreamlandThe sea breeze in southern Taiwan, the shrubbery along the road, and the midsummer sun all feels like a beautiful daydream. Your car stops before the distant scenery of the eight great mountain ranges which surround the small town of Hengchun. You look out at the pair of buildings with white walls like the two wings of an angel speckled with small windows, each one hiding the angel’s secrets. A couple of wiener dogs rush towards you wagging their tails, with your host Lisa waving and smiling at you, welcoming you to this tranquil, white dreamland. Walking indoors, you see the azure sky and deep, blue sea through the large French windows, and all of the exhaustion you may have carried with you along your journey slips away into that distant azure horizon. Next, you enjoy delightful afternoon tea on the lawn, tasting desserts and admiring the scenery. You walk with your special friend to the ocean lookout and wonder at the beauty of the golden sunset, offering each other a kiss under the blessings of sea and sun.Twelve guest rooms offer a vacation in the company of the seaTwelve rooms, like twelve keys to happiness - Daybreak, Splendid Sun, Sunset, Moonlight, White Cloud, Blue Sky, Rainbow, Starry Sky, Meadow, Jade Wave, Spring Breeze, Summer Peace - each room providing beautiful vacation scenery to accompany you.Each four-person suite is sure to provide your family with warm memories; the outdoor gardens overflow with verdant scenery, the red Chinese hibiscus in full bloom provide the perfect backdrop for solid-wood, Southeast Asian furnishings as pleasant music plays in the background. In the simplicity of “Double Room A” the lapping sea provides the background music as you recline on the balcony in wooden lounge chairs discussing life. “Double Room B” has additional mountain-view windows and is relaxed and comfortable. The “VIP Double Room” is the most attractive of all, with a bathtub that offers an ocean view, allowing for the tender enjoyment of both water and sunlight. In the evening, if you are lucky, you may pull open the curtains to behold the moonlight sparkling on the surface of the ocean, with the Milky Way sparkling overhead.Happiness in the Kenting hillsWhen morning breaks, you and your special friend walk to the first-floor dining room and choose a table near the windows where you enjoy a delicious breakfast beside the ever-present blue sea. You pick up your book to read a few pages while your partner writes in a journal, both of you enjoying this tranquil time.Children frolic with the weiner dogs on the lawn outside the window, while the cattle ruminate over the grass in the neighboring field. You feel like you’re in nature’s paradise. The ocean is like a secret left in the human world by the angels. In this place, you feel like blessings are always near, as if that distant ocean is always nearby.

stays.name: Orange Moon Inn
stays.description: Pingtung｜Orange Moon InnOrange vacation beneath a century-old breadfruit treeTurning a corner off Kenting’s Main Street and heading down a small lane, you embark on a stroll through the daily happenings of this southern Taiwanese town. A little down the lane, you encounter a stately breadfruit tree that has inhabited this place for a century. Tucked away in the shade of the tree sits Orange Moon Inn, almost as if extending both hands to you in welcome. Your vacation is about to be immersed in the orange warmth of Kenting.A life adorned with the warmth of the sunPerhaps because it sits in the embrace of a breadfruit tree, as you push open the wooden doors of Orange Moon Inn, you are struck by the gentle warmth of the midsummer sun dancing on the orange interior walls. However simple and reserved, the wooden space with its bare cement walls is not devoid of texture. The simple decor is offset by various displays of adorable goods which from time to time surprises you with their orange ingenuity. Genial collectibles and stacks of books adorn the stairwell, inherited from the “Orange Moon Bookstore” once owned and operated in Kenting by host and guesthouse owner, Alumi. Feel free to peruse which ever book may catch your eye.Orange Moon Inn is a split-level structure, and each half-storey level is represented by a different color and botanical theme. For instance, the romantic Rose level is painted in passionate red, while the Ginger Lily level is clad in calming blue. A number of specially crafted carvings represent such local flowers as Small-leaved Barringtonia, Narrow-leaved Dracaena, Frangipani, and others, all indigenous to Pingtung county. The four-person rooms are suitable for groups of friends, while, in consideration of lone travelers, Orange Moon Inn also offers single rooms. If you’re travelling alone, Orange Moon Inn has the perfect nook for you to enjoy. Architectural aesthetics in dialogue with spaceThe eight conceptually colored rooms spread across four stories are replete with ingenuity, inspiring a kind of dialogue between travelers and the building they inhabit. The facade of the cement wall in the entrance is modeled after traditional iron window grates. As the second floor atrium running up through the entire building allows sunlight to trickle downwards, it also invites the wind into Orange Moon Inn, inspiring the atmosphere with rhythmic life. Having been retrofitted by Alumi with a pneumatic luggage elevator, the Orange Moon Inn has integrated an increasingly simple aesthetic. The purpose: to provide each and every traveler the right amount of space to enjoy true freedom and ease.All of these design concepts were generated by guesthouse owner Alumi himself. Alumi once acted as editor in chief of his university magazine, at which time he developed his seemingly endless ingenuity in artistic culture and design. Alumi was previously the owner of a bookstore here in Kenting, when his wife began to dream of opening a bed and breakfast. “Architecture needs to correspond to the environment, and must harmonize with it, the experience of which cannot be replaced by any particular style of interior design.” With such staunch dedication to architectural aesthetics, Alumi resolved to introduce sunlight and shade, wind and form into his design. Close your eyes and you can hear the space breathe, as if all the sunlight and tranquility of Kenting has been gathered in this place.Jubilant mornings beneath the breadfruit treeBreakfast is made fresh every morning. Travelers who stay more than one night will be treated to different breakfast creations every day. Sitting in the wooden space of the main hall as a hot chicken sandwich is placed on the table, you enjoy every toasty bite, washing it down with ice-cold milk tea in a state of pure satisfaction.Before you leave Orange Moon Inn, why not linger a moment beneath the breadfruit tree! Look into the near distance and see the morning sun shining upon Dajianshan mountain and the pastures of Kenting ranch. Beneath the hundred-year-old breadfruit tree, tucked away down a little lane, enjoy your very own orange vacation.

stays.name: Otousann B&B
stays.description: When visiting Kenting, you'll feel right at home at Otousann B & B, which offers quality accommodation and great service. From here, guests can enjoy easy access to all that the lively city has to offer. With its convenient location, the hotel offers easy access to the city's must-see destinations.Otousann B & B also offers many facilities to enrich your stay in Kenting. Guests of the hotel can enjoy on-site features like free Wi-Fi in all rooms, daily housekeeping, private check in/check out, taxi service, 24-hour front desk.All of which exude an atmosphere of total peace and harmony. Whether you're a fitness enthusiast or are just looking for a way to unwind after a hard day, you will be entertained by top-class recreational facilities such as garden, water sports (motorized), water sports (non-motorized). With an ideal location and facilities to match, Otousann B & B hits the spot in many ways.

stays.name: Peninsula Travel B&B
stays.description: At the southern tip of Hengchun Peninsula, The wind is freer than in the city, and time goes slower. We chose to open a B&B here. It's not for the pursuit of excitement. Nor is it to make travelers just passers-by for entertainment, I want to make a space. Become the most gentle stop in a journey. ⸻ Today’s tourism, It often turns into a race for equipment. KTV, swimming pool, electric mahjong table—— It seems that if something is missing, it can’t be called a “good B&B”. But we believe that Really touching, Not these facilities, But the light from a window, A gust of sea breeze blew in in the afternoon. A quiet night to be alone. ⸻ We want you to come here. It's not for some reason to hit the checkpoint. But to feel again— Sunshine, wind, tree shadows, dogs on the street corners, The smell of incense in the temple and the sweetness of milk tea in the breakfast shop. ⸻ Here, You don’t need to fill your schedule. Go out to the mountains and the sea. It's also safe to stay indoors. You can read, daydream, write, Bake a pot of tea, or do nothing. ⸻ We believe that • Traveling is not about escaping from life, but getting closer to life • The beauty of Hengchun does not need to be packaged, it can be preserved • B&B is not a commodity, but an invitation to life • The simpler, the more real; the slower, the more profound ⸻ This is Peninsula Hotel A place that does not pursue exaggeration and just wants you to be quiet. Welcome to listen to the wind and yourself

At the southern tip of Hengchun Peninsula, The wind is freer than in the city, and time goes slower. We chose to open a B&B here. It's not for the pursuit of excitement. Nor is it to make travelers just passers-by for entertainment, I want to make a space. Become the most gentle stop in a journey. ⸻ Today’s tourism, It often turns into a race for equipment. KTV, swimming pool, electric mahjong table—— It seems that if something is missing, it can’t be called a “good B&B”. But we believe that Really touching, Not these facilities, But the light from a window, A gust of sea breeze blew in in the afternoon. A quiet night to be alone. ⸻ We want you to come here. It's not for some reason to hit the checkpoint. But to feel again— Sunshine, wind, tree shadows, dogs on the street corners, The smell of incense in the temple and the sweetness of milk tea in the breakfast shop. ⸻ Here, You don’t need to fill your schedule. Go out to the mountains and the sea. It's also safe to stay indoors. You can read, daydream, write, Bake a pot of tea, or do nothing. ⸻ We believe that • Traveling is not about escaping from life, but getting closer to life • The beauty of Hengchun does not need to be packaged, it can be preserved • B&B is not a commodity, but an invitation to life • The simpler, the more real; the slower, the more profound ⸻ This is Peninsula Hotel A place that does not pursue exaggeration and just wants you to be quiet. Welcome to listen to the wind and yourself

stays.name: Qingtaoyuan B&B
stays.description: The owner of this B&B is Mr. CHANG, Shih-Yuan. To commemorate the ancestor, the B&B is named Qing Taoyuan Homestay representing the name of CHANG, Qing-Lai, his father; CHANG WANG Chung-Tao, the mother; and part of his own name Yuan respectively. The name is adopted in the hope that their off-springs will remember the hardship of developing the home at the very beginning and that the B&B will serve as a Shangri-La, allowing every visitor an experience different from city life. It is an individual blue and yellow villa, resembling a castle standing tall and firm in a wide meadow. The outdoor courtyard is specifically designed and arranged by the innovative ideas of the owner decorated with stone, pavilion and recreational facilities in presenting delicate and secluded landscape guiding visitors to the dream-like fairy tale land while serving as a playground for children. The guestrooms are designed in modernized concise style adorned with wooden flooring and comfortable bedding. In this way, every room is subtly designed by the owner like his own room to provide a clean and comfortable living quality for every guest. "Kenting - Qing Taoyuan Homestay" has a great view and allows you to look far into the mountains . You may look toward the mountain ranges along the “Niu Shan Ling Mountain and further to the lake scenery of the “Lung Luan Lake” and the birds flying around there. While taking in the dawn, be sure to take a big breath of the fresh air. When strolling in the garden, stop occasionally to find the species of the birds that are singing. Enjoy the fund of the wild field and the beauty of sunset dusk. Before turning in, do not forget to look upward and say good night to the stars. Travel is to discover another level of life! A quest for the fun of life.

stays.name: Redgarden Resort
stays.description: Pingtung｜Red Garden ResortA blooming secret garden in the south of TaiwanYou pass through Kenting’s bustling main street and head toward Sail Rock. The number of pedestrians gradually decreases until, finally, your only company is the sunny skyline along the coastal highway. You make a sudden turn up a sloping gravel lane and continue unhurriedly along until your eyes light up at the sight before you: behold Red Garden Resort.An exquisite garden abloom with vibrant lifeRed Garden Resort is hidden down a little alley in Sail Rock. Open the gate and you are greeted by a little garden facing out over the sea which, as the name implies, is full of colorful red flowers. Though small in size, the terrace is delicate and orderly, arranged into multiple impressive layers so that the style of the garden changes depending on where you stand. Small stone carvings imported from Bali hide between blossoming shrubs; here a tranquil Buddha, there a calm little crocodile. It’s as if they are keeping company with the flowers or playing with the travelers. No matter day or night, this enchanting venue allows you to linger a long, long time.In keeping with the design of the gardens, the dwelling of Red Garden Resort is equally bright and romantic. Walls are accentuated with passionate orange and bright yellow paint, and are covered with winding, dark green vines. Looking up at the windows of the top floor left slightly ajar, you might imagine this to be the Taiwanese abode of Rapunzel, unravelling her long, silk-like hair out those windows day and night, awaiting the arrival of her prince charming.An exquisite and enchanting Southeast Asian fairy taleAn ingenious mix of exotic decorations from Bali and various other indigenous cultures greets you as you step indoors, giving Red Garden Resort a uniquely tropical, southern style, at once subdued yet bold. The bathrooms exhibit clay bottles of shampoo and shower gel, and volcanic rock flooring, the varied heights of the design elements echoing the multi-level composition of the gardens outside. Lying on the white bedding of the large wooden bed late at night, you hear the faint lapping of waves against the seashore. The subtle yellow lighting, the fresh cut flowers and the scent of sandalwood in the air are so charming that you feel loathe to let sleep overtake you.Your hostess Amy, in her long, flowing skirt, is the beautiful caretaker of this elegant garden. Passionate and strong, Amy was born and raised in Kenting. Giving up her dream of being a professional soccer player, her athletic vigor and perseverance allowed her to go from serving in a hotel restaurant to become an apprentice at another establishment opened by the hotel chef where she learned to cook and to speak English. She later took charge of her own restaurant, at which time she met her true love, an Englishman named Neil. Red Garden Resort is the fruit of their labor, bearing witness to their good fortune and happiness.Blooming in the hearts of travelersOriginally employed in the field of shipbuilding design, Neil found himself making frequent trips to Taiwan. An avid surfer, he would escape to the beaches of Kenting nearly every week. It was on one of those trips that he met Amy, who was working in a restaurant he patronized. Their exotic foreign romance culminated in Neil giving up his career to stay in Taiwan and start a family with Amy. At that time, Amy was growing increasingly weary of her hectic restaurant job, and began to imagine the contentment of a leisurely lifestyle in a garden paradise. In order to fulfill his wife’s dreams, Neil once again took up his design profession. He drew up all the designs and oversaw the construction work himself. The details of Red Garden Resort took shape in each meticulously drawn blueprint, as if with each stroke of his pen, Neil was bringing his commitment to Amy to life, each gorgeous flower nurtured with his love for her. So long as they hold hands, the flowers in their garden will bloom eternally in brilliant red.When you stay at Red Garden Resort, you feel like you’ve arrived at your own private villa. The atmosphere gives travelers the warm sensation of returning home for the holidays. As you enjoy a delicious breakfast under the garden trellis, the sea breeze caresses your skin and the sound of ocean waves rolls in the distance. Sometimes, you might find yourself lounging in a garden chair with a good book, at others strolling the beach in the sunshine. Passing your days in such cordial comfort, you feel utterly free. For over ten years, it is precisely this secret that Red Garden Resort has been planting in the hearts of travelers.

Looking up at the windows of the top floor left slightly ajar, you might imagine this to be the Taiwanese abode of Rapunzel, unravelling her long, silk-like hair out those windows day and night, awaiting the arrival of her prince charming.An exquisite and enchanting Southeast Asian fairy taleAn ingenious mix of exotic decorations from Bali and various other indigenous cultures greets you as you step indoors, giving Red Garden Resort a uniquely tropical, southern style, at once subdued yet bold. The bathrooms exhibit clay bottles of shampoo and shower gel, and volcanic rock flooring, the varied heights of the design elements echoing the multi-level composition of the gardens outside. Lying on the white bedding of the large wooden bed late at night, you hear the faint lapping of waves against the seashore. The subtle yellow lighting, the fresh cut flowers and the scent of sandalwood in the air are so charming that you feel loathe to let sleep overtake you.Your hostess Amy, in her long, flowing skirt, is the beautiful caretaker of this elegant garden. Passionate and strong, Amy was born and raised in Kenting. Giving up her dream of being a professional soccer player, her athletic vigor and perseverance allowed her to go from serving in a hotel restaurant to become an apprentice at another establishment opened by the hotel chef where she learned to cook and to speak English. She later took charge of her own restaurant, at which time she met her true love, an Englishman named Neil. Red Garden Resort is the fruit of their labor, bearing witness to their good fortune and happiness.Blooming in the hearts of travelersOriginally employed in the field of shipbuilding design, Neil found himself making frequent trips to Taiwan. An avid surfer, he would escape to the beaches of Kenting nearly every week. It was on one of those trips that he met Amy, who was working in a restaurant he patronized. Their exotic foreign romance culminated in Neil giving up his career to stay in Taiwan and start a family with Amy. At that time, Amy was growing increasingly weary of her hectic restaurant job, and began to imagine the contentment of a leisurely lifestyle in a garden paradise. In order to fulfill his wife’s dreams, Neil once again took up his design profession. He drew up all the designs and oversaw the construction work himself. The details of Red Garden Resort took shape in each meticulously drawn blueprint, as if with each stroke of his pen, Neil was bringing his commitment to Amy to life, each gorgeous flower nurtured with his love for her. So long as they hold hands, the flowers in their garden will bloom eternally in brilliant red.When you stay at Red Garden Resort, you feel like you’ve arrived at your own private villa. The atmosphere gives travelers the warm sensation of returning home for the holidays. As you enjoy a delicious breakfast under the garden trellis, the sea breeze caresses your skin and the sound of ocean waves rolls in the distance. Sometimes, you might find yourself lounging in a garden chair with a good book, at others strolling the beach in the sunshine. Passing your days in such cordial comfort, you feel utterly free. For over ten years, it is precisely this secret that Red Garden Resort has been planting in the hearts of travelers.

stays.description: Countless sentimental stories are told by those who have visited Kenting. I would love to share mine, as your hostess at Sasa L’amour Villa.When I first arrived in Hong Kong from Cambodia, I thought that Hong Kong would be my final destination. As it turned out, my heart brought me to Kenting.Making a profit is never my focus, rather, it is to build my dream home. To build this dream, I have ventured through China collecting items for the interior design of Sasa L’amour. I have devoted to turning the dilapidated old house that I found here years ago into a welcoming home with a unique and delightful design.The Sasa L’amour Villa is surrounded by evergreen shrubs unique to the area and scenery in Kenting. As our guest, you will immerse in the pleasant and relaxing Kenting lifestyle full of sun, sand, and sea breeze. Delicious food, drinks and refreshments are prepared for you with care.Your friends at Sasa L’amour welcome you with open arms and heart, inviting you to plant your footprints on the soft sand and set your spirit to sail through the wild, rocky coastline

stays.name: Shangren Homestay
stays.description: Located at No. 93, Section 2, Shengbei Road, Hengchun Township, next to the 20 km mark on Pinge Highway (Provincial Highway No. 26, going toward Hengchun and Kenting), Shangren Bed and Breakfast is a short 5 minute drive from attractions such as the National Museum of Marine Biology and Aquarium, Nanwan, Houwan, Hengchun Old Street, and scene of the film “Cape No. 7,” a 10 minute drive from Kenting Main Street, and conveniently close to Hengchun, Checheng, and Sichong Stream. In preparation for the grand opening on February 22, 2006, the hardware facilities of the all-new building emphasized security and health, with an overall simple and refreshing style. The space was carefully planned by the owner, who decorated it with elegance and comfort, making this Kenting’s best vacation spot. The large villa-style rooms have their own parking spaces, and the expansive courtyard is suitable for family gatherings as well as group activities. We also organize water and land activities and can purchase boat tickets for guests. Xiaoyang, the owner, is a local with 19 years of experience at the Kenting Youth Activity Center. With a friendly, hospitable personality and strong interest in bed and breakfast management, he hopes to share with others the joy of fruit garden harvests, and has worked hard to create a pure countryside bed and breakfast combining educational value and recreational activities. The charm of greenery, simplicity, and leisure, enjoying the wind and ocean, sunlight and sunsets and stars, a place to daydream; all of these complete the perfect romantic story of the common person.

Each room comes with a balcony and wooden flooring. A flat-screen cable TV and desk are included. Private bathroom has a stone bathtub, shower, hairdryer and free toiletries.A 5-minute drive away is a 24-hour convenience store and the Kenting Night Market, which offers a variety of seafood and snacks.

stays.name: The Tree
stays.description: The Tree is here in Guanshan, Hengchun. The owner planted the tree and spent 2 years taking care of it. Finally, it has grown big. It shelters us with its leaves. The Tree is our dream. At the end of 2014, The Tree Homestay is born. There had been joy and sorrow. But all the sorrow had faded when we saw the the mountains and the sea in the distance.. The driftwoods brought by Typhoon Morakot is what started everything. All types of wood were collected and used in different parts of the homestay. The homestay is thus named The Tree. We wish to share the scenes here at The Tree. We have 7 guestrooms and all of them have ocean views. Wherever you are, you can see the views of Nanwan beach, Eluanbi lighthouse, and Chaunfan Rock. Every furniture is handmade with our own hands. Everyone is welcomed to come see and give us feedbacks. On May 1st 2015, The Tree is finally approved as one of the Featured B&B in Kenting. It is definitely worth visiting!

stays.name: Tuo Si Ka Ni Tese Homestay
stays.description: Maybe you’ve never heard of “Under the Tuscan Sun,” by the poet Mayes. The work assembles an image through the use of words of imagination, just like we built an all-natural resort in Kenting, brick by brick. Here, you’ll be unconsciously drawn in by our tile-roofed stone building, with a diverse, changing green slope stretching into the background. Feel the pulse of the hill, stand in the room, and push out the ink brick-colored window ledge, commencing a journey of brilliant sunlight and cool shade. Here, in your personal notebook, you can record the names of different flowers and plants, sketch the outline of the Kenting Mountains, put down your feelings as you strolled the beach, or attach snippets of different-styled bed and breakfasts, all of which can be a memory of your life in Tuscany, ready to embrace new surprises. Here, you are the owner…

stays.name: Wandering Walls
stays.description: Surrounded By Nature・A Utopian RetreatWandering Walls is located on the original mountain ridge on the northwest side of the Hengchun Peninsula,there are mountains between the front and the northwest.The building is surrounded by acacia forests and grasslands.The nearest village is 1.5 kilometers away, and there is only one country path in and out.The well-known utopia retreat allows people to stay away from the hustle and fully immerse themselves in nature.Wandering wallsBlown by the unique downhill wind in Hengchun, the walls of the three floors unfold like ribbons.Boldly flying over the overhangs to become echo walls that capture the sound of the acacia trees swaying in the wind.The streamlined arc wall extends and divides the spatial interface between public and private, interior and exterior, and architecture and landscape.These free-flowing walls constitute the most distinctive architectural appearance of the building.This is the name of “Wandering Walls” came about.

stays.description: Avignon Bed and Breakfast, recommended by numerous newspapers and magazines, is an all-new French countryside-style villa bed and breakfast. The residents of Avignon love sunshine and are always searching for entertainment, and the friendly atmosphere makes it a memorable travel destination. Avignon features an outdoor courtyard with flowers of all seasons, an ecological pond, a pavilion, a BBQ area, and a children’s play area. The building features thoughtful, exquisite decoration, all-new bathing facilities providing top-class enjoyment, and other surprises in every corner, making this an excellent choice for expert travelers. stays.name: G.SHOCK Motel
stays.description: Gshock-Motel's design concept was based on the typical business motel architecture, and created a motel with unique, simple but classy environment. Different from typical motel's fancy theme, Gshock-Motel created romantic vacation themes. In addition, our unique sun-logo is intended to evoke a sunny, passionate, bright and safe atmosphere, so all of our guests will be happy, relaxed and safe when they stay with us. GShock-Motel's modern natural aesthetic concept begins from the garage and extends to the guestrooms. There are many individual and shared facilities and services, including spa bath, colorful bubble bed, jacuzzi, Vichy bath, steam room, mini bar, business area and free Wifi connection.

stays.name: Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B
stays.description: Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B(1). Basic information of B&B:1. Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B is a legal B&B, registered: Pingtung B&B No. 1404. Obtained legal license on January 16, 2013.2. Area: Located at the junction of Ligang Township, Pingtung County and Qishan District, Kaohsiung City.3. Reservation hotline: 0932753131 Zhuang Youzhang/0928558267 Miss Chen/08-77317894. Please add the B&B line search phone number (ID): 0932753131 Zhuang Youzhang5. Reservation time: 7:00 am ~ 9:00 pm6. B&B Facebook:7. Search "Taisan 3rd Line Fengjing B&B" on Google Map. Don't search by address, it's not easy to find.(2). Room price:Update date: 113/07/01Room Type: Weekdays/Holidays/Spring Festival (Pricing)Triple Suite No. 1: 2000 on weekdays/2200 on holidays/3200 on Spring FestivalSuite No. 2 for two persons: 1,500 on weekdays/1,700 on holidays/2,700 on Spring FestivalQuadruple Suite No. 3: Weekdays 2,300/Holidays 2,700/Spring Festival 3,700No. 5 Japanese-style room for six people: 2,500 on weekdays/3,000 on holidays/4,000 on Spring FestivalPrivate rooms (one of which is the master room): 9800 on weekdays/11200 on holidays/16100 on Spring Festival(3). B&B Features:1. Please use Google Map to search for " Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B "2. Opposite the B&B is the "Shisanjia Tire Shop". The property is 3 km from Tuku CPC Taisugar Gas Station. Pingtung Ligang Sanhe Elementary School is 3 km away.3. There are no businesses near the B&B. It is recommended to go to Qishan Old Street (13 minutes away), Meinong Town (10 minutes away), Ligang Street (12 minutes away), Fo Guang Shan and Buddha Memorial Hall (15 minutes away) After dinner, head to the B&B.4. This B&B is a legal B&B located at the junction of northern Pingtung and Qishan. It is a rare farm-style, single-family villa-style one-story B&B, full of pastoral atmosphere. It is located next to Provincial Highway No. 3, with a large target and good location. It is suitable for vacation, rest, family reservation, gathering, wedding, and motorcycle stopover. It is definitely the best choice for you to stay in Pingbei District!5. The B&B has a rich ecology. Small animals can often be seen living freely among the rocks, grass and flowers. There is a chance to see sporadic fireflies at night. If you are afraid of mosquitoes, it is recommended to wear thin long-sleeved shirts and long pants and carry mosquito repellent.6. This homestay has an open plant landscape and a large courtyard space, which is suitable for children to play; the greenery is surprising everywhere, and the magnificent and luxurious buildings welcome couples to check in and take photos and enjoy a sweet time for two; the flat barrier-free space and circular The natural health trail is suitable for the elderly to take a walk during vacation; the large outdoor leisure space and comfortable corridor chat corner are suitable for family members to meet their needs. If the weather is good and visibility is high, the "sunset scenery" in the evening and the "moon and stargazing" at night are the beautiful scenery you cannot miss!(4). Location of B&B:1. Search for " Taiwan Third Line Fengjing B&B " on Google Maps and you will find it.2. Location of the B&B: On Qiping 2nd Road, Provincial Highway 3, at km 413, opposite the "Shisanjia Tire Shop". There is a "walled villa" on the side of the provincial road. Please call Zhuang Youzhang on 0932753131 in advance for inquiries.3. Never use the address search (No. 1-38, Bei'an Road, Tuku Village, Ligang Township, Pingtung County) as it is easy to be led to a side road and take the wrong road.(5). Transportation to B&B:【Driving Traffic Information】:1. Take National Highway 3 (South Second Highway) and get off at Jiuru Interchange. Go north towards Ligang and Qishan. Follow Provincial Highway 3, Jiuru Road Section 3 - Zhongshan Road - Ligang Road. Go up Ligang Bridge - San He Road - Nanxing Road - Tuku Road - Beian Road, you will see the Taisugar-CNPC Tuku gas station, then walk north towards Qishan for 1 km. After about 1 minute, you will see a "walled villa" in the field. ".2. Take National Highway 3 and turn to National Highway 10 Kaohsiung Branch Line. Exit at Ligang Interchange and head north toward Qishan. Go along Provincial Highway 3 for about 8 kilometers and you will see a "walled villa" in the fields.3. Take National Highway 10 towards "Qishan". At the end, turn right south towards Ligang. After about 5 kilometers, you will arrive.【Bus Information】1. Going north: From Pingtung, take the Pingtung Bus or Kaohsiung Bus to Qishan-Meinong, get off at Bei'an Station, and walk 1 km to the destination.2. Going south: From Qishan, take Pingtung Bus or Kaohsiung Bus to Ligang or Pingtung Bus, get off at Jiyang Station, and walk 1 kilometer to arrive.(6). B&B facilities and equipment:[Public facilities] Water dispenser, living room TV, outdoor tables and chairs, free parking, health trail【Room Facilities】TV, hair dryer, fan, air conditioning, WiFi, shampoo, shower gel, towel, indoor slippers, tea cup, hanger[Not provided proactively] No breakfast is provided, and no disposable toothbrushes, toothpaste, combs, shower caps, razors, or shaving foam are provided.(7). Remittance InformationPlease pay half or the full deposit within 2 days. Remittance information: Post Office (700) account number 0071275-0039030. After completing the remittance, please call to inform: name, phone number, last five digits of account number, amount, accommodation date, room type, The reservation procedure is completed. Please call Mr. Zhuang Youzhang at 0932753131.

stays.name: Cai Die Homestay
stays.description: The first butterfly-themed B&B in Hsiao Liouciou (Farfalla in Italian means ‘butterfly’) There’s no fancy architecture, but the construction features an irregular mosaic of brilliantly colored square tiles that present a lively atmosphere reminiscent of the hanging gardens of legend, while fluttering butterflies double the sensation of happiness. Indoor settings are established around the main theme of romantic rural gardens, and we have also provided various furnishing styles to add a wondrous, refreshing vibe to our rooms. Our rooms are perfect for friends, families, married couples, and passionate lovers, and we have invested a great deal of effort to help our guests feel right at home. Holidays should provide an enjoyable getaway experience, and the cozy environment will help provide warmth and bring people closer while eliminating pent up stress. We are also pursuing continuing improvements to this new B&B to ensure its healthy, lovely growth! This B&B is located on a quiet street with refreshing air and is extremely close (just a 3 to 5-minute walk ^0^) to the Tourist Wharf and bustling boulevard. We are right next to a butterfly garden, a perfect place to hold delightful conversations with friends and family. Don’t worry if you’re driving since there’s also an exclusive parking area to add to our already excellent convenience. The Farfalla family welcomes you to stay with us!

stays.name: Dreamer B&B
stays.description: Hsiao Liouciou homestay - Dreamers Farmhouse B&B. Everyone harbors a simple dream of happiness in their heart. Do you want to prance and roll around on lush, green lawns? Or do you want to experience cool, comfortable evenings admiring the vastness of the universe and its stars? Welcome to Dreamer B&B where dreamers are able to achieve their simplest dreams and experience the happiness derived from these simple joys! Pristine beaches of white shell sand, azure oceans, schools of tropical fish, green sea turtles (a protected species), vast grassy plains, and an infinite expanse of beautiful, starry skies. This dream is within your grasp. We drew upon these simple pleasures to give birth to the Dreamer Farmhouse B&B. Our guest rooms are spacious, comfortable, and uniquely furnished, offering first-rate elegance and quality accommodations to our guests within a natural, mountainous forest. We wait here for you to achieve your dreams...

stays.name: Fala Homestay
stays.description: The first butterfly-themed B&B in Hsiao Liouciou (Farfalla in Italian means ‘butterfly’) There’s no fancy architecture, but the construction features an irregular mosaic of brilliantly colored square tiles that present a lively atmosphere reminiscent of the hanging gardens of legend, while fluttering butterflies double the sensation of happiness. Indoor settings are established around the main theme of romantic rural gardens, and we have also provided various furnishing styles to add a wondrous, refreshing vibe to our rooms. Our rooms are perfect for friends, families, married couples, and passionate lovers, and we have invested a great deal of effort to help our guests feel right at home. Holidays should provide an enjoyable getaway experience, and the cozy environment will help provide warmth and bring people closer while eliminating pent up stress. We are also pursuing continuing improvements to this new B&B to ensure its healthy, lovely growth! This B&B is located on a quiet street with refreshing air and is extremely close (just a 3 to 5-minute walk ^0^) to the Tourist Wharf and bustling boulevard. We are right next to a butterfly garden, a perfect place to hold delightful conversations with friends and family. Don’t worry if you’re driving since there’s also an exclusive parking area to add to our already excellent convenience. The Farfalla family welcomes you to stay with us!

It is in the vicinity of attractions, such as Baisha Port, ChungAu Beach, Vase Rock, etc. No matter whether you come to and depart from Liuqiu, buy travel souvenirs, go shopping, or taste local special dishes, it is very convenient. You can easily have a good time in Liuqiu～ "Liuqiu Homestay～Jin Gan Dan Homestay" provides Twin and Quad rooms. The well-designed decorations by the owner of the Homestay create a warm, elegant, refreshing, and pleasant atmosphere. Everywhere you look it says holiday! Our suites are equipped with a comprehensive of equipment supplies which allows you to have a free and comfortable space to rest after your activities

stays.name: SEA-SHOY B&B
stays.description: Sea-Shoy (Three-section building) Specialty Bed and Breakfast is located next to the Sanfu Ecological Path and Roundabout Road (100 meters from Shanban Bay). The building is a remodeled version of a standard Sanheyuan (traditional Taiwanese-style three-section building compound) renovated to display its antique beauty. As Liouciou (Liuqiu) only completely preserved Sanheyuan, it retains the antique stone and earth brick door threshold, warm in the winter and cool in the summer. The building is surrounded by luxuriant green areas (nearly 6,600 square meters) for activities, including a tea brewing and BBQ area. The Dapeng Bay National Scenic Area of the Tourism Bureau designated us as Liouciou (Liuqiu Best Specialty Bed and Breakfast as well as awarding a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast certification.

stays.name: Shou Watt Sheji Homestay
stays.description: Shou Watt, pronounced as "Shou-Wa", means "first tile". The name represents the first tile put on the roof that started the heritage and origin of Shou Watt Design B&B. Shou Watt B&B has a slanted roof and white walls. Its building principal is energy conservation - UV-resistant tempered glass, energy-efficient building materials such as using natural light, and reducing energy consumption by using a heat pump water heater, etc.. The open-style living room and dining room, open staircase and the simply treated driftwood (unique to Liuqiu) all make the living space special and unique. In addition, the open kitchen has a small space to rest or take a break. The small open area on the second floor has a small courtyard that brings a lot of natural light to the room. The history behind the name "Shou Watt" was that this house was built on the location of the owner's ancestral home, "Wa-Cuo-Nei". Since Wa-Cuo-Nei was the first courtyard house in Xiaoliuqiu built with tiles, therefore the name "Shou Watt Design B&B" was given to remember the ancestor's hard work. In order for our guests to fully enjoy and relax in the privacy of their own home, we only receive one group of guests each day.

stays.name: Star Moon Villa
stays.description: We took the shining moonlight as the theme and the universe as the imagining space to decorate the rooms to make you feel like being in the galaxy. The space is not segmented in lines or angles. We let the rhythm exist in this space, giving the building a new life. We used mosaics to present the boundless starry sky as well as the beautiful mermaid swimming in the water, and the sunlight shining into the French windows and carved glass windows to attract your attention. Travel with enthusiasm and relaxation and enjoy a fantastic trip in this island! Live in Liuqiu! We take the shining moonlight as the theme and the universe as the imagining space to make you feel like being in the galaxy. Buildings should combine with nature instead of rigidity. We gave this building a new life. Enthusiasm, laziness, ebullience, sincerity and delicacies are the impressions which most people have for Spain. Possessing the shining sunlight, beautiful blue sky and great music, Star Moon Villa is waiting for your coming to enjoy a trip being like in Spain.

stays.name: TRUE-FDs INN
stays.description: Taitung｜TRUE FDs INNExperience Life in an Ecological Classroom on Little Liuqiu!If you get some rare time off, why not embark on a special island journey? Little Liuqiu is the perfect spot! This place has it all, including splendid sunshine, sea views, and a wealth of ecological culture. If you’re seeking travel accommodations near the convenience of the wharf, look no further than TRUE FDs INN, where you will find comfortable rooms, passionate hosts, and the joyous laughter of travelling guests. Everything you need awaits you at TRUE FDs INN!An ecological classroom located on the Old StreetEntering Little Liuqiu’s bustling old street district, you come to the bright yellow door of TRUE FDs INN. Pulling the door open, the host of the guesthouse, Cheng-Nan steps out from behind the bar to greet you. With his love of natural ecology, he has turned his guesthouse into a little classroom devoted to ecological education. The spacious living room provides a place for travelers to interact. From tissue boxes, to the homemade map of Little Liuqiu on the wall, to models of sea turtles, look around to see the entire space devoted to ecological awareness.TRUE FDs INN sees all guests as dear friends - all of your questions are welcome. Your host will share information about his treasured collection of sea animal miniatures. The son of a fisherman, Cheng-Nan was born and raised in Little Liuqiu. After high school, Cheng-Nan left the island life for a time to pursue his independence in Kaohsiung. After his daughter was born, he decided to return to his hometown to raise her. He was determined to introduce her to all the beauty of this little island. He applied his experience in hotel management as well as his passion for ocean ecology to create the TRUE FDs INN we see today.A lesson in seven rooms on the beauty of LiuqiuThe clear, square exterior appearance of TRUE FDs INN actually contains traditional construction which is long and deep. All seven rooms are decorated in a simple yet comfortable industrial style. The name of each room contains both a story and special local significance. In the “Crab” and “Hermit Crab” rooms, Cheng-Nan urges travelers to “take nothing but pictures” and “leave nothing but footsteps” so as to protect the ecology of Little Liuqiu. The “Fisherman” and “Mermaid” rooms conceal the secret legend of the Black Dwarf Cave, and are most suitable accommodations for two good friends to check into. Furthermore, the “Little Liuqiu”, “Ocean Superman” and “Sea Hare” rooms are all well worth checking out.Beyond the rooms, Cheng-Nan has combined local ecology with cultural creativity in his design, even preparing small gifts for each traveler who checks in. The gift box made of eco-friendly materials can be used as a tissue box, and contains a t-shirt of the nightly theme, postcards, and descriptions in an interesting passage introducing to travelers the nightly theme for their room. Little Liuqiu: a profound exploration “Sleeping accommodations are the first and most direct line of contact with travelers!” Cheng-Nan firmly believes that travel accommodations offer the best opportunity to educate travelers. Travelers are usually left with a profound impression of the natural beauty of Little Liuqiu, yet very few people know about the rich cultural history of the island. In the future, Cheng-Nan plans to launch a different kind of itinerary for travellers, allowing visitors to go beyond the educational ocean eco-tourism that is now prevalent, to become acquainted with local culture, and to have a deep experience of life on the island. Furthermore, Cheng-Nan is beginning to promote habitat regeneration of intertidal zones, beach clean-up efforts, and weekly lectures from ecological experts and environmental protection figures. Through this series of discussions, he hopes to allow more and more people to understand ways in which to coexist and thrive within the natural environment.TRUE FDs INN is built upon Cheng-Nan’s passion for natural ecology, and his dreams and determination are visible in every nook and corner. Above and beyond the wish to offer travelers a comfortable space in which to stay, Cheng-Nan hopes that after his guests will gain a deeper knowledge of natural ecology, and work together to protect the environment, and become friends of the ocean!

stays.name: Xiao Liu Qiu Chuan Wu Tese Homestay
stays.description: Located close to Liouciou (Liuqiu) Wharf, Boathouse Specialty Bed and Breakfast’s special wharf shape was designed to highlight the local features of Liouciou (Liuqiu) Fishing Village, with the anchor symbolizing our new establishment in this ocean paradise. If you want to experience the deep blue sea, schools of fish, fantastic coral reefs, and glimpse the mysterious ocean depths, Boathouse Bed and Breakfast is the place to visit. We love this little island, far from the dirt and noise of the city, and originally worked in the restaurant business. While servicing customers, we felt a twinge of pride and satisfaction every time customers left here smiling. We were proud of the fact this beautiful little island was our home, and satisfied that another person could witness its beauty. Our cruise ship-themed bed and breakfast is “docked” at Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we provide travelers with unique, honorable service. Come tour the ocean paradise of Liouciou (Liuqiu) with us; we offer various themed cabins where you’ll soon catch the vacation spirit. We offer professional ecological tour guides so you can experience the beauty of this place up close, and you’ll discover one surprise after another as the guide leads you through the rich intertidal zone. Dip your feet in the water as the waves come forward and recede, or dive into the sea and search for new surprises. You’ll fall in love with this island and the ocean scenery! Our restaurant offers local seafood, and the fresh pollution-free seafood banquet is a special feature of this place. We’d like to sincerely invite everyone to Liouciou (Liuqiu) to experience the beauty and friendliness of this place. Put aside worries and cares, give yourself a reason to take a vacation, and relax with a trip to Liouciou (Liuqiu), where we’ll bring you a different seaside experience.

stays.name: Butterfly B&B
stays.description: The warm sun shines high in the sky over the southern region of Kenting. Look out over Dajianshan and Menmaluo Shan, resembling a great picture of scenery stretching from the ground to the sky, and feel the soft, warm ocean breeze. Everything about Kenting is unforgettable. Our location is excellent, near popular tourist sites on the east coast of Taiwan, such as Chufor：Nature ground fire, Jialeshuei： Mountain sea water fall, and Fengchueisha ：Wind blown sand, as well as convenient for transportation - an 8 minute drive from downtown Hengchun, 12 minutes from Nanwan, and 18 minutes from Kenting Main Street. Covering expansive grounds, Zhu An Villa Bed and Breakfast’s subdued grey building amidst green grass looks like it’s a part of nature, surrounded by luxuriant green scenery. Whenever you feel like it, quietly lay back on the lounge chairs in the front courtyard, or enjoy the refreshing countryside and dancing butterflies in the back yard. To really experience this atmosphere of southern Taiwan, we recommend that you relax, pack light, and let the green sea and blue skies, lively waves, and simple countryside satisfy your soul. Experience the friendly embrace of southern Taiwan’s Kenting! Follow the owner inside the villa, where we offer 4 person suite rooms with large French windows that let in the friendly sunlight, warm ocean breezes, good lighting, and a spacious and comfortable area, with the owner’s care evident in all the details. The Bali-style rattan chairs, lounge chairs on the private stand-alone balcony, cable Internet in the rooms, and wireless Internet on the balcony combine to provide an unrestrained vacation atmosphere, whether you’re a businessperson, family, or group of friends. When you’re fully rested, take a bike ride through the southern Taiwanese countryside, deeply enjoying and understanding the wonder of relaxed living. Website includes discount plans and a video introducing us. http://088801118.okgo.tw/

stays.name: Xiang Yuan Homestay
stays.description: Enjoy the warm sunshine, Feel the waves and sand gently brushing against your skin, The beautiful Southern Taiwan is definitely memorable. Kenting is the most exotic vacation spot in Taiwan's southern border. The warm sun shining on the deep blue ocean, and the lush green Forest Park are going to satisfy your interest, whether you like to explore local ecology, participate in water activities or just relax. Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B is located in a quiet spot in Manzhou Township, Pingtung County. Some of the local attractions - Chuhuo Special Scenic Area (fire from the earth), Jialeshui, Hengchun downtown and Hengchun Old Street - are all very convenient to get to. Covering a wide area, Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B allows you to fully enjoy Southern Taiwan's sunshine and cool breeze. You can even see the endless starry sky at night. Kenting B&B - Xiangyuan B&B has rooms for two and four people. The great lighting, spacious and comfortable living space are evidence of the owner's care. There are refrigerator, television and many other modern conveniences to satisfy your every need. We create a warm and relaxing vacation spot so you can experience southern hospitality and our leisure lifestyle.

stays.name: Fennel Resort
stays.description: Fennel Resort is the newest member of the Sichong Stream Area, integrating Greek and Mediterranean romantic elements with the rough style of the Paiwan people. The owner is from Hsinchu, and after marrying a woman from the Paiwan tribe, he settled in this area and created the romantic Fennel Resort. With such beautiful natural scenery, the villa was a dream come true for the owner. Its decoration, layout, and overall design were all conceived of by the owner, who has a background in advertising. His wife planted the garden with fennel (in Chinese, a homonym for “returning home”), and the Fennel Resort was thus born.

stays.description: We’re located on the mountainside on the way up North Dawu Mountain, at an elevation of 500 meters, featuring unique natural scenery and offering health, mental stimulation, delicious food, coffee, and of course convenient transportation, making this place perfect for groups or smaller parties. Please reserve beforehand, and we will be happy to be at your assistance. We arrange 2 and 3 day in-depth cultural tours that include trying out local food, aborigine mountain boar feasts, local flavor restaurants, hot pot, and 5 types of DIY courses for parents and children. Most importantly, we integrate with the community by promoting local industry, using locally-grown, pesticide free vegetables and fruit. We also include a large courtyard forest bath, trail, and traditional aboriginal culture activity area.

stays.name: Shanfeng B&B
stays.description: Located in the Wutai Tribe Community, Shanfeng B&B has been in business for nearly 20 years. In order to provide a better accommodation environment, it was renovated in mid-2020 to create a clean, simple and comfortable accommodation environment. In addition, Wutai has clean air quality and beautiful scenery. It is very quiet at night. Come to Wutai and stay for a night to relax your body and mind!After reconstruction, the style of the B&B is simple, but the outdoor square outside the B&B is the living space of the chieftains of the Rukai tribe (the home of the B&B owner). There are traditional stone houses and stone pillars in the square. The barbecue area we provide is also built like the kiln where the Rukai people used to roast taro! The barbecue has a unique flavor.※ Accommodation does not include meals. If you need meals, you can inform the host in advance (traditional Rukai cuisine and home-cooked dishes can be provided)※There is a kitchen on the first floor of the B&B, and all kitchen utensils can be used (gas fee and cleaning fee of 300 yuan/room will be charged)※There is a barbecue area in the outdoor square. You can bring your own equipment (free of charge). If you use a traditional stone barbecue kiln (cleaning fee/wood fee of 500 yuan/room)※There are 4 parking spaces outside the hotel.※Smoking is not allowed in the guesthouse rooms.

stays.name: Mr.Petter
stays.description: Nestled in the heart of Taichung’s Beitun District, Mr. Petter Hotel is a refined haven that blends modern design with heartfelt hospitality. This boutique property embraces a Bauhaus-inspired aesthetic, creating an atmosphere that is both stylish and inviting—a perfect retreat for couples, families, and even guests traveling with pets.Each room is thoughtfully designed to balance comfort and sophistication. From intimate double rooms to spacious family suites, every detail reflects a commitment to quality. Guests are treated to premium amenities such as Dyson hair dryers, TOTO bathroom fixtures, ACQUA DI PARMA bath products, and ECLIPSE ice-silk mattresses, ensuring a stay that is both indulgent and restorative.Beyond the guest rooms, Mr. Petter offers spaces that enrich the travel experience. A dedicated children’s playroom provides joy and safety for younger guests, while the hotel’s pet-friendly policy welcomes furry companions as part of the journey. Dining areas are designed for convivial gatherings, allowing travelers to savor meals and moments together.Booking directly through the official website, mrpetter.com, unlocks exclusive privileges: no deposits or prepayments, flexible cancellation policies, priority room and floor selection, and greater chances of complimentary upgrades. These thoughtful benefits give travelers peace of mind and freedom when planning their trip.In essence, Mr. Petter Hotel is more than a place to stay—it is a destination where design, comfort, and personalized service converge. Whether you are seeking a romantic escape, a family adventure, or a pet-friendly getaway, this hotel promises a memorable experience that feels both luxurious and warmly familiar.

stays.name: TAICHUNG THE SUN HOT SPRING & RESORT
stays.description: A Premium Resort Experience and a New Hub for Urban Travel. In the past, if a visitor to Taichung wanted to soak in hot springs, they had to go to the Guguan-Lushan area, but now, there’s no need to go to such great lengths. The Dakeng Scenic Area, just 30 minutes from Taichung, is home to newly formed hot springs created by the powerful geological activity of the 1999 Jiji Earthquake. Located in the tranquil Dakengshan area, The Sun Hot Spring & Resort is a beacon of taste, with its black stone façade and low-key luxury aesthetic. To offer something new to visitors, The Sun not only provides “Mountain Paradise” double rooms with one night, two meal special packages, but also a number of other distinctive options, including guides to how to make the most of the Dakeng and Xinshe areas. As well as the wealth of tour options, guests can also relax in the 1,300-square-meter outdoor public pool, nude springs, spa area, and even a hot-springs fish pond. Accommodation, cuisine, springs, and recreation—The Sun Hot Spring & Resort is your one-stop travel destination. Visit us at The Sun and relax in comfort with our friendly staff and experience an unforgettable, top-quality vacation.

stays.name: Hotel Mi Casa
stays.description: Located at the transport hub of Taichung, Hotel Mi Casa is the oasis in the city desert. Under the flowing water wall, a piece of greenness is flushed out to gently unlock the heart covered in dust, just like a blooming flower. Here, travelers can rest their exhausted feet, take a sip of mellow coffee or cold drink or savor a light meal. Those who spend a night here by can go onto the balcony for the great view or the bustling world underneath, or even the starry night above! A short break or good sleep to recharge oneself and start your next journey anew. Some say no matter how long the journey is, it always leads to home. The wanderer's heart is always full of the desire for home. At Hotel Mi Casa, passers-by without any destination can find their home and enjoy the peace and warmth just like home.

stays.name: Mapleton Spa Motel
stays.description: Mapleton Spa Motel (sometimes be called Fong-cai Motel by transliteration) is located in the mountain region of the Taichung metropolitan area. In this region, Mapleton Spa motel is the first motor hotel which provides with steam room, jacuzzi and spa facilities in each guest room. This motel building exterior was designed in a simple and elegant style, which is inspired by the traditional design of southern European residence. Several Palm trees and Pandanus trees were planted as the mainstay within the motel driveway garden, further showing the atmosphere of this subtropical island. The motel logo is derived from traditional hot spring icons. It aims to illustrate the image of: “in colourful autumn, maple leafs and hot spring steam dance together in the wind.” It also implies that the motel offers outstanding bathroom facilities.The motel has thirty guest rooms; each room has an attached and covered garage. Average room sizes are forty to fifty square meters, providing guests a clean and comfortable environment. Rooms are classified into three types: Standard Room, Twin Room and Quad Room. All guest rooms have one 42-inch LCD television and a jacuzzi bathtub. Most of guest rooms also have a steam room and a spa facility.

stays.name: Dragon Valley Hotel
stays.description: Dragon Valley Hotel is located in the Guguan Hot Spring Scenic Area, along the riverbank of Dajia River. It has the most comprehensive facilities and is the largest hotel in the area. The surrounding scenes of mountain, water, cliffs, drawbridge and streams are beautiful and enchanting. After passing the landmark archway over the highway, the semi-circular white Dragon Valley Hotel appears before you. Besides the hot spring rooms, the hotel also has an international conference hall that accommodates up to 500 people. It's perfect for corporate meetings, school conferences, education trainings or performances. It is the largest and most professional meeting facility in the area. The PH level in the hot spring is 7.6 and is a low alkaline sodium bicarbonate spring with chloride (27ppm per milliliter) as the main ingredient . Other chemical compositions include sodium, magnesium, calcium and potassium ions. The temperature is around 43 degrees Celsius. The water is clear and smooth. As outdoor hot springs become increasingly popular, our hotel has exclusively launched NEC hot spring - Crystal Energy Spa. You will feel the flow of the crystal magnetic energy, and we guarantee you will leave feeling energetic, refreshed and all your troubles will be forgotten. Enjoy the clear spring water that leaves your skin smooth and silky.

stays.name: King Villa(dss-manor)
stays.description: "King Villa (dss-manor)" is along the road to "Daisetsuzan National Park" (Xueshan Rd is also known as Trail 200). In addition to the world-class birdwatching places here, there are beautiful sceneries, including Hengliu Creek Suspension Bridge, Chu-Yun-Shan Nursery, Yuanzui Mountain Trail (28K), Heng-Lling-Shan Trail. The surrounding area is quiet and beautiful with rich natural and ecological landscape. The Villa sits in natural forests which are cool in summer and not frozen in winter. You can occasionally hear the ambient sound of birds and insects which gives visitors isolated yet quiet and beautiful feelings. "King Villa (dss-manor)" was built on the mountainside of Chu-Yun-Shan. Woods stand in the mountains fringed by clouds and fogs. When you stay in these place, you may feel like a celestial couple; or when clouds and fogs disappear, you can have a night view of Taichung downtown under a starry sky. The Villa provides Twin and Quad rooms with a view. It also has unique family suites which are decorated warmly and elegantly and have a balcony. Tourists just stay at Villa and can easily enjoy a wide mountain view and tranquil moment. If you have any question about your trip or route, call 【0933-065669, 0937-932676, or 04-25971057】King Villa (dss-manor).

stays.description: When Taiwan regained its territory in 1945, Guguan was renamed "Guguan" (meaning "valley pass") due to its valley terrain and the water in Dajia River running to the ocean, which seemed like a pass the water had to travel through, hence the name. In 1984, the hotel was expanded and named "Ku Kuan Hotel". After the 921 Earthquake, the hotel was renovated and renamed "Ku Kuan Hot-Spring Hotel" and emerged as an enterprise establishment. Ku Kuan Hot-Spring Hotel is surrounded by mountains. There are river and streams, and lush green plants in the area. With an elevation of 800 meters, the air quality in this serene, quiet location is very fresh. It& #39;s also blessed with the best natural hot spring and beautiful scenery in Taiwan. There are elegant hot spring suites, exquisite cuisine, a variety of hot spring pools, meeting rooms and banquet rooms. In addition, there are a number of hiking trails nearby. We& #39;re waiting for you to join us to explore nature.

stays.name: LISHAN RESORT HOTEL
stays.description: Located at 1,956 meters above sea level on Zhongheng Highway, Provincial Line 8, Heping District, Taichung City, it is the tallest palace-style hotel in Taiwan. It is located in the center of the Lishan area. As a local landmark, it is also one of the must-visit attractions to learn about Lishan. one. Construction began in the 48th year of the Republic of China (1959) under the order of the late President Chiang Kai-shek, and was completed in the 54th year of the Republic of China (1965). It was the earliest hotel built locally. It was also the main place where Chiang Kai-shek stayed and received foreign guests when he visited Taiwan in the early years. One of the museums, its antique appearance has become a landmark of Zhongheng.

stays.name: Uni-Resort Guguan
stays.description: Uni-Resort-Guguan is located next to Dajia River and is the first hotel you see when you visit the Guguan area. The scenery here is beautiful and changes from season to season. In the spring, cherry blossoms cover the mountain. In the summer, fish swim leisurely in the water. In the autumn, maple leaves color the mountain bright red. In the winter, cold breeze sweep through the mountain. The resort features hot spring and spa, so you can enjoy a variety of hot spring treatments without leaving Taiwan. The ultimate comfort and hot spring relaxation can be enjoyed in Guguan all year round. We're the only one who have an outdoor pool in the Guguan area. Besides the comfortable and elegant Japanese garden and outdoor hot spring, we also have a variety of spa treatments and facilities, including spewing spring, tunnel bath and bubble bath. In addition, there are also a variety of health, leisure and interactive play facilities that are great for families to have fun. You will have happy and warm memories every time you stay with us! Song Tao Lou, the restaurant in the hotel, uses local special ingredients and creates delicious Atayal Tribe cuisines. Some of the memorable delicious gourmets are Crispy Xige Fish, Japanese-style Wild Vegetables, Fresh Guguan Trout and fresh sturgeon. Some of the nearby attractions - Basianshan National Forest Recreation Area, Shaolai Trail, Hot Spring Culture Center, Xinshe Mushroom Farm and Dongfeng Green Tunnel - are all worthwhile visiting.

stays.name: Lane62 Hostel
stays.description: “Life is an unfinished journey. Take a break here and enjoy yourself. Then move on to the next destination with renewed energy and courage! The life is just like a backpacker's journey. Once it starts, it cannot be stopped. Let us embrace and enjoy various surprises and challenges with an open mind during the journey! Lane62 Hostel is not only a hotel, but also a space for you to experience the culture and arts. We are dedicated to bringing wonderful things for people. So we often organize artistic and cultural activities, such as: dance, music, and photography. In the industrial style decorations, you can watch a drama or deeply interact with the tourists from different countries. Lane62 Hostel is near the Pingding Station of the Taichung Bus Lane. The area has a good public transport network with a good environment. It is suitable for the backpackers who do not like a bustling environment with heavy traffic. No matter whether you come from an airport, bus terminal, or high-speed railway station, it is very convenient to come here, It is in the vicinity of Tunghai University where The Luce Chapel is an attraction tourists must visit in Taichung. The surrounding attractions include: Taichung Tung Hai Night Market and Tung Hai Arts Street ─ It takes 10 minutes to walk or 2 minutes to take a bus to these places Fengjia Night Market ─ 30 minutes by taking Bus 28 National Museum of Natural Science and Calligraphy Greenway ─ about 25 minutes by taking Bus 300~308 Taichung Airport ─ about 25 minutes by taking Bus 302 Gaomei Wetlands ─ about 1 hour by taking Bus 305 and transfer to Bus 178 or 179 (Lane62 Hostel is the nearest youth hostel to Gaomei Wetlands in Taichung) Rainbow Village ─ about 40~50 minutes by taking Bus 300~308 and transfer to Bus 27 Welcome the individual visitors, backpackers, business visitors, student groups, and sports clubs to stay here.

stays.description: i-Deal Hotel is located in central Taichung. It was completed in 2010, offering travelers who come to Taichung another convenient place to stay. With a 10 minutes' walk, you can reach the Taichung Railway Station and bus station. It's easy for guests to plan their business trips. Our hotel is located in the city center, a home to lots of popular stores and shopping areas like Chungyo Department Store, Yizhong Street, Ziyou Rd. shopping area and Fengjia Night Market. You can enjoy the happiness of shopping in your spare time. Popular attractions near our hotel include Taichung Chung Shan Hall, National Museum of Natural Science, National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts, Taichung Confucius Temple, Taichung Martyrs' Shrine, Taichung Park, Taichung City Dadun Cultural Center and Jing-Guo Parkway. You can visit each of them by the well-connected transport routes.

stays.description: Norwegian Forest Taichung Cultural and Creative CenterIt is built next to the Taichung Cultural and Creative Industry Park (the old Taichung Winery), close to the Zhongxiao Road Tourist Night Market, Ambassador Cinema, Changchun National Sports Center, Taichung City God Temple and the nearly 100-year-old Taichung Elementary School, and is rich in historical and cultural background.The entire hotel is designed with different elements and styles based on cultural and creative industries and youth entrepreneurship, creating 45 different situations and rich themes, and perfectly integrating the literary and creative style into the rooms, so that tourists can easily enjoy the artistic conception of the room characteristics. Every visit is a new surprise and experience, making people reluctant to leave and linger on the cultural and food enjoyment journey, so as to achieve the purpose of Norwegian Forest: forest life and leisure travel, enjoy it.The hotel offers eight room grades, including Forest Creative, Urban Creative, Golden Dot Creative, Youth Creative, Modern Business, Landscape Business, Warm Family, and Parent-Child Family, to meet the needs of travelers with different needs. Each room is equipped with independent air conditioning, 65-inch garage room, 55-inch business room flat-screen TV, on-demand audio-visual equipment, environmentally friendly compressor-free refrigerator, wireless network WiFi, KTV equipment with 70-inch flat-screen TV, bubble massage bathtub, rain shower, leg beauty machine, and bidet according to the room type. The public area also provides a fitness center that is loved by parents and children, a sky tower ball pool, a spiral slide, a sliding track, a buffet restaurant, a forest life shop, a self-service laundry room and an accessible toilet. The hotel is equipped with parking spaces and provides a full range of considerate services.The Norwegian Forest Creative Center is the first choice for leisure travel that makes parents feel at ease, children happy, and lovers connected with each other.

stays.name: THE WAY INN
stays.description: This English version is crafted to be inspiring and professional, capturing the soul of the movie The Way while highlighting your hospitality and high ratings.Lowei Hotel: The ConceptA Journey Inspired by "The Way"Our name finds its inspiration in the film "The Way," a story of pilgrimage and discovery. We view the spirit of pilgrimage as a profound form of travel—a quest not just for destinations, but for meaning.On every journey, there are moments that linger in our hearts forever.Travel is a way to quiet the mind.Travel is a way to broaden one’s horizons.Above all, travel is an opportunity to encounter a better version of yourself.Lowei Hotel aspires to be more than just a place to stay; we are a unique and soulful sanctuary on your personal "pilgrimage" through life.Our HospitalityOperated with the warmth and intimacy of a boutique guesthouse, our young and energetic team is dedicated to providing friendly, spirited service. We strive to ensure that every guest feels a genuine sense of belonging and creates beautiful memories during their stay.Our ExcellenceIn the two years since our grand opening, we have been honored with exceptional recognition from travelers worldwide and major booking platforms:Agoda: 9.4 / 10Booking.com: 8.9 / 10Expedia: 9 / 10These ratings, along with countless heartfelt reviews, are a testament to our commitment to excellence. We look forward to welcoming you to Lowei Hotel, where your next great story begins.? Professional Tips for your English Listing:Title/Header: I translated "The Way Inn" as Lowei Hotel, as it sounds elegant and is easy for international guests to pronounce and search for.Tone: The language used is "aspirational" yet "welcoming," which is the standard for high-end boutique hotels and well-rated guesthouses.Keyword "The Way": Since the movie is a core part of your brand, emphasizing the word "Pilgrimage" adds a layer of depth that Western travelers (especially those who enjoy the film) will find very appealing.

It is the best choice for corporate meetings and parties. The hotel has many parent-child rooms and family rooms for family travel and rest. It has become the first car hotel in the Greater Taichung area to have a self-service car wash. The service and design of the Manhuo Hotel in all aspects will bring you a different new experience and enjoy life, fully reflecting the core value of the Norwegian Forest Hotel Group "Forest Life Leisure Travel, Enjoy It".
