stays.description: Hotel National was built in 1980, is not only an award-winning classic style hotel, but also a splendor history with numerous records in an atmosphere that the history intertwined with the modern. Located in Taichung City's most prosperous Zhonggang district and situated in Calligraphy Greenway, Hotel Nation offers 178 glorious style rooms, three Chinese and Western restaurants providing top-rated delicacies and premier banquet space. The National Museum of Natural Science and Botanical Garden are only minutes away. Kuang San SOGO department store and Park Lane by CMP are also in close proximity. Here you can enjoy the convenience of a metropolis. Hotel National, due to its charismatic quality, full greenery elegance, and exuding humanities becomes one of the most meaningful, symbolic, representative hotel of Taichung.

stays.name: INTERCONTINENTAL TAICHUNG
stays.description: InterContinental Taichung, directly managed by the IHG InterContinental Hotels Group, is situated in Taichung& #39;s popular commercial center, adjacent to the culturally rich Calligraphy Greenway district. The hotel offers 206 brand-signature guest rooms, featuring a contemporary and luxurious design that incorporates imagery of Taiwan& #39;s high mountain elevations, infusing every corner with the profound cultural heritage of the island and city.The hotel features four restaurants and one bar:Leaves & Vines Lobby Bar: Enticing pastries and beverages that invite you to linger.IL Limone Italian Restaurant: A fusion of classic and modern, leading guests through an artistic feast of Italian cuisine.Ming Juan House Chinese Restaurant: Focusing on the essence of Chinese gastronomy, presenting a contemporary Cantonese feast with exquisite culinary skills.Cai Yue Hot Pot: Featuring rich and flavorful broths as the base, combined with fresh mountain and sea delicacies, offering a bountiful taste of land and sea.Rolling Bar: A creatively reimagined new-style sports bar that immerses you in a wave of visual and auditory collisions, turning the act of drinking into a flowing feast.Additionally, the hotel boasts a pillarless grand ballroom accommodating up to 480 people, four independent meeting rooms, an outdoor swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness center, and the InterContinental Club Lounge. Upholding the principles of kindness and sincerity, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury.

stays.name: Mei Hotel
stays.description: In the West District of Taichung, there’s a place that quietly waits for travelers.This is Mei Hotel, a modest and warm little hotel that has been part of the city for over 30 years.We don’t have a grand lobby or extravagant decorations — just clean, comfortable rooms, soft lighting, and thoughtful touches in every corner.Whether you’re here for business, leisure, or simply looking for a peaceful place to rest, Mei Hotel offers the perfect starting point.Popular spots like CMP Green Park Lane, Calligraphy Greenway, and the National Taichung Theater are just a short walk or drive away.We offer free Wi-Fi and self-service laundry facilities, making both short and long stays easy and comfortable.No matter how long you stay, you’ll quickly feel at home.Many of our returning guests say that Mei Hotel feels less like a hotel and more like a quiet place where you can truly relax.No formalities, no pressure — just a simple, clean space that feels just right.If you’re looking for a place like this,Mei Hotel is here, quietly waiting for you in Taichung’s West District.

Combining symphonic design elements, it creates a multi-sensory experience, allowing melodies and space to resonate with each other, presenting a unique audiovisual experience. Through carefully arranged sound, color, and rhythmic shapes, it creates an immersive atmosphere for guests. This is not just a place to stay, but a symphonic feast for the senses.

stays.name: Taichung Harbor Hotel
stays.description: Wuqi is a coastal suburban district in Taichung with a beautiful origin. Its original name was Wucha but literati and scholars who frequented the place beautified the name and changed it into Wuqi, literally “to rest under the Wu-tong (Chinese Parasol) tree”. It is derived from a line of a Chinese poem that goes like this: “And the phoenix will rest on nothing but the Wu-tong tree”. Situated in Wuqi, Taichung Harbor Hotel features 200 elegant rooms. It is the first international tourist and business hotel at the central Taiwan coastline with a simple and stylish design. Refresh your body and mind in our comfortable and relaxing environment. Whether on business travel or on vacation, our staff is eager to welcome all of our guests. Indulge in our tasty fusion cuisine made with the highest standards. Our multifunctional banquet halls and conference rooms are the best choice for your conferences and business travels. Stay active in our well-equipped fitness center, luxuriate in our hotel spa or simply have a good time in the piano bar and find fine Taiwanese quality goods in our hotel shop.

stays.name: Ganlan Shu Homestay
stays.description: Olive Tree Farm is a Bed & Breakfast/coffee shop in the valley. With attention-catching European countryside architecture, located away from the noise and pollution of the city in a quiet corner of Xinshe District, the air is filled with a pleasant atmosphere, because this is a dream garden. The idea for the farm was born when Mr. Fu, the current owner, was a young boy. Playing with other children under an olive tree, he was inspired to build a house underneath it, and this dream stayed with him for the next 30 years until the spring of 2004, when the restaurant was completed. In the summer of 2008, the Bed & Breakfast was completed, finally realizing his dream. There’s no interference from work here, just birds and insects to keep you company, a soft breeze blowing by, and beautiful scenery. Are you searching for a spiritual garden? Take a seat here on the mountaintop. The Bed & Breakfast is a European countryside-style wooden house built against the mountain in a wide open area where you can sit and watch the clouds roll by. Some days there isn’t a cloud in sight, and the verdant mountains, green water, and pleasant, tranquil atmosphere transport you to the European countryside.

stays.description: Garden Life is located in Xinshe district, northeast of Taichung city, also called “Taichung back garden”. We are surrounded by grapes and mushroom farms. The area around Garden Life has many leisure farm with flowers, fruits or vegetable, and hiking trails.Garden life are 40 minutes from Taichung high speed train station and Taichung airport and Taichung city center, 30 minutes from the Lavender Cottage. Guests can enjoy our traditional Taiwanese breakfast with sweet potato porridge, tea, coffee, toast, and side dish. We provides the ideal opportunity to escape and truly relax. Garden life offers the trip planning to our guests and the information about the car rental with driver. We warmly welcome those guests who like and prefer a relaxing and quiet environment. We fluent in written and spoken English, Mandarin, Cantonese, Hokkien, Indonesian and Malay. Please do not hesitate to contact us if you require any further information.

stays.name: Moon Lake House Inn
stays.description: We are the legal house inn No.63 in Taichung city. Moon Lake House Inn,, Introduction Xinshe is the largest fluvial terraces in Taiwan. Ten thousand years ago, the activities of human beings had already existed here, and a century ago Bai-Len Canal was constructed here, a considerable feat of irrigation works at the time. The climate is cool and comfortable, and the best breeds of mushrooms, loquat, grapes, and Oncidium grow here; pleasant scenery, convenient transportation, floral festivals year after year, and attractions everywhere, here is the Yangmingshan in Taichung. Mon Lake House Inn, B&B, is located on the side of Moon Lake Fluvial Terrace, facing Dongshih on the opposite side of Dajia River, having vast horizons, extending peaks of Mt. Hengling, Mt. Yuanzui, Mt. Shaolai, Mt. Xiaoxue are presenting in front of you. In the night, bugs chirp and frogs chant, and Taiwan No. 8 Line looks like Galaxy with lights on. It is hard to imagine that here is just one km from Xinshe downtown, and we have the convenience of a city and the tranquility of rural life. Your host and hostess are born gardeners, crazy lovers of flowers, both personally planted the flowers and trees, which all are nearly 30 years old; the original appearance of the house has been kept for more than forty years. Decorations come from family and friends, including Papa's wind drum of more than 60 years old, Mom's dowry table and ancient shoulder pole for selling vegetables, younger sister's trophies of exploring the world, my son's paintings, and my daughter's drawing cards, etc., A little bit here and a little bit there are all our intentions to make you feel the warmth. The old house is the most mini here. We have only three rooms that can accommodate up to 8 people. Wireless Internet services. If you are interested in plants, you are welcomed to visit our secret garden. We advocate the concept of "Leave No Trace" and environmental protection activities of health and low-carbon; therefore, we hope the visitors bring their own personal toiletries,ex: towels, toothbrushes, and razors,etc. We welcome your family or friends together to appreciate the natural and cultural beauties of Xinshe, and enjoy the quiet simple happiness of our little home.

stays.name: TEMPUS HOTEL TAICHUNG
stays.description: The moment you walk through the doors of the Tempus Hotel, our staff will greet you with warm smiles and friendly service. With passion and sincerity, we strive to provide the best possible service to all of our guests from all corners of the globe. Our aim is to make your stay one marked by warmth, passion, gratefulness, and most importantly, joy.City and Resort: The Ultimate Relaxing Experience. Tempus comprises two buildings that each give guests a different accommodation experience: A, which combines pop styling with minimalist design, giving guests a clear, vibrant, northern European atmosphere; and B, where you can enjoy a more classical environment using high-quality stone and classy wood furniture, escaping the rat race of the city into an air of warmth and comfort. And out of consideration for vacationing families, in September 2011 Tempus opened the four-person-room-focused Da-Dun Building, offering 84 all-new rooms in a simple grey-white checkerboard motif with twin bathrooms with European baths and balconies adorned with greenery. Overall, these new offerings create a sense of total relaxation and feel like vacationing abroad.A Gourmet Combination of East and West. The Tempus offers both Chinese and Western restaurants to satisfy all kinds of appetites. Kenting Ali Seafood Restaurant’s flagship Taichung branch is located here, and the restaurant fields its own fleet of eight fishing boats to catch its own fresh fish. Master chef Li Wenzhan puts to use his 26 years of experience to create fresh dishes with a distinctively southern Taiwanese taste. La Mode Restaurant, headed up by chef Zhong Qingtian, offers European style cooking made with locally sourced ingredients, serving up international meals that are both spectacular and healthy. Between the combination of East and West, these restaurants make the Tempus a culinary landmark for central Taiwan.Balinese Relaxation in the Middle of the City. Located next to the Tempus is a large, freshly designed recreation center where guests can swim, sunbathe, or just enjoy the sunshine and breeze amongst the coconut trees. Guests at the Tempus have unlimited access to this center, and can freely take advantage of the gym, classes, and sauna for a taste of high-quality tropical relaxation in the middle of the city.

stays.name: TREEART Hotel
stays.description: TREEART HOTELis located in Taichung, a city with the warmest and clearest climate in Taiwan, and a pleasant and charming atmosphere. It blends the design concepts of Feng Shui, light and oxygen to create an organic space full of pulse and vitality. It is the first fragrance-themed boutique hotel in Taichung to receive SGS certification for cleanliness and fresh air quality. The hotel has also been awarded the Bronze-Level Green Mark by the Environmental Protection Administration and recognized as a Low-Carbon Hotel by the Taichung City Government.Conveniently located near Taichung City Hall and surrounded by key attractions such as the Taichung National Theater, Fengjia Night Market, Shuinan Economic and Trade Park, Central Taiwan Science Park, Top City Department Store, Shin Kong Mitsukoshi, Maple Garden, and Central Park.Guests can enjoy our exclusive immersive aromatherapy essential oil experience and a signature breakfast crafted by an award-winning chef.During your stay, we hope that you will experience the surprise of living in a "tree" surrounded by a relaxing atmosphere and ten thousand square meters of greenery in the heartbeat and breathing guest room space and facilities that we have carefully created.

stays.name: The Lin Hotel Taichung
stays.description: Fusing futurism with classicist elegance, THE LIN HOTEL TAICHUNG stands as a new landmark deftly planted in the green city center of Taichung, at a stone’s throw from the Taichung Metropolitan Opera House and the scenic Maple Garden. Its façade of bronze-tinted glass and Syrian travertine express The Lin’s low-key approach to refined luxury which reveals itself as you enter. The golden-ratio-based design lends a sense of balance and comfort to the guest rooms, while the Dubai-style outdoor swimming pool and wellness center, and the healthful culinary buffet tend to the body and soul of every guest. In addition, the executive rooms and suites offer convenient services and exclusive benefits which may weigh in as much or even more than their tangible luxuries. Lastly, the 11-meter high, 1340 m² banquet hall with 430-inch T.V. Wall Screen and dedicated service team guarantees that every event will leave a lasting impression. Whether you’re on a business trip, a family outing, or a romantic journey, THE LIN HOTEL TAICHUNG welcomes you with well-appointed rooms with gorgeous views, fine dining, and attentive service will surely make your stay into more than you imagined.

stays.name: Windsor Hotel
stays.description: Windsor Hotel Taichung towers over the hub of Zhonggang shopping district. The architectural plan is to build an environment that is tranquil, secluded and surrounded by gardens, with a distinctive twin architecture. The lighting scheme won 2007 International Lighting Design Competition Award of Excellence. Windsor Hotel is a top-rated hotel, and is also the nearest hotel to the Taichung Station of High Speed Rail. Everywhere inside the hotel, there are works of arts intertwined with plenty of natural light, and full of green, which makes you feel like you are in a painting. A colorful attitude that leads the wave of going urban vacation. Comfortable and cozy rooms with a view are designed according to the customer's demand. Innovative cuisines, which blends west with east, are memorable to gluttonous passengers. Upholding the high standards to serve every international traveler, with the design full of technological implication, we provide the just right, considerate services. Whether it is for business or for leisure travel, we write a beautiful page for your journey. Since its opening in 2006, the hotel has received numerous well-known groups and dignitaries, held several high-profile international festivals, and been repeatedly elected as a designated hotel for international events. Professional team of the hotel are attentive to detail and are dedicated to creating great dining and accommodation experiences. Tel: 04-24656555. Fax: 04-24658555. Address: No. 610, Sec. 4, Taiwan Boulevard, Xitun Dist., Taichung City, 40764, Taiwan (78-3, Sec. 3, Taichung Kang Road, Xitun Dist., Taichung City, 40764, Taiwan)

stays.name: 1969bluesky_CHECKinn
stays.description: In the unique urban context of the Taichung old city area and surrounded by the romantic and nostalgic atmosphere of 1969, the Hotel establishes a modern and exquisite Yuppie industrial style. “History, culture, classic sentiment, and habitability in industrial style” are the native DNAs of 1969 BlueSky. Pushing open the heavy brass door, you will encounter piles of travelers’ memories under the bright chandelier. With the front desk transformed from an old boiler, panel of an old transformer box, the texture of walls left by knocking out the old stairs, and every little detail, it seems you were returning back to the romantic and glamorous 1969 on a time machine. We design the rooms in exquisite and elegant industrial style by looking for lamps, nuts, and hardware parts of different but interesting forms. The Minotaur shape hat rack paying tribute to Picasso and local culture, the bathroom floor with colorful classic patterns Majolica tiles, and the interlocking Burr Puzzles over the washstand all spice up the room. The traveler will feel warmth and surprise in each corner of the room.

stays.name: KIWI EXPRESS HOTEL-Taichung Station Branch 1
stays.description: Taichung Honey Dew Hotel is located in Taichung, a city of culture, and is conveniently placed near Zhongzheng Rd., Taichung Train Station, and stations for Taichung Bus and Kuo Kuang Motor Transport companies, and is thus the perfect affordable, convenient destination for visitors to Taichung, whether for business or for pleasure. Offering excellent recreational facilities, Taichung Honey Dew Hotel strives to create a homely atmosphere for its guests. It is also close to the electronics district, Xuguang Commercial District, and Ziyou Rd. Commercial District, three of Taichung’s most well-known commercial areas, meaning while you’re in Taichung, you can easily take in the culture and the shopping.Taichung Honey Dew Hotel provides a variety of rooms designed with different feelings in mind, making it perfect for business visitors, recreational travelers, and couples alike. Every nook and cranny of the hotel is cleaned each day and new toiletries are supplied, and the hotel also offers a business center and in-room wireless Internet, helping business visitors stay on top of things at all times. With its professional service, Honey Dew Hotel has strived to create a new, high-class experience for visitors to Taichung, and we work hard to ensure that you’ll be back again and again.Taichung Honey Dew Hotel also offers information on what to see and do around Taichung. For example, if you’re here for two days, why not check out the National Museum of Natural Science, Dakeng Scenic Area, Fengjia Night Market, Jingming 1st Street, and Taichung Park! With so much to see and do, Honey Dew Hotel is happy to provide a quality place for you to stay during your journey. We also offer online bookings through our safe, secure online service, letting you pick your check-in date and room type. We also have special offers available from time to time, in recognition of the ongoing support of the users of our online system. So why not book some time at Taichung Honey Dew Hotel and let us help you create fantastic memories of your stay!

stays.name: Norway Forest Taichung Travel Hotel 1
stays.description: Norwegian Forest. Travel Inn 1 is located right in front of Taichung Railway Station. The hotel has a restaurant, fitness center, public lounge area, and aerial viewing platform on the 12th floor. The hotel provides double room, deluxe triple room, parent-child family room and parent-child six-person room and other room types, and is equipped with indoor slides for children's play area, nursery room, parent-child toilet, 24-hour reception counter and exclusive unmanned self-service counter to facilitate you quickly Check in. Free WiFi is available in all areas of the hotel. The room is equipped with independent air conditioning, 55-inch flat-screen TV, audio-visual equipment on demand, environmentally friendly compressor-free refrigerator and premium TOTO free toilet. It also has a quick-cooking kettle, capsule coffee machine, hairdryer and business desk; private bathroom with shower facilities and Free toiletries (some rooms have a separate bathtub), and all hotel rooms use an ozone cleaner to improve the air quality of the room. The hotel restaurant serves a variety of Chinese and Western buffet breakfasts, coffee machines, various drinks and snacks; you can also watch the changes of Taichung Station, trains and crowds directly from the restaurant. While enjoying the food, you can also feel the bustling beauty of Taichung. Exactly-the meaning of "Mori live travel. Free roaming". The hotel has a sightseeing and travel consultation counter, and provides special locomotive rental services; and a fitness center is attached to allow guests to exercise while they are free. Popular nearby attractions include Miyahara Ophthalmology, Jiguang Business District, Taitang Ecological Park, Zhonghua Road Night Market, Yizhong Street Night Market, Zhongxiao Night Market, Caowu Road, Science Museum, Taiwan Art Museum, Autumn Red Valley and other well-known attractions; It takes only 10 minutes by car from Taichung Train to Taichung Railway Station. The nearest airport is Taichung International Airport, which is about 30 minutes by car from 16 kilometers. Norwegian Forest. Travel Inn No.1 is located right in front of Taichung Railway Station. It has convenient transportation and pleasant scenery. It is definitely an excellent choice for business meetings, couples and friends escorts, and family parent-child travel and sightseeing.

stays.name: Norway Forest Taichung Travel Hotel 3
stays.description: Norwegian Forest Travel Hotel Hall 3 is located right in front of the Taichung Transfer Station. The overall exterior style is elegant and fresh, as if you are in a southern European manor. The hotel has a Forest Life Restaurant, Forest Life Shop, business center, self-service laundry area, open-air spiral staircase check-in area, and gym. It also combines Mr. WISH fresh fruit tea players and Gogoro electric scooter charging stations, providing diversified facilities and services so that every traveler can enjoy a different experience.The hotel offers six levels of guest rooms, including economic double room, comfortable double room, exquisite double room, elegant double room, family quadruple room and parent-child family quadruple room, to meet the different needs of all customers. Different themes of different styles are presented on each floor, including light industrial style, literary creativity and warm elegance. Each room is equipped with independent air conditioning, 43-inch flat-screen TV, on-demand audio-visual equipment, environmentally friendly compressor-free refrigerator, and wireless WiFi. Depending on the room level, there are also bidet toilets and single bathtubs. Each room has an independent window facing the outside, so that all travelers can enjoy the natural tranquility and sunshine in the busy city center.The Morihuo Xiaoyu restaurant provides diversified catering services. It not only provides brunch, afternoon tea and other delicacies, but also focuses on light meals and handmade salads, which can meet the health and wellness needs of modern people. The exclusive and private salad dressing is even more memorable. It aims to allow every customer to experience "New Morihuo, Healthy Food, Zero Burden" to achieve the spirit of Morihuo Xiaoyu~ Morihuo taste, infinite excitement~In order to promote nature and environmental protection, the hotel not only integrates Gogoro electric scooter charging stations, but also provides Gogoro electric scooter rental services. Let us work together to save energy and reduce carbon emissions for the earth.

We welcome you to join our professional team and contribute to the brand value of Red Dot Resorts. Red Dot Hotel (formerly Galaxy Hotel) is located in Taichung& #39;s Central District, adjacent to Zhonghua Road Night Market and Rixin Grand Theater (formerly Zhonghua Theater). The British media outlet Daily Express reported that Red Dot Hotel is the World& #39;s Most Fun Hotel. This space, brimming with creativity and design, has garnered numerous accolades, including the Taiwan Interior Design Commercial Space Award (TID Award), Best Architecture and Space Design Planning at Shopping Design, La Vie magazine& #39;s Top 100 Stylish Hotels in Taiwan, TripAdvisor Traveler Choice& #39;s Top 25 Hotels, and the only design hotel recommended in the 2020 Taipei-Taichung Michelin Guide… A decade has passed, and Red Dot Resorts will be back in 2024 with a brand new look. Join us! We need professionals from different fields to create wonderful travel memories and build a platform for a better future. We welcome you to join our professional team and contribute to the brand value of Red Dot Resorts. Let& #39;s continue to glide gracefully on our great journey!Business Philosophy: Unlike typical hotels, Red Dot Resorts is based on "creative aesthetics" and incorporates the essence of "local experiences." With an innovative and creative approach, we depict the unique cultural traces of many local Taiwan locations. We guide domestic and international travelers to discover the beauty of a new Taiwan through Red Dot Resorts, painting a dream travel experience for them.

stays.name: We2 Design Hotel
stays.description: We welcome guests with fervor, embracing the French minimalist style, and are committed to creating a vibrant and modern accommodation experience that also exudes the unique charm of Taiwan. The minimalist and pure delicate tone constructs a new world beyond the daily routine. At OnlyTwo Design Hotel, we elevate the arrangement of form and space to a higher level, presenting unique quality beyond the novel and bright appearance. The hotel style is full of vitality and modernity, exuding an intriguing charm, while integrating the unique style of Taiwanese accommodation. Following the spirit of the 20th-century architectural master Mies van der Rohe, we firmly believe that "less is more", and this concept runs through the modern style decoration design, becoming the essence of the OnlyTwo Design Hotel. Designed by Taiwan& #39;s emerging designers, the old building retains its original appearance, integrating different local humanities and history. Through design, it communicates with the travelers of this city. The lobby combines a Tea Bar, conveying the Taiwanese hospitality tea culture to every traveler, cup by cup.

The hotel's main feature is its view of the large whale-shaped installation art, "Blessing of the Big Fish," allowing you to enjoy a broad and open vista during your stay. During the day, you can easily walk to Anping Old Street to explore the charming historical alleys, and in the evening, you can enjoy a peaceful view of the fishing port while watching the beautiful sunset.In addition, Tainan Big Fish Hotel is located in the city center, making it very convenient to visit Tainan's major night markets. Whether you're looking to taste local snacks or experience the vibrant night market atmosphere, everything is within easy reach. For travelers who drive, the hotel provides free public parking, making it the ideal accommodation choice for your trip to Tainan.

stays.description: The Ronchamp Villa is named in tribute to the Ronchamp Church completed by the French architect Le Corbusier in 1964. Its architectural expression and distinctive features make us think about how this design trend affected the land of Taiwan from 1954 to 1964. The design pulse of the year has spread from Europe to Taiwan. Old bungalows have witnessed the development trajectory of society and recorded the appearance of the times, leaving Anping with cultural treasures worth preserving.

stays.name: ShareHouse Yamaki
stays.description: The whole concept started from architecture. In 2004, Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop and us built BIBOFI in Anping. This project is the initial point of architecture for me and Architect WU-I WU. What's more, I saw a group of people making effort to turn out their ideal under the traditional system of constructing. They are making the change, restarting a new house pattern by focusing on every single detail which would also touch you in various ways. That's why my family and I made a wish. We hope that more and more people can experience such fragrant thing. We then took over Share House which is built in 2015, making it into a guesthouse. Hoping to continue the spirit of sharing and provide the oppurtunity for more travelers to enter a new generation of townhouse. A house that's minuscule but has it's own front and backyard at the same time, this gains you a peaceful night just for you and you companions. Inspired by architecture, turned out by Guesthouse The final goal is hoping we and our next generation to resonate the houses we live in everyday. The possibilities that we can seek in buildings, especially to feel the breeze, the sun naturally in urban. We desire to get close to mother nature because we are borned from it, If we can be surrounded by nature in urban, how precious could it be? A group of hard-working people fulfilled this building so it worth recommending. The base of Share House is nothing but a slim land, by the effort of those people we can see how different they are using the interior and changing the way of life from the traditional ways. This is not just a townhouse, but also a feast of living and seeing. The effort of us keep on going Such worthy of recommendation, we hope all of you would find here as another home that you would want to come back often. We sincerely share this Share House with you. About interior furnishing We decorated Share house with our collection in the past 20 years of traveling under the systematic material. colour and detail design of Yuan Ken Architecture Workshop. We hope to share our travel experience with all travelers. Home bears the accumulation of life. Family will always devote the best of themselves to each other. This would increase the happiness between everyone visbly and invisbly. We hope that everyone can consider Share House as your home in Tainan. Leisurely enjoy traveling and clear out the tireness in Share House.

stays.name: Taiowan One Piece Anping House
stays.description: About Taiowan One Piece Anping House Located in Tainan – Taiwan’s historical capital, close to Taijiang National Park, Sicao Green Tunnel, Anping Fort, Anping Matsu Temple and Anping Tree House.Fiddler crabs, land crabs, egrets, stilt plovers and migrant birds including black-faced spoonbills are our precious neighbors. We like uncrowded and peaceful life quality, so the house is not in the center of downtown, and is located between Anping Fort and the beach. Our home is close to nature and quiet at night; we don’t have many bright street lights surrounded though, there’re more stars staying with us. We would like to provide a comfortable, cozy and relax place for partners to have a rest after walking all day through the historical city with its temples, night markets and narrow old streets. To help you enjoy Tainan, we’ll be happy to share the tourist attraction and food tips with you. Have a great stay at Taiowan One Piece Anping House! Professional – the hosts passed the National Tour Guide We realize that every partner’s visiting Tainan might be a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, so we’re eager to provide better travel service for our partners. That’s the reason why we asked ourselves to learn the professional skill and knowledge in tourism industry. We’re the only one hosts in Tainan who passed the National Tour Guide. Local – the guest house won the official Hospitality Award The meaning of winning the official Hospitality Award for Taiowan One Piece Anping House is the recognition of our hearts of sharing the local life styles, special events and yummy food information with our partners. We would love to be your best local partner in your trip and share Tainan’s wonderful things with you! stays.name: Taipung Suites
stays.description: Located directly across from the Tainan City Government, and adjacent to the Anping Cultural Park and the Hai'an Road Art Street, this hotel combines accommodation, leisure, dining, and conference facilities into one, making it a representative business hotel in the Tainan area with a refined and sophisticated approach. The hotel offers 103 guest rooms, each designed in one of six distinct styles and settings, creating a dream experience that cannot be achieved at home. Each room is meticulously designed, blending advanced hardware and software facilities, elegant custom-made furniture, and thoughtful, comfortable bathroom amenities, ensuring that every guest enjoys a flawless and relaxing stay.The lobby is designed with an emphasis on elegance and sophistication, featuring a simple, bright, and comfortable space adorned with carefully selected artworks, allowing all guests to easily and comfortably complete check-in and check-out procedures.A perfect trip requires a perfect meal. At the Taibang Pasha Restaurant, guests can enjoy a leisurely and nourishing breakfast prepared by the chef while basking in natural sunlight pouring through the glass curtains, giving visitors from afar a full day of energy.With a service culture and business philosophy centered on "intellect and elegance," Taibang Business Hotel offers guests visiting Tainan for business or tourism the warm and welcoming feeling of home.

After the war, in 1946, the three brothers Ou Shanfa, Ou Shande, and Ou Haifa joined forces and hired Da Mu as chief engineer. My father built it as a traditional humanistic residence in Sanheyuan and hired master Pan Chunyuan to paint it himself.

stays.name: Hoya Hot Spring Resort Guanziling
stays.description: When you come to Guanziling Mud Hot Spring in Tainan, you feel like you have entered a leisurely and quiet time tunnel. This is an ideal place to relax your body and mind, bringing you into a slow and peaceful spring water feast, allowing you to feel the generous gifts of nature in your leisurely time. The winding mountain paths and green tree shadows interweave into a charming picture, seeming to invite you to roam as you please. When the breeze blows by, the mud hot springs bring a burst of warmth, like a leisurely whisper, making the body and mind feel as if they are melting into the embrace of the earth. The water surface of the mud hot spring bath is picturesque, as if you are bathing in the natural clear stream. You can immerse yourself in it, feel the pleasure of the warm mud covering your body, gradually forget the hustle and bustle of life, and gradually release all stress.

stays.name: People's Hostel_Taiwan Image Calligraphy Museum
stays.description: The Siraya National Scenic Area Management Office of the Tourism Bureau of the Ministry of Transportation renovated the Shirakawa-Zaki Nei Elementary School that had been abandoned for many years in Tainan City and established the "In-person Hotel_Taiwan Imagery Calligraphy Museum". Chen Shih-hsien, a local calligrapher in Shirakawa, serves as the director. Combining calligraphy art performances, restaurants, accommodation and other integrated services, it provides irregular art-themed exhibitions. In addition to static exhibitions, it will also combine 3D animations to present calligraphy animation videos, hoping to present local artistic characteristics and promote the development of local arts and tourism.There are rich tourism resources around the Calligraphy Museum. In addition to the seasonal Kapok Road in Linchupi, Baihe Lotus Park and Yufeng Green Tunnel, you can also go to Guanziling to experience the mud hot springs and taste special food. We hope to integrate the surrounding tourism through the operation of the Calligraphy Museum Resources are used to build the Calligraphy Museum into a tourist relay station, bringing tourists a diverse and rich travel experience. It also combines local artists, communities and surrounding tourism industries to build the Taiwan Image Calligraphy Museum into a new iconic tourist attraction.

stays.name: Yu Shuen Garden Homestay
stays.description: In front of Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast is a green tunnel, and behind it, a pond and garden. Situated on Tainan Road 90, it is in close proximity to the hundred-year-old mango tree green tunnel, as well as fields of lotuses and paddies of rice. Looking out across the Jianan Plain, a huge expanse of greenery and fields as far as the eye can see, is an amazing experience. In the early morning or at dusk, why not take a walk or ride, watch the sun rise/set, breathe deep of the fresh air, and relax? Or how about just taking in the majestic sight of Mt. Guanzihling (Guanziling) A mere 15-minute walk will get you to the Lotus Information Center, and one kilometer to the west sits the Linchupi Cotton Trail. About five kilometers to the west lies Xiaonanhai Natural Ecological Park, and 1.5 kilometers to the north is Lianhua (Lotus) Park. Baihe Township is 4.5km south of Yu Xuan Yuan, and about 14km to the east is Guanzihling (Guanziling), a wonderful place for a drive or a ride, with the promise of hot springs at the end! Behind Yu Xuan Yuan itself sits a “secret garden” complete with fountain, lotuses, and carp, as well as a beautiful pagoda that combines classic and modern design. With fruit trees and shrubs abounding, the air is crisp and clean, making it a refreshing place to relax and listen to nature, far from the madding crowds. The lotuses are at the best between June and August each year, filling the air with fragrance — and if you want to fully enjoy them at their peak, the best time would be between 6am and 8am. In March, the cotton trees bloom, while May sees the golden shower trees on show; April and May are also when the mangoes and passionfruit are at their best, while June offers the chance to try your hand at picking fully ripened mangoes. December, meanwhile, is the perfect time to try picking, or just appreciating, the lotus roots and having a go at making lotus flour — and of course, you’ll need somewhere to spend the night too! A stay here is truly great for the mind, body, and soul. Yu Xuan Yuan Bed & Breakfast has been running for over 13 years now, and was even recognized by the Tourism Bureau, Republic of China (Taiwan) in 2011 as one of the “100 Happy Stays” and received a “Taiwan Host” award in 2012! It truly is a place well worth a visit!

stays.name: Yan She Homestay
stays.description: From 1976 to 1981, the Taiwan Salt Company built salt workers' houses in Beimen and "Jingzijiao" to take care of the salt farmers. In 1981, a row of two buildings with a total of 12 households were built on the north side of the "Jingzijiao" temple, commonly known as "12 Households". Since most of the buyers were salt workers, the houses were named "Salt Houses" because they were the houses where the salt workers lived. Jingzijiao is a simple countryside place with sunsets, salt fields, rich birdlife and ecology, allowing travelers to relax and unwind from the busy pace of the city and experience the different strolling lifestyle of the local residents.

stays.name: Wu Long Yuan Kafei Homestay
stays.description: Wulong Coffee is a bed & breakfast located in Tainan’s Dongshan area, which boasts a mild climate making it like springtime all year round. The views are spectacular, spreading all the way out to the western coastline from Taixi in Yunlin County along to Budai Harbor and Dongshih (Dongshi) Harbor in Chiayi, and covering virtually all of Tainan County out past Tainan City to the two prominent smokestacks of Kaohsiung City’s Xingda Harbor. By night, the lights of the Jianan Plains stretch out in front of you. Wulong Coffee Bed & Breakfast itself boasts organic gardens of fruit and vegetables, a coffee plantation, and even a saltwater pond. The food on offer, whether full meals or simple snacks, is cooked using natural, unpolluted, locally sourced spring water, creating a peerless flavor. The bed & breakfast also offers wireless Internet access. The mountains nearby boast beautiful hiking trails, passing from the premises through Mt. Dadong, Dashihling (Dashiling), Siaoshihling (Xiaoshiling), and Tianchi, while nearby destinations include the hot springs of Guanzihling (Guanziling), Fire and Water Cave, Kanding Fuan Temple, Mt. Kantou Xiangong Temple, and Zengwun(Zengwen) Reservoir, all reachable within a 15 to 30 minute drive from Wulong Coffee Bed & Breakfast.

stays.name: Xiangyang Tianyuan Ju Homestay
stays.description: Sunny Villa—Our sincerity brings you a memorable journey.Sunny Villa is run by a retired teacher Mei-hui Su and her daughter-in-law Wei-rong Yang. “Sunny” is our attitude—we are always optimistic. We treat every visitor as our close friend, hoping to radiate soothing warmth anytime. On July 14, 2012, Sunny Villa was reported in Liberty Times, “Sunny Villa often sponsors local cultural and artistic activities and it puts Dongshan Section in the spotlight.” It was also chosen as one of the best stores in Tainan in 2014. stays.name: Cultural Trust Hotel
stays.description: CulturalTrust Hotel sits in Tainan City’s East District, near the Tainan City Culture Center and Barclay Memorial Park. Transportation is easy and convenient, with the hotel only a minute’s walk from the Chongxue or Chongming stops on the Chi Mei Hospital high-speed rail shuttle bus route. From Tainan Train Station or Tainan Airport, it is only a 10-20 minute drive. CulturalTrust Hotelneighbors many of Tainan’s well-known historical landmarks, including Chihkan (Chikan) Cultural Area, Guoxingye's Shrine (Yanping Junwang Temple), and the Confucius Temple, and provides free bicycle rental to help you enjoy the city, its history, and its food at your own pace. You can also take tourist buses 88 and 99 to travel Tainan’s historical sites, see Anping Old Street, visit Sihcao (Sicao) Wildlife Preserve, or explore Tainan Salt Pan Eco-Village. Shopping is also convenient, with several commercial districts, along with T.S. Mall and Poya Living Mart, We are committed to offering the best service to our guests, and as part of that we not only offer luxurious rooms, but also a business center, demonstrating our commitment to international perspective and attention to detail. Every guest is a VIP to us, and we strive to provide dedicated, quality service to all. We hope you will make CulturalTrust Hotel your home away from home.

stays.description: Evergreen Plaza Hotel (Tainan) is located in the eastern district of Tainan City, a place filled with a thriving arts & culture atmosphere, close to the Tainan Municipal Cultural Center, and has received numerous renowned performers and celebrity guests from around the world. With widely known exquisite cuisine and attentive service, the hotel was awarded the first Five Star Rating Hotel in Tainan by Tourism Bureau. The hotel features 197 superior rooms, a gym, outdoor landscape swimming pool, sauna, and other leisure facilities, as well as Chinese and Western restaurants, versatile meeting spaces and banquet rooms, etc., and it is suitable for all kinds of conferences, meetings, or banquets. Surrounding environment includes a well-known ecological Barclay Memorial Park and convenient shopping department, only 15 to 20 minutes' walk from Tainan Railway Station, Tainan High Speed Rail Station, or highway Rende Interchange. With convenient transportation, the hotel is suitable for travelers of business, as well as leisure, such as tasting Tainan snacks, touring historic monuments, Taijiang National Park, Southwest Coast National Scenic Area, and Siraya National Scenic Area. stays.name: Shangri-La Far Eastern, Tainan
stays.description: Shangri-La Far Eastern, Tainan, located in downtown Tainan, offers 331 guestrooms and suites, three restaurants, one lounge, one bar and seven banqueting and function rooms. The 38-storey hotel has the largest guestrooms in the city spanning a minimum of 50 square meters. All rooms showcase an elegant, Asian-inspired decor with contemporary accents and panoramic view that invariably distinguish the hotel from other luxury hotels in Taiwan. In addition, the Health Club provides state-of-the-art fitness machines, aerobic room, sauna facilities, and an outdoor heart-shaped swimming pool. Sports lovers will have a happy and relaxing time here while exercising.The hotel is also within walking distance of the city''s main railway and bus stations, while Tainan''s domestic airport and Taiwan High Speed Railway (THSR) station are just a 15-minute and 25-minute drive respectively.

stays.name: The Place Tainan
stays.description: The design hotel brand of Royal Hotels & Resorts, The Place that sets to connect with local cultures wrote its first chapter in a city full of stories – Tainan in the end of 2014, as the group’s 12th hotel. The Place Tainan is a masterpiece of collective efforts, including the architecture firm Mecanoo of the Netherlands, the lighting from the DPA of the UK and other international teams. To showcase the theme of new and old, window grille, bricks and wood materials are widely used in the hotel, reflecting Tainan’s landscape and traditional images through modern design.Located in downtown Tainan, the east district, The Place Tainan shares the same complex with the T.S. Dream Mall, a new must-go of Tainan. The hotel has 223 rooms, the Ganchui Italian Restaurant, the Bar 21 and the Huigan Café, as well as the fitness center and the laundry room. To highlight local arts and culture, The Place Tainan also features an exhibition space (400 square meters) and the Ganching Shop on one corner of the lobby, presenting selective works from local designers and craftsmen. It is hoped that local culture through sophisticated design works and artifacts could be better appreciated and shared amongst travelers.

stays.name: Guantian want Tiankai Homestay
stays.description: The 50-year-old Japanese-style courtyard house was built after the Baihe earthquake. It witnessed the transformation of rural Taiwan and received grassroots ambassadors from all over the world. It was inherited from the Ming Zheng period when Zhuge -- Chen Yonghua joined the army. The only descendants of the Chen family in Taiwan are left behind. The official homestay Yixiangtian opened a B&B. It is worth your stop to enjoy the warmth of history.Next door is the Guantian Visitor Center of the Siraya National Scenic Area, which often hosts hot air balloon, triathlon, cycling, road running and pet-friendly activities. There is also a Taiwan Travel Ningbo Guantian Sightseeing Bus Station, which can connect to Xinying Longtian Shanhua Railway Station and travel to various scenic spots such as Liuying Liujia Guantian Shanhua Mountain and Danei. There is also an Ubike station, which allows you to travel to various scenic spots in Guantian and Lingtian.

stays.name: L・A・I HOTEL
stays.description: LAI HOTEL GUIREN is located in Guiren Township of Tainan with abundant historic and cultures. LAI HOTEL GUIREN is a new landmark in Guiren that shows the opening attitude to the world and express the warm care to travelers coming from other countries.LAI HOTEL GUIREN brand core: "three degrees and two flavors". The meaning of "three degrees" is a symbol of warm love, experience depth and culture width; "two flavors" expresses taste and recollection. We focus on customers' demands. The word "LAI" consist of five people, and it means travelers, businessmen, family members, newly-wed couple and home returners; we also expect each guest staying here can be inspired and experience the warm of people and nature with service and environment. Therefore, everyone can get rid of the fatigue caused by long journey, and the whole body and mind is nourished and go home in satisfaction.Moreover, we pay attention to present local culture and integrate the particular features and humanistic care in building design concepts, and Cattleya garden concept originates from the local orchid species- Cattleya, and Red Tile Castle was constructed in Taiwanese traditional red tiles with dedicated designs in order to let travelers experience much more local culture, passion and energy from local residence. The internal arrangement is a simple style to present high quality and affinity and customers can feel like live at "home" with natural and meticulous design concepts.LAI HOTEL GUIREN is willing to accept any viewpoint from the world.

stays.name: Liuying Jianshanpi Resort
stays.description: Located in the scenic Chianan Plain, Jianshanpi Resort, managed by Taiwan Sugar Corporation, is a unique vacation destination in southern Taiwan. With its beautiful natural scenery, well-planned facilities, and warm professional service, the resort has become a well-known leisure spot. Since 2008, it has been continuously awarded the highest honor as an “Outstanding Tourist Recreation Area” by the Taiwan Tourism Bureau. Surrounded by tranquil landscapes of lakes and hills, the resort offers a peaceful escape resembling a hidden paradise. Here, guests can take a lake cruise to admire the picturesque willows, maples, and boats drifting on the serene waters, while savoring authentic Tainan-style cuisine. It’s the perfect place to unwind from the hustle of daily life — enjoy sightseeing, forest bathing, outdoor barbecues, or camping with family and friends. For a richer experience, the resort also offers activities such as paintball, canoeing, lake tours, and swimming with SPA facilities, ensuring every visitor returns home with lasting, joyful memories.

With its beautiful natural scenery, well-planned facilities, and warm professional service, the resort has become a well-known leisure spot. Since 2008, it has been continuously awarded the highest honor as an “Outstanding Tourist Recreation Area” by the Taiwan Tourism Bureau. Surrounded by tranquil landscapes of lakes and hills, the resort offers a peaceful escape resembling a hidden paradise. Here, guests can take a lake cruise to admire the picturesque willows, maples, and boats drifting on the serene waters, while savoring authentic Tainan-style cuisine. It’s the perfect place to unwind from the hustle of daily life — enjoy sightseeing, forest bathing, outdoor barbecues, or camping with family and friends. For a richer experience, the resort also offers activities such as paintball, canoeing, lake tours, and swimming with SPA facilities, ensuring every visitor returns home with lasting, joyful memories.

stays.name: Neat Hostel
stays.description: After years of change, the Neat Hostel, still retain the original style of the building, the space reflects the trajectory of different years. When travelers walk into the hall you can see the grindstone counters and pillars seem to greet and welcome your arrival, those terrazzo stairs, floors and walls still showing past beautiful style.It has no ornate decoration, without deliberately packaging decoration and artificial landscaping, in order to retain the unique style of Japanese architecture so that travelers can sink into the classical elegant space, explore the history of the footprint.There are many objects can touch your heart, recall with nostalgia feelings, it is worth your exploration of the stories it contains. Welcome to those who like the style of the old house to investigate local culture.

The elegant lighting design at the entrance and the colorful welcoming driveway make guests feel at home before entering their rooms. The theme rooms of this hotel are exquisite and romantic, while the family rooms are warm and comfortable. There are also business rooms designed for business travelers. The designer paid attention to details and humanized considerations, and planned trendy, simple and fashionable decoration and equipment. One of the advantages of this hotel is the unique high-ceilinged building-in-a-building design and the rich and delicious buffet breakfast. Let the VIPs have a relaxing and pleasant vacation time and a high-quality leisure environment at all times.

stays.name: King & Princess Motel
stays.description: Make a Wish; Dreams do Come True. Designed in an elegant baroque architectural style, King & Princess Motel is your lucky star in Tainan. With ISO9001:2008 accreditation, easy access, and a Tourism Bureau three-star rating, this motel stands out from the crowd. King & Princess Motel’s rooms are elegant and luxurious and its service friendly, and with an emphasis on a clean, private space, it is somewhere you can truly relax. It has 33 twin rooms and four family rooms. Tainan is a city known for its cuisine, and King & Princess Motel upholds this tradition with its breakfast, lunch, and dinner service, offering food that is fresh and freshly prepared, giving you the best. Being near Huayuan Night Market, Anping Scenic Area, the Eternal Golden Castle, and the Gold Coast, it is easy to get to and ready to serve. Weekday rates start at NT$1380 a night and Saturdays at NT$1880 a night, and you can also stay for shorter periods starting at NT$480 for two hours. Weekday check-ins end at 6pm, with check-out at 12pm; on weekends and holidays, check-ins end at 8pm, while check-out remains at 12pm.

stays.description: Shanhua, located in the geographic center of Tainan, is also the location of the [Tainan Science Park].Nanke Zhan Hotel is located right in the city center, 3 minutes away from Shanhua Railway Station, 5 minutes away from National Highway No. 3, and only 10 minutes away from National Highway No. 1. It is close to the transportation network extending in all directions!The second hall of Nanke Zhan Hotel is created by the famous architect Huang Jianjun, which combines the color block art of Mondrian and the blessing color of the Tibetan Fengma Flag. The hotel park covers an area of ​​more than 10,000 square meters. From a distance, you can see the distinctive architectural appearance with distinctive colors. It sits on the excellent idyllic landscape of the Jianan Plain, and the hinterland is very broad. There are abundant facilities and dining options in the museum, including grandma's vegetable garden - non-toxic parent-child farm, Hongqiao Hong Kong-style tea drinking, paintball field, outdoor swimming pool, poolside bar, etc. There are also Baiping banquet hall, glass-made Dream Treasure Church and Luoyu The lake of the heart surrounded by pine, provides VIPs to hold wedding banquets or outdoor weddings, and make a once-in-a-lifetime romantic vow. There are also nearby attractions including Shanhua Old Street, Xinhua Old Street, Niu Xu, Mountain Garden Waterway Museum, Nanying Observatory, Orchid Botanical Garden, Wushantou Reservoir, Dannei Painted Village, Hucuoliao Painted Village and other attractions. , different from the hustle and bustle of the downtown area, it is very suitable for groups and families to take an in-depth tour and experience the slow and light travel of Tainan.

stays.name: Romantic code motel
stays.description: Romantic Code Hotel is located in downtown Tainan, next to Shanhua Interchange. The hotel is conveniently located close to various tourism attractions in Tainan and is in the same neighborhood as the Southern Taiwan Science Park. The variety of attractions and activities available here make it a great lodging choice whether you're here on a date, for a family outing or for business. Unlike the steotypical image that most motels represent, Romantic Code Hotel has an artistic and tasteful ambiance. It retains the function of a business hotel, but has the fun and interesting elements of a motel. The 55 guestrooms are carefully designed with a variety of art themes. As soon as you step inside a room, you will be immediately transformed into a tasteful and charming space. The creativity, quality and comfort created in each room set us apart from other motels. We're a Five-star Hotel that Meets All Your Needs Besides having beautifully decorated rooms, Romantic Code Hotel covers an area of more than 9,900 meters, with close to 5,000 meters of courtyard space. Within the courtyard, there are plants and flowers, fruit trees, sandpit and other recreation areas. There are also KTV rooms, meeting rooms and restaurants. All the facilities and equipments available here make this a great hotel for business or vacation. Romantic Code Hotel upholds our five-star hotel status and continues to put our customers first. We want our customers to feel like they are home away from home when they stay with us, and leave with happy and precious memories.

stays.name: Sigang Vacation Homestay Tainan
stays.description: When an ordinary place in the countryside transforms into a stress-free and relaxing rest spot, we would like to welcome you to our home. We& #39;re not a top vacation villa or luxury 5-star hotel. Our B&B is ordinary but has a simple elegance. Our country-style home is where you can enjoy some peace and quiet and stay restful. Take a break from the busy city and enjoy a different lifestyle in Tainan! Xigang Vacation B&B combines country-style living, local culture, art and fine cuisine into our business operation. This may not be a well-known town, but there are rich culture, diverse ecology and many stories about country living waiting for you to discover. Some of the nearby tourist attractions worthwhile seeing are the well-known and most popular temple in Taiwan - Xigang Qing& #39;an Temple, Shuwanggong (a giant old tree), Qigu Salt Mountain/Village, a lagoon to observe migratory birds (black-faced spoonbill), Taiwan Sugar Corporation& #39;s Jiali old warehouse, Xiaolong Cultural Park and Madou Daitian Temple. We only rent out the whole house and only receive one group of guests at a time. You will have the whole house to yourself and enjoy the privacy as in your own home.

You will definitely be able to experience Tainan's local culture and hospitality here and have lasting memories.

stays.name: Sweet House
stays.description: Homestay located in TainanWelcome to play~ Our "Xuejia" is one of the main production areas of "milkfish" in Tainan. stays.name: Art Ocean
stays.description: Art Ocean Homestay is a legally registered homestay (Tainan Homestay #300) in Tainan City´s Yujing District. Although the homestay is located in the Yujing mountainous region, it is easily accessible as it is near both Provincial Highway 84 and Provincial Highway 3. The environs offer a wide variety of activi-ties, and convenience stores, night markets, and restaurants are all reachable with only a three- to five-minute walk.Art Ocean Homestay is an art-themed guesthouse nestled in Taiwan´s mango hometown. The exterior of the building is in a Baroque style, and the interior fea-tures artwork of different styles personally created by the owner. It´s like an ocean of art. Every suite has its own style of painted murals and a comfortable accommodation environment, allowing guests to rest and relax.“The pleasure we derive from a journey may be dependent more on the mind-set we travel with than on the destination we travel to.＂ – Alain de BottonOur story starts with our love of art.The Baroque-style exterior, the different styles of the painted murals, the stories from different eras… we admire color and reproduce the classics, allowing art to become an ocean.We not only offer the opportunity to experience art, but also quality accommoda-tions – clean rooms, comprehensive facilities, an elegant environment – to relax our bodies, minds, and spirits.This is Art Ocean Homestay.We are located in the hometown of mangoes, Tainan City´s Yujing District (Tain-an Homestay #300), near Provincial Highway 84 and Provincial Highway 3.The environs offer a wide variety of activities and the transportation is convenient.If you want to experience art and seek the story of art after enjoying the land-scapes, then you must come here. Take our word for it.

stays.name: Pi-thon In House
stays.description: Paison's B&B is located in Yujing, Tainan. Opposite is Yujing Hutoushan Sports Park. It has a quiet environment and no noisy sounds. You can stop and take a rest in the busy life. The first floor of this B&B has a living room and dining table. , entertainment facilities and refrigerators, and thoughtfully provide instant coffee, instant tea and snacks, so you don’t have to worry about being thirsty or hungry. Stay with mountain views and free WiFi.Paison has an independent design for each room. The rooms are equipped with air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, bathrooms, shower facilities and hot water kettles. Some rooms have independent balconies or terraces. Bath towels, hairdryers and toiletries are provided in the bathrooms, allowing you to enjoy a relaxing and enjoyable journey.Opposite Paison's house is the Hutoushan Sports Park. The park is located at the foot of Hutoushan. It has sparse green trees and a diverse ecology. It has good forest trails, allowing you to find peace in your busy life. In the park, you can absorb phytoncides and slow down your pace. , a great place to relax.If you want to take a different trip, you can visit nearby famous attractions, such as Zoumarai Farm, Yujing White Church, Youjian Ice Shop Mango Ice, Nanhui Planetarium, Tainan Zuozhen Fossil Park, Siraya National Scenic Area District, Wushantou Library Water Park and other attractions.

stays.name: yunding
stays.description: The exterior of Tainan B&B - Yunding Landscape B&B is featured by beautifully carved pillars, marble steps and big glass windows, which create an extraordinarily majestic and brilliant ambiance. The top quality construction materials used in the B&B speak to the owner's high demand in quality and care. Ultimately, his intention is for his guests to have a comfortable and safe stay. Yunding Landscape B&B is close to Tsou-Ma-Lai Farm, Zengwen Dam Scenic Area, Meiling, Xuankungfa Temple, Galilee Driftwood Ark Church, Tainan Science Education Museum, Nanhua Dam, Guidan Hot Spring and Wushan Formosan Rock Macaque Protected Area. The views around the B&B are quite nice. In the morning, you'd see sunrise and a sea of clouds. In the evening, there is beautiful sunset, and at night, the Yujing night scene and rolling fog can all be seen from the B&B. During the day, you can also see the fruit trees on the nearby mountain top. All the guestrooms have curtain walls, and most of them have balconies where you can sit quietly, enjoy the mountain view and have a commanding look of the scenery around you. The guestrooms at Tainan B&B - Yunding Landscape B&B are spacious and bright. The wooden floor and curtain walls make the rooms look refreshing, natural, clean and comfortable. In addition, the B&B is located in a quiet setting, which is another advantage as guests will be guaranteed to get a quality and restful sleep. Besides the excellent living condition, the B&B also has a dining room that serves exquisite hot pots, delicious waffles, fruit vinegar and various kinds of cold and hot beverages. Guests can taste delicious cuisine while enjoying the beautiful scenery.

stays.name: 1969-Elixir of Love
stays.description: "1969-Elixir of Love" is tucked away in a small alley across from Yongfu Elementary School in Tainan's West Central District. This very alley was famously described by the late Tainan literary figure Yeh Shih-tao as "Snail Alley." His former residence still stands within this quiet lane.This townhouse, built over 50 years ago during the 58th year of the Republic era (1969), retains its original terrazzo flooring and a colorful pebble stone bathtub. We have revitalized the old house, giving each room its own character. We hope travelers visiting Tainan will find a room that speaks to them, and experience what Yeh once described as “a place where people can dream, work, fall in love, get married, and live a leisurely life.”Located in the heart of Tainan City, the townhouse is within walking distance of key attractions such as the Tainan Train Station, the Confucius Temple area, Chihkan Tower, Wu Garden, Hayashi Department Store, and the famous Du Hsiao Yueh Dan Zai Noodles. Public bus stops and T-Bike rental stations are also nearby, making it easy to explore further sites like Anping Old Street and Sunset Viewing Platform.Motorbikes can be parked at the alley entrance, and car parks are available nearby. We also offer discounted motorbike rentals from a designated shop near the train station.In his essay Memories Like Clouds, Yeh Shih-tao wrote: “I bought an old house to live in at the head of Snail Alley, drawn by its location—just behind the bustling Miyako Theater in West Gate Town. It’s like a peaceful valley tucked within the lively city.” We invite you to experience the calm and unhurried lifestyle that Yeh so beautifully captured, right here at 1969-Elixir of Love.Let me know if you’d like a more concise version for marketing material or booking platforms.

stays.name: BONJOUR ESCARGOT
stays.description: BONJOUR ESCARGOT is a townhouse over 60 years old with only 2 floors and 3 rooms. After renovation, it was transformed into a private B&B with a comfortable and elegant style. It is small and exquisitely hidden in the alleys of the city.Only one group of guests is accepted each time, and travelers can experience the local life of Tainan in a completely independent space.BONJOUR ESCARGOT is located in the West Central District of Tainan City, which is the earliest developed area in Tainan City. It is characterized by numerous historical sites, rich cultural history, and a mixture of old and new landscapes. Nearby are Hele Plaza, Shennong Street, Zhengxing Street, Hai'an Business District, and Zhongzheng Business District. It takes only 15 minutes by bike or car to reach Chihkan Tower, Confucius Temple Cultural Park, Hayashi Department Store, Blue Print Cultural and Creative Park, Anping Old Street, Sicao Ecological Reserve, etc. The area near the B&B is also a hot spot for food gathering. Whether you are sightseeing in the city, looking for food, visiting historical sites or just wandering aimlessly and enjoying the alleyways of Tainan, the perfect location of "Good Day Snail" is a good choice for your trip to Tainan!

stays.name: CHUNG FU INN
stays.description: Tainan｜Chung Fu Inn Invigoration relay station for Tainan visitorsNo sooner do you leave the Tainan Train Station than the warm southern sun welcomes you. Rent a scooter at a nearby dealership, turn the ignition and set off! Turning into the lane, you see a three-story townhouse with ornate iron window grates, vestiges of former times. You push the wooden doors and enter Tainan’s Chung Fu Inn!Preserving the enchanting iron window grates of a townhouseChung Fu Inn is co-owned by a designer from Taipei and a building contractor from Jiayi. They were attending a wedding banquet in Tainan when the old local townhouses caught their eye. They went on to apply their respective specialties in refurbishing it and named it Chung Fu Inn, using one character from each of their names.Each of Chung Fu Inn’s two townhouses preserves the original brick walls and ornate iron window grates. Once you enter the lobby, you are greeted by antique Chinese medicine cabinets and an ancient television set, which belong to the owners’ personal collections. As you climb the stairs in the Da Fu building, you see the ornate cement air vents along the top of the hallway walls. The stairwell of the outbuilding has been painted in rich and various colors, giving the old edifice a novel and vivid look.In the Da Fu building, antique wooden frames are reborn as partition screens to divide the interior of the Tranquil Room. In the Shu Huo Room, an entire wall of ornate iron window grates creates charming inverted patterns in the sunlight. Inside the outbuilding, the decor of the little Qing Xin Room incorporates vivid blue wall paint and wood-framed cabinets. Raise your head as you walk up the stairs to the third floor, and you are greeted by an array of fluttering, white butterflies. When you sit in the old rocking chair in Small Balcony Room, the butterflies will guide you in recollections of beautiful bygone times.Wooden doors, tatami mats, antique sofasBeyond the townhouses, you find two wooden single-storey houses as you enter the alley near the park, each of which are rented by one party at a time. The living room of Villa Number 45 is furnished with two retro sofas, and an elevated room to one side offers you a place to sit and rest. Take the steps onto the second floor and find a tatami sleeping area under the slanted roof, where you enjoy the air made warm and fragrant by the sunlight.Across the way sits Villa Number 47, with a similar Japanese layout and decorative elements. The bathtub on the first floor is remarkable, but even more surprising is the polished bar counter at the far end of the living room! After night falls, a cork pops out of a bottle of red wine and glasses are poured one-third full. It’s bottoms up in a toast to friendship!Now this is the passion of Tainan! When it comes to Tainan, the most anticipated part for most people is all the delicious and diverse foods. Chung Fu Inn is assisted in this regard by a varied host of well-known snack vendors. Not only do the owners of Chung Fu Inn offer recommendations for local scenic spots but they are even considerate enough to prepare local refreshments for their guests. The feeling of friendship is richly felt at Chung Fu Inn and leaves an indelible impression of Tainan. Chung Fu Inn won’t be the last stop on your journey, but rather a relay station where you can rest and recharge. Take the cordiality of Tainan with you today as you mount your scooter, turn the key and set off on the next leg of your adventure!

stays.name: CaoJi Book inn
stays.description: CaoJi Book inn, located across the Confucius Temple in downtown Tainan, is a hostel featured with books. We renovate the living areas with a good many of antiques and the massive book collections. Every sleeping-nook is your own universe- you can enjoy some moments of solitude after exploring the city all day long. Climbing out of your nook, there is a big public area where you can chat and laugh, cook, share talents, or sit in cozy corners and read quietly. We encourage you to make friends from all over the world in every possible way, feeling the fun to be together through interpersonal connection.Well-known tourist attractions and gourmet’s selections are all within walking distance. There is accessible transport in the neighborhood supplied with all you need for a breezy living. Welcome to check in here and explore Tainan.

stays.name: FUWARD Hotel Tainan
stays.description: FUWARD Hotel Tainan was invested and constructed by Founding Construction. It is a brand under FUSHIN Hotel. It is located in Tainan City Center, at the intersection between Zhongzheng Road and Zhongyi Road, close to the railway station, Beimen Shopping District, Shinkong Mitsukoshi and Hai'an Road Art Street. It is also in the vicinity of the first department store in Southern Taiwan "Hayashi Department Store" (Five-Stories House) and the attraction, Confucius Temple.It is close to Fort Provintia, Martial Temple, Tian Tan, Grand Matsu Temple, National Museum of Taiwan Literature and other well-known monuments and attractions. It is also near to food like milkfish porridge, Fusheng Bowl Cakes, Zaifa Meat Dumpling, Klin Taiwan Bun, Yifeng Wintermelon Tea and other old 100-year snack eateries famous in Taiwan. The accessible location of FUWARD Hotel Tainan makes it the absolute best choice for your leisure travel and business trips. The hotel has 96 guest rooms. It's modern and minimalist design creates a comfortable, neat and cozy all-rounded accommodation and hotel, providing travelers with comfortable accommodation and meeting the various business needs of business travelers; wireless Internet access is provided in the rooms, making it convenient for guests to search for information and share their experiences at any time. The Business Center also provides Internet access, fax, photocopy and other business services; during your stay, travelers can rent bicycles from the counter free of charge to explore Fucheng in another way; there are self-service laundry rooms and washing, spinning and drying equipment on the 3F and 5F in the hotel, providing convenience to all the travelers who stay here. The Fuli Restaurant on 2F provides Chinese and Western buffet breakfast. Various seasonal dishes are carefully prepared for you to enjoy a delicious meal in the open and bright dining space, and to enjoy a happy morning. There is a gym on B1 and it is equipped with a lot of fitness equipment. You are free to use them at any time during your stay.

This ancient house has an excellent geographical location, which is both prosperous and quiet. It retains the beautiful appearance of the retro old house, allowing you to travel through time and space, feel the integration of modernity and history, and find your own leisure time.

stays.name: Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel
stays.description: The Heliaogang stone tablet sits quietly at the street corner, telling of war and the past. Koxinga landed here with his troops 360 years ago and reclaimed Taiwan. The Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan, part of the Louvre Hotels Group, opened here 360 years later, aiming to be the key to Tainan travel. With unadorned Renaissance style, the hotel exudes European aesthetics. It has a 360-degree Tiffany glass dome lobby, Keukenhof de Bistro, Glory Magic, Royal VIP Room, and 47 European style guestrooms. It feels like the meeting of da Vinci and JK Rowling, artistic and interesting.The hotel is your starting point for exploring historic sites such as Chikan Tower, God of War Temple, and Tianhou Temple. It is surrounded by department stores, shopping malls, and traditional markets. A key to Tainan travel, Golden Tulip RS Boutique Hotel – Tainan is a must-visit attraction in Tainan.

stays.name: Haru Guesthouse
stays.description: Haru guesthouse provides a quiet and clean accommodation space. Take a relaxing break while exploring Tainan's diverse history, culture, scenery, food, and more.1. Haru guesthouse is a self-check-in B&B, and the main door and room door are managed with password access control.2. After booking, please add Haru guesthouse’s official Line (@700wynha) or use Booking’s messaging platform to conveniently inform you of your room door password and follow-up contact information.3. No breakfast or car parking spaces are provided, but motorcycles can be parked at the door. If you need car parking information, please feel free to ask.4. Large bath towel + shower gel + shampoo + hair dryer are provided. Haru guesthouse is an environmentally friendly and sustainable certified B&B. Disposable items such as toothbrushes, toothpaste, shaving razors, and shower caps are no longer provided.5. Smoking, including e-cigarettes, is strictly prohibited indoors. Please cooperate.6. Do not bring pets without permission.7. For private rooms or reservations for more than two days, please call or Line for enquiries, and you can enjoy preferential prices.I would like to trouble you to read the above instructions before making a reservation! Thank you, thank you~

stays.name: JUST ENJOY
stays.description: Located in Tainan, a city of history and culture, this spacious, simple hotel, with its eye-catching lighting and clean, elegant aesthetic, offers top quality accommodation and customer-centric service. With bicycle rentals available and shuttles able to be booked to the airport or science park, it’s a convenient stay for domestic and international guests alike. The hotel also has its own parking lot, free fiber-optic Internet access, and a business center with all new computers, making your stay even more convenient. Whether you’re coming to Tainan for business or for leisure, Tan Tso Ma Li Commercial Hotel offers top-quality service at affordable prices, making it a home away from home. The hotel is just a five-minute walk from Tainan’s renowned commercial districts, as well as Haian Rd. Art Street, Baoan Rd. Traditional Snack Street, Xialin Rd. Open-air Seafood Barbeque Street, and Guohua Youai Zhongzheng Commercial District;a three-minute drive from Shinkong Mitsukoshi, Confucius Temple Historical Area, and Chikan Cultural Area; and a five-minute drive from Tainan’s well-known Huayuan Night Market and Anping Tourist Culture Commercial District. From here, you can experience all of Tainan’s cultural offerings at your own pace, taking in the rich environment of the city and enjoying a mix of history and cuisine.

stays.name: LI HE JIA ZHU
stays.description: Li He Jia Zhu | Tainan West Central DistrictLi He Jia Zhu is located in Tainan West Central District, with convenient transportation and close proximity to many famous tourist attractions and shopping areas. It is an ideal accommodation choice for travelers looking to explore Tainan history, culture, food, and local life.Our establishment is a legally registered hotel, a standalone building with elevator access, and a smoke-free environment throughout the property, providing a safe, clean, and comfortable stay.The guest rooms are equipped with separate shower and toilet facilities, and we use Oright brand shower products and hand soap, emphasizing both guest accommodation quality and environmental sustainability.Starting from 2025, we will support sustainable travel by not providing single-use amenities, so we kindly ask guests to bring their own personal toiletries.Our hotel is located near several iconic Tainan landmarks. The Shin Kong Mitsukoshi West Gate Store is about a 10-15 minute walk away, and guests can also visit the Blueprint Cultural and Creative Park along the way.It takes about 10 minutes by car to reach the Garden Night Market, one of the largest night markets in Tainan, which operates on Thursdays, Saturdays, and Sundays. It offers a variety of food and specialty snacks from all over Taiwan. There are also traditional markets nearby, such as Yongle Market and Yamu Liao Market, where guests can experience local flavors and cultural atmosphere.Check-in time is from 15:00 to 17:30 daily, and check-out time is before 11:00 the following day.Li He Jia Zhu looks forward to providing every guest with a safe and comfortable travel experience, allowing you to experience the unique slow-living charm of Tainan.**Please note that our front desk service hours are from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM daily. If you plan to check in outside of these hours, we offer self-check-in service.**The self-check-in process will be sent to you through our official LINE account @lihejiazhu.To ensure a smooth check-in, please settle your room payment in advance and provide the guest& #39;s personal details for registration.This information will be used for legal registration and to comply with relevant regulations. We are a legitimate accommodation provider, and all check-in processes will follow legal requirements to ensure your safety and privacy.If you have any questions, please contact us during business hours or through our official LINE account. We are here to serve you. We look forward to your visit and wish you a pleasant stay!
