stays.name: Mu Mu House
stays.description: Property DeionAlley of Time – Stay in the heart of Tainan’s quiet charmTucked away in a peaceful alley beside the historic Koxinga Shrine, Alley of Time offers a warm, minimalist retreat in the center of Tainan. Designed with white walls, wooden textures, and lush greenery, our space is a blend of simplicity and soul—perfect for travelers who want to slow down and truly live the city.Within walking distance of Chihkan Tower, the Confucius Temple, and Guohua Street, you’ll enjoy both cultural landmarks and local eats just steps away—while still enjoying the calm and quiet of our hidden corner.Whether you& #39;re here for the history, the food, or a moment of stillness, Alley of Time invites you to make memories in the flow of Tainan’s gentle rhythm.? Key Features?️ Next to Koxinga Shrine – 3-minute walk to the historic site and tranquil garden paths? Quiet alley location – Peaceful stay just minutes from city landmarks? Warm minimalist design – White walls, wooden accents, natural light?️ Local tips from hosts – Hidden gems and local shops off the tourist path? Walkable to everything – 10 mins to Chihkan Tower, Confucius Temple, Guohua Street

stays.name: PAPOA _Tainan Hotel
stays.description: PAPO’A LABS: A Breathing Poem of the CityWe were born on this land, raised in this city.Our founder studied and started his first venture in Tainan—drawing inspiration from humble alleyways and learning humility from weathered city walls. With gratitude and courage, we have returned to the place where the dream began. Through the form of hospitality, we say to Tainan: “We are home.”More Than a Hotel—A Way of Living in TainanPAPO’A LABS may look like just a hotel, but its soul is closer to a “breathing anthology of poetry.”Through design, we converse with old buildings; through service, we pass along the warmth of human connection; through stories, we weave the memory of the city into your journey.Here, you are not a passerby, but a temporary neighbor of this ancient city. Perhaps around a corner, you’ll encounter the familiar fragrance beneath the arcades; perhaps at the breakfast table, you’ll be served not only food, but also the proud rhythm of life that belongs to old Tainan.Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the WorldWe believe that passion makes places visible, and stories memorable.PAPO’A LABS chose to take root in Tainan not for romance, but because we know—when the soul of a city is preserved with care, it can walk confidently onto the global stage.That is why what we want travelers to feel is not just “a stay,” but an experience of resonating with the heartbeat of Tainan.A Touch of Humor—Because Travel Should Be EasyDon’t worry—we are not an archaeological museum, nor a library.We will make your bed with great care, but we might also slip a little note by your bedside reminding you to “take one more look at tonight’s stars.” We can lead you through centuries of culture, but even more so, we hope you leave with a smile, saying: “I’ve never experienced Tainan quite like this.”PAPO’A LABS: Rooted in Tainan, With a Heart Set on the World.We look forward to meeting you,and writing your next beautiful chapter,between tradition and innovation.

stays.name: S&E Hotel
stays.description: Wander through the roads and alleys in Tainan, the ancient capital city of Taiwan. Immerse in the splendor reflected by the historic relics and monuments A brand new world awaits you at the next turn - In Tainan, the ancient capital city of Taiwan, you can go on a tour of culture and delicacies and roam the well planned walking trails or bike paths Enjoy the gentle breeze and let it lead you into the traces of history surrounded by historic relics and artifacts. Lost in the picturesque scenery and the passing of time and savor a mind banquet of total relief and relaxation. Peace of mind should be followed by an experience of Anping delicacies, such as shrimp roll, shrimp patty and bean curd pudding, for the bodily satisfaction...""Bean Curd Pudding"" sits on a geographic location boasting a well connected and easily accessible transportation owing to its wonderful position inside Tainan City downtown. This allow guests to travel to major scenic spots with ease! The design style of modern simplicity create an all-around hotel of comfort, cleanness and friendliness Such comfortable accommodation space meets the needs of every traveler on vacation or on business away from home From the smallest space to the entire room, the hotel is designed and prepared with the utmost care Guests will be able to recover from their exhaustion, tension and pressureand enjoy an accommodation and resting space of mind equilibrium. Wireless network is provided in all rooms for you to access information and share your thoughts at any time. Our business center also provides other services, including internet access, fax and copying. Chines and Western breakfast buffet is served with well-cooked seasonal cuisines. From the sweet date with the early morning sunshine to the bike tour of the wonderful old town the infinite attractiveness of Tainan is yours to discover!

stays.name: SSS Life Hotel
stays.description: SSSlife Hotel is a Tainan hotel for petty-bourgeois girls. It is located in the city center. It is within walking distance of Tainan Railway Station, Guohua Street Snacks, Tainan Art Museum, Lin Department Store and other popular attractions. Wander in the alleys and feel Tainan’s slow work and the tastes of old Tainanese. You can eat ten kinds of special snacks if you save on renting a motorcycle or taxi.Standard hotels are too expensive, and the equipment, services and cleaning quality of the homestays are different. Youth hotels are the cheapest but they often can’t really relax and rest-a rare holiday trip. I want the kindness and comfort of the homestay, but I also want the cleanliness of the hotel. And convenient equipment, and don’t forget to plan carefully-SSSlife Hotel is born for your needs. Without the restraint of a hotel, you can feel the human touch of a hotel; the hotel is clean and safe, but we are not less.Even the single rooms are equipped with bathtubs that are rarely found in rental houses, and each room type provides bath salts and Dyson hair dryers. You can soak in the bath as much as you want. The tri-fold high-density mattress makes it easy for people to sleep well to light sleep. In the alleys of the hotel, there are Wenqing coffee shops and Japanese grocery stores. Almost all Tainan snacks are also within walking distance. Relax and simply spend an afternoon.SSSlife Hotel is also an old house in Tainan’s Centennial Alley. It was renovated by the design team. The new design meets the old elements. The whole building is made of white and wood as the main color. The compact Japanese and Western styles seem to take you into Tainan. history.Completely relax from the busy life, and deeply feel the charm of Tainan's alleys. Let the hotel no longer be just a place to sleep for a night, returning to the hotel will also become a good memory. SSSlife Hotel is looking forward to sharing a beautiful human touch with you.

stays.name: Saikaukin House
stays.description: Tainan｜Sai Kau Kin Old HouseGold in the Gutter, An Old House that Spans Three CenturiesWalking at an unhurried pace through the narrow streets of the old capital city, you turn down Xinyi Street, walking past a mixture of residences both old and new. Eventually, you stop before an old wooden door painted white with couplets handwritten on red paper framing the doorway - on the horizontal scroll above the door are the characters for Sai Kau Kin Old House. You lightly push the door open, feeling the wealth of stories it must contain, and are seemingly transported a century into the past to a beautiful bygone time.The story begins with a smelly riverSai Kau Kin (literally “The Bank of the Open Sewer”) is the name of the northernmost tributary in Wu Tiao Gang (“Five Channels Harbor”). In olden days, it was used for the storage and transportation of the city’s sewage waters, hence the rather smelly sounding name. Built in 1897, the old house of today’s visit is located on the bank of this river channel. After construction of the Tainan Canal was completed, the accumulating silt and sludge filled up the channel, at which time residents in the area began to expand their dwellings outward and upward, creating the Sai Kau Kin living environment that we see today.As you set foot in Sai Kau Kin Old House, the simple wooden construction, the bamboo and wicker furniture exhibits the classical style of life in Tainan. James, the owner of the guesthouse, chose the name Sai Kau Kin Old House in the hopes of preserving the local culture, and of giving people a place to enjoy a life of freedom and ease. The roof beams overhead, the pebble-inlaid flooring underfoot, and the red brick wall all preserve the traces of history. More than a hundred years ago, during the era of Japanese occupation, the Japanese came to Tainan to implement plans for urban renewal and tore down many old city walls and buildings. The workers from the local harbors collected these bricks dating back to the era of Dutch occupation and the Ming and Qing dynasties, using them to build their own houses.Deep conversations with an old soulThis is a house that spans three centuries, as well as James’s old family home. Over forty years ago, James’s father bought this old house to provide his parents with a place to enjoy their golden years in peace. However, his parents later moved elsewhere, after which time this old house sat vacant for over twenty years. It wasn’t until 2011 that James decided to return to live in Tainan, with the belief that, “The true value of Tainan is to be found in these old laneways, these old houses, and this culture.” Thus he set about rebuilding the old building into a guesthouse with the intention of sharing memories and stories of the past with his travelling guests. Illuminated by the warm sunshine, travelers climb the steep wooden steps, arriving at the “Ballast Room” which is decorated with collected items from James’s travels through Europe when he was a young man. “This house is like a centenarian, it actually has a soul!” Continuing on, James invites you to walk barefoot upon the wooden floorboards, which sing their creaky song with every step you take.As you climb even higher, you reach the top-floor sleeping quarters. On a peaceful afternoon, you recline on the old sofa lost in thought, and looking out across the sloping open balcony which has no enclosing walls, you see all the neighboring rooftop balconies. Turning around, you notice that behind you there is another sliding door which connects to the “Matsu Room” in the attic. Looking out from the small hatch-like window, you feel like a child again, hiding in a small corner and peering out at the scenery of the laneways below. In the tranquility of night, you close your eyes, the gentle smell of rushes accompanies you as you drift into dreams of olden days.Still, the story of an old city continuesIn the morning, with Sai Kau Kin Old House as your starting point, you begin to walk along Xinyi Street. This place is different than other cities - there are no high-rise apartment buildings, only short old single-story houses one after another. These gifts that time and history have left to the city reveal the culture and enchanting atmosphere of which the people of Tainan are so proud.Xinyi Street lies between the Matsu Building and the Jifu Temple, and so receives the protection of these two great deities. It is the kind of precious land found in legends, and the place where James was born. After growing up, he backpacked around Europe and Asia, travelling to Germany, Singapore, Hong Kong, and China, even experiencing the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Tiananmen Square incident and other significant historical events, all of which nourished him to become who he is today. Afterwards, he attended advanced courses at Tokyo College of Photography. After returning to Taiwan James and his wife first decided to return to Tainan to establish their own photography studio. After striving for more than twenty years, they happened to encounter the Foundation of Historic City Conservation and Regeneration. Deeply moved by their philosophy, it was after this time that James began to operate his guesthouse and put down roots in the local culture.Beyond the operation of his guesthouse, James also devotes his efforts to putting on all kinds of different activities pertaining to arts and culture, establishing Sai Kau Kin Old House as an arts and culture space to increase interaction and exchange within the community. Check-in to Sai Kau Kin, sip a cup of tea, savour the slow passage of time, and look forward to the memories written down by each and every traveler who comes by to visit.

stays.name: Silks Place Tainan
stays.description: Superbly positioned for both business and leisure, Silks Place Tainan is situated in the heart of this enchanting city that was once a bustling cultural capital. A mere thirty-minute drive from Tainan High Speed Rail station, we are just a stone’s throw away from Shin Kong Mitsukoshi shopping district and major historic landmarks.Timeless designs, from the suspended calligraphy brush lamps in each of the 255 guest rooms to the motif of pottery rooftop tiles in the lobby walls, gracefully reflect Tainan’s rich history of art, literature, and architecture. Without compromising on modern luxury, our hotel features a stunning outdoor swimming pool, a magnificent banquet hall, a sublime Chinese cuisine restaurant, and a Western steakhouse and teppanyaki, popular among both locals and travelers. With our junior guests in mind, our Kid’s Club offers a stimulating array of activities from story time and Xbox games to our exclusive Chinese “Six Arts”, where families can enjoy simple calligraphy exercises, bean bag toss, abacus practice, and more. Art lovers looking to soak up a splash of local culture are invited to join our guided tour of the exquisite collection of paintings, photographs and other works by local artists on display throughout Silks Place Tainan. A pioneering local author once wrote, “Tainan is the perfect place to daydream, to work, to fall in love, to get married, and to live in utter bliss.” We invite you to discover this charming city for yourself. Welcome to Silks Place Tainan!

stays.description: Hello! Welcome to the intimate contact with "Twilight Art Villa." The beauty of art comes from the experience of life. Please feel it with your delicate mind and immerse...The original building has to have over 50 years of history. The owner repaired the building without breaking the original style to keep its original wooden roof and floor format. In addition, it combines modern lighting with art, penetrating ancient history & culture. In the shadow of the curtain, we are welcoming all of the travelers who love Tainan!Located in the Sec. 3, Jinhua Rd., West Central Dist., Tainan City, Taiwan.When dusk falls, the sparse crowds become bustling during the day. There are many famous Tainan snacks on both sides of the street, welcoming travelers with a feast!At the same time, it is close to Tainan City Art Museum 1st and 2nd Hall, the Blueprint Culture & Creative Park and Shin Kong Mitsukoshi. It is only one kilometer away. You can walk to the art and enjoy the food!

stays.name: YanBen House
stays.description: The 60-square-meter room has a private living room and bathroom, as well as an outdoor space with custom-made art furniture from the Museum of Fine Arts and a famous Tatami store in Tainan, with a mattress attached to the tatami mats. It is a traditional three-story building with a patio, old houses, red brick and historical space.Located on Shen Nong Street, it looks forward to Haian Art Street, close to Guohua Street and Shui Xian Market, and continues to the cultural and creative alleyways of Zheng Xing Street, connecting to cultural monuments such as the Taiwan Museum of Art, the Museum of Literature, Chikan House and Confucius Temple, all within a 10-minute walk. More than 10 temples and 50 half-century-old stores provide an unparalleled view of Taiwanese snacks and cultural monuments.

stays.name: fairytalehouse
stays.description: In everyone’s heart, there is a child who is not growing up. The fairy tales of dreams are not easy to be realized in real life. So we build a fairy tale home, through this home, let the parents on the journey. There are also lovely babies that can have a good memory. We are located in the center of Tainan, adjacent to the Guohua Youai business district. Guohua Street, Baoan Road and Haian Road have many well-known old gourmet restaurants, such as: Jinde Spring Rolls, Fusheng Hao Wan Barley, A Village Beef Soup, Qiu Home small roll rice noodles, six thousand beef soup... etc. are all within walking distance. In addition to the well-known Guohua Youai Commercial District, Hai'an Commercial District, Baoan Road Snacks, Ximen Shin Kong Mitsukoshi Department Store and the opposite Lanshatu Cultural and Creative Park, Shennong Old Street, Confucian Temple and Fuzhong Old Street, Chihkan Tower, Lin Department Store, Garden Night Market ...They are all close to each other, which is suitable for travelers who like to eat, drink, and visit the ancient cultural capital of Tainan. It only takes 15-20 minutes to drive to Anping historic sites, Ten Drum Cultural and Creative Park, and Chimei Museum. Isn’t it very convenient? When checking in, we provide free food and scenic spots maps. A wonderful journey memory.

stays.name: j.youai.house
stays.description: J Youai House(No.592) is a building for entire place rental, which is close to Tainan Art Museum Building 2. The process was planned for two years, and now J Youai House stands silently at Youai street.The building originally looked like a Taiwanese classic townhouse. Team members from June June House met this building and regarded it as their serendipity. Being fascinated at a wonderful view from the art museum, team members start managing J Youai House after combining all of the materials and cooperating with a new ownership.J Youai House achieves a smooth balance of space through open-mindedness and compromise.Open-mindedness allows the wind, light, scenery, and even the rain to enter the space. Immerse ourselves in the space, wind, light, celestial bodies in nature, outdoor streets, people and citizens who wander around the art museum, and the amazing Mori Mountain Market…Compromise is the best way to reflect yourself on the space. We tried to scale down the size of rooms and created a big balcony that can gather people together or enjoy solitude.J Youai House is a collaborative work by the designer and team with the aim of providing travelers with a unique experience. Being open-minded and willing to compromise can lead to the new beginning of a new relationship. We would like to invite you to make yourself at home, enjoy your stay, and share your experience with us.

During the process, there were many voices and suggestions. Some suggested cutting down the trees and building a canopy, while others suggested installing iron rolling doors to make it easier to enter and exit.But the rebellious couple insisted on leaving behind the original and most beautiful appearance and the lovely iron gate. They also left behind the two big trees that even the neighbors found incredible, and grandma's jasmine flowers, especially the fragrant osmanthus flowers that filled the house.Our philosophy is that the renovation is to allow the house to breathe and receive more sunlight and air, allowing the house to breathe naturally.In order to make the indoor space more comfortable and free for people to live in, we chose to completely rebuild the old bathroom equipment, so that the people living there can have a better quality of life.During the renovation process, we found that the old British furniture that had been used for more than 50 years was still so charming. stays.name: Sian ban tian
stays.description: I am a native Tainan native, born in Houbi, the hometown of rice.Although I am very familiar with Tainan, Zuozhen is a strange place to me. In my memory, the sunrise over the sea of ​​clouds is a short-lived phenomenon that often occurs in the mountains. However, a chance encounter four years ago changed my mind. I witnessed with my own eyes that in the early morning, among the lowland forests covered with thorny bamboos, there were actually dark and flowing clouds, and the sun slowly emerged from the ridge of the Central Mountain Range. At that moment, it was so beautiful! The scenery is like a landscape splash-ink painting, with the tips of the bamboo forest outlining the layers of the sea of ​​clouds. It is like a fairyland, intoxicating...This is a deserted place, very quiet, everyone is welcome to come in and think for a while and act "bored"!I want peace for half a day. I want peace for half a day.

stays.name: CHYUAN DU SPRING RESORT
stays.description: Chyuan Du Spring Resort is not far from downtown to have fresh air and natural surroundings. It is located near Xinbeitou MRT Station ; with only two minutes walking distance. With MRT, travelers can reach almost every major tourist attraction in Taipei, whether it is to the 101 building in the center of Taipei, Tamsui, Shilin, Yangmingshan National Park, etc. And there is a large indoor parking lot to avoid the trouble of parking. The hall presents a European-style exquisite and elegant decoration, with a variety of guest rooms, 1 information center and a new European-style restaurant. The rooms are equipped with white sulfur hot springs, and guests can enjoy a private bathing space, and a variety of different bathing room types are available to meet the different preferences of guests. The hall has also obtained the "Hot Spring Seal" issued by the Taipei City Government, which is confirmed to be a safe bathing and accommodation place! In addition, a number of e-entertainment equipment are provided free of charge (all rooms are equipped with free video channels, wireless Internet access.... etc.), so that you can fully experience the romantic and fashionable Taipei hot spring trip.

stays.name: Grand View Resort Beitou
stays.description: Located in Beitou high ground, neighboring Yangmingshan National Park, overlooking the Danfeng mountains, embracing Datun Mountains, Grand View Resort Beitou enjoys "mountain, water, heaven, earth." The hotel was designed by the architect CY Lee. The building utilized wood and stone materials, supplemented with titanium metal and natural plantings, to infuse cleverly architectural concepts into the precious natural landscapes, presenting the deeply introverted, timeless, refined, extraordinary qualities ofa combination of natural and human world. Unlike other services and design of Japanese-style spa hotel, Grand View Resort Beitou emphasizes on Taiwanese-style services and the concept of making the best out of local materials to blend architectural aesthetics with accommodation, leisure, food culture, bathing enjoyment, and many other elements into every corners of the hotel, hoping to convey the beauty and charm of Taiwan and Beitou to all guests visiting the hotel, bringing travelers rich humanities and the natural flavor of the leisure space. The hotel offers a total of 66 top-level rooms, Chinese and Western restaurants, 24 hours concierge, eight private baths, open-air baths, Le Spa, and many other services. When you are in the hotel you will feel like wandering in the most beautiful vacation paradise. Each room has more than 16 pings (floor area) of private space with a great mountain view, allowing you enjoy the most comfortable leisure environment, why you are staying in your room. Chinese Cuisine and Western European Restaurants select certified local fresh ingredients, and our chefs magically prepare specialty cuisine stunning your visual and taste buds to make eating an aesthetic attitude. The hotel's bathing enjoyment planning is definitely worth tasting. The intimate space surrounded by mountains, and the warm, moist, nourishing white sulfur springs is one of the four largest white sulfur springs in the world. Grand View Resort Beitou perfectly presents you so beautiful realm to allow your body, mind, and soul to be completely returned to zero and relaxed.

stays.name: Hotel Royal Beitou
stays.description: The Hotel Royal Group’s brand vision is to create a hotel that is an amazing place to be, where unforgettable memories are created. After three years of planning a high-end health and lifestyle resort, we launched the Hotel Royal Beitou as a completely new kind of hotel, incorporating both fitness and health treatments.Hotel Royal Beitou is the only hotel in Taipei to offer a range of hotel-based and outside classes and activities. With our three core offerings—fitness, stretching and relaxation, and hydrotherapy—we use both dynamic and static exercise to revitalize your body and reinvigorate your mind.Our guiding concept is to incorporate health management in a hotel so as to build lasting health through a comprehensive service which comprises nutrition, aromatherapy, hydrotherapy, a wide range of indoor and outdoor exercise, and professional consultation. When our guests leave, they take with them a deeply planted understanding of health which opens up to them new vistas of healthy living. We hope to become known as the first choice for travelers staying in Beitou.

stays.name: Jia Bin Ger Hot Spring Resorts Hotel
stays.description: JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel is a hot spring resort with a history. It is located in Beitou, where the first hot spring resorts began. Over 70 years of soothing the weariness, the resort grew and remodeled into the modern hotel as we see now. It is one of the most comfortable and modern resort in the area.Situated in the center of Beitou near Xinbeitou MRT Station and Beitou Library, JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel is close to many attractions like Xinbeitou Park, Taiwan Folk Arts Museum, Hot Spring Museum and Beitou Geothermal Valley. It is the best place to explore and enjoy the hot spring culture.The hotel provides a variety of hot spring rooms. Each room is installed with complete hot spring facilities to guarantee the best hot spring experience. It is suitable for vacation, getaway and family.The Taipei MRT takes you straight to Beitou where only a few minute walk to JBG Hot Spring Resort Hotel. The hotel also provides parking space for personal vehicles and valet parking service.To ensure the best hot spring and accommodation experience for all guests with the finest facilities and service is what JBG Hot Spring Hotel Resort hopes to accomplish.

stays.name: Li De Bei Tou Hot Spring Hotel
stays.description: Hotel Double One, named after their address 11, Youya Rd., is a luxury hot springs hotel in Beitou District, Taipei City. The hotel consists of 3 levels above ground and a basement. Featuring in total of 19 prestigious rooms and a high quality restaurant. The hotel was designed by a famous local designer, breaking the traditional designing style used in other hotels in the area by focusing on the themes of “colors & taste” and “simplicity & romantic”. Applying to every aspects of hotel from interior decorations to furnishings. By doing so, Hotel Double One separates itself from other Beitou hot spring hotels with excellent facilities and one-of-a-kind hot springs accommodating experience. Hotel Double One ensures a unique yet luxurious hot springs accommodation like no other.Every floor within Hotel Double One offers different types of pleasure and visual sensation for guests. Visitors are welcomed with colors of “Red Roses” on the 1st floor, “Champagne Gold” colors were used to project a sophisticated and elegant atmosphere on the 2nd floor. “Aqua Blue” on the 3rd floor represents the magical hot springs accommodation experience Hotel Double has to offer while the basement is covered with “chocolate” themed colors to emphasis the sweetness of love.

stays.name: Radium-Kagaya
stays.description: The Radium Kagaya International Hotel is located in the Beitou district of Taipei City, less than a 5 minute walk from the Xinbeitou Metro Rail Transit (MRT) Station. Conveniently situated across the hotel are historic landmarks such as the Beitou Hot Spring Museum and the eco-friendly Taipei Public Library (Beitou Branch).AccommodationsThe hotel offers 90 exquisitely appointed Japanese Sukiya style guestrooms ranging in size from 13 pings to 32 pings. All guestrooms feature cypress wood or marble hot springs bathing facilities, generous living spaces, premium mattresses and luxurious down beddings for an unforgettable night’s rest. Public and Private Hot Spring Rooms The public hot-spring facility overlooks the picturesque Beitou mountainside and is equipped with indoor bathing areas, sauna and steam rooms allowing guests to experience total relaxation. 17 individual hot-spring rooms provide guests with the utmost privacy; these bath houses employ cypress wood and natural millstones as themes, displaying various different decor, and providing guests with another type of choice. The Spa by Socie (5F)Operated by Japan’s top spa “Socie”, using renowned E-SPA skin care products imported from England, employing a tranquil interior design and professional techniques and treatments, bringing you a once in a lifetime luxurious serenity.Dining (In Room)The chef serves a traditional “Kaiseki” meal comprised of numerous dishes featuring the freshest ingredients from Taiwan and Japan while employing classical cooking methods originating from the Noto region of Japan, the birthplace of the original Kagaya. Each dish and utensil has been handpicked to enable the guest to experience a truly authentic Japanese meal. Tenshou Restaurant The restaurant overlooks the lush mountains of Beitou. Aside from the Kaiseki meals, Tenshou provides authentic Japanese dishes for lunch and dinner. Tenshou also has 7 private dining rooms to cater to larger parties, family gatherings and business banquets. Yuuduki Bar (2F)The bar overlooks Beitou Park and serves an impressive collection of Japanese sakes, red & white wines, imported and local beers.Function/Conference Rooms (6F) Conference rooms are located on the sixth floor and are adorned in the traditional Japanese-style. The 6 rooms cater to small and larger groups depending on the need. The venues are equipped with complete conference facilities and meal facilities. Guests will leave with an unforgettable meeting experience.

stays.name: Fullon Hotel Taipei,Central
stays.description: Fullon Hotel (Taipei) stands in an area between Ren'ai Road and Xinyi Road, the two thoroughfares in Taipei, near Jianguo South Road Interchange. Only 10 minutes by car from Xinyi Planning District. Nearby Taipei Zhongxiao Mall (which is a bustling business, shopping and entertainment area) is also only 10 minutes drive away from the hotel. With its prime location, the hotel is the ideal choice for leisure and business travel by domestic and international travelers. Fullon Hotel (Taipei) is an international tourist hotel, the unique high ceiling design of the lobby, where potted flowers and greenery stands, reflects an amazing, fresh, bright, and elegant atmosphere. The hotel features 120 exquisite guest rooms and suites with trendy designs, secure accommodation, and high-tech facilities to cater the demand of the business and leisure travelers. Combining taste and fashion, the unparalleled window view allows Taipei 101, one of the world-class landmarks, to greet you. With international facilities, spacious and elegant rooms, all food services and well-built top club facilities, and sincere and thoughtful professional services, the hotel offers business travelers and dignitaries from around the world to be engaged in a pleasant comfortable atmosphere.

Travelers can promenade Taishun St. to feel the aroma of literature and coffee. Right side is Dongmen Commercial District. Walking into the most beautiful area in Taipei, Lishui St., to experience historical atmosphere, or surrounded by greenery in Daan Forest Park.Enjoy traveling alone. Here serves separate personal living spaces and bathroom equipment for every traveler can rest, write, and bathe when they return.As long as you know how to play, slow down and enjoy your life, welcome to Goodmore Hotel. Experience Eastern culture from opening our wooden door and have a relaxing journey with us!

stays.name: Kimpton Da An Hotel
stays.description: An Urban Sanctuary Hotel In TaipeiTucked away from the main street, and only steps away from Zhongxiao Fuxing MRT station, Kimpton Da An stands still between tradition and modernity, frenetic energy and slow pace. The walkable neighborhood has a buzzing energy as people flow in and out of the city. Each corner, turn, or block is a journey of discoveries infused with sophistication and tranquility. A definite sanctuary for laid back savvy travelers, the 129 tranquil rooms hum the melody of calm and beauty also demonstrate a designer’s piece itself. At our cozy lobby living room, start your day with the famous Morning Kickstarter or chill out during the Social Wine Hour. Embrace Taipei’s skyline at our rooftop terrace. Join our biking or hiking program to live like a local and feel the beauty of authenticity. It is here you feel a sense of belonging and the true Taiwanese hospitality.

stays.name: Nihao Cafe Hotel
stays.description: ​NiHao Café Hotel is a boutique hotel located in Taipei's Da'an District, just a 1-minute walk from Exit 1 of MRT Da'an Station. The hotel uniquely combines a city café with a design hotel, creating a green environment filled with plants, and offers authentic local cuisine alongside expertly crafted coffee.​The hotel provides a variety of room options, including double rooms, mini double rooms, twin rooms, mini twin rooms, triple rooms, and quadruple rooms. Each non-smoking room is equipped with air conditioning, a refined desk, flat-screen TV, refrigerator, and a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries. ​The on-site café operates daily from 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM, serving brunch, desserts, and beverages. The front desk is available from 8:00 AM to 09:00 PM. Additional amenities include free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, and self-service laundry facilities to cater to various traveler needs. ​Overall, NiHao Café Hotel offers an ideal accommodation choice with its convenient location, comfortable environment, and quality dining services.​

stays.name: Rido Hotel
stays.description: Taipei Rido Hotel has excellent location advantages. Sitting at the center of Taipei City's main financial district and facing towards Da'an Forest Park which is of 60 thousand ping, Taipei Rido Hotel makes you experience a brilliant view as if staying in a mansion. In addition to convenient transportation providing an easy access for conferences or meetings, the hotel is also close to the popular Yungkang Street and Din Tai Fung restaurant; you could simply visit there by walk. If you prefer visit the nearby Guanghua electronics 3C Plaza, Taipei 101 or Taipei World Trade Center, you could take a bus or taxi; it is only about 5 to 10 minutes drive. Therefore, no matter you are here for business trip, shopping or just visiting, Taipei Rido Hotel is the best accommodation choice for both international visitors and Taiwan local people. Taipei Rido Hotel provides you a comfy and warm space and makes you feel like at home. Upon entering the lobby, the vintage and priceless hanging lamp immediately gives out a European sentiments and romantic atmosphere of medieval center, adding a sense of elegant to the hotel. A series of unique and creative suites allows every guest enjoys exquisite service quality and the artistically crafted hotel architecture features while in the busy town center. Every suite in this hotel has adopted international standard fire door and fire-proving woods. Taipei Rido Hotel's fire-fighting facilities have passed the standard of Taipei City Government and have regularly report for inspection and maintenance. The most attractive part of Taipei Rido Hotel is not only for the beautiful landscape and the aesthetic style, but also for the majestic managing manner and thoughtful considerations, meeting the expectations of every guest.

stays.name: SWIIO HOTEL DAAN
stays.description: SWIIO regards an elegant and high quality life as the most important goal, and creating a comfortable living space is the premise for this motto. Thus they have created a residence for travelers who value exclusive tastes. Designer Fang Xu Zhung (Joe Fang) is the chief designer in charge of the brand vision for the hotel. Guo Zhida is responsible for the interior design and is known for his finesse in film art design. The staff uniform is designed by plain-me, a brand of menswear design known for its matching pieces. The concept of the geometrically shaped white building façade is the brainchild of Tung Hung-Lin CEO (CEO Anderson Tung). The exterior wall is coated with waterproof paint of German STO and serves as an eye-catching beacon of style amongst a sea of densely packed gray buildings. The pure white luster emanating from the building itself tells a story and creates a thought of travel, independent of the surrounding space. We hope all travelers who cross our doorstep feels compelled to stay once again.

stays.name: Bayman Hotel
stays.description: Inherited from Taipei Prefecture Capital North Gate, Beimen Cheng-En Gate, also known as the ancient entrance to Taipei City, this old famous hotel opened at Beimen used to receive tourists from around the world; after being renovated and redecorated, “Bayman Hotel” is presented with a brand new image. Engraved with the classical embroidery of Kun Ming Hall, its historical culture is integrated with visual creativity, presenting the ancient elegance of Tataocheng with the latest virtual and augmented reality technology of AR and VR. All introduced into the hotel, a new life was given, composing a new page during the shifting of the generations!Located at Datong District in Taipei City, Bayman Hotel is within the scope of MRT, Taiwan Railways and Taiwan High Speed Rail, accessible in all senses. In the future when the airport MRT is constructed, it will also provide the travelers a full range of transportation options. Closed to Ningxia Night Market, rear station commercial district, Zhongshan Square and Q Sqaure, one can experience the life of a modern Taipei resident, enjoying delicacies and shopping fun. The areas provided by Museum of Contemporary Art and Huashan 1914 Creative Park allow everyone to be immersed in the otherworldly artistic and cultural life. Thus, the dynamic life in Beimen provides the travelers the best option for accommodation!

stays.name: Bee House Hotel
stays.description: Bee House(Taipei Station Branch ) is a brand new chic boutique hotel situated in the Taipei rear station shopping district. Jointly created by Cosmos Hotel Group and Taipei Garden Hotel, the hotel’s name is derived from the concept of bees returning home to offer each traveler a natural, minimalistic and fashionable accommodation space. Furthermore, the guests will be treated to a memorable accommodation experience through the relaxing atmosphere and comprehensive, thoughtful service.(Google Map) The brand and concept is inspired by the flower garden to portray the image of bees diligently collecting pollen, symbolizing industriousness and vitality, just like enthusiastic travelers from all over the world; although they are busy expanding their businesses or traveling everywhere, they must ultimately come home. As a brand new label, Bee House welcomes travelers worldwide to come back to the warmth of home through Scandinavian minimalism, comfort, cozy ambiance and thoughtful services. The overall spatial design employs warm, contrasting hues with a touch of vibrant colors to present a sense of liveliness and playfulness. In the lobby, the wood grain and vacant spaces create an aura of warmth and leisure through the ingenious lighting arrangement. Such ingenuities are abundant inside and outside the hotel. For example, the beehive’s hexagonal structure is used as the source of visual planning to fully embody express the concept and imagery of the Bee House. The comfortable space is matched with a comfortable recreational space, classic sofa and wooden furniture to create the refreshing, natural and unadulterated ambiance that has warmed the hearts of many a traveler! Bee House(Taipei Station Branch ) has six stories and 32 well appointed guestrooms with natural, rustic elements as well as sunshine-like radiance and dazzling colors to create painting-like vibrant colors. The unique and cleverly executed home décor will bring surprise and a smile on your face. At the same time, the Garden Café on the first floor ,From the generous wood accents of its interior, to the elegantly simple chandeliers, Garden Café embodies the sophistication of the Scandinavian style café. Enjoy a hand crafted specialty coffee or espresso masterpiece in our specially commissioned handmade mugs and cups, and you will feel the warmth of every sip right down to your heart and soul. Come in and be prepared to be greeted with the pleasant aromas of flower, fruit, tea and coffee, and thoroughly enjoy your precious moment of peace and comfort in the relaxed warmth of Garden Café. The Bakery serves mainly exquisite, European-style desserts and breads to satisfy the palate of our guests. Furthermore, in order to cater to our guests’ every need, we have created Internet services in the lobby together with other facilities such as launderette, play room, and self-help snack bar. We would like to provide you a comfortable accommodation and dining environment. Just like coming home, travelers will feel total relaxation of the body, mind and spirit.

stays.name: Palais De Chine Hotel Taipei
stays.description: Located in western Taipei, Palais de Chine Hotel offers exquisite, compact and modern space and services to present urban oasis experience to business persons and tourists from around the world, and features a comfortable environment full of luxury aesthetic expression, as well as personalized meticulous, caring services. Combining top delicacies (C& #39;est Bon), luxury accommodations (C& #39;est Magnifique), and considerate "one-stop service" (C& #39;est Unique), Palais de Chine Hotel perfectly reproduces China and Paris, the two separated historic cultural centers of the world, to create a new unrivaled hotel aesthetic. Palais de Chine Hotel renders the luxury aesthetic of a comfort space in French neoclassical, and uses a space full of character and an extensive art collection and imported furniture to reflect the noble qualities as well as the depth of European culture. The Executive Floors Sceau Imperial located on the 14th to the 16th floors offers great views and top quality service. Palais de Chine Hotel combines functionality with elegant design-based, European-style palace like space, equipped with the latest audiovisual equipment and design ingenuity, whether for business or sightseeing, Palais de Chine Hotel offers a comfortable and efficient environment. Palais de Chine Hotel Taipei is positioned as a world-class sophisticated business hotel, with rich artistic European-style design and furniture, supplemented by Chinese style elements, and offers 286 comfortable guest rooms, including 97 single rooms, 175 double rooms, 12 deluxe suites. In addition, a modern yet comfortable Vice Presidential Suite La Rose, and a luxurious Presidential Suite Charles V. Executive Floors Sceau Imperial are located on the 14th to 16th floors. Hostel Address: No. 3, Section 1, Chengde Road, Datong Dist.,Taipei, Taiwan (Palais de Chine Hotel, Taipei occupies ranging from the 1st ground floor to the 3rd underground floor, and from the 5th ground floor to the 17th ground floor.)

stays.name: Santos Hotel
stays.description: Santos Hotel, since its inauguration in 1979, has always adhered to offering "customer-oriented" services that is considerate to every guests, such as modern elegant suites of generous style and hidden high-tech security equipment. So, over the years, whether it is for a business trip or for an international tourism and travel, Santos Hotel has always been popular in international leisure travelers and global business elites of all ages from Europe, America, and Japan. Transportation surrounding the hotel is convenient and accessible. Minquan West Road MRT Station, Taipei Main Station, and many bus networks are within easy reach. Whether sightseeing trip or business trip, it is fun and convenient. The first two recommended attractions in the vicinity of the hotel are Taipei Fine Arts Museum and Taipei Confucius Temple, where you can find not only a wealth of artistic life, humanistic experiences, but also the cultural representatives of Taipei since time immemorial.

stays.name: Forward Hotel Taipei-Nangang Branch
stays.description: After the opening of the Songjiang branch, Forward Group opened Banqiao Forward Hotel, Grand Forward Hotel, Fu Li Hotel, Xinzhuang Hotel Purity, and after a year of remodeling and renovation, the Forward Hotel Taipei in Nangang, which became Nangang Business Park’s top business hotel. The simple European architecture brings a relaxing, romantic atmosphere to Nangang Business Park. Forward Hotel Taipei wishes to convey an impression of comfort and cleanliness, from elegant white decorations to modern, fashionable European design. Northern European window design allows for great natural lighting and creates a warm atmosphere, and it was our hope to provide visitors with the most warm and comfortable living environment when opening the new Forward Hotel Taipei in Nangang. The building features European architecture, a blue-white color theme, and trendy line-style exterior. It’s located on Sanchong Road in Nangang, next to Nangang Business Park and a 5 minute walk from Taipei World Trade Center Nangang Exhibition Hall. In front are the Bannan and Wenhu MRT lines, about a 5 minute walk away, and transportation is quite convenient with nearby roads including the Huandong Expressway and National Highway 1 and 3. Elegant, tasteful design and an exotic style bring a romantic atmosphere to Nangang Business Park. The hotel’s 66 rooms come with 32-inch liquid crystal TVs, free wireless Internet service, and the NHK channel to keep visitors up to date with the latest news and information. Fire-proof building materials and smoke detectors provide our elegant, comfortable rooms with a sense of security. For the convenience of business travelers, computer, Internet, mail, and fax services are available 24 hours a day in the main lobby.

stays.name: GRAND HILAI TAIPEI
stays.description: The Grand Hilai Taipei stands at a height of 26 floors with 4 underground levels and nearly 900 parking spaces.Inheriting the spirit of “Grand Hilai-style Hospitality and Heartwarming Services,” the hotel holds dual certificationsfrom the Les Clefs d’Or (Golden Keys) and the British Butler Guild (UKBG), aligning it with the luxury experience of international five-star accommodations. The hotel offers 425 exquisite guest rooms, including luxurious suites with panoramic views of Greater Taipei. Room sizes range from 43sqm to 528sqm. The well-appointed rooms feature a sleek and minimalist mid-century modern design with a grayscale color palette, complemented by expansive floor-to-ceiling glass, offering breathtaking views of Nangang District, Keelung River, Taipei skyline, as well as charming outdoor venues and an infinity pool.

stays.name: The Place Taipei
stays.description: "The Place", is a brand crafted with style under the Hotel Royal Group. The name of "the Place" stresses deep link to local culture where the hotel locates, and insists the spirit of "Fun, Fusion, Fashion". The Place first opened in Tainan in 2014, then the Place Yilan, the Place Taichung were born. In 2019, the Place officially opens in Taipei.Design team from Mecanoo architecten in Holland was appointed on a project basis for the interior design of the hotel. The team planned for 179 chic and simple rooms, the public art space, meeting rooms and specialty restaurants. The team uses ports, red bricks, tea and other historical and pictorial elements in the hotel to present different periods of Nangang.The exterior and lighting of the hotel building are designed by internationally famous C.Y. Lee and James Yuan. The façade is streamlined to enrich the silhouette of skyline, adding to local features of the building, and stressing the importance of being the center of transportation; the unique, innovative and moving lighting at night is the first system to operate by new type of chip with WIFI, together creating a very distinctive landmark in Nangang.

stays.name: Capella Taipei
stays.description: Capella Taipei is a transcendent blend of contemporary elegance with timeless sophistication in the heart of Taiwan’s dynamic capital. Nestled in the vibrant Songshan district, Capella Taipei fuses tradition with a modern-day narrative of the city, capturing André Fu’s personal interpretation with a “modern mansion” concept. 86 exquisitely crafted rooms and suites offer sweeping views of the city skyline, highlighting the Taipei 101 landmark and surrounding mountains, while culinary excellence abounds with five dining venues and a tri-level destination bar. Capella Wellness offers holistic treatments for those seeking rejuvenation, and the signature Living Room, where Capella Culturists curate personalised experiences, rounds out this urban retreat—a haven designed to indulge and inspire

stays.name: Delight Hotel
stays.description: Taipei’s Delight Hotel sits in the heart of the city, near the Nanjing and Dunhua commercial districts, as well as being close to the Taipei Arena, the Interchange Association, Chang Gung Memorial Hospital, and several major department stores. Just a two minute walk from Nanjing East Road Metro Station, from Delight Hotel you can quickly reach Taipei Songshan Airport, Jiannan Rd. Station Miramar Entertainment Park, and Taipei World Trade Center Nangang Exbition Hall. heading north on the Wenhu Line; Taipei Zoo and the Maokong Gondola south along the same line; Taipei Main Station, Ximending, and Banqiao to the west along the Bannan Line; and National Dr. Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, City Hall, and the Zhongxiao-Fuxing commercial district heading east. With its convenient location, Delight Hotel offers the best opportunities for its honored guests. Whether you want to visit a park, attend an exhibition, or catch a concert, you can rely on Delight Hotel to offer an oasis of tranquility in the bustling city. Recently renovated, the hotel provides 32-inch to 42-inch LED televisions in every room, all housed in a funky, fashionable Asian aesthetic. With ISO 9001 certification from ANAB as well as Taiwanese government certification, Delight Hotel offers high quality bilingual service in a clean, hygienic environment. Delight Hotel is committed to providing the best, most professional service all its honored guests.

stays.name: Golden Garden Hotel
stays.description: Along with the development of the new commercial area, Golden Garden Hotel has gone from a small business hotel to a new layout. Located on Sec.4, Bade Road, it is nearby Living Mall, Taipei 101, Taipei World Trade Center, Shin Kong Commercial Area, Civic Boulevard, and the elevated highway. With 51 rooms, Golden Garden Hotel has officially surpassed the common image of Taipei hotels and is developing into an “exquisite business and tourist hotel” to meet the needs of business travelers, tourists, shoppers, and short-term residents. Golden Garden Hotel is constantly innovating in order to keep up with the development of the commercial area. Renovated and redecorated at the beginning of last year, the building’s facilities and materials of the rooms were planned based on the rarer tourist hotel style of a double entrance hall, therefore aspects such as living comfortability and security were examined and assessed. Since reopening, the hotel has been well-received by business people in the area. Golden Garden Hotel’s features: An exquisite business hotel convenient for conducting business, travel, shopping, or recreation. 51 rooms provide customers with a variety of choices, as well as a serene garden in the heart of the city. We’re committed to friendly service, making this your home away from home. With the poetics of space and a home ideal as our service mission, customers feel at home, and Golden Garden Hotel aims to be not only to provide accommodation but also be a place where memories are born.

stays.name: ILLUME TAIPEI
stays.description: Nestled in the heart of Taipei City, ILLUME TAIPEI is ideally located on the corner of Nanjing East and Dunhua North Road, a lush green main artery with verdant trees on both sides. Facing the Taipei Arena and next to two MRT stations - Taipei Arena, and Nanjing-Fuxing Station – the hotel is just a mile down the road from Taipei Songshan Airport. With the Xinyi Shopping District and Taipei 101 Building only 3km away, the hotel is a super-convenient choice for business and leisure travelers to experience affordable, down-to-earth luxury.ILLUME TAIPEI boasts a diverse collection of guest rooms and suites. Our new well-appointed guest rooms offer the very best in comfort and privacy, while providing a peaceful retreat in which to relax and unwind throughout your stay. The well-equipped health club and outdoor swimming pool allow the traveler to enjoy a quiet, relaxing experience within the metropolis.The hotel features 3 restaurants, offering Chinese cuisine, buffet and snacks. There are pillar-less banquet venues with elevated ceilings on the 2F and 5F floors of the hotel, as well as 11 independent, partitioned VIP rooms, convention centers and banquet venues that can accommodate up to 1,000 guests. Thus the hotel is suitable for organizing various large international events, weddings, events, meetings and seminars.

In addition to the extensive artworks displayed in the hotel, various art exhibitions will be held from time to time for providing artists with more exhibition opportunities and allowing guests to stay in the hotel and enjoy the art of cleansing the soul.

stays.description: Well situated in the Wanhua District district of Taipei, Comma Boutique Hotel is located a 7-minute walk from The Red House, 600 yards from MRT Ximen Station and a 14-minute walk from Presidential Office Building. The property is close to several well-known attractions, a 15-minute walk from Qingshan Temple, 0.9 miles from Bopiliao Old Street and 1.1 miles from Mengjia Longshan Temple. The property has a 24-hour front desk, airport transportation, a shared lounge and free WiFi throughout the property.Complete with a private bathroom equipped with a shower and free toiletries, all rooms at the hotel have a flat-screen TV and air conditioning, and some rooms also offer a terrace. At Comma Boutique Hotel all rooms have bed linen and towels.Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Taipei Zhongshan Hall, Huaxi Street Tourist Night Market and Taipei Main Station. The nearest airport is Taipei Songshan Airport, 3.7 miles from Comma Boutique Hotel.

stays.name: Caesar Metro Hotel
stays.description: Located in the heart of Taipei west district, Caesar Metro Taipei, Twin Towers of the new Taipei landmark, possesses the convenient location to easily access to the city's must-see destinations. The hotel is adjacent to WanHua Railway Station, and only three minutes away from MRT Longshan Temple Station on foot. The main transportation city point, Taipei Railway Station is just 2 MRT stops away and Ximending shopping area is only one stop away. A five-minute walk to the famous Longshan Temple is easy accessible and Hwahsi Tourist Night Market and Bopiliao Old Street are both 500 meters away only. All 745 newly designed rooms and suites enjoy the stunning city views, and all furnished with free Wi-Fi internet access, washlet, separate bathroom and TV Satellites. Caesar Metro Taipei ensures an unbeatable value and tourism experiences.The hotel provides a superb range of recreation and leisure facilities, such as fitness center, outdoor pool and playroom. There are 3 unique restaurants and a bar to serve Chinese and Western cuisines, and 7 meter-high ceiling ballrooms provide the best banquet and meeting venues. The hotel offers variety of services, including free car parking, 24-hour Front Desk with multi-language speaking staff, luggage storage, foreign currency exchange and tour information, Caesar Metro Taipei is an ideal accommodation for travelers who are seeking for fun, charm, comfort and convenience experiences in Taipei.

stays.name: Hotel Riverview Taipei
stays.description: Embracing the elegance of Mt. Guanyin and grasping the magnificence of the view of the Danshui River, Hotel Riverview Taipei provides you with the most agreeable and pleasant dining and accommodation environment in gorgeous natural scenery. Located between the mountain and the river, Hotel Riverview Taipei is never away from the city. Coming with the modern urban appearance of Ximen and the traditional essence of Wanhua and Longshan, Hotel Riverview Taipei invites you to enjoy the homelike feelings and our efficient and thoughtful services supported by the hospitality virtue in Chinese culture. Tranquil and warm, putting the customer first is the pride of Hotel Riverview Taipei. Whether it is comfortable accommodation, exquisite delicacies, the boundless view, or heart-touching services, they can always help you forget about the tense modern life and enjoy the ecstasy of leisure. With landscaping planned by celebrated designers, a full house of genuine antiques, and the graceful decorations incorporating the essence of Zen with European elegance, we redefine the feeling of home. In the elegant and comfortable atmosphere, your fatigue from travel is alleviated.

stays.name: Inn Cube (Ximen)
stays.description: Inn Cube Ximen is a hotel located in Ximending, Taipei City. It is inspired by the early Japanese capsule hotels, capturing their ingenuity in making good use of space, but improving their shortcomings of poor sound insulation and lack of privacy. It hopes to break the traditional hotel pattern in Taiwan and create a new type of accommodation suitable for Taiwan& #39;s metropolises, meeting the needs of travelers who want to save money while maintaining a taste for accommodation. The Ximen Branch is close to the Ximen MRT Station and is surrounded by numerous places to eat, drink and have fun. It is the best choice for you to experience the wonderful entertainment life in Ximending. It also has rooms for 3 to 4 people, as well as facilities such as tanning machines and red light machines, so that you can enjoy the fun of light therapy during your trip~~~

Ximen Shopping Area which contains various popular elements is the consuming paradise in young people’s mind, but also attracting many domestic and foreign tourists. If you are a backpacker, the convenient transportation and nearby shopping area make MEI LODGE your top selection. It only takes about 3 minutes on foot from Ximen to our lodge if you take MRT Bannan Line at Taipei Main Station. Also you can transfer to the north Taiwan or South Taiwan by TRA or HSR from Taipei Main Station.

stays.name: Taipei City Hostel
stays.description: TW I is located next to the popular yet sophisticated walking path in XiMenDing. There are myriad stores, shops, movietheaters, diverse array of cuisines, distinctive local delicacies to satisfyand impress both domestic and foreign visitors. One can also find traces ofprehistoric buildings recalling the era of 100 years ago leaving you with abreathtaking sight. MRT Ximen Station is only approximately one minutewalking distance, Airport Bus Stop is approximately five minutes walkingdistance and Taipei Main Station is approximately 5 minutes by car. All of thisallows you to get the most exciting venues of Taipei in the shortest time. TW I was originally a prehistoric ancient building, renovated in 2010 to a baroque style appearance which boldly contrasts with the city’s plush and modernism. TW Hostel I ’s ambience istranquil with minimal décor; it is a place where you can relax and soak in natural elegance. We provide 24 hour security control with monitoring system, travel information area, duvet covers, spacious basin, free high-speed internet, touch screen computers, emergency telephone, lockers, kitchen, self-operated laundry area, hot showers, and most importantly, attentive service to give you maximum convenience just as if at home. With the most affordable price, we provide you with excellent service in which backpackers from all over the world can experience this extraordinary cultural difference.

stays.name: Tomorrow Hotel
stays.description: Conveniently in Taipei City, Tomorrow Hotel is within a 3-minute walk from Ximen MRT Station and the popular Ximending shopping district. It has modern rooms and provides free Wi-Fi access throughout the property. The hotel is just a 15-minute walk to the well-known Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall. Taipei Train Station and Taipei Songshan Airport are a 20-minute drive away, and Taoyuan International Airport is accessible with a 40-minute drive. Fitted with hardwood floors, air-conditioned rooms include a desk, a flat-screen TV and an electric kettle with complimentary tea-making facilities. The attached bathroom includes towels, shower, hairdryer and free toiletries. Available round-the-clock, the friendly staff at Tomorrow Hotel can assist guests with fax/photocopying and concierge services. Ticketing, sightseeing and travel arrangements can also be made at the tour desk. At Tomorrow Hotel, guests are served with daily buffet breakfast at the common dining area. Alternatively, a variety of restaurants and food stalls offering local dishes are available within a 5-minute walk away.

stays.name: Jing Mei Hotel
stays.description: Jingmei Hotel is one of the licensed excellent hotels in the Health Self-Management announcement made by the Taipei City Government's Department of Health. Our room rate is inexpensive and we are within walking distance from the Ministry of Examination (Examination Yuan and Hujiang High School). During exam period, many students would make room reservations with us. Across from our hotel is the famous Jingmei Night Market. Restaurants, convenience stores, 7-Eleven and library are all close by and take less than a minute to get to. Some of the nearby popular toursim attractions are Maokong Gondola, Zhinan Tea Road, Qinshan Trail, Zhinan Temple, Xianji Yan Qinshan Trail, Mushan Maokong Tea Garden and Mushan Zoo (Taipei Zoo). Convenient Transportation: There are several buses you can take to get to our hotel from the Taipei Station. You can also take the subway - Xindian line to Jingmei Station (about 15 minutes) - and exit at No. 1 exit, then walk for 2 minutes. Our hotel is very convenient for students who have to take exams. ~ Jingmei Hotel sincerely wish you will stay with us on your next visit ~

stays.name: Le Meridien Taipei
stays.description: Le Méridien Hotels, renowned worldwide for their deep connection to culture and art, trace their origins to the fashion capital—Paris. With a forward-thinking and trendsetting essence, Le Méridien not only provides guests with a flawless stay but also offers an inspiring journey of effortless exploration.Officially opened on December 3, 2010, Le Méridien Taipei is located in the heart of Taipei’s fashion and arts district—Xinyi. Rooted in the curatorial concept of contemporary art, the hotel embraces the theme of "light and shadow," seamlessly integrating art into every corner accessible to guests. This non-traditional approach fosters direct interaction between guests and artistic expression, transforming the hotel into a dynamic gallery space. The curated collection features nearly 700 works and installations by contemporary artists from Taiwan, China, Japan, Korea, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Belgium, spanning various mediums and forms. Through these visionary artworks, guests are invited to engage their senses and ignite their creative thinking.Designed with a modern and minimalist architectural aesthetic, the hotel meticulously crafts 160 guestrooms and suites, offering six distinct room types with lofty ceilings. Each room is thoughtfully furnished with the Sealy bed, a 60-inch flat-screen TV, an immersive surround sound system, high-speed internet, a multimedia hub, and an illy espresso machine, creating a seamless blend of comfort and functionality for both work and relaxation.The bathroom design exudes refined sophistication, featuring a rainforest shower, a bidet toilet, and premium large-sized amenities from the American brand MALIN+GOETZ, harmonizing sustainability with luxury. Additionally, most room types include an independent bathtub, set within a spacious and elegantly designed bathroom, offering an indulgent and immersive bathing experience—transforming each stay into an unforgettable journey of refined comfort.Le Méridien Taipei brings together a diverse array of dining experiences, crafted with meticulous attention to detail to offer the ultimate gastronomic indulgence. My Humble House Restaurant showcases the exquisite artistry of classic Cantonese cuisine, presenting refined and masterfully prepared gourmet delights. Latest Recipe curates global delicacies, offering freshly made-to-order creative dishes that captivate the palate with boundless surprises. Meanwhile, Latitude 25 Lobby Bar harmonizes the cultural essence of illy® coffee with an exclusive selection of fine wines coveted by connoisseurs worldwide, creating an unparalleled ambiance for relaxation and refinement.In 2024, the hotel unveiled two new in-house dining concepts. Drip & Dough offers a tranquil ambiance with warm wooden tones and a contemporary artistic flair, featuring hand-brewed coffee from Cupping Room, a Hong Kong-based champion roastery, paired with exquisite pastries and light bites—inviting travelers to immerse themselves in a leisurely, sensory journey. TIPSY Sparrow, a collaboration between a Michelin-starred chef and an award-winning mixologist, reinterprets classic cuisine through a modern lens, creating a social dining experience inspired by French and American flavors. The bar also introduces an exclusive selection of cocktails infused with the rich essence of Taiwanese tea, delivering a uniquely sophisticated and innovative tasting experience.

stays.name: CityInn Hotel Plus Fuxing N. Rd. Branch
stays.description: Our 120-room CityInn Fuxing North has distinguished itself from other CityInn hotels that embrace the vivid tone. We have invited architecture crew from Japan to carry out the work of architectural concrete as its façade, and we have sought interpretations for remarkable Oriental Zen from Jun-Liang Chen, the country’s ablest curator, for the interior. The fresh and simple design here merges uninhibitedness and mellowness; travellers will have a comfortable rest and experience tranquility in the bustle of the city at its best. This is where you could collect yourself at the end of the day. Neighboring Taipei Songshan Airport and Neihu Technology Park, CityInn Fuxing North is only a two-minute walk from MRT Zhongshan Junior High School. All the famous sites in Taipei City are easily accessible by MRT here, and you will find all sorts of local cuisines at your choice on Jinzhou Street nearby; if you would like to experience the cultural atmosphere, you could take a walk to Minsheng Community to visit the characteristic coffee shops and creative design shops. The perfect location of CityInn Fuxing North not only suffices the convenient transportation needed for business and travel, but also meets the need of in-depth travel in Taipei City. With the energy and friendly smiles brought by our passionate receptionists, along with ample amenities, we offer great service like CityInn hotels always do. We aim to make a fashionable stay at an affordable price for every guest, and to make all our guests feel at home.

stays.name: Dear Hotel
stays.description: Dear Hotel is proud to receive the Excellent Hotel Award from the Taipei City Government for being a safe, quiet and clean hotel. The Tourism Bureau rated our hotel as a two-star hotel, the highest honor for hotels without a restaurant. Dear Hotel is located on No. 62 Changchun Road, 8th Fl., Taipei. It was legally established on October 2003, and was a member of the Hotel Association since then. Our business philosophy is to strive for perfection, treat our guests cordially and provide a clean and comfortable environment. Our hotel is a boutique business and leisure hotel. The spacious guestrooms are decorated in different styles - Japanese, Southeast Asian, European and American. The interior is designed by a famous interior designer, and only the best quality building materials were used. Our facilities and services include: dehumidifier in every room, 24-hour free internet access, clean and pleasant bathroom and comfortable jacuzzi tub. After a busy and fun day of travels, or a long day of business meetings, you will be able to fully relax and enjoy yourself in our hotel. Our target clients are business people and couples. We aim to satisfy your various needs and requirements, and strive for perfection or even exceed your expectation. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, Dear Hotel is your best choice. Your patronage is our honor. We sincerely wish that you will visit us and enjoy our excellent service.

stays.name: Evergreen Laurel Hotel (Taipei)
stays.description: Evergreen Laurel Hotel (Taipei) is a luxury yacht-themed 5-star hotel, stationed in the capitol like a great ship. The area was once the headquarters of the Evergreen Marine Corporation, and the hotel is now situated in the financial and economic center of Taiwan, frequented by politicians, business leaders, and celebrities. Come for a stay and plan your grand strategy for seizing economic opportunity. The inside of the building is filled with ocean-themed designs and a variety of ship models and valuable items, including oars, door handles, anchors and ornamental borders on the walls, a wave-shaped ceiling, 19th century paintings of the River Thames, and Swarovski crystal decorations across the ceiling, creating the feeling of riding a luxurious yacht across the wide ocean. Looking out at the sky, you can feel Evergreen Laurel Hotel’s deep connection to the sea. 95 spacious, comfortable, luxurious suites and rooms are designed and decorated at luxury yacht scale, featuring Italian nationally-acclaimed Dubini furniture, 24K gilded wash basins handmade by Dutch masters, Japanese-style bidet toilets, supersonic massage tubs, triple layer sound-proof glass, special service buttons, all-in-one printers, 42-inch TVs, and wireless communication systems. The hotel includes the Garden Hall, serving a variety of fine foods and beverages, the coffee shop and Evergreen Passage, and another large hall providing diners with a chance to enjoy Western and Eastern cuisine. Famous chefs prepare delicious, fragrant, colorful dishes, giving diners a taste of their expertise; this exquisite cuisine is not to be missed. Recreational facilities include a fitness center and spa, another serene paradise to relax your mind and body. Website: http://www.evergreen-hotels.com/branch/taipei

stays.name: GRAND VICTORIA HOTEL
stays.description: Grand Victoria Hotel, a new nobility classical fashion hotel, features Victorian architectural style from 19th-century England. Located next to Jiannan Road MRT Station, it’s the only 5-star hotel in Dazhi, Neihu. The hotel’s diverse style features classical architecture, an English clock tower, gradually transforming LED lights, English-style outdoor garden, sky spa, and poolside garden. Convenient transportation: Nearby attractions include the Neihu Technology Park, Taipei World Trade Center, Xizhi and Nangang Industrial Area, Shilin Night Market, East District Commercial Area, National Palace Museum, Revolutionary Martyrs’ Shrine, and Miramar Entertainment Park. We’re a 35 minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport and 15 minutes (or 2 MRT stops and a 3 minute walk) from Taipei Songshan Airport. Rooms: Grand Victoria Hotel offers 96 rooms, including 90 rooms and 6 suites. Elegant, fashionable rooms come with large French windows, great for natural lighting, as well as high-quality imported designer furniture, including chairs from Philippe Starck and Louis Ghost Armchair and Melampo lights from Artemide. An experience of luxury. Bathrooms come with high-class fixtures such as walk-in showers, walls and floors of snow-white silver fox marble from Greece, Dornbracht faucets handmade in Germany, and Villeroy and Boch installations. The 9th and 10th floor feature nobility rooms, elite business rooms, and Grand Victoria suites, all equipped with 40-inch SONY Bravia liquid crystal TVs, German handicraft Villeroy and Boch bidet toilets, illy coffee machines, and L’Occitane bath products, giving customers the most honored and comfortable experiene in our rooms of extraordinary taste. Food and beverages: We provide unique Chinese and Western-style banquets. The Oriental cuisine restaurant team is led by He Qinghui, an experienced chef known as the “king of Cantonese cuisine,” and serves up authentic Chinese banquets and meals. Deng Youkui, known as the “steak master,” is the consultant for our No. 168 Steak Restaurant, which in 2011 won the Win Spectator award (US), officially marking it as a international-class restaurant. In August 2011, we worked with Igor Macchia, a chef from the Michelin-starred Italian restaurant La Credenza, to open La Festa Italian restaurant, Taiwan’s first Michelin-starred restaurant in a 5-star hotel. Here, lovers of fine food can enjoy a variety of choices of exceptional quality. stays.name: HOTEL INDIGO TAIPEI NORTH
stays.description: A century ago, standing at Keelung riverside, overviewing the sight of smoke-filled air from chimneys of brick kiln factories in the area surrounding Dazhi Bridge. Ever since the time of Japanese Occupation, Dazhi has been recognized as the gathering place for numerous brick kiln factories. As brick kiln masters pick up every piece of meticulously crafted bricks, branded with the T.R logo (T.R represents “Taiwan Renga”—quality bricks that are produced by Taiwan Renga Stock Corporation), the entire process serves as a reminder of the changes and glorious past of Dazhi. Inheriting the spirit of persistence from the kiln masters, Hotel Indigo Taipei North sparing no effort for five years with a careful selection of 520,000 handmade bricks, methodically constructed a building which overlooks Dazhi in its entirety. Bring a new aspect of the hotel construction, through its stylized design, historical concepts and beautiful paintings, reappears once again in the hotel spaces, completely imprinted Dazhi’s wonderful past.

stays.name: Hotel Cozzi Mingsheng Taipei
stays.description: The first hotel brand under Cathay Hospitality Management, HOTEL COZZI understands the lifestyles and traveling needs of young and mature travelers in the country and from abroad. It aims to create a brand new and fitting accommodation experience for them. The hotel emphasis on “cozy accommodation experience” is an unprecedented initiative in the hotel industry in Taiwan. Through appropriate service that is friendly and yet subtle, the spirit of branding is externalized from within, subsequently upgraded the positioning and standard of local chain hotels.Located in the heart of the city with accessible transportation, HOTEL COZZI is ideally affable in hope to enhance the traveling experience of every guest, and ensure that they feel unwound and relaxed. The hotel outlined its services and equipments around its motto “Unwind, Relax”, and offers a variety of signature COZZI experience and tailored services, including, comfortable beds in every room, 3C products friendly environment, fast payment service, and a house guest exclusive dining area that offers nutritionally balanced Colorful Sunshine Breakfast and around the clock snacks..Aiming for guests to unwind and relax, the service at HOTEL COZZI is informal, relaxed but at the same time offers warmth and friendliness that are lacking in big hotels. Whether you are a business traveler who has been out making business calls, or a leisure traveler exploring the city for a whole day, HOTEL COZZI offers a cozy environment to let down their hair and relax.

stays.name: Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei
stays.description: Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei is an international chain hotel managed by Nikko Hotels International that operates under Okura Nikko Hotel Management Company Limited.The hotel is located on Chung Shan North Road, in the heart of Taipei's commercial district, which is suitable for both business and leisure travelers. It is a 45-minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport, a 15-minute drive from Taipei SongShan Airport , and a 3-minute walk from MRT Chung Shan Station.The hotel is a 12-storey structure with 3 basement levels. There are 202 exquisite guest rooms and suites, all furnished with Wi-Fi internet and shower toilet. The hotel was remodeled by Kume Sekkei, a leading Japanese design company. The poised, off-white base tone is designed to elicit a tranquil air and homely comfort. The fusion of modernistic European architecture and unique oriental ambience, as well as urban convenience and exquisite Japanese-style hospitality has earned high international reputation.There are three dining establishments on premise: all-day dining restaurant "Le Café", Japanese restaurant "Nakayama", and Cantonese restaurant "Ming Court". A bakery, Royal VIP Lounge, two meeting rooms, and other facilities are also available.With its top-notch facilities and services, Hotel Royal-Nikko Taipei has received five-star certification awarded by Taiwan Tourism Bureau.

stays.name: Humble Boutique Hotel
stays.description: As the private-label brand of My Humble House Group, Humble Boutique Hotel offers experience from the heart, allowing guests to travel the neighborhood through the colorful alleyways and share the urban life. The hotel will become a focus of the community and create an oasis for the body and mind of the city traveler.My Humble House occupies the first to the tenth floors of a vertical co-integration building / boutique hotel. The 1st to 10th floors of the 24 storey building is Humble Boutique Hotel. Adhering to My Humble House aesthetics and its unique artistic taste, the hotel was designed by AB Concept to introduce the ideal living style illustrated in The Story of Peach Blossom Spring: “He suddenly came upon a peach grove. At the end of the grove, he saw a spring which came from a cave in the hill. After a dozen steps, it opened into a flood of light.”The hotel is a tranquil and peaceful sanctuary in the busy and bustling city, aiming to meet the basic needs of guests and provide a sophisticated life style that makes a hotel feel like home, a resting place in the city, embracing the moment, and enriching your heart.
