stays.name: Regent Taipei
stays.description: Regent Taipei is a flagship member of Regent Hotel Group and also one of the most prominent and popular international five-star hotels in Taipei. The main demographic includes international business travelers, tourists, and local guests. Emphasizing on simple but elegant, generous décor and ensuring delicate services, we provide customers with the highest quality of accommodation and enjoyment of food and beverage, becoming the benchmark for fine living in Taiwan. The hotel also features a total of eight Chinese and Western cuisines and restaurants, offering quests delicious Chinese, Western, or Japanese-style foods. On the 20th floor, Wellspring SPA provides world-class aromatic treatments. while on rooftop the hotel offers heated swimming pool and gym. And, Regent Galleria, located on level B1 and B2, houses finest high fashion boutiques and other leisure facilities to create the perfect vacation enjoyment. Regent Taipei's excellent service and facilities won many prizes in the international awards, is among Asia's Best 50 Hotels, as voted by readers of Conde Naste Traveler magazine, and the best in Taiwan, for two consecutive years. It also is the hotel of first choice by many world-class political and business celebrities and film stars, when visiting and staying in Taipei. The hotel offers a total of 538 well-lit rooms, and the average number of pings (floor area) for each room ranks the highest in the industry. Each room is equipped with ADSL for a fast and convenient wireless access and broadband Internet access system, where guests can enjoy themselves in the online world. In addition, we also offer considerate "pillow menu" in each room with eight different options of hardness and texture, ranging from feather pillow, air pillow, wool pillow, to memory pillow, and others. The hotel offers Wellspring mattresses which are made from high-tech materials, with the effects of temperature sensing, shape fitting, pressure releasing, and comfortable sleeping to create the most comfortable sleep environment for our guests. The hotel is located in the heart of Taipei, near the Taipei Main Station and Exit 4 at Zhongshan Station of MRT Tamsui Line, and close to Nanking East Road/Zhongshan department store business district. And, at the hotel entrance there are also airport shuttles and bus stops to access well-known attractions in Taipei City. stays.name: SC Hotel
stays.description: SC HOTEL is a new boutique hotel built with the mission of making every stay exquisite through exceptional care and service. Taiwanese people are known for their generosity and friendliness–qualities that we hope to deliver to guests visiting us from all around the world. SC HOTEL is located on Section 1, ZhongShan North Road (at the center of the "Tiao Tong Business Commercial District"). We're conveniently located for both business and leisure travelers. Not only is SC HOTEL within walking distance to Taipei Main Station, the nearby 3 MRT lines also offer easy access to the neighboring Nanxi and Hua Yin shopping districts. The "Tiao Tong Commercial District" of ZhongShan North Road is known for its exotic neighborhood character reminiscent of the 1900s when Taiwan was under Japanese rule. At night, we encourage you to explore the narrow alleys filled with popular restaurants and pubs. In recent years, a large number of Taiwanese and Japanese ramen shops have made this neighborhood their home, creating charming fusion of pop culture and nostalgia. Our team is devoted to building a leisure culture, a comfortable atmosphere for wary travelers to rest and relax. Allow SC HOTEL clean and simple design to protect you from the noise and stress of the city, so you can immerse yourself in the beauty of the "Tiao Tong" neighborhood. Whether you're traveling for business or leisure, SC HOTEL can be your "home away from home" and you're always welcome!

stays.name: The Grand Hotel
stays.description: The Grand Hotel founded in 1952. It is a 14-story palace-style building, towering high above the foothills of Yuanshan, overlooking the Keelung River, and situated in front of Yangmingshan, to the west of Songshan, and to the east of Tamsui.The hotel& #39;s red pillars and golden tiles serve to impart an imposing appearance to the fine vista, and set off the magnificent classical atmosphere that conveys the beauty of Chinese art. The hotel is one of the landmarks of Taipei City, known around the world, and the best choice for accommodation or business meetings for the Chinese and foreign tourists.The hotel boasts 408 rooms and overlooks Taipei& #39;s bustling cityscape by day and its serene nighttime facade. The combination of contemporary and classical make the Grand Hotel a wonderful experience that reaches across space and time.It features fine gourmet cuisine restaurants serving the delicacies to guests,and provides five-star facilities and services. We invite you to experience this unique face for yourself.

stays.name: The Landis Taipei
stays.description: With an elegant French art deco style, The Landis Taipei has offered legendary services to its guests since the “Grand Opening” in 1979. Our guest rooms are the reflection of the refined and luxurious themes with a touch of the modern world. Offering to all business and leisure travelers a welcome “oasis” in the busy Taipei, our property presents a wide variety of facilities combined with a high level of personalized services.In 2018, the hotel has completed renovation of all its superior rooms and introduced iPad to all guestrooms which led the hotel to win the Best Hotel Award by Tourism Bureau in the same year. For those travelers who are seeking a combination of the “classic” and the “comfort of modern life,” The Landis Taipei has all the amenities and the facilities that travelers expect from a business hotel with truly impeccable services.“Paris 1930 de Hideki Takayama” is the pioneer of authentic French fine dining in Taiwan and has earned the Michelin One Star in 2022 and Wine Spectators Award 2019-2023. It is guided by the pursuit to perfection climax in a thrilling expression of French culinary craft, making it the place of choice for gourmands and connoisseurs. “Tien Hsiang Lo” which offers authentic Hangzhou delights was awarded with Michelin one star in 2018 to 2022 respectively. The restaurant was completely remodeled with a fusion of western and oriental style design. “La Brasserie,” our French-European restaurant provides provincial specialties, International varieties and healthy sumptuous breakfast buffet. It is an ideal spot for cocktails or an array of mixed drinks with friends, acquaintances, and business colleagues. Website: http://taipei.landishotelsresorts.com/chinese-trad/index.php

stays.name: The Okura Prestige Taipei
stays.description: Taipei’s prestigious Japanese-style hotel, the Okura Prestige Taipei, is located in the downtown part of the city in the Nanjing East and Zhongshan North Road Commercial Area, whose history dates back to the Japanese colonial era, when it was a gathering place for merchants. Today, it is a center of finance, business, shopping, and entertainment, home to several business buildings, boutique shops, and high-class restaurants. Zhongshan North Road is heavily shaded by trees, features attractive sites, and is home to several embassies and foreign restaurants; here one can really feel the pulse of Taipei. Modern classic space contains Okura Prestige’s legacy, as the Taipei location is one of Prestige’s 5-star hotels. The building’s design was the newest creation of famous Hong Kong designer Rocco Design Architects Limited, and its decoration was directed by Chhada, Siembieda & Associates Ltd, a famous hotel design company from Hong Kong. The main hall features a modern classical European design. Classic European patterns and crystal lighting are thoughtfully placed within the simple colors and line of the modern space, producing a low-key yet calm atmosphere. The space features traditional Japanese elegant design, balancing function and aesthetics and converying the Japanese cultural ideal of harmony with nature. In the relaxed, comfortable space, one can experience Tokyo’s friendly and harmonious spirit of service, continuing a half-century legacy of attentive customer service. Featuring a luxurious living experience and rich living entertainment and style, the hotel’s 208 modern rooms and suites come with a raised space design that perfectly combines modern classical decoration and Japanese functional aesthetics to provide visitors with the ultimate quiet and comfortable accommodation. We also provide a professional gym, heated rooftop pool, spa, and sauna, where you can relax your body and mind. The hotel also includes a multi-purpose meeting area serviced by attentive staff ready to meet your needs. Customized banquet and professional meeting planning makes this a perfect place to hold important banquets and meetings. Feast on fine food and beverages rivaling Tokyo –YAMAZATO fine Japanese Cuisine, Toh-Ka-Lin Chinese Restaurant, and other representative Japanese restaurants have made their home in Okura Prestige Taipei, where you can enjoy classic Japanese cuisine. The hotel also includes the European-style Continental Room, featuring an all-day buffet, The Nine Bakery, and The Pearl, a great bar to relax in and sip fine brews from around the world. The heated rooftop pool features another bar with magnificent views of Taipei 101, the cityscape, and surrounding mountains.

stays.description: A new era of hedonism designed with fortune, only in Wego Boutique Hotel (Dazhi)Wego Boutique Hotel(dazhi) has become the flagship house of Wego with the highest investment since Wego established its leadership in the boutique hotel enterprise in Taiwan. With a considerable salary offer, Wego has hired over twenty top-class designers from five well-known design companies, including the studio of Demos Chiang, a great-grandson of Chiang Kai-shek, and Mark Lintott Design. With this collaborative effort, the first Designer Hotel in Taiwan is made, which is a realization of New Hedonism, a Fun-tel (Fun Hotel). Surprise! Delight! Excitement! – A Paradise Never CompletedA huge round chandelier, a set of yuppie-style red sofa with a tint of decadence, a king-size round bed, a distinguished armchair in the shape of a cross, and a television with its huge 65'' screen, which is hung on a dramatically big wall. With all these, we're always trying to make our guests 'over-satisfied', and view Wego as 'a paradise never completed'. Now, let's step into our Wego party room, a space of Surprise! Delight! And Excitement!40 Themed Bedrooms: an Encounter of Dream-makers and FunctionalistsWego has always been a dream-maker. In the meantime, we know the focus of the consumer is on the essence of the commodity. Therefore, a lot of our attention is paid to improve the functionality of our design and demonstrate its unique aesthetic value and personality. That's why our designs are wild and at the same time delicate, not only making the dreams of our guests tangible, but also touching our guests deeply. Our guest-rooms are furnished in as many as 40 themes, and each of them is an encounter of dream-makers and functionalists, a vehicle taking our guests to a Disneyland for adults.

stays.description: Tourist Hotel located in TaipeiThe tourist hotel located in Taipei offers rooms with a panoramic view of the cityscape. stays.name: Cozzi
stays.description: The first hotel brand under Cathay Hospitality Management, HOTEL COZZI understands the lifestyles and traveling needs of young and mature travelers in the country and from abroad. It aims to create a brand new and fitting accommodation experience for them. The hotel emphasis on “cozy accommodation experience” is an unprecedented initiative in the hotel industry in Taiwan. Through appropriate service that is friendly and yet subtle, the spirit of branding is externalized from within, subsequently upgraded the positioning and standard of local chain hotels.Located in the heart of the city with accessible transportation, HOTEL COZZI is ideally affable in hope to enhance the traveling experience of every guest, and ensure that they feel unwound and relaxed. The hotel outlined its services and equipments around its motto “Unwind, Relax”, and offers a variety of signature COZZI experience and tailored services, including, comfortable beds in every room, 3C products friendly environment, fast payment service, and a house guest exclusive dining area that offers nutritionally balanced Colorful Sunshine Breakfast and around the clock snacks..Aiming for guests to unwind and relax, the service at HOTEL COZZI is informal, relaxed but at the same time offers warmth and friendliness that are lacking in big hotels. Whether you are a business traveler who has been out making business calls, or a leisure traveler exploring the city for a whole day, HOTEL COZZI offers a cozy environment to let down their hair and relax.

stays.name: FUN INN TAIPEI
stays.description: Fun Inn Taipei Hostel is located in only a 5-minute walk from MRT Beimen Station. It offers simple and affordable accommodations with free WiFi access. It takes an 7-minute for guests to walk to MRT Ximen Station and Ximending shopping area.From Taipei Main Station, a terminal of Taipei Metro, Taoyuan Airport Metro, bus, train and high speed rail, guests can walk to Fun Inn Taipei Hostel in just 10 minutes. The hostel is a 20-minute drive from Taipei Songshan Airport, while Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport is a 40-minute drive away.Dormitories for 4 to 12 people and female dormitories are offered. Sheets and beddings, lockers, private curtains around the bed are provided. Bathroom and toilet are inside the room but shared with other guests.At Fun Inn Taipei you will find a shared kitchen and a shared lounge. Luggage storage is possible at the front desk. There are also a wash machine and dryer. In line with the concept of environmental protection, no personal hygiene products are provided in the museum.

stays.name: Taipei Garden Hotel
stays.description: The “Taipei Garden Hotel”, located between Manga (Wanhua) and Ximen Business Circle, is a deluxe business and tourist hotel in Western Taipei that provides 241 comfortable high-ceiling suites and versatile catering service that blends Chinese dishes with Western ones. With “Travel in Manga and Ximen” as the theme of the hotel and combining it with the meaning of Bangka boat, enthusiasm and cultural meanings are created through design techniques.Taipei Garden Hotel has 241 comfortable and spacious guest suites, as well as a great selecion of dining options, including To-Gather Kitchen that serves a fusion of Western and Asian cuisine, the popular Taipei Garden Café Toast & Thai, PRIME ONE Steak House and Hanabby Bakery. Also available are a large pillar-free multi-purpose banquet hall with 7-meter ceilings, several fully customizable, self-contained conference rooms, and well equipped business center and fitness center. Our goal is to offer you a comfortable stay and a delightful dining experience, so you can enjoy calm and tranquility amid the hustle and bustle of the city.White marble sets the tone for the magnificent seven-meter high atrium while the luxurious glass chandelier is a glittering presence among the stainless steel. This fusion of different materials together with the one-of-a-kind glass sculpture creates the kind of sparkling ambience that only crystal can achieve. The design of the corridors keeps the theme of consistency and provides a brand new accommodation experience.

stays.name: Taipei toy hotel
stays.description: we providing the perfect haven between tranquility and proximity in the vivid leisure district of Ximending near MRT Ximen Station for your Taipei travel. Ximending, also known as “Harajuku of Taipei,” is Taipei’s fashionable shopping center famed for the diversity of entertainments and activities that allure large numbers of young people and foreigners. Boasting a wonderful location, our hotel is only 3 minutes stroll away from the shopping heaven- Ximending, while Taipei Main Station, the major transportation hub, is about a 10-minute walk away, offering a swift access to other thriving destinations throughout city and beyond. Our hotel is strategically towered in a quiet alley away from the traffic noises of the main road, ensuring you utmost peaceful atmosphere and relaxations. Each room of our hotel is designed with modern furnishings that blend perfectly with intimate comforts to ensure you an intimate stay. Our hotel is one of the best choices among hotels in Taipei for all discerning travelers. Towered in the excellent location of Taipei City, numbers of noted historical sites are within a short walking distance from our hotel, including the Presidential Office Building, 228 Peace Memorial Park, and Red House Ximending. Dadaocheng, Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, and Wanhua Mongjia Longshan Temple are some of the attractions nearby about 5-10 minutes drive away, while Danshui Old Street, National Palace Museum, Taipei 101, and Shilin Night Market can be reached within a short MRT ride. The convenience in location of our hotel make your Taiwan travel an easy and efficient one.

stays.name: YUEH LAI HOTEL
stays.description: Sunny hotel Taipei is a contemporary hotel, providing the perfect haven between tranquility and proximity in the vivid leisure district of Ximending near MRT Ximen Station for your Taipei travel. Ximending, also known as “Harajuku of Taipei,” is Taipei’s fashionable shopping center famed for the diversity of entertainments and activities that allure large numbers of young people and foreigners. Boasting a wonderful location, our hotel is only 3 minutes stroll away from the shopping heaven- Ximending, while Taipei Main Station, the major transportation hub, is about a 10-minute walk away, offering a swift access to other thriving destinations throughout city and beyond. Our hotel is strategically towered in a quiet alley away from the traffic noises of the main road, ensuring you utmost peaceful atmosphere and relaxations. Each room of our hotel is designed with modern furnishings that blend perfectly with intimate comforts to ensure you an intimate stay. Our hotel is one of the best choices among hotels in Taipei for all discerning travelers. Towered in the excellent location of Taipei City, numbers of noted historical sites are within a short walking distance from our hotel.

stays.name: Bear 611 B&B
stays.description: About Us Experience a Cabin VacationLittle Bear Villa is located on the banks of the Beinan River, nestled within the picturesque primeval forests of the East Rift Valley. It& #39;s a secluded resort paradise, far from the hustle and bustle of city life. Six forest cabins, constructed from red cypress logs, are situated on a vast green space. Upon entering, you& #39;ll be greeted by the fragrant aroma of cypress, the sounds of insects and butterflies, and a romantic starry sky. The resort offers meeting facilities, a tour counter, and luggage storage. Guests can enjoy various activities on-site or in the surrounding area, including fishing. The resort provides ample free parking, a volleyball court, a basketball court, a children& #39;s sandpit, and more.Resort-Style Accommodation – Enjoy a Relaxing and Joyful GetawayLittle Bear Villa offers double, triple, and quadruple rooms, and can also book entire cabins for five, six, seven, eight, or nine people. Whether it& #39;s a romantic getaway for couples or a group of friends, Little Bear Villa is the perfect choice.The cozy and lovely forest cabins feature a rustic design and spacious, bright interiors. The park also offers a variety of recreational facilities: the most charming mineral spring swimming pool in eastern Taiwan, a super exciting inline skating rink, a coffee plaza, an outdoor children& #39;s playground, a log-style restaurant, badminton courts, basketball courts, a free karaoke room with a bear-themed karaoke, a fishing pond, bicycles, and more, allowing visitors to easily enjoy their vacation and forget their worries.

Everyone who loves Tinker Bell is welcome to come and exchange.

stays.name: Coconut Beach
stays.description: Coconut Coast B&B is hidden among the coconut trees on Doulan Bay, by the coast of the Pacific Ocean, along Provincial Highway 11. Being near the coast and at the foot of the mountain, Coconut Coast B&B seems to be veiled by a sheet of fog and cloud all year long. At night the mountain breeze travels downward, passes the B&B and moves towards the ocean. The B&B doesn't face the ocean and is not luxurious, but all the furnishings in the house are very comfortable. Coconut Coast B&B serves delicious local gourmets. There are no industrial pollution, so all the local ingredients are safe to eat. Some of the mountain grown wild vegetables include Black Nightshade, Slender Amaranth and Houmaozi. The organic free-range chickens and lamb are free of antibiotics. The fish caught in the Pacific Ocean include yellow tail, marbled rockfish, grouper and snapper. They are prepared simply to retain freshness.

stays.name: DONG TAIR SPA HOTEL
stays.description: Situated in Chihpen hot spring area and close to the Chihpen National Forest Recreation Area, DONG TAIR SPA HOTEL has a wonderful natural scenery and hot spring resources. A total of 146 carefully designed hot spring suites are available in the hotel, in addition to a Chinese restaurant with a capacity of 500 people and a elegant karaoke lounge with ample space . The services provided include accommodation, dining, rest, conference, tour package and so on. DONG TAIR Spring Resort is a multi-purpose hot spring resort with health improvement, recreation, networking and family management capabilities through the integration of the style of Austronesian cultures from Taiwan's Indigenous Cultures. Based on our business philosophy, we position DONG TAIR SPA HOTEL as a hot spring resort with a clear theme. Through the provision of a safe, comfortable and healthy environment of food and accommodation, the caring service from a professional team, and the multi-purpose hot spring facility, the ultimate goal is to give all guests a completely relaxed trip.

stays.name: Spring Maple B&B
stays.description: Spring Maple B&BChunfeng B&B is a private house among Puyuma tribes. Because the owner is learning to help others in related fields, he likes to make friends and share space. Therefore, after sharing friends& #39; visits frequently, and with the encouragement of friends, he has the idea of ​​establishing a homestay, and wants to share the space with people who are looking forward to living in Taitung. A wandering traveler.The B&B is located in the countryside of Lijia Village, Beinan Township, about 20 minutes from the center of Taitung City, and about 15 minutes from Zhiben Hot Spring. It is not a place with convenient transportation. For travelers who like excitement and convenience, it is recommended to choose a B&B near Taitung Station as the place of accommodation.Spring Maple B&B, the space is expected to accommodate only one group of travelers at a time, with a maximum of one vehicle. It is recommended that it can be acquaintances or a family of about 4 people. Both the living room and the kitchen can be used for simple sharing and convenient use.You can park on the side of the entrance (the size of a parking space for ordinary cars) or park on Limin Road and walk for about 1 minute to reach the accommodation space. Because the accommodation space is located in the tribe, you need to pay attention to the sound volume at night, and the animals participating in the tribe may get up early in the morning because of their singing. There are quiet trails in the back mountain of the tribe, where you can take a slow walk, and you can also watch the night view from the high point and enjoy the tranquility of the tribe.B&B space is mainly established as a sharing space, providing a place for travelers to rest quietly, and also providing a comfortable place for parents and children/friends to gather together. Through familiar travelers living with each other in the entire space (room, living room, kitchen, bathroom, etc.), relaxation and freedom can be achieved.

stays.name: Taitung County Farmers' Association East Travel Season Hot Spring Resort
stays.description: Toyugi Hot Spring Resort & Spa is located within the Zhiben Hot Spring Area in Wenquan Village, Beinan Township, Taitung County, and. close to Jhihben (Zhiben) National Forest Recreation Area. The Resort covers 15 hectares. Visitors are lured into stepping on the soft grass and viewing the towering mountains so that they will forget all their mundane troubles and enjoy a forest bath in the valleys. It’s 16 km from downtown Taitung City. Surrounded by mountains and the sea, Toyugi has splendid views and is blessed with great ecological diversity. Away from the hustle and bustle of the city life, Toyugi is free of traffic jams yet extremely accessible. Toyugi Hot Spring Resort & Spa features all types of comfortable and elegant rooms, as well as the largest and most comprehensive wellness Spa area. The Resort also provides conference centers, campsites, and barbecue zones. Its main goal is to serve famers across the country, farmers& #39; organizations, and those working in the agricultural sector by providing venues for agricultural promotions, continuing education sessions, workshops and other activities.

stays.name: YA WAN HOTEL
stays.description: Yawan Hotel is located near the Jhihben (Zhiben) hot springs (in front of Jhihben Hot-spring Bridge) on a slope, and is surrounded by hills and mountains, away from the hubbub of city life, making you feel secluded. stays.name: Fengnai Travel B&B
stays.description: Welcome to the Changguang Tribe. Our tribe is located in Changbin Township, Taitung County. It is the largest Amis settlement in Changbin Township. The annual Sea Festival in May and the Harvest Festival in July are the most popular among the tribe. Geographically speaking, the largest celebration takes an hour and a half to drive from Hualien to the north and Taitung to the south. Therefore, despite the inconvenience of public transportation, it is the last piece of pure land in Taiwan. It is worth going here to relax and feel comfortable. Relieve stress. Coastal Amis is close to both mountains and sea. It doesn’t take too much time to get to the mountains or the beach nearby. It’s also right in the middle of Taitung and Hualien. Staying here for three days and two nights can combine the main features of Taitung and Hualien. Enjoy the attractions thoroughly.

Therefore, despite the inconvenience of public transportation, it is the last piece of pure land in Taiwan. It is worth going here to relax and feel comfortable. Relieve stress. Coastal Amis is close to both mountains and sea. It doesn’t take too much time to get to the mountains or the beach nearby. It’s also right in the middle of Taitung and Hualien. Staying here for three days and two nights can combine the main features of Taitung and Hualien. Enjoy the attractions thoroughly.

stays.name: Return to Nagahama Hall
stays.description: Huari Fashion Leisure Hotel was built by Fuli Construction from Tainan and Changbin from Taitung to jointly create a dream. The reason why we chose Changbin, Taitung, is not only because of its natural and lively atmosphere, but also because we hope that people can cherish their own land. Instead of spending a lot of money to fly abroad, traveling on the island can also experience the scenery and leisurely life like Bali, eliminating the annoying urban areas and enjoying an extraordinary and quiet life. The hotel is integrated with the original ecology. The most charming element is the architectural beauty that is in harmony with heaven, earth and nature, and the residence is full of rural charm.The clubhouse adopts a natural and rustic style to create a simple and fresh atmosphere. It also has the comfortable feeling of a five-star micro-hotel. Whether it is a family gathering, business travel, or conference accommodation, it can provide a tailor-made place to stay. The clubhouse& #39;s 13 rooms have views of the mountains and the sea, or the overlapping ridges of the coastal mountains. From the early morning, you can watch the sunrise, appreciate the sun, chase the sun, and love the sun. When the sun sets, you can look up at the vast Milky Way at night. There is no need to deliberately fill your itinerary with entertainment. Just enjoy the days of looking at the sea. Come to Nanzhu Lake Clubhouse to find your original intention and find your true self.

stays.name: Yu Huang Mi Homestay
stays.description: 【Tenno Rice】has used a refining approach of a hundred years to radiate solid luster and to ruminate the sweet after-taste. We applied these classic centurial expectations in creating 【Tenno Rice Villa】. An architecture of timeless simplicity and restrained, not exaggerating, engraved on the coastal road scene of beautiful Taiwan Highway 11. The Villa is built with stones imported from Spain and teakwood from Indonesia, and has a courtyard filled with plants and a pond and with an area of 1,980 square meters. A spacious space suitable for industrial and commercial organizations to carry out training programs and welfare activities. Facing the Pacific Coast with back to the ridge of Coast Mountains, a sightseeing Villa that embraces mountains, the ocean, hot springs, flowers. Here you can listen to the music of the sea, step on the waves, visit and track the trails of hermit crabs on the beach, or ride a bicycle or take a stroll through the Pacific coastline, enjoy the early morning sunrise and evening sunset. What are you waiting for? Pack your luggage, pretend that you are the protagonist in an idol drama, enjoy every moment of romance in Huatung Valley, at Tenno Rice Villa.

stays.name: Zhu Hushan Ju Homestay
stays.description: Taitung｜Juhu VillaJourney to a mountain residence of endless surprisesYou drive along a winding mountain road and the silence along the way gives you the feeling that you’re about to arrive at a secluded, secret place. The natural scenery out the car window excites you as you approach Juhu Villa; a quiet place brimming with vitality.A treasure chest of natural wonders deep in the mountainsXiao Hei, the lively little black dog, approaches the car to welcome you upon arrival. You see baskets of freshly-picked tangerines, and a bunch of hardy bananas on a wooden table. Wearing simple clothing and a bashful smile, your amiable host, Jin-Tian, approaches. Pointing to the freshly harvested bananas on the table, he says, “Have some! Don’t be shy!” This place exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. With no neighbors in sight, you quickly make the acquaintance of the sky, the earth, and the abundant wildlife.You walk with Jin-Tian up a sloping road towards the independent lodging area. Beautiful primrose blossoms line the road, butterflies dancing between them. Xiao Hei and the endless mountain scenery accompany you on your stroll as you feel your mind and body being cleansed. Jin-Tian points to the distant mountains on either side, saying, “Our land extends from here to there…” He names for you the many tree and plant species along the way; tomatoes, persimmons, dragon fruit, banana... “Listen! That’s the call of the muntjac deer!” Pointing once again to the far off mountain ridge, “Formosan serows inhabit those mountains!” Jin-Tian is even able to climb up the wire obstacle course they have set up with his bare hands, or quickly ascend the trees above the river valley like a young boy playing in the mountains. Following his footsteps, you feel like you are exploring a treasure chest full of natural wonders, discovering endless surprises.A mountain household with a view of the Pacific OceanAfter climbing the steep road, you catch your breath on the mountain terrace looking out between the high mountains. Suddenly you catch a glimpse of light reflecting off azure waters: the faraway Pacific Ocean. As the sea breeze blows by and you take a deep breath, you feel just like a mountain spirit.Three white bungalows sit to one side of the road, simple and elegant. French windows allow the beautiful scenery to merge into each residence. In the Maroon Oriole Residence, furnished in the style of a Chinese court, you feel immersed in the refinement of the pink and red decor. In the mustard yellow decor of the Collared Scops Owl Residence, you enter the magnificence of classical European style. The colors of the Formosan Blue Magpie Residence are just as lively as the bird for which it is named, with elements of maritime Greece mixed in, giving you the impression of an ocean voyage. No matter which residence you inhabit, all have a spacious balcony overlooking the mountains, and a large bathtub in a roomy bathroom to help spoil your world-weary body.Make your way to a world-class villa with unparallelled mountain viewsThe sky is still light after you finish checking in, and Xiao Hei seems to know that you want to go out to play, bouncing around and wagging his tail. Jin-Tian has finished his farming work and invites you to experience an activity with a set itinerary. With expectation and excitement, you and your friends jump aboard the little blue work truck as the steep mountain road and beautiful environs foretell of the unimaginable journey to come. Jin-Tian stops the truck on a flat section of the hillside as a crested goshawk spirals above your head and into the distance. Looking down you see the Changbin plains and the Pacific Ocean beyond. You seem to be able to make out Green Island in the fog off the coast. Hanging from a large tree by the hillside is a swing, and after being reassured by Jin-Tian, you bravely give it a try. Your extended legs feel the rushing of the wind as you surge forward, gripping the ropes tightly in your hands. You feel like a small bird enjoying the swiftness of soaring through the air. You feel you might even be able to jump into the Pacific Ocean before you. You can’t believe that such a private, world-class scenic spot could exist here in Taiwan.After dark, Jin-Tian’s wife, Mei-jyu, prepares a full table of organic cuisine for you. After dinner, you chat with your friends in the open air mountainside dining area, enjoying the comforts of this farming household. Afterwards, you might again explore the mountain environment with Jin-Tian, encountering once more a little muntjac deer, a flying squirrel, or perhaps an owl.In the early morning light, you enjoy a multicolored vegetarian breakfast. Deep in the mountains, you experience the beauty of a more primitive lifestyle, exploring the precious surprises that nature offers. When it is time to leave, your reluctance to leave transforms into immense gratitude as you give thanks to the rich offerings of the natural world, and to Jin-Tian and Mei-jyu for their passionate love of nature and their unreserved sharing.

stays.name: BASRA SHORE B and B
stays.description: Baslaan means "resting place" in the Amis language.As the name suggests, it encourages travelers to let go of worldly concerns and relax freely on their vacation!Baslaan B&B is nestled in a beautiful natural setting, close to nature. Enjoy the breathtaking views of towering mountains and the vast ocean while absorbing the phytoncides!The first floor houses the lobby, offering ample space for guests to enjoy their meals, enjoy afternoon tea, read, and listen to music.The second floor houses the overnight guest rooms, each with a combination lock, offering complete privacy.The third floor features a terrace overlooking the vast sea and mountains. On clear days, you can even see Green Island Mountain in the distance.We also thoughtfully provide king-sized lounge chairs and parasols. Enjoy the scenery during the day and stargaze at night with a glass of wine.We also enjoy a convenient location close to Chenggong City, convenience stores, ATMs, scenic spots, and the fishing port.Basraan offers a home-like feeling, hoping that visitors can let go of all their burdens, travel with ease, and return home with full of memories.

stays.name: David SamStrong Villa
stays.description: Taitung｜David SamStrong VillaA seaside mountain vacation with sunlight and shadeDriving down the eastern coast, your car turns a corner and leaves the ocean behind. Another left turn and you head towards the entrance to Hsiaoma Hoping Mountain as an alley opens up between flowers to one side of the road. Wind ripples the trees and grass beside the alley as you make your way expectantly towards the end of the road where David SamStrong Villa is situated. You can’t help but wonder what kind of pleasant surprises await.A tender dream stacked in layers upon the hillsideA gray building sits upon the hillside. The concrete walls of David SamStrong Villa maintain their original color and are coated with a monolithic finish, the building itself square-shaped, like a stack of toy building blocks. Suddenly, a burst of bright yellow enters your line of sight. As David, the host of this guesthouse, explains, that splash of color represents his frame of mind. Every day is a splendid vacation under such blue skies.Originally employed as an engineer in a computer company, David has a resonant laugh and a soft heart. While performing his military service here in Taitung, David fell in love with the beautiful mountains and ocean vistas of the area. In order to give his elderly parents a place to retire and rest, he built a personal residence in the Taitung hills. At that time, now 10 years past, he spent his days tending the fruits, vegetables, and plants in his gardens. Three years ago, he began planning construction of a bed and breakfast, in the hopes of introducing even more people to the beauty of the simple life. Once built, he named this second building by combining his English (David) and Chinese (SamStrong) names. Thus, the jocular name David SamStrong Villa came into being.Framing the various postures of sunlightDavid limits admission to a single group of travelers at one time. In his villa, you can relax and live it up, and are guaranteed your favorite corner to lounge in. First floor accommodations consist of two double rooms which exhibit simple concrete-gray walls sprinkled with large splashes of yellow decor, yet are devoid of fancy furniture. Instead, large windowpanes allow the vastness of the Pacific Ocean to spill indoors. The semi-open design allows you to linger in the courtyard, strolling along the verdant garden paths. Alternately, you can sit in your doorway in a comfortable loveseat, savoring the sun-bathed hills in the distance. You can also stroll out behind the stairs, finding a wall fashioned with rectangular openings of different sizes through which the sunlight dances and plays in magical ways all day long.Climbing the stairs to the second floor, you find a living room and a kitchen in the same simple, down-to-earth style. Gray walls accentuate the natural warmth of the wooden furniture. David’s own handmade dried fruit preserves sit to one side of the dining table for the enjoyment of his guests. Two lounge chairs, ideal for sunbathing and admiring the emerald green mountainside, await you on the balcony outside. Gazing towards the base of the mountain, sky and sea meet at the horizon in a poetic landscape where time seems to stand still.Straightforward design highlighting spectacular viewsThe following morning, you are greeted by a table full of David’s handmade delicacies. Such things as eggs, salads, hibiscus tea, peanut butter and bread - all breakfast ingredients are organically grown and prepared by David and his mother. This distinctive, nourishing breakfast is made even more enjoyable by the blue backdrop of the Pacific Ocean beyond the windows.Light and shadow play through every corner of the semi-open and dynamic design of David SamStrong Villa. Wherever you go, you follow the tracks of sunshine and shade, whether standing or sitting or lying down. The green of the mountains and the blue of the ocean always seem easily within reach. How could a single day living in such luxury possibly be enough?

stays.description: Meihualu Tingyuan Jiawu Homestay is located in the downtown of Chenggong Township, Taitung County. Pushing the door open, you can see a delicate path, on which you can walk in the spacious garden to enjoy the great atmosphere. At this point, having a cup of roselle tea will help to relax the chaotic mind and tense body. Stepping into the house, you can smell a faint scent of wood, because you stepped into a log cabin. Inside the cabin, there is a spacious lounge and a huge wooden tea table. You can stay in the house for a cup of tea or go outside for landscape viewing. This is what we want to do for you, enjoy and relax!

stays.name: Mianhuatang Homestay
stays.description: Mianhuatang B&B is located in Chenggong Township, Taitung County. Chenggong Township boasts magnificent Pacific Ocean views, rich local fishing port culture, and natural landscapes, making it a popular tourist destination for travelers who love seascapes, sunrises, and a leisurely lifestyle. Guests can enjoy the sunrise over the sea in the morning and stroll along the harbor or coastal bike path in the evening, feeling the sea breeze. Nearby attractions include Sanxiantai, the East Coast National Scenic Area, and the Amis Cultural Village, making it ideal for multi-day trips. The B&B exudes a sophisticated and luxurious style, allowing guests to not only enjoy the sea but also experience the lifestyle aesthetics of a B&B.

stays.name: knt-house
stays.description: With back to the mountains and facing the Pacific Ocean, the architecture is built with white Mediterranean style, outlined boldly with blue and yellow colors, and created a building that presents a relaxed, comfortable, and lazy feeling. Besides the characteristics of the building, it has a greenery garden with an area of nearly 13,200 square meters. Based on the spirit of the natural ecological protection, we built a natural ecological pond, creeks, flowing water, to integrate with the sandy bay in front of the park, forming a rear unique scenic resort that includes mountains, sea, river, pond, trees, fruits, and flowers. In the garden, you can enjoy your leisure activities at any corner of the garden, including hammock, swings, or having barbecue fun. This is the garden that innkeepers to create specially for lazy leisure, family fun, and family gatherings. Outside the garden, it is close to the East Coast National Scenic Area Administration, Ami Folklife Center, Taiyuan Valley, Donghe estuary surfing resort, Antong Hot Springs ... and a variety of tourist attractions. Activities of your choices. The following outlines the available activities: 1. Catching Fish: (Kids can catch guppy fish in creek, and may bring a small amount back.) 2. Planted Crops: Cucumber, luffa, passion fruit, hydroponic water spinach, tomatoes, sugar-apple, guava, mango, wax apple, and other crops that can be harvested. 3. Bird Watching: Wild birds include Common Pheasant, Pheasant-tailed Jacana, Spotted Dove, Crested Myna, Japanese White-eye, Formosan bulbul, Little Egret, Grey Heron, tri-colored bird, Hoopoe, Pale Thrush, Black Bulbul, as well as domestic Ducorp& #39;s Cockatoo parrots, pigeons. 4. Flowers: Planted plants include: gold perfume magnolia, rose, Indian rubber tree. Native species: lilies, bougainvillea, Hibiscus rosa-sinensis L, Hibiscus, garlic vine, sweet-scented osmanthus, Osmanthus Fragrans, Ceylon Ardisia, Silvery Messerschmidia, Bauhinia, Allamanda, Chinese Fringe-tree, Giant Crape-myrtle, Dutch Amaryllis, Huang Huai, Lady& #39;s eardrops, Madagascar periwinkle, Rose-flowered Jatropha, cherry, olive, Golden Dewdrop, etc. 5.Beach: build sand castles, play with water (swimming not recommended), fly kites, go fishing, catch hermit crabs, dig turban snails, and Taiwan abalone (during low tide) if lucky.6. Enjoy SPA, sea views, sunrise (viewing platform), coffee, beer, and tea.7. Equipped with swings, hammocks, slides, stone tables and chairs sets, wooden tables and chairs sets, and large wooden platforms are available for rest and play.8. Tools container house offers: stone carving tool sets, wood carving tool sets, chain saws, fishing rods, fishing tackles, and other supplies are available to borrow.

stays.description: Fujiyuan B&B is 700 meters from the streets of Chishang and has convenient transportation. Surrounded by farm fields and open space, the mountain ranges and rural countryside become a natural scenery. Fujiyuan B&B covers an area of 1,940 square feet. stays.name: Huan E Homestay
stays.description: Huan Er (exchange of a goose) Homestay is named after the classic allusion of Wang Xizhi& #39;s exchanging his writing for a goose. Just a three-minute& #39; walk from Chihshang Station, originally this three and a half story townhouse was a residence. We hope you will have the feeling of home when you checked in. The reason to draw the name from Wang Xizhi& #39;s exchange allusion is that Huan Er& #39;s family members love calligraphy deeply, especially the founder Dad Huan Er even uses calligraphy to make friends, and Huan Er& #39; hostess, "Xiaoshan." also opens calligraphy talent classes for children in Huan Er Homestay. As long as you like calligraphy, we offer you Four Treasures of the Study for you to experience, when you are staying in the B&B. The interiors of Huan Er Homestay is a minimalist style, there is no luxury décor, but calligraphy is visible everywhere .If you are interested in calligraphy, we welcome you to experience this cultural essence of over a thousand years. Huan Er Homestay offers mainly simple, clean, and comfortable rooms, and of course, we decorate the rooms with a lot of calligraphic works .Currently, the room types of Huan Er Homestay include double suites and four-person rooms. Although Huan Er is known for his calligraphy, but he is active in sports. The host "Xiao Hei" has once cycled around the island,; therefore he understands the needs of the friends cycling around the island, and hence Huan Er Homestay is a good place for cycling friends to stay for a time on their journey. Chishang has beautiful Dapo Pond, vast rice fields. For cycling lovers, do you want to wander in the scenery of golden paddy waves of Mr. Brown Avenue and Paradise Road? Do forget to come to Chishang.

stays.name: Richun Chishang B&B
stays.description: Rihchun Chishang B&B Introduction:I. Located in Chishang Township, Taitung County, Rihchun Chishang B&B is situated in a green building that embraces a friendly environment (white pebble finish). Our architectural philosophy is "for your own enjoyment." Drawing back the curtains feels like stepping onto the rice paddies and fields, a feast for the eyes and mind. Rihchun Chishang awaits your return!II. Key Highlights:* **Stunning Views:** Large balcony/floor-to-ceiling doors/mountain views, pastoral scenery/sunrise, sunset, starry skies, cloud waterfalls, etc./360-degree panoramic views from the rooftop/birdsong/green mountains, clear waters, and fresh air.* **Design Experience:** Wabi-sabi/exposed concrete/wood tones/industrial style/railway elements create a warm and high-quality accommodation experience.* **Prime Location:** 1.5 km from the city center.5 minutes from the bus station/Dapo Pond/10 minutes by car from Brown Avenue. 1 minute walk from Da Chi Doupi Shop / 3 minutes walk from the library / 6 minutes walk from Du Garden.

stays.name: Rihui International Resort
stays.description: Reservation Hotline: 089-862-222 / 02-6630-0999, Fax: 089-862-121 Hotel Website: https://www.papago-resort.com/taitung/welcome.htmlPapago International Resort--Taitung is located in central East Rift Valley, to the north of and adjacent Fuli Township, Hualien County, to the south of Guanshan. In quiet and secluded mountains, the unique geographical location offers you to embrace the scenery of East Rift Valley together with your companions. We provide a bicarbonate chloride spring for every room. HOTEL Area features a total of 119 rooms, all equipped with a scenery balcony. Open your windows gently, enjoy the views of blue sky of Huatung Valley (East Rift Valley), clouds and mists in the green overflowing mountains. PRESIDENT VILLA Area features a total 102 villas, the largest villa complex in Southeast Asia. Each villa has landscape garden, private pool, balé (Gazebo); comfortable and bright living rooms and separate bedrooms, for you to enjoy undisturbed privacy. Check in Papago International Resort, you'll find yourself seeming to stay in a beautiful dreamland. ※ Won the first place by vote in "2009 Excellent Hotel of Choice in East Rift Valley" sponsored by the East Rift Valley National Scenic Area Administration, Tourism Bureau. ※ Won the fifth place in "2010 National Survey of the Service Sector" sponsored by Global Views Monthly. This was the first time Papago participated in the survey and was the only hotel candidate selected in a competitive market of leisure travel hotel in Hualien-Taitung-Pingtung Area. ※ In 2010, Papago pioneered the "2012 Super Car Tour" in Taiwan, establishing the new culture of the East Rift Valley, Super Car Tour in Papago! ※ In 2011, the third anniversary of Papago, Taitung County Government sponsored "2011 Taiwan Balloon Fiesta" and held the International Airspace Seminar at Papago International Conference Venue. And, hot air balloons took off from the Love Square of Papago, Chihshang (Chishang), which was an event for promoting both Taitung City and Papago International Resort synchronously. ※ In 2011, Papago and Taitung County Government organized "2011 Super Car Tour Holiday" to integrate Taitung Tourism Cultural in holiday activities, promoting the culture to the international arena. ※ In 2012, Tourism Bureau, MOTC, granted Papago a Five-star Rating certificate, and Papago International Resort becomes a quality resort with both five-star rating and certified hot spring.

stays.name: Zhuangjia Shule Homestay
stays.description: A story: a young child, playing under the apple tree, said goodbye to parents in the brisk and set off to find the legendary treasure of happiness. Years later, the child, after travelling around in the world and becoming white-haired, returned home only to find that the treasure was under the apple tree where he said goodbye to their parents before." Standing on the grass in front of the house, the air is extremely clean, the owner Wenxuan said: "To the right is my son& #39;s school, 12 people a class, to the left is my prayer chapel, in front of me, the organic rice field I am working on, followed by a .... There is ..., on the hillside." Under the warm winter sun and the dark skin, the abundant joy of life is hardly concealed. "Whenever he closed his eyes to rest, prayed silently, his eyes seemed to be lift up to the high altitude overlooking the bustling city, where people lived like ants blindly making money, spending money, and working again," and then Wenxuan decided to return to his hometown. "Looking at the designs being refused one by one, my heart felt cold, I cried out loud uneasy, because, I didn& #39;t see the future, how distant is it." Hostess Su Qing described the impact of life-turning process. "I have no way to get rid of the genetic bones of creative desires." Wenxuan, an Information Engineer, and his father is an average-people turned sculptor, but he found his creative outlet on his wife& #39;s interior design field. In order to have a place for creating sculptures, he started to arrange a studio; however, the arrangement lasted for two years, because of his haunting perfect aesthetic perception. Children grew up, the house was finally completed at the beginning of the year, and then looking back, the journey has already lasted for six years. Originally, it was a decision made without hesitation to put down everything in the city, though I lost something, all is worth it, because what I have now are impossible, even devoting whole life, to get from a city, rustic life, paddy waves, rice fragrance, noise of children& #39;s frolic, and the hometown mien, which I believe are luxurious hopes. I often also think that it was lucky for people of our generation have a chance to return, look at the children, and think of myself, what I am worried about is that how to pave a smooth home returning way for the kids and let them know that there is a way back home they should remember, and the parents at the home will always light up a lamp waiting for them.

stays.name: Coastline Azure
stays.description: Taitung｜Coastline AzureA long coast of unbroken ocean blueOne clear afternoon, you rush along Taiwan’s East coast Highway 11. As you round a corner, the vast, grassy landscape stretches out ahead of you under an azure sky. In the middle of this magnificent scene sits a welcoming, white guesthouse, resembling a countryside sketch from a European diary. Today, between the mountain and the sea, discover -- Coastline Azure. The elegance of European country lifeWalking up to Coastline Azure along the courtyard path, you see dogs at play on the lawn nearby. Remove your shoes and enter the lobby where refined leather seating and wooden furniture bespeak of the classic country life. Shirley, the owner of Coastline Azure, has decorated this space with her favorite owl imagery as well as local works of art. These eclectic elements work seamlessly together to create a style which is totally Shirley. Her floral print dress and graceful smile are as warm and bright as today’s sunshine. Shirley skillfully manages every detail at Coastline Azure, from the meticulous dinner table arrangements to the inspired decor of each room. Once a part of the bustling world of business, Shirley’s extraordinary sense brought her great success as the chief financial officer of such distinguished companies as Pizza Hut, China Synthetic Rubber Corporation and Levi’s. At the peak of her business career, Shirley also experienced the greatest mental and physical stress of her entire life. After a 21-day period of continuous work with no time off, she realized that without a doubt health turns out to be the greatest wealth. She vowed to give up her busy career and return to a simple life. A love of the Pacific Ocean led her to seek out property in Taidong, with a view of Green Island on the horizon, where she would build her own guesthouse. At Coastline Azure, Shirley delights in leading travellers back into a slower, simpler rhythm where they can enjoy a broad slice of endless azure blue. A beautiful vacation in the company of mountains and sea “We only use world-champion roast coffee beans in our house! If you’re lucky, who’s to say you won’t end up with premium Geisha coffee in your cup!” Working from her own ample experience, seasoned traveler Shirley aims to provide her guests with nothing but the best. On a leisurely afternoon, guests are welcomed by a taste of her own afternoon tea preparations: an array of exquisite and delicious snacks on a wooden platter, such as cream puffs with cool filling, handmade brownies, and Isigny butter cookies accompanied by a cup of freshly brewed coffee. Guests arriving at Coastline Azure ought to slow down and savour the fine flavor of their vacation. On the second floor, Coastline Azure has two- and four-person rooms available. Each room derives its name from the movement of the sun and moon through the sky. In the rooms called “Moon Companion” and “Star Gazing”, the warm yellow glow of the moon and the resplendent stars illuminates the pitch-black night sky. You can greet the first rays of dawn as you sit enveloped by the boundless ocean vista in rooms with the names “Listen to the Ocean” and “Sunrise”. Shirley’s meticulous planning of the small two-person loft allows guests to soak in exclusive tranquility as they sit quietly near windows, overlooking the ocean. After a night in such a room, you’ll understand that the connection to the landscape is the best part about this place. Step out onto the spacious balcony where the rhythmic slap of the waves sounds nearby and revel in the exquisite company of the sun, moon, and stars. Living by the boundless water If you feel like an even farther view, then ascend to the rooftop patio and gaze into the distance. At a glance, take in the entire coastline from Jinzun in the North to Fugang in the South. Turn toward the west and behold the mighty and continuous ridge of the mountain range. Wrapped in the embrace of both mountains and sea, forget your worries and return to the purity of yourself. With your spirit enriched and refreshed by nature, the exhaustion you brought with you has long since disappeared without a trace. At Coastline Azure, put contentment back in your step as you walk abreast the mountains and the sea and embark on your next journey.

stays.name: Date with happiness
stays.description: Indulging in this clear blue sky while soaring amongst the natural green mountains, this is the natural scenery and happiness. The sky and the mountains outside the windows become one, the gloomy mood suddenly becomes bright without the obstacles of urban skyscrapers; enjoy the super mountain and sea views, the vast grassland, together with the leisurable air, which further offers a cozy and comfortable sentiment of home, hence happiness fills the heart. Although one cannot take home the scenery seen along the way in a journey, but one may return with loads of memories. I have a date with happiness.

stays.name: Henanban B&B
stays.description: An unexpected encounter with the pure land of scenery. Following a long period of consideration, we decided to create it - Sea View Bed and Breakfast. Fall in love with this pure land, roam through the beauty of the mountains and sea, and having being amazed and surprised, accept our sincere invitation to return to the joy and pulse of nature. Find a reason and provide an opportunity to respond to the call of the mountains and sea. Each day, the color of the beautiful, expansive, deep-blue seacoast stretches out into the distance, and the sun shines bright over the Taitung coastline. Travel the long coastline and embrace the natural scenery of sea and mountains. The layered scenery of sea and mountains along Provincial Highway No. 11 possesses an intoxicating beauty. Top attractions along the highway include Dulan, Donghe, and Chenggong. From south to north, the entire area is filled with scenic beauty, and each of the rest spots is worth taking a break to check out. Slow down and leave behind beautiful memories at Sea View Bed and Breakfast of Donghe. We welcome you to one of Taitung’s best bed and breakfasts.

stays.name: Solarhouse Homestay
stays.description: Allowing a quest follows the host& #39;s agenda and vents any negative thought all day is one of the characteristics of the Solarhouse Homestay. Unless you don& #39;t like this characteristic or you have a better place, Solarhouse Homestay should be your best choice. Want to experience the situations of venting and being lost in thought? Come to Solarhouse Homestay and we will certify it. Old Saying: We have friends coming from afar, isn& #39;t that a joy? Preparing quiet, clean and comfortable rooms for friends coming from afar to enjoy meditation rest for a few nights is truly a happy thing. Solarhouse Homestay is located in Donghe Village, Donghe Township, before the mountains and facing the sea, at 131 km of Taiwan Highway No. 11, you can find a blue house facing the Pacific Ocean in the east, Dulan Mountains in the west, tribes in the south, Mawuku River in the north. Solarhouse Homestay offers no luxury equipment in the room, only simple and comfortable furnishings; no TV, but starlight cinemas; a rock climbing field to make your mettle, and also quality bicycles to let you have a leisurely tour. Here you have the best surf spots in Taiwan, Mawuku River rafting, visiting macaques in Taiyuan Valley, sipping a cup of coffee at the land-tied island of Jinzun, and overlooking the azure Pacific Ocean from the East Coast National Scenic Area. Sharing is a joy,have a good sleep, and then enjoy the light, healthy, nutritious breakfast. The hostess has a C class bartending license and a baking certificate will prepare you a glass of drink, handmade biscuits, and special toast. The host of the house, who loves nature, is willing to share with you his experiences in natural ecosystems, from plants to animals, and covering the arts, humanities, and green building.

The changes in the weather throughout the day are amazing, and the play between ocean and sky is always of crystal clear beauty. Xinlan is a simple, slow-paced community where cats and dogs can often be seen sleeping on the roadside. At night, the shining stars and low hum of the waves will lull you into tranquil sleep in this place blessed with graces from above. We warmly invite you to this quiet yet profound place (The Treasure Bay Seaview Grace House)that is truly one of a kind.

stays.name: THE ROCK B&B
stays.description: THE ROCK B&B is located in Donghe Township, Taitung County. It leans against the towering mountains and overlooks the vast blue ocean. From a high position, it has a bird& #39;s-eye view of the Mawu Ku River and the parallel new and old East River bridges. Along the winding country roads, you can reach Donghe Old Street, which is rich in humanities. The interior and exterior walls of the B&B are made of uncarved concrete buildings. Low-key, quiet, simple and full. It is like a large stone standing on the hillside, contrasting with the imperial stone monoliths scattered on the bed of Mawu Ku River. The farmland where the B&B is located is planted with various herbs and fruit trees. The harvest is used to make agricultural products such as spices, jams and soaps. Within 30 minutes of driving, you can reach Dongheqiao Scenic Area, Jinzun Fishing Port, Lulian Island, Taiyuan Valley, the hometown of citrus, Chenggong Fishing Port, Dulan Sugar Factory Cultural and Creative Park and other places. It is a popular spot for surfing, rafting and tourism. Dashi Space hopes that travelers who stay here can feel the beauty of ultimate simplicity.

Facing the Pacific Ocean, Green Island is clearly visible, a vast garden, luxuriant flowers and trees, quiet and serene, with spacious, bright, and clean rooms. The 1st floor lounge and restaurant can accommodate up to thirty people and offers an exquisite breakfast and free coffee, Mr. Yan Changshou, musician Mr. Hu Defu, writer Lung Ying-Tai, Ovid Tzeng, Minister Bai Pei Ying, Miss Xu Lu, Mr. Yang Zhao, Professor Charles Gao, Dr. David Ho, international superstar Brigitte Lin, Hu Tingting, well-known artists Pai Ping-ping, Miss Guo Meizhu, legislator Li Fuxing , Mr. Zhou Shouxun, and Taitung County Magistrate Huang Jianting, Speaker Rao Qingling, etc., all think highly of " The Happy House." The B&B is a leisure paradise for overlooking Green Island and watching the sunrise and the moon rise.

stays.name: ミスターM ドゥラン ホームステイ
stays.description: A Secret Haven Between Mountains and Sea – Welcome to Mr. M Dulan& gt;Location: Nestled in the beautiful Dulan Tribe, a corner of Taitung& #39;s most enchanting landscape, Mr. M embraces the azure Pacific Ocean and the majestic Dulan Mountain, a veritable paradise sculpted by nature itself. Whether exploring the mountains, gazing at the sea, or immersing yourself in Dulan& #39;s unique artistic atmosphere and slow pace of life, every step is a journey of healing for both body and mind.& gt;Unique Design: Comfortable Enjoyment Mr. M Dulan& #39;s design philosophy is based on "simple and clean lines and a natural concrete style," blending local cultural elements with modern comfort. Every detail brings travelers the purest sense of relaxation. Open the window to be greeted by the gentle sea breeze and the scent of the mountains. This is not just accommodation, but a beautiful experience of returning to oneself.& gt;Explore Nature: Immerse Yourself in a Slower Pace of Life The area surrounding Mr. M Dulan boasts the magnificent Dulan Mountain Trail, secluded beaches, and local art communities. Every exploration will make you fall in love with the charm of this land. You can hop on a bicycle and leisurely cruise along the coastal highway, admiring the shimmering Pacific Ocean; or spend an afternoon exploring the charming shops, savoring Dulan& #39;s unique handcrafted crafts and local flavors; or stroll along the beach to admire the beautiful Milky Way and starry night sky.& gt;Savor the Cuisine: Experience Taitung& #39;s Local Flavors. Wander through the unique shops of Dulan& #39;s villages, where fresh local ingredients are used—every bite is imbued with the warmth and care of Taitung. In the evening, visit nearby restaurants to savor fresh seafood and indigenous cuisine, immersing your taste buds in the beauty of your journey.Come for a unique vacation experience. Whether you& #39;re traveling alone, on a romantic getaway, or spending quality time with family and friends, Mr. M Dulan is the perfect choice to relax and enjoy life. Come, slow down, listen to the whispers of the sea and the mountains, and let us warmly welcome you!

stays.name: Dongli Fang Homestay
stays.description: Tao Yuan-ming, a poet from the Jin Dynasty, wrote the following verses in his Wine Tasting Poem: "Picking chrysanthemum by the east fence, South Mountain vaguely in the distance". The sentiment portrays Dongliyuan perfectly. Guanshan Township is the largest rural town in Taitung County. The town has a beautiful park call Guanshan Water Park, the first environmental protected water park in Taiwan. It also has Taiwan& #39;s first surround-town bikeway. In addition, Guanshan Rice is also quite famous. Dongliyuan B&B is located next to the Guanshan Water Park, overlooking the Central Mountain Range and Beinan River, both are beautiful natural scenery of Guanshan that rival the famous Swiss mountains. The B&B owner runs the business like a home to give visitors the feeling of home away from home. We know you will fully enjoy your vacation here. In addition, each room has a newly added herbal steam room to provide visitors with complete relaxation and enjoyment.

stays.name: Fiesen Homestay
stays.description: Nestled in a verdant town surrounded by the Central Mountain Range and the Coastal Mountain Range, **"Füssen Guesthouse"** quietly awaits. Here, the city& #39;s hustle and bustle is shut out, leaving only the rustling of wind through the rice paddies and the purest moments for yourself, your loved ones, and friends.To allow you to embrace the joy of light, we have carefully planned the spaces, ensuring each room boasts a bright floor-to-ceiling window and a private balcony, inviting the morning light and mountain mists to be nature& #39;s alarm clock. High-quality bathroom facilities and carefully selected soft furnishings, within a minimalist design, reveal our commitment to quality, allowing you to feel the comfort and warmth of home, even when you are far away.Here, you can find a moment of slow living, share pure laughter with friends, explore the wonders of nature with your children, or stay alone for a long stay that cleanses your mind and body.In Füssen, we offer more than just accommodation; we propose a relaxed lifestyle. We invite you to bring your loved ones to this valley town and create your own heartwarming travel story.

stays.name: Off Red Mountain Park Bed and Breakfast
stays.description: We are situated in the small township of Guanshan, a place where you may experience the rural life, and feel the simplicity and wonderfulness of nature. This place is filled with green and vast garden and grassland, where your children may play happily and safely. This place features clean and simple rooms, where you may stop to take a break. This place is surrounded by mountains afar, with vast rice fields at close distance, where you may listen to the wind, enjoy the mountains, watch the clouds and admire the waves of the rice crops from the alfresco balcony, and even see the “running train” passing through the rice fields. This place has fresh and unique Taitung coffee, allowing you to experience the leisurable and comfortable life. This place is non-busy, non-crowded and non-sophisticated, it is a simple and tranquil place that makes people feel happy.

stays.name: STROLLING YUEMEI HOMESTAY
stays.description: Strolling Yuemei Homestay is a stand-alone elevator villa located in Guanshan, Taitung. It is located on a small hilly terrain with a quiet and peaceful environment. Each room has a balcony, and the scenery is magnificent while also being delicate and elegant.The owner of the B&B is hospitable but not overly enthusiastic. He hopes that every visiting guest can feel as comfortable as at home. There are small corners carefully arranged and decorated by the hostess throughout the house, so that every guest can find his favorite place to relax.We treat our guests like friends. We installed an elevator to make it possible for the whole family to travel together. All guest rooms use independent spring mattresses, hoping that visitors can have a good night's sleep after fully enjoying the beauty and hospitality of the east. We do not use wall-mounted hair dryers, which shows the hostess's thoughtfulness towards guests with long hair. We cannot provide the facilities and services of a five-star hotel, but our cleanliness and tidiness are definitely not inferior. If you like beautiful scenery, a quiet and peaceful environment, or the ease of visiting a friend, you are sincerely welcome to come and visit us.

stays.name: Xiama Homestay
stays.description: The beauty of the Southern Cross-Island Highway can only be truly appreciated by experiencing it firsthand. The eastern section of the highway is comprised of numerous magnificent natural landscapes, coupled with the rustic charm of the Bunun indigenous people, making every stretch of the Southern Cross-Island Highway unique. Driving along the winding highway, you& #39;ll be surrounded by lush green trees, and the unique, refreshing mountain breeze will invigorate you! You can leisurely drive at a slow pace, enjoying the scenery along the way. If you& #39;re lucky, you might even spot the Formosan Blue Magpie, its silhouette like a blue ribbon flying past!Xia Ma Hot Spring B&B is located at Xia Ma on the Southern Cross-Island Highway. The environment is tranquil and serene, and the B&B offers a variety of room types, allowing you to soothe your travel fatigue on a slightly cool mountain night. Unlike typical family-run B&Bs, each room is thoughtfully designed, offering spacious living areas and en-suite bathroom facilities, making it the perfect choice for your Southern Cross-Island Highway stay.Xia Ma B&B warmly welcomes you! Please join us in experiencing the beauty of the Southern Cross-Island Highway!

stays.name: Ma chawu Homestay
stays.description: "Ma chawu" in Pinayuanan means "Excellent" The owner was a teacher before. She attended a beverage preparation course for some reason. After she learned the techniques, she prepared one cup of tea for her husband someday. Her husband felt tasty after drinking and said "Ma chawu" to praise her! After the owner obtained the certificate of beverage preparation, she established a beverage shop named "Ma chawu" in her village, offering tea, snacks, coffee, and locally produced fruit/vegetable juice which are loved by neighbors and visitors alike. From the very beginning, the “Ma chawu Homestay” was a beverage store. Later, the owner started realizing that the Sapulju Tribal Village where he lives is an environment mingling beautiful natural scenery and abundant crops that outsiders visit frequently. To provide more complete services, the owner and her husband began the plan to run a homestay service. The brand-new “Ma chawu Homestay” is located at a site facing the sea and embraced by the hill at the foot of Jing Jeng Mountain. It overlooks the Pacific Ocean to welcome the first dawn in Eastern Taiwan. The homestay is simple, clean-cut and colorful in outer appearance in presenting stylish artistic beauty. Native indigenous features give this innovative and modern homestay an authentic local touch. The “Ma chawu Homestay” is a B&B facility full of native features. By combining agricultural and indigenous art, it provides a cozy residential environment. Guests can also savor local agricultural produce and delicately prepared beverages to experience the native culture. Come and visit “Ma chawu Homestay”. It provides you an experience that combines stunning views, wonderful flavors, spiritual relaxation, and soulful joy.

stays.name: TjiljuveKang art & leisure house
stays.description: "Jilufugan Art and Culture Homestay" is located in the Sabuyou Tribe of Xinxing Village, Jinfeng Township, nestled between mountains and the sea. Upon entering the village, a striking artwork depicting a thorny ball, a symbol of Paiwan traditional culture, immediately catches the eye in front of the homestay. The building itself is a two-story reinforced concrete structure, constructed with traditional stone slabs.The homestay owner& #39;s late mother (Hu Shunli) was one of the eight chieftains of the Sabuyou Tribe (of the Skado family). She personally carved and painted traditional Paiwan cultural life on the wooden pillars at the entrance, the main pillars inside, the eaves, and the interior walls. She also depicted her memories of the old tribe and its life in paintings, using the walls of the house as her canvas.The homestay owner, Wu Jiuzi, said that she initially wanted to run "Jilufugan Art and Culture Homestay" to commemorate her late mother& #39;s dedication to traditional culture. She has also displayed her mother& #39;s belongings and traditional Paiwan artifacts in a showcase. It also allows visitors to gain a deeper understanding of Paiwan culture, so the house is decorated with many Paiwan cultural installations and artworks, making it feel like a small indigenous cultural exhibition hall.

stays.description: Hai Bolang from Lanyu went to Taiwan to work when he was young. He fought hard and every time he saved some money, he would return to Lanyu to build "Haibang& #39;s home". When the money ran out, he would return to Taiwan to start over and save more money. So, the foundation, the four walls of the first floor, the bathroom and kitchen on the first floor, the stairs from the first floor to the second floor, the rooms on the second floor... In this way, he went back and forth between Lanyu and Taiwan, piling up one part and one corner at a time... Now, nine years later, "Haibang& #39;s home" is finally completed.

We not only provide accommodation, but also a warm base for travelers to meet and leave stories with each other.Every morning, a pot of hot coffee is prepared, waiting for you to watch the sea and refresh your mind with the breeze. There is an honesty store here 24 hours a day, with instant noodles, snacks, and drinks. You can eat whatever you want. Just remember to pay.? Room introduction?️ 8-person backpacker bed roomSuitable for you who love to meet friends and go on a trip.Independent bed curtains, sockets and reading lights allow you to maintain your personal space and make friends.?‍?‍?‍? Quadruple Single Bed RoomThe first choice for short trips with good sisters, family, and friends, with four single beds + private bathroom, it is super comfortable to live, laugh, and have fun together.? Large double roomA world for couples or besties, with an extra-large double bed and private bathroom, clean and comfortable, with the sunshine and sea breeze of Lanyu just outside the window.? Location: Red Head Village, Lanyu, within walking distance to the beach, convenience stores, and food stalls☕ Free hot coffee in the morning to help you wake up slowly? 24-hour coin-operated honesty store?️ Lobby social space, there is always someone to chat? Daily disinfection, clean environmentComing to Lanyu is not just to see the sea, but to meet warm people and leave a story.Hi Hai Backpacker Inn is waiting for you to stay, chat and travel.

stays.description: The rooms at Lanyu Haixing B&B were originally the daughters' rooms and the Japanese-style hall where they played with each other. As the children grew up and left home to study or work, the originally noisy sounds gradually quieted down... The father and mother of the Starfish B&B loved their children very much, and gave the room with the best view outside the window to their children. Just by looking out of the window of the room, you can see the sunrise, Prayer Mountain, Lover's Cave, Dongqing Bay, the Dawn Sculpture Pillar, etc. When you fall asleep at night, you can hear the sounds of frogs, insects and waves. We hope to share this comfortable living environment with everyone. Are you ready to come live in my house~GO!

stays.description: The B&B Mutian located in Taitung County is located in the Dongqing tribe. For the owner, this building is a reminder of the strong connection with home. With this belief, he returned to the place where his roots were rooted. Based on the island's diverse natural and cultural heritage, and the motivation to miss his relatives, he built this living space step by step. The beach in front of the B&B is the perfect place to enjoy the most beautiful sunrise and experience paddle boarding. It is nearby famous attractions such as Lover's Cave and Secret Land. In front of the B&B is the only Dongqing Night Market on the island. There is a 7-11 (ATM), breakfast and restaurant within a 2-minute walk, making it the most convenient choice for travelers.
