stays.name: Original Tribe Exquisite B&B
stays.description: The origin of Lanyu B&B "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B", "DO ji mi ney li Original Tribe"? It is said that this area was originally a small settlement. Hundreds of years ago, this small settlement was buried by the soil sliding down the slope above, so the residents here moved to the Dongqing tribe. After a long time, we returned to this place and built the "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B" with reinforced concrete. In order to commemorate the ancestors who once lived here, the B&B was named "DO ji mi ney li& #39;s original living tribe". This is the origin of the "Original Tribe Exquisite B&B".Our B&B "Yuanbu Village Exquisite B&B" recommends high-quality rooms with Lanyu sea and mountain views. It is located in Dongqing Village on the east side of Lanyu. Accommodation introduction: the B&B room types include double suites, six-person suites, and one love suite. The bathroom threshold has been changed to a flat type, specially designed with barrier-free facilities and movable safety handrails. The door has also been widened to facilitate electric wheelchairs to enter and exit. The bathroom door uses a horizontal pull design, which is easy for the elderly or disabled friends to push open.The entire space of "Yuanbu B&B" is 3.45 meters high. The stairs for going up and down are designed with night fluorescent light strips to provide guidance in the event of a power outage. There are also escape indicator LED lights and night LED lighting, flame-proof curtains, fire-fighting equipment, etc. Our original intention is to make the guests who come to stay feel at ease and relaxed.The beautiful island of Lanyu is the best place in Taiwan to watch the first light of dawn. You don& #39;t have to go out to watch the sunrise when staying at the "Original Tribe B&B". Just gently open the curtains and you can see the beautiful sunrise in the sea view room. The mountain view room is even farther away from the hustle and bustle of the city, allowing you to wash away the fatigue of your body and soul and relax your body. The "Original Tribe B&B" is surrounded by mountains and rivers, with a broad view and beautiful scenery. The balcony of the sea view room has a view of the endless sea, with green mountains and green waters behind it, and vegetation surrounding the entire hill. It only takes about 5 minutes to walk from the B&B to the Dongqing Night Market and 7-11 convenience store. It has good living functions and convenient access, making it your best choice.

stays.name: lraraley229 Fa Ge& #39;s Homestay
stays.description: Irately Fa Ge& #39;s Homestay (Introduction)The name of Lanyu, Parsley, means a warm and polite place.Before the road was opened, Lang Island was a must-go place for residents of the Dongqing Tribe and the Coconut Oil Tribe.Therefore, the Langdao tribe, which greets everyone they meet in a friendly manner, is known as a polite tribe.The Langdao tribe is located between the Coconut Oil tribe and the Dongqing tribe. It has the largest territory among the six tribes. The tribe has more strange rocks and stones than other tribes, and the living area is flat.It is divided into the lower tribe and the upper tribe. The lower tribe is currently a space for the elderly to live in.The cement public housing previously built by the government was built at the foot of the mountain above the tribe, called the upper tribe, which is where young people live, forming a contrast between traditional underground houses and modern cement houses and two generations.The tribe& #39;s cultivated land is on the left and right sides of the tribe, and the hillside behind is an orchard. The Langdao tribe has a large hinterland, with a wide intertidal zone and endless sea in front.The beach in front of the lower tribe was set aside as a place for ceremonial activities such as the Fish Attraction Festival.lraraley Fa Ge& #39;s Home B&B is located in the upper residential area, with the mountain behind and the sea in front, quiet in the hustle and bustle, and you can enjoy the sunrise in the east and the sunset in the west. There is a lush green forest on the back mountain. There is no gorgeous decoration design inside Fa Ge& #39;s Home B&B, but it is presented to the guests in a simple, elegant and natural living style. It is a passionate, heroic and story-telling local. It took more than three years to build. There are three rooms in total, one double suite and two Japanese-style rooms with dormitories. It is also the warmest homestay choice for bird watching groups, divers, academic researchers, and friends and relatives, as well as families who bring their children to Lanyu for tourism.16:29 2228 Fa Ge& #39;s Homestay Reservation Hotline: 0919-846601LINE ：ID:franks1225

stays.name: 13 Live country house
stays.description: 13 Inn is a stand alone vacation house located on the gentle slopes of the northernmost corner of Luye Township, Taitung County. The leisure and relaxing environment overlooks the Guanshan and Chishang plains nearby. The simple and rustic countryside doesn& #39;t have luxurious houses, just natural and simple grass fields and Taiwan& #39;s native plants. The rich, diverse ecology and greenery here make 13 Inn vacation house a unique place to experience the rustic and simple lifestyle. The architecture style of 13 Inn is simple and minimal. The space inside is divided into living room, dining room and kitchen, and there are large sliding doors that allow you to see the outdoors almost in every corner of the house. The clear shallow outdoor pool reflects the blue sky. The comfortable and roomy house has a lot of natural lights, simple and modern furnishings, and an open kitchen. 13 Inn is a private home made available to folks to rent as a vacation home. It only receives one group of guests a day. Therefore, touring is not accepted in order to avoid disturbing the guests. Currently, only reservations made over the phone are accepted. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

stays.name: Luye Jamie's House
stays.description: Hello backpackers! If you plan to visit Taitung, then come and stay at "Luye Jamie's Guesthouse"!In addition to being a cozy backpacker's inn, the breakfast here is not to be missedWe use natural ingredients from Taitung and cook them with Jamie’s cooking skills, so you can taste the original flavor and care of the ingredients.As soon as you enter the "Luye Jamie's Guesthouse", you can feel the warmth just in the lounge. There are many postcards sent back by travelers who have stayed here on the wall, and each one contains the memories of each traveler.During his stay in Luye, Jie Mi made many friends and often got the good local ingredients they grew.Jie Mi, who is interested in cooking, uses these ingredients to make meals, such as bread, jam, vegetables, etc.This "Good Morning Deer" combines good local ingredients provided by friendly farmers, and is true to the natural flavor of the ingredients.Guests can purchase a vegetarian breakfast for $200 per person, while non-guests can purchase a vegetarian breakfast for $350 per person. Breakfast is available from 8:00 to 10:00 in the morning.

stays.name: Qiao Daotian Homestay
stays.description: Location and Transportation• Location: Located at No. 10, Lane 298, Zhongshan Road, Ruifeng Village, Luye Township, Taitung County, near the 340 km mark of Provincial Highway 9 (Huadong Highway), it offers convenient transportation and easy access to Luye and Guanshan.• Train: Approximately a 5-minute drive from Ruihe Station.• Driving: Directly access the property by turning onto Zhongshan Road from Provincial Highway 9.Accommodation Style and Atmosphere• Architectural Features: This single-family villa-style B&B features a spacious courtyard, allowing guests to relax and enjoy the outdoors.• Style: The rooms are simple, quiet, elegant, and warm, reflecting the understated, tranquil atmosphere of Taitung& #39;s countryside. The lush greenery reflected through the windows adds to the tranquil and rustic feel.• Scenic Features: The B&B courtyard offers views of Luye Highland, grasslands, and hot air balloons, creating a romantic and exotic experience.Accommodation Services and Regulations• Services:• Chinese breakfast (7:00–8:30 AM)• Tour assistance• Pick-up service (Guanshan and Luye Train Stations).• BBQ area, orchard (free seasonal fruit picking), and water dispenser (tea and coffee bags provided).• Check-in: After 3:00 PM, check-out before 11:00 AM.• Reservations and Payment:• Reservations must be confirmed by phone. A deposit of 50ï¼ of the room rate (full payment required during the Spring Festival) must be remitted within 3 days and confirmed by phone.• Cancellation, extension, and refund policies are subject to the B&B& #39;s official announcement.• Accommodation Notes:• No pets, smoking, betel nut chewing, or drinking alcohol are allowed indoors.• No noise after 10:00 PM.• Please present your ID and pay the remaining balance upon check-in.Recommended Travel Experiences• Geographical Advantage: Located in the heart of the East Rift Valley, Luye is close to many attractions, including Luye Highland, hot air ballooning venues, tea plantations, and bike paths, making it a great choice for nature lovers and those seeking relaxation.• Recommended Activities: Enjoy hot air ballooning, strolling through the tea plantations at Luye Highland, cycling, or exploring the idyllic countryside of Luye.

stays.name: Good Viewing Spot B&B
stays.description: Green Island "Good Viewing Spot B&B" sits at the middle of Gongguan Bay (Village), the landing site of the first settlers. The early residents lived in straw huts, then coral stone houses, and subsisted on agriculture and fishing. Local tourism has brought opportunities, and "Good Viewing Spot B&B" was planned and built on the site of some old buildings, and eventually, started operation at the end of June 2014. The business is run by the seventh generation of the Tien family, the owner, to ensure service quality and as a display of love to the homeland. The host hopes your journey can be more interesting with a good place to rest and taking your time to enjoy yourself, instead of worrying about the time of the returning ferry as soon as you reach here! Mind you, the starry sky and sunrise at Gongguan Bay are mesmerizing! Traveling is not a marathon, walk slower and you will notice more of the beauty around you.

Green Island "Good Viewing Spot B&B" sits at the middle of Gongguan Bay (Village), the landing site of the first settlers. The early residents lived in straw huts, then coral stone houses, and subsisted on agriculture and fishing. Local tourism has brought opportunities, and "Good Viewing Spot B&B" was planned and built on the site of some old buildings, and eventually, started operation at the end of June 2014. The business is run by the seventh generation of the Tien family, the owner, to ensure service quality and as a display of love to the homeland. The host hopes your journey can be more interesting with a good place to rest and taking your time to enjoy yourself, instead of worrying about the time of the returning ferry as soon as you reach here! Mind you, the starry sky and sunrise at Gongguan Bay are mesmerizing! Traveling is not a marathon, walk slower and you will notice more of the beauty around you.

The entire length of the Green Island Ring Road is only about 20 kilometers, so two days and one night is enough for you to visit all the attractions. The "Green Island Green Embankment Cafe" located in Nanliao Village can not only help you plan a series of entertainment itineraries, but also make proper arrangements for you in terms of restaurants or BBQs and hotels or B&Bs. In addition, for snorkeling, "Green Embankment" also provides a complete set of equipment and arranges professional and responsible instructors to be on hand, allowing you to have a relaxing and safe experience during this Green Island trip. In terms of accommodation, Green Island Green Embankment has prepared a comfortable resting space for travelers. The furnishings are simple yet warm, creating a refreshing and elegant island taste. Without excessive packaging and embellishment, it welcomes every friend who comes to visit "Green Island Green Embankment" with its most natural side. In addition, Green Island "Green Dike" also provides motorcycle rental services, and regularly maintains all motorcycles. At the same time, it also provides additional insurance for players who rent motorcycles, so that you can enjoy safety protection while having fun. When everything is ready, all that’s missing is a happy heart. On the “Green Island” without a trace of restraint, please release your most natural and pure enthusiasm to every piece of land that belongs to the Green Island. stays.name: Dan Di Jin Lun Hot Spring Homestay
stays.description: Located in Taitung County, Taimali Township, in the Jilun Hot Spring area, a traditional Paiwan tribe village. Danti Hot Spring Inn is situated beside Jilun Creek, adjacent to the original Jilun natural hot spring. The hot spring is a typical valley-type hot spring, with bicarbonate-rich water (formerly known as sodium bicarbonate spring), also containing trace amounts of sulfur. Each guest room has a private hot spring bath. Amenities include breakfast, a public hot spring pool, airport/train station pick-up service, Wi-Fi, and cable TV. The public hot spring pool is for guests who wish to enjoy a soak; bathers must bring their own swimwear, swim cap, and other necessary items. There are two hot spring pools of different sizes, and one large cold water pool.

stays.description: Our hotel is nestled in Jinlun, a serene coastal area of Taimali Township in Taitung, where the healing power of the ocean seamlessly blends with the soothing effects of hot springs, offering you a unique holiday experience.The hotel features a total of 36 guest rooms and a restaurant, complete with a saline hot spring pool. This allows you to enjoy a special hot spring bathing experience while on vacation. Rich in bicarbonate, iron, and beneficial trace elements and minerals, the saline hot spring can soothe your mind and body, moisturize your skin, and provide anti-aging health benefits, delivering an unprecedented wellness experience.Whether you are seeking natural healing or a retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city, our hotel is your ideal choice. Our rooms offer a view of the sea and the Jinlun Bridge, known as "Taiwan& #39;s Most Beautiful Viaduct." You can enjoy the warmth of a private hot spring bath while admiring the azure Pacific Ocean and the beauty of the sunrise. Let the hot springs and the power of the East Coast heal your soul and body, taking you into a truly relaxing world.

stays.name: Mavaliw Backpacker Inn
stays.description: Forty years ago, this home was born. Named “Mavaliw” in the Paiwan language, it means “being blown by the wind,” symbolizing a home that can withstand the wind and stand firm, and reminding us that each of us, on our life’s journey, is someone who needs to be shaped by the wind. Life is a journey filled with changing winds and waves, and no matter what kind of wind you are facing, today we meet here on the land of Jinlun. May this place become a stop for rest, reflection, and regaining your strength. Our guesthouse offers a mixed-gender backpacker 8-bed dormitory with bunk beds, suitable for solo travelers, backpackers, and those who enjoy connecting with fellow travelers. The space is simple and comfortable, where stories and moments are shared under one roof. NT$700 per person / per bed / per night, with special discounts available for full-house bookings. Welcome to add our official LINE account for reservations and inquiries, and to receive the latest availability and offers.

stays.name: Tte Forgetworry Hotel
stays.description: The Forget Worry Villa is located at the most beautiful part of Taiwan’s South-Link Line. Staying at the villa, you can enjoy both ocean and mountain views. The Mediterranean style resort villa is decorated with colors of sky and sprinkled with white to create the atmosphere of Greek sea line. The blue dome and white building reflects the waves from ocean, arched window frame makes you feel right in the Mediterranean Ocean. You can enjoy a cozy afternoon lying on the poolside chairs on the balcony feeling the sea breeze. At night, bed times will be watched over by the starry sky. You should relax and slow down your pace when you arrive at the villa. Close your eyes and listen to the nature’s symphony, feel the sea breeze, and leave all the agony and sorrow behind and indulge yourself in Mediterranean to enjoy the peacefulness and leisure. The Forget Worry Villa is in Taitung’s Tai Mai Li district, neighboring Provincial Highway 9. The villa is conveniently located near the popular attractions such as the Kinluan Hot Spring, fields of lily flowers; or you can follow the beautiful landscape South Link Line to other attractions in Taichung. The Forget Worry Villa offers Twin Rooms, Quad Rooms, and Family Suites. The comfortable room space is elegantly decorated with natural lighting and beautiful scenery, demonstrating fresh and daintiness. Guests can leave behind all the worries and feel like staying at paradise.

stays.name: ChengDing B&B
stays.description: Introduction to Chengdian B&BIndigo, still and bright blue, the sky in Taitung is always clean and clear.After a while, when the car slowly drove into Nanhui, my mood began to settle down, and I finally returned to Taitung, where I thought about it day and night, to calm down physically and mentally.The B&B is located next to Taitung Airport. It is equipped with an elevator, four double rooms, and two parking spaces. It is suitable for family travel. It has an oversized living room, an island kitchen, and a large dining table for 8 people. The design adopts IKEA Nordic style.The fourth floor is a family room with windows on both sides. To the north, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Dulan Mountain, known as Mount Fuji in Taitung. The west window can enjoy the turbulent scenery of the Central Mountains. The large terrace in front can overlook the Pacific Ocean and Green Island. In the evening The hour is accompanied by colorful sunset.The front of the third floor is the brother's room. There is a small independent balcony and floor-to-ceiling windows in front, which provide bright lighting and excellent views.Behind the third floor is the younger brother's room, and behind the second floor is the parents' room, with windows on both sides, making the space bright.Since childhood, the owner of the B&B has liked the whole family to have homely conversations at the dining table and cook and eat slowly, so there is no TV in the dining space. This is how the family's feelings are accumulated and nourished. There is a comfortable leather sofa in the living room, where three generations can enjoy the sofa movie theater together, or sisters can chat over a glass of red wine in comfort.There are large windows in the living room, and there is a Japanese garden outside the window, with grass, stone steps and various potted flowers running around. You will be in a good mood when you wake up early in the morning.If you are a camping fan, the large terrace on the fourth floor can definitely satisfy your mood. You can enjoy barbecue in a separate space. The barbecue supplies can be brought up by the elevator for you without having to take the stairs. There is also a dishwasher for the finished cups and plates. Do it for you.​

stays.name: Emerald Homestay
stays.description: We are located in the suburbs of Taitung City, offering a standalone "courtyard vacation house" with private access and easy parking. Just 10 minutes from the city center, Tiehua Village, Zhonghua Road shopping district, Showtime Cinemas, PX Mart flagship store, Blue Dragonfly Fried Chicken, Banyan Tree Rice Noodles, and Zhengqi Tourist Night Market. Enjoy fresh air and a comfortable resting space. Please allow us to introduce you to the beauty of Taitung and let’s enjoy the blue skies of Taitung together.The owner personally designed the space with gentle, understated tones—nothing flashy. The high ceilings create a relaxing atmosphere. In the living room, there is a massage chair (sanitized regularly) as a thoughtful little service for those driving or riding motorcycles. We provide oversized beds to ensure travelers can rest comfortably—small details but very important. We look forward to welcoming travelers to experience the happiness of Taitung.Our green-themed guesthouse is located in Taitung City but without the crowding of the urban area. Just 10 minutes to the golden city center. We are a standalone courtyard house with neighbors nearby. There’s a FamilyMart convenience store close by, and the airport is only 1.3 kilometers away. Perfect for vacationers, small families, and motorcycle enthusiasts (safe parking for your beloved bikes). Renting the entire house for weddings or banquets is also a great option.The guesthouse is spotless inside and out because the owner loves cleanliness. We hope you come here to feel the simplicity, warmth, and relaxed lifestyle of Taitung. Most importantly, the owner warmly welcomes guests to share this space and invites you to chat whenever you have time. We welcome you to visit and share your travel experiences with us.Green rice fields and blue skies await you!

stays.name: Formosan Naruwan Hotel & Resort Taitung
stays.description: Naruwan is a greeting word which means “ How are you?” and “Welcome!” in Taiwan aboriginal language, just like “Aloha” in Hawaii. Name the hotel ‘Formosan Naruwan Hotel Taitung’, we are greeting all guests with the highest passion. Taitung as the Native town of the sun makes sunshine as our greatest assets. At the initiative concept of designation, we took a ladder-shaped design and use great measure of glass to take in the brilliant sunshine and scenery; hence the similar pyramid building becomes a new landmark in Taitung. Containing modern fashion and aboriginal culture, Formosan Naruwan Hotel Taitung is a genuine artwork. The four pillars in front of the facade are 9 meter height and the material is sandstone from ShanshiProvince of mainland China. On the pillars, it tells the history of Taiwan aboriginal tribes, Lu-Kai, Dao, Puyuma and Amis.

stays.name: Healing space
stays.description: Here lies a story that belongs to the host of this guesthouse and this land. The host grew up in the urban tribal area of Keelung, a mixed heritage of Han and Amis descent, and has always felt a deep sense of pride in their indigenous identity. When tribal friends spoke about returning to their homeland, it sparked a longing to reconnect with their roots. Carrying this hope, they came to Taitung, only to find themselves without connections or a guide to lead them back to the tribe. Life in Taitung was lonely at times until one day, the companionship of cats brought a sense of comfort. The unconditional love and support of these animals provided a familiar warmth on this unfamiliar land and became the inspiration for creating this guesthouse. Through **Healing Cats Café and Guesthouse**, the host hopes that every traveler who visits can not only experience the healing presence of animals but also discover the beauty of indigenous culture. Here, they wish for every visitor to relax their hearts and feel the warmth that flows deep from this land.

stays.name: Heart Sea Homestay
stays.description: The vastest thing in the world is the ocean. Even more vast than the ocean is the sky, and even more vast than the sky is the human heart.After surviving the devastation of a typhoon, starting from scratch was no easy task. I persevered for four years, experiencing hardships, reluctance, and even tears. But facing this vast ocean, a voice always encouraged me: Don& #39;t give up! Keep persevering! Finally, I have the vastness of my heart I feel today. Although life isn& #39;t always perfect, no difficulty is greater than the ocean, no setback is broader than the sky. Only by stepping out of your own heart can you unlock limitless possibilities. May you and I enjoy the beauty of nature. Welcome here to create beautiful memories together!Nearby attractions: Forest Park and Live Water Lake are a 5-minute drive away, Seaside Park is directly in front, the city is a 3-minute drive away, and Tomioka Fish Port is a 15-minute drive away.

stays.name: Im here B&B
stays.description: The sisters who grew up in the back mountains of Taitung had to leave their hometown for study and employment, and came to the unfamiliar metropolis of Taipei. They lived a busy life all day long...but they always appreciated the slow and elegant life in Taitung, so they decided to return to their hometown to work hard and share the slow-paced life attitude and warm human touch with you~"Taitung B&B‧Ai Xier B&B" is a single-family building. The exterior is composed of a variety of ever-changing geometric shapes, showing a fashionable and novel special shape. The interior space is strong and colorful wall colors, with different themed styling scenes and exquisite and elegant styling decorations, exuding the quiet atmosphere of Taitung& #39;s back mountains. It is an excellent place for you to relax when visiting Taitung."Taitung Bed and Breakfast - Ashley Bed and Breakfast" is located near Taitung Railway Station, and can be easily reached in just 5 minutes on foot. It is also conveniently accessible to popular attractions that travelers must visit, such as Beinan Cultural Park, Taitung Forest Park, and Makabahai Park. Whether you are a free-spirited backpacker or a self-driving traveler, you can enjoy the unrestrained elegance and leisure here.

stays.name: Jia Hui Homestay
stays.description: JiaHui Homestay is a legal homestay with homestay certificate, Taitung County No. 0686. It is located in Taitung downtown, and takes less than a 10-minute walk for you to enjoy various famous Taiwanese snacks, such as pork blood jelly soup, Baosang Tang Yuan, Mi Tai Mu. It is also within convenient distance from Seashore Park, Tiehua Music Village and Taitung Railway Art Village. The tourists can not only absorb the spectacular scenery of Taitung but also leave the hustle and bustle city life behind to enjoy the tranquility. Jia Hui Homestay is a new building with a modern design. It is characterized by earthy, black and gray tones to present agreat vitality. The lobby is spacious while the guest rooms are elegant, which we kept in a simple style . We retained the original layout of the building and furnished it with complete furniture to offer the travelers a warm and comfortable space.

stays.name: Jinglan Small Homestay
stays.description: "Located on the Taiwan-Kowloon-B route, Jinglan Small House is a short 15-minute journey to the mountains or to the beach. The mountains, seas and food in Taitung will make people miss and come back again and again. The place.For friends who like to travel in Taitung, arrange a place where you can relax and have a good night's sleep. The room is full of sunshine and flowing wind, and the air has the fragrance of natural life. After eating the breakfast carefully prepared by the butler, it is full of ingredients that are nourished and grown in Taitung’s sunshine, and then go out to enjoy the sunny weather after a full meal. There is no scheduled itinerary, because there are scenery everywhere. In addition, Jinglanjia also has outdoor tea banquet activities, you can book in advance to taste the tea taste nourished by local tea farmers. #Assam #Old CamelliaAll these memories of the terroir, food, and beautiful mountains and rivers are no wonder people say that the land in Taitung is sticky.There is no TV equipment in Jinglan’s house. There are many better activities to participate in here than watching TV. At home, you are also welcome to listen to carefully collected music, read a book, eat a meal seriously, and feel the locality and life. The comfort in other places is the best travel.Welcome to call and make an appointment at 089383026 or search for Jinglan Small Residential Private Message to make a reservation. I look forward to seeing you and come to live in a relaxed way. "

stays.name: KHOSTEL
stays.description: K2 Hostel is conveniently located in Taitung City, just 800 meters from the train station. Designed with a focus on practicality and warmth, the interiors feature minimalist wooden decor, creating a cozy and natural ambiance. The bunk bed setup maximizes space efficiency, with each bed equipped with a personal curtain to ensure privacy and comfort. The women’s dorm includes a Japanese-style low table and seating area, perfect for relaxing, reading, or playing games with travel companions. Small windows on the walls bring in natural light, making the space bright and inviting. Each room is also equipped with a simple clothes rack and a waste bin, catering to essential needs and highlighting the convenience of light travel. The overall atmosphere is modest yet comfortable, making K2 Hostel an excellent choice for backpackers and small groups seeking a simple, homey stay and a pleasant travel experience.

stays.name: Li Ho Bun B&B
stays.description: Introduction of Li Ho Mantou B&BAs a sports enthusiast, I often go to various counties and cities to participate in road running, triathlon, and bicycle competitions. Being able to live comfortably or meeting the owner of a homestay who also loves sports can often add better memories to this journey. The seed of wanting to run a sports-friendly homestay was planted in my heart.LiHo Mantou B&B is located in downtown Taitung. It has a light industrial design with four rooms, two four-person rooms and two three-person rooms. 24-hour hot water, Wi-Fi, and each room has its own bathroom.LiHo Mantou B&B is located in the last piece of pure land in Taiwan, which is located in the good mountains, good water, but not boring. Whether you want to go to the mountain line to experience the hot air balloon at Luye Gaotai, taste the delicious Guanshan bento made with Guanshan rice, the green Brown Avenue in Chishang, or even take a beautiful photo under the big tree where the famous "Takeshi Kaneshiro" took an advertisement, Are you already looking forward to it?If you want to witness "Taitung Blue" with your own eyes, then you can& #39;t miss the sea line trip. You can enjoy the thrill of surfing in Dulan, and you can go to Donghe to eat Donghe meat buns when you are hungry! The stone umbrellas mentioned in Shen Wencheng& #39;s "Come and Go Taitung" are also worthy of your visit to explore the natural beauty of the terrain surrounded by limestone.At night, you don’t have to worry about having nowhere to go. You can walk for about 10 minutes to Tiehua Village to shop at the special market, or go to the Taitung Night Market to fill up the Wu Zang Temple. Couples can even go to the Star Tribe on County Road 197 to see the beauty. night view of Taitung.If you are also a fan of triathlon, you must not miss it. The best venue for triathlon is Living Water Lake. You can experience the feeling of living water lake different from the competition. LiHo B&B is really the best place for you to come to Taitung choose!

stays.name: Lingering Garden B&B
stays.description: "A good house should be shared with travellers and friends," said the owner of the B&B. Even though many people think it is a pity to turn such a beautiful house into a B&B, the owner still holds the heart of sharing, providing a good environment and high-quality and considerate services to establish a relationship with past travelers. This "Liuyuan B&B" named after the male owner, Qing Liu, coincides with the Liuyuan Garden, one of the four famous gardens in China, and has a quiet and elegant atmosphere. Each room has a comfortable balcony with a view of the clouds and waterfalls of Dulan Mountain. Not only that, Liuyuan B&B is very convenient to the airport, train station and various attractions in the city, and behind it is the Iron Horse Trail, where tourists can take a leisurely walk and appreciate the beauty of Taitung.

stays.name: Little Angel Homestay
stays.description: The Taitung B&B "Little Angel B&B" is located in the city. It is conveniently located. Many well-known attractions and local snacks in Taitung City are within walking distance. You can also taste Taitung's must-eat Laodong Taimi in 3 minutes' walk. Taimu, Lin's stinky tofu, Baosang glutinous rice balls and the finger-licking blue dragonfly. In addition, if you want to go to Taitung Railway Art Village or take a walk to Tiehua Village at night to experience local art creation, it only takes 10 to 15 minutes to walk.The Taitung B&B "Little Angel B&B" is designed with a modern Japanese-style architectural style. It also has a green back garden. The public space on the first floor is mainly a spacious and bright rest area and an open kitchen, with large floor-to-ceiling windows. Instead of cold walls, natural light is introduced to make the interior brighter. There are tables and chairs placed by the window, where you can enjoy a cup of coffee and read a book.The room types of Taitung B&B "Little Angel B&B" mainly include warm and comfortable double rooms and quadruple rooms. The living space is simple and elegant, and the wooden decoration adds a warm element to the interior. The bathroom adopts dry and wet separation and TOTO WASHLET series, and the drinking water is treated with soft water. The machine allows travelers here to drink water with more peace of mind.

stays.name: Makapahay Creative
stays.description: Makapahay Creative is the native language of the Amis people, which means very good, very beautiful, and great. We are located in the Malan Tribe in the center of Taitung City, which is a traditional Amis settlement area. The exterior uses the unique cement relief painting technique of the Rukai and Paiwan people to express the beauty of traditional totems and culture. The installation art in the backyard of the lobby arcade uses the Amis culture as the background, and uses stones from Taiwan and Hualien to paste a beautiful painting of the Amis warrior dance. The construction period lasted for nine months. It is a very delicate and attentive work that shows the beauty of authenticity.

stays.description: Manman B&B is a boutique B&B located in Zhiben, Taitung. It has five individually designed guest rooms, creating a comfortable and warm accommodation experience for travelers. Manman B&B adheres to the concept of "slow down and enjoy the moment" and combines Taitung& #39;s local characteristics and beautiful natural landscape to provide travelers from all over the world with an ideal place to relax physically and mentally.The interior of the B&B adopts a simple yet elegant design style. Each room has a unique style. Looking out from the large windows, you can enjoy the beautiful scenery of Zhiben& #39;s mountains and sea. The surrounding environment of the B&B is quiet and it is very convenient to Zhiben Hot Spring Area, local night market and many natural attractions. Whether you want to relax in a hot spring or explore Taitung culture in depth, Manman B&B can meet your needs.Let us take you away from the hustle and bustle of the city, slow down here and feel the peace and beauty spreading in your heart.

stays.name: Pandora B&B
stays.description: I am the owner of the B&B. My wife's surname is Pan, and she is from Taimali. My surname is You. Everyone calls me Abla. "Duo" means "and" in Japanese, so the name of our B&B is Pandora.I worked in the hotel industry for over 30 years and when I retired, I fell in love with the blue sky, white clouds, green mountains and clear waters of Taitung, so I decided to open a homestay here. I can live a retired but not retired life and make some new friends.Pandora is an elevator B&B. We are considerate of travelers who come from far away, some of whom bring children, drag luggage, and even elderly elders. We save them the pain of climbing stairs, so this is the first B&B in Taitung with an elevator!Our location is near Taitung Railway Station, about seven or eight minutes' walk. It is very convenient to rent bicycles, motorcycles, and cars. The attractions in Taitung City are also within a 15-minute drive. The transportation is convenient and the location is quiet. Resting here for a night can wash away all your fatigue. Pandora is undoubtedly the best place to stay!

stays.name: Promised Land
stays.description: The coastline in eastern Taiwan has magnificent waves and stretching green mountains, and always hides much unique fascinating scenery with back to the mountains. Come to Taitung to have a good vacation. Located near the Taitung Station, "Taitung B&B--Promised Land" is a registered legal Taitung B&B, has a distinctive white Mediterranean-style building, a vast lawns and space, though simple in appearance, has a unique landscape, showing the B&B's unique exotic mien. We named the B&B Promised Land, because we uphold our promises and trust, and with sincerity, we are practical to serve guests, as this belief is also recorded in the Bible as "the promised land." I hope the staying guests can leave with happiness and health enjoyed and lingering memories. Promised Land, though located in the countryside with a featureless sign, offers a charming local style, under the blue sky, it is a unique Mediterranean architecture, and innkeepers carefully plant coconut trees, manage gardens, to make you staying in an atmosphere of tropical country and experience the beautiful mien of exotic vacation. Spacious and comfortable interior offers elegant chic room types, including honeymoon, double, four-person, and six-person, providing more choice of accommodation. We also offer single accommodation for people who likes to enjoy a trip alone. Welcome you to "Promised Land," you can enjoy Taitung people's warmth, passion, and simplicity, and a stay full of warm and homely feeling. Return to the home of soul ~ "Promised Land" It is your best choice for vacation accommodation in Taitung.

stays.name: Ri Chu Tianji Homestay
stays.description: Taitung is blessed with vast blue skies, fluffy white clouds, vibrant greenery, fresh air, and beautiful sunrises. We hope to share the beauty of these natural experiences with travelers, so that when you come here, you can relax your body and mind, and find inner peace. Here, take a moment to slow down, breathe deeply, and recharge yourself with positive energy.The Sunrise B&B is located on a corner of Taiwan’s East Coast.In the front, you can enjoy the unique landscape of the “Liji Badlands (Moon World)” and the magnificent sight of the sunrise over the Pacific Ocean.Behind, the Beinan Mountain Range of Taitung stands in view.The house features an elegant and natural atrium design, allowing in abundant daylight and fresh airflow. Inside, each room has hand-painted walls adorned with floral themes, creating a graceful and cozy ambiance, so you can enjoy both the leisure and the beauty of travel life.

stays.name: THE GAYA HOTEL
stays.description: Hotel located in Taitung CountyThe hotel logo adopts the four letters GAYA to form the Chinese hieroglyph of “tidal” this word. The blue G stands for the vast Pacific Ocean, the yellow A stands for the land that is full of golden rice fields, the red Y stands for the cultural integration of diverse ethnic groups in Taitung, and the green A stands for the central Embraced by the mountains, coasts and mountains.THE GAYA HOTEL Taitung determines to provide an ideal accommodation experience with a fusion of Taitung’s local culture and modern design concepts Located at the foot of Liyu (Carp fish) Mountain in Taitung, the city center where local Taitung folks are living with. The old bricks that carried history telling the story of the past decades. THE GAYA HOTEL site was the Taitung local tax bureau. Adopting and transforming these old bricks and re-engraved into modern design, the hotel building inherits the familiar emotions of Taitung people. THE GAYA HOTEL Taitung reappeared in 2017, detailing the history, combining the locality, and savoring the arts and culture.THE GAYA HOTEL emphasizes cultural impression, with mountains, ridges, streams, oceans, unique natural landscapes and aboriginal culture in Taitung. Architect Mr. Yu-Ching YEH, experts at integrating old stories into design, has successfully designed and built several successful design hotels in Bangkok. Based on Taitung’s rich and diverse natural and cultural heritage, he exudes the spirit of Taitung people’s kindness, honesty and harmony with nature. The new design of THE GAYA HOTEL building and interior space adopts the dark and calm black bamboo forest in the reception hall, creates an oriental tranquility abmiance, and precipitates the aesthetics of Zen. Through the unique elements of Taitung, such as local delicacy, music, literature, modern art, aboriginal tribal life, and more, to create the brand THE GAYA HOTEL, bringing travelers a comfortable and profound accommodation experience.

stays.name: TT ShareHouse
stays.description: ●In Taitung City, there is a garden-style old house bed-and-breakfast that still remains. Originally the Taitung Sugar Factory Manager’s Residence, the building is nearly 70 years old. Both the exterior and interior retain the style from the 1950s, while the guest rooms are a mix of Scandinavian design, offering a combination of retro charm and comfortable accommodation. ●This is a space designed for Type I personalities. The property spans nearly 200 ping (approx. 660 square meters) with only three rooms, hosting a maximum of two groups of guests at a time. Self-check-in is available, and there are no TVs, karaoke machines, or mahjong tables, but there are large trees, grass, and swings. ●Experience Taitung's slow living with just a suitcase. The house is equipped with a kitchen, washer-dryer, and bicycles. Parking is convenient, and it’s only a 10-minute drive to the station and city center. A bus stop and a nearby supermarket are just around the corner, making everyday life convenient and complete. You are welcome to come for a trip, relax, or enjoy a Workation.

stays.description: Taitung Qing'an Travel - embark on a relaxing and luxurious journeyHidden in the quiet and charming land of Taitung, Qing'an Manlv B&B is an ideal place for you to relax your mind and find inner peace. This poetic B&B embodies the current owner’s deep understanding and love for gardening and life aesthetics. At that time, this was a mansion carefully designed and lived in by an owner living in Japan. The current owner has continued this oriental sentiment and planted Qilixiang, a symbol of friendship and elegant life, in the courtyard. This fragrant floral fragrance, like a mark of time, leads you into this Japanese garden full of stories.Every corner of the B&B has been carefully decorated, combining Japanese style with French exquisite embellishments, perfectly integrating Eastern and Western aesthetics. All rooms are designed with Japanese tatami mats, allowing you to feel the warmth and tranquility of a Japanese-style hotel. Stepping here, you will be immersed in a picturesque atmosphere and enjoy a delicate and quiet moment. Every detail of the room exudes warmth and elegance, making you feel as if you are far away from the hustle and bustle and find a pure land of your soul.Here, you can not only experience a unique accommodation environment, but also enjoy extremely convenient transportation services. The B&B is only a 5-minute walk or a 2-minute drive from the train station, and a 15-minute drive from Taitung Airport. Whether you are strolling in the garden in the morning light or taking a bus to your next destination, Qing'an Travel can provide you with the most considerate service and make every trip so relaxing and enjoyable.At Taitung Qing'an Travel, let the fragrance of flowers and breeze accompany you and enjoy a completely relaxing and poetic luxury trip. Everything here is waiting to spend that unique and wonderful time with you.

stays.name: Tang yuan second Houes
stays.description: Tang Home B&B is a charming building made of white and orange cultural stone, which looks even more beautiful at night with atmospheric lighting that creates a poetic vibe. The B&B offers free breakfast and free parking for added convenience. The interior design is thoughtfully curated by the owner, with each room having its own unique color scheme and style. The lobby has a more American-style vibe, and on the first floor, you& #39;ll find a mosaic wall art designed by the owner herself. The warm lighting inside creates a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. Additionally, Tang Home B&B is equipped with an elevator, making your stay even more comfortable.Located in the heart of Taitung City, the B&B is just a 10-minute drive from the Taitung Train Station, making it very accessible. For your convenience, the B&B offers self-check-in after 5 PM, allowing for a smoother arrival process. Guests can also enjoy free bicycles to explore nearby attractions like the Taitung Art Museum, Tiehua Village, Taitung Forest Park, and Seaside Park—perfect for a relaxing and enjoyable vacation. There are also affordable and tasty local restaurants nearby, where you can savor the flavors of Taitung and experience its rich culture.At Tang Home B&B, you can take a leisurely stroll through the thoughtfully designed space, soak in the authentic atmosphere of Taitung, and unwind in a comfortable setting that promises a pleasant journey. Whether you& #39;re here with family, a partner, or for business, Tang Home B&B offers the perfect retreat for all types of travelers. We look forward to welcoming you and making your Taitung trip unforgettable.

stays.name: The Suites Taitung
stays.description: With a great view to the greenery Nanjing Boulevard, the mountains, and Pacific Ocean, the site of “The Suites Taitung” has an exclusive view that’s hard to find. The building massing concept utilizes the concrete characters to mimic the layers of setting back mountain rocks. Guests go through a three-dimensional water-scape and walk up to the man-made cave before entering hotel lobby. The hotel lobby is intentionally arranged on the second floor, with a great wide panorama to the city. We incorporate the existing tree at the northwest corner to vitalize the entrance space adjacent to the greenery boulevard. The sensational entrance sequence making the access experience a memorable journey. The outdoor corridor and stairway are arranged on the northeast corner to respond to the monsoon, which introduce the breeze into the building and relieve the heat load. The waterscape adjacent to the stairway cooled the air, making the hallway a pleasant outdoor space. Horizontal balcony and the light color façade prevent the solar heat from entering the building and decrease the heat gains. By using the light color pebble wash concrete wall, the robust massing accent stands out while blending into the context.

stays.name: Tiintinn Inn Showtime
stays.description: In the heart of the Taitung Tiehua Village shopping district, there's a place filled with the aroma of coffee and travelers’ memories — Menting Roushi Hotel · Tiehua Showtime Branch.This hotel has been serving guests since the 1950s and 60s, originally located in front of the old Taitung train station. From Jin An Inn to Jun An Hotel, and now as Menting Roushi, it has carried the marks of over half a century, witnessing the rise and fall of eras and the passing of generations.In recent years, as modern hotels have emerged, this old inn slowly faded from the spotlight and even shifted to long-term rentals at one point. It wasn’t until 2019 that a passionate young team took over. Dedicated to preserving the original spirit of the hotel, they began to brush away the dust and breathe new life into it. Along the way, they carefully retained many elements with period character — such as wooden windows and vintage bathtubs — blending them with fresh design concepts and craftsmanship. The result is a warm, simple, and heartfelt space full of stories and a sense of nostalgia.

stays.name: minsuku
stays.description: The word "B&B" comes from the Japanese Minshuku (みんしゅく sound Minshuku). Therefore, the hotel is named B&B Library after this. This hotel is a themed B&B. There are life-like 3D paintings in the front courtyard. The first floor is in industrial style. The rooms have six major themes (Children's Paradise, Castle Paradise, Surfing, Movies, Zen Style, and Retro). Guests have different feelings every time they come to stay. Especially the children's paradise and castle paradise have sliding stairs, which are children's dream paradise. The owner personally participated in the design style, so that everyone who stays here can feel his intentions. . Breakfast is sometimes paired with aboriginal delicacies, local fruits and local agricultural products, allowing travelers to experience Taitung's food culture.The B&B also hopes that visitors from afar will slow down, take their time, and use different angles and different perspectives to understand the different Taitung now.

stays.description: As the very first capsule hotel ever inside Taoyuan International Airport,CHO Stay Capsule Hotel is a tea-themed hotel with a cozy and relaxing atmosphere, making it an ideal choice for those with layovers, early flights, or late arrivals. With its enviable location where departure and arrival halls are less than a minute away, guests can enjoy a seamless transition from air to rest, ensuring that every moment of their journey is as stress-free as possible. The shared bathroom and shower facility provides Dyson hair dryers and local brand, Cha Tzu Tang, shampoo and shower gels. What’s more, guests are welcome to enjoy a cup of freshly brewed Taiwanese oolong tea at the lobby.

stays.name: Fuyam Tourist Home
stays.description: "Hills upon the hills, and meandering and circuitous creeks, I suspected no route, / but the willow trees make the shade, the flowers give the light, and a glimmer of a village I find" This is the encounter with "Fuyam Tourist Home," so amazing. The Fuyam's owner makes good use of natural landscaping to create a slick place for relaxing, and waits for the blessed or destined people to come to share this paradise on earth together. Fuyam Tourist Home is located in northern Taiwan's most aerobic Lalashan Forest Reserve, near Qara Stream valley around 800 meters in elevation, giant stones stand in great number, trees, flowers, and grasses are dispersed, and all charms vary with the seasons, a beautiful retreat like a paradise. By the owner's skillful planning, design, and layout, Fuyam offers several log cabins with different sizes, gardens, and landscaping space, set off by trees, bamboos, flowers, ponds, and streams, making you feel more quiet and beautiful. Natural terrains and materials are used in space landscaping, creating a unique atmosphere and layering. In recent years, in addition to local visitors, more and more foreign tourists have come here especially attracted by Fuyam's fame, some visitors even went straight to Lalashan upon arrival in Taiwan for a weeklong stay, in order to enjoy the natural environment bit by bit. Even just sitting In the outdoor patio, drinking tea, reading books, it is a great enjoyment. Attractions around: Daxi Historic Street / the Culture Resort of the Jiang, Cihu / Jiaobanshan / Dongyanshan Forest Recreation Area, Little Wu-Lai Scenic (Skywalk) / Lalashan Forest Reserve.

stays.name: Goodian coffee , Bed & Breakfast
stays.description: Taoyuan｜Goo Dian Coffee HouseA happy little house beside a verdant green valleyYou drive out of the city on a winding country road and head deep into the mountains. Opening the car window, the breeze brushes by smelling of green grass. Slowing down the car, the layers of greenery outside the window put you in a fine mood. Turning a corner, you come upon a traveler’s relay station in the mountains - Goo Dian Coffee House is subtly located in a valley on Lala Mountain, embraced by the blue sky and green environment and just waiting to bring you in touch with the natural world.Situated in relaxed and carefree mountainsShutting off the engine, you hear the wind flowing through the mountains. As you breathe the cool mountain air, you smile and raise your head to take in your surroundings; a simple wooden house sits in the embrace of the green mountain forests. House and forest merge together, creating a harmonious scene. Tiantian (literally means “sweet”), the enthusiastic little Corgi, rushes forward to welcome you with his big, round eyes. You follow Tiantian into the relaxing environment of Lala Mountain.Attached to the wooden reception building is a two-level outdoor coffee terrace. You sit comfortably in a chair sipping a cup of flavorful coffee. The terrace is without windows and doors, so there is no separation between you and the grandeur and magnificence of the mountain range. The Daman creek flows by, revealing the vitality of nature. After a heavy rain, you may have the good fortune to see white gauze-like clouds enshrouding the emerald green mountains. Those clouds also envelope your worries, and you feel convinced that all your troubles will slowly scatter with the clouds and mist.Serene life in the mountain valleyIn your bedroom, host Lin has created a cozy, simple decor that mirrors the rustic character of the mountains. In the three double rooms - the Maple Leaf, Ginkgo, and Wistaria rooms - elegant color schemes further accentuate the endless green scenery outside the windows. Lying lazily upon the soft bed, you can admire the myriad transformations of the mountains as you drift naturally into slumberland. The three-room Sakura Suite is large enough to accommodate a large family on vacation together. In the afternoon, playful children can feed the koi fish in the nearby pond while adults chat about life in the living room. The wooden swing hanging outside the house brings innocent smiles to the faces of young and old alike. In the evening, you prepare a simple late-night snack. After everyone has eaten and drunk to their heart’s content, you sit enjoying each other’s company. It is such simple things that fill life with happiness.A generous and friendly ambiance is the best spiceLin lives here with his younger brother and parents, working together to operate Goo Dian Coffee House and maintain the vast forest park surrounding it. His cute, taciturn father has created an area for raising special and unusual animals, while his mother is responsible for cooking and taking care of the fruit trees. For the convenience of travelers from afar, Goo Dian provides both breakfast and dinner using vegetables from the local mountain landscape to satisfy the taste bud of their guests. Fresh, crisp bamboo shoots, crispy yet tender trout that is grilled to perfection - with fine skill, the chef produces dish after dish of beautiful, seasonal cuisine, with a mother’s home-cooked touch. It is almost as if you’ve returned to your own home away from home in the mountains.Early spring is the time to appreciate the sakura blossoms and in summer, you can savor the fragrant sweetness of juicy peaches. Winter is the time to marvel at a romantic landscape of snow-covered mountains. Stay for a single night at Goo Dian Coffee House and allow your body and spirit to be completely absorbed into the embrace of Lala Mountain. Leave the gloom of the city far behind and return to nature to enjoy the beauty of mountain life.

stays.name: Heanawan
stays.description: ⛳️B&B Introduction:"Honawan" is nestled amidst picturesque landscapes, a place steeped in stories and a way of life.The name originates from the Atayal language, referring to a rest stop, inn, or food pavilion. Geographically, the upper reaches of the Dahan River and the winding mountain ranges⛰ are visible in the distance, overlooking the southwest bend of the river and the home of the male owner. This three-tiered perspective led to the name "Honawan."Services Offered:B&B, camping area, local cuisine, afternoon tea, coffee, experiences (one-day farmer, fruit picking, vegetable picking, mushroom picking, and bamboo shoot picking, etc.), activity planning (Atayal Night, DIY, hunting and crafting, children& #39;s games, and archery, etc.). Besides numerous true and touching stories, the park is also a top choice for strolling, relaxing, sightseeing, appreciating, experiencing, and intellectually enriching journeys. It allows visitors to enjoy the best of nature& #39;s bounty of forests and mountains without having to travel abroad or to remote forests. The owner has built this beautiful garden, a gift from God, with passion and sincerity.

stays.name: PRADO HOLIDAY HILL
stays.description: Prado Hills Holiday Resort & RestaurantNestled in Fuxing District, Taoyuan City, Prado Hills Holiday Resort & Restaurant is a tranquil paradise just 30 minutes away from Sanxia and Daxi city centers. This enchanting retreat features European-style architecture set against magnificent mountain vistas, complemented by exquisite cuisine.Throughout the four seasons, the resort blooms with a variety of beautiful flowers. Summer brings the splendor of hydrangeas in the morning and the magical glow of fireflies at night. Autumn paints the landscape in stunning maple reds, offering a truly immersive fall experience. Winter transforms the resort with festive Christmas decorations, enhanced by local poinsettias that create an atmosphere reminiscent of a foreign wonderland.This idyllic destination is perfect for families and friends seeking a peaceful retreat to unwind and reconnect with nature.

stays.description: Official website: http://www.xanadu.url.tw/ Official Facebook Fans' Club: https://www.facebook.com/1971xanadu Official blog: http://www.wretch.cc/blog/paven Xanadu ‧ Pass the Natural Concept of Xiaowulai on. Xanado Xiao Wu Lai Vacation Village is located in Taoyuan Township. In 1971 responding to the request for assistance from mountaineering friends, the innkeeper registered the Village in 2003 and became the first legitimate characteristic B&B in Taoyuan County and a good merchant of the National Travel Card. The innkeeper would like to provide guests a comfortable, relaxing, leisure trip, and hope that he can bring people closer to nature for temporarily forgetting urban hubbub, finding peace of mind, and enjoying the mind feast. Because natural forces originate from the forest, Xiao Wulai Scenic Area includes many spectacular attractions, and most attractions are within walking distance from the Xiao Wulai Vacation Village. Walking along the forest trail, you can reach the most famous Xiao Wulai Waterfalls, directly enjoy the Phytoncide emitted from the forest and the negative air ionization therapy released from the waterfalls. In July 2011, a "Skywalk," similar to the concept of the Grand Canyon Skywalk, just above the Xiao Wulai Waterfalls, was opened to the public, where tourists can watch Xiao Wulai Waterfalls from above. The trail is paved with transparent glasses to give more different excitements.

stays.name: You De Yuan Homestay
stays.description: You De Yuan is located next to the Giant Tree Area, about 1,500 meters in elevation, has a vast horizon, a panoramic view of nature, fresh air, tranquility, bird chirps and insect buzzes, fresh and cool mountain breezes, making you forget the hubbub earthliness and feel like being in paradise. You De Yuan is a legitimate B&B in Lalashan and a merchant of National Travel Card. Lalashan peaches are known far and wide and Lalashan's beautiful landscape is desirable, and You De Yuan is your best choice to stay in Lalashan for one-day trip or two-day tour. In You De Yuan, the houses are all log cabins constructed with importing Formosan China-firs or Chinese Spruces. Each house is full of Phytoncide which is beneficial to physical and mental relaxation. You have a private space that is free from the interference of others, and you can enjoy serenity in a comfortable environment. In a breezy clear night, with a starry sky, sip a cup of tea and talk of old times, while watching the moon and stargazing. Here has a fresh and pleasant climate all year round; visitors can bring their own food to enjoy the happiness of tasting barbecue and hot pot. We provide stoves, pots and pans, grills, charcoals, and iron mesh for tourists to use. In summer, it is a good time for kids to observe unicorn beetles, stag beetle, and butterflies. Welcome to You De Yaun.

stays.name: Wusulin Before
stays.description: Taoyuan｜Before B&BThe intoxicating delight of lingering between booksIn open fields only an hour south of Taipei sits a small villa, which brings together books and fine beer. Sitting brightly under a blue sky, the amber colored building of Before B&B invites you to join in writing the story of your unrestrained journey.Sipping beer with your nose in a bookAs you enter Before B&B, sunlight streams through large windows and spills across the square pattern of the terrazzo floors. The uneven wooden bookshelves along both walls give the sensation of being in a forest where the trees have grown to varying heights. In this staggered forest, the treasures hiding between the trees are not birds’ nests, but rather the book collection of B&B host Danny, as well as his collection of craft beer! According to Danny, books are like friends who enrich our innermost selves, while beer is a good companion for pleasant worldly conversation. These two items appear to be unrelated, yet they are Danny’s indispensable life companions. So the first floor of Danny’s B&B is an independent bookstore that sells beer. This design is not for profit, but rather to satisfy Danny’s heartfelt desire for sharing his passions with others. “My B&B is a part of my life. It is an extension of me, so you have to appreciate my lifestyle to stay in my B&B.” Danny comes across as somewhat arrogant and proud, but after all, confidence comes from working hard at what you do. The moment his family decided to refurbish their aged courtyard home, the opportunity to create Before B&B was born. Black Forest is the name of the area were Before B&B is situated, while Before is actually a play on “b-four”, as in bed, breakfast, books, and beer - all delightful things which Danny just can’t wait to share with travelling guests. You may buy a book with which it was love at first sight, or perhaps a bottle of mouthwatering beer to pass a relaxing afternoon.Volume after volume recounting the collage of lifeHeading upstairs past walls lined with books, you discover that Before B&B is itself a colorful hardcover storybook, each page containing different scenery, as the names of the five guest rooms imply. Occasionally flipping this storybook open to the “life style” page, the central mountain range, however distant, appears right before your eyes. Occasionally opening it up to the “fiction & literature” section or the pages describing “indigenous literature” and light streams in through skylights, illuminating the split-level loft design of the B&B. Meanwhile, you share your discoveries with friends in the nooks beneath the stairs. The page of this B&B storybook about “travel & food” is the tender green color of a grassy field, the warmth of the sun and the specs of pink flowers accompany you in welcoming springtime. Meanwhile in the gosling-yellow story regarding “kids’ picture books” you and your friends have ample room to roll freely around like children on the two large double beds. Yet no matter which meticulously collaged page you open the Before B&B storybook to, it is sure to bring your imagined scenery to life.Discover story after brilliant storyStanding there in a simple t-shirt with a bottle of beer in hand, Danny looks just like the character Ling Hu-chong out of Jin Yong’s famous 1967 martial arts novel “Swordsman” who regarded the liquor in his cup as a lifelong friend. Most surprising, though, is that the practice to which he has devoted more than twenty years of his life is not what is in his cup, but rather what lies between the pages of his books! With a laugh, Danny proclaims, “Not a day goes by that I don’t read a book, nor a day when I don’t drink alcohol.” Danny exudes an open and generous humor, and is quite insistent on realizing the ideals he feels passionate about. Though it isn’t easy to operate a bookstore, he still hopes to use the magic of his shop to help people fall in love with reading. Even when work keeps him busy, whenever he meets a like-minded traveler, he’s more than willing to discuss books over bottles of beer all night long. Danny appreciates life and is apt to follow his whims, just like that free and easy character Ling Hu-chong, laughing his way through life.When you arrive at Before B&B, please remember to leave your hurried urban pace at the door, take the time to truly enjoy a good book, a bottle of beer, or an amusing phrase from your amiable host, Danny. Shouldn’t everyone’s life contain just this kind of carefree comfort? On this trip, you need not travel far, just a little to the south and you can find yourself in the midst of lush nature, fine literature, and craft beer. Put yourself in a holiday frame of mind, and enjoy the intoxicating delight of books and beer!

stays.name: Yaward Hotel
stays.description: Come to Yaward Resort, a calm oasis away from the hustle and bustle of the city. Here you will find a 27-hole golf course, guest rooms and dining options, as well as attentive and personalized service so that you can enjoy your leisure time in luxury. Amidst our 90 hectares grand gardens, if you are looking to take a short break, you will be able to enjoy many pleasures such as plenty of space to exercise, cozy accommodations and a splendid dining space. At Yaward, you will feel how close people can be to open space, sunshine and nature.We sincerely invite you to escape a busy life and go through this refreshing path to see the sea and the mountains and let this entirely new scenery release your stress. Come to Yaward with a stress-free vacation experience, and also to enjoy the nature fresh air and quiet your mind in this rare Shangri-lar full of phytoncide.The luxurious 12-meter-high atrium space with natural wood and stone materials displays a practical style. The soaring coconut trees standing straight into the patio, the lively sunshine together with the Hakka round buildings create a harmonious and welcoming atmosphere. In the morning, you will be waken up by the sunshine through the window and lark& #39;s singing outside the French window. Upon accommodation, you can enjoy the hotel& #39;s leisure facilities free of charge: glass gym, pool table, outdoor swimming pool and children& #39;s play ground. We are ready to welcome you to enjoy a relaxing and comfortable vacation free from any stress.The hotel owns 61 comfortable rooms with free broadband internet access. Jade Restaurant and Sunshine Cafe are well-known for Chinese and Western cuisines. The 6-meter-high banquet hall, spacious and pillar-free, the fully-equipped meeting rooms capable of providing customized services and the 16-fairway tee box golf practice course, is the first choice for any banquets, gathering, business, or vacations!

stays.name: dauhe jhan
stays.description: Dauhejhan-In 2024, as Longyuan Temple — the heart of faith in Longtan — celebrates its 200th anniversary, the temple invited a local youth team called “Wild Water Caltrop” to breathe new life into an old unused space. That’s how Daohe Inn was born — a name that pays tribute to the temple’s main deity, Shennong Dadi, the God of Agriculture and Five Grains.Here, we hope to bring back the warmth of everyday living and the easy rhythm of the seasons — letting a simple, grounded way of life quietly grow again in the heart of the neighborhood.

stays.name: Freedom Design Hotel
stays.description: Freedom Design Hotel is located in Nankan, Taoyuan, surrounded by lush greenery and serene landscapes, providing a tranquil and peaceful environment. The hotel officially opened on July 5, 2013.The hotel features a design concept of "exquisite, unique, and distinctive," blending retro-modern and minimalist styles. It boasts a striking 9-meter-high glass ceiling, designed to maximize natural light, with carefully placed lighting fixtures that enhance brightness and create an impressive ambiance.The hotel offers 181 guest rooms, with layouts ranging from 33 m² to 148 m². All rooms feature exterior windows and are equipped with YKK airtight windows. The rooms are fully equipped with essential amenities, including microwaves and 5G wireless internet. Hotel also feature imported wooden floors, bathrooms designed with separate wet and dry zones, and each floor is equipped with washers and dryers for guest convenience. The hotel also offers a 1,600 m² outdoor leisure area, providing a relaxing space for travelers and a play area for children, making it ideal for business trips, romantic getaways, and family vacations.The hotel is located just a 10-15 minute drive from Taoyuan Airport and Taoyuan High-Speed Rail Station, and only 1.8 kilometers from the Nankan Interchange. A five-minute walk along the river leads to the TaiMall Shopping Center, offering an excellent location.

stays.name: Victoria Lin-Kou Home
stays.description: Welcome to Linkou Victoria Homestay — a charming century-old cypress wood villa nestled in a peaceful neighborhood just 5 minutes from Linkou city center and 30 minutes from Taipei or Taoyuan. Our exclusive full-house rental offers four spacious rooms, each with a private bathroom. Originally converted from seven rooms, the layout is flexible to accommodate 10 to 16 guests. The 330 m² indoor space and a 6,000 m² garden provide ample room for families, school trips, or corporate retreats. The building blends British Victorian and Japanese design elements, recreating the elegance of 1930s Taiwan. Enjoy your stay in an environment surrounded by nature and history, with convenient access and free parking. We welcome international guests to book easily through Agoda or Airbnb. Come and experience a stay that combines warmth, comfort, and culture in northern Taiwan.

stays.name: CHUTO PLAZA HOTEL
stays.description: Chuto Hotel was established in 1999, under the owner& #39;s serious operation, it was recognized by the relevant authorities& #39; rave reviews and is a quality hotel in terms of international standards. The hotel is located in the rear of Taoyuan Station, and offers fantastic rooms and restaurants. Guests can enjoy the exquisite service quality and ingenuity hotel features, after bustling days. The hotel features exceptionally elegant and comfortable rooms, plus facilities and clubs, and guests can enjoy privileges at reasonable prices. For dining, Chuto Hotel offers distinctive specialty restaurants. Seafood Buffet Cafeteria, on the 1st floor, is carefully designed by distinguished designers to make you feel comfortable and warm. Seafood Buffet Cafeteria offers exquisite cuisine, rich, delicious desserts, and a variety of beverages, with special mouthfeel, and it is worthy of recommendation and tasting. On the 2nd floor, the hotel features 7 elegant banquet rooms, and delicate dishes are personally prepared by the famous chef, and after the dining, guests praise the foods to high heaven. The banquet halls on the 1st and 3rd floors are the perfect places for wedding, celebration, teacher appreciation, and meeting banquets, after a careful planning. Chuto Hotel, with its features and level of standard, attracts celebrities and public figure to come and to linger, but the staff is still upheld a passionate heart with dedication and await your advice. I hope one day you can appreciate our specialty and share your comments with us.

stays.name: Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan
stays.description: Choose Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan, a modern high-rise hotel just 20 minutes by taxi from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport.Relax, arriving at Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan is a breeze thanks to our proximity to the airport and Taoyuan Railway Station. It's not just our handy location in downtown Taoyuan that keeps guests coming back, but our friendly staff, complimentary breakfast buffet and complimentary wireless Internet throughout the hotel.Hire our intimate meeting room to welcome up to 10 people to your presentation, and feel free to use the PCs in our 24-hour Internet Corner at your leisure. Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan is just 20 minutes' drive from major electronics companies in Huaya Technology Park and Guishan Industrial Zone.Sample local favourite popcorn chicken at vibrant Taoyuan Night Market, and go bargain-hunting in neon-lit TaiMall shopping centre. Tranquil Tiger Head Mountain, set in a leafy park 2.5km from the hotel, provides a quiet retreat away from the bustle of the city centre. A public bus service to Taipei, Taiwan's largest city, leaves from outside the hotel and takes around 40 minutes.Holiday Inn Express Taoyuan's helpful Front Desk staff are happy to help you plan your stay, from travel tips to where to find the best pork chop stall in town. Children stay free in their parents' room, making us a good-value choice for family breaks.

stays.name: OHYA MOTEL
stays.description: Oh-Ya Motel - Taoyuan Branch is also known as Oh-Ya Hua-yang Motel. The design of the 28 suites were inspired by various types of flowers from around the world. Floral motives and essence are expressed in the interior design by fully capturing the sentiments evoked by each blossom. The design team did an excellent job in creating guestrooms with colorful and varied visual effect. Every small detail shows the intent on refinement and perfection. Consistent with Oh-Ya's usual design features - light, water and greenery - the Taoyuan Branch further pushed the enevelope by cleverly incorporating the concept of lush green plants and water features into every guestroom. This innovative design concept broke away from the traditional standard look employed by typical hotels. This allows our guests to relax and enjoy their surroundings even more. The excellent usage of lighting, ventilation and soothing greenery not only gives our valued guests a luxurious restful space, but also allows them to have control over their comfort and health.

The hotel offers a business center, common room, gym, and conference room, fully capable of satisfying any business needs. It’s the most user-friendly accommodation for any business and leisure travelers.The lobby on the first floor is a visual pressure free space with a scenery garden at the back, a treat for your mind.The second floor is open for art exhibitions, multipurpose conference rooms fully equipped with the finest facilities.From the third floor to the twelfth floor, 240 exquisite rooms designed with the concept of tea gardens and sky lanterns bring out the traditional Taoyuan. Hospitable attitude and professional service, it’s the finest accommodation for any business, seminar, company retreat and leisure travel.We offer 7 room types decorated with themes of Taiwan like tea gardens and sky lanterns for guests to admire the beauty of Taiwan the moment they step in. Comfortable and relaxing, the spacious room will soothe your weariness.

stays.name: LIAU
stays.description: Near Yong’an Fishing Harbor, we restored a red-brick house and brought it back to life. We kept the home’s original warmth and texture, then added a light, modern rhythm so the old house doesn’t just sit in memory—it speaks to the present.The original layout and hand-touched furniture remain, and sunlight, breeze, plants, and everyday sounds flow through the rooms. Every corner gently slows you down and invites a slower way of living.This place is for travelers who like to go deeper and “move in” for a while. You can walk to the sea and clear your mind, wander through rice fields and feel the land, sit in the square and watch the sunset, and at night—if you’re lucky—look up at the Milky Way and meet fireflies. It’s a simple day in Taiwan’s Hakka countryside.Many guests say it feels like visiting Grandma’s house—only with a touch of design and more ease. This isn’t a tourist spot; it’s an invitation to a way of life, a just-right place for anyone who wants to live well.

stays.description: An International Ocean Themed Tourist Hotel that Connects to the WorldNavigating from 20,000 km below the sea, we invite you to explore this beautiful, fantastic ocean secret scene with adventure spirit. Facing the glory sunshine on the ocean, one can relax himself/herself on the blue coastline. After relaxation, you will feel refreshed and be ready to go back to the comfortable, COZZI (harmony) space from the warm sandy beach.Working with Xpark Aquarium, Shin Kong Cinema Flagship Store, and Taiwan’s first Children’s Paradise of Qiohu, the Hotel built its one-stop park to satisfy every need.COZZI Blu presents you the story of the ocean world that gives visitors new vision as well as opportunities to experience mysterious, romantic, adventurous, passionate, and fun stays. Visitors from abroad and Taiwan will feel like beginning the exciting and wonderful journey of the ocean world that transcends island country’s culture and connects seamlessly to the world. Diverse tourism experiences creates unlimited fun and exciting holidays.

stays.name: SEVEN STAR MOTEL
stays.description: To respond to the demands of urban convenience, we provide a venue for the purpose of both entertainment and rest in Jungli (Zhongli). Seven Star Motel offers 78 double rooms. In response to popular trends, we also added diversified consumer choices, such as the party project that offers VIP preferential choices to provide a place for impeccable accommodation and entertainment. In addition, Seven Star Motel is located near the Dayuan Interchange in Jungli and the Taiwan Highway, even closer to downtown Jungli and Jungli Station, and it is convenient for arrival and visiting the commercial and entertainment district. For guests from out of town, the front desk staff can give you directions to the Metrowalk Shopping Center located nearby, as well as the famed Jungli Tourist Night Market and the Chungyuan (Zhongyuan) Night Market for enjoying or tasting the local delicacies. Of course, do not forget amusement parks, such as Leofoo Village and the Window On China Theme Park, about 30 minutes' drive from the Longtan Interchange. In your spare time, you can still stay at Seven Star Motel to rest or for r entertainment.

Muku Xia Bed and Breakfast is located in this special place, surrounded by mountains and water, with an expansive view and pure, tranquil atmosphere. Approaching nature, and enjoying its gifts, make every city dweller want to take a deep breath of fresh air. The owner sincerely welcomes all visitors, hoping they experience this unique living culture and experience.
