stays.name: SPRING VILLA
stays.description: Yilan｜Fengchun VillaA Mountain Retreat that is Peaceful Year RoundA fine drizzle falls upon the leaves, sliding off into the pool below one drop at a time. You stand and look into the distance, and beyond the water droplets sparkling on the soft lawn, an immense scene unfolds before your eyes: layers of dark and light green leading up to mountain peaks, with a light blue stream tracing a path across it all. The clouds and mist slowly disperse, little by little revealing the mountain’s complexion. Rain or shine, this mountain retreat is peaceful year round - Fengchun Villa.A tranquil residence concealed within the mountainsAfter following a winding little road up into the mountains, you park your car and let the refreshing air encircle your nose. To one side, the main doors have been left open for you, so you stroll into the hidden territory which is Fengchun Villa. You admire the lush lawn beside the sloping road, decorated with a few European statues and wooden lawn chairs. You walk deeper into the gardens and Lilysan comes forward extending a warm greeting. Arriving at the semi-open scenic lookout space, you enjoy the tea and snacks that have been prepared for you: organic honey fragrance black tea from a nearby tea farm, dragon fruit from Fengchun Villa’s own gardens, and green bean cakes. You look out over the vast scenery before you as any worries that were hiding deep in your heart are carried away on the gentle mountain breeze.Fengchun Villa was established in 1989 when Lilysan finished her previous business and bought this vacation garden property. Nearly four acres in size, Lilysan and her family prepared and constructed it all themselves. They didn’t expect that this quiet mountain lifestyle, away from the bustle of the city, would attract many family and friends to visit. This inspired the family to construct a white, European style building to serve as a guesthouse, choosing to name it Fengchun after the pen name of an ancestor. As a way to allow the name of their ancestors’ Fengchun Trading Company to live on, they used the same enthusiasm to operate Fengchun Villa as their ancestors did their trading company.An intimate time for self-healingStepping into the house, you smell the mild fragrance of cunninghamia, a type of cypress wood imported from Laos, and it puts your mind at ease. The various guest rooms are named after local birds and are available in many different layouts to meet the different needs of travelers. Taking off your shoes, you admire the abundant greenery outside the massive windows. Reclining beside a window or walking out onto the balcony, the gentle golden light of sunset caresses your body. You pour yourself a hot cup of tea and in this way, feel the slow passage of time. You reserve the afternoon just for yourself, allowing the peaceful view to wash the exhaustion from your train of thoughts. In Fengchun Villa, besides the enjoyment of spacious interior accommodations, you can also make reservations for an infrared foot bath, sauna, or energy space experience. In the evening, the Fengchun Villa menu of rich and sumptuous mountain cuisine is sure to satisfy your taste buds and completely relax both your body and mind.Relaxed and restful mountain lifeThe gentle morning sun signals the start of a new day, urging you toward the table to enjoy a lavish breakfast. You admire the elaborate oil paintings of your host as the mountain air fills you with energy. As a part of your spontaneous vacation, you might set off with your hosts on a scavenger hunt into the mountains, or make reservations for a Chinese tea ceremony. Either of these may help you regain a healthy rhythm for your life, allowing you to experience true comfort from the bottom of your heart, and enjoy the carefree passage of time in the mountains!

stays.name: Wei Dan B&B
stays.description: We love Yilan plain with the lush green fields, but we love being surrounded by woods even more, with their priceless scenery, the refreshing air, the natural phytoncides, the tranquility amongst the woods which is far away from the urban maddening crowd, allowing this piece of land to become even more simple and peaceful. Wei Dan is located in a corner of Yulan surrounded by mountains, without luxurious decorations, and is constructed using only natural logs. Other than the fresh air, this place is also filled with a faint log fragrance; the massive use of French windows in the rooms allow lighting and views to accomplish the ideal state, so that we are right next to the nature at all times.

stays.name: 512 huts
stays.description: 512huts Due to its address, the 512 wooden house edge comes from No. 12, Lane 100, Lane 500, Meihua Road, Dongshan Township, Yilan County. As for the wooden house, there is a large wooden house that is built in 1979 and covers an area of ​​100 square meters. The reason why I will come back to operate the B\u0026B after retirement is mainly because I have been eager to get close to nature after working for many years in the society. I have a large grassland with gardens and small dishes, which can provide me with activities and muscles. Busy, it is difficult to get close to nature, it is more difficult to talk with friends and relatives. Therefore, I hope that I can introduce such a good environment to the same people, and then I will raise the idea of ​​operating a hotel. It will also allow me to reach out to all kinds of people in the society. It is totally different from what I encountered at work. It has no interest in it. Purely because of the same interest, we can go east and west without being influenced by anyone. After more than a year of operation, I found that I can introduce this beautiful environment to more people who like it. Therefore, we started the operation of afternoon tea this year. Three or five friends gathered together and wentssip. While enjoying the surrounding environment, drink a rich and fragrant coffee, taste a fragrant and crispy bread, cake, etc.; in the hot summer, you can stay away from the air-conditioned room, the breeze bursts, and the flowers are bursting with flowers. How much is this? Great enjoyment! Any hardware equipment in the park, no matter how luxurious, will always make people look tired. Only the natural scenery, with the weather changes throughout the year, will never be monotonous. Welcome to visit us.

stays.name: Barefoot Springs B&B
stays.description: Barefoot Springs B&B is a social enterprise and founded by Yilan County DER AN Family Care Association. As a vocational competence training workplace for teenagers, we employ teenagers who need to improve the vocational competence and we offer them training for hotel and catering. Your every visit will offer these teenagers a chance to learn how to work. We are looking forward to your visit. Enjoy the fun of earth and nature with barefoot! We are near the Plum Blossom Designated Scenic Area and Renshan Botanical Garden, natural and the suitable place for leisure activities. With an outdoor lawn over 1650 square meters, we provide you a beautiful and fantastic lawn scenery. There are tall and straight fan palms in front of the house and verdant and lush bald cypresses in the back in summertime, which are adorable and pleasing. In Barefoot Springs B&B, you can ride a bicycle through the fields, enjoy the landscape of Plum Blossom Lake and have a happy time with your friends and family! You can experience the fun of earth oven cooking!

The location of the B&B is close to Luodong Sports Park and 8 minutes from Luodong Night Market. It is a dream paradise for children. There are not only cisterns for swimming in summer, boating in winter, glazed sandpits, indoor children's play area...etc. Game facilities, as well as vast indoor and outdoor spaces. Even if you play in the homestay all day, you will not get tired!!! There are bicycle trails by the river embankment, you can ride a bicycle or take a walk to enjoy the scenery of nature. From June to August, you can take children to see groups of beetles.

Surrounded by lush greenery and open space, it offers a warm and relaxing retreat for guests of all ages. Inside, the guesthouse is bright and welcoming, thoughtfully equipped with all essential amenities to make you feel right at home. The spacious outdoor lawn is ideal for children to play freely, making it an excellent choice for family-friendly travel. Conveniently located near popular attractions like Dongshan River Water Park, Luodong Night Market, the National Center for Traditional Arts, and Meihua Lake, Kangzhuang Guesthouse is the perfect base for exploring the local charm of Yilan. Slow down, reconnect with nature, and enjoy a truly rejuvenating getaway at Kangzhuang Guesthouse.

There are many attractions nearby and many people stay for 2-3 nights. Friends who don& #39;t want to just stay can also purchase Fairy Tale Village to find rice happiness-Four Seasons Happy Farm Experience Fun, 1680 yuan per person, 1280 yuan per person for 10 people: Included: Flower and fruit tea or freshly ground coffee + feeding fish to drink + touching clams to catch big-bellied fish & black shells + letting big-bellied fish do foot massage + plane maze game + taking photos with dwarfs and seasonal experience DIY activities: January-December: pulling onions, planting onions (Cong), washing onions, making scallion pancakes DIY; picking silkworms and mulberries at the end of March and the beginning of May (creative competition- Tree Doctor Experience), firefly viewing from March to June, rhinoceros beetle season from May to July, rice harvesting, rice rubbing, rice milling experience, and dressing the rice in the king& #39;s new clothes to take home to enjoy, picking roselle from September to November to make roselle enzyme DIY, picking jujubes from December to February to make golden jujube enzyme DIY or cutting winter plums to make plum vinegar DIY and enjoy the rich sea and land hotpot from the friendly farming in the fairy tale village to the good farming garden directly to the table~ Tour the natural ecology of Meihua Lake and eat all the special snacks in Yilan, which will surprise you everywhere~ look forward to your arrival~ and go home with full of memories, booking fun line:@drz9142s, wechat: m0932090003, WhatsApp: +886932090003

stays.name: Fly Inn
stays.description: Located in the middle of the green rice fields, a lazy yet elegant atmosphere can be deeply felt from the appearance of the building. Pushing open the thick door that looks like a fairy tale castle, you will be instantly stunned by the scenery in front of you! This home is full of design sense yet warm, and it is definitely a popular B&B that has not yet been exposed. The style is a bit rural, a bit industrial, and even a bit dreamy. The owners of the B&B said that they don't like to follow the trend and designed this home based entirely on their own feelings. All the elements that I love are cleverly designed in this space. It is difficult to describe it in one style.Just prepare some simple luggage, bring a pair of comfortable walking shoes, book your flight (train) tickets, and you are ready to go! Staying at Fly Inn and having fun in Yilan is really simple!

stays.name: Han Shian Homestay
stays.description: The Han Shian Boutique is located between Dong Shan River Park (the site of 2012 Yilan International Children's Folklore and Folk Game Festival) and Lanyang Estuary Waterbird Refuge, at here, the secluded vast natural beauty is blossoming in front you, a nature's grand feast is staging ─ ─ you are greeted by thousands dancing white egrets, dragonflies, butterflies, and quiet contented waterfowl surround them. Travellers chat with nature communicating and washing their long wandering heart, but also filter completely the hustle bustle in this world. In this beautiful B&B in Yilan, brew a pot of tea, chat with a few friends together. People's emotions like the flavor of tea, sweet after the first bitter. The most beautiful journey is no more than sharing life with favorite people, experiencing and enjoying life together. Offer yourself a chance to enjoy a shocking experience of your body, mind, and spirit. Come here we write the most meaningful memories in time spent together. Walk under canvas in the sky, and sketch our own life journey ─ ─ our self-portrait. Travelers get together with nature, and nature is their home, their cover and pillow. Unconsciously, want to penetrate the invisible wall. Han Shian Boutique is a social occasion of light and shadow, we dance, we fly unbridled, and it seems that there is no trace of tilting, "Han Shian Boutique" in Yilan has become a Utopia in the minds of travelers and they also find their own home--Han Shian Boutique. Glass walls are outwardly inclined 15°, a perfect balance to eyes, Han Shian Boutique is a building that can breathe, with the flow of vision senses, every corner's projection is a new world. Lots of minimalist black and white, fashion elements enjoy themselves to the full. The warm colors of cypress and teak wood sprinkle around lightly, having cleverly harmonized the cool temperatures of minimalist fashion. Our B&B has both soft and strong natures, romantic atmosphere blend with rational ambience, penetrating the barriers between man and natural space. Welcome to Han Shian Boutique.

stays.name: I Tsai Yuan Homestay
stays.description: Yi Tsai Yuan Homestay is located next to Dongshan River, 150 meters from the forest park, and close to Zhenzhu Community, with a great scenic view of the surrounding areas. Yi Tsai Yuan is embraced by the lush green rice frields, a scene of great natural beauty, and right from the front door you can see the beautiful Dongshan Train Station. You’ll feel as if you’ve been transported to Europe, and can experience the colorful scenery of falling cherry blossoms at the beautiful cherry blossom tunnel. Here, the charm of the countryside fields will lift your spirits and put your mind at ease. Yi Tsai Yuan is surrounded by incredibly beautiful and secluded scenery. Go for a relaxing bike ride between the countryside fields, where you can smell the fragrance of the straw and fully experience the memory of warm nautre. Take a stroll through the area, thoroughly appreciating the romantic atmosphere of the Dongshan River bank, home to several natural ecological areas, where peacefulness, relaxation, leisure, and tranquility may also be experienced through the landscape. Beautiful as a painting, Dongshan River bank is an experience that provides an excellent way to fulfill your need for mental and spiritual relaxation. Also, Ms. Li enjoys traditional Taiwanese opera, playing a few tunes on strings made from coconut shells or singing a few songs, sharing the fun of this art form with guests. The bed and breakfast features a spacious living room with a small stage and costumes that guests can try out free of charge, experiencing the life of traditional Taiwanese opera.

stays.name: Lan Yang Resort Four Seasons Homestay
stays.description: Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion is located in the upper reaches of the Dongshan River. Bicycle paths run along both sides of the river, and it is close to Dongshan River Ecoark, Dongshan Train Station, Meihua Lake, Wulaokeng Scenic Area, Renshan Botanical Garden, and Luodong Forestry Culture Park. Within a 30-minute drive, you can also reach the Water Park, National Center for Traditional Arts, Luodong Sports Park, and Neipi Lovers Bay in Nanfang’ao.Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion is a legal and stylishly designed B&B that combines modern and contemporary aesthetics. Upon entering the spacious and bright lobby, you are warmly welcomed by the friendly hosts, making you feel right at home. The interior features clever decorations and lighting, creating a comfortable, pressure-free space. The large floor-to-ceiling windows in the rooms allow you to enjoy the ever-changing scenery of the four seasons, refreshing both body and mind while immersing you in the relaxing beauty of nature.Yilan B&B · Lanyang Four Seasons Pavilion offers accommodations for couples, families, and full-house rentals. In the Noble Suite Series, you can relax on a lounge chair in the outdoor garden, basking in the morning sunshine or listening to the night-time chorus of insects and frogs. In the Prestige Suite Series, you can enjoy the view of the sunset and golden dusk while seated outdoors, along with the calming rural night sounds. Experience a relaxing and leisurely vacation here.

stays.name: Mei Shiou B&B
stays.description: Yilan｜Meishiou B&B A Fairytale-Like Carpenter’s HouseWhite clouds drift through the clear, blue Yilan skies as you sing a song and stroll along the country lanes. Suddenly, you hear the energetic barking of a little dog. A little black and white Chihuahua stares at you with its sparkling big eyes. Behind it, a three-level building painted in off-white and brown comes into view. Welcome to Meishiou B&B!Countryside memoirs of a happy encounter with woodPushing open the low, wooden gate, you enter a garden filled with lush and vibrant flowers and plants. Red dragonflies accompany you down the crushed stone pathway right up to the front door. On the veranda, you find a sturdy wooden shoe cabinet above which a blackboard has been colorfully decorated with the words “Meishiou B&B: lodging, woodworking, playful life.” You open the door to a room full of richly colored wooden furniture, giving the interior the feeling of a small forest. Lifting your head, you see a beautiful scene of blue sky and green trees out the window, and you feel as if you’ve entered the home of a fairytale elf!This fairytale-like home and all the beautiful furniture within is a product of the hard work of your hosts. The doghouse in the entrance is your hostess Meishiou’s first woodworking project, to create a warm little corner for her beloved dog, Bogi. She has since transformed herself into a stylish female carpenter! She dragged Piety, who loves DIY projects, into her plan, to become her number-one helper. Piety’s passion for carpentry, however, originates from his inherent desire to get his hands on everything around him. He once even helped SGS to do inspection work! Eventually, they built a tiny woodworking shop behind their house, helping to establish their dream home. A cozy, warm woodworking shop, a miniature tri-color fairytaleGoing up stairs, you see Meishiou’s creativity in the natural tri-color decor: red, blue, and green. Each room seems to embody its own miniature fairytale. The first page of the tale tells the story of a sunflower growing up in a safflower garden. With multi-colored pillows and tender-colored walls, the “Red Warmth Room” is a little paradise just for you and your furry friend, set up to give you the most delightful experience before settling in for bed.The second page of the tale tells of an elf’s fantasy adventure in the green forest. The “Green Forest Room” is the only four-person room at Meishiou B&B, serving as the perfect secret base for you and your friends to share a vacation together. A red dinosaur dangling from a floating balloon drifts up near the ceiling, the clock on his belly tick-tocking away as if to suggest that this is the moment for a joyous adventure to begin!On the third floor, you open the third page of the tale, where a mermaid princess shares her story about the world beneath the sea. The “Blue Waters Room” has an elevated wooden floor with a row of tall blue waves for bed headboards. This room has the only bathtub, and it’s pink, like a romantic blessing from the mermaid princess.A fairytale home converging with real lifeIn the morning, you walk out onto the balcony, take a deep breath of that fresh, clean Yilan air, and catch a whiff of a delicious breakfast cooking! Soy milk, a fresh fruit and vegetable salad, mashed potato balls, soft-boiled eggs, and perfectly toasted bread combine for a simple yet perfectly energizing breakfast. If you’re intrigued by Meishiou and Piety’s woodworking life, you can book a seat in Friday’s woodworking course for a chance to hammer around with Meishiou in the workshop! Different than your standard carpentry course, Meishiou enjoys using love to create woodcrafts with her guests. Piety humorously refers to their workshop as their “delivery room” where you can experience with your own hands the satisfaction of creating things from wood.The warm feeling inside the house is just like the interaction between Meishiou and Piety – comfortable and cozy. When they met each other, one had just completed a job, while the other had fallen in love with hiking as a way of coping with a break up. They began hiking, fishing, and bicycle-riding together - they’ve even conquered half of the hundred highest peaks in Taiwan. Having an unspoken understanding of one another, they began to construct their guesthouse together. They’ve been through a lot in their countryside life; even though Piety recently fell seriously ill, the illness was unable to defeat them as they faced it with unyielding optimism. This fairytale-like home is not simply a physical building. Even more so, Meishiou B&B is a product of the charisma of its hosts.

stays.name: Nature Garden B&B
stays.description: Nature House Homestay is located at No. 168 Fuxing Road, Dongshan Township, Yilan County, next to Luodong Sports Park, a raised stand-alone 3-story building with 53 large windows providing great ventilation and lighting, grounds covering 1650 square meter grounds, three courtyards – front, middle, and rear, over one hundred types of precious trees and flowers, greenery as far as the eye can see, and a fragrant atmosphere. The courtyard contains a huge stone weighing over 10 tons and big Taiwanese pine, maple, and camphor trees reaching 3 stories in height. The middle courtyard is paved with fine golden gravel, fun for kids to play with or providing healthy therapeutic effect if walked on barefoot. The courtyard is surrounded by a green fence and includes a trail paved with a variety of gravel – environmentally-friendly, organic, and natural. Relax in this refreshing, natural, pleasant environment. If you enjoy being close to nature and appreciating trees and stones, we welcome you to Nature House Homestay, a heavenly experience!

stays.name: ORLA B&B
stays.description: An ordinary family of three generations, because of an opportunity allowing them to move back from Taipei to their birthplace--Yilan, and because of longing for the warm, lazy, natural, relaxed living atmosphere of Spanish style, they designed and constructed a Spanish-style architecture with a wide corridor in the Lanyang Plain of similar simplicity and hospitality. After moving into the new home, we found that here has a valuable ecological environment without pollutions. In the evening, when chatting in the corridors, the fireflies will join us, and as insects chirp and frogs cry, the natural concertos are prevalent. During sleep, the air is filled with the fragrance of wild ginger flower. In the morning, the melodious sounds of birds chirping make you happy to get up. Open the windows, you are greeted by the rolling greenish-blue hills that reflect the shading of dawn squeezed out from the gaps in the clouds. Fish, wild eels, and crabs are swimming leisurely in the surrounding clear stream, playing hide and seek with you. Hordes of white egrets are frequent visitors here, so as the stunning beauty of the evening sky. Do not think that it is situated in the wilderness, Orla is a 10 minutes& #39; drive from the Luodong Night Market where delicious specialty snack stands are lined up. Along the way you will find the Luodong Sports Park, the largest combined sports and leisure park in Yilan. You can rest on this night, planning to Ilan County in other popular sites, or you want in this beautiful natural surroundings and get the head venting, put photos of their favorite music, grab a cup of coffee, read several books or holding a fishing rod to a wild creek fishing, you can sit comfortably on the balcony watching the rich birdlife four weeks to Euler (ORLA) trip now! ~ Life was so casual ease!

This is ideal for traveling with your friends or family and you won't feel sorry for staying up all night playing or holding parties.

stays.name: Shenxianwan bnb
stays.description: Celestial Bed and Breakfast is located between the outskirts and center of Luodong, providing guests the opportunity to experience countryside scenery as well as being only a 10 minute drive from the city center. We’re near Luodong Sports Park, where you can stretch out your muscles and appreciate the beauty of nature. Look up and appreciate the flower garden before you, and realize you’re experiencing not just the romance of life but the honor and nobility of royalty. Celestial Bed and Breakfast was planned and designed by the owner himself, with classical-style interior decoration rivaling 5-star hotels, while the area is surrounded by green plants and a natural stone landscape pond. We offer several large, exquisite, elegant suite rooms, and each room features concepts of fine carving craftsmanship, creating a lasting antique atmosphere with an artistic rather than commercial feel, establishing a highly interesting and tasteful style that exhibits not just rooms but attentive service and acute perception. Let your vacation linger at this most beautiful living environment.

stays.name: The Dew B&B
stays.description: A real, authentic bed and breakfast upholding the principles of the trade instead of being over-commercialized. You’ll never be met by standardized or automatic greeting or service here! We treat every guest as a family member or friend and are committed to providing a home for everyone who comes to visit Yilan, hosting each one with sincerity and friendliness. For us, running a bed and breakfast isn’t about money, it’s about sharing the fun of life with you. Located in the countryside, The Dew offers a spirit of sharing in the bed and breakfast life. This isn’t a hotel or motel, it’s your home in Yilan! Wake up to the sound of birds and insects instead of a machine, an alarm clock. After getting washed and dressed, take a 5 minute bike ride and before you know it come into view of the beautiful Dongshan River. Bathe in Yilan’s beautiful scenery along the river, and by the time you return, the owner’s wife will have a rich, authentic Chinese or Western-style breakfast waiting for you! Our family warmly greets and hosts every guest, and you can be sure never to feel like a stranger here. Though we’ve never met, we’re like long-separated family or friends! Pack your bags and come by yourself or with a group of friends, taking a temporary break from life to come to Yilan and take a deep breath, daydream, read, listen to music, or take an in-depth trip. Relax and give yourself the opportunity to be pampered!

stays.name: The Tiles Garden
stays.description: Yilan is a must-visit place for travelers"Qiwaju" is the best choice for travelers to relax and calm their mindsSurrounded by green mountains and shrouded in clouds and mist, it is like a fairylandGet away from the hustle and bustle of the cityLet the chirping of insects and birds accompany youSinging the most beautiful melodyThe museum is located in the Zhongshan Leisure Agriculture Area of ​​Dongshan Township. The main agricultural products are jasmine tea and pomelo. It is about a 5-minute drive from Meihua Lake, Renshan Botanical Garden, and Xin/Jiuliao Waterfalls. The ecology is rich, and there are tung flowers and fireflies from April to May every year. It is about an 8-minute drive from Dongshan Railway Station. It is the most beautiful railway station in Yilan. There is also the Ecological Green Boat Scenic Area around it. It is the closest secluded manor to the city. Everyone is welcome to enjoy this beautiful time of leisure and slow living.

stays.name: Vanilla forest
stays.description: Vanilla Forest is in Dongshan township, Yilan county. It is near Meihua Lake where you can ride a bicycle and feel the breeze. When was the last time you felt so free? The name, Vanilla Forest, is named after our special room. If you want to experience our forest room, please contact us and make a booking. The rest of the rooms are named after plants and their features as well. Every room has lovely potted plants to bring you a sense of nature. There is no luxurious design. There is no hustle and bustle of the city. We provide the best services and a comfy environment. You will be amazed by our lively plants and the magnificent nature. When you come here, please take a deep breath slowly. Let out the emotions that have long been suppressed and say to yourself, "I am fine. I am here. I am enjoying my vacation in Vanilla Forest."

stays.name: Xinyuan
stays.description: As you enter the main hall of Xin Yuan House, you’ll notice two elegantly-shaped inscribed boards next to the door, bearing the words “I only care about you, no matter where you’re from” and “I hope my effort can win your heart.” This is the beauty of Xin Yuan House. We provide each castle with its own romantic English-style breakfast in the morning and mild-strength cocktails in the evening. Rooms come with automatic coffee machines and organic flower tea. Don’t forget to bring your camera and leave behind beautiful memories. We hope you enjoy a wonderful atmosphere from the moment you enter Xin Yuan House. Every guest is instantly impressed the moment he or she enters the room – it’s a castle for princes and princesses, straight out of a fairy tale. In 2000, we were honored as the Most Beautiful Garden Bed and Breakfast by Yilan County. The garden is full of a variety of flowers, attracting a number of newlyweds to take wedding photographs here. We’ve also been the setting for several television shows as well as being interviewed by Japanese TV and thereby earning the reputation of having “more authentic style than England itself.” People often ask, “What’s the best part of being a bed and breakfast owner?” When friends wave goodbye and say, “When I have time, I’m definitely coming back!” Xin Yuan House is a rest stop embracing happiness, leaving guests with a feeling of warmth and happiness as they depart and knowing the wonder of this place will always be a part of their memories.

stays.name: Ya Di Homestay
stays.description: Reservation Hotline: 03-954-6377 "Reclaiming the southern land, / dull, I was, to settle into life in a rustic home. / Empty house, clean courtyard, / contented, I am." -- Return to a Rustic Life by Tao Yuanming. How desirable is the world of pastoral poetry. Nowadays, to immerse in a pastoral landscape, you are no longer looking for it in your dream, or imagining. Take a 40 minutes’ drive from Taipei to Ya Di San He Yuan in Yilan, and you can immerse in experiencing the scenery of a bucolic farm and the life without contention only in a poetic world. "Ya Di San He Yuan" has high ceiling spacious interiors, modern kitchen equipment of European style, warm and comfortable rooms, in addition to a 450 square-meter outdoor music garden, which includes a BBQ area, happy organic farm, a fishing area with natural springs, a paddling pool with natural springs, etc. Staying at Ya Di San He Yuan, you will drop unconsciously the bother of dusts, fatigue, and worries of a city life, and relax yourself to listen to the sounds of nature, to sip a cup of coffee, to watch the visiting migratory birds flying pass in the sky. Also, the children living in the urban jungle stay here they can run and play free, and enjoy the fun of fishing and barbecue with parents together. As night falls, the stars are coming in all over the sky, embellishing Ya Di San He Yuan with romantic, quiet leisure.

stays.name: muho
stays.description: There is an acre of land in everyone’s heart…What do you plant it with? This place used to be a piece of golden rice field, now we have planted love, hope and dream here… Hope you can cast aside the urban noises and escape from the maddening crowd to enjoy tranquility and the Slow Life. How long have you not listened to your own voice? Listen to the bug buzzes and bird chirps, to experience the baptism of nature. The warm breeze and the fragrant rice fields, this is an ideal place to calm one’s spirit, let us soar in this rich rice field and pursue your dream…

stays.name: my sweetie homestay
stays.description: Sometimes you call your lover or best friend "My sweetie," and that is exactly why we name our B&B as "my sweetie homestay"! Just imagining how a husband would treat his beloved wife, we have the same feeling to share the pure food and friendly people with you. Taking friendliness and health as the business theories,"my sweetie homestay" is committed to providing the tourists a healthy and non-toxic accommodation. "Friendliness" means being friendly to the earth, which means cultivating and tilling without using insecticides, chemical fertilizer or herbicides. The host is an eco-friendly farmer supported by the County Government. In the plantation, we planted lots of trees, constructed a water lily ecological pond and only use natural detergents and cleaning solutions. We try our best to be friendly to the Earth. Inside the house, we put the furniture made of logs, and set up the barrier-free facilities. There is less decoration in the house; thus, we make low pollution and reduce the chance for people breathing in the chemical substance. We try our best to be friendly towards people. The host is a food expert and has the certificates of Level B and C technician for Chinese culinary and for baking food. He knows well that chemical additives are harmful, so he selects the best natural food ingredients for you. You can experience the plantation life and cook with clean ingredients. My sweetie homestay is located in Kelin Village, Dongshan Township, Yilan County, and is close to resorts like Luodong Sports Park, night market, Plum Blossom Lake, Kelin Fountain, Annong River and E-long goat farm. The B&B is near Luodong River, and you would have an extensive view - the sunrise in the morning, the sunset in the evening, and stars and moon at night. Besides, you would see Guishan Island on your left and San-Ching-Kung on the right. The scenic beauty will definitely refresh your mind. Welcome to the best B&B of Yilan!

stays.name: Baron''s Hot-Spring Hotel
stays.description: Jiaosi~ People''s first impression of Jiaosi is its beauty as the "Hometown of Hot Springs".The calling of "beautiful hot springs", weak alkaline sodium bicarbonate springs, attracts a great number of people who pay close attention to their wellness to visit Jiaosi. Jiaosi has hot springs, fresh fruits and vegetables and beautiful scenery, all just waiting for you to visit. The hearty hospitality of the Baron''s Hotel will help you feel the local sincerity and passion!Just about a 5-minute walk to the hotel from the Jiaosi Train Station, stepping onto Gongyuan Road is like stepping into paradise. On the right side is the Tourist Service Center surrounded by trees. This is a good place to take a walk and meditate along the quiet trails, on which you can hear birds and insects chirping from time to time. Located on the left side is a sophisticated and stylish building standing brilliantly, and that is the Baron''s Hotel. When you walk into the lobby, our cordial reception will be the first greeting to welcome you to the Baron''s Hotel!

stays.name: Bay Inn
stays.description: WeInnOne Jiaoxi is located on Wunuan Road, consisting of a twin villa. It features a community driveway that can accommodate 6-8 cars, and there is a front yard for BBQ with a semi-automatic rain and sunshade tent measuring 3x3 meters. WeInnOne Jiaoxi has two buildings, each with four floors. The 2nd and 3rd floors of each building have double rooms with large balconies and double rooms with large panoramic windows. The 4th floor has 4-person rooms, with a total of 12 bed spaces (the top floor is only open for groups of over 8 people). In addition, the 2nd and 3rd floors each have a wet and dry bathroom with a shower, which is clean and spacious, making it suitable for 8-16 people to stay comfortably. In addition to the consistent room types, each building has entertainment facilities, including BBQ, KTV singing, and electric mahjong tables. This allows friends and family to gather, sing, and have fun. Finally, WeInnOne is a pet-friendly guesthouse—besides having an outdoor space for pets to run around, the indoor space is also very spacious, making it a perfect place for pets to relax and enjoy their vacation.

stays.name: Campestral Garden Homestay
stays.description: The elegant structure of Campestral Garden merges with the natural scenery, and the clear call of birds is the most pleasing symphony of this place. Feel the gentle breeze and enjoy a cup of coffee in the courtyard, experiencing a sensation of intoxicating leisure that fills Campestral Garden. During the day, you can clearly see the magnificent outline of Guishan Island; in the evening, you’re surrounded by Lanyang’s night scenery. Here, the untouched countryside and waves of rice compose the most beautiful painting you’ve seen, the night birds and insects the most special symphony you’ve heard. Campestral Garden is a place of nature, simplicity, and serenity. We’re located in the famous Erlong Dragon Boat Racing Community, and the newly-completed Erlong River embankment is a great place to take a walk, jog, or go bike riding. The Yilan Visitor Information Center provides information regarding the Lanyang area. The famous Wufengqi Waterfall is also nearby, as well as the night scenery of Lin Mei Golf Course and the century-old Xietian Temple, all being worthy tourist attractions.

stays.description: -Find your own little universe at corner 79!Want to escape from the hustle and bustle of the city and take a healing micro trip?#79 Corner B&B Villa is waiting for you to lie down!It is only 10 minutes away from Jiaoxi city, and it is just the right place for a quiet place in the bustling city.Just outside the door is the water bird sanctuary, surrounded by nature, and every breath of air feels like cleansing your lungs!Whether you want to relax with your loved ones, take your children to relax, or go on a spontaneous trip with friends,Here you will find all the chill, relaxing vibes and plenty of great photo spots you need!The room is spacious and comfortable, and the photos are so beautiful that they can be easily taken on Instagram.I lay in bed, staring at the sunset and listening to the water birds singing. I didn’t want to check out at all!

stays.name: Goodeatting
stays.description: Star Riverbank is located in the Shichao Leisure Farm Area in Jiaoxi Township. This area is a waterfowl protected area. Not only is Star Riverbank lucky to be in this area, its close proximity to the riverbank of Erlong River is another desirable element. Erlong River is a natural river that has not gone through any man-made changes. The riverbank bikeway is highly recommended by the B&B owners. There is another excellent bikeway next to Star Riverbank where you can take County Road 191 at Yulong Bridge, near Erlong River, and ride in the direction of the edge of the mountain. To go toward the direction of the ocean, ride along Erlong River downstream (the right bank of Dezikou River), which is also a nice bikeway shaded by trees on both sides. The river and scenery here make it worthwhile for nature-loving visitors.

stays.description: This is a simple hotel located in Jiaoxi. Come here to communicate with people from all over the world, or try a different pace of life, and provide travelers with an opportunity to get to know this town. What we provide is a simple accommodation space, simple but not crude. Different from the luxurious facilities of big hotels, you can slow down and live here at your own pace, simply providing travelers with an opportunity to get to know this hot spring town and explore the former prosperity in the streets and lanes. This place is not big, but it is suitable for exploring slowly, maybe it will give you new discoveries and new feelings every time. We invite you to experience the various things in Jiaoxi at a slow and leisurely pace.

stays.name: Hotel Les Champs (Jiaosi)
stays.description: The first impression of Yilan is one of abundant greenery, followed by an gentle ocean breeze and the idyllic pace of the Lanyang Plain. This is the setting for “Hotel Les Champs”, a minimalist granite building with a classic copper roof with a rich European ambience? The 7M tall lobby puts guests completely at ease while the attentive reception staff offers weary travelers a warm welcome. The 12-storey European style building is also surrounded by a carefully landscaped garden. Walking down the spiral staircase in the rear garden brings guests to the newly added Bali Hot Spring Swimming Pool, the Four Seasons Hot Spring Spa and the Crystal Energy Sauna where a tropical atmosphere awaits. During the day, you can wander beneath the warm sunlight to embrace the country ambience and metropolitan opulence. At night, you can relax and enjoy the purity of a sky filled with sparkling stars. Les Champs& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39; most famous feature is our special “Sunken Ceramic Bath”. Guests can enjoy the sodium hydrogen carbonate spring waters – also known as “Beauty Hot Spring” – in their own suits with perfect privacy and hygiene. We particularly recommend the “Yocyuan Hot Spring Suite” as it offers breathtaking views of Gueishan Island without having to go to see it. The French windows also offer unparalleled views of the Lanyang Plains. This is a unique experience that only Hotel Les Champs can offer out of all of the hotels in Jiaosi. At Les Champs, “To be a hotel worth visiting and a hotel worth remembering” is our philosophy. We hope to offer our guests an even better travel experience. The hotel& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39;s facilities are therefore regularly adjusted in keeping with the seasons. We also offer the best quality and most reasonably priced packaged tours of beautiful Lanyang. “Hotel Les Champs” is confident that our high quality suites and extensive facilities backed by the most attentive service will meet the needs of your mind and body. Why keep such a wonderful experience a secret? Come and experience for yourself the magic of “Hotel Les Champs”, rated by the Japanese publisher Shueisha as one of the “Top 50 Hot Spring Hotels in the World”.

This is the setting for “Hotel Les Champs”, a minimalist granite building with a classic copper roof with a rich European ambience? The 7M tall lobby puts guests completely at ease while the attentive reception staff offers weary travelers a warm welcome. The 12-storey European style building is also surrounded by a carefully landscaped garden. Walking down the spiral staircase in the rear garden brings guests to the newly added Bali Hot Spring Swimming Pool, the Four Seasons Hot Spring Spa and the Crystal Energy Sauna where a tropical atmosphere awaits. During the day, you can wander beneath the warm sunlight to embrace the country ambience and metropolitan opulence. At night, you can relax and enjoy the purity of a sky filled with sparkling stars. Les Champs& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39; most famous feature is our special “Sunken Ceramic Bath”. Guests can enjoy the sodium hydrogen carbonate spring waters – also known as “Beauty Hot Spring” – in their own suits with perfect privacy and hygiene. We particularly recommend the “Yocyuan Hot Spring Suite” as it offers breathtaking views of Gueishan Island without having to go to see it. The French windows also offer unparalleled views of the Lanyang Plains. This is a unique experience that only Hotel Les Champs can offer out of all of the hotels in Jiaosi. At Les Champs, “To be a hotel worth visiting and a hotel worth remembering” is our philosophy. We hope to offer our guests an even better travel experience. The hotel& #39;& #39;& #39;& #39;s facilities are therefore regularly adjusted in keeping with the seasons. We also offer the best quality and most reasonably priced packaged tours of beautiful Lanyang. “Hotel Les Champs” is confident that our high quality suites and extensive facilities backed by the most attentive service will meet the needs of your mind and body. Why keep such a wonderful experience a secret? Come and experience for yourself the magic of “Hotel Les Champs”, rated by the Japanese publisher Shueisha as one of the “Top 50 Hot Spring Hotels in the World”.

stays.name: MU JIAO XI HOTEL
stays.description: Inheriting My Humble House’s unique taste on aesthetics, culture and art, MU JIAO XI HOTEL commissions Taiwanese artists and world-renowned LTW hotel design team to integrate contemporary art into local culture, curating an elegant, relaxing and tasteful space. MU JIAO XI HOTEL and MU JIAO XI RESERVE, 2 architectural styles, offers a total of 190 guest rooms, featuring 6 room types. Contemporary room spaces showcasing minimalism design, ranging from 12 to 90 pings, offers a retreat back to the basics. Every guestroom is outfitted with a private hot springs tub, and 174 guestrooms have an extended deck area. The open space design invites warm sunlight into the room, rejuvenating the body and soul. MU JIAO XI HOTEL offers four room types(WOOD SUPERIOR ROOM/BREEZE SUPERIOR PATIO ROOM/TWILIGHT DELUXE PATIO ROOM/MU PRESIDENTIAL SUITE), as well as PLAY GROUND and MU CLUB. You& #39;re cordially invited to share the experience of MU. MU TABLE (2F) provides all day buffet service, with abundance of local ingredients served with classic dishes. MU TABLE will definitely satisfy your palate.MU BAR (1F) invites you to enjoy a relaxed ambience while tippling your favorite beverage. With a selection of exquisite art inspired by nature and a variety of multi-purpose facilities, MU JIAO XI HOTEL is the choice for complete relaxation.

stays.name: MUMU JIAO-XI Hotel
stays.description: Passing Taipei Yilan Highway and heading for Jiaoxi along Provincial Highway 9, Chuang-Tang Spring Spa Hotel is located in the hot spring area. Walking into the lobby and you will be greeted with friendly smiles. With intimate services and fully equipped facilities in the Hotel, you can relax and enjoy the romantic ambience of the home of hot spring.Total 121 guest rooms available. Each room is unique and elegant. Choices of room sizes at least 50 square meters. Luxurious and elegant amenities. The Hotel also offers hot spring and spa facilities of different styles, exquisite hot spring parlor, and outdoor hot spring bathing pool. In particular, the Wuxin and Liu-foo Hot Spring pools offer alternative bathing styles with complete and comfortable leisure facilities for you to indulge Jiaoxi’s hot spring atmosphere. Next, savor the Hotel’s fine dining, professional management, international class intimate service, carefully designed room types for you to choose from. You will have a warm hot spring journey that you wish to stay for longer time.

stays.name: Orient Luxury Hotel - Jiaoxi
stays.description: In Yilan, an art city, we use an architectural style that stands out with a mesh exterior grille structure, combined with clean water construction methods, a large open-air bath with a natural atmosphere of a hot spring forest, and a hot spring-style children's play area space to create a It is a unique hot spring hotel and has a semi-open-air marble hot spring bathtub in the room, allowing you to experience the open-air hot spring experience without interference in the room. The base of the hot spring club is located in Jiaoxi, Yilan. It often rains continuously in Yilan. The linear raindrops are the unknown medium between people and the streets. The reinterpretation also fragments the appearance of the streets. The hot springs in Jiaoxi in the rain even merge with the hazy mist. There was a vague quality between people in the soup pool.We try to replace a heavy volume with an unknown texture, so that the irregular lines produce an unknown volume. The lines are mixed with the activities of travelers in the room and change their appearance. Sometimes the roller blinds are half-covered, and sometimes Fog fills the room, sometimes the windows are bright and clear, and sometimes the night light shines through. The pedestrians' perception of the building changes with the movement, and the building becomes a changing texture, just like the mystery of Jiaoxi in the drizzle and mist.

stays.name: Starshine Hill
stays.description: Gazing at stars veiled by the mist, next to the lotus pond, Among lotus pond and rice paddy, Luxurious house erects in a beautiful village, Sounds of birds chirping and stream water running in the early morning, Sunset evening and starry night. Jiaoxi B&B - Starshine Home Stay is a Baroque style white house situated in the countryside of Jiaoxi Township. Located in the midst of farmlands and lotus ponds, the surrounding scenery changes according to season. Each season presents a stunning view and a different sentiment. The B&B covers a large area with a spacious interior. It's well-run and well-equipped so guests don't need to worry about anything. They just need to enjoy themselves and soak in the beautiful Yilan lifestyle. Jiaoxi B&B - Starshine Home Stay has guestrooms for couples and for family of four. Guest with a big group can rent the whole house as well. The decor in each room corresponds to the names given to each room - romantic and elegant. stays.name: Sun Spring Resort
stays.description: Sun Spring Resort is a leisure resort hotel located in Jiaoxi (Jiaosi), Yilan. All safety measures and facilities adhere to the strictest standards mandated by the government. Sun Spring Resort is located eight-minute-walk away from the Jiaoxi train station. The hotel is facing mountains with its back facing Lanyang Plain. The hotel is conveniently located among a number of popular attraction points including Jiaoxi Park, Jiaoxi swimming pool, hiking trails, and so on. The hotel's back is facing Turtle Island with a magnificent view.Every room in Sun Spring Resort has hot springs. The hotel has a public hot spring spa pool, two outdoor naked hot spring pools, two indoor naked hot spring pools, free Chinese Western breakfast buffet for guests, delicious and healthy combination meals, free bicycle rental, free binocular rental, free parking, free transportation from and to the Jiaoxi train station for guests.At the top floor you can overlook the magnificent view of Jiaoxi, Yilan. The restaurants can double as conference rooms and places to host various activities such as a birthday party and a business dinner. The hotel has a game room for rent and full body massage with oil for purchase. You can access WiFi anywhere in the hotel.

stays.name: Taiori
stays.description: Yilan｜TaioriPlentiful Harvest! The Gourmand’s Ideal Japanese FeastPassing through the Snow Mountain Tunnel and exiting the highway interchange, you turn down a small road into a rural atmosphere rich with the scent of rice paddies. To say that the enchanting county of Yilan is akin to Taipei’s backyard garden simply doesn’t do it justice. This place could more rightly be described as every traveler’s ideal paradise. In the same way, Taiori is every Japanese cuisine-loving gourmand’s Shangri-la.Experience the exquisite character of a Japanese-style homeAs with every other bed and breakfast in Yilan county, Taiori is tucked away beside farmers’ fields, and exudes a generous and friendly ambiance. Even though this is so, it’s difficult to miss the sight of it, with its light gray slate wall and wooden door. To one side of the door sit several bicycles and potted plants. Compared to the other cement buildings in the area, Taiori radiates a different kind of warmth.Opening the doors and stepping forward, you immediately smell the rich aroma of solid wood. Above a long wooden table, a Japanese-style water kettle hangs peacefully from a hook over a charcoal burner. A colorful Japanese-style flag bearing the name of the bed and breakfast hangs on the wall in the entrance. Symbolic in Japan of a plentiful fishing harvest, the colorful red fish leaping into the sunshine between Mount Fuji and a magnificent sea wave seem to represent the feelings of satisfaction and abundance that Taiori hopes to give to every guest. Your hostess, Shan, approaches and greets you in her delicate voice. Her genuine smile gives every traveler the feeling that they have arrived at a traditional Japanese household, and are about to experience the meticulous attention to detail characteristic of the Japanese. “Our original motivation was to allow people to travel to Yilan for a vacation, to eat local fish, and discover the deliciousness of Taiwanese fish!” With his wife Shan’s support, Wesley exacting tastes realized that no other bed and breakfast had yet combined the local seafood of Yilan with the hot springs for which Jiaoxi is famous into a single space. So they took the initiative and constructed just such a landmark restaurant guesthouse which is now in high demand.Experience the warmth of slow livingWhen you arrive at Taiori with its solid wood construction and head upstairs to the second floor, the symmetrical rooms left and right both consist of comfortable two-level spaces. The bedrooms contain soft beds and a full wall of windows overlooking the vast fields beyond. After soaking in the hot spring bathtub, you don a supple bathrobe and sit in the Japanese-style space sipping hot tea and playing Chinese chess. Turning your head, you admire the bright green rice paddies outside the windows. During migratory bird season, black-winged stilts with their long, slender legs can be seen wading slowly through the fields.The upper level of each room consists of your very own private hot spring spa which, however small, is brimming with character. The spacious hot spring bathtub is large enough for three or four friends to enjoy without feeling crowded. Bathing in the gentle hot spring water of Jiaoxi, while sipping a glass of ice-cold sake wine and marveling at the meticulously manicured Japanese garden outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, you feel elated and content.Collect for safe keeping all the delicious memoriesFor the gourmand traveler, the most fascinating element of Taiori B&B is obviously the sumptuous evening meal. When he was a boy, Wesley fell in love with eating and enjoyed helping his mother in the kitchen. Stationed in Shitiping, he often joined the fishermen at sea, experiencing firsthand how to eat freshly caught fish raw and straight from the sea. Seizing the opportunity to open a restaurant beside the Shitiping Harbor, he learned the ropes for cooking seafood while consulting his indigenous chef friends. To this day, Wesley still makes daily trips to the harbor to select the freshest fish, always striving to prepare a unique seasonal menu just for you.Appetizers consist of Yilan’s famous smoked duck and handpicked seaweed. Japanese Jack mackerel, Oriental tuna, and sweet prawns caught fresh that evening are prepared into sashimi, allowing you to savor their most authentic flavor. Precious harlequin shrimp and red big-eyed fish are served lightly salted and broiled to perfection to preserve the delicate freshness of the meat. The seasonal main dish is fried on a pottery skillet: anglerfish liver, testes, and maw served with a rich variety of vegetables and mushrooms, paired with a clear soup and light brown Japanese soy sauce. The sweetness of the veggies perfectly complements the savory fish in mildly salty sauce to produce an indescribable array of flavors. The meal is followed at last by a bowl of miso soup and a kumquat slushie. Using the authentic flavors of the best unadorned ingredients, tonight’s meal leaves you with an unforgettable dining experience.In operation for nearly nine years, Wesley and Shan have not lost their passion for life. Through the hot springs of Jiaoxi and their deliciously sincere intention, they take care of the heart of every traveler. Between blue sky and green fields, they have created a happy safe harbor, providing you with relaxation and peace of mind.

stays.name: Tian Long hotel
stays.description: If you want to experience Yilan County to the fullest, Tian Long Hotel will absolutely be your best partner. Here, you can go to many tourist, shopping and dining spots at ease. Only a 5-7 minute walk from Tian Long Hotel can take you to numerous spots, such as train station, transfer station and Jiaoxi Hot Spring Park. ""Tourism Bureau grants three star rating – Tian Long Hotel"" Although we have only 33 rooms, the bathroom equipment we have is all from 5-star brand like Kohler (the U.S.) and Perla whirlpool tub (Italy). The hot spring bath built with Kuan Yin stones perfectly conveys our concept of enjoying hot springs! As you walk into the bath, the beautiful music will help you relax in the warm spring. Servicing with all heart and sustainable operation are what Tian Long care about! The breakfast is quite popular among our guests! Our rooms are mostly equipped with independent cylinder and down comforter to make it possible for you to leave all of your worries behind and have a sweet dream. Let’s fall in love with hot spring! Tian Long Hotel has several semi-outdoor scenery hot spring pools which can act as SPAs. You can appreciate the night scenes of the Lanyang Plain and enjoy the soft breeze and music, while easing the fatigue throughout the day.

stays.name: WeInnOne2
stays.description: WeInnOne Jiaoxi is located on Wunuan Road, consisting of a twin villa. It features a community driveway that can accommodate 6-8 cars, and there is a front yard for BBQ with a semi-automatic rain and sunshade tent measuring 3x3 meters. WeInnOne Jiaoxi has two buildings, each with four floors. The 2nd and 3rd floors of each building have double rooms with large balconies and double rooms with large panoramic windows. The 4th floor has 4-person rooms, with a total of 12 bed spaces (the top floor is only open for groups of over 8 people). In addition, the 2nd and 3rd floors each have a wet and dry bathroom with a shower, which is clean and spacious, making it suitable for 8-16 people to stay comfortably. In addition to the consistent room types, each building has entertainment facilities, including BBQ, KTV singing, and electric mahjong tables. This allows friends and family to gather, sing, and have fun. Finally, WeInnOne is a pet-friendly guesthouse—besides having an outdoor space for pets to run around, the indoor space is also very spacious, making it a perfect place for pets to relax and enjoy their vacation.

stays.description: Yamagata Prefecture in Japan contains many majestic natural sights and mysterious temples hidden in mountains; intertwined with Mount Zaō, the elegance of nature is conveyed through the light of dusk reflected off frosted tree branches, icy mountain paths, and emanating mists from hot springs.Extending along the Sendai line, the mountain’s temples are major spiritual grounds for religious practitioners. Walking along the serene paths, events and scenes from the past carry a color of mystery but one breaks free from mundane fetters for tranquil relaxation in sacred grounds.The Kavalan, an indigenous people of Yilan are known as “people of the plains”; their nurturing of these lands has established their symbiotic relationship with the mountains and forests.Yamagata Kaku was inspired by traditional local culture with an exterior design based on the mountainous terrain and soaring cliffs that the indigenous people call home.Décor and furnishings are infused with ancient history and an acknowledgment of this region for an aura that exudes the affinity of nature and tranquility.Soft and gentle colors fill each guest room through the use of natural stone and wood materials, an alternating warm palette that combines to paint a welcoming atmosphere, as if our guests stood amid the forests and plains.Yamagata Kaku can be found in the optimal location of Jiaoxi, providing today’s guests with a recreational resort that is relaxing, free, comfortable, and serene.Listen to the voice of your heart and delicately enjoy the stories of this land through the philosophy of naturalism and Zen meditation.Mountain Temple,It represents the devotion of one’s body in exile to train the spiritescape from the grime and stressthe aspects of mankind, nature, society, and history establish the spacepractice in this hidden land.Experience and meditate,allow your mind, body, and soulto return to their most primitive state.Upholding the Japanese tea ceremony spirit of “one chance in a lifetime”We look forward to your visit and await your experience here

stays.name: Yoai Jiaoxi Hotel
stays.description: HOTEL j Jiaoxi is located in the most bustling part of Jiaoxi, a location from which it is convenient to get to any attraction in Yilan. Better yet, we provide a warm and comfortable environment to make you feel at home.We are right next to the shops and food streets. Visitors may shop and taste the authentic delicacies of the Jiaoxi hot spring. HOTEL j Jiaoxi is located on Provincial Highway Number 9. Transportation is convenient as we are within a 5-minute walking distance from both the train station as well as the bus station. We are within 5-8 minutes driving distance after getting off State Highway Number 5 via Toucheng Interchange. The hotel itself is a single 5-story building equipped with 31 guest rooms. The reception lobby, restaurant and each room are all designed with the unique Lanyang style. We are also equipped with the best facilities such as hot spring pools, air conditioning, satellite/cable TV and free Wi-Fi. The hot springs in Jiaoxi also known as the springs of beauty, are unique plain sodium bicarbonate springs. It is colorless, odorless and the only one in Taiwan. All room types in the hotel are outfitted with a spring pool, Japanese style room separation of dry and wet,allowing you to enjoy the spring of beauty unique to Jiaoxi right in your room. Guest rooms are designed in the metropolitan fashion style and painted in a colorful manner, providing travelers with a diverse and comfortable living area. "j" means "Home." HOTEL j's main appeal is our brand image of homeliness, allowing you to enjoy the sweet times of being at home. HOTEL j offers buffet-style breakfast in Chinese and Western styles, allowing you to enjoy the authentic Lanyang taste during your stay.We uphold the spirits of passion, care and thoughtfulness as we serve our guests. Your trip will transcend simple tourism and become an enjoyable experience of relaxation for mind and body.

stays.name: Yunju B&B
stays.description: The owner of Yun Ju House has 5 brothers and 1 uncle, and the 6 families gather together every Chinese New Year’s or major holiday. So the owner and his wife dreamed of having a big house where everyone could comfortably stay, and thus built this place in the outskirts of Jiaoxi as a vacation villa for relatives working in other parts of the country to return to. In order to maintain accommodation quality, whenever not occupied by relatives it is open to travelers who happen to make their way here. Yun Ju House is situated on a countryside path, with different scenery throughout the year, from the time of rice planting to harvesting. The little birds will serve as your alarm clock, and on clear days you can gaze out at the beauty of Guishan Island and the Xueshan Mountain Range, making this a great place for a day trip. Rest your weary body in the hot springs and enjoy the serenity of the countryside fields. Many of our customers choose to rent out the entire building. The first floor includes a spacious living room and tea brewing area with complete facilities for guests to use, while the spacious activity area behind the building lets guests fire up a countryside BBQ, chat with a group of friends, go for a leisurely bike ride through the fields and appreciate different scenery throughout the year. Located in a quiet spot away from the noise of the city, we’re a 2 minute bike ride away from King Car Ecological Orchid Garden, a 28,200 square meter greenhouse area where you can see butterflies and a sea of orchids. We’re a 3 minute drive from the Mary Leu Carving Art Gallery and 6 minute drive from Jiaoxi City, making this a great place to plan an art and fine cuisine-themed trip.

stays.name: Happiness B&B
stays.description: A young couple born in the 1980s love to make friends, with this personality they incidentally had a chance to make their home a B&B to share with everyone. We are very happy to share with our favorite hometown and the life in here. It is happy to share. Let us have a cup of coffee on the couch, and continue to chat about it. As persons born in the 1980s, we decided to stay in our favorite place, Yilan, after the marriage to create a warm nest that belongs to us. Happiness 300 m was designed by the hostess Vivi. It is a building full of lively vitality, with 22 matching colors, which fully renders her colorful inner world. It was originally a home for the family of the three, and at the un-refusable request of enthusiastic old friends, we opened the house as a B&B to share our life with everyone. Sharing makes you happy, we will share our lives with you, and at the same time, you would be also willing to share yours with us. During the time of sharing a pot of tea, we could talk about anything and exchange each other's experience in the life. This is the most fun thing in a B&B. We are not a hotel, nor an inn. This is a small nest that you can temporarily put aside all things, also a place that you can stay for a time to find happiness, and with the most comfortable way, with the most relaxed mood, we can plant the happiness together to share the life.

stays.name: Lu He Feng Homestay
stays.description: LuHeFeng Homestay: A Tranquil Retreat Back to NatureNestled in the serene town of Luodong in Yilan County, LuHeFeng Homestay is the perfect getaway for those looking to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and unwind in a peaceful, natural environment. Every corner of this place seems to embrace nature, offering guests a quiet and leisurely retreat. Whether you& #39;re here for a brief weekend escape or an extended stay to recharge, this haven allows you to fully relax and reconnect with nature.1. An Invitation from NatureSurrounded by lush green fields, LuHeFeng Homestay boasts fresh air, free from the noise and traffic of the city. Instead, you& #39;ll be greeted by the melodious songs of birds and the occasional gentle breeze, encouraging you to slow down and breathe in the clean, refreshing air. During the day, you can relax on the balcony and enjoy the beautiful rural landscape, while in the evening, you can gaze at the stars and experience the peacefulness and mystery of the twilight.2. Designed with the Feeling of "Home"The design of the homestay is simple yet warm, with every corner of the rooms exuding a "homey" feeling. The soft, neutral colors and gentle lighting create an atmosphere that allows you to unwind and leave behind the stress of everyday life. Each room is equipped with modern amenities, ensuring that you can enjoy a comfortable stay even in the countryside. The view of the fields outside, combined with the cozy indoor ambiance, creates a stress-free environment for your relaxation.LuHeFeng Homestay is a place where you can truly slow down and immerse yourself in nature. Whether you’re from a busy city or simply looking for a quiet sanctuary away from the noise of daily life, this homestay offers the perfect experience for relaxation and comfort. Reconnect with nature and embrace the tranquility – let LuHeFeng Homestay be your ideal choice for rejuvenating both body and soul.

stays.name: March 3
stays.description: March 3rd Bed and Breakfast is located in the scenically beautiful area of Yilan, an 80 minute drive from Taoyuan International Airport, and a 50 minute drive (through Xueshan Tunnel, the longest in Asia) from Taipei, Xinyi District, and 101. Facing the beauty of the Xueshan Mountain Range, we feature a living room with an 8 meter-high ceiling from where guests can enjoy beautiful colors of the sunlight shining through the trees and flowers and listen to the natural symphony of chirping birds and croaking frogs as they enjoy a hearty breakfast. Outside the front door is a bike trail where you can ride through the scenic countryside fields, approaching farms and experiencing the fun of kiln ovens. Try out Taiwan specialty snacks at the night market, or relax your mind and body at Su’ao Cold Springs and Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Yilan – a different experience of Taiwan. The living room of the front building features an 8 meter-high ceiling and covers 200 square meters, where where guests can enjoy the sunrise and listen to the natural symphony of chirping birds and croaking frogs as they relax and enjoy a hearty breakfast. Rooms are 66 to 165 square meters in size. Next to babbling water of the pond, the gentle breeze blows in summer, and the sunlight gently shines in the afternoon. This is a place far from the noise and dirt of the city, where you can slow down and experience a deliberate journey.

stays.name: Memory Garden
stays.description: Memory Garden Villa, which emphasizes health, fortune, and romance, is located in Luodong Township, a busy and flourishing area, next to Luodong Sports Park and Luodong River, with a nearly 270 degree view of natural scenery and a tranquil environment. Along with changes and shifts, the broad Luodong River resembles a Picasso painting. Gaze out at the verdant mountain such as the Syue Mountain Range, Taiping Shan, and Qilan Mountain, observe the sunlight at dawn and clouds at sunset, or relax at the wooden scenic observation deck. Natural scenery and attractions are all laid out before you, at your fingertips. Rooms come in 3 different styles: *Oriental – based on Matsuo Basho’s great travel work “Oku no Hosomichi” *Western – A legendary space and imagination based on the birthplace of Picasso and classic film “Roman Holiday” *South Pacific – Based on Bali, with 130 square meters of space inside and outside the room, creating the best leisure and vacation atmosphere.

stays.name: Shire Homestay
stays.description: Yilan｜Shire GuesthouseThe Tranquil Life in a Secluded AlleyOn a balmy afternoon, you set aside your busy life and take a leisurely stroll across the Luodong Sports Park. In the quiet alleys behind the park, among the many rows of residential houses, you see the elegant Chinese characters of the Shire Guesthouse sign. You need not go far to find your ideal lifestyle after all, for it now appears right before your eyes.The leisure to be found within a secluded residenceThe term “Shire” comes from Ｔhe Lord of the Rings and is the place where the Hobbits live. Shire Guesthouse is precisely like the Shire we know from the movies; a warm, leisurely, peaceful life amid the natural beauty of the land. In this place, your hosts Ivan and his wife Ivy have realized their ideal lifestyle. The moment you set foot in Shire Guesthouse, you are greeted by genial sunlight spilling across a soft carpet through large French windows with warm wooden furniture everywhere you look. The design of Shire Guesthouse has a simple beauty which is not showy. The red brick flooring throughout the ground level makes for a cozy living room, extending under the dining table and into the kitchen. The pastiche stone walls stealthily absorb the humidity of the Yilan air, making for ideal temperatures all year round. Even staying indoors, it is easy to find a spot to sit or lounge or flip through a book and enjoy a leisurely time.Ivan, who began learning landscape design when in university, has unique tastes and specialties. He worked with many important construction companies after graduation. The Luodong Sports Park is one of his works of which he is particularly fond. Later on, he fell in love with Ivy, after which time they worked together to realize their aspirations to build a guesthouse. Before retreating into their Shire lifestyle, Ivy who was born in Yilan was working in Taipei as a clothing assistant. Though the bustling city has its charms, Ivy longed to return to her familiar hometown. As such, when Ivan proposed returning to Yilan to open a guesthouse, Ivy threw herself into the project without hesitation in order to create a beautiful life with her lover. A beautiful evening with the BeatlesFollowing the pastiche stone walls upstairs, the unadorned whitewall design evokes the simple life, alleviating your everyday exhaustion. Walking into the shower to wash away your fatigue, the multi-colored porcelain wall tiles add a splash of excitement to life. Continuing the solid-wood theme of the Shire, the bedroom’s wooden pillars were handpicked by Ivan himself. The unpreserved Taiwanese cypress shows the vestiges of time, like the process of the beautification of life itself. In the quiet of the evening, you are accompanied by the Beatles singing “A Hard Day’s Night” as you recline on the retro leather sofa reading a book until the vinyl record clock on the wall points to 11 o’clock. Even nighttime at the Shire is full of vitality. If you are lucky enough, you may have the pleasure of engaging in deep conversation with Ivan and Ivy, which may be the start of a secret adult meeting. Make an appointment on a whim, chatting happily over some drinks from their private red wine collection - tonight you feel just as content as if meeting with intimate friends for the first time in ages. The courage to face your ideal lifeAs the first rays of sunlight spill into the room, you feel prepared to meet a new day. As your footsteps on the stairs signal your descent to the ground floor, Ivy starts to cook a hot breakfast and the delicious aromas fill the air - the Shire menu changes in accordance with the seasons. Yet one thing always stays the same: the courtesy and consideration extended to all travelling guests. The daily menu and ingredients are flexible, so that even the picky traveler can eat their fill. If you haven’t eaten enough, there is no need to feel awkward - Ivy will happily cook another portion for you! “You need a full belly to be able to head out to have fun!” Ivy’s warm, impassioned laugh and your full belly fill you afresh with energy.The appearance of the ideal life may be a little journey with your sisters, a delightful trip with your sweetheart, or perhaps running off bravely on your own adventure. As such, Ivan and Ivy have the consideration to offer a special package for independent travelers, as a way to assist you in setting off on a new life. If it is in your destiny, perhaps Ivy can even accompany you in exploring parts of Yilan you’ve never seen. “In fact, Ivy always says that I’m just like a hobbit, which is why this place is called the Shire.” Ivan smilingly jokes about Ivy. From time to time, the sound of their quarrels and laughter fills the whole house. The Shire feels like a simple, ordinary space, yet it is filled with an indescribable energy that brings warmth and happiness to all who stay there. In this place, the easy atmosphere and genuine ideal lifestyle are shared with you.

stays.name: Xiang-Heng B&B
stays.description: The neat and tidy design of the house is apparent at first sight, but the interior space is organized completely different from the outside. Based on the exterior style of simplicity, the owner has provided a guest-friendly living environment with all-new decoration, a pleasant visual experience, and comfortable facilities, in addition to attentive service, making this a place where every guest can completely relax their mind and body. After relaxing from the wearies of your travels, take a walk to the park in the back, shedding your burdensome coat and removing your stifling shoes, letting yourself take a deep breath of fresh air and pouring a spoonful of sunlight onto your head to prepare for photosynthesis. As night falls over this warm bed and breakfast, you’ll discover the power of life gathering within your body, like the twinkling light of fireflies in a dream. The charm of Xiang Heng House will amaze you.

stays.name: Yuandian B&B
stays.description: -Yuandian Homestay – LuodongYuandian Homestay is conveniently located in Luodong, just minutes from Luodong Night Market and the beautiful Luozhuang Sakura Trail. The property features a fully equipped kitchen and an electric mahjong table, making it a perfect choice for families and friends seeking a relaxing getaway.Situated beside the historic Shiliufen Canal, the homestay enjoys a unique and scenic setting. The Shiliufen waterway offers both cycling paths and pedestrian walkways, connecting to the Dongshan River and extending all the way toward the river mouth. Surrounded by lush riverside greenery, vegetable gardens, and rice fields, the canal’s crystal-clear waters are home to tilapia and a variety of freshwater fish. Along the way, you may often see locals fishing from the banks or casting nets from the bridges.In the early mornings and evenings, grandparents stroll along the canal paths with their grandchildren, creating a peaceful and heartwarming atmosphere.Yuandian Homestay offers a tranquil and comfortable stay—your ideal choice for a relaxing visit to Luodong.We warmly welcome you.

Quanwo is a 5 minute walk from the 60-hectare Luodong Sports Park, and the area behind the courtyard includes a fountain park where you can play in the water and cool off in the summer, a 10 minute bike ride from Luodong Night Market. We are truly a quiet and peaceful sanctuary within the busy city. Our environment is elegant, peaceful, and quiet, with the owner living in a separate building so as not to disturb guests. We warmly welcome you to Yueyaquan Bed and Breakfast!
