stays.name: Cat Sky Country B&B
stays.description: Yilan｜Cat Sky HouseFollow the cat to a playful old house in the countrysideA comfortable autumn breeze blows through Yilan, as the Annong River reflects the dazzling sunlight. Strolling along a country lane between farmers’ fields as chickens cluck and dogs bark, you somehow feel like closing your eyes when suddenly your gaze is caught by a building colored red and orange: Cat Sky House, the brightest traditional courtyard home on the bank of the Annong River, sits waiting between rice paddies for travelers to visit.Rich and delightful countryside courtyard homeWalking into the courtyard at Cat Sky House, everything is brightly colored, with cute, playfully arranged scenes all around. The courtyard preserves the traditional cement ground covering, as grass grows in cracks that opened up in the cement many years before. Several cats, stretching out beneath a red sun parasol, continue rolling around. Your host Lisa walks toward you with a smile. After retirement, she and her husband, Paul bought this house, originally in ruins, for the street cats that they had adopted. They have since remodeled it into a cute courtyard house full of cats. The moment you enter the house, you are greeted by a warm aroma - you discover that it’s the smell of the home-baked welcome cookies being prepared by Miss Tian, the housekeeper. In the kitchen, the same warm color theme you have seen elsewhere at Cat Sky House continues, and the old wood-burning hearth remains as well. Watching Miss Tian’s busy movements, you feel a sense of returning to your family home in the countryside.And why have they chosen Yilan as the place to pursue life after retirement? Originally living in Taipei, Lisa says with a laugh, “We do it all for these little animals!” Following the growth and independence of her children, Lisa gradually started to adopt cats. First one, then another, then a third… the more cat adoption information she saw, the more she took in, and before she knew it she had seven or eight cats living in her home! A while later, after going on a trip with several friends, they suddenly became inspired to buy a house in Yilan where they could retire to one day, to live together and take care of one another. This was the birth of Cat Sky House. As Lisa says with a laugh, “You have to have your own life!” Retirement is not the finale, it is the start of a new life.Peaceful, easy times in the countryCat Sky House only entertains a single group of guests at any given time, so you can relax completely and enjoy the company of your friends in your own exclusive building. This country-style home filled with miscellaneous goods will set you completely at ease. Stepping into the bedroom, you take in the colorful decor on the roof beams, as well as the cute figurines lying on the bed and in front of the windows. The pristine white sheets are soft and welcoming, inviting you to fall asleep to the singing sounds of insects.Walking outdoors, Paul excitedly shows you the sweet potato leaves he just picked in order to give traveling guests the most natural, flavorful breakfast possible the following morning. At this time, however, a sumptuous afternoon tea has been prepared to welcome you, and it is up to you whether you enjoy it outdoors or inside. Sitting in a corner of the courtyard, admiring the expansive country fields and the soothing breeze, you enjoy passionfruit jam on handmade cookies with hibiscus wax gourd tea. Chickens cluck as they walk around the courtyard in a scene that seems right out of a peaceful, pastoral painting.A sumptuous countryside breakfastYou wake at the break of dawn to the sound of clucking chickens, barking dogs and the aromatic breakfast that awaits you. Walking to the breakfast table, you’ll certainly be shocked at first sight of the table full of sumptuous foods. You may even think you’ve overslept and your hosts have skipped right to preparing lunch! Besides Paul’s own sweet potato leaves and corn, there is a host of other seasonal vegetables. Delicious egg flatbreads sprinkled with cilantro delight the taste buds. Lisa proudly states, “Our egg flatbreads are made with indica rice milk, making them softer, and they’re really hard to come by!” At that moment, the housekeeper delivers a freshly baked pizza to the table! The melted cheese invites you to eat just one more slice. After you are full, Lisa will provide you with all the info you need about local sights to see.Cat Sky House maintains the old-school retro lifestyle and pastoral tranquility of an old courtyard home in the countryside. In such a place, time simply slows down. With Lisa’s humor and Paul’s warmth, you’ll certainly see how genuine the interaction between people can be. When you arrive at Cat Sky House, you’ll see just how fun the countryside can be. In this old courtyard home, you can even follow the cats’ lead, to gaze upon a new slice of sky.

stays.name: Dayinstars B&B
stays.description: When we decided to get married, we began to search for an ideal home. We accidentally discovered the Dayin Community, a quiet and serene place far away from the busy city. The endless blue sky, bright shining stars at night, and farm fields and lush green mountain at the touch of our finger tips were all enticing elements for a girl like me, who was raised in a crowded noisy city. Unwaveringly, we decided to start the next stage of our life right here. Another simple reason we started Day In Stars B&B is the financial burden of maintaining a home. This simple reason alone enabled us to plan and decorate each guestroom the way we have always dreamed of: The relaxing Rosemary Room, the Sakura Room that evokes beautiful memories, and the Gemini Meteor and Polar Sky rooms that make star gazing in the room possible. Everything at Day In Stars B&B is so simple and natural. We welcome you to our home to experience this wonderful living!

stays.name: Dream Forest - kids friendly BnB
stays.description: Dream Forest - kids friendly BnBIt's located in Yilan Sanxing, surrounded by paddy fields. In our yard, there are slides, swings, kids' motorcars , and a swimming pool for all the children to enjoy outdoor fun time.On the first floor, there's a large play set and a tree house - it's a kid's secret base with a lot of children's books. Everyone can relax and enjoy reading there. On the second floor - the guest rooms area. Along the hallway, there's a huge glass window. You will see an incredible view created by the mother nature. All the rooms are kids friendly. Not only the arrangements but also the service it's all about the family amenities. Dream Forest BnB only host the family with children. And for the best sleeping quality to all the family members, there are no play sets or toys in the guest rooms. The boss lady even tells the night time story to share with the parents and kids. (reservation in advance) We wish everyone bring home with the happiest memories. Dream Forest - kids friendly BnB. It's the best choice for you when you come visit Yilan, Taiwan.

stays.name: Flower Wall Homestay
stays.description: Featuring a quiet, spacious rest area and expansive, refreshing scenic views, Flower Mast Vacation Villa is located in Sanxing Township, a place where travelers may enjoy a comfortable vacation as well as experiencing Yilan’s unique countryside. Escape from the city crowds and come to Flower Mast, where a temporary vacation in the undisturbed countryside will allow you to forget your cares and worries and block out all the noise and commotion. The friendly owner has carefully organized everything and will accompany you during what is sure to be an unforgettable vacation. Amidst the shade of dense trees and luxuriant green grass, take advantage of the clear sky to leisurely pass the afternoon. The owner can help you organize a tea party at the outdoor pavilion. As midnight approaches, the spacious living room and tea brewing area are great places for you to chat with family. At Flower Mast Vacation Villa, we lead a simple life, feature refined decoration, and offer service and quality rivaling that of hotels, providing guests leisure and recreation during their stay.

I finally found Yilan, and Hospitality Samsung is located in the endless rice fields between mountains and ocean, where the distance between buildings and the height restrictions offer an broad sight of vision; the environment is beautiful and tranquil with the company of Singjian River and Annong River. stays.name: Ink Art Guest House
stays.description: Feel the slow-living moments in the fragrance of books and the charm of ink.Nestled in the tranquil countryside, "Ink Aart Guesthouse" was founded by Mr. Hung-Yi Wu, a passionate calligraphy artist. Not only is he skilled in brushwork, but he also infuses his love for calligraphy into the overall spatial design andhospitality philosophy. The name Ink Art — meaning "Ink and Art" — captures the essence of ink fragrance and artistic spirit, symbolizing that this is more than just a place to stay — it& #39;s a peaceful corner where the soul can rest and appreciate Eastern aesthetics.In addition to its cozy rooms and serene, elegant atmosphere,Ink Art Guesthouse also occasionally hosts calligraphy workshops, inviting guests to pick up the brush and experience the power and beauty of ink. Whether you& #39;re new to calligraphy or a traveler seeking creative inspiration,this is a window into traditional culture waiting for you to discover.

stays.name: JHENG TONG HOUSE
stays.description: If you want to enjoy a leisurely rural life in Yilan, you are welcome to come to Zhengtong Farm. Zhengtong Farm is located in Sanxing Township, Yilan. Sanxing Township is famous for its pollution-free environment and produces onions and garlic. In addition, it is very convenient to reach various tourist attractions from Sanxing Township. In summer, you can go to Dongshan River to play in the water and stroll along the riverside. In winter, you can go to Taiping Mountain to enjoy the snow and maple leaves. Zhengtong Farm is not only far away from the hustle and bustle of the city, but also provides tourists with a best place to rest. The single-family house and the outdoor coffee tables and chairs make people fall in love with this place at first sight. This is Zhengtong Farm. Zhengtong Farm not only has comfortable and elegant guest rooms for tourists to rest, but also bright public spaces and complete equipment, making tourists feel as convenient as at home. In addition, rural life in the fields is a good place to relax. You can wake up in the morning to the pleasant sound of birds and see beautiful clouds in the evening. It is a very comfortable resting life.

stays.name: Mandys House B&B
stays.description: Listen to the sounds of nature, experience the tranquility and simplicity of the natural scenery, welcome the dazzling rays of the sunrise, and embrace the atmosphere of the earth and sky. House of Love, Mandy’s House is located in Sanxing Township, Yilan County, rising above a luxuriant green rice field. The sky is full of stars at night, and the wide blue sky forms the backdrop day and night. Now and then white clouds drift by, adorning the surrounding green mountains, enriching the natural scenery of this place by day and night. Room design is warm and elegant, with styles including Leisurely Mediterranean, Star Gazing Fir Double-Layer, and Fantasy Kitty, each providing a high-quality accommodation experience. Open each window and let in the playful wind, circulating, blowing through every corner, and bringing in the fragrance of flowers, grass, and the rice field. Aren’t these nature’s most precious phytoncides? The owner of House of Love, Mandy’s House loves this land and town, and introduces and shares the local scenery with every guest who comes to visit. Look up at the flock of birds, flying freely through the sky, the school of fish, swimming leisurely through the stream, and the farmer, busy in the fields, and a warm and contented sweetness glows within the depths of your heart.

stays.description: 5 years ago, we unexpectedly came to this little-known place called Sanxing Township, deliberately crossing the street and turning into an area with luxuriant green fields of rice. Ming Shui Lu, hidden among the countryside roads, has no extravagant exterior, opting for wonderful natural scenery, fresh air, and a great environment instead. I love the feeling of simplicity, because it’s the only true way to relax, and it’s only a vacation if you really feel relaxed. We’d like to share the simple joy of this place with you. Sanxing Township – I think it’s a countryside within a countryside. Free of industrial pollution or commercial bustle, the special agricultural area authentically preserves the purity of this place. Take a deep breath and relax your body as the green rice fields stretch out as far as the eye can see, your mood swaying along with the rhythm. Would you like to stay here with them?? Then welcome to Ming Shui Lu!

stays.name: fuluart b&b
stays.description: The couple who own Fulu Art Bed and Breakfast work in architecture and art, and constructed Fulu as a building composed of lines and color blocks, a “home” with a unique artistic style. We feature the first row of most beautiful scenery along Annong Stream as well as a view of several dozen kilometers of the Xueshan and Central Mountain Ranges, the beauty of Guishan Island, and sunrise over the east coast. The highly artistic main hall contains the wife’s ink paintings and the husband’s ceramic reliefs, making guests feel like they’re in an art museum, absorbing its atmosphere. The grounds cover nearly 3,300 square meters and include a 600 square meter building with only 5 well-planned guest rooms. 36 – 69 square meters of relaxation area closest to nature is thoughtfully furnished with special wood furniture and artwork. Bathrooms come with large glass windows so you and your loved ones can look out at an evening sky full of stars.

stays.name: puju home stay
stays.description: We built Puju on ancestral land at the foot of Taiping Shan in our lovely township of Sanxing, and originally lived in the building ourselves before deciding to entering the bed and breakfast business. Bestowed with the cypresses of Taiping Shan, Yilan is a place of beautiful natural scenery and plentiful rain, creating fertile fields and a beneficial environment for the agriculture and livestock industry, as well as a great place to live and travel. When you come to Puju, slow down and appreciate the winding mountain range and white clouds spread across the sky above the mountain, wander the countryside paths, pursue the light of sunrise or sunset, and let the babbling water and sound of birds and insects accompany you. We provide a spacious, bright, comfortable living space and share a beautiful moment of happiness with guests. Welcome to Puju.

stays.description: Located in Sanshing, Yilan County, Tshang-á, our Minshuku, is inspired by the Taiwanese (Southern-Min) pronunciation of Sanshing’s famous produce: Sanshing Green Onion. The building of the Minshuku is in pure white with greenery as decoration, which is taken from Green Onion’s two colors. Tshang-á offers comfortable accommodations, considerate service, and modern amenities. Enjoy the peaceful countryside at Tshang-á and distance yourself far away from the hustle and bustle of the city: we hope the green fields and the starry sky will help you relax and have a pleasant stay.

stays.name: Koh Tsit Kang Hotel
stays.description: Once, there was a beloved local landmark—the Nanfang’ao Theatre. It was more than just a movie house; it served as a venue for Taiwanese opera performances, gatherings, teaching and knowledge exchange. When the curtains fell for the last time, the theater was reduced to rubble. In its place rose a hotel—an aged building that has stood for over 50 years, undergoing transformations under different names and styles. Today, a new story begins within its walls—Koh Tsit Kang.At Koh Tsit Kang, you’ll become neighbors with the locals, sharing in the ebb and flow of daily life under the shifting sunlight of the open-air courtyard. We epitomize the essence of Nanfang’ao without embellishment—just as it is—so that visitors can linger, immerse themselves in its culture, and sync with its rhythm. Yet, more than anything, we hope that this place serves as a harbor for you—where you can experience one day in Nanfang’ao, and another day in rhythm with the sea.

stays.name: SU AO HOTEL
stays.description: Meet Suao and enjoy the beautiful sceneryThe newly renovated Su'ao Hotel is adjacent to the Su'ao International Business Port, surrounded by mountains and the sea, with pleasant scenery. Whenever the sea in the port is calm, the reflections of ships in the sea look like an illusion of buildings rising from the sky, so it is named "Su'ao Mirage" and has become one of the "Eight Scenic Spots of Lanyang". The hotel's unique landscape allows travelers to watch the sunrise, enjoy the night view, soak in cold springs, and eat seafood. Whether you are on a business trip or visiting the scenic spots here, it is your first choice for accommodation! The hotel's meticulous layout design and sophisticated hardware facilities provide an elegant and comfortable accommodation environment, as well as a warm and friendly service attitude, allowing you to enjoy a relaxed and comfortable stay even when you are away from home!

stays.name: Chevland B&B
stays.description: "Chevland B&B" is located beside the intersection of the National Highway No. 5, Taipei-Yilan Highway, and Coastal Highway. It is the first B&B you encounter on the way to Jiaoxio, where has a transportation network in all directions, and it is also a hub to connect to the Dong Shan River, Wu-lao Mountain Stream, Lanyang Museum, and Wushih Harbor. Visitors coming from the Hsuehshan Tunnel, take exit ramp to Jiaoxi, Toucheng, then you can reach Chevland." Hsuehshan Tunnel, "Fo Guang University," and "Lanyang Plain," staying at "home" you can see all of them; therefore their initials consist of the name "Chevland B&B." Standing in front of the house, look far into the distance at our spiritual fortress Guishan Island, which has the initial "gui" as if to tell visitors to have a happy journey, and a peaceful "return." The building itself is an newly built RC structure, new interior equipment, and each room has an individual theme, welcome to visit. Living in Finland or in the Netherlands, it is better to live Yilan, because Yilan has "powerful" fun.

stays.name: Hai Tan Feng Qing Homestay
stays.description: Go barefoot in the soft beach sand as wave after wave beat against the shore. Listen to the sound of their crashing as you settle into a comfortable, leisurely, deep blue mood, feeling extra romantic. The dazzling morning light gradually rises from the distant ocean horizon, and the refreshing ocean breeze blows freely. Experience the purest and most natural beach landscape here at Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast on the Northeast Coast. Located next to coastal highways in Toucheng Township (Yilan), we’re a legally-certified bed and breakfast housed in a thoughtfully designed stand-alone building, offering nearly 330 square meters of spacious area, a pure white color theme combined with furniture in different shades of brown, with rattan chairs arranged throughout, displaying a rich Bali style. Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast provides several comfortable suite rooms with a South Pacific atmosphere and provides high-quality facilities to provide guests with a 5-star vacation experience. Some of the rooms come with balconies, where you can look out over the azure sea or appreciate the graceful beauty of the sunrise or sunset. For any questions regarding your trip or plans, please call Beach Landscape Bed and Breakfast at 0910-166575.03-9773674

stays.name: Mountain Sea Surf Homestay
stays.description: Welcome to "Mountain and Sea Surfing B&B," located in the scenic Wai& #39;ao area of ​​Northeast Coast. Nestled between mountains and the sea, this comfortable and pleasant environment is the perfect choice for a relaxing vacation. Just minutes& #39; walk from the beach, you can enjoy surfing, beach walks, and parasailing during the day, and admire the mesmerizing sunset at dusk.The B&B is fully equipped with a karaoke room and an electric mahjong table for endless fun with friends and family. An outdoor barbecue area allows you to enjoy delicious grilled meats in the sea breeze and relax. At night, the sounds of insects and the waves will help you completely unwind.Nearby attractions abound. Guests can leisurely sip coffee and soak in the artistic atmosphere at King Car Brown Cafe; savor fresh seafood at Daxi Fishing Port; or take a boat trip from Wushi Harbor to explore the mysterious Turtle Island. Hiking enthusiasts shouldn& #39;t miss the Wushan Ancient Trail, Gengfang Trail, Pingxi Ancient Trail, and Shikong Trail in the back mountains, all offering stunning scenery with different charms in each season.Whether you& #39;re looking to relax, connect with nature, or spend quality time with family and friends, "Mountain and Sea Surfing B&B" can meet your expectations. We sincerely invite you to experience the beauty of mountains and sea.

stays.name: Ocean Deep
stays.description: Ocean Deep Bed and Breakfast is an authentic legally-certified establishment personally operated by the former deputy head of Yilan (as well as head of Toucheng Township) and his wife. It was designated as a Hospitable Bed and Breakfast by the Tourism Bureau, part of the Smile Taiwan Alliance of Bed and Breakfasts by Commonwealth Magazine, and Environmental Bed and Breakfast of the EPA’s Green Promotion Program. Located on the bay of the Northeast Coast National Scenic Area, it features a vast layout with a marine atmosphere and an extremely warm and accommodating living environment, with down-to-Earth countryside friendliness and a feeling of home. We offer free cooking service for fresh seafood from Daxi Fishing Harbor, which includes 10 highly nutritious breakfasts such as sweet potato porridge, bula fish, sakura shrimp, and sugarcane-smoked duck, making guests feel at home and creating unforgettable memories. Yilan – a spiritual home for travelers; Ocean Deep Bed and Breakfast – a place that feels most like home during the journey. Unique attractions and activities within a 5-20 minute drive include the mountains, ocean, seeing the ocean scenery, feeling the ocean breeze, trying out seafood, dawn at Guishan Island (Yilan’s top natural site), the vast Pacific Ocean, mysterious Guishan Island, the sight of fishing boats dotting the ocean, fresh fish from Daxi Fishing Harbor, Honeymoon Bay, Gang’ao Beach surfing, Guishan Island and whale-watching, Beiguan Tidal Park, Dali Marine Erosion Platform, Caoling Historic Trail and Restharrow Flower Season, Taoyuan Valley, exploration of Yingshijian, bike riding at the Old Caoling Tunnel, Wai’ao paragliding, Lanyang Museum, Lion’s Kingdom Museum, Crab Museum, Wine Village, Wushigang sailboating, Toucheng Old Street and Qiang Gu (pole climbing festival), Mr. Brown Coffee Castle, Fulong Sand Sculptures, and the Beach Music Festival. A trip to Lanyang is guaranteed to be exciting.

stays.name: Sealuv Home-stay
stays.description: Yilan｜Sealuv HomestayThe Delightful Taste of The Deep Blue SeaComing out the other side of the Hsuehshan Tunnel, the world seems to become brighter the further you move away from Taipei city! On your way to the Wushi Marina, you roll down the window and look out to your right at the ocean. Amid the row of ocean-view guesthouses along Waiao Beach, you see a sign which reads “Enjoy Blue Paradise” on a wave-shaped white wall. Here in Toucheng Township of Yilan County, you’re always very close to the ocean!Make a beeline for the beach with the seawater and the sunshineEntering Sealuv Homestay from the back door, to one side, you notice a professional kitchen the likes of which is rarely seen in ordinary guesthouses. Not only is there a central food counter, they have a hotel restaurant grade oven and stainless steel freezer room. The spacious dining hall is painted white and blue in Greek style, and, overlooking Waiao Beach through the front doors, is filled with the sound of the waves breaking on the sand. Removing your shoes and walking upstairs, the guest rooms all bear the names of oceanside cities. The Greek Mykonos and Aegina rooms both employ a loft design, with comfortable sofas indoors and lounge chairs on the balcony for you to recline upon. The French Marseille and Balinese Kuta rooms employ a European South seas style decor to provide visitors with a peaceful vacation time.In contrast to this, the other Sealuv edifice employs a medieval Greek style. The Sun God Apollo room on the first floor has a wading pool from which you can admire the ocean. Indoors, you can enjoy the comfort of the steam room. Similar in layout, the Moon Goddess Diana room has a home theatre system in the living room, as well as a television in the bedroom. Entering the Goddess of Beauty Venus room from the back door, you can enjoy the expansive seaview from the balcony, and delight in watching the sunrise from the comfort of your bed. Yet the most breathtaking scene must surely be on the 65-inch liquid crystal display with full surround sound audio system furnishing the God of the Sea Poseidon room. From the balcony, take the staircase upwards and discover your own private outdoor pool.Every delicious mouthful is fresh from the seaAs every gourmand who travels to Sealuv Homestay surely knows, after night falls, you are in for a flavorful feast! Your host Brother Cong introduces each local ingredient and freshly caught seafood delicacy in detail. Flying fish caviar, whitebait, and seaweed prepared cold with special dressing taste sweet and refreshing. Then comes a plate of carefully selected sashimi from the local fish market, meticulously prepared sweet shrimp, neritic squid and the rare mackerel bonito served with special sauce gives the sensation that the ocean waves are dancing on your tongue. Gently steamed bowls of chawan mushi (savoury egg custard) with fresh prawns, clams, and broccoli harmonize perfectly with the delicious flavor of katsuobushi (dried skipjack tuna flakes). The main course is perfectly broiled red blowfish with a sprinkle of salt and pepper or shichimi spicing. Each bite of fish is bursting with zesty sweetness. Served with a bowl of stewed pork over rice and homemade daikon pickle, washed down with a bowl of warm ginger fish broth, and followed by a dessert consisting of coconut cream purple rice congee and a glass of white wine.Not only do you get to enjoy an evening banquet, you can savor a European style breakfast in the morning sunshine. A delicious breakfast embraced by the sea breeze provides the perfect start to a beautiful day. Your cordial host, Brother Cong, happily suggests a travel itinerary for you: the Lanyang Museum, followed by Toucheng old street and the paragliding base. And don’t forget the privately owned local restaurants.Enjoy a beautiful place to liveWhen Brother Cong was young, he left Yilan and moved to Sanchong in New Taipei City. stays.description: 7 of the world 10 Most Expensive Homes were built on the beach in places such as Hawaii and Miami Beach. Although Sealuv Homestay is not a mansion, it features Wai’ao Beach on the Pacific Ocean, with activities including playing in the waves, surfing, or paragliding, in addition to the Guishan sunrise, Yilan’s most beautiful scenic sight. Everyone should experience Greek romance at least once in their lives, and Sealuv’s blue and white atmosphere will give you a taste of Mediterranean romance and leisure without leaving Taiwan. The seafood from Guishan Island provides an excellent and satisfying addition to your trip. Forget about price and experience value; time should be wasted on things of beauty. The owner, a Virgo, and his wife, a Taurus, anticipate your arrival! Your perfect vacation begins here!

stays.name: TOU CHENG HOTEL
stays.description: Dreaming of life on the Farm? Many people may fantasize about living in the country, but only a very few ever get around to living the pastoral life a reality.Chuo Chen Ming had her epiphany 30 years ago on the eve of her 40th birthday. “If I don’t begin working on my dreams while my mind and body are at their peak,” she thought, “when am I going to do it?” Soon after, she was crossing hill and dale with a real estate agent haunting for the perfect place. When she found it at the mountains of Kengfeng village at Toucheng Township, Yilan County, she spent all of the more than NT$5 million she had earned from her garment factory and teaching, to buy it. Thus begun what was to become the legendary story of the farming Grandma. “Look, children!” exclaims Chuo Chen Ming, “That’s our national bird, the Formosa blue magpie. They’re very family-oriented birds. After the chicks grow up, they help their parents raise their younger siblings”. She then leans forward to make sure she doesn’t miss any of the questions coming from the large group of children before her.Her eyes and ears are surprisingly sharp in spite of her 68 years- there’s no movement in the forest that escape her notice. Visitors to the Toucheng Leisure Farm in Yilan County, all remember the grandmotherly old woman who pops up in the Farm. Always bursting with energy, she is happy to share her opinions with visitors, including her insistence that the farm grow its food organically, and prepare it in a traditional fashion. Her personality is so warm and frank that visitors almost always end up addressing as “Mama Chuo” regardless of their own age. Chuo Chen Ming was born in Chingshui Township, Taichung County, Taiwan in 1940. After graduating from The Taipei Women’s Normal College, (now the Taipei Municipal University of Education), she began working as a teacher primarily of sixth graders.

stays.description: Wushi Inn – A Serene Retreat Near Wushi Harbor and Lanyang MuseumNestled in Toucheng, Yilan County, Wushi Inn is the closest and coziest accommodation near Wushi Harbor and Lanyang Museum. With breathtaking scenery all year round, this charming retreat offers travelers a unique opportunity to immerse themselves in nature.From March to November, visitors can apply for a Guishan Island tour. Due to limited daily slots, we recommend booking at least two months in advance to secure your spot and experience the island’s mesmerizing beauty up close.Recommended Winter Activities:✔ Jiaoxi Hot Springs – Soak in the soothing warm waters and enjoy a truly rejuvenating winter escape.✔ Wushi Harbor Seafood – Savor the rich flavors of fresh bonito sashimi and succulent winter crab, indulging in the essence of the sea.To avoid traffic congestion, consider staying overnight in Toucheng. Take your time to appreciate the peaceful charm of this coastal town before heading home via National Highway No. 5 for a more relaxed journey.Book your stay now and experience the pure beauty of Yilan!

stays.name: Beautiful village
stays.description: MEI-CUN HOMESTAY is a rare "Holiday Farm" type homestay in Taiwan that is rich in ecological elements! Located in the northeast corner of Taiwan - Yilan County, which is known as the Back Garden of Taipei. We’re about a 10-minute drive from the Luodong Interchange after driving out of the Hsuehshan Tunnel on the National Freeway 5, and is close to Dongshan River Water Park and National Center for Traditional Arts, so the transportation is quite convenient! All our rooms overlook the scenic view of the treasure of Yilan County - Gueishan Island (Turtle Island) which sits in the Northeast of the Pacific Ocean. A stroll along the Bald Cypress Trees-lined trail will be an unforgettable experience. The flowing water along the small bridges, the sound of frogs and birds, coupled with the fragrance of flowers will truly be memorable. Our 9 stepped natural ecological pool is a well-known parent-child outdoor education venue! Enjoy lotus viewing, water playing, barbecuing, singing... Coffee or tea tasting, reading, writing, playing the piano... Your FIRST CHOICE Country Retreat! A Great Holiday Resort in Yilan! Come and stay with us at BEAUTIFUL VILLAGE HOMESTAY!

stays.name: DOT
stays.description: Walking along the stone-paved pathway brings us into the tranquil, graceful alley of Wujie Township, where Dot Bed and Breakfast is located. We’re a recreational bed and breakfast full of a warm atmosphere, with a comfortable environment created by the owner herself. The elegant front hall is where guests can enjoy a soft breeze while sipping a rich cup of coffee, the simple, bright living room is a good place to chat with friends, and the warm, elegant rooms provide the opportunity to rest from your fatigue and get a good night of sleep. After awaking from pleasant dreams, look outside the window and be welcomed by the refreshing morning and sound of chirping birds. The air is filled with the faint fragrance of plants and flowers, making this a great time to explore the countryside by bicycle, leisurely winding along the little paths through the fields. The beauty of Yilan’s countryside is everywhere you look, letting you experience the beauty of nature, while the nearby Dongshan River is a rest stop you won’t want to miss. Dot Bed and Breakfast - a bed and breakfast worth the trip, a bed and breakfast where you can fully rest and relax.

stays.searchText: DOT 逗點休閒民宿 宜蘭縣民宿178號 Yilan County Wujie Township No.6, Aly. 1, Ln. 103, Sec. 2, Qinhe Rd., Wujie Township, Yilan County 268, Taiwan (R.O.C.) Walking along the stone-paved pathway brings us into the tranquil, graceful alley of Wujie Township, where Dot Bed and Breakfast is located. We’re a recreational bed and breakfast full of a warm atmosphere, with a comfortable environment created by the owner herself. The elegant front hall is where guests can enjoy a soft breeze while sipping a rich cup of coffee, the simple, bright living room is a good place to chat with friends, and the warm, elegant rooms provide the opportunity to rest from your fatigue and get a good night of sleep. After awaking from pleasant dreams, look outside the window and be welcomed by the refreshing morning and sound of chirping birds. The air is filled with the faint fragrance of plants and flowers, making this a great time to explore the countryside by bicycle, leisurely winding along the little paths through the fields. The beauty of Yilan’s countryside is everywhere you look, letting you experience the beauty of nature, while the nearby Dongshan River is a rest stop you won’t want to miss. Dot Bed and Breakfast - a bed and breakfast worth the trip, a bed and breakfast where you can fully rest and relax.

Eat, drink and have fun at Dongshan River Farm.

stays.name: Dongshan River left bank B&B
stays.description: Hello,Yilan is the back garden of Taipei, Dongshan River Water Park is our back garden, the legal number of B&B on the left bank of Dongshan River is 149200 meters away from the main entrance of Children's Play Festival Dongshan River Water ParkChildren's Play 1+1=2. Accommodation will get 1 per room + accommodation receipt voucher. 2,000 yuan can be exchanged for 1 person to enter the park free of charge. A total of 2 people can enter the park for free regardless of weekends~illustrate1. The redemption coupons can be used regardless of weekends or full and half tickets.2. The redemption voucher is not limited to the date of stay or check-out, and can be used as long as the children play.◆If you stay on Saturday, you will get 1 holiday ticket per room, and if you stay on weekdays for the other 6 days, you will get 1 weekday ticket. If you need to enter on Saturdays and Sundays, you can enter with the weekday ticket + 100 yuan.◆An additional accommodation receipt of NT$2,000 can be redeemed at the activity park for free admission for one person. It can be used regardless of weekends.♡Dongshan River Left Bank B&B (Legal B&B No. 149)Free variable-speed bicycles are provided to tour the beautiful Dongshan River Bicycle Trail. There are also parent-child bicycles, children's bicycles, cooperative bicycles and four-wheel convertibles available for purchase. If you want to ride easily, there are various electric bicycles to choose from http://www.leftbankbnb.com .tw/ds.html♡ Go straight for four kilometers from the provincial road at the entrance to Luodong Night Market. It takes 7 to 10 minutes to drive. We are only 200 meters away from the main entrance of Dongshan River Water Park (the venue of the Summer Children's Play Festival), and it is only 7 minutes to drive to the National Center for Traditional Arts. It only takes 15 minutes by boat.♧Dongshan River Left Bank B&Bhttps://www.leftbankbnb.com.tw/room.htmlThere are welcome fruits for accommodation, and for general accommodation, there is also a delicious brunch with a credit of 100 yuan per person (available from 7:30 to 13:00, so you can enjoy brunch at your leisure. http://www.leftbankbnb. com .tw/food.htmlIt takes about 10 minutes by bicycle on Dongshan Brown Avenue (the golden rice fields are the most beautiful when the first rice crop is close to May to mid-to-late June)There are the most number of fringe flowers in the country nearby~The flower season is around the Dragon Boat Festival, it’s so beautiful.♡The latest and most popular fun experience centers nearby:◆King Agent 007, 200 meters away from the B&B, is a rare spy-themed venue. You can experience the mystery of Morse code. You can also do sniper shooting and even fighting. It is a game suitable for both adults and children.https://jason123455.pixnet.net/blog/post/230347549Business hours: 09:00~17:00 (closed on Wednesdays)Address: No. 57, Section 2, Qinhe Road, Wujie Township, (03)960-5070◆The nearby Yaliu Story House and Golden River Rice Canoe are suitable for arranging activities all year round.Relaxation half-day tour:Golden River Rice Canoe+Bicycle+Aliao Story House■Individual bookings or private rooms for more than one building are welcome (each building has 2 four-person suites and 2 double suites). Basically, 12 people can be added. Small rooms can also be booked for less than 12 people. The first Saturday of July every year The Children's Play Festival, which lasts for 44 days, is located at the Dongshan River Water Park next to the B&B. Admission to the park is free on weekdays.If you need barbecue ingredients, you can order ingredients from a professional barbecue company and provide electric grill pans (can be used indoors). Mahjong, tables and chairs, and piano leisure facilities are provided free of charge.♤The B&B is 800 meters away from Luodong. It is not far away from the dust and has convenient transportation. The lane entrance is the provincial highway and it takes 6 minutes to reach the Luodong Interchange. It is very convenient.◇Bus informationTaipei National Highway Passenger Transport: Capital, Kuoguang, Kavalan, and Metropolitan Passenger Transport go directly to Luodong Transfer Station and then transfer1. Guoguang Passenger Transport Line 1797 runs from Luodong to Yueming, passing through B&B Alley and getting off at Olive Society Station - the first stop in front of Dongshan River Water Park. However, you cannot take it due to Shujing Qingshui (the journey takes about 13 minutes).2. Taiwan's Dongshan River Line runs from Luodong to the Traditional Art Center, passing through the Dongshan River Water Park Station to the B&B, which is 200 meters away.3. Capital Line 241 from Luodong to Suao New Station, pass through Minsu Alley and get off at Olive Society Station - the first stop in front of Dongshan River Water Park (about 13 minutes' drive).4. For those who don’t drive or ride bicycles, there is a free round trip from Luodong Station (or Luodong Night Market) to the B&B. The one-way journey is 4 kilometers and the journey takes about 7 to 10 minutes.CITS Card* Special Store Taiwan PAY LINE PAYPets are welcome to enter the room but please do not go to bed. Each pet will be charged a cleaning fee of 200 yuan.◆Surrounding attractions1Lize Pacific Beach (12 minutes away by bicycle)2Yilan Yaliao Story House: The ducks inside are simply standard ducks.https://bunnyann.com/duckgo/3 Wujia Wetland is a primitive wetland natural landscape where you can enjoy bird watching. In the summer, there is Dongshan Brown Avenue, and there are summer fireworks before and after the Dragon Boat Festival. You can enjoy the flowers at Suihua Checkerboard Foot.4 Famous attractions in Lize Old Street-Leisheng Hospital (film crews often come here to shoot scenes)5Dongshan River Water Park and beautiful bicycle trails (tickets are only required during the Children's Play Festival from July)6National Center for Traditional Arts7. Wuyuan Water and Fire Come from the Same Source and Slippery Big Bowl: Underground natural gas and springs are available all year round, creating a wonder where water and fire appear at the same time. You can soak your feet in the water. It is just under the National 5 Expressway, and you are not afraid of the sun and rain. It is covered with artificial turf and grindstones. It is a great place for adults and children to relive their childhood. It can be reached in 2 to 3 minutes by car or by bicycle.8 new venues: Agent Kim 007 is 200 meters away from the B&B, Khatifa Manor Taiwan’s largest skin care products tourist park, Tiger Brand Rice Noodles Tourist Factory, 6 to 7 minutes by car, Qiliwan Milk Culture Center, Yilan Cake Invention Museum, La Art Labi Castle, Yimi, RobertY Crazy Dream Art Park, and Qili Tourist Park are all within a 10 to 15-minute drive of the B&B.◆Turn left at the nearby food alley and you’ll find Lai Lai Steakhouse, a famous restaurant. 7-11 is about 600 meters away. There’s Marshall Fish Pot next to it. Go to the B&B alley and go to the right next to the Water Park. You can get a 10% discount on booking at the B&B. There are also Wu Tao Bento Shop, Jiale Steakhouse, Tangzheng Hotpot Restaurant, Longzhiyuan Restaurant, Gathering from All Directions, and Lao Liu Beef Noodles that are commonly eaten by locals (only open at noon, closed on Sundays), which is a 2-minute drive away.The accommodation provides free supplies: parking lot, toiletries (disposable towels, toothbrushes and other toiletries are provided for personal hygiene), washing machine and dehumidifier to dry clothes.Discount coupons: 50% off Tiger Brand Rice Noodles (Ticket of 200 yuan includes 1 of 3 DIY options, 100 yuan shopping coupon and all-you-can-eat fried rice noodles for free, 5% off on Yilan Pancakes, 20% off on Xihe Sandaimu DIY, 10% off on Awan’s House duck reward, 50% off at Tyrannosaurus Crazy Dream Art Park (ticket 200 yuan)***Accommodation Notes***Karaoke, barbecue and making noise are prohibited after 10pm every night to 8am the next dayAdan, a native of Yilan, has served in the sales department of EVA Air and the tourism marketing unit of the county government. He is skilled in planning travel itineraries and can help you plan it for free. There are also private attractions for you to further understand the beautiful scenery and food of Yilan. Yilan has beautiful mountains and seas, and is fun and fun. Welcome to Yilan for vacation♡Dongshan River Left Bank B&B Mr. Lin Tel 0923507500/03 9507500/Line ilandenny

stays.name: Jinzhuya Homestay
stays.description: Jinzhuya Homestay is located on the riverbank of Dongshan River, close to the Chuanyi Road and freeway intersections, a few hundred meters from the Interchanges, an 80 minutes' drive from Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport, and just 50 minutes' drive from Taipei 101 if you take the route through Asia's longest mountain tunnel, Hsuehshan Tunnel. We have quite convenient transportation to all directions. We offer separate gardens and parking lots, two double rooms, two four-person rooms and a Japanese four-person room, in addition to an elevator, accessible ramps, and other facilities to make the stay of elderly and families with children more convenient, as well as a saloon for visitors to chat with friends and family leisurely and enjoy our offer of tea and snacks. In the night, you may stroll to the famous Luodong Night Market, and after your return play XBOX with the whole family together, or exercise, enjoying the warmth of family time. After a good night's sleep, you can enjoy a Chinese breakfast with local food ingredients carefully prepared by the proprietress in the restaurant under the sunshine. After breakfast, you can ride a bicycle provided by the Jinzhuya Homestay to the nearby Dongshan River. Along the riverbank, you enjoy the scenery and river views of the Long Yang countryside, slowing down to experience the Lohas tour, away from the hubbub.

Along the riverbank, you enjoy the scenery and river views of the Long Yang countryside, slowing down to experience the Lohas tour, away from the hubbub.

stays.name: Riverside Cottage Homestay
stays.description: The mission of Riverbank Cottage is to provide a living space that feels as comfortable as home, whether it’s the interior decoration or attentive service. Go for a bike ride down countryside paths and greet the morning sun, and enjoy the gentle breeze in the shade by the riverbank during the afternoon. Let yourself go and enjoy a feast of treats at Luodong Night Market, and soak in the soft embrace of the Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Go whale-watching at Guishan Island, a secure yet exciting and adventurous place, or take a journey through time at the National Center for Traditional Arts. The red maples on Taiping Mountain are refreshing and alluring; experience the amazing Su’ao Cold Springs and let yourself free at Nanfang’ao Fishing Port. Discover the beauty of Taiwan through travel. Whether you’ve got a fixed destination or are planning your trip, Riverbank Cottage is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, making it your best choice of accommodation, regardless of what part of Yilan you’re interested in experiencing, whether it’s the mountains, ocean, river, or active or passive activities. Riverbank Cottage, on the bank of Dongshan River, is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, and we hope to fulfill all your accommodation needs.

You can have lots of fun singing and feasting.

stays.name: THE MOMENT HOTEL
stays.description: Gather happily at NCFTA and to explore the cultural traces in everyday life, to experience Taiwan’s traditional arts in depth.The Moment Hotel Yilan by Lakeshore based on the concept of “Spending a night in the ancient city” is located by the Yilan Park of NCFTA (National Center for Traditional Arts), allowing travelers to sleep well and play freely, to gather happily at NCFTA and to explore the cultural traces in everyday life, to experience Taiwan’s traditional arts in depth. The guest room buildings in the park were designed by Huang Sheng-Yuan Architects, where the lattice windows with terrazzo flooring, the hallway with the fish pond, the pavilion with wooden chairs sum up to provide a strong Taiwanese-style ancient city, such that one feels as if going back to Taiwan in the old days while strolling around freely during the accommodation period, thereby creating memories filled with strong cultural ambience for the travelers.

When the night is falling, lights in the distance gradually lit up enriching the scenery. You can enjoythe night view, count the stars or have a chat with your family and friends together to leave all your worries and pressure behind…

stays.name: Xiang Ri Kui Homestay
stays.description: The mission of Sunflower Bed and Breakfast is to provide a living space that feels as comfortable as home, whether it’s the interior decoration or attentive service. Go for a bike ride down countryside paths and greet the morning sun, or enjoy the gentle breeze in the shade by the riverbank during the afternoon. Let yourself go and enjoy the feast of treats at Luodong Night Market, and soak in the soft embrace of the Jiaoxi Hot Springs. Go whale-watching at Guishan Island, a secure yet exciting and adventurous place, or take a journey through time at the National Center for Traditional Arts. The red maples on Taiping Mountain are refreshing and alluring; experience the amazing Su’ao Cold Springs and let yourself free at Nanfang’ao Fishing Port. Discover the beauty of Taiwan through travel. Whether you’ve got a fixed destination or are planning your trip, Sunflower Bed and Breakfast is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, making it your best choice of accommodation, regardless of what part of Yilan you’re interested in experiencing, whether it’s the mountains, ocean, river, or active/passive activities. Sunflower Bed and Breakfast, on the bank of Dongshan River, is located in the busiest part of Lanyang, and we hope to fulfill all your accommodation needs.

stays.name: Xin yi B&B
stays.description: Xinyi Xinyi is a newly opened homestay in 2022/July. It is located in Wujie Township, Yilan County, near the Interchange of National Highway No. 5 (Luodong/Wujie), near Dongshan River Water Park, Chuanyi Center, Luodong Night Market, etc. The transportation location is convenient. Sex is high, and it is also a good place to be quiet in the midst of trouble. We present comfort and expectation of life in the most natural, simple and pure way. The living room is spacious to create a feeling of relaxation, and there are several large floor-to-ceiling windows and large window frames, allowing natural sunlight to flow in. Each window is a natural landscape painting, adding a touch of greenery to each space. Extending to the restaurant, it is a good space for dining. The simple and spacious environment hopes to bring you a comfortable, natural and relaxing space. It's a good place to be in a daze, to be empty, and to forget that time is flowing. You can have a cup of coffee and a cup of tea here, in the flowing space, laughing happily or roaming the field road for a day, it seems to inject energy, a kind of enjoyment of life, and live your vacation. This is where we want to give you comfort and relaxation. Come to Xinyi ~ feel it! In spring, the fields are green, but the green is different: dark green, oily green, tender green, neatly divided into small pieces. In summer, in the low fields, the rice is ripe, and the golden ones seem to be covered with a thick layer of gold. The autumn waves swayed the rice, causing the heavy ears of rice to fluctuate rhythmically, as if the golden mountain was on a landslide. The sound of wind and rice waves is like a moving piece of music. In autumn and winter, the fields are like mirrors, reflecting the sky and beautiful scenery. Seeing it is fate~

The popular Luodong night market is around 15 minutes’ drive from our place whereas the National Centre for Traditional Arts is within 5 minutes’ drive. There are convenient stores, supermarkets, traditional markets, local food stalls and restaurants nearby. The Lize Old Street is also within walking distance.

To escape the hubbub life of city, he returned to the hometown to build his dream in 2007 to realize the countryside life that he had been longing for. Bluish sky, gentle breeze, quiet country. Everything is so natural! “Lan-tian Homestay” cordially invites you to experience the beauty of countryside in I-Lan and provides free vegetable gardening land for you to enjoy a fun time on the farm fields.

stays.name: Aleex Villa
stays.description: Aleex Villa, which opened in May 2014, is located in the scenic Yuanshan Township. It has a luxurious and elegant palace appearance and European-style design. It was designed and built by the male owner who loves European architecture and decoration. It took 2 years from design to completion. The hostess's oil paintings can also be seen in the B&B rooms and restaurant area. Only by experiencing it carefully you can understand the uniqueness of Aleex Villa.The cozy, comfortable, and undisturbed atmosphere is adjacent to a bicycle path that is several kilometers long. Riding the free bicycles, you can easily go to various nearby attractions in Yuanshan Township, providing travelers with a new accommodation option to wander among the blue sky and greenery and perform "photosynthesis".Each room at Aleex Villa has large landscape windows, offering vast pastoral views and a distant view of Guishan Island (Turtle Island, allowing you to enjoy the ever-changing scenery at sunrise. Aleex Villa has a garden and terrace with tables and chairs for guests to enjoy the scenery. The public space on the first floor is equipped with tabletop games. The B&B also provides tourism consulting services and free private parking.Famous attractions nearby include:Kavalan Whisky Distillery 5 minutes driveBajia Fishery 5 minutes by carShengyang Aquatic Plant Museum 5 minutes driveLuodong Sports Park 8 minutes by car【Intimate Service】Public facilities: children's swimming pool, viewing terraceFree Yilan specialty productsFree bicycle rental serviceFree travel consultationFree private parking

stays.name: He Qun Cottage Homestay
stays.description: Hequn Nongzhuang Bed and Breakfast combines travel, recreation, culture, delicious food, and an experience of farm life. When trying to find outstanding bed and breakfasts, it’s tough to make a choice! An Internet search yields numerous destinations, many of which may not be reliable, so we recommend you stay at Hequn Nongzhuang, and give us a try. Past visitors have all praised us highly, and you can check out their testimonies for yourself. We feature a wonderfully natural, secure, clean, and comfortable environment and friendly service that makes guests feel at home. Instead of artificial scenery, we’re surrounded by green farmland, mountains, water, and beautiful landscapes everywhere you look. Lie back and enjoy a moment of idle leisure as the white clouds lazily drift by, the wind gently blows, and birds fly and butterflies dance through the air. Recreational facilities include: free bikes, swing chairs, hammock beds, a community ecological fountain pond, and fish and shrimp catching in the area in front of the building.

stays.name: Huihao Small Farmhouse
stays.description: Countryside Retreat in Yilan, TaiwanNestled in the rural landscape of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, this private vacation cottage offers a serene escape surrounded by lush greenery. The standalone modern-minimalist home features an open-concept kitchen, allowing guests to cook and dine while enjoying the picturesque countryside views. Experience the tranquility of Taiwan’s rural lifestyle in this thoughtfully designed farmhouse retreat.Designed and planned by three sisters—a renowned architect, an interior designer, and a travel journalist—this cozy yet stylish homestay embodies warmth and comfort. To ensure an intimate and exclusive experience, we host only one group at a time, accommodating 4 to 6 guests. Ideal for friends and families, it’s the perfect place to unwind and savor the charm of country living.The integrated kitchen and dining area create a welcoming space for shared meals and gatherings. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide unobstructed views of the surrounding farmlands, while the verdant garden and wooden deck with a hanging chair offer a peaceful retreat. Whether you seek relaxation or a quiet getaway, a stay in Yilan promises a rejuvenating rural escape.Important InformationCheck-in: After 4:00 PMCheck-out: Before 12:00 PMAccommodation: 4–6 guests (2 double beds + 1 sofa bed). Please inform us of the number of guests when booking.Amenities: The farmhouse does not have a TV or provide meals. However, the kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, gas stove, microwave, electric kettle, small oven, rice cooker, tableware, cookware, and basic condiments. A 7-Eleven is conveniently located across the street.House Rules:No barbecues or pets allowed.Smoking indoors is strictly prohibited.Absolutely no drug use or parties.Nature & Environment: As this is a rural area, we recommend bringing mosquito repellent.Enjoy a peaceful countryside retreat in Yilan!

We also provide spa and beauty services. Light and Shadow Spa Bed and Breakfast offers natural ecology, water fountains, a flower and herb garden, Indian oil massage, hot stone spa, Decoupage collage, clay, and wooden coloring DIY learning. We are not far away from tourist spots such as Zhentoushan Agricultural Leisure Area, Fushan Botanical Garden,Kuailegu, Dahu Scenic Area, Shuanglianpi, Big Deified Tree, Taiyangpi, Wanglongpi, which are all the unique natural spots of Yuanshan Township. It only takes 10 to 15 minutes from the exit of National Highway No. 5 to arrive at the B&B.

stays.description: Fields of rice gently blow in the wind as guests enjoy the chorus of frogs, fragrange of osmanthus and jasmine, and summer nights under a starry sky. “Yosemite” derived its name from the owner as well as the hope that it could equal the beauty of the famous American national park, and we hope to create an elegant, recreational vacation retreat. The hardware facilities are not particularly grand or luxurious, but rather make use of simplicity and wood elements to create a warm, spacious, and comfortable environment, while the software facilities are infused with our artistic atmosphere and friendly hospitality toward friends. We hope every guest who comes here will enjoy and treasure this place as if it were their own home, that this rest stop will be unforgettable to everyone who visits, and that every guest will feel physically and mentally relaxed. Remember to slow down and enjoy the charming scenery and friendliness of Yilan.

stays.description: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. It’s also just a 16-minute drive to the popular Luodong Night Market. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

stays.name: Chang House
stays.description: Yilan｜Chang HouseA Dwelling That Breathes Along with NatureFollowing the perfectly straight country road, you drive into a golden rice paddy with farm houses scattered throughout. Rolling down the window, you stretch your head out to admire Yilan’s pastoral landscape, the rice stalks by the roadside laiden with grain sway in the gentle breeze to welcome travelers. Following the road signs onwards, you approach your destination: Chang House, in perfect harmony with the natural world, and enveloped in the breeze rich with the aroma of rice.Tasting local refreshments in a classic Yilan residenceHanson is the owner of Chang House. Wearing a warm smile and wooden clogs, he walks out to greet you, leading you along the slate pathway into the back yard. Pushing open the screen door, the wind and sunlight dance together as you see the unique desserts and traditional refreshments that Chang and the housekeepers have prepared for you. As they place the local flavors of Yilan upon the table, you admire the plate arrangement and local ingredients. Taste a bite of kumkuat, enjoying the sweet & sour flavor; salted plum cakes, a local delicacy, stuffed with dehydrated fruit, get sweeter the longer they are chewed; roasted wheat flour tea with a sprinkle of crispy bun cake combines the most classic traditional flavors; wash it all down with a cup of warm honey peach black tea to warm the stomach and the heart.Designed by famous architect Huang Sheng-yuan, Chang House is the most representative residential building in Yilan. The height of the ground floor allows one to appreciate both the view of the fields and the painting-like mountain scenery. Slow down your pace and appreciate the rhythmic interaction between the courtyard and the surrounding natural environment. Even when sitting indoors under the midday sun, you can sense the movement of the wind. The sun floods indoors through large floor-to-ceiling windows, bright and warm. The cubic structure, the square-shaped courtyard, the single pink plumeria tree highlight the year-round beauty of Chang House.A home accordant with nature and founded on peopleEight years in construction, Chang House is founded upon people, accordant with nature, and fused with the local culture. “Looking down at the design of our house from above, you can see the square-within-a-square shape of the Chinese character for return. It is built upon the concept of home, which is precisely what I wanted.” In order to implement this ideal, Hanson waited eight years for the design and construction to be completed. He used patience and trust to exchange for what he loved most.Moving alone from Yilan to Taipei, Hanson got a job as a hairdresser after graduating from high school in order to help ease his family’s economic pressure. Along the way, he met the most important person in his life - Sister Lan. After saving a bit of money, they decided to move together to Yilan and build a home they could call their own. Even though an accident quietly took Sister Lan from this world, her warm spirit had already had a profound influence on Chang House. Hanson says that the property upon which Chang House is built was bought by Sister Lan, so no matter what, he must continue her dream of making her dreamland a reality.The greatest luxury is in fact very simpleChang House’s five suites have all been named after the rooms formerly inhabited by members of Hanson’s family: the Master Bedroom, the Mother Room, the Eldest Daughter Room, the Little Daughter Room, and the Guest Room. All rooms are simple and elegant, while retaining a cozy warmth. Hanson lived with his family in this home for ten years before deciding to share it with the outside world, allowing even more people to stay in a local Yilan residence. His hope was that travelers could also share in their experience of life in this special living room and in this courtyard.In the morning, you enjoy a delicious Chinese-style home cooked meal made entirely of seasonal vegetables and fruit grown in their own garden. Afterwards, you lie in the spacious front yard enjoying the aroma of the rice paddies. In the afternoon, you curl up in a corner of the courtyard with a book. The evening is the most important time of day at Chang House - you climb to the rooftop from where you can enjoy the expansive natural scenery. This is the most magical moment of all, when the golden sun setting beneath orange clouds creates a splendid play of light and shadow across the open fields. It has been said that human beings require sunlight, air, water, and trees. After coming to Chang House, you realize that all you need to do is open your eyes and relax your mind, and all at once, all of these wonderful elements are yours!

stays.name: Feng Che Guan Homestay
stays.description: Nestled along the coast of Zhuangwei Township in Yilan, 9G Love Ocean Villa is conveniently located less than 1 kilometer from several top attractions, including Lanyang Animal and Botanical Kingdom, Zhuangwei Sand Dunes Visitor Center, Yi Qi Yuan Ranch, Zhuangwei Beach Swings, and Yongzhen Seaside Park. It’s also just a 16-minute drive to the popular Luodong Night Market. The villa offers free parking in front of the property, suitable for tour buses or 4–9 cars, and receipts are available—making it ideal for families, student groups, or corporate outings, whether arriving by car or bus.Although the villa consists of two separate buildings—the Main House and Windmill House—they are rented together as one exclusive booking, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and a relaxed experience.There are 17 rooms in total, including: 1 single room (shared bathroom), 1 double room (shared bathroom), 9 double suites, and 6 quadruple suites. Rooms are allocated based on the group size, and unused rooms are securely locked.The base occupancy is 28 people, but the villa can accommodate up to 65 guests with extra beds. Facilities include a spacious 25-ping (approx. 82 sqm) outdoor BBQ area with sunshade and restrooms, a kitchen, KTV karaoke system, electric mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, as well as baby-friendly items like a bathtub, bottle sterilizer, and bed rails. With its proximity to the beach and multiple attractions, Love Ocean Villa is a perfect choice for family-friendly and pet-friendly group stays in Yilan.Rates start at NT$22,000 per night on weekdays (up to 28 guests) and NT$28,000 on weekends (up to 28 guests). Official receipts are available. This villa is highly recommended for family reunions, class gatherings, and company retreats looking for a spacious and private getaway.shared kitchen, coffee machine, and Wi-Fi. It’s also a pet-friendly accommodation, welcoming furry companions for a cleaning fee of NT$1,000 per pet—making it one of the top choices for private pet-friendly stays in Yilan.

stays.name: Lanyang River Riverside third
stays.description: Located in Zhuangwei Township, Yilan, 9G Riverside House (also known as Lanyang Riverside Stay) sits right beside the scenic Lanyang River. It’s just a 12-minute drive from the famous Luodong Night Market and Dongmen Night Market in Yilan City. With free roadside parking right outside the community, it’s the perfect stay for families or groups traveling by car.The house is available as a full-unit rental, with only one group hosted at a time, ensuring privacy and comfort. It includes two buildings—House 2 (No.1) and House 3 (No.3). Each building accommodates 8 to 16 guests, and both together can host up to 32 guests. Inside, you’ll find two double suites and two family suites, each equipped with a private bathroom, balcony, air conditioning, and TV channels. The entire property is non-smoking, and the space is bright, spacious, and designed for a relaxing stay.Rates start at NT$12,000 per night on weekdays (for 12 guests) and NT$16,000 on weekends (for 12 guests). Official receipts can be issued, making it ideal for family gatherings, reunions, or small corporate groups. The house is fully equipped with a kitchen, KTV sound system, automatic mahjong table, free Wi‑Fi, and family-friendly items like a baby bathtub, bed rail, and bottle sterilizer.Just steps from the entrance, a riverside lawn connects directly to the banks of Lanyang River, the largest river in Yilan. Guests can enjoy peaceful walks along the dike path with children, cats, or dogs—a perfect blend of nature and comfort in one ideal riverside retreat.

Although they are not as large and luxurious as a hotel, they are warm and friendly like home.

stays.name: HODUA B&H
stays.description: Website:www.0932587227.com.tw Facebook:https://zh-tw.facebook.com/0932587227.com.tw Our mission: to provide a comfortable resting place for travelers, artists, and worshippers. The wonders of travel: Enjoy a period of wandering, putting your mind at ease, or getting lost in small lanes. Beigang is a small township with four centuries of history, and we welcome you to come for vacation and meet the locals and learn about what brings them fun and happiness, reflecting on the kind of life you wish to pursue. Take thoroughgoing trip and discover that love is the origin of life. We offer great food as well as accommodations! The first floor houses a compound-style Italian restaurant, giving travelers who have come to the old city of Beigang to pray a chance to try out Italian cuisine as well. The bed and breakfast owner’s third son runs the Jiujiuchun Italian Restaurant, approaching his profession with care and using the professionalism he developed from a decade of training in Taipei to prepare healthy dishes for every customer. These delicious, authentic dishes have been strongly recommended by numerous previous guests! Welcome to Beigang, where you can stay at Haozhu Bed and Breakfast and try out the Jiujiuchun Italian Restaurant.

stays.name: Moon Area Business Leisure Motel
stays.description: The word “amazing” is insufficient to describe the feeling one experience when entering the Moon Area Motel. Featuring 41 different themes, we make guests feel as if they’re reading a novel and traveling the world, from Europe to Asia, Japan to Greece. A different theme means a new experience for each visit. Whether you’re in search of luxury and elegance or a subdued yet interesting style, in a room with complete, top-class facilities, you’ll find it here, experiencing a pleasant union of body, mind, and spirit. Our building’s exterior and interior both feature a clean, efficient visual space blending light and heavy materials, and the unassuming items placed here combine four natural elements: sunlight, air, water, and plants, creating a unique harmony. Featuring a South Pacific style, distinct blue and white Mediterranean lines, classic Chinese atmosphere, and friendliness and the sunlight of Bali, our hotel is no longer simply a usage of space but represents a special emotional dialogue. The abundant design energy fills the space with life, while the rooms capture the attention of guests, gradually drawing them to spend the night here. Like a dream airship, it transports us to a fantasy kingdom.

stays.name: Huai-Gu-Yi-Jhan Tradition Inn
stays.description: Room reservation line: (05)5900148 Fax: (05)5901650 The innocent memories of childhood leave a deep impression, and the simple three-section building compound gently recalls them. Our bed and breakfast is a log-built three-section compound integrating modern creative detail, the only traditional bed and breakfast building on the Gukeng Coffee Farm. We welcome families or groups and provide a BBQ area and convenient transportation, being a 5-minute drive from Janfusun Fancyworld. Filled with a strong nostalgic atmosphere, our bed and breakfast features amazing surprises, such as exquisitely carved window patterns, antique jars by the pathway, and an ox-cart pavilion at the fish pond. The sakura and peach flowers blossom, as do the March snow coffee flowers and seasonal fruit. The grounds have a relaxing atmosphere, so come and enjoy a journey of nature and nostalgia! Small vaulted domes are paired with a slanted roof of brick red tiles with shining beige walls and stone pillars. The first floor lobby reaches as high as 23 meters with a bar in the courtyard. stays.name: Kafei Dajie Homestay
stays.description: Room reservation line: 05-5900401 Slowly savor a unique flavor of coffee and enjoy the leisurely atmoshpere of nature. When people mention Gukeng in Yunlin County, pure coffee is definitely the first image that comes to mind. Coffee Street Bed and Breakfast, located in Huashan, is a secure, legally-certified establishment close to Janfusun Fancyworld in Yunlin Gukeng and a number of tourist attractions, featuring a great vacation atmosphere that delights guests, and high-quality coffee brewed partially by hand from homegrown, handpicked beans, winning constant praise from travelers! Coffee Street Bed and Breakfast was established by a PE teacher from Tainan, a local scholar interested both in books and the outdoors, who retired and came to Huashan, Gukeng in search of a comfortable, otherworldly paradise. Mr. Wu is a highly learned man who has written on life philosophy, natural ecology, and historical sites as well as being skilled in calligraphy. His works are on display in the main hall! The suite rooms feature elegant layout, and dark wood furniture gives off a feeling of class, creating an atmosphere of tranquility in combination with the warm yellow wallpaper. In addition to providing accommodation, for your convenience we sell local specialty products and coffee and offer services such as a Huashan cuisine restaurant and ecological tour. Whether you’re here to go hiking, sample high-quality coffee, or buy local specialty products, Coffee Street Bed and Breakfast is the answer to all your needs!

stays.name: Sweet House No.12
stays.description: 'Sweet House No.12 B&B', it's located in Tianxin Village, Gukeng Township, Yunlin County, at the central-south part along the western coast of Taiwan where I called HOME. My hometown is a small farm village, named Tianxin, pronounces the same as 'sweetheart' in Chinese, and 'No.12' is the doorplate of my house.In this village, younger generations have left for better jobs in the major cities like i did before, while I still found adorable Taiwanese bungalows, traditional Taoism culture, functioning rice farms and the most beautiful bamboo woods are still here, waiting to be re-discovered and preserved! So I decided to quit my job and return home. I am certain I can bring the vitality back, revive the village and reserve the cultural value with the power of art by running an art B&B! I already invited 3 artists to create their amazing work here, and will launch an artist resident program in the future to create a peaceful, beautiful retreat for all of us.

I already invited 3 artists to create their amazing work here, and will launch an artist resident program in the future to create a peaceful, beautiful retreat for all of us.

stays.description: Tianxiu Mountain Villa is located in the garden behind Yunlin, Huashan, and Gukeng, surrounded by mountains and streams where visitors can go hiking or quietly enjoy the scenery. We provide eight types of themed wooden houses, suitable for families or groups of co-workers. The grounds includes a BBQ area, tea-brewing area, KTV, riverside restaurant, conference room, and DIY activities like river trekking, plant dyeing, beetle painting, and having coffee with the owner, making this a different kind of bed and breakfast experience. Our mountain villa is located close to the trail entrance, a 10-layer golden waterfall, the Huashan sky ladder, Huashan Lover’s Bridge, Literature Trail, Music Trail, and Ecological Area, providing visitors with a variety of local experiences. The owner runs a local cuisine restaurant offering a coffee shop, “insect meals,” and locally raised chicken, demonstrating the owner’s care and effort.
